1948年6月24日：Berlin Blockade: The Soviet Union blocked rail and road access to West Berlin.
1948年6月25日：Berlin Blockade: The commander of the American occupation zone ordered an airlift of supplies into West Berlin.
1948年6月28日：Yugoslavia was expelled from the Cominform.
1948年9月9日：The Democratic People's Republic of Korea was established.
1949年5月11日：Berlin Blockade: The Soviets lifted the blockade.
1949年8月29日：Joe 1: The Soviet atomic bomb project culminated in a successful test detonation.
1949年10月1日：Chinese Civil War: Mao Zedong proclaims the establishment of the People's Republic of China, with the Soviet Union recognized it the next day.
links: Proclamation of the People's Republic of China

items.text: 1950年1月30日：Korean War: Regarding a mass invasion of the South, Stalin wrote to his ambassador to North Korea: "Tell him [Kim] that I am ready to help him in this matter."
1950年6月25日：Korean War: The North Korean army launched a 135,000-man surprise assault across the 38th parallel.
1950年11月1日：Korean War: Soviet-piloted MiG-15s first crossed the Yalu River and attacked American planes.
1952年11月20日：Prague Trials: A series of show trials purged the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia of Jews and insufficiently orthodox Stalinists.
1953年1月13日：An article in Pravda accused some of the nation's most prominent doctors – particularly Jews – of participating in a vast conspiracy to poison top Soviet leaders.
1953年3月1日：After an all-night dinner with party members Lavrenty Beria, Nikolai Bulganin, Nikita Khrushchev and Georgy Malenkov, Stalin suffered a paralyzing stroke.
1953年3月5日：Stalin died.
1953年3月6日：Malenkov succeeded Stalin as Premier and First Secretary of the Communist Party.
links: General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1953年3月14日：Khrushchev became First Secretary.
links: General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1953年4月3日：The Presidium of the Central Committee of the Communist Party officially acquitted those arrested in connection with the so-called "doctors' plot".
links: Politburo of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1953年6月16日：Uprising of 1953 in East Germany: In response to a 10 percent increase in work quotas, between 60 and 80 construction workers went on strike in East Berlin. Their numbers quickly swelled and a general strike and protests were called for the next day.

1953年6月17日：Uprising of 1953 in East Germany: 100,000 protestors gathered at dawn, demanding the reinstatement of old work quotas and, later, the resignation of the East German government. At noon German police trapped many of the demonstrators in an open square; Soviet tanks fired on the crowd, killing hundreds and ending the protest.
1953年6月26日：Beria was arrested at a special meeting of the Presidium.
1953年7月27日：Korean War: An armistice was signed, ending the conflict.
1953年9月7日：Khrushchev was confirmed as head of the Central Committee.
links: Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1954年5月16日：Kengir Uprising: Prisoners at a Gulag adjacent to the Kazakh village of Kengir occupied the camp's service yard.
1954年6月25日：Kengir Uprising: The prison camp at Kengir was invaded and subdued by Soviet troops and tanks.
1955年6月2日：Khrushchev and Tito issued the Belgrade declaration, which declared that "different forms of Socialist development are solely the concern of the individual countries."

1956年2月25日：At a closed session of the 20th Party Congress, Khrushchev read the "Secret Speech," On the Personality Cult and its Consequences, denouncing the actions of his predecessor Stalin. The speech weakened the hand of the Stalinists in the Soviet government.
links: On the Personality Cult and its Consequences

items.text: 1956年4月17日：The Cominform was officially dissolved.
1956年6月28日：Poznań 1956 protests: Poles upset with the slow pace of destalinization turned to protests, and then to violent riots.
1956年6月29日：Poznań 1956 protests: Konstantin Rokossovsky, the Polish minister of defense, ordered the military in to end the riots. At least 74 civilians were killed.
1956年7月16日：The Karelo-Finnish SSR became the Karelian ASSR of the Russian SFSR.
1956年10月19日：The liberal Władysław Gomułka was elected leader of the Polish Communist party.

1956年10月23日：1956 Hungarian Revolution: A small pro-Gomułka demonstration in Budapest expanded into a 100,000 head protest. The protestors marched on Parliament; when they were fired on by the Hungarian Security Police, they turned violent and began to arm themselves. An emergency meeting of the Central Committee appointed the reformist Imre Nagy Prime Minister.
1956年10月31日：1956 Hungarian Revolution: Hungary under Nagy withdrew from the Warsaw Pact.
1956年11月4日：1956 Hungarian Revolution: A Soviet invasion, involving infantry, artillery, airstrikes, and some 6,000 tanks entered Budapest. 2,500 Hungarians were killed in the ensuing battle.

1956年11月8日：1956 Hungarian Revolution: Pro-Soviet János Kádár announced the formation of a new "Revolutionary Worker-Peasant Government," with himself as Prime Minister and leader of the Communist Party.

1957年6月18日：Led by the Stalinist Anti-Party Group, the Presidium voted to depose Khrushchev as First Secretary. The Presidium reversed its vote under pressure from Khrushchev and the defense minister and deferred the decision to a later meeting of the full Central Committee.
links: Politburo of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1957年6月29日：A Central Committee vote affirmed Khrushchev as First Secretary and deposed Anti-Party Group members Molotov, Kaganovich, and Malenkov from the Secretariat of the CPSU Central Committee.
links: Secretariat of the CPSU Central Committee

items.text: 1957年10月4日：Sputnik was launched at 7:28 pm
1958年3月27日：Khrushchev replaced Bulganin as Premier of the Soviet Union.
1959年1月1日：Cuban Revolution: Revolutionaries led by Fidel Castro overthrow Fulgencio Batista.
1960年4月16日：Sino-Soviet Split: The Chinese Communist Party accused the Soviet leadership of "revisionism."
1960年7月16日：Sino-Soviet Split: Moscow recalled thousands of Soviet advisers from China and ended economic and military aid.
1961年4月12日：Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human to travel into outer space.
1961年8月13日：Construction began on the Berlin Wall.

1962年6月2日：Novocherkassk massacre: Soviet workers gathered in the town square of Novocherkassk to protest an increase in food prices and work quotas. Shots were fired at the rioters, killing 25 and injuring 87 people.

1962年10月16日：Cuban Missile Crisis: President Kennedy is shown aerial photos from U-2 surveillance flights showing missile bases in Cuba. The thirteen days marking the most dangerous period of the Cuban Missile Crisis begin.

1962年10月22日：Cuban Missile Crisis: Kennedy announced that any nuclear missile attack from Cuba would be regarded as an attack by the Soviet Union, and that the island would be placed under "quarantine" to prevent further weapons shipments.
1962年10月26日：Cuban Missile Crisis: The Soviet Union offered to withdraw the missiles in return for a U.S. guarantee not to invade Cuba or support any invasion.
1962年10月28日：Cuban Missile Crisis: Khrushchev announced that he had ordered the removal of the Soviet missiles in Cuba.
1964年10月14日：Khrushchev's rivals in the party deposed him at a Central Committee meeting. Leonid Brezhnev and Alexei Kosygin assumed power as First Secretary and Premier, respectively.
links: Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1967年2月7日：Sino-Soviet split: The Chinese government announced that it could no longer guarantee the safety of Soviet diplomats outside the embassy building.
1967年6月10日：The Soviet Union severed diplomatic relations with Israel. see Soviet Union and the Arab-Israeli conflict
links: Soviet Union and the Arab-Israeli conflict

items.text: 1968年1月5日：Prague Spring: The liberal Alexander Dubček was appointed to succeed Antonín Novotný as First Secretary of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia.

1968年4月5日：Prague Spring: The Communist Party of Czechoslovakia published their Action Programme. This document guaranteed a number of new freedoms including free speech, travel, debate and association.
1968年8月20日：Prague Spring: Between 200,000 and 600,000 Warsaw Pact troops crossed the Czechoslovak border.

1968年8月21日：Prague Spring: Leading KSČ liberals – including Dubček – were arrested, flown to Moscow and forced to repeal the reforms of the Prague Spring. They agreed to the presence of Soviet troops in Czechoslovakia.
1969年3月2日：Sino-Soviet border conflict: A Soviet patrol came into armed conflict with Chinese forces on Zhenbao Island.

1973年1月27日：Vietnam War: The Paris Peace Accords pledged the signatory parties to "respect the independence, sovereignty, unity, and territorial integrity of Vietnam as recognized by the 1954 Geneva Agreements on Vietnam," and promised a complete withdrawal of United States forces from Vietnam and Laos.
1975年4月30日：Vietnam War: People's Army of Vietnam overrun and capitulate the city of Saigon, capital of South Vietnam.
1977年10月7日：Brezhnev Constitution adopted. The Communist Party was proclaimed "the leading and guiding force of the Soviet society".
1978年4月28日：Saur Revolution: Military units loyal to the PDPA assaulted the Afghan Presidential palace, killing President Mohammed Daoud Khan.
1978年5月1日：Saur Revolution: The PDPA installed its leader, Nur Muhammad Taraki, as President of Afghanistan.
1978年7月：A rebellion against the new Afghan government began with an uprising in Nuristan.
1978年12月5日：A treaty was signed that permitted deployment of the Soviet military at the Afghan government's request.
1979年9月14日：Taraki was murdered by supporters of Prime Minister Hafizullah Amin.
1979年12月24日：Soviet–Afghan War: Fearing the collapse of the Amin regime, the Soviet army invaded Afghanistan.
1979年12月27日：Operation Storm-333: Soviet troops occupied major governmental, military and media buildings in Kabul, including the Tajbeg Presidential Palace, and executed Prime Minister Amin.
1980年1月22日：Andrei Sakharov is exiled without charges to the closed industrial city of Gorky for opposing the invasion of Afghanistan.
1980年2月6日：The United States announces its planned boycott of the Moscow Olympics because of the invasion of Afghanistan.
1980年：1980 Summer Olympic Games in Moscow.
1982年1月25日：Suslov died after a severe stroke.
1982年11月10日：Brezhnev died of a heart attack.
1982年11月12日：Yuri Andropov was elected General Secretary of the CPSU.
links: General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1983年9月1日：South Korean Boeing 747 was shot down by the Soviet Air Forces
1984年2月9日：Andropov died after a lengthy kidney disease and was succeeded as General Secretary by Konstantin Chernenko.
links: General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1984年5月8日：Chernenko announces a Soviet-bloc boycott of the Los Angeles-held Summer Olympics, citing security concerns for its athletes.
1985年3月10日：Chernenko died of emphysema.
1985年3月11日：The Politburo unanimously supported Mikhail Gorbachev as General Secretary of the Communist Party.
links: Politburo of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1985年5月7日：Gorbachev launches an anti-alcohol campaign by decree of the Council of Ministers "On measures to overcome alcoholism".
links: Prohibition in the Russian Empire and the Soviet Union

items.text: 1988年4月14日：Soviet–Afghan War: The Soviet government signed the Geneva Accords, which included a timetable for withdrawing their armed forces.
1988年4月13日：Singing Revolution: The Popular Front of Estonia was founded.
1988年6月3日：Singing Revolution: The liberalization movement Sąjūdis was founded in Lithuania.
1988年10月9日：Singing Revolution: The Popular Front of Latvia was founded.
1988年11月15日：Soviet Union and the Arab-Israeli conflict: The Soviet Union recognizes the independence of the State of Palestine declared by the Palestine Liberation Organization.
links: Soviet Union and the Arab-Israeli conflict

items.text: 1988年12月7日：An earthquake destroyed the city of Spitak in northern Armenia.
1989年2月15日：Soviet–Afghan War: The last Soviet troops left the country.
1989年8月23日：Singing Revolution: Two million people joined hands to form the Baltic Way across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania to demonstrate for independence.
1989年11月9日：The East German government loosened restrictions on travel into the West, effecting the end of the Berlin Wall.
1989年11月28日：Velvet Revolution: The Communist Party of Czechoslovakia announced the end of its monopoly on political power.
1989年12月1日：Mikhail Gorbachev meets with Pope John Paul II at the Vatican.
1989年12月7日：Singing Revolution: The Lithuanian parliament ended the political monopoly of the Communist Party of Lithuania.
1989年12月25日：Romanian Revolution of 1989: Romanian dictator Nicolae Ceauşescu and his wife, Elena, were captured in the countryside and executed.
1990年3月11日：Singing Revolution: The Lithuanian government declared its independence from the Soviet Union.
1990年3月18日：Singing Revolution: Elections to the Latvian Supreme Soviet gave the majority of seats to a pro-independence coalition, led by the Popular Front of Latvia.
1990年6月12日：The First Congress of People's Deputies of Russia issued the Declaration of State Sovereignty of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic.
links: Congress of People's Deputies of Russia
Declaration of State Sovereignty of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic

items.text: 1990年8月21日：Gagauzia conflict: The Gagauz declared a new soviet republic on Moldavian soil.
1991年1月11日：January Events: Soviet troops violently seized important buildings in cities throughout Lithuania.
1991年3月17日：A referendum on the future of the Soviet Union was held, with nearly 70% of voters supporting the renewed New Union Treaty.
1991年6月12日：1991 Russian presidential election: Boris Yeltsin was elected to the presidency of the Russian SFSR.

1991年8月19日：Soviet coup attempt of 1991: A group of high-ranking officials calling themselves the State Emergency Committee announced that Gennady Yanayev was to replace Gorbachev as President of the Soviet Union.
1991年8月20日：The Estonian government declared its independence.
1991年8月21日：The government of Latvia declared its independence.
1991年8月21日：Soviet coup attempt of 1991: The military refused State Emergency Committee orders to take the capital. The leaders of the coup were arrested.
1991年8月24日：The Ukrainian parliament adopted the Declaration of Independence of Ukraine.
1991年8月27日：Moldova declared independence.
1991年8月31日：The Republic of Kyrgyzstan declared independence.
1991年9月6日：The Soviet Union recognized the independence of the Baltic states.

1991年9月6日：Militants belonging to the separatist All-National Congress of the Chechen People (NCChP) stormed a session of the Supreme Soviet of the Chechen-Ingush ASSR. NCChP leader Dzhokhar Dudayev was appointed to the presidency.
links: All-National Congress of the Chechen People

items.text: 1991年10月18日：Soviet Union and the Arab-Israeli conflict: The Soviet Union restores full relations with Israel.
links: Soviet Union and the Arab-Israeli conflict

items.text: 1991年10月27日：A national referendum confirmed Dudayev's presidency. Dudayev unilaterally declared the independence of the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria.
1991年12月8日：The leaders of Russia, Belarus and Ukraine signed the Belavezha Accords, dissolving the Soviet Union.
1991年12月26日：The Supreme Soviet confirmed the dissolution of the Soviet Union.
links: Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1992年1月2日：Centralized price controls have been canceled. "Liberalization of prices" started.
1992年3月31日：Treaty of Federation signed by the representatives of the Russian federal government and regional authorities.
1992年10月1日：Voucher privatization begins.
1992年：Ossetian–Ingush Conflict over the eastern parts of the autonomous republic of North Ossetia

1993年9月21日：1993 Russian constitutional crisis: Yeltsin announced the dissolution of the Russian legislature. The legislature, in turn, responded by impeaching Yeltsin and declaring Aleksandr Rutskoy the new President of the Russian Federation.
1993年10月4日：Russian constitutional crisis of 1993: The army occupied the parliament building and arrested a number of its leaders.
1993年12月12日：Russian constitutional crisis of 1993: A new 5th Russian constitution was approved by referendum, vastly increasing the power of the presidency.
1994年8月2日：First Chechen War: The leader of the Russian-backed Provisional Council of the Chechen Republic announced his intention to overthrow Dudayev's government.
1994年12月11日：First Chechen War: Russian troops entered Chechnya.
1996年7月3日：1996 Russian presidential election: Yeltsin narrowly defeated his communist challenger, Gennady Zyuganov.
1996年8月30日：First Chechen War: The Khasav-Yurt Accord was signed, signaling the end of the war.
1999年8月7日：Dagestan War: A Chechnya-based militia invaded the Russian republic of Dagestan in support of local separatists.
1999年8月16日：The State Duma confirmed the appointment of Vladimir Putin as Prime Minister of Russia.
1999年8月23日：Dagestan War: The militias began their retreat back into Chechnya.
1999年8月26日：Second Chechen War: The militia that had invaded Dagestan was bombed inside Chechnya.
1999年9月：Second Chechen War: Russian apartment bombings
1999年10月2日：Second Chechen War: Russian ground troops entered Chechnya.
1999年12月8日：The treaty of creation of the Union of Russia and Belarus was signed.
1999年12月31日：Boris Yeltsin resigned as President of the Russian Federation. Prime Minister Putin became acting president.
2000年3月26日：2000 Russian presidential election: Putin was elected President of Russia with 53 percent of the vote.
2000年8月12日：Russian submarine Kursk explosion: An explosion disabled the Russian submarine K-141 Kursk.
2001年3月23日：Mir - the last national orbital station re-entered Earth's atmosphere.

2002年10月23日：Moscow theater hostage crisis: Chechen rebels seized the Dubrovka theater in Moscow, taking approximately 700 theatergoers hostage, and demanded an immediate Russian withdrawal from Chechnya.

2002年10月26日：Moscow theater hostage crisis: The police pumped anesthetic into the building, then stormed it from every entrance, executing all 42 terrorists. Over 120 hostages also died due to cumulative effects of intoxication, hunger and maltreatment by the terrorists.
2003年：Russia-Ukraine territorial dispute over Tuzla Island
2003年10月25日：Yukos affair: Khodorkovsky arrested.
2004年1月：Russia–Belarus energy dispute.
2004年3月14日：2004 Russian presidential election: Putin won re-election to a second term, earning 71% of the vote.
2004年8月24日：Russian aircraft bombings killed all 90 people on board.

2004年：Beslan school siege. A group of Chechen terrorists took approximately 1100 adults and children hostage at School Number One in Beslan, the ensuing battle left over 330 civilians, 31 of 32 hostage-takers and 10 policemen dead.

2004年9月：Vladimir Putin came up with an initiative to change the appointment procedure for governors, proposing to confirm them in office by decision of legislature from the candidates proposed by the President. Putin logically linked his initiative to the Beslan tragedy.
2004年12月：A bill to abolish direct gubernatorial elections was drafted and adopted.

2005年10月13日：2005 raid on Nalchik: A large group of terrorists assaulted and captured buildings throughout the city of Nalchik. By afternoon, Russian soldiers surrounded and entered the city, forcing their enemies to retreat. Some 136 people were killed.
2005年12月1日：Perm Oblast and Komi-Permyak Autonomous Okrug merged into Perm Krai.
2006年：32nd G8 summit in St. Petersburg
2007年4月23日：Boris Yeltsin died of congestive heart failure.
2008年3月2日：2008 Russian presidential election: Deputy Prime minister Dmitry Medvedev won, earning 70.5% of the vote.
2008年5月7日：Vladimir Putin becomes Prime Minister of Russia.
2008年：Russo-Georgian War: Russia revoked Georgia's attempts to reintegrate breakaway republics of South Ossetia and Abkhazia.
2008年12月31日：2008 Constitutional amendments extended the terms of the President and Parliament
links: 2008 amendments to the Constitution of Russia

items.text: 2009年1月：2009 Russia–Ukraine gas dispute
2009年：Eurovision Song Contest 2009
2009年8月17日：Sayano-Shushenskaya power station accident
2009年12月5日："Lame Horse" nightclub fire
2010年4月8日：The New START treaty, which would cut the nuclear arsenals of Russia and the United States by a third, was signed.
2010年：2010 Russian wildfires
2011年3月27日：Time zones reform reduced its number from 11 to 9
2011年12月4日：2011 Russian legislative election, that caused large protests against alleged vote fraud
2012年3月4日：2012 Russian presidential election: Vladimir Putin won, earning 63.6% of the vote.
2012年6月1日：an Act came into force, which returns the direct election of Governors.
2012年8月22日：Russia became a WTO member.
2013年：2013 Summer Universiade in Kazan
2013年：Russian Far East and Northeastern China affected by heavy flooding on Amur river
2014年：2014 Winter Olympics in Sochi
2014年3月16日：Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation: Referendum on the political status of Crimea
links: Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation

items.text: 2014年3月18日：Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation: Putin and Crimean officials signed the Treaty on Accession of the Republic of Crimea to Russia.
links: Treaty on Accession of the Republic of Crimea to Russia

items.text: 2014年10月26日：2011 time zones reform was canceled
2015年1月1日：The Treaty on the Eurasian Economic Union came into force.
2015年9月30日：Russian military intervention in the Syrian civil war begins
links: Russian military intervention in the Syrian civil war

items.text: 2015年10月31日：Aircraft bombing over Sinai
2015年11月24日：2015 Russian Sukhoi Su-24 shootdown
2016年9月8日：2016 Russian legislative election
2016年12月19日：Assassination of Andrei Karlov
2017年：St. Petersburg International Economic Forum
2017年：2017 FIFA Confederations Cup
2018年3月18日：2018 Russian presidential election
2018年：2018 Kemerovo fire killed at least 60 people.
2018年：The 2018 FIFA World Cup was held in Russia.
2018年：2018 Russian pension protests
2018年10月15日：2018 Moscow–Constantinople schism
2018年10月17日：Kerch Polytechnic College massacre killed 21 people including the perpetrator.
2019年9月8日：2019 Moscow City Duma election preceded by massive public protests in support of unregistered opposition candidates.
2019年：The first (inaugural) Russia-Africa Summit is held at Sochi.
2020年1月15日：2020 Presidential Address to the Federal Assembly. Announcement of the constitutional reform. Resignation of the Cabinet.
links: 2020 Presidential Address to the Federal Assembly
2020 amendments to the Constitution of Russia

2022年2月24日：Russian invasion of Ukraine begins
2022年9月21日：2022 Russian mobilization
2022年9月30日：Russian annexation of Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts
links: Russian annexation of Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts

2024年2月16日：Death and funeral of Alexei Navalny
links: Death and funeral of Alexei Navalny

2024年8月6日：Kursk offensive (2024–present)

前4000000年－前100000年：Tools crafted by proto-humans that have been dated back two million years have been discovered in the northwestern subcontinent. The earliest archaeological site in the subcontinent is the palaeolithic hominid site in the Soan River valley. Soanian sites are found in the Sivalik region across what are now India, Pakistan, and Nepal. Some of the Bhimbetka rock shelters were inhabited by Homo erectus more than 100,000 years ago. Evidence suggested that occupation of the Indian subcontinent by hominins was sporadic until circa 700,000 years ago, and was geographically widespread by around 250,000 years ago. Madrasian culture sites have been found in Attirampakkam (Attrambakkam=13° 13' 50", 79° 53' 20"), which is located near Chennai (formerly known as Madras), Tamil Nadu. Thereafter, tools related to this culture have been found at various other locations in this region. Bifacial handaxes and cleavers are typical assemblages recovered of this culture. Flake tools, microliths and other chopping tools have also been found. Most of these tools were composed of the metamorphic rock quartzite. The stone tool artifacts in this assemblage have been identified as a part of the second inter-pluvial period in India. Evidence for presence of Hominins with Acheulean technology 150,000–100,000 BCE in Tamil Nadu.
前74000年－前30000年：Technology similar to contemporary artifacts found used by Homo sapiens in Africa found in Jwalapuram around 74,000 BCE. Paleolithic industries in South India Tamil Nadu 30,000 BCE.

前9000年：Early Neolithic culture with first confirmed semi-permanent settlements appeared 11,000 years ago in the Bhimbetka rock shelters in modern Madhya Pradesh, India. Some of the Stone Age cave paintings found among the Bhimbetka rock shelters are approximately 30,000 years old. The ancient history of the region includes some of Indian subcontinent's oldest settlements and some of its major civilizations.

前4000年：Phase of the Indus Valley Civilisation begins. The civilization used an early form of the Indus signs, now called Indus script. Over the course of the next 1000–1500 years, inhabitants of the civilization developed new techniques in handicraft (carnelian products, seal carving) and metallurgy (copper, bronze, lead, and tin) had elaborate urban planning, baked brick houses, efficient drainage systems, water supply systems, and clusters of large non-residential buildings. The civilization depended significantly on trade, was the first civilization to use wheeled transport in the form of bullock carts, and also used boats.
前2800年：The Indus Valley Civilization expand across the whole of modern-day Pakistan, much of northern India, and large parts of Afghanistan, with Harappa and Mohenjo-daro becoming large metropolises.
前2600年：End of the Early Indus Valley Civilization culture. Start of Mature Indus Valley Civilization culture.
前1900年：End of Mature Indus Valley Civilization culture, late Indus Valley Civilization period starts.
前1800年：Adichanallur urn-burial site in Tirunelveli district in Tamil Nadu. In 2004, a number of skeletons dating from around 3,800 years ago.
前1700年：Brihadratha also known as Maharatha, was the initiator of the Brihadratha dynasty, the earliest ruling dynasty of Magadha according to the Puranas.
前1680年：Jarasandha was the son of Brihadratha and became the 2nd ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding his father.
前1665年：Sahadeva of Magadha became the 3rd ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Jarasandha.
前1661年：Somadhi became the 4th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Sahadeva of Magadha.
前1603年：Srutasravas became the 5th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Somadhi.
前1539年：Ayutayus became the 6th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Srutasravas.
前1503年：Niramitra became the 7th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Ayutayus.
前1500年：Early Vedic period (until 1000 BCE) begins.
前1463年：Sukshatra became the 8th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Niramitra.
前1405年：Brihatkarman became the 9th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Sukshatra.
前1400年：Gopala Dynasty established by Gopa.
前1382年：Senajit became the 10th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Brihatkarman.
前1332年：Srutanjaya became the 11th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Senajit.
前1300年：Indus Valley Civilization and Cemetery H culture comes to an end.
前1292年：Vipra became the 12th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Srutanjaya.
前1280年：Pundravardhana Kingdom was established sometime before 1280 BCE.
前1257年：Suchi became the 13th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Vipra.
前1200年：Rigveda codified. The Kuru kingdom is established.
前1199年：Kshemya became the 14th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Suchi.
前1171年：Subrata became the 15th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Kshemya.
前1107年：Dharma became the 16th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Subrata.
前1043年：Dharma stepped down as the 16th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha.
前1008年：Susuma became the 17th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Dharma.
前1000年：Middle and Late Vedic period (to 500 BCE).
前1000年－前300年：Kanchi district, gold mine of Megalithic sites in Tamil Nadu, South India.
前1000年－前900年：Kingdom of the Videhas and the Pañcāla Kingdom was established.
前970年：Dridhasena became the 18th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Susuma.
前912年：Sumati became the 19th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Dridhasena.
前879年：Subala became the 20th ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Sumati.
前877年：Birth of Parsvanatha, 23rd Jain Tirthankara (traditional date).
前857年：Sunita became the 21st ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Subala.
前841年：Gopala Dynasty was de-established.
前817年：Satyajit became the 22nd ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Sunita.
前767年：Viswajit became the 23rd ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Satyajit.
前732年：Ripunjaya became the 24th and the last ruler of the Barhadratha dynasty of Magadha succeeding Viswajit.
前700年：The Upanishads, a sacred text of Hinduism, are written.
前700年：Kingdom of Kosala was established. Kosala belonged to the Northern Black Polished Ware culture (c. 700–300 BCE).
前600年：Sixteen Maha Janapadas ("Great Realms" or "Great Kingdoms") emerge.
前600年：The Chola, Pandya, and Chera dynasties are established.
前600年：The capital of the Early Pandyan Kingdom was initially Korkai, all around 600 BCE, and was later moved to Koodal (now Madurai) during the reign of Nedunjeliyan I.
前599年：Mahavira of the 24th Tirthankara is born. This turns out to become the most famous wave of Jainism.
前563年：Siddhārtha Gautama, Buddha-to-be, is born in Lumbini into a leading royal family in the republic of the Shakyas, which is now part of Nepal.

前543年：The Vanga-based Prince Vijaya (c. 543 BCE) married a daughter of the Pandyan king of Madurai, to whom he was sending rich presents every year. Sinhala chronicle Mahavamsa or the Great Chronicle of Sri Lanka mentions this event.
前538年：Cyrus, founder of the Persian Achaemenid Empire reached up to northwestern parts of the Indian subcontinent, today's Afghanistan.
前527年：Nirvana of Mahavira achieves Moksha.
約前525年：Kuru kingdom was de-established.
約前500年：The Vedic period ends.
前483年：Proposed Mahaparinirvana date of Gautama Buddha at Kushinagar.
前400年：Siddhartha Gautama 'Buddha' of the Shakya polity in South Nepal, founds Buddhism (older date: 563–483 BCE)

前350年：Pāṇini, labelled as the father of linguistics, a resident of Gandhara, describes the grammar and morphology of Sanskrit in the text Aṣṭādhyāyī. Pāṇini's standardized Sanskrit is known as Classical Sanskrit.
前333年：Persian rule in the northwest ends after Darius III is defeated by Alexander the Great, who establishes the Macedonian Empire after inheriting the Persian Achaemenid Empire.
前326年：Ambhi king of Takshila surrenders to Alexander.
前326年：Porus who ruled parts of the Punjab, fought Alexander at the Battle of the Hydaspes.
前321年：Maurya Empire is founded by Chandragupta Maurya in Magadha after he defeats the Nanda Empire. Mauryan capital city is Pataliputra (modern Patna in Bihar).
前305年：Chandragupta Maurya defeats Seleucus I Nicator of the Seleucid Empire.

前304年：Seleucus gives up his territories in the subcontinent (Afghanistan/Baluchistan) to Chandragupta in exchange for 500 elephants. Seleucus offers his daughter in marriage to Chandragupta to seal their friendship.

前290年－前270年：Pingala, ancient Indian mathematician and poet writes the Chandaḥśāstra (also called the Pingala-sutras), which presents the description of a binary numeral system for prosody. He described meters in the form of short and long syllables.
前273年：Ashoka the Great regarded as the greatest ancient Indian emperor, grandson of Chandragupta Maurya, ascends as emperor of the Maurya Empire.
前266年：Ashoka conquers and unifies most of Indian subcontinent, along with most of Afghanistan and Balochistan.
前265年：Kalinga War takes place between Ashoka and the Kingdom of Kalinga.

前261年：After conquering Kalinga, Ashoka who recently converted into Buddhism and made it a quasi-official state religion of the Maurya Empire, reportedly regrets what he has done and relinquishes violence.
前260年：Ashoka inscribes the Edicts of Ashoka, written down using Brahmi script. The Edicts describe his Buddhist religious views and his commitment to the welfare of his subjects.
前232年：Ashoka dies and is succeeded by Kunala.
前230年：Simuka declares independence from Mauryan rule and establishes the Satavahana Empire.
前200年：Kuninda Kingdom is established.
前200年：Tolkāppiyam describes the grammar and morphology of Tamil; it is the oldest existing Tamil grammar (dates vary between 200 BCE and 100 CE).

前200年：Indo-Greek Kingdom (also known as the Yavana Kingdom) is established. It was a Hellenistic-era Greek kingdom covering various parts of Afghanistan and the northwestern regions of the Indian subcontinent (parts of modern-day Pakistan and northwestern India). The kingdom was founded when the Graeco-Bactrian king Demetrius (and later Eucratides) invaded India from Bactria in 200 BCE. During its existence, the kingdom was ruled over by 30 successive kings, with Menander I being the most famous Indo-Greek king.
前185年：The Mauryan Empire ends.

前165年或前155年：Menander I becomes the king of the Indo-Greek Kingdom. Menander is noted for having become a patron of and convert to Greco-Buddhism and he is widely regarded as the greatest of the Indo-Greek kings.

前100年：Birth of Charaka, ancient Indian physician who writes the Charaka Samhita, an ancient text that describes theories on human body, etiology, symptomology and therapeutics for a wide range of diseases and is based on the Agnivesha Samhitā.
前65年：The Pandyan king sends ambassadors to the Greek and Roman lands.
前58年：Beginning of Vikram Era.
前1年：Fall of the Indo-Greek Kingdom.
35年：Western Satraps formed.
68年：Establishment of the Kushan Empire by Kujula Kadphises.
79年：Gautamiputra Satakarni becomes Satavahana emperor and starts Shalivahana era calendar after defeating Scythian king Maues.
113年：Vima Kadphises becomes the ruler of the Kushan Empire. He was the Kushan Emperor to first introduce gold coinage, in addition to the existing silver and copper coinage.
127年：Kanishka ascends the throne of the Kushan Empire, succeeding Vima Kadphises. Under his reign, the Kushan Empire reached its zenith.
240年：Sri-Gupta starts the Gupta Empire in Magadha, with its capital in Pataliputra
250年：The Vakataka Dynasty in the Deccan is formed by Vindyashakti. He rules until 275.
275年：The Pallava dynasty is established.

275年：Pravarasena ascends the throne of the Vakataka Dynasty, expanding his empire. He was the first Vakataka ruler who called himself a Samrat, or emperor. He is perhaps the only emperor in his dynasty.
320年：Chandragupta I ascends the Gupta throne.
335年：Samudragupta ascends the Gupta throne and expands the empire.
345年：Kadamba Kingdom established by Mayurasharma, Banavasi as its capital and they were the first kingdom to use Kannada in administration.
380年：Chandragupta II, Samudragupta's son becomes the Gupta Emperor.

390年：Prabhavatigupta, a Gupta Princess who was the daughter of Chandragputa II, becomes the regent of the Vakataka dynasty after the death of her husband Rudrasena II, effectively ruling the Vakatakas until 410.
413年：Kumaragupta I adopted the title of Mahendraditya.
455年：Skandagupta, faced Hunas effectively.
467年：Invasions by the Huna. Pallavas became a major power during the reign of Mahendravarman I (590 – 630 CE).
475年：Harishena takes over the Vakataka Dynasty. He was a great patron of Buddhist Art. The World Heritage monument Ajanta Caves is a surviving example of his works.
476年：Birth of Aryabhata, ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer who goes on to write the Aryabhatiya, a Sanskrit astronomical treatise and the Arya-siddhanta.

502年：Mihirakula becomes the ruler of the Alchon Huns. He was the second and last of the Alchon Huns. He was considered to be an extremely violent and cruel ruler. He destroyed many Buddhist monasteries in his kingdom.
528年：Confederation of Indian rulers Yashodharman, Narasimhagupta and Adityavardhana defeat the Huna emperor Mihirakula in the Battle of Sondani.
528年－540年：Yashodharman conquers vast territories from the Hunas and Guptas after the Battle of Sondani, and establishes the short-lived Aulikara Empire
554年：Collapse of Gupta Empire after the death of Vishnugupta.

573年：Varāhamihira, ancient Indian astrologer, astronomer, and polymath writes the Pañcasiddhāntikā, a treatise on mathematical astronomy which summarises five earlier astronomical treatises by five authors.
606年：Harsha is crowned Monarch of Kannauj.

628年：Ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer Brahmagupta completes the Brāhmasphuṭasiddhānta, a text on mathematical astronomy explaining the role of zero, rules for manipulating both negative and positive numbers, a method for computing square roots, methods of solving linear and quadratic equations, and rules for summing series, Brahmagupta's identity, and Brahmagupta's theorem. Brahmagupta described gravity as a force of attraction. He posited that it is the nature of the Earth to attract objects, a significant departure from the Aristotelian view of objects seeking their "natural place".
637年：Badami Chalukya power at its peak. Pulakeshin II pushes north up to the Narmada and defeats the invading Harshavardhana of Kanauj.
647年：Death of Harsha.

665年：Ancient Indian mathematician and astronomer Brahmagupta completes the astronomical treatise Khandakhadyaka covering topics such as the longitudes of the planets, diurnal rotation, lunar and solar eclipses, risings and settings, the moon's crescent and conjunctions of the planets.
700年：According to the Qissa-i Sanjan, the immigrants Parsi are granted permission to stay by the local ruler Jadi Rana.
711年：Arab commander of the Umayyad Caliphate, Muhammad bin Qasim defeats Raja Dahir, king of Sindh Region in modern-day Pakistan.
728年：Narasimhavarman II of the Pallava dynasty constructs the Shore Temple of Mamallapuram.
736年：Delhi is re-established by Bilan Deo Tomar also known as Anangpal Tomar.

738年：Confederacy of Indian kings consisting of Nagabhata I of Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty and Bappa Rawal, ruler of Mewar defeat Arab Umayyad Caliphate invasion attempts in the Battle of Rajasthan (738 CE)
739年：Avanijanashraya Pulakeshin of the Chalukyas of Navasarika kingdom defeats an invasion attempt by the Arab Umayyad Caliphate.
753年：Establishment of Rashtrakuta Kingdom of Manyakhet by Dantidurga by defeating Chalukyas of Badami
753年：Saindhava naval fleet defeats Arab naval fleet sent by the Arab governor of Sindh.
776年：Saindhava naval fleet under Agguka I defeats second Arab naval expedition.
788年：Birth of Adi Shankara.
800年：Vikramashila University is established by the Pala emperor Dharmapala in present-day Bhagalpur district in Bihar, in early 9th century
814年：Nripatunga Amoghavarsha I becomes Rashtrakuta emperor. Kannada literature flourishes.
836年：Mihira Bhoja, regarded as the greatest ruler of the Gujara-Pratihara dynasty, he reorganized the empire to its peak.
935年：Chandrapur University established in 935 CE by Srichandra,(Jatin korgaonkar) a ruler of the Chandra dynasty.
985年：Rajaraja Chola ascends to the throne of Chola empire. He expands the empire to Sri Lanka and to the north to include Kalinga kingdom.
993年：Rajaraja Chola invades Sri Lanka, capturing the northern half.
1000年：Invasion of Mahmud of Ghazni begins (1000–1025 CE).
1003年－1010年：The Brihadisvara Temple is built by Raja Raja Chola I.
1014年－1025年：Rajaraja Chola adds the Lakshadweep and Maldives islands to the Chola empire.

1014年－1025年：Rajendra Chola I became the king of Chola Empire after his father Rajaraja Chola. During his reign, he extended the influences of the already vast Chola empire up to the banks of the river Ganges in the north and across the ocean. Rajendra's territories extended coastal Burma, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Maldives, conquered the kings of Srivijaya (Sumatra, Java and Malay Peninsula in South East Asia) and Pegu islands with his fleet of ships. He defeated Mahipala, the Pala king of Bengal and Bihar, and to commemorate his victory he built a new capital called Gangaikonda Cholapuram. The Cholas became one of the most powerful dynasties in Asia during his reign. The Tamil Chola armies exacted tribute from Thailand and the Khmer kingdom of Cambodia. Rajendra Chola I was the first Indian king to take his armies overseas and make conquests of these territories, even though there is epigraphical evidence of Pallava presence in these very areas.
1014年：Mahmud Ghazni defeats the Hindu Shahi king Trilochanapala and annexes Punjab. He then attempts to invade Kashmir, but is defeated by Sangramaraja.
1017年：al-Biruni travelled to the Indian subcontinent.
1017年4月26日：Ramanuja is born at Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu.
1021年：Mahmud of Ghazni again attempts to invade Kashmir, but is defeated by Samgrāmarāja.
1025年4月30日：Last invasion of Mahmud Ghazni, sacked and destroyed temple of Somnath.
1027年：The Sun Temple of Modhera is completed by Bhima I of the Chaulukya dynasty
1030年4月30日：Death of Mahmud of Ghazni.
1033年6月15日：Suhaldev, king of Shravasti defeats and kills Ghazi Saiyyad Salar Masud, nephew of Mahmud of Ghazni.
1035年：The Brihadisvara Temple, Gangaikonda Cholapuram is built by Rajendra Chola I.
1058年：Soomra dynasty ends the Arab domination and establishes its own rule over Sindh.
1120年：Kalyani Chalukyas power at its peak. Vikramaditya VI ushers in Vikrama Chalukya era.
1121年：Ajayaraja II, of the Chahamanas of Shakambhari dynasty repulse Ghaznavid invasions.
1134年：Life of Basaveshwara, philosopher and social reformer (to 1196).
1149年9月30日：Birth of the Great poet and writer of India Chand Baradai in Lahore.

1150年：Bhāskara II, mathematician and astronomer writes the Siddhānta Shiromani, consisting of three books Līlāvatī on arithmetic and measurement, Bijaganita on algebra and Gaṇitādhyāya and Golādhyāya on astronomy.
1157年：The Kalachuris of Kalyani under Bijjala II capture Kalyani
1175年：Muhammad of Ghor invades India.
1178年：Forces of the Chaulukya king Mularaja II led by his regent mother Naiki Devi defeat Ghurid invaders led by Muhammad of Ghor who escapes back to Ghazni, in the Battle of Kasahrada.
1191年：First Battle of Tarain between Mohammed Ghori and Prithviraj III. Ghori is defeated by Prithivi Raj Chauhan III.
1192年：Second Battle of Tarain fought between Muhammed Ghori and Prithviraj Chauhan III. Prithviraj Chauhan III is defeated by Mohammed Ghori.
1193年：Muslim general Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khalji destroys the ancient university of Vikramashila.
1194年：Battle of Chandawar fought between Muhammad of Ghor and Jaichand of Kannauj. Ghori defeated Jayachandra and killed him.

1204年：Trailokyavarman, the Chandela ruler defeats the Ghurid Empire in the Battle of Kakadadaha and retakes the Kalinjar Fort. Subsequently he restores and expands Chandela power across much of the former Chandela realm.
1206年3月15日：Khokhars killed Muhammad Ghori during a raid on his camp on the Jhelum River, marking the end of 14 years of Ghurid rule over northern India (1192–1206).
1206年6月25日：Qutb ud-Din Aibak establishes slave dynasty (Mamluk) later to be known as Delhi Sultanate, beginning 320 years rule over India (1206–1526).
1206年：Raja Prithu defeats Muhammad Bakhtiyar Khalji, destroying his army of 12,000 with only about 100 survivors.
1210年：Qutb ud-Din Aibak dies while playing polo.
1210年：Shams ud-Din Iltutmish, the third ruler of the Delhi Sultanate, belonging to the Mamluk dynasty (slave dynasty), introduced IQTA (tax, revenue) system. Died in 1236.
1211年－1215年：Anangabhima Deva III of the Eastern Ganga dynasty in present-day Odisha defeats invasions by Ghiyāth ad-Dīn ʿIwaz Khalji the ruler of Bengal.
1221年：Genghis Khan invades Punjab in pursuit of the fleeing Khwarezm Shah Jalal al-Din Mangburni and defeats him in the Battle of the Indus.
1226年：Raja Prithu repulses invading forces of Ghiyas ud din Balban the ninth sultan of the Mamluk dynasty of Delhi, in present-day Assam

1229年：Sandhya (ruler of Kamarupa) in present-day Assam drives Muslims out of his territory and captures territory till Karatoya river. Thereafter, to avenge previous defeats, he invades the western border of Gaur (Lakhnauti) and annexes regions across the Karatoya into his kingdom.

1236年：Narasingha Deva I ruler of the Eastern Ganga dynasty in present-day Odisha launches attacks against the Turko-Afghan rulers of Mamluk dynasty in Bengal that had captured Bihar and Bengal and not only repulses their attacks, but pushes them as far back as Padma River in current-day Bangladesh.
1236年11月10日：Rule of Razia Sultana; the daughter of Iltutmish.
1238年10月：Sri Madhwacharya born in Pajaka near Udupi, Karnataka
1240年10月14日：Murder of Razia Sultan by Turkish nobles (Chalisa).

1243年：Narasingha Deva I ruler of the Eastern Ganga dynasty defeats Tughral Tughan Khan of the Mamluk Sultanate of Delhi in the Battle of Katasin and annexes several districts of Bengal into his empire.
1246年－1266年：Rule of Nasiruddin Mahmud with support of Balban (Wazir and powerful member of Chalisa). Chalisa- a council of 40 members.
1250年：The Konark Sun Temple is completed, built by Narasingha Deva I.

1257年：The Kamrup kingdom, led by its ruler Sandhya defeats and executes Malik Ikhtiyaruddin Yuzbak, the Mamluk Governor of Bengal. His domains are split between the Kamrup kingdom and Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga Empire.
1266年－1286年：Rule of Balban; Chalisa wiped out.
1267年：The Mahanubhava philosophy established by Chakradhar Swami.
1275年：Birth of saint Dnyaneshwar.
1290年：Murder of Muiz ud din Qaiqabad by Jalaluddin Firuz Khalji, an army commander.
1290年－1296年：Jalal-ud-din Khilji founds the Khiliji Dynasty.
1309年：Alauddin Khalji sends Malik Kafur to South. Malik Kafur Lays siege on the Kakatiya dynasty Capital Warangal and Extracts Tribute. The diamond Kohinoor was among the loot collected.
1310年：Ala-ud-din Khilji's army under Malik Kafur occupies Devagiri ending the Seuna Yadava Kingdom

1311年：Malik Kafur attacks the Hoyasalas. In the aftermath of the destruction Hoyasalas abandon the old capital Halebidu. He later attacks Madurai. The attacks on Warangal, Halebidu and Madurai is accompanied by wide scale killing, destruction of temples and repatriation of wealth back to Delhi.
1323年11月9日：Ulugh Khan (Muhammad bin Tughluq) defeats Prataparudra II ending the Kakatiya dynasty.
1333年：Prithvi Chand II of the Hindu Katoch kingdom of Kangra defeats the army of Muhammad bin Tughluq who loses nearly all his 10,000 soldiers and is forced to retreat.

1334年：Musunuri Kapaya Nayaka with assistance from the Hoysala ruler Veera Ballala III leads a rebellion against the Tughluq rule of Delhi Sultanate, driving it out of Warangal region in present-day Telangana.
1336年4月18日：Vijayanagara Empire established by Harihara I and his brother Bukka Raya I.
1336年：Rana of Mewar Hammir Singh defeats and captures Tughlaq dynasty ruler Muhammad bin Tughluq in the Battle of Singoli.

1340年：Birth of great mathematician Madhava of Sangamagrama who goes on to found the Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics and write the Venvaroha, which describes the methods for the computation of the true positions of the Moon at intervals of about half an hour for various days in an anomalistic cycle.
links: Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics

items.text: 1343年：Veera Ballala III captured and killed in the Battle of Kannanur.
1347年：Governor Hasan Gangu revolts against Muhammad bin Tughluq founding the Bahmani Sultanate.
1351年：Samma Dynasty assumes rule over Sindh.
1370年：Bukka, the Vijayanagara ruler and his son Kumara Kamapna capture the entire Tamil speaking parts.
1398年：Sack of Delhi is committed by Timur's invasion. He plunders cities such as Lahore, Tulamba, Multan, and Bhatner.
1401年：Dilawar Khan establishes the Malwa Sultanate in present-day northern India.
1407年：Zafar Khan: governor of Gujarat, declares himself as Sultan Muzaffar Shah founding the Gujarat Sultanate/Muzaffarid dynasty.
1414年：Khizr Khan, deputized by Timur to be the governor of Multan takes over Delhi founding the Sayyid dynasty
1424年：Deva Raya II succeeded his father Veera Vijaya Bukka Raya as monarch of the Vijayanagara Empire
1437年：Rana Kumbha of Mewar and Rao Ranmal Rathore of Marwar defeat and take prisoner Mahmud Khalji, Sultan of the Malwa Sultanate in the Battle of Sarangpur
1442年：Rana Kumbha of Mewar defeats Mahmud Khalji in the Battle of Mandalgarh
1443年：Abdur Razzaq visits India.
1446年：Rana Kumbha of Mewar defeats Mahmud Khalji in the Battle of Banas
1446年：Mallikarjuna Raya succeeds his father Deva Raya II
1449年9月26日：Sankardev, founder of Ekasarana Dharma was born in Nagaon, Assam.

1450年：Shri Guru Ravidas Ji was born in 1450 in Varanasi. He was an Indian mystic poet-sant of the Bhakti movement during the 15th to 16th century CE. Venerated as a guru in the region of Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh, the devotional songs of Ravidas have had a lasting impact upon the bhakti movement.
1451年4月19日：Bahlul Khan Lodhi ascends the throne of the Delhi sultanate starting the Lodhi dynasty

1456年：Rana Kumbha of Mewar defeats the combined armies of Shams Khan (sultan of Nagaur) and Qutbuddin Ahmad Shah II (Sultan of Gujarat) in the Battle of Nagaur and captures Nagaur, Kasili, Khandela and Shakambhari. Nagaur Sultanate ceases to exist.
1469年4月15日：Guru Nanak, the founder of Sikhism, is born.
1474年：Rao Jodha defeats Bahlol Khan and Hussian Shah of Jaunpur Sultanat.
1483年2月14日：Birth of Babur in Andijan, Fergana Valley in Central Asia.
1485年：Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya drives out Praudha Raya ending the Sangama Dynasty.
1486年：Advent of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, founder of Gaudiya Vaishnavism and leader of the world's first civil disobedience movement, in Navadwip, West Bengal.
1490年：Ahmadnagar declares independence, followed by Bijapur and Berar in the same year thus breaking up the Bahmani Sultanate.
1492年3月30日：Satal Rathore of Marwar kills Afghan warlord Gudhla Khan in the Battle of Peepar, to rescue 140 girls abducted by the Afghans. He later succumbs to injuries sustained in the battle.
1498年5月20日：Vasco de Gama was the first portage's sailor first voyage from Portugal to India and back (in 1499).
1503年：Kingdom of Cochin is taken over by the Portuguese creating the first European settlement in India.
1508年2月3日：The Christian-Islamic power struggle in Europe and the Middle East. Spills over into the Indian Ocean as Battle of Chaul during the Portuguese-Mamluk War.
1509年2月3日：Battle of Diu marks the beginning of the dominance of the Europeans in the Asian naval theater.
1518年：Kingdom of Mewar under Rana Sanga defeats Lodi Empire under Ibrahim Lodhi in the Battle of Khatoli, gains control over north eastern Rajasthan.
1519年：Kingdom of Mewar under Rana Sanga defeats the Malwa Sultanate and the Gujarat Sultanate in the Battle of Gagron, obtains control of Malwa.
1519年：The Kingdom of Mewar under Rana Sanga again defeats Lodi Empire under Ibrahim Lodi in the Battle of Dholpur, extends control up to Agra.
1520年：Vijayanagara Empire under Krishnadevaraya defeats the Sultanate of Bijapur in the Battle of Raichur.
1520年：Rana Sanga leads a coalition of Rajput armies to invade the Gujarat Sultanate, reinstates Raimal as the Rao of Idar. The Sultan of Gujarat is forced to flee to Muhammadabad.
1520年：The mystic poet-sant of the Bhakti movement, Shri Guru Ravidas, dies.
1522年：The Portuguese land on the Coromandel Coast.

1526年4月21日：Sultan Ibrahim Lodi, of the Delhi Sultanate, angers local nobles, who respond by inviting Babur, the Mughal ruler of Kabul, to invade Delhi and Agra. The local population, plus the possession of artillery, assists Babur in killing the Sultan (whose soldiers desert him) at the First Battle of Panipat. Marks the beginning of Mughal Empire.
links: List of emperors of the Mughal Empire

items.text: 1527年3月17日：Babur defeats Rana Sanga of Mewar in the Battle of Khanwa.
1530年：Astronomer-mathematician Jyeṣṭhadeva of the Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics writes the Yuktibhāṣā, a major treatise on mathematics and astronomy in Malayalam.
links: Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics

items.text: 1530年：Babur completes his Baburnama, reflecting on society, politics, economics, history, geography, nature, flora and fauna, which to this day is a standard textbook in 25 countries. Babur dies, and is succeeded by his son Humayun.
1532年：Ahoms under king Suhungmung defeat Turbak Khan of the Bengal Sultanate in Battle of Hatbor.
1533年：Ahoms under king Suhungmung defeat Turbak Khan of the Bengal Sultanate in Battle of Duimunisila.
1539年：Battle of Chausa fought between Humayun and Sher Shah Suri in which Humayun is defeated.
1539年：Guru Angad Dev becomes second guru of Sikhs.
1540年9月18日：Battle of Kannauj fought between Humayun and Sher Shah Suri and Humayun was completely defeated. Humayun lost the Mughal empire to Afghans (Suri Dynasty), and passed 12 years in exile.
1540年5月9日：Maharana Pratap Singh of Mewar (son of Maharana Udai Singh II) is born.
1542年10月15日：Akbar is born at Umerkot.
1545年5月22日：Death of Sher Shah Suri and succeeded by Islam Shah Suri.
1552年3月26日：Guru Amar Das becomes third Guru of Sikhs.
1554年11月22日：Islam Shah Suri dies.
1555年5月22日：Humayun regained the throne of Delhi from the hands of weak successors of Sher Shah after Battle of Sirhind.
1556年1月27日：Humayun dies, and is succeeded by his son Akbar.
1556年10月7日：Hindu king Hemu defeats Mughal forces in the Battle of Tughlaqabad.
1556年11月5日：Hindu king Hemu establishes his raj in North India and bestowed with title of Vikramaditya. He was defeated at the Second Battle of Panipat by Akbar and Bairam Khan's forces.
1565年1月26日：Battle of Talikota results in the rout of Vijayanagara Empire.
1568年：Paradesi Synagogue, the first Jewish synagogue in India constructed by the Paradesi Jews.

1572年：Akbar annexes Gujarat, also shifts the Mughal capital to Fatehpur Sikri where a new township and citadel containing buildings of a unique all-India character—inspired by the architecture of Bengal, Gujarat, Malwa, Kashmir as well as the Timurid world—is born.
1574年9月1日：Guru Ram Das becomes fourth Guru of Sikhs.
1574年：Akbar annexes Bengal.
1581年9月1日：Guru Arjan Dev becomes fifth Guru of Sikhs.
1582年：Maharana Pratap defeats Mughal governor in Battle of Dewair in present-day Rajasthan
1586年10月6日：Akbar annexes Kashmir.
1589年：Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) build in Amritsar by Guru Arjan.
1600年12月31日：East India Company is formed in England. Gets exclusive trading rights with India.
1602年：Dutch came to India at Pulicut (back to 1825).
1605年10月27日：Akbar dies, and is succeeded by his son Jahangir.
1606年5月25日：Guru Hargobind is selected to becomes the sixth guru of Sikhs by Guru Arjan.
1606年5月30日：Guru Arjan is tortured and killed under orders of Mughal Emperor Jahangir for refusing to convert to Islam.
1612年8月24日：East India Company enters into a trade agreement with the Mughal Emperor Jahangir.
1616年：Susenghphaa, ruler of the Ahom kingdom defeats Mughal forces in a land and naval battle at Bharali, Assam.
1621年：Sikhs army led by Guru Hargobind defeat Mughals in the Battle of Rohilla.
1628年：Jahangir announces "Chain of Justice" outside his palace that anyone can ring the bell and get a personal hearing with the emperor. Jahangir dies, and is succeeded by his son Shah Jahan.
1630年2月19日：Shivaji, future founder of Maratha Empire is born in Shivneri Fort, near Pune.
1634年：Sikhs armies led by Guru Hargobind defeat Mughal armies in the Battle of Amritsar (1634) and Battle of Lahira.
1635年4月25日：Sikhs army led by Guru Hargobind defeat a Mughal army in the Battle of Kartarpur.
1636年：Establishment of Kohra (estate) by Babu Himmat Sah.
1644年3月8日：Guru Har Rai becomes seventh guru of Sikhs.
1640年：Rani Karnavati of the Garhwal Kingdom repels and defeats invasion attempt by Mughal army of Shah Jahan.

1658年：Shah Jahan completes Taj Mahal, Jama Masjid, and Red Fort. Imperial treasuries drained by architectural and military overexpenditures. Shah Jahan put under house arrest, and is succeeded by his son Aurangzeb.

1659年2月19日：Shivaji's ill-equipped and small Maratha army defeat numerically much larger Adilshahi troops at the Battle of Pratapgarh marking the first victory of the Maratha Kingdom. Shivaji personally kills Adilshahi commander Afzal Khan (general).
1659年12月27日：Marathas under Shivaji defeat the Adilshahi troops in the Battle of Kolhapur.
1660年7月13日：Maratha army of 600 defeats a much larger army of the Bijapur Sultanate of 10,000 in the Battle of Pavan Khind, near the city of Kolhapur.
1661年2月3日：Marathas under Shivaji defeat Mughal Empire forces in the Battle of Umberkhind.
1661年10月6日：Guru Har Krishan becomes eight guru of Sikhs.
1664年：Marathas under Shivaji defeat Mughal Empire forces in the Battle of Surat.
1665年2月13日：Shivaji conducts a raid on the Portuguese colony in Basrur and gains a large booty which enables him to strengthen the base of his new kingdom by building a strong navy and forts.
1665年3月20日：Guru Tegh Bahadur becomes ninth Guru of Sikhs.
1665年6月11日：Treaty of Purandar (1665) (or पुरंदर चा तह) was signed between Shivaji and the Rajput ruler Jai Singh I.
1669年11月28日：Jats defeats the Mughal Empire in the Battle of Tilpat takes control of Mathura.
1670年2月4日：Marathas under Shivaji capture the fort of Sinhagad (then known as Kondhana) from the Mughals in the Battle of Sinhagad.
1671年：Ahom kingdom defeats the Mughal Empire in the Battle of Saraighat, takes back control of Guwahati

1671年：Chhatrasal revolts against the Mughal Empire with an army of only 5 horsemen and 25 swordsmen. In ten years he conquers a large tract of land between Chitrakoot, Chhatarpur and Panna in the east and Gwalior in the west, and from Kalpi in the north to Sagar, Garhakota, Shahgarh and Damoh in the south.
1672年2月：Maratha forces under Prataprao Gujar defeat a Mughal army twice its size in the Battle of Salher.
1674年6月6日：Shivaji is crowned Chhatrapati.
1675年5月6日：Marathas defeat the Bijapur Sultanate and capture Ponda Fort after the Siege of Ponda.

1675年11月24日：Guru Tegh Bahadur, the ninth Guru of Sikhs is tortured and executed in Delhi by the order of Aurangzeb for his support for the Kashmiri Hindus to practice their religion and for refusing to convert to Islam. Guru Gobind Singh becomes tenth Guru of Sikhs.
1680年4月3日：Shivaji dies of fever at Raigad.
1680年7月20日：Sambhaji becomes 2nd Chhatrapati of the Maratha Kingdom.
1680年：Kingdom of Venad defeats the Mughal Empire in the Battle of Manacaud.
1681年：Aurangzeb invades the Deccan.
1681年：Maratha ruler Sambhaji attacks and sacks the Mughal city Burhanpur.
1682年8月：Ahom kingdom defeats the Mughal Empire in the Battle of Itakhuli, takes back control of Kamrup region.
1684年：Marathas under Sambhaji repel a Mughal attempt to invade Konkan. Mughals are forced into a slow retreat and suffer great losses.
1687年12月16日：Marathas under Sambhaji defeat the Mughal Army in the Battle of Wai. However, Maratha General Hambirrao Mohite is killed.
1688年：The Sikandara was plundered by Rajaram Jat. Even the skeleton of Akbar, was taken out and the bones were consumed to flames.
1689年3月11日：After being ambushed and captured by the Mughals, Sambhaji is tortured and killed for refusing to convert to Islam. Rajaram I becomes the third Chhatrapati of the Maratha Kingdom.
1689年：Rani Keladi Chennamma defeats Mughal army sent by Aurangzeb in pursuit of Rajaram I, who takes refuge in Keladi.
1690年：Maratha Kingdom defeats the Mughal Empire in the Battle of Athani.
1691年：Joint forces of Bhim Chand (Kahlur) of Bilaspur and Guru Gobind Singh defeat Mughal army in the Battle of Nadaun.

1692年12月：Maratha General Santaji Ghorpade defeats Mughal General Alimardan Khan and captures him. Mughal army under Zulfikhar Ali Khan defeated by Santaji and Dhanaji Jadhav and Zulfiquar Khan is forced to sue King Rajaram for peace.
1693年11月21日：Maratha General Santaji Ghorpade defeats Mughal General Himmat Khan.
1695年11月20日：Maratha General Santaji Ghorpade defeats and kills Mughal General Kasim Khan.
1696年：Sikhs under Guru Gobind Singh defeat Mughal forces in the Battle of Guler (1696)
1696年11月20日：Danish India (to 1869).
1699年10月3日：Guru Gobind Singh, the 10th Guru of Sikhs creates Khalsa, the saint-soldier at Anandpur Sahib, Punjab.
1700年：Sikhs army of 1,000 under Guru Gobind Singh defeats Mughal army numbering 10,000 in the Battle of Anandpur (1700)

1700年3月3日：Rajaram I dies. The infant Shivaji II becomes the Chhatrapati of the Maratha Kingdom, with his mother Tarabai as the regent. She continues the Maratha battles against the Mughal Empire, leading the Maratha army herself.
1702年：Sikhs army under Guru Gobind Singh defeats Mughal army in the Battle of Nirmohgarh (1702).
1707年2月13日：Birth of Suraj Mal son of Badan Singh.
1707年3月3日：Death of Aurangzeb the Mughal emperor. Marks the end of Mughal territorial expansion over India.
1708年10月7日：Guru Gobind Singh is assassinated by Mughals and the Guru Granth Sahib becomes the eternal Guru of the Sikhs.
1710年5月12日：Sikh army under Banda Singh Bahadur defeats Mughal Empire in the Battle of Chappar Chiri and establishes Sikh rule from Lahore to Delhi.
1717年：Meitei king Pamheipa (Gharib Nawaz (Manipur)) introduces Hinduism as the state religion and changes the name of the kingdom to the Sanskrit Manipur.
1721年：Attingal Outbreak takes place.
1721年：The Madras cyclone occurs.
1720年：Bajirao I appointed by Shahu as Peshwa (prime minister) who would later expand the Maratha Kingdom.
1724年：Meitei king Gharib Nawaz of the Ningthouja dynasty invades Burma.
1728年2月28日：Bajirao I defeats the combined forces of the Mughal Empire and the Nizam of Hyderabad in the Battle of Palkhed.
1729年3月：Maratha Kingdom under Bajirao defeats the Mughal Empire, in response for an appeal for help from Chhatrasal, ruler of Bundelkhand in the Battle of Bundelkhand.
1731年：Maratha Kingdom under Bajirao defeats Mughal Empire and Maratha rebel factions in the Battle of Dabhoi
1737年3月16日：Marathas under Bajirao I defeat the Mughal Empire in the Battle of Delhi (1737).
1737年12月24日：Marathas defeat a combined army of the Mughal Empire, Nizam of Hyderabad, Nawab of Awadh and Nawabs of Bhopal in the Battle of Bhopal.
1739年：Marathas under Bajirao I defeat the Portuguese in the Battle of Vasai, Portuguese army and administration pulled out of Baçaim (Vasai).
1739年3月：Nader Shah invades India from Iran. Nader Shah captures and sacks Delhi. Nader loots the Koh-i-Noor and Darya-i-Noor diamonds, alongside gaining the Peacock Throne.
1740年5月：Raghoji I Bhonsle of the Maratha Confederacy defeats and kills Dost Ali Khan the Mughal Nawab of Arcot in the Battle of Damalcherry.
1741年3月26日：Maratha army defeats the Nawab of Carnatic and captures Trichinopoly after the Siege of Trichinopoly (1741)
1741年8月10日：Kingdom of Travancore under Marthanda Varma defeats the Dutch Empire in the Battle of Colachel.
1753年5月10日：Jats under Suraj Mal defeat the Mughal Empire in the Capture of Delhi (1753).

1753年8月15日：Treaty of Mavelikkara signed between the Kingdom of Travancore and the Dutch East India Company, effectively ending the political and commercial dominance of the Dutch on the Kerala coast and beginning of the end of Dutch influence in India.
1754年：Bharatpur State defeat the Marathas in Battle of Kumher.
1756年：Black Hole of Calcutta infamous incident where soldiers of East India Company were held hostage in tortuous conditions, later served as a precedent for the Battle of Plassey.
1757年1月16日：Maratha Confederacy defeats Durrani Empire in the Battle of Narela.

1757年6月23日：British East India Company defeats the Nawab of Bengal in the Battle of Plassey, marking the end of Islamic period of 565 Years over India (1192–1757) & beginning of British conquests in India.
1757年8月11日：Maratha Confederacy defeats Rohilla Afghans in the Battle of Delhi (1757), captures Delhi.
1757年2月12日：Jats under Suraj Mal defeat Durrani Empire, in the Battle of Bharatpur.
1757年：Third Carnatic War.
1758年：28 April
1758年4月28日：Maratha Confederacy led by Raghunathrao and Mahadaji Shinde defeats Durrani Empire in the Battle of Attock (1758), captures Attock.
1758年5月8日：Maratha Confederacy led by Raghunathrao, Malhar Rao Holkar and Tukoji Rao Holkar defeats Durrani Empire in the Battle of Peshawar (1758), captures Peshawar.
1759年：French India (to 1954).
1759年：Maratha Confederacy supported by Sikh Sukerchakia Misl defeats Durrani Empire in the Battle of Lahore (1759).
1760年1月3日：Marathas comprehensively defeat the Nizam in the Battle of Udgir. Maratha Confederacy reaches its zenith.
1760年1月22日：Battle of Wandiwash, British troops beat French.

1761年1月：The Marathas are routed in the Third Battle of Panipat on 14 January 1761, by the Afghans led by Ahmad Shah Durrani, also known as Ahmad Shah Abdali. The battle is considered one of the largest battles fought in the 18th century.
1761年6月12日：Capture of Agra Fort by the Kingdom of Bharatpur led by king Suraj Mal, defeating the armies of the Mughal Empire and Rohilla Afghans
1761年8月：The Sukerchakia Misl of Dal Khalsa (Sikh Empire) defeats the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Sialkot (1761)
1761年9月：The Sikh Confederacy defeats the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Gujranwala (1761)
1762年1月5日：The Marathas under the leadership of Peshwa Madhavrao defeat the Nizam's forces in the Battle of Uruli
1762年2月5日：Vadda Ghalughara, the massacre of 30,000 Sikhs, mostly non-combatants, by the army of Ahmad Shah Durrani
1762年5月：Sikh Misls under Jassa Singh Ahluwalia defeat the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Harnaulgarh
1763年8月10日：Maratha Confederacy led by Madhavrao I defeats the Nizam of Hyderabad in the Battle of Rakshasbhuvan and gains territory.
1763年12月25日：Suraj Mal dies.
1764年2月26日：Sikh Misls under Jassa Singh Ahluwalia defeat the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Sirhind (1764) and capture Sirhind
1764年10月22日：Battle of Buxar (British victory against allied Mughal, Bengal and Oudh forces)
1765年2月：Kingdom of Bharatpur led by king Jawahar Singh defeats the Mughal Empire in the Battle of Delhi (1764)
1767年：First Anglo-Mysore War begins, in which Hyder Ali of Mysore defeats the armies of the British East India Company.

1770年：Great Bengal famine of 1770, estimated to have caused the deaths of about 10 million people. Warren Hastings's 1772 report estimated that a third of the population in the affected region starved to death. The famine is attributed to failed monsoon and exploitative policies of the East India Company.

1771年：Marathas led by Mahadaji Shinde defeat Rohilla Afghans and re-capture Delhi and parts of North India, thus reasserting their supremacy in north India. As revenge for the losses in the Battle of Panipat, the Maratha army devastated Rohilkhand by looting and plundering and also took the members of royal family as captives.
1772年5月22日：Ram Mohan Roy Born (to 1833)
1773年：Narayanrao Peshwa is murdered by his uncle Raghunathrao's wife in front of Raghunathrao in Shaniwar Wada, Pune.
1773年：Regulating Act 1773 is established.
1773年：Warren Hastings appointed as first Governor-General of Bengal.
1774年：Chief Justice of the Maratha Confederacy, Ram Shastri passes death sentence against the ruling Peshwa Raghunathrao for murdering his nephew.
1775年：First Anglo-Maratha War takes place.
1775年6月：Alliance of Shekhawat chieftains and Kingdom of Jaipur defeat the Mughal Empire supported by Baloch chieftains in the Battle of Mandan
1779年：Maratha sardar Mahadji Shinde routs the East India Company army at the Battle of Wadgaon. War ends with the restoration of status quo as per Treaty of Salbai.
1780年：Second Anglo-Mysore War begins.
1781年：Maratha Confederacy defeats forces of the British East India Company in the Battle of Bhorghat.
1784年：Second Anglo-Mysore War ends with the Treaty of Mangalore.

1784年：Captivity of Mangalorean Catholics at Seringapatam, by armies of Tipu Sultan, suffer extreme hardships, torture, death, forcibly converted to Sunni Islam. Of the 60,000–80,000 Christians taken captive, only 15,000–20,000 survive.
links: Captivity of Mangalorean Catholics at Seringapatam

items.text: 1786年：District collectors in Bengal were made responsible for settling the revenue and collecting it.

1787年：Maratha Confederacy defeats Tipu Sultan, the king of Mysore in the Maratha–Mysore War, resulting in the Treaty of Gajendragad. Tipu Sultan is forced to pay 4.8 million rupees as a war cost to the Marathas, an annual tribute of 1.2 million rupees and return all the territory captured by his father Hyder Ali
1789年：Third Anglo-Mysore War begins.

1789年：Tipu Sultan invades Malabar (present day Kerala), destroys a number of temples including the temples of Bhagamandala, Payyavoor, Ammakoottam Mahadevi temple and Thrikkadamba Sri.mahavishnu temple. Thousands are killed, women raped and populace forced to convert to Islam,

1790年：The Marathas under Holkar and General de Boigne defeat the Rajputs of Jaipur and Mughals at the Battle of Patan, where 3000+ Rajput cavalry is killed and the entire Mughal unit vanquished. The defeat crushes Rajput hope of independence from external influence
1790年5月：Kingdom of Travancore defeats the Kingdom of Mysore in the Battle of Nedumkotta
1792年：Third Anglo-Mysore War ends.
1793年：Birth of Rani Rashmoni, one of the pioneers of the Bengali Renaissance.
1795年3月11日：Maratha Confederacy defeats the Nizam of Hyderabad in the Battle of Kharda, Nizam ceded territory.
1795年8月13日：Death of Ahilyabai Holkar
1796年：Ching-Thang Khomba moves Manipur's capital to Kangla
1798年：Fourth Anglo-Mysore War begins.
1799年：Fourth Anglo-Mysore War ends with the death of Tipu Sultan, the victory of the East India Company, and the restoration of their ally, the Wodeyar dynasty of Mysore.
1799年：Polygar War.
1800年3月13日：Death of Nana Fadnavis.
1801年4月12日：Maharaja Ranjit Singh establishes Khalsa rule of Punjab from Lahore. Khalsa army liberates Kashmiri Pandits and invades Afghanistan via the Khyber Pass.
1802年10月11日：The Kingdom of Kottayam defeats the British East India Company in the Battle of Panamarathukotta
1803年9月11日：The Second Anglo-Maratha War begins.
1805年12月24日：The Second Anglo-Maratha War ends.
1806年7月10日：Vellore Mutiny, the first instance of a large-scale and violent mutiny by Indian sepoys against the East India Company.
1807年2月10日：Hari Singh Nalwa, commander of the Sikh Khalsa Army of the Sikh Empire defeats the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Kasur, the first in a series of battles.
1809年4月25日：The East India Company signs the first Treaty of Amritsar with Ranjit Singh.
1811年10月28日：The death of Yashwantrao Holkar.
1813年7月13日：Dewan Mokham Chand and Hari Singh Nalwa, commanders of the Sikh Khalsa Army of the Sikh Empire defeat the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Attock and capture Attock
1815年1月15日："Atmiya Sabha" is established by Raja Ram Mohan Roy.
1817年1月20日：Establishment of Hindu College (Presidency College, now Presidency University, Kolkata)
1817年6月13日：The Third Anglo-Maratha War begins.
1818年：Sikh Empire defeats the Durrani Empire and captures Multan after the Siege of Multan (1818).
1819年7月3日：Sikh Empire defeats the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Shopian and captures Srinagar and Kashmir. Islamic rule ends in Jammu and Kashmir.
1819年4月9日：The Third Anglo-Maratha War ends with the capture of Asirgarh Fort and the end of the Maratha Confederacy, leaving the East India Company with control of almost the whole of India.
1820年9月26日：Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar is born (to 1891).
1823年3月14日：Sikh Empire defeats the Emirate of Afghanistan and the Nawab of Amb to annex Peshawar Valley, in the Battle of Nowshera
1824年2月12日：Dayananda Saraswati is born (to 1883)
1824年3月5日：First Anglo-Burmese War (to 1826)
1825年：Battle between East India Company and Bharatpur State
1826年1月4日：British rule in Burma (to 1947)
1827年4月11日：Jyotirao Phule is born (to 1890)
1828年11月19日：Rani of Jhansi was born (to 1858)
1831年：Kol uprising
1831年5月6日：Sikh Empire defeats the Mujahideen forces of Syed Ahmad Barelvi in the Battle of Balakot
1834年5月6日：Sikh Empire defeats the forces of Afghan Durrani Empire in the Capture of Peshawar (1834). Peshawar becomes part of the Sikh Empire.
1836年2月18日：Ramakrishna is born (to 1886)

1837年2月18日：Hari Singh Nalwa, commander of the Sikh Khalsa Army defeats the Durrani Empire in the Battle of Jamrud and extends the frontier of Sikh Empire to beyond the Indus River right up to the mouth of the Khyber Pass.
1845年12月11日：First Anglo-Sikh war (to 1846).
1845年11月4日：Vasudev Balwant Phadke is born (to 1883).
1848年11月22日：The Sikh Empire under Sher Singh Attariwalla defeats the British East India Company under Sir Hugh Gough in the Battle of Ramnagar
1849年1月13日：The Sikh Empire under Sher Singh Attariwalla defeats the British East India Company under Sir Hugh Gough in the Battle of Chillianwala
1853年4月1日：The Post Service started.
1853年4月16日：The first railway is established between Bombay and Thane.
1855年5月31日：Rani Rashmoni complete the Dakshineswar Kali Temple with the installation of Ma Kali.
1855年6月30日：Santhal rebellion
1856年7月25日：Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act, 1856
1856年7月23日：Bal Gangadhar Tilak is born (to 1920)
1856年8月20日：Narayana Guru is born (to 1928)

1857年5月10日：British victory in Indian Rebellion of 1857. Last Mughal Emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar was deposed by British East India Company and India transferred to British Crown. Marks the End of Mughal Dynasty rule over India.
1857年：India's first three modern universities, (University of Mumbai, University of Madras, and the University of Calcutta), are established.
1858年11月1日：British Raj (to 1947) Marks the Beginning Of Direct British Rule Over India For 89 Years(1858–1947).
1858年11月7日：Bipin Chandra Pal is born (to 1932).
1859年4月18日：Death of Tatya Tope.
1861年5月7日：Rabindranath Tagore is born.
1862年：The high courts of Calcutta, Madras, and Bombay are established.
1863年1月12日：Swami Vivekanand is born (to 1902).
1865年1月28日：Lala Lajpat Rai is born (to 1928).
1867年3月31日："Prarthana Samaj" established earlier known as "Atmiya Sabha", "Tahzeeb-ul-Akhlaq" was started
1869年10月2日：Mahatma Gandhi is born (to 30 January 1948)
1869年11月29日：Thakkar Bapa is born (to 1951).
1873年9月24日：Jyotirao Phule establishes the Satyashodhak Samaj society.
1875年：Deccan Riots.
1875年4月10日："Arya Samaj" is established.
1875年：Aligarh Muslim University
1876年12月25日：Muhammad Ali Jinnah was born (1876–1948)
1877年1月1日：The first Delhi Durbar
1883年10月30日：Maharishi Dayanand Saraswati dies.
1885年12月28日：The Indian National Congress is established
1889年11月14日：Jawaharlal Nehru is born (to 1964).
1889年12月3日：Khudiram Bose is born (to 1908).
1891年4月14日：B. R. Ambedkar is born (to 1956).
1891年3月31日：Anglo-Manipur War.
1895年5月11日：Jiddu Krishnamurti is born (to 17 February 1986).
1897年1月23日：Subhas Chandra Bose is born (to 1945); the first fingerprint bureau of India is established in Calcutta.
1897年6月11日：Ram Prasad Bismil is born.
1897年6月22日：Chapekar brothers assassinates W.C. Rand.
1900年3月3日：Maghfoor Ahmad Ajazi is born (to 1966).
1902年：Anushilan Samiti, revolutionary association formed.
1903年12月11日：British expedition to Tibet.
1903年1月1日：Delhi Durbar Second Time.
1904年11月5日：University Act established.
1905年：Bharat Sevak Samaj founded by Gopal Krishna Gokhale.
1905年10月16日：Partition of Bengal (1905).
1906年4月：Jugantar formed.
1906年12月30日：All-India Muslim League formed in Dacca.
1907年：Surat Split.
1908年5月：Alipore bomb case takes place.
1909年5月25日：Indian Councils Act 1909 is enacted.
1911年：Cancellation of Partition of Bengal.
1911年12月：Delhi Durbar Third Time.
1911年12月12日：The British government moves the capital from Calcutta to Delhi.
1912年12月：Delhi conspiracy case.
1913年7月15日：Gadar Party formed.
1913年：Rabindranath Tagore won Nobel Prize in Literature

1914年8月26日：Rodda company arms heist, in which members of Bengali revolutionary organisation Anushilan Samiti intercept and make away with a shipment of Mauser Pistols and ammunition. In the following years, these pistols and ammunitions were linked to almost all the instances of nationalist struggles in Bengal.
1914年：Hindu–German Conspiracy takes place.
1915年：Ghadar conspiracy.
1915年12月1日：Provisional Government of India formed in Kabul.
1915年：Mahatma Gandhi returns to India.
1916年12月29日：Lucknow Pact.
1917年：Champaran Satyagraha and Kheda Satyagraha.
1917年：Justice Party (India) is founded.
1918年：Kheda Satyagraha and Ahmedabad Mill Strike.
1919年4月13日：Jallianwala Bagh massacre takes place.
1919年：Montagu–Chelmsford Reforms.
1919年3月18日：Rowlatt Act is passed.
1919年12月23日：Government of India Act 1919 introduces a system of diarchy
1920年：Non-cooperation movement and Khilafat Movement.
1922年2月5日：Chauri Chaura incident.
1924年10月：The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association is formed.
1925年8月9日：Kakori conspiracy.
1925年9月27日：Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) is founded.
1927年3月20日：Mahad Satyagraha.
1927年11月：Simon Commission.
1928年：Bardoli Satyagraha.
1929年：Central Assembly bombed by Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt.
1929年：Purna Swaraj resolution.
1930年：Salt Satyagraha, the civil disobedience movement, begins with the Dandi march.
1930年：The first Round Table Conferences (India)
1931年3月：Gandhi–Irwin Pact.
1931年3月23日：Bhagat Singh, Rajguru and Sukhdev martyred
1931年：The second Round Table Conferences (India).
1932年9月24日：Poona Pact established.
1932年8月16日：Communal Award.
1932年：The third Round Table Conferences (India).
1935年8月：Government of India Act 1935 is passed.
1937年：1937 Indian provincial elections.
1939年：The All India Forward Bloc established by Subhas Chandra Bose
1940年3月23日：Lahore Resolution.
1940年：The All-India Jamhur Muslim League established by Maghfoor Ahmad Ajazi to support a united India
1940年8月8日：August Offer.
1942年：Cripps Mission follows.
1942年8月：Quit India Movement is established and the Indian National Army is established by Subhas Chandra Bose.
1943年：Arzi Hukumat-e-Azad Hind, the Provisional Government of Free India is formed by Netaji.
1944年：Subhas Chandra Bose calls Mahatma Gandhi the "Father of the Nation."
1945年8月18日：Subhas Chandra Bose dies in a plane crash at Taiwan.
1945年：Wavell Plan, Simla Conference.
1946年2月：Royal Indian Navy mutiny happens.
1946年3月：Cabinet Mission.
1946年8月16日：Direct Action Day/Great Calcutta Killings.
1946年：Noakhali riots takes place.
1947年7月：Indian Independence Act 1947 by British Raj.
1947年8月14日：Partition of India and Pakistan becomes an independent state.
1947年8月15日：Indian independence from the British Raj.

1947年10月22日：Pakistan starts the Indo-Pakistani war of 1947–1948 a few weeks after its independence by launching tribal lashkar (militias) from Waziristan supported by irregular Pakistani forces, in an effort to capture Kashmir.
1947年11月7日：Battle of Shalateng is fought on the outskirts of Srinagar, where on the advance of the tribal lashkar and Pakistani irregulars is halted and a counter-attack begins to push them back.
1947年：Hundreds of thousands die in widespread communal bloodshed after partition, continuing to 1948.
1948年1月30日：Mahatma Gandhi is assassinated by Nathuram Godse.
1948年：War with Pakistan over disputed territory of Kashmir.
1948年：Telangana and other princely states are integrated into Indian union.
1950年1月26日：India officially becomes a republic.
1951年：Reconstruction of the Somnath temple under the orders of the Home Minister of India Vallabhbhai Patel.
