1951年：Congress Party wins first general elections under leadership of Jawaharlal Nehru (to 1952).
1955年：Nationalisation of the Indian insurance sector.
1956年9月1日：Establishment of LIC.
1956年10月14日：B. R. Ambedkar converted to Buddhism along with 600,000 followers.
1956年12月6日：B. R. Ambedkar died. States Reorganization Act in force from 1 November.
1962年：War over disputed territory of Kashmir with China.
1962年：India seizes Diu, Daman and Goa from Portuguese India.
1964年5月27日：Death of Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.
1965年：Second war with Pakistan over Kashmir.
1966年1月11日：Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri's mysterious death in Tashkent.
1966年1月24日：Nehru's daughter Indira Gandhi becomes prime minister.
1969年7月19日：Nationalisation of 14 major private Banks.
1969年8月15日：Indian Space Research Organisation formed under Department of Space.
1971年：Third war with Pakistan, culminating in the creation of Bangladesh.
1971年：Twenty-year treaty of friendship signed with Soviet Union.
1974年5月18日：The Smiling Buddha is the first nuclear device in underground test.
1975年5月15日：Sikkim becomes part of Indian Union after a referendum in the Sikkim Assembly.

1975年6月25日：Indira Gandhi declares a state of emergency after being found guilty of electoral malpractice. Nearly 1,000 political opponents imprisoned and programme of compulsory birth control introduced. (to 1977)
1977年：Indira Gandhi's Congress Party loses general elections. Janata Party comes to power. The Communist Party of India (Marxist) comes into power in West Bengal.
1979年：The Janata Party splits. Chaudhary Charan Singh becomes Prime Minister.
1980年：Indira Gandhi returns to power heading the Congress party splinter group, Congress (Indira).
1983年：N. T. Rama Rao NTR's nine-month-old Telugu Desam assumes power in AP becoming a challenger post Loknayak Jayprakash Narayan against Indira Gandhi.
1983年：India won World Cup for the first time, in one day international Cricket led by Kapil Dev.

1984年：Troops storm Golden Temple, the Sikhs' most holy shrine, after Jarnail Singh Bhindranwale seeks refuge inside. There are a movement to flush out Sikh separatism and calls for secularism, called Operation Blue Star. "Anti-Sikh Riots 1984".
1984年：Indira Gandhi is assassinated by her bodyguards; her son, Rajiv, takes over.
1984年：Many Sikhs were killed due to the assassination of Indira Gandhi. see 1984 anti-Sikh riots.
1987年：India deploys troops for peacekeeping operation in Sri Lanka's ethnic conflict.
1988年：SEBI was established by The Government of India on 12 April 1988 and given statutory powers in 1992 with SEBI Act 1992 being passed by the Indian Parliament.
1989年：Falling public support leads to a Congress defeat in general election.
1989年：The National Front (India), headed by V. P. Singh and led by Janata Dal, is formed and storms into power with outside support from BJP and CPI(M).
1990年：Muslim separatist groups begin campaign of violence against Hindus in Kashmir resulting in Exodus of Kashmiri Hindus.
1991年5月21日：Rajiv Gandhi is assassinated by a suicide bomber sympathetic to Sri Lanka's Tamil Tigers.
1991年：An economic reform programme or Economic liberalisation in India is begun by Prime Minister P. V. Narasimha Rao.
1992年12月6日：The demolition of the Babri Masjid, triggering the Bombay riots.
1992年5月：Over 200 people die in Cuttack in Odisha, after drinking illegally brewed liquor in the 1992 Odisha liquor deaths incident.
1995年7月：West Bengal Chief Minister Jyoti Basu made the first call from Kolkata to inaugurate the cellular services in India.
1996年：Congress suffers its worst electoral defeat ever as BJP emerges as the largest single party.
1996年8月：The Amarnath Yatra tragedy in which at least 194 pilgrims are reported to have frozen to death in northern Kashmir after being stranded by violent rain and snow storms.
1998年：BJP forms coalition government under Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
1998年：India and Pakistan carry out nuclear tests, leading to widespread international condemnation.
1999年2月：Vajpayee makes a historic bus trip to Pakistan to meet Premier Nawaz Sharif and to sign bilateral Lahore peace declaration.
1999年5月：Indian Army launches operations to evict Pakistani forces capturing Indian positions on the icy heights in Kargil district, known as the Kargil War.
1999年10月：The Cyclone devastates eastern state of Odisha, leaving at least 10,000 dead.
2000年3月：US President Bill Clinton makes a groundbreaking visit to improve ties.
2000年5月：India marks the birth of its billionth citizen.
2000年11月15日：The states of Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Uttarakhand were created.
2001年1月26日：The 7.7 Mw Gujarat earthquake shakes Western India with a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme), leaving 13,805–20,023 dead and about 166,800 injured.

2001年7月：Vajpayee meets Pakistani President Pervez Musharraf in the first summit between the two neighbours in more than two years. The meeting ends without a breakthrough or even a joint statement because of differences over Kashmir.
2001年7月：Vajpayee's BJP party declines his offer to resign over a number of political scandals and the apparent failure of his talks with Pakistani President Musharraf.
2001年9月：US lifts sanctions which it imposed against India and Pakistan after they staged nuclear tests in 1998. The move is seen as a reward for their support for the US-led anti-terror campaign.
2001年10月：India and Pakistan fire at each other's military posts in the heaviest firing along the dividing line of control in Kashmir for almost a year.
2001年10月：Pakistani forces shelled the village of Arnia about three km (two miles) from the border in the early hours of Monday 6 June, killing five and wounding at least two dozen civilians.
2001年12月13日：Terrorist attack on Indian parliament in New Delhi, killing several police. The five gunmen are killed in the assault.

2001年12月：India imposes sanctions against Pakistan, to force it to take action against two Kashmir militant groups blamed for the suicide attack on parliament. Pakistan retaliates with similar sanctions, and bans the groups in January.
2001年12月：Indian and Pakistani mass troops on common border amid mounting fears of a looming war.
2002年1月：India successfully test-fires a nuclear-capable ballistic missile – the Agni – off its eastern coast.

2002年2月：Inter-religious bloodshed breaks out after 59 Hindu pilgrims returning from Ayodhya are killed in a train fire in Godhra, Gujarat. More than 1,000 people, die in subsequent riots. (Police and officials blamed the fire on a Muslim mob; a 2005 government investigation said it was an accident, though later court and SIT report held Muslim mob responsible.)
2002年5月：Pakistan test-fires three medium-range surface-to-surface Ghauri missiles, which are capable of carrying nuclear warheads.
2002年6月：The UK and US urge their citizens to leave India and Pakistan, while maintaining diplomatic offensive to avert war.
2002年7月：Retired scientist and architect of India's missile programme A. P. J. Abdul Kalam is elected president.
2003年8月：Two simultaneous bomb blasts in Bombay, in which over 50 people are killed in, by Pakistan-based Lashkar-e-Taiba.
2003年11月：India matches Pakistan's declaration of a Kashmir ceasefire.
2003年12月：India, Pakistan agree to resume direct air links and to allow overflights.
2004年1月：Groundbreaking meeting is held between government and moderate Kashmir separatists.
2004年5月：Surprise victory for Congress Party in general elections. Manmohan Singh is sworn in as prime minister.
2004年9月：India, along with Brazil, Germany and Japan, launches an application for a permanent seat on the UN Security Council.
2004年11月：India begins to withdraw some of its troops from Kashmir.
2004年12月：Thousands are killed when tsunami, caused by the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake off the Indonesian coast, devastate coastal communities in the south and in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
2005年7月：More than 1,000 people are killed in floods and landslides caused by monsoon rains in Mumbai (Bombay) and Maharashtra region.
2005年10月8日：The 7.6 Mw Kashmir earthquake strikes with a maximum Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe), leaving 86,000–87,351 people dead, 69,000–75,266 injured, and 2.8 million homeless.
2006年2月：India's largest-ever rural jobs scheme is launched, aimed at lifting around 60 million families out of poverty.

2006年3月：US and India sign a nuclear agreement during a visit by US President George W. Bush. The US gives India access to civilian nuclear technology while India agrees to greater scrutiny for its nuclear programme.
2007年2月：India and Pakistan sign an agreement aimed at reducing the risk of accidental nuclear war.
2007年2月18日：68 passengers, most of them Pakistanis, are killed by bomb blasts and a blaze on a train travelling from New Delhi to the Pakistani city of Lahore.
2007年3月：Maoist rebels in Chhattisgarh state kill more than 50 policemen in a dawn attack.
2007年4月：India's first commercial space rocket is launched, carrying an Indian satellite.
2007年5月：Government announces its strongest economic growth figures for 20 years – 9.4% in the year to March.
2007年5月：At least nine people are killed in a bomb explosion at the main mosque in Hyderabad. Several others are killed in subsequent rioting.

2007年7月：India says the number of its people with HIV or AIDS is about half of earlier official tallies. Health ministry figures put the total at between 2 million and 3.1 million cases, compared with previous estimates of more than 5 million.
2007年7月25日：Pratibha Patil becomes first woman to be elected president of India.
2008年7月：Series of explosions kills 49 in Ahmedabad, in Gujarat state. The little-known terrorist group Indian Mujahideen claims responsibility.
2008年10月：Following approval by the US Congress, President George W. Bush signs into law a nuclear deal with India, which ends a three-decade ban on US nuclear trade with Delhi.
2008年10月22日：India successfully launches its first mission to the moon, the uncrewed lunar probe Chandrayaan-1.

2008年：The 2008 Mumbai attacks (often called the 26/11 attacks) kill 174 people, including 9 of the 10 terrorists from Lashkar-e-Taiba, an Islamic terrorist organisation based in Pakistan. India decides not to attack Pakistan in retaliation.
2008年12月：India announces "pause" in peace process with Pakistan. Indian cricket team cancels planned tour of Pakistan.
2009年2月：India and Russia sign deals worth $700 million, according to which Moscow will supply Uranium to Delhi.
2009年5月：Resounding general election victory gives governing Congress-led alliance of PM Manmohan Singh an enhanced position in parliament, only 11 seats short of an absolute majority.
2009年7月：Delhi court decriminalizes gay sex.
2010年2月13日：16 people are killed in a bomb explosion at German Bakery in the city of Pune, Maharashtra.
2011年4月2日：India wins cricket world cup after 28 years under the captaincy of MS Dhoni.
2011年5月13日：After 34 years of Left Front Government, Trinamool Congress and Congress alliance come to power in West Bengal.
2012年7月25日：Pranab Mukherjee, the former Finance Minister is elected as the 13th president of India.
2013年2月12日：Indian helicopter bribery scandal comes to light.
2013年2月21日：Terror attacks in Hyderabad in Dilsukhnagar area.
2013年11月5日：Mars Orbiter Mission, is successfully launched into Mars orbit by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
2014年5月16日：Narendra Modi elected as prime minister of India, Congress was routed in the general elections.
2014年6月2日：Telangana, The state of Telangana was officially formed on 2 June 2014.
2015年6月21日：The first International Yoga Day was held.
2016年：Terror Attacks on Pathankot Air Base.
2016年6月27日：India becomes a member of Missile Technology Control Regime.
2016年9月23日：India signs a billion-dollar defence deal with France to buy 36 Rafale fighter jets.
2016年9月27日：India launches its first space laboratory, AstroSat, in its biggest project since its Mars orbiter mission in 2014.
2016年9月28日：India conducted Surgical Strike in response to Uri attack on army base on September 18, 2016
2016年11月8日：In a surprise announcement, the government withdraws high denomination notes from circulation causing chaotic scenes at banks across the country as customers try to exchange old notes.
2017年6月30日：The Goods and Services Tax (GST) launched, the biggest tax reform in history of India.

2019年2月14日：A convoy of vehicles carrying Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel on the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway was attacked by a vehicle-borne suicide bomber in the Pulwama district, Jammu and Kashmir, India.

2019年2月26日：The 2019 Balakot airstrike was conducted by India, when Indian warplanes crossed the de facto border in the disputed region of Kashmir, and dropped bombs in the vicinity of the town of Balakot in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province in Pakistan.

2019年2月27日：The 2019 Balakot strike from Indian side was given a reply named "Swift Retort". After a dog fight between Pakistani and Indian Fighter Pilots. Indian Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman was captured by the Pakistani side. However acting to the pressure of various global leaders and bound by the Vienna Convention. Pakistan was Forced to release the Indian Pilot with all due respect.
links: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties

items.text: 2019年5月22日：2019 Indian general election, Narendra Modi is re-elected as the Prime Minister of India.
2019年8月5日：The state of Jammu and Kashmir divided into two separate union territories known as Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh by scrapping of Article 370 of the Constitution of India.
links: Article 370 of the Constitution of India

items.text: 2019年12月11日：The Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019 was passed by the Parliament of India on 11 December 2019. It amended the Citizenship Act of 1955 by providing a path to Indian citizenship for members of Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi, and Christian religious minorities, who had fled persecution from Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan before December 2014.
2020年1月30日：The first COVID-19 case of the country was reported in Kerala's Thrissur district.
2021年5月12日：COVID-19 pandemic in India, with an official death toll of 533,847.
2022年7月18日：Droupadi Murmu is elected as President of India, making her the first tribal woman and youngest person to the office.
2022年10月30日：The collapse of a suspension bridge in Gujarat, leaves at least 135 dead.
2023年6月2日：A train collision in Odisha results in at least 296 deaths and more than 1,200 others injured.
2023年7月3日：Indian oil refiners start payments for Russian oil imports in Chinese yuan as an alternative to the US dollar due to increasing sanctions against Russia.
2023年8月23日：Chandrayaan-3 becomes the first spacecraft to land near the lunar south pole, carrying a lunar lander named Vikram and a lunar rover named Pragyan.
2023年9月2日：The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launches Aditya-L1, India's first solar observation mission.
2024年6月：2024 Indian general election, Narendra Modi elected as Prime Minister for third term.

2025年1月13日：The 45-day 2025 Prayag Maha Kumbh Mela held, with over 660 million (66 crore) devotees coming to Prayagraj to participate in the bathing rituals at the sacred confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswati rivers.

2025年4月22日：Terror attack in Pahalgam, Kashmir. Terrorists open fire on tourists, killing 26 and injuring 20. India blames the attack on Pakistan based terrorists, and the Pakistan government for supporting and enabling them.
2025年：India launches precision missile strikes named Operation Sindoor on 9 terrorist hideouts in Pakistan and Azad Jammu and Kashmir, as a punitive retaliation for the Pahalgam attack.
2026年1月27日：The India-European Union Free Trade Agreement is announced in New Delhi.

約前48000年－前63000年：The ancestors of Aboriginal Australians began arriving from south-east Asia 50,000 to 65,000 years ago, during the last glacial period. Arriving by sea, they settled the continent and had formed approximately 250 distinct language groups by the time of European settlement, maintaining some of the longest known continuing artistic and religious traditions in the world.

約前2000年：The Torres Strait Islander people first settled Torres Strait Islands around 4000 years ago. Culturally and linguistically distinct from mainland Aboriginal peoples, they were seafarers and obtained their livelihood from seasonal horticulture and the resources of their reefs and seas.
1521年：Several writers have argued that Portuguese expeditions visited Australia at this time. However, historians generally disagree and the evidence remains contentious. (to 1522)
links: Theory of the Portuguese discovery of Australia

items.text: 1606年：The Dutch East India Company (VOC) ship Duyfken, under Captain Willem Janszoon, explored the western coast of Cape York Peninsula, near what is now Weipa. This was the first recorded landfall by a European on Australian soil.

1606年8月：Spanish seaman Luís Vaz de Torres sailed through the Torres Strait, between Australia and New Guinea, along the latter's southern coast. Torres reported 'shoals', some of which may have been the northernmost atolls of the Great Barrier Reef.

1616年10月25日：Dutch captain Dirk Hartog in the Eendracht made the second recorded landfall by a European, at Dirk Hartog Island on the western coast of Australia. He left a commemorative plate, the Hartog Plate.
1618年7月：VOC ship Mauritius under command of Supercargo Willem Janszoon, landed near North West Cape, near the modern town of Exmouth, and named Willem's River, later renamed Ashburton River.
1622年5月1日：The English ship Tryall sighted Point Cloates on the west coast of Australia.

1622年5月25日：The Tryall was wrecked on Tryal Rocks, northwest of the Montebello Islands, crew spent seven days ashore before sailing a longboat to Bantam in Java – this was the first recorded shipwreck in Australian waters and first extended stay in Australia by Europeans.
1623年：Dutch captain Jan Carstensz navigated the Gulf of Carpentaria aboard the Pera and Arnhem. The Arnhem crossed the Gulf to reach and name Groote Eylandt.

1623年：First white child in Australia was Born. Seebaer van Nieuwelant (born 27 July 1623), son of Willemtgen and Willem Janszoon, was born south of Dirk Hartog Island, in present-day Western Australia.

1629年6月4日：VOC ship Batavia wrecked on Houtman Abrolhos, off Geraldton. Mutiny ensued and at least 110 men, women and children were murdered. First European structure in Australia – Wiebbe Hayes Stone Fort on West Wallabi Island.
1642年：Dutch explorer Abel Tasman explored the west coast of Tasmania, landed on its east coast and named the island Anthoonij van Diemenslandt.

1656年4月28日：In 1656 the Vergulde Draeck struck a submerged coral reef midway between what are now the coastal towns of Seabird and Ledge Point, Western Australia. On board were 193 crew, eight boxes of silver coins worth 78,600 guilders and trade goods to the value of 106,400 guilders. Of the 193 crew, 118 are believed to have perished. The initial 75 survivors, including the ship's captain Pieter Albertszoon, and the under steersman, made it to shore. They had with them the ship's boat, a schuyt, along with a small amount of provisions and stores washed on shore. A number of rescue attempts was conducted by the Dutch East India Company once the loss was reported.
1681年：English navigator John Daniel on the New London charted the west coast of Australia, including Rottnest Island and the Wallabi Group of the Houtman Abrolhos.
1688年：English explorer William Dampier explored the west coast of Australia.
1696年：Dutch explorer Willem de Vlamingh charted the southwestern coast of Australia, making a landfall at Rottnest Island and the site of the present-day city of Perth.

1770年：English Lieutenant James Cook's expedition in HMS Endeavour charted the eastern coast, and claimed it for the British Crown. Australia was dubbed "terra nullius" i.e., according to the European legal precepts of the era, it was unclaimed by any sovereign nation.
1787年5月13日：The First Fleet of 11 ships, led by Governor Arthur Phillip, departed from Great Britain for Australia to begin European colonisation.
1788年1月3日：Captain Arthur Phillip of the (First Fleet), having decided to sail ahead of the rest of the fleet to prepare for the new settlement, sighted the coast of Van Diemen's Land.
1788年1月18日：At 2:15 pm, the brig HMS Supply anchored on the northern side of Botany Bay. He began exploring the surrounding countryside and made contact with the Aboriginal Australians.
1788年1月19日：In the morning, the transports Alexander, Friendship and Scarborough arrived at Botany Bay, watched by a large number of Indigenous Australians who gathered on Point Solander.
1788年1月20日：The remaining seven ships of the First Fleet, led by HMS Sirius, anchored in Botany Bay.

1788年1月21日：Deciding that Botany Bay was unsuitable for settlement, Captain Arthur Phillip set out with a party in three open boats to seek out another site. He later reported to Lord Sydney, British Secretary of State; "We got into Port Jackson early in the Afternoon, and had the satisfaction of finding the finest harbour in the world, in which a thousand Sail of the line may ride in the most perfect security." He selected a cove with a stream and named it Sydney Cove.
1788年1月24日：The French ships Boussole and Astrolabe commanded by Jean-François de Galaup, comte de Lapérouse appeared off Botany Bay.
links: Jean-François de Galaup, comte de Lapérouse

items.text: 1788年1月25日：Captain Phillip sailed out of Botany Bay aboard the Supply and reached Sydney Cove in the evening.

1788年1月26日：Early in the morning, Captain Phillip took a party ashore at Sydney Cove, raised the British colours and formally proclaimed British sovereignty over New South Wales. This day is now celebrated as Australia Day. In a ceremony at sunset Phillip and the officers drank to the health of the king and the royal family, and success to the new colony. In the meantime, La Perouse entered Botany Bay as the remaining British ships prepared to leave.
links: Jean-François de Galaup, comte de Lapérouse

items.text: 1788年1月27日：Convicts disembarked at Sydney Cove and helped clear the ground.
1788年1月28日：17 Wives of marines and 14 children disembarked from Prince of Wales. They were the first women and children to land. The first of the livestock was brought ashore.
1788年2月3日：Rev. Richard Johnson held the colony's first religious service ‘on the grass’.
1788年2月6日：The women convicts came ashore. There was a violent thunderstorm.

1788年2月7日：The whole party assembled on the west side of Sydney Cove, where the deputy judge-advocate David Collins read the King's commission establishing Phillip's governorship over the colony and the letters patent establishing civil and criminal courts. Phillip addressed the convicts, wishing them ‘reformation, happiness, and prosperity, in this new country'.

1788年2月11日：At the first criminal court, Samuel Barnsley was sentenced to 150 lashes for assault and Thomas Hill to confinement in irons on a small rocky island at the head of the cove for stealing bread.
1788年2月14日：Lt. Philip Gidley King sailed with a party of 23 including 15 convicts, in Supply to found a settlement on Norfolk Island, where native flax was to be harvested and others grown.

1788年2月17日：Rev. Johnson celebrated Holy Communion for the first time in the colony, according to the rites of the Church of England (see Book of Common Prayer (1662)). The Communion took place in the tent of Lt. Ralph Clark. Lt. Henry Ball, commander of the Supply on its way to Norfolk Island, discovered an island that he named after Admiral Lord Howe.
1788年2月27日：Thomas Barratt was hanged for stealing in stores, the first execution.
1788年2月29日：James Freeman was pardoned for stealing flour, on the condition that he become public executioner.
1788年3月2日：Phillip set out to explore Broken Bay. On this trip he visited and named Pittwater.
1788年3月6日：Lt. King took possession of Norfolk Island. British settlement founded.
1788年3月10日：The two French ships left Botany Bay, and were later wrecked near Santa Cruz (Solomon Islands).
1788年3月：Phillip issued the first government conservation order: that no trees should be cut down within 50 feet (15 metres) of the stream that ran into Sydney Cove.
1788年4月26日：An exploring party led by Phillip sighted and named the Blue Mountains.
1788年5月6日：Following an outbreak of scurvy, HMS Supply sailed for Lord Howe Island to catch turtles to supplement the settlement's meat supply. Having failed to catch any, it returned on 25 May.
1788年5月21日：Aboriginal peoples killed a convict and seriously injured another.

1788年5月30日：The bodies of two rushcutters, William Okey and Samuel Davis, were found pierced with spears and beaten, evidently on reprisal for stealing a canoe belonging to Aboriginals. The next day Phillip led a party to apprehend the murderers, but he was unable to identify them.
1788年6月：Owing to the neglect of the convict who was supposed to look after them, two bulls and four cows strayed from the settlement and were lost.

1788年7月5日：In a despatch to the under-secretary of state, Evan Nepean, Phillip recorded the rations for marines and male convicts. For seven days each received 7 pounds of bread or in lieu thereof 7 pounds of flour, 7 pounds of beef or in lieu thereof pork, 3 pints of pease, 6 ounces of butter, 1 pound of flour or in lieu thereof 12 pounds of rice. The women received two-thirds of this amount and the children generally had one-third although some received as much as the women.

1788年8月20日：Lt. William Bligh in HMS Bounty, en route to Tahiti, anchored at Adventure Bay, Van Diemen's Land. The party planted apple trees, fruit stones and various vegetables before departing on 4 September.
1788年9月28日：Phillip decided to send HMS Sirius to Cape Town for urgently needed food supplies.
1788年9月：The last remaining cow was killed.
1788年11月2日：A party of marines from the New South Wales Marine Corps and 10 convicts left to establish a farming settlement at Rose Hill (Later called Parramatta).
1788年11月19日：The last two ships of the First Fleet, Golden Grove and Fishburn, sailed for England with despatches and reports.
1788年12月11日：Phillip set out to explore Botany Bay, where he examined the Cook's, George's and Woronora Rivers.

1788年12月31日：Because the Aboriginal Australians could not be coaxed into the settlement, one named Arabanoo was captured and held in confinement. Phillip hoped to learn his language and so to promote good relations between Aboriginal Australians and Europeans.
1790年：5 of 6 ships of the beleaguered Second Fleet arrived. The colony was gripped by a food crisis.
1791年7月9日：The first ship of the Third Fleet arrived at Sydney Cove.
1792年：Two French ships, Recherche and Espérance, anchor at Recherche Bay, near the southernmost point of Tasmania.
1792年：Governor Philip returned to England, accompanied by Bennelong, who became the first Australian-born person to sail to Europe.
1797年：Sydney Cove was wrecked and some survivors travelled from Bass Strait to Port Jackson, enabling the rescue of others. This also furthered knowledge of the geography of Australia.
1798年：George Bass and Matthew Flinders sailed from Sydney and circumnavigated Tasmania, thus proving it to be an island. (to 1799)
1803年：Matthew Flinders completed the first circumnavigation of the continent
1804年：A settlement was founded at Risdon on the Derwent River in Van Diemen's Land
1804年：Castle Hill convict rebellion, also known as the second Battle of Vinegar Hill, occurred in New South Wales.
1804年2月20日：The Risdon settlement was moved to Sullivan's Cove (now Hobart) by Colonel David Collins.
1808年：The Rum Rebellion
1813年：Blaxland, Lawson and Wentworth crossed the Blue Mountains.
1813年：Matthew Flinders referred to New South Wales by the name "Australia".
1817年：John Oxley charts the Lachlan River
1817年：Australia's first bank, the Bank of New South Wales, opened in Macquarie Place, Sydney. (The bank became Westpac in 1982).
1817年：Governor Lachlan Macquarie petitioned the British Admiralty to use the name "Australia" instead of "New Holland"
1818年：Oxley charted the Macquarie River.
1824年：A penal colony was founded at Moreton Bay, now the city of Brisbane.
1824年：Bathurst and Melville Islands were annexed.
1824年：Permission was granted to change the name of the continent from "New Holland" to "Australia"
1824年：The Hume and Hovell expedition travelled overland to Port Phillip Bay and encountered the Murray River
1825年：The New South Wales western border was extended to 129° E. Van Diemen's Land was proclaimed.
1826年12月26日：New South Wales established first settlement in Western Australia at King George Sound as a convict-supported military garrison, named Frederick Town but renamed Albany in 1832
1827年1月21日：The whole of Australia was claimed as British territory when Major Edmund Lockyer formally annexed the western portion in a ceremony at King George Sound.
1829年：Charles Sturt charted the Darling River.
1830年：Sturt arrived at Goolwa, having charted the Murray River.
1831年3月7日：Administration of King George Sound passes to Swan River Colony, convicts returned to New South Wales.
1831年4月18日：The Sydney Herald (later to become The Sydney Morning Herald) was first published.
1832年：Swan River Colony had its name changed to Western Australia.
1833年：The penal settlement of Port Arthur was founded in Van Diemen's Land.
1834年：The Tolpuddle Martyrs are transported to Sydney and Hobart.
1835年8月30日：John Batman and John Pascoe Fawkner established a settlement at Port Phillip, now the city of Melbourne.
1835年：William Wentworth established Australian Patriotic Association, Australia's first political party, to demand democracy for New South Wales.
1836年12月28日：Province of South Australia proclaimed with its western border at 132° E.
1838年：First Prussian settlers arrived in South Australia; the largest group of non-British migrants in Australia at the time.
1839年：Paul Edmund Strzelecki became the first European to ascend and name Australia's highest peak, Mount Kosciuszko.
1840年：Australia's first municipal authority, the City of Adelaide, was established, followed by Sydney City Council.
1841年7月1日：New Zealand was proclaimed as a separate colony, no longer part of New South Wales.
1842年：Copper was discovered at Kapunda in South Australia.
1843年：Australia's first parliamentary elections was held for the New South Wales Legislative Council (though voting rights are restricted to males of certain wealth or property).
1845年8月4日：The ship Cataraqui was wrecked off King Island in Bass Strait. It is Australia's worst civil maritime disaster, with 406 lives lost.
1845年：Copper was discovered at Burra in South Australia.
1849年6月1日：Western Australia became a penal colony.

1850年：Australian Colonies Government Act [1850] granted representative constitutions to New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and Tasmania. These colonies set about writing constitutions which produced democratically progressive parliaments.
1850年10月1日：Australia's first university, the University of Sydney, was founded.
1851年7月1日：Victoria separated from New South Wales.
1851年：The Victorian gold rush started when gold was found at Summerhill Creek and Ballarat.
1851年12月15日：Forest Creek Monster Meeting of miners at Chewton near Castlemaine
1852年：Francis Cadell, in preparation for the launch of his steamer service, explored the Murray River in a canvas boat, travelling 1,300 miles (2,100 km) downstream from Swan Hill.

1853年：First paddle steamers on Murray River on the spring flood. From South Australia, the Lady Augusta captained by Francis Cadell, reached Swan Hill while Mary Ann captained by William Randell, made it as far as Moama (near Echuca).
1853年：Bendigo Petition and Red Ribbon Rebellion at Bendigo
1854年12月3日：The Eureka Stockade
1855年：The transportation of convicts to Norfolk Island ceased.
1855年：All men over 21 years of age obtained the right to vote in South Australia.
1856年1月1日：Van Diemen's Land name changed to Tasmania.

1857年：Victorian Committee reported that a 'federal union' would be in the interests of all the growing colonies. However, there was not enough interest in or enthusiasm for taking positive steps towards bringing the colonies together.
1857年：Victorian men achieved the right to vote.
1858年：Sydney and Melbourne linked by electric telegraph.
1858年：New South Wales men achieved the right to vote.
1859年8月6日：SS Admella wrecked off south-east coast of South Australia with the loss of 89 lives.
1859年：Australian rules football codified, Melbourne Football Club founded
1859年6月6日：Queensland separated from New South Wales with its western border at 141° E.
1860年：John McDouall Stuart reached the centre of the continent. The South Australian border changed from 132° E to 129° E.
1861年：The ill-fated Burke and Wills expedition occurred.
1861年：Skiing in Australia introduced by Norwegians in the Snowy Mountains goldrush town of Kiandra.
1862年：Stuart reached Port Darwin, founding a settlement there. Queensland's western border was moved to 139° E.
1863年：South Australia took control of the Northern Territory which was previously part of the colony of New South Wales.
1864年：Great Fire of Brisbane
1867年：Gold was discovered at Gympie, Queensland.
1867年：Saint Mary MacKillop founded Sisters of St Joseph of the Sacred Heart.
links: Sisters of St Joseph of the Sacred Heart

items.text: 1868年：The transportation of convicts to Western Australia ceased.

1869年：Children of Australian Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are removed from their families by Australian and State government agencies. This practice lasted 100 years and is known as the Stolen Generation.
1872年8月22日：The Overland Telegraph Line linking Darwin and Adelaide opened.
1873年：Uluru was first sighted by Europeans, and named Ayers Rock.
1875年2月24日：SS Gothenburg strikes Old Reef off Bowen, North Queensland and sank with the loss of approximately 102 lives.
1875年9月：Adelaide Steamship Company was formed.
1878年：First horse-drawn trams in Australia commenced operations in Adelaide.
1877年：The first internationally recognised game of Test Cricket is played between Australia and England at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG).
1879年：The first congress of trade unions was held.
1880年11月11日：The bushranger Ned Kelly was hanged.
1880年：Parliamentarians in Victoria became the first in Australia to be paid for their work.
1882年：First water-borne sewerage service in Australia commenced operations in Adelaide.
1883年：The opening of the Sydney–Melbourne railway.
1883年：Silver was discovered at Broken Hill
1888年：Louisa Lawson established The Dawn: A Journal for Australian Women.
1889年：The completion of the railway network between Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney.
1889年10月24日：Sir Henry Parkes delivered the Tenterfield Oration.
1890年：The Australian Federation Conference called a constitutional convention.
1890年4月26日：Banjo Paterson published "The Man from Snowy River"
1891年：A National Australasian Convention met and agreed on adopting the name "the Commonwealth of Australia," also drafting a constitution.
1891年：The first attempt at a federal constitution was drafted.
1891年：The Convention adopts the constitution, although it had no legal status
1891年：A severe depression hit Australia

1893年：The Corowa Conference (the "people's convention") called on the colonial parliaments to pass enabling acts, allowing the election of delegates to a new constitutional convention aimed at drafting a proposal and putting it to a referendum in each colony.

1894年：South Australia became the first Australian colony, and the second place in the world, to grant women the right to vote, as well the first Parliament in the world to allow women to stand for office with the Constitutional Amendment (Adult Suffrage) Act 1894.
1895年：The premiers, except for those of Queensland and Western Australia, agreed to implement the Corowa proposals.
1895年："Waltzing Matilda" was first sung in public, in Winton, Queensland
1896年：The Bathurst Conference (the second "people's convention") met to discuss the 1891 draft constitution.

1897年：In two sessions, the Second National Australasian Convention met (with representatives from all colonies except Queensland present). They agreed to adopt a constitution based on 1891 draft, and then revised and amended it later that year. Catherine Helen Spence became the first female political candidate for political office, standing for election as a representative for South Australia.
1898年：The Convention agreed on a final draft to be put to the people.

1898年：After much public debate, the Victorian, South Australian and Tasmanian referendums were successful; the New South Wales referendum narrowly failed. Later New South Wales voted "yes" in a second referendum.
1899年：The decision was made to site the national capital in New South Wales, but not within 100 miles of Sydney.
1899年9月22日：Queensland's offer of troops for the Second Boer War is accepted by the Imperial Government.
1899年11月4日：The New South Wales Lancers arrived in Cape Town from London to begin Australia's participation in the Second Boer War.
1899年11月6日：The Australian contingent to the Boer War departs Albany on the Medic.
1899年：The Australian Labor Party held office for a few days in Queensland, becoming the first trade union party to do so anywhere in the world.
1899年12月22日：Western Australia enacted full women's suffrage.
1900年：Several delegates visited London to resist proposed changes to the agreed-upon constitution.
1900年：The constitution was passed by the Parliament of the United Kingdom as a schedule to the Commonwealth of Australia Constitution Act, and was given royal assent

1901年1月1日：Australia becomes a federation. Edmund Barton becomes the 1st Prime Minister of Australia; the 7th Earl of Hopetoun becomes Governor-General. Black death strikes Australia, just over 100 people killed in Sydney.
1901年：The first parliament met in Parliament House, Melbourne
1901年：The Immigration Restriction Act was introduced forming the basis of the White Australia policy
1901年：The Australian National Flag was flown for the first time

1902年：The Franchise Act guarantees women the right to vote in federal elections (by this stage, most states had already done this). However, it excludes most non-European ethnic groups, including Aboriginal people, unless already registered to vote on State roles.
1902年：King Edward VII approved the design of the Australian flag.
1902年2月27日：Breaker Morant is executed for having shot Boers who had surrendered
1903年8月25日：The High Court of Australia is established with Samuel Griffith as the first Chief Justice.
1903年：The Defence Act gives the federal government full control over the Australian Army
1903年12月16日：1903 Australian federal election: Alfred Deakin is elected as the 2nd Prime Minister of Australia.
1904年：A site at Dalgety, New South Wales chosen for the new national capital
1904年：Chris Watson forms the first federal Labor (minority) government
1904年4月27日：Deakin resigns and Chris Watson assumes office as the 3rd Prime Minister of Australia.
1904年8月18日：George Reid becomes the 4th Prime Minister of Australia.
1905年7月5日：Alfred Deakin returns to the position of prime minister.
1906年：Australia takes control of south-eastern New Guinea
1906年12月12日：1906 Australian federal election: Alfred Deakin is reelected.
1908年：Dorothea Mackellar publishes My Country
1908年：The Dalgety proposal for the national capital is revoked, and Canberra is chosen instead.
1908年8月27日：Birth of Donald Bradman in Cootamundra, New South Wales.
1909年：The first powered aeroplane flight in Australia is made.
1909年6月2日：Alfred Deakin becomes prime minister.
1910年：Andrew Fisher forms the first federal majority Labor government.
1910年4月29日：Andrew Fisher become prime minister.
1911年：The Royal Australian Navy is founded
1911年：The Northern Territory comes under Commonwealth control, being split off from South Australia
1911年：The first national census is conducted.
1911年：Australian Capital Territory proclaimed.
1912年7月：Australia sends women to the Olympic Games for the first time
1912年10月22日：The Central Flying School RAAF, the foundation for the Royal Australian Air Force, is founded
1912年5月23日：Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin win the design competition for the new city of Canberra
1913年2月20日：The foundation stone for the city of Canberra is put in place
1913年3月20日：Canberra is officially named as the Capital of Australia.
1914年：Australian soldiers are sent to the First World War. This was first time Australians had fought under the Australian flag, as opposed to that of Britain's.
links: Military history of Australia during World War I

items.text: 1914年9月17日：Andrew Fisher becomes prime minister.
1915年4月25日：Australian soldiers land at ANZAC Cove on the Gallipoli Peninsula in Turkey.
1915年：Jervis Bay Territory comprising 6,677 hectares surrendered and becomes part of the Australia Capital Territory.
1915年：Surfing is first introduced to Australia
1915年10月27日：Billy Hughes became the 7th Prime Minister of Australia.
1916年：Hotels are forced to close at 6 p.m., leading to the beginning of the "six o'clock swill"
1916年：Australia suffers heavy casualties in the Western Front Battle of the Somme
1916年：The Returned Sailors’ and Soldiers’ Imperial League of Australia, the forerunner to the Returned and Services League of Australia is founded
links: Returned and Services League of Australia

items.text: 1916年：The Labor government under Billy Hughes splits over conscription. First referendum on conscription is rejected
1917年：Second referendum on conscription is rejected. Transcontinental railway linking Adelaide to Perth is completed.
1917年5月5日：1917 Australian federal election: Billy Hughes reelected as prime minister.
1917年10月31日：Battle of Beersheba: Australian 4th Light Horse Brigade launches last cavalry charge in modern warfare to capture Beersheba from the Ottoman Turks.

1918年：Battle of Amiens: Australian troops spearhead 8 August offensive against Hindenburg Line: the "black day of the German Army". On 12 August, Australian commander General Sir John Monash is knighted in the field of battle by King George V
1918年11月11日：First World War ends – 60,000 Australians dead.
1918年12月17日：The Darwin Rebellion takes place, with 1,000 demonstrators demanding the resignation of the Administrator of the Northern Territory, John A. Gilruth.
1919年：Prime Minister Billy Hughes signs Treaty of Versailles: the first signing of an international treaty by Australia. Australia obtains League of Nations mandate over German New Guinea.
1919年12月13日：1919 Australian federal election: Billy Hughes reelected as prime minister.
1920年：The airline Qantas is founded
1921年3月12日：Edith Cowan becomes the first woman elected to an Australian parliament
1922年：The Smith Family charity is founded in Sydney
1922年9月2日：Death of Henry Lawson aged 55.
1923年：Vegemite is first produced
1923年2月9日：Stanley Bruce became 8th Prime Minister of Australia.
1925年12月16日：1925 Australian federal election: Stanley Bruce reelected as prime minister.
1926年：The first Miss Australia contest is held
1927年5月9日：The tenth parliament is formally opened in Canberra, finalising the move to the new capital.

1928年：Bert Hinkler makes the first successful flight from Britain to Australia, and Charles Kingsford Smith makes the first flight from the United States to Australia. The Shrine of Remembrance is built.
1929年：Western Australia celebrates its centenary
1929年：Labor returns to office under James Scullin. The Great Depression hits Australia.
1930年1月6日：New South Wales batsman Don Bradman scores a world record first-class individual innings of 452 not out in a Sheffield Shield match against Queensland

1930年7月11日：In the Third Test at Leeds against England, Don Bradman scored a Hundred before Tea, a Hundred before lunch, and a Hundred by the end of the day's play, 309 in Total. He went on to make 334. Altogether in his 52 Test career, Bradman scored 29 Hundreds, 12 Double Hundreds and 2 Triple Hundreds. This is therefore the fastest Triple Hundred in Test History.
1930年9月27日：Sydney–Brisbane railway opens connecting New South Wales with Queensland by rail
1931年：Sir Douglas Mawson charts 4,000 miles of Antarctic coastline and claims 42% of the icy mass for Australia
1932年1月19日：Construction on the Sydney Harbour Bridge is completed.
1932年3月19日：The Sydney Harbour Bridge opens.
1932年：The Labor government falls and Joseph Lyons becomes prime minister.
1933年4月8日：Western Australia votes at a rerefendum to secede from the Commonwealth, but the vote is ignored by both the Commonwealth and British governments.
1935年11月8日：Sir Charles Kingsford Smith disappears. He was 38.
1936年：The last thylacine dies.
1937年：The radio series Dad and Dave begins.
1938年：Sydney hosts the Empire Games, the forerunner to the Commonwealth Games.
1939年1月13日：Victoria is devastated by the Black Friday bushfires.
1939年4月7日：Prime Minister Joseph Lyons dies in office and is replaced by Robert Menzies and the first Menzies Government.
1939年9月：Australia enters the Second World War following the German Invasion of Poland. The 2nd Australian Imperial Force is raised.
links: Military history of Australia during World War II

items.text: 1939年：The first flight is made by an Australian-made warplane, the Wirraway.
1940年：A team of scientists, under Howard Florey, develops penicillin
1940年：Fascist Italy enters war, Royal Australian Navy engages Italian Navy in the early stages of the Battle of the Mediterranean.

1941年：3 Divisions of the 2nd Australian Imperial Force join operations in the Mediterranean. After initial successes against Italy, 2nd AIF suffered defeat against the Germans in Greece, Crete, and North Africa.
1941年：Apr–Aug, Australian garrison (Rats of Tobruk) halt advance of Hitler's panzers for the first time during the Siege of Tobruk.
1941年：Menzies resigns and John Curtin becomes prime minister in the Curtin government of 1941–45.
1942年2月：Singapore falls, 15,000 Australians become Prisoners of War of the Japanese
links: Military history of Australia during World War II

items.text: 1942年：Japanese air raids – almost 100 attacks against sites in the Northern Territory, Western Australia and Queensland (to 1943). Bombing of Darwin sees largest attack on Australia by a foreign power.
1942年：The Royal Australian Navy and 6th and 7th Divisions of 2nd AIF are recalled from Mediterranean Theatre to participate in the anticipated Battle for Australia.
1942年：Sparrow Force engages in guerilla campaign in Battle of Timor (to 1943)
1942年：Battle of the Coral Sea: United States and Royal Australian Navy halt advance of the Japanese towards Port Moresby (Australian Territory of Papua)
1942年：Battle of Kokoda Trail: Australian soldiers halt Japanese march on Port Moresby
1942年：Australian forces inflict the first defeat on the Imperial Japanese Army in the Battle of Milne Bay.
1942年：Australia's 9th Division plays crucial role in the First and Second Battle of El Alamein, which turned the North Africa Campaign in favour of the Allies.
1942年：National daylight saving is introduced as a war time measure.
1942年10月9日：The UK Statute of Westminster is formally adopted by Australia. The Statute formally grants Australia the right to pass laws that conflict with UK laws.
1943年3月4日：Australia wins its first Oscar, with cinematographer Damien Parer honoured for Kokoda Front Line! documentary.
1943年：2,815 Australian POWs die constructing Japan's Burma-Thailand Railway
1943年：Australian forces engage Japan in New Guinea, Wau, and the Huon peninsula. (to 1944)
1944年8月5日：Cowra breakout, mass escape of Japanese prisoners of war occurs in NSW.
1944年：Japanese inflict Sandakan Death March on 2,000 Australian and British prisoners of war – only 6 survive. The single worst war crime perpetrated against Australians.
1944年：Australian forces battle Japanese garrisons from Borneo to Bougainville.
1944年：The Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme is introduced, providing subsidised medicine to all Australians
1945年：the Liberal Party of Australia is established with Robert Menzies as its first leader.
1945年：Australian forces lead Battle of Borneo
1945年5月7日：Nazi Germany surrenders
1945年7月：Prime Minister Curtin dies and is replaced, briefly by Frank Forde, then by Ben Chifley and the Chifley Labor government
1945年8月14日：Japan surrenders
1945年：Australia becomes a founding member of the United Nations
1945年：The Sydney to Hobart Yacht Race is held for the first time
1946年：Minister for Immigration Arthur Calwell introduces the major post-war immigration scheme
links: Minister for Immigration and Border Protection (Australia)

items.text: 1946年：Norman Makin, is voted in as the first President of the United Nations Security Council.
links: President of the United Nations Security Council

items.text: 1948年：Minister for External Affairs, Dr. H. V. Evatt is elected President of the United Nations General Assembly.
links: President of the United Nations General Assembly

items.text: 1948年：Holden starts manufacturing its first Australian designed and built car. The First Model is the 48/215 followed by the FJ, FE, FC, FB, EK, EJ, EH, HD, HR, HK, HT, HQ, HJ, HX. The Holden Commodore was introduced in 1978 and started off with the VB, VH, VK, VL, VN, VT, VY, VZ, VE. Due to financial problems, Holden will no longer manufacture cars in Australia from 2017.
1948年：Australia becomes a signatory to the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
1949年：All indigenous ex-servicemen and any Indigenous Australians who are eligible to vote in State Elections (NSW, VIC, SA and TAS) are given an unrestricted right to vote in federal elections.
1949年1月26日：The Nationality and Citizenship Act is passed. Rather than being identified as subjects of Britain, the Act established Australian citizenship for people who met eligibility requirements.
1949年10月17日：Construction of the Snowy Mountains Hydro-Electric Scheme officially begins
1949年12月10日：1949 Australian federal election: Robert Menzies returns to power as leader of the new Liberal Party Menzies Government.
1950年：Australian troops are sent to the Korean War to assist South Korea. (to 1953)
1951年：Voters reject a referendum to change the Constitution to allow the Menzies Government to ban the Communist Party
1951年9月1日：Australia signs the ANZUS treaty with the United States and New Zealand
1952年10月3日：Operation Hurricane: First nuclear test conducted in Australian territory by the United Kingdom off the coast of Western Australia.
1954年：Elizabeth II and Prince Philip make a royal visit; the Soviet diplomat Vladimir Petrov defects, leading to the Petrov Affair and another split in the Labor Party
1955年：Democratic Labor Party splits from Australian Labor Party over concerns of Communist influence in the labour movement
1955年：Australia becomes involved in Malayan Insurgency
1955年：Hotels in New South Wales no longer have to close at 6 p.m., ending the "six o'clock swill"
1956年9月16日：Television in Australia is launched.
1956年：The 16th Summer Olympics is held in Melbourne
1956年：Performing artist Barry Humphries introduces Edna Everage to the Australian stage
1957年：The song "Wild One" makes Johnny O'Keefe the first Australian rock'n'roller to reach the national charts.
1957年：Slim Dusty's Australian country music hit "A Pub with No Beer" becomes the first Australian song to attain international chart success.
1959年3月1日：Construction begins on the Sydney Opera House. It will eventually cost $102 Million.

1962年：Robert Menzies' Commonwealth Electoral Act provided that all Indigenous Australians should have the right to enrol and vote at federal elections, removing remaining restrictions applying in QLD, WA and NT.
1962年4月16日：Sydney–Melbourne rail corridor opens with Spirit of Progress connecting New South Wales to Victoria by rail
1962年：Malayan Insurgency ends
1964年：The Beatles' 1964 world tour reach Australia
1964年2月10日：82 sailors die when HMAS Voyager sinks after collision with HMAS Melbourne
1964年：The editors of Oz magazine are charged with obscenity
1964年：Prime Minister Robert Menzies announces the reintroduction of compulsory military service for men aged from 18 to 25 years old
1964年：First troops sent to Vietnam War.
1965年：Indigenous Australians gain right to vote in state of Queensland
1966年：The ban on the employment of married women in the Commonwealth Public Service is lifted
1966年1月26日：Robert Menzies retire as Australia's longest-serving prime minister and is succeeded by Harold Holt.
1966年1月26日：The Beaumont Children Jane (9), Arnna (7), and Grant (4) disappear from Glenelg Beach.
1967年2月3日：Ronald Ryan becomes the last person legally executed in Australia.
1967年2月7日：Black Tuesday bushfires devastate large areas of Hobart and south-eastern Tasmania; 64 people were killed.
1967年2月9日：Gough Whitlam becomes leader of the Labor Party
1967年5月27日：The constitution is changed to allow Aboriginal Australians to be included in the population count and for the federal government to legislate for them
1967年：Sydney is rocked by a series of brutal underworld killings
1967年：Talkback radio is introduced
1967年12月17日：Prime Minister Harold Holt disappears while swimming at Cheviot Beach, Victoria

1967年12月19日：Holt was officially presumed dead by the government. Governor-General Lord Casey swore John McEwen in as prime minister, on an interim basis pending the Liberal Party electing its new leader
1968年1月10日：John Gorton replaces John McEwen as Prime Minister
1968年6月24日：British comedian Tony Hancock commits suicide in Sydney
1968年7月1日：Australia signs the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons
links: Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons

items.text: 1968年：Aboriginal boxing champion Lionel Rose defeats Masahiko "Fighting" Harada in Japan to become the world bantamweight champion
1968年：Australia's first liver transplant operation is performed in Sydney
1969年：French conceptual artist Christo 'wraps' Little Bay in Sydney
1969年11月：Renowned author-artists Norman Lindsay and May Gibbs die
1969年：The Australian production of the rock musical Hair premieres in Sydney
1969年：Top pop groups the Easybeats and the Twilights break up; Tim Burstall directs 2000 Weeks, the first All-Australian feature released since Charles Chauvel's Jedda in 1958
1969年10月25日：1969 Australian federal election: John Gorton reelected as prime minister.
1970年：More than 200,000 people participate in the largest demonstrations in Australian history, against the Vietnam War
1971年：Neville Bonner becomes the first Aborigine to become an Australian Member of Parliament;
1971年3月10日：John Gorton resigns as prime minister and is succeeded by William McMahon

1971年：The 1971 South Africa rugby union tour of Australia sparks protest all throughout Australia. Premier of Queensland Joh Bjelke-Petersen declares a state of emergency in QLD in response to escalating protest.
links: 1971 South Africa rugby union tour of Australia

items.text: 1971年：Daylight saving is introduced to New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia and the Australian Capital Territory.
1971年：Green Bans begin in Hunters Hill, Sydney and spread across New South Wales.
1972年：The Commonwealth Conciliation and Arbitration Commission rules that women doing the same job as men have the right to be paid the same wage.
1972年：Queensland discontinues Daylight Saving.
1972年：Aboriginal Tent Embassy erected in response to the Coalition government's approval of exploration licences and mining tenements on reserves
1972年7月：Supersonic passenger plane Concorde lands in Darwin
1972年12月2日：1972 Australian federal election: The first Labor government since 1949 is elected under the leadership of Gough Whitlam
1972年：Australia recognises the People's Republic of China
1973年10月20日：The Sydney Opera House formally opened by Elizabeth II
1973年：The White Australian Policy (established 1901) is officially dismantled
1973年：Vietnam War ends
1973年：The federal voting age is dropped from 21 to 18
1973年：Unionists save the historic The Rocks area of Sydney from demolition by introducing Green Bans
1973年：Patrick White becomes the first Australian to win the Nobel Prize in Literature
1974年："Advance Australia Fair" recognised as Australia's national song, but not as national anthem.
1974年：Darwin is devastated by Cyclone Tracy.

1975年：The Privy Council (Appeals from the High Court) Act removes the right to appeal High Court decisions to the British Privy Council. Appeals to the Privy Council direct from State Supreme Courts remain until 1988.

1975年1月5日：The Hobart Bridge collapsed. A bulk ore carrier travelling on the Derwent River collided into several pylons of the Tasman Bridge killing a total of 12 people. These included 7 crew on board the ship and 5 people that were in 4 cars which drove 45m off the bridge into the Derwent River.
1975年9月17日：Papua New Guinea gains independence from Australian rule
1975年：South Australia becomes the first state in Australia to legalise homosexual acts between consenting adults in private.

1975年：Whitlam government introduced the Aboriginal Land (NT) Bill into Parliament. The bill proposed land rights in the Northern Territory based on land claimed on grounds of need as well as traditional affiliation and traditional landowners maintaining control over mining and development.

1975年：A constitutional crisis occurs when Malcolm Fraser delays supply, threatening a government shutdown until Governor-General John Kerr dismisses Prime Minister Gough Whitlam on 11 November 1975. Kerr then appointed Malcolm Fraser, Leader of the Opposition, as caretaker prime minister.
1975年12月13日：1975 Australian federal election: Malcolm Fraser wins elections and becomes Prime Minister
1976年：The Australian Capital Territory legalises homosexuality between consenting adults in private.
1977年1月18日：Granville rail disaster killed eighty-three people
1978年6月24日：First Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras
links: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras

items.text: 1979年：Australian women win the right to maternity leave
1979年：Kakadu National Park and the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park are both proclaimed.
1980年8月17日：Baby Azaria Chamberlain disappears from a campsite at Uluru (Ayers Rock), reportedly taken by a dingo.
1980年10月18日：1980 Australian federal election: The Coalition is elected.
1981年：A referendum is held in Tasmania to vote for whether or not the Franklin Dam should be built.
1982年：12th Commonwealth Games held in Brisbane.
1982年：The National Gallery of Australia is opened.
1983年2月16日：The Ash Wednesday bushfires kill 71 people.
1983年3月5日：1983 Australian federal election: Bob Hawke defeats Fraser and leads Labor back to government.
1983年：Australia wins the America's Cup
1983年12月12日：The Australian dollar is floated.
1984年4月19日："Advance Australia Fair" is proclaimed as Australia's official national anthem.
1984年2月1日：Medicare is established.
1984年5月14日：The one dollar coin is issued to replace the one dollar note.
1984年12月1日：1984 Australian federal election: Labor wins.

1985年：The government grants the freehold title of a large area of land in central Australia, including prominent landmarks Uluru and Kata Tjuta, to the Mutitjulu people, who in turn give them a 99-year lease. The last state to do so (New South Wales) abolishes capital punishment.

1986年：The Australia Act removes the right of appeal from State courts to the British Privy Council, making the High Court the final court of appeal in Australia. The Act also removes all remaining rights of the UK parliament to pass law for Australia.
1986年2月2日：Murder of Anita Cobby in Sydney.
1986年3月27日：Russell Street Bombing in Melbourne.
1986年：Crocodile Dundee is released in Australia.
1987年8月9日：Hoddle Street massacre kills 7 victims and injures 19
1987年12月1日：Sir Joh Bjelke-Petersen resigns as Premier of Queensland after 19 years at the top.
1987年12月8日：Queen Street massacre kills 8 victims and injures 5.
1988年1月26日：Australia celebrates its bicentenary, with large celebrations and major funding for capital works projects.
1988年9月3日：Federal referendums on 4-year parliamentary terms, recognition of local government and other issues are defeated.
1988年：Brisbane hosts World Expo 88.
1988年5月9日：The new Parliament House opens in Canberra.
1989年：Newcastle earthquake kills 13 people. ACT gains self-Government. The Kempsey bus crash and Grafton bus crash kill a total of 56 people.
1989年：Queensland commences three-year trial of Daylight Saving.

1989年：Rosemary Follett (Australian Labor Party) becomes the first Chief Minister of the Australian Capital Territory and the first woman to become head of government in an Australian state or territory.
links: Chief Minister of the Australian Capital Territory

items.text: 1990年：Royal Australian Navy deployed in preparation for the First Gulf War. Carmen Lawrence becomes the first female premier of an Australian state. Labor wins the 1990 federal election.
1991年7月4日：Prominent heart surgeon Victor Chang is gunned down.
1991年8月17日：Seven people die in the Strathfield massacre.
1991年8月21日：The Coode Island chemical storage facility in Melbourne explodes, leaving a toxic cloud hanging over the city for days.
1991年9月2日：Council for Aboriginal Reconciliation Act 1991 is passed; reconciliation in Australia policy established.
1991年12月20日：Paul Keating replaces Bob Hawke to be the 24th Prime Minister of Australia.

1992年：The High Court delivers the Mabo Decision, which rules that indigenous native title does exist. This effectively extinguishes the concept of terra nullius. New South Wales Premier Nick Greiner resigns.
1992年2月22日：Queensland holds a referendum on daylight saving, which is defeated with a 54.5% 'no' vote.
1993年3月13日：1993 Australian federal election: Keating defeats John Hewson; the Australian Greens stand candidates for the first time.
1995年：The Northern Territory legalises voluntary euthanasia, but it is overruled by the federal government when Liberal MP Kevin Andrews proposes the Euthanasia Laws Bill 1996
1996年：The High Court hands down the Wik Decision, which holds that indigenous native title can survive the granting of pastoral leases.
1996年3月2日：1996 Australian federal election: Liberal John Howard becomes prime minister, defeating Paul Keating after a record 13 years of Labor government
1996年：Howard government leads all Australian states and territories agree to introduce uniform gun laws following the deaths of 35 people in the Port Arthur massacre
1997年：Expelled Liberal MP Pauline Hanson forms the One Nation Party
1997年5月1日：Tasmania legalises homosexuality
1997年7月30日：1997 Thredbo landslide: Eighteen people die when the Bimbadene and Carinya Lodges collapse at Thredbo Alpine Village at 11.30 p.m.
1998年：A major strike results when Patrick Stevedores attempt to introduce non-union labour to reduce the influence of the Maritime Union of Australia
1998年：The Australian Securities Exchange is demutualized and floated as a public company, becoming the world's first stock exchange to be listed on an exchange.
1999年8月26日：Both houses of the federal parliament pass a Motion of Reconciliation signifying both recognition of and regret at past mistreatment of indigenous Australians.
1999年11月6日：A referendum on changing to a republic is unsuccessful
1999年：Howard government deploys Australian forces to East Timor to lead the INTERFET mission, following violence in wake of East Timorese vote for independence.
2000年7月1日：Howard government introduces a Goods and Services Tax
2000年：27th Summer Olympic Games held in Sydney.
2001年：Australia celebrates centenary of federation.
2001年2月25日：Death of Donald Bradman, aged 92 in Kensington Park, Adelaide, South Australia.
2001年：Western Australia adopts a uniform age of consent of 16.
2001年：Boat load of asylum seekers is rescued by Norwegian ship, leading to the Tampa affair.
2001年：Australian forces deployed to War to topple Taliban for supporting Al-Qaeda.
2001年11月10日：2001 Australian federal election: John Howard is reelected as prime minister.
2002年10月12日：2002 Bali bombings, the deadliest act of terrorism in the history of Indonesia, killing 202 people (including 88 Australians).
2003年：Australian military deployed to Iraq War to oust the Saddam Hussein regime for serial non-compliance with the 1991 Gulf War Peace Treaty.
2003年：Northern Territory introduces uniform age of consent set at 16 for everyone.
2003年：New South Wales becomes the last State to have a uniform age of consent at 16 for everyone.
2003年：Australia hosts the Rugby World Cup, with the home side losing the final to England.
2003年9月19日：Country music singer and musician Slim Dusty dies, aged 76.
2004年9月9日：A bomb explodes outside the Australian embassy in Jakarta, Indonesia.
2004年10月9日：2004 Australian federal election: Howard government (Liberal-National Coalition) wins fourth term and defeats Mark Latham led Australian Labor Party.
2005年12月：Sydney beachside suburb of Cronulla sees a protest against the alleged bashing of a beach lifeguard, developing into an alcohol-fuelled, racially charged riot.
2006年：The Commonwealth Games are held in Melbourne.
2006年9月4日：Wildlife conservationist and television personality Steve Irwin dies, aged 44.
2006年9月8日：Motor racing driver Peter Brock dies, aged 61.
2006年：Australian Forces are again deployed to East Timor to help stabilize the country.
2007年：Australia avoids recession amidst 2008 financial crisis (to 2010).
2007年11月24日：2007 Australian federal election: Kevin Rudd (Australian Labor Party) defeats John Howard (Liberal-National Coalition) to become the 26th Prime Minister of Australia.
2008年1月22日：Actor Heath Ledger dies from an accidental prescription drug intoxication, aged 28.
2008年2月13日：Kevin Rudd leads bi-partisan Parliament to formally apologise for the Stolen Generations.
2008年：Longest heatwave for an Australian capital city recorded in Adelaide.
2008年：Sydney hosts Catholic World Youth Day.
2008年9月5日：Quentin Bryce assumes office, becoming the first female Governor-General of Australia.
2009年：Black Saturday bushfires: Massive bushfires swept across Victoria, resulting in 173 fatalities.
2010年：Julia Gillard challenged and replaced Kevin Rudd as leader of the Labor Party to become the 27th and first female Prime Minister of Australia.
2010年10月17日：Mary MacKillop canonised as Australia's first Saint of the Roman Catholic Church.

2010年8月21日：2010 Australian federal election: Election results in hung Parliament and narrow victory by Julia Gillard (ALP) over Tony Abbott (Lib-Nat Coalition); Liberal Ken Wyatt becomes the first Aboriginal member elected to the Australian House of Representatives.
2011年：Queensland is affected by major flooding, followed by Cyclone Yasi.
2012年7月1日：Carbon price introduced by the Gillard government.
2013年3月21日：Julia Gillard apologises to victims of forced adoption practices for removal of babies from predominantly young single mothers.
2013年6月26日：Kevin Rudd defeats Julia Gillard in a leadership spill, 57 votes to 45. Gillard resigns from parliament, Rudd is again sworn in as prime minister.
links: Australian Labor Party leadership spill, June 2013

items.text: 2013年9月7日：2013 Australian federal election: Tony Abbott defeats Kevin Rudd to become the 28th Prime Minister of Australia.
2014年7月14日：Carbon price is dropped by the Abbott government.
2014年10月21日：21st Prime Minister of Australia Gough Whitlam dies, aged 98.
2014年：2014 Sydney hostage crisis.
2015年3月20日：22nd Prime Minister of Australia Malcolm Fraser dies, aged 84.
2015年9月15日：Malcolm Turnbull defeats Tony Abbott in a leadership spill, 54 votes to 44. Turnbull is sworn in as the 29th Prime Minister of Australia.
links: September 2015 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill

items.text: 2015年：The Matagurup Refugee Camp is founded in Perth to defend Aboriginal Rights.
2016年7月2日：2016 Australian federal election: Malcolm Turnbull remains as Prime Minister of Australia.
2016年11月21日：A Thunderstorm asthma event in Melbourne kills 10 people and sends thousands to emergency departments
2017年：John Cameron sets off the chain of events that became the 2017 Australian parliamentary eligibility crisis.
2017年12月9日：Same-sex marriage is legalised by the Marriage Amendment (Definition and Religious Freedoms) Act 2017.
links: Marriage Amendment (Definition and Religious Freedoms) Act 2017

items.text: 2018年8月24日：Following two leadership spills, Scott Morrison succeeds Malcolm Turnbull as leader of the Liberal Party and is sworn in as the 30th Prime Minister of Australia.
links: 2018 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spills

items.text: 2019年5月18日：2019 Australian federal election: Scott Morrison remains as Prime Minister of Australia.
2019年：Bushfires occur throughout late 2019 in every state and territory, destroying 2600 homes and killing 34 people.
2020年1月31日：The ACT becomes the first Australian region to legalise recreational cannabis.
2020年：Australia suffers lockdowns and social restrictions due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
2021年9月15日：The AUKUS security partnership between Australia, the United Kingdom, and the United States is announced after negotiations.
2022年：2022 eastern Australia floods
2022年5月23日：2022 Australian federal election: Anthony Albanese (Australian Labor Party) defeats Scott Morrison (Liberal-National Coalition) to become the 31st Prime Minister of Australia.
2022年9月8日：Elizabeth II, the longest-reigning Australian monarch in history, dies aged 96, after a reign of 70 years. Charles III becomes the new Australian monarch.
2023年10月14日：The Australian Indigenous Voice referendum fails to pass, with 60% of Australians voting "No".
2023年11月9日：Tuvalu and Australia signed the Falepili Union
2024年1月14日：Mary Donaldson becomes the first Australian-born queen consort of a European monarchy when she is proclaimed Queen of Denmark when her husband Frederik X ascends the throne.
2024年4月13日：Bondi Junction stabbings kills 6 victims and injures 12
2025年5月3日：2025 Australian federal election: Anthony Albanese remains as Prime Minister of Australia.
2025年10月6日：Papua New Guinea and Australia signed the Pukpuk Treaty
2025年12月14日：Bondi Beach shooting kills 16 and injures 40.
2026年7月6日：Fiji and Australia signed the Veitacini Treaty
2026年10月19日：Federal member for Indi Helen Haines is attacked in Wangaratta
前25000年：The Soi Nhụ culture appeared.
前23000年：The Ngườm culture appeared.
前20000年：The Sơn Vi culture appeared in modern Lâm Thao district.
前12000年：Hoabinhian artifacts began to be produced in Northern Vietnam.
前10000年：The Bắc Sơn culture appeared.
前8000年：The Quỳnh Văn culture appeared.
前5000年：The Cái Bèo culture appeared.
前4000年：The first rice cultivation of which evidence survives in modern Vietnam took place.
前4000年：The Đa Bút culture appeared in what is now Vĩnh Lộc district.
前3500年：Wet rice was cultivated in the Red River Delta.

前2879年：Kinh Dương Vương unified all vassal states in his territory into the single state of Xích Quỷ, which he ruled as Hùng king from the capital at Phong Châu. He also sponsored the development of martial arts in Xích Quỷ at the time.
前2793年：Kinh Dương Vương was succeeded as Hùng king of Xích Quỷ, since renamed Văn Lang, by his son Lạc Long Quân.
前2637年：The lunar calendar came into use in Văn Lang.
前2524年：The first Hùng king of the Cấn line came to power in Văn Lang.
前2500年：The Hùng king ordered an increase in rice cultivation.
前2253年：The last Hùng king of the Cấn line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前2252年：The first Hùng king of the Chấn line came to power in Văn Lang.
前2200年：The earliest surviving artifacts indicating use of the Vietnamese calendar appeared.
前2000年：The Phùng Nguyên culture appeared.
前1913年：The last Hùng king of the Chấn line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前1912年：The first Hùng king of the Tốn line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1712年：The first Hùng king of the Ly line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1700年：Burial rituals and tomb building came into practice.
前1631年：The first Hùng king of the Khôn line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1500年：The Đồng Đậu culture appeared.
前1500年：A sophisticated agricultural society developed on the Vietnamese coast.
前1432年：The last Hùng king of the Khôn line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前1431年：The first Hùng king of the Đoài line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1331年：The first Hùng king of the Giáp line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1251年：The first Hùng king of the Ất line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1200年：The Lạc Việt discovered bronze casting.
前1200年：Irrigation was first used in rice cultivation in the plains of the Mã and Red Rivers.
前1162年：The last Hùng king of the Ất line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前1161年：The first Hùng king of the Bính line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1100年：The Gò Mun culture appeared.
前1055年：The last Hùng king of the Bính line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前1054年：The first Hùng king of the Đinh line came to power in Văn Lang.
前1000年：The Đông Sơn culture appeared in the valley of the Red River.
前1000年：Copper casting began to be used in Văn Lang in the manufacture of brass tools, weapons, and ornaments.
前1000年：The population of Văn Lang reached one million.
前1000年：The Lạc Việt developed observational astronomy.
前969年：The last Hùng king of the Đinh line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前968年：The first Hùng king of the Mậu line came to power in Văn Lang.
前853年：The first Hùng king of the Kỷ line came to power in Văn Lang.
前754年：The first Hùng king of the Canh line came to power in Văn Lang.
前700年：Refugees from the increasingly fragile Zhou dynasty began to arrive in the Red River Delta.
前661年：The last Hùng king of the Canh line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前660年：The first Hùng king of the Tân line came to power in Văn Lang.
前600年：The metallurgical style unique to the Đông Sơn drums was invented.
前600年：An elaborate system of canals and dikes was invented which made possible the tidal irrigation of rice fields.
前569年：The last Hùng king of the Tân line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前568年：The first Hùng king of the Nhâm line came to power in Văn Lang.
前500年：The earliest artifacts suggesting the celebration of Tết appeared.
前470年：King Goujian of Yue sent messengers to Văn Lang demanding submission.
前470年：The last Hùng king of the Nhâm line ended his rule of Văn Lang.
前408年：Hùng Duệ Vương became Hùng king of Văn Lang.
前400年：A mass migration of refugees to the Red River Delta took place due to the ongoing collapse of the Zhou dynasty.
前300年：Buddhist missionaries from Maurya Empire arrived in Văn Lang.
前300年：The Âu Việt settled across the northern border of Văn Lang and opened trade relations with the Lạc Việt.
前257年：Thục Phán, ruler of the Âu Việt, invaded and conquered Văn Lang. He renamed the country Âu Lạc and took the regnal name An Dương Vương, ruling as king from Cổ Loa Citadel.
前250年：The Hùng Temple was built.
前210年：The Battle of Tiên Du took place.
前207年：The Qin general Zhao Tuo captured Cổ Loa Citadel. An Dương Vương fled and later committed suicide.
前207年：Zhao Tuo divided the territory under his control into the commanderies of Jiaozhi and Jiuzhen.Chinese annals mark this as the start of Vietnamese history.
links: Chinese Annals of History of Science and Technology

items.text: 前206年：The warlord Xiang Yu led an army into the Qin capital Xianyang, burned the Epang Palace and killed the Qin emperor Ziying and the royal family.
前203年：Zhao Tuo declared himself king of Nanyue, with his capital in modern Panyu, Guangzhou.
前203年：Nanyue conquered Guilin.
前198年：Two delegates were assigned to oversee the affairs of Jiaozhi and Jiuzhen.
前196年：The Han official Lu Jia gave Zhao Tuo a seal recognizing him as king of Nanyue in exchange for his nominal submission to the Han emperor.
前183年：Empress Lü, the Han empress dowager and regent for her grandson Emperor Houshao of Han, ordered a trade blockade of Nanyue.
前183年：Zhao Tuo sacked the Han capital Chang'an.
前183年：The nearby polities of Minyue, Yelang and Tongshi declared their allegiance to Nanyue.
前181年：A punitive Han invasion of Nanyue stalled after much of the invading army fell to illness.
前180年：Lü Zhi died. Nanyue conquered some Han territory near the border.

前179年：In exchange for the restoration of his family in modern Zhengding County and the withdrawal of Han forces from the Nanyue border, Zhao Tuo renounced the title emperor and pledged submission to the Han dynasty.
前179年：Luy Lâu was founded.
前179年：Zhao Tuo died. He was succeeded as king of Nanyue by his grandson Zhao Mo.
前135年：A border war took place between Nanyue and Minyue.
前122年：Zhao Mo died. He was succeeded as king of Nanyue by his eldest son Zhao Yingqi.
前118年：Confucian ideas were introduced to Nanyue.
前115年：Zhao Yingqi died. He was succeeded by his son Zhao Xing.

前112年：Lü Jia, the prime minister of Nanyue and a Lạc Việt chief, killed Zhao Xing and his Han Chinese mother Juishi after the latter agreed to full submission to the Han dynasty in order to preserve her authority in Nanyue. He declared Zhao Xing's elder brother Zhao Jiande king.

前111年：Han conquest of Nanyue: Han forces invaded Nanyue. Zhao Jiande was captured in flight and executed. The zhou of Jiaozhou was organized on the territory of the defunct Nanyue and divided into the commanderies of Nanhai, Cangwu, Yulin, Jiaozhi, Hepu, Zhuya, Taner, and Jiuzhen. Shi Dai was appointed its governor.
前111年：Tây Vu Vương launched a revolt against Han forces.
前110年：Tây Vu Vương was assassinated by his assistant Hoàng Đồng.
前86年：Shi Dai's rule of Jiaozhou ended.
前48年：The commandery of Rinan in Jiaozhou was organized south of the Hoành Sơn Range.
2年：Tích Quang became governor of Jiaozhou.
2年：A census in Jiaozhou counted some hundred thousand households and nearly one million people.
31年：Tích Quang's rule of Jiaozhou ended.
34年：Su Ding became governor of Jiaozhou.
39年：Thi Sách was assassinated.
40年：Trung sisters' rebellion: The Trưng Sisters launched a rebellion against Han authority in the Red River Delta.
43年：Trung sisters' rebellion: the Trưng Sisters committed suicide by drowning themselves before The Han general Ma Yuan could capture them.
229年6月23日：Sun Quan declared himself emperor, founding the state of Eastern Wu, separating from the Han dynasty.
246年：Lady Triệu uprising.
544年2月：Following his rebellion and expulsion of Liang forces from Jiaozhou, Lý Nam Đế was proclaimed emperor of Vạn Xuân.

545年：The Liang general Emperor Wu of Chen launched a surprise attack on the Vạn Xuân capital Long Biên, forcing Lý Nam Đế and the imperial administration to flee to the Gia Ninh Citadel in modern Việt Trì.
546年：Lý Nam Đế was forced to retreat to Khuất Lão Cave, where he reorganized his army under the command of Triệu Việt Vương.
547年：Vạn Xuân forces defended Dạ Trạch in modern Khoái Châu District from Liang forces.
548年2月：Lý Nam Đế ceded rule of Vạn Xuân to Triệu Việt Vương and his older brother Lý Thiên Bảo.
548年4月：Lý Nam Đế was assassinated in modern Laos.
550年：Triệu Việt Vương expelled Liang forces from Vạn Xuân and reestablished the capital at Long Biên.
555年：Lý Thiên Bảo died without heirs.
557年：Hậu Lý Nam Đế, Lý Nam Đế's cousin and claimant to the throne of Vạn Xuân, signed a truce with Triệu Việt Vương establishing a boundary between their two territories.
571年：Hậu Lý Nam Đế surprised and conquered Triệu Việt Vương and moved his capital to Phong Châu.
602年：Sui–Former Lý War: Sui conquered Vạn Xuân following a brief rebellion by Hậu Lý Nam Đế.
713年：Mai Thúc Loan uprising.
776年：Phùng Hưng uprising.

938年：Battle of Bạch Đằng: Ngô Quyền defeated the Southern Han kingdom at the Battle of Bạch Đằng north of modern Haiphong and ended 1,000 years of Chinese domination dating back to 111 BC under the Han dynasty, founding the Ngô dynasty.
965年：Anarchy of the 12 Warlords

979年：Emperor Đinh Bộ Lĩnh of Đại Cồ Việt was assassinated along with his crown prince Đinh Liễn by a minor palace official. His surviving son, the young Đinh Phế Đế, succeeded him under the regency of the commander-in-chief Lê Hoàn.
979年：Lê Hoàn declared himself viceroy of Đại Cồ Việt with the support of the empress dowager Dương Vân Nga.
