1785年：Bodawpaya's invasion of Siam fails; Lan Na now firmly in Siamese camp (to 1786)
1787年：Defeats Siamese invasion of Tenasserim
1790年：Resumes diplomatic relationship with China
1792年：Defeats another Siamese invasion of Tenasserim
1797年：Burmese invasion of Lan Na and Luang Prabang fails
1802年：Ceylonese monks seek ordination at Amarapura
1803年：Siamese invasion of Kengtung fails (to 1804)
1809年：Burmese invasion of Junkceylon (Phuket) fails (to 1812)
1814年2月：Burma annexes Manipur
1817年：Assam becomes tributary to Burma
1819年：Burmese put down rebellions in Assam and Manipur
1822年6月3日：Burmese put down another rebellion in Assam, and make it a Burmese province
1824年3月5日：Start of First Anglo-Burmese War
1826年2月24日：End of First Anglo-Burmese War; Burma cedes Arakan, Assam, Manipur and Tenasserim
1849年：Defeats Siamese invasion of Kengtung (to 1855)
1852年：Second Anglo-Burmese War; British seize Lower Burma
1853年：British expand Rangoon (modern-day downtown Yangon)
1859年5月23日：Mindon moves capital to newly founded city of Mandalay
1866年：Head of reform movement, Crown Prince Kanaung is assassinated.
1871年：Fifth Buddhist council convenes
1875年3月：Mindon cedes Karenni States to the British to avoid annexation
1878年：Rangoon College founded
1885年11月29日：Third Anglo-Burmese War; end of Burmese monarchy
1886年：British "pacification" of Burma (to 1896)
1886年1月1日：Burma is proclaimed a British colony. February: Burma is proclaimed a province of British India
1920年：First Rangoon University strike
1921年：The Dyarchy reforms begin
1930年：Nationalist and leftist Dobama Asiayone founded
1930年：Peasants' rebellion (to 1932)
1936年：Second Rangoon University strike
1937年：Burma is separated from British India and becomes a separate colony
1938年：Third Rangoon University strike and nationwide strikes
1941年：Burma Independence Army formed with Japanese help
1942年：Japanese occupation of Burma. Thai occupation of Kengtung (to 1945)
1945年：Return of British rule
1947年2月12日：Panglong Agreement signed by Shan, Kachin, Chin and Burman leaders to gain independence from the British
1947年7月19日：Aung San and most of his cabinet assassinated. U Nu and his AFPFL party prepare to take power from the British by finishing Burma's first constitution
1947年9月24日：1947 Constitution guarantees the Federated Shan States (later Shan and Kayah states), Kachin State, and Karen State, the right to secede after a period of ten years after independence
1948年1月4日：Burma gains independence from the United Kingdom with U Nu as Prime Minister
1949年：Insurgencies begin
1950年：Burmese Army repels Nationalist Chinese invasion of Shan State (to 1961)
1958年：Caretaker government, led by army Chief of Staff General Ne Win, formed following a split in the ruling AFPFL party. (Caretaker Gov. rule until 1960)
1960年：U Nu's party faction wins decisive victory in 1960 elections, but his promotion of Buddhism as the state religion and his tolerance of separatism angers the military.
1961年：U Thant becomes 3rd Secretary-General of the United Nations. Yangon hosts Second Southeast Asian Peninsular Games

1962年3月2日：Democratically elected government of U Nu is overthrown by Ne Win, who abolishes the federal system and inaugurates "the Burmese Way to Socialism" – nationalising the economy, forming a single-party state with the BSPP as the sole political party, and banning independent newspapers
1962年7月7日：Government guns down student protesters
1969年：Yangon hosts Fifth Southeast Asian Peninsular Games
1974年：Ne Win proclaims a new constitution. Chin Special Division becomes Chin State; Mon State is created out of Tenasserim Division. Government guns down student protesters following U Thant's death
1985年：Repeated demonetization of higher denomination kyat notes; Intensification of economic hardship on general populace (to 1987)
1988年：Nationwide uprising brings down Ne Win's government. Military crushes protests, forms a ruling junta, promises elections
1989年：Junta changes the English spellings of geographic names, including the country's name (to Myanmar)
1990年：National League for Democracy wins 82% of the seats in the general election. Junta refuses to hand over power, jails NLD leader Aung San Suu Kyi
1990年：Western nations and Japan begin economic sanctions against Myanmar
1991年：Aung San Suu Kyi is awarded the Nobel Peace Prize
1997年：Myanmar is admitted to ASEAN
2003年2月：A major bank run in private banking occurs
2005年5月7日：Bombings kill 11 people and injured 162
2005年11月6日：Junta moves the capital to Naypyidaw
2007年：Junta suppresses anti-government protests, killing scores of protesters, including Buddhist monks
2008年：2008 Constitution reserves 25% of the seats in a bicameral Hluttaw to the military.
2008年5月2日：Cyclone Nargis kills nearly 140,000 people and devastates the Irrawaddy delta
2009年：1st Kokang incident occurs
2010年4月15日：Bombings kill 10 people and injured 178
2010年10月21日：Government changes country's flag and its official name is adopted as "Republic of the Union of Myanmar"
links: Republic of the Union of Myanmar

items.text: 2010年11月：The 2010 general election gives the victory to military-backed USDP
2010年11月：Aung San Suu Kyi is released from house arrest
2011年1月31日：The first session of Pyidaungsu Hluttaw (parliament) convenes
2011年3月24日：An earthquake occurs in Shan State
2011年3月30日：Thein Sein becomes President of Burma
2011年：Reforms in Burma begins
2012年：Economic sanctions imposed by the European Union and the United States are eased
2012年1月13日：Prominent political prisoners including Min Ko Naing are released
2012年4月1日：National League for Democracy wins in by-elections
2012年5月2日：Aung San Suu Kyi becomes a lawmaker
2012年：Rakhine State riots occurs
2012年11月9日：A train crash kills at least 27 people and injured 80
2012年11月：Government suppresses copper mine protests
2013年：Tensions between Buddhist and Muslim flare into violent clashes in various cities
2013年：Bombings kill 3 people and injured 10
2013年：27th Southeast Asian Games takes place
2014年：7th ASEAN Para Games takes place
2014年：A nationwide census takes place (Total population 51,486,253)
2014年：Ninth East Asia Summit takes place
2015年：2nd Kokang incident occurs
2015年3月：Government suppresses education law protests
2015年：Severe flooding occur
2015年11月10日：The 2015 general election gives the victory to NLD
2015年11月22日：A major landslide kills at least 116 people
2016年2月1日：The second session of Pyithu Hluttaw (lower house) convenes
2016年2月3日：The second session of Amyotha Hluttaw (upper house) convenes
2016年2月8日：The second session of Assembly of the Union (Union Parliament) convenes
2016年2月8日：The second session of State and Region Hluttaws (regional parliaments) convenes
2016年3月30日：Htin Kyaw becomes President of Myanmar
2016年4月6日：Aung San Suu Kyi becomes State Counsellor of Myanmar (de facto prime minister)
2025年3月28日：A 7.7-magnitude earthquake in central Myanmar. Over 140 people died and 730 were injured in Myanmar.
前400年：The prehistoric clay pottery Buni culture (near present-day Bekasi) flourished in coastal northern West Java.

前200年："Dvipantara" or "Yawadvipa", a mystic Hindu kingdom is mentioned in India's earliest epic, the Ramayana; Sugriva, the chief of Rama's army dispatched his men to Yawadvipa in search of Sita then later used by the Indianized islander of Java Island and kingdom of Portugal to name the island during the age of discovery.
前65年：A footprint of a kingdom in Java island according to Chinese records.
350年：The Kutai Martadipura phase in East Kalimantan produced the earliest known stone inscriptions in Indonesia.

450年：Several stone inscriptions were created in West Java. Among others, the Tugu inscription announce decrees of Purnavarman, the king of Tarumanagara, one of the earliest Indianized kingdom in Java.
664年：A Tang dynasty Chinese source written by I-tsing, mentioned about Holing (Kalingga) kingdom, located somewhere on the northern coast of Central Java.
671年：I-tsing visited Srivijaya and Malayu in Sumatra and Kedah in Malay peninsula on his way to Nalanda, India.

683年：Dapunta Hyang Sri Jayanasa performed Siddhayatra as the journey to expand his influence. The event is mentioned in several inscriptions such as Telaga Batu inscription, Talang Tuwo inscription, and Kedukan Bukit Inscription. The beginning of Srivijaya hegemony over the maritime region around Malacca Strait and Sunda Strait.
686年：Srivijaya launch naval invasion against Java, mentioned in Kota Kapur Inscription. Probably contributed to the end of Tarumanagara kingdom.
687年：I-tsing returned to Srivijaya on his way back from India to China. In his record he reported that the kingdom of Malayu was captured by Srivijaya.
700年：The Sumatra-based Srivijaya naval kingdom flourishes.
700年：Wet-field rice cultivation, small towns and kingdoms flourish. Trade links are established with China and India.

700年：Sojomerto inscription possibly dated around late 7th century discovered in Batang Regency, Central Java, mentioned about Dapunta Selendra, possibly the ancestor of Shailendra dynasty. The inscription was written in old Malay suggested Srivijayan link to this family.

718年：Sri Indravarman King of Srivijaya send a letter to the Caliph Umar bin Abdul Aziz of the Umayyad Caliphate in Damascus, signing early ancient Indonesian official contact with Islamic world in the Middle East.
732年：The Sanjaya dynasty is founded around this time according to the Canggal inscription.
752年：The Hindu Mataram kingdom flourishes.
760年：The construction of Borobudur started.

770年－779年－780年－789年：Java launched series of naval raids on ports of Dai Viet, Champa and Cambodia; Sontay in Tonkin (767); Nha Trang (774); captured Indrapura in Cambodia (770); Phan Rang (787). The naval raids was probably launched by Shailendran-Srivijayan Maharaja Dharmasetu or Dharanindra.
778年：Kalasan temple constructed according to Kalasan inscription.
792年：The Manjusrigrha (Sewu) temple is completed according to Manjusrigrha inscription.
800年：The agriculturally based Buddhist Shailendra dynasty rules Sumatra and Java.
825年：Borobudur is completed during the reign of Samaratungga.
856年：Prambanan is completed. According to Shivagrha inscription Rakai Pikatan — the husband of Pramodhawardhani — defeated Balaputra.

860年：Balaputra the Maharaja of Suvarnadvipa and the ruler of Srivijaya, constructs the buddhist temple and monastery in Nalanda India, on the land given by King Devapaladeva of Pala in Benggala, according to the Nalanda inscription.
907年：Sumbing volcano erupted, according to Rukam inscription.
907年：King Balitung created Mantyasih inscription containing the list of Mataram kings, moved the capital from Mamratipura to Poh Pitu, and expanded Prambanan temple.
914年：The Warmadewa dynasty rules Bali.
928年：During the reign of King Wawa, the capital of Mataram in Mamratipura was devastated, probably by the massive eruption of Mount Merapi.

929年：Mpu Sindok moved the seat of power of the Mataram kingdom from Mamratipura in Central Java to Tamwlang in East Java and established Isyana Dynasty. The shift was probably as a result of the eruption of Mount Merapi and/or invasion from Srivijaya.
937年：Mpu Sindok moved the capital again from Tamwlang to Watugaluh, both near bank of Brantas River in modern Jombang in East Java.
約980年－989年：Dynastic marriage between princess Mahendradatta of Javanese Isyanas and king Udayana of Balinese Warmadewas.
990年：King Dharmawangsa of Mataram kingdom launches a naval invasion on Palembang in an unsuccessful attempt to conquer Srivijaya.
990年：Airlangga, son of King Udayana and Queen Mahendradatta was born in Bali.
996年：Dharmawangsa commissioned the translation of the Mahabharata into Old Javanese.
1006年：Srivijaya successfully repelling the Dharmawangsa's invasion, the invasion ultimately unsuccessful.
1016年：King Dharmawangsa's Mataram kingdom falls under invasion of King Wurawari from Lwaram (highly possible Srivijayan ally in Java).
1019年：Airlangga establishes the Kingdom of Kahuripan.

1025年：Rajendra Chola, the Chola king from Cholamandala in South India, conquered Pannai and Kadaram from Srivijaya and occupied it for some time. The Cholas continued a series of raids and conquests of parts Srivijayan empire in Sumatra and Malay Peninsula.
1030年：Sanghyang Tapak inscription in the Cicatih River bank in Cibadak, Sukabumi, West Java, mentioned about the establishment of sacred forest and Kingdom of Sunda.
1041年：Airlangga divided Kahuripan into two kingdoms Janggala and Kadiri and abdicated in favour of his successors.
1104年：King Jayawarsa of Kadiri ascends to the throne.

1115年：King Kamesvara of Kadiri ascends to the throne. Janggala ceases to exist and united under Kadiri domination, highly possible under royal marriage. During his reign Mpu Dharmaja writes Kakawin Smaradahana, a eulogy for the king and become the inspiration of Panji cycle, the tales that spreads across Southeast Asia.
1130年：King Jayabaya of Kadiri ascends to the throne.
1222年：Battle of Genter, Ken Arok defeated Kertajaya, the last king of Kediri, thus established Singhasari kingdom Ken Arok ended the reign of Isyana Dynasty and started his own Rajasa dynasty.
1257年：Baab Mashur Malamo established The Kingdom of Ternate in Maluku.
1275年：King Kertanegara of Singhasari launched Pamalayu expedition against Melayu Kingdom in Sumatra.
1284年：King Kertanegara launched Pabali expedition to Bali, which integrated Bali into the Singhasari territory.
1289年：Kertanegara insult the envoy of Kublai Khan that demand Java to pay the tribute to Yuan Dynasty.
1292年：Jayakatwang, duke of Kediri, rebelled and killed Kertanegara, ended the Singhasari kingdom.
1292年：Marco Polo, on his voyage from China to Persia visited Sumatra and reported that on the northern part of Sumatra there were six trading ports including Ferlec, Samudera and Lambri.
1293年：Mongol invasion of Java, Kublai Khan of Yuan dynasty China, sent punitive attack against Kertanegara of Singhasari. The Mongol forces were repelled.
1293年11月10日：The coronation of Nararya Sangramawijaya as the monarch of Majapahit kingdom, marked the foundation of Hindu Majapahit kingdom in eastern Java.
1300年：Footprint of Islam state is present in northern tip of Sumatra.
links: The spread of Islam in Indonesia (1200 to 1600)

items.text: 1309年：King Jayanegara succeeds Kertarajasa Jayawardhana as ruler of Majapahit.
1318年：an Italian Franciscan friar, Mattiussi visited Sumatra, Java, and Banjarmasin in Borneo. In his record he described Majapahit kingdom.
1328年：Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi succeeds Jayanegara as ruler of Majapahit.
1334年：Hayam Wuruk, son of Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi was born.
1334年：Mount Kelud in East Java erupted.
1334年：Gajah Mada declared his Palapa oath.
1347年：Adityawarman moved the capital of Dharmasraya and established the kingdom of Malayupura in Pagarruyung, West Sumatra.

1350年：Hayam Wuruk, styled Sri Rajasanagara succeeds Tribhuwana Wijayatunggadewi as ruler of Majapahit; his reign is considered the empire's 'Golden Age'. Under its military commander Gajah Mada, Majapahit stretches over much of modern-day Indonesia.
1355年：Kingdom of Negara Dipa was established in South Kalimantan by Empu Jatmika.

1357年：In the Battle of Bubat, the Sundanese royal family were massacred by the Majapahit army under the order of Gajah Mada. This event led to the death of Sundanese King Lingga Buana and the princess Dyah Pitaloka Citraresmi that committed suicide.
1365年：The Old Javanese text Nagarakertagama is written.
1377年：Majapahit sends a punitive expedition against rebelling Palembang in Sumatra. Palembang's prince, Parameswara, flees to Singapura, eventually became king of Singapura for several years.
1389年：Wikramawardhana succeeds Sri Rajasanagara as ruler of Majapahit.
1398年：Majapahit launched an invasion to Singapura. Parameswara (later Iskandar Syah) flees, eventually finding his way to Malacca and establishing it as a major international port.
1405年：Paregreg war, Majapahit civil war of succession between Wikramawardhana against Wirabhumi. (to 1406)
1405年－1407年：The first voyage of Zheng He, a massive Ming dynasty naval expedition visited Java, Palembang, Malacca, Aru, Samudera and Lambri. (to 1433)
1429年：Queen Suhita succeeds Wikramawardhana as ruler of Majapahit.
1447年：Wijayaparakramawardhana, succeeds Suhita as ruler of Majapahit.
1451年：Rajasawardhana, born Bhre Pamotan, styled Brawijaya II succeeds Wijayaparakramawardhana as ruler of Majapahit.
1453年：Reign of Rajasawardhana ends.
1456年：Girishawardhana, styled Brawijaya III, becomes ruler of Majapahit.
1466年：Singhawikramawardhana, succeeds Girishawardhana as ruler of Majapahit.
1478年：Reign of Singhawikramawardhana ends.
1500年：Islam becomes Indonesia's dominant religion.
1500年：Around late 15th century Bujangga Manik manuscript was composed, tell the story of Jaya Pakuan Bujangga Manik, a Sundanese Hindu hermit journeys throughout Java and Bali.

1509年：The Portuguese king sends Diogo Lopes de Sequeira to find Malacca, the eastern terminus of Asian trade. After initially receiving Sequeira, Sultan Mahmud Syah captures and/or kills several of his men and attempts an assault on the four Portuguese ships, which escape. The Javanese fleet is also destroyed in Malacca.
1511年8月：Afonso de Albuquerque after sailing from Portuguese Goa conquers the Sultanate of Malacca with a force of 1,200 and seventeen or eighteen ships.

1512年：The first Portuguese exploratory expedition was sent eastward from Malacca to search for the 'Spice Islands' (Maluku) led by Francisco Serrão. Serrao is shipwrecked but struggles on to Hitu (northern Ambon) and wins the favour of the local rulers.
1520年：The Portuguese established a trading post in the village of Lamakera on the eastern side of Solor as a transit harbour between Maluku and Malacca.
1520年：Sultan Ali Mughayat Syah of Aceh begins an expansionist campaign capturing Dayak on the west Sumatran coast, and the pepper and gold producing lands on the east coast.
1520年：The establishment of Banjar Sultanate in South Kalimantan with Sultan Suriansyah as the first king.
1521年11月：Ferdinand Magellan's expedition reaches Maluku and after trade with Ternate returns to Europe with a load of cloves.
1522年：The Portuguese ally themselves with the rulers of Ternate and begin construction of a fort.
1522年8月：Luso Sundanese Treaty signed between Portugal and Sunda Kingdom granted Portuguese permit to build fortress in Sunda Kelapa

1535年：The Portuguese in Ternate depose Sultan Tabariji (or Tabarija) and send him to Portuguese Goa where he converts to Christianity and bequeaths his Portuguese godfather Jordao de Freitas the island of Ambon.
1546年：Francis Xavier works among the peoples of Ambon, Ternate and Morotai (Moro) laying the foundations for a permanent mission. (to 1547)
1559年：Sultan Khairun of Ternate protesting the Portuguese's Christianisation activities in his lands. Hostilities between Ternate and the Portuguese.

1562年：Portuguese Dominican priests build a palm-trunk fortress which Javanese Muslims burned down the following year. The fort was rebuilt from more durable materials and the Dominicans commenced the Christianisation of the local population.
1569年：Peace treaty was signed by Sultan Khairun of Ternate and Governor Lopez De Mesquita of Portuguese.
1570年：Sultan Hairun of Ternate is killed by the Portuguese. The reign of Sultan Baabullah.
1575年：Following a five-year war, the Ternateans under Sultan Baabullah defeated the Portuguese.
1578年：The Portuguese establish a fort on Tidore but the main centre for Portuguese activities in Maluku becomes Ambon.

1579年：The British navigator Sir Francis Drake passes through Maluku and transit in Ternate on his circumnavigation of the world. The Portuguese establish a fort on Tidore but the main centre for Portuguese activities in Maluku becomes Ambon.
1583年：Death of Sultan Baabullah of Ternate.
1595年：First Dutch expedition to Indonesia sets sail for the East Indies with two hundred and forty-nine men and sixty-four cannons led by Cornelis de Houtman.

1596年6月：de Houtman's expedition reaches Banten the main pepper port of West Java where they clash with both the Portuguese and Indonesians. It then sails east along the north coast of Java losing twelve crew to a Javanese attack at Sidayu and killing a local ruler in Madura.
1597年：de Houtman's expedition returns to the Netherlands with enough spices to make a considerable profit.
1598年：The Portuguese require an armada of 90 ships to put down a Solorese uprising. (to 1599)
1598年：More Dutch fleets leave for Indonesia and most are profitable.
1599年：The van Neck expedition returns to Europe. The expedition makes a 400 per cent profit. (to 1600)
1599年3月：Leaving Europe the previous year, a fleet of eight ships under Jacob van Neck was the first Dutch fleet to reach the 'Spice Islands' of Maluku.

1600年：The Portuguese win a major naval battle in the bay of Ambon. Later in the year, the Dutch join forces with the local Hituese in an anti-Portuguese alliance, in return for which the Dutch would have the sole right to purchase spices from Hitu.
1600年：Elizabeth I grants a charter to the British East India Company beginning the English advance in Asia.
1602年：The Portuguese send a major (and last) expeditionary force from Malacca which succeeded in reimposing a degree of Portuguese control.
1602年：The Dutch East India Company (VOC) is established by merging competing Dutch trading companies.

1602年6月：British East India Company's first voyage, commanded by Sir James Lancaster, arrives in Aceh and sails on to Bantam where he is allowed to build trading post which becomes the centre of British trade in Indonesia until 1682.
1603年：First permanent Dutch trading post is established in Banten, West Java.

1604年：A second English East India Company voyage commanded by Sir Henry Middleton reaches Ternate, Tidore, Ambon and Banda. Fierce VOC hostility is encountered in Banda thus beginning Anglo-Dutch competition for access to spices
1605年2月：The VOC in alliance with Hitu prepare to attack a Portuguese fort in Ambon but the Portuguese surrender.
1606年：A Spanish fleet occupies Ternate and Tidore.
1608年：Iskandar Muda of Aceh Sultanate launched series of naval conquest on coastal Sumatran and Malay peninsula states. (to 1637)
1610年：The VOC establishes the post of Governor General to enable firmer control of their affairs in Asia.

1611年：The English establish trading posts at Sukadana (southwest Kalimantan), Makassar, Jayakarta and Jepara in Java, and Aceh, Pariaman and Jambi in (Sumatra) threatening Dutch ambitions for a monopoly on East Indies trade.
1611年：The Dutch establish a post at Jayakarta (later 'Batavia' and then 'Jakarta').
1613年：The Dutch expel the Portuguese from their Solor fort.
1619年：Jan Pieterszoon Coen appointed Governor-General of the VOC who would show he had no scruples about using brute force to establish the VOC on a firm footing.
1619年5月30日：Coen, backed by a force of nineteen ships, storms the Jayakarta driving out the Banten forces, and from the ashes of Jayakarta, establishes Batavia as the VOC headquarters.
1620年：Almost the entire native population of Banda Islands was deported, driven away, starved to death or killed in an attempt to replace them with Dutch colonial slave labour.
1620年：Diplomatic agreements in Europe commence a three-year period of cooperation between the Dutch and the English over the spice trade.

1623年：In a notorious but disputed incident, known as the 'Amboyna massacre', ten English and ten Japanese traders are arrested, tried and beheaded for conspiracy against the Dutch Government. The English quietly withdraw from most of their Indonesian activities (except trading in Bantam) and focus on other Asian interests.
1628年－1629年：Sultan Agung of Mataram launched a failed campaign to conquer Dutch Batavia.
1629年：Iskandar Muda of Aceh Sultanate launched a failed attempt to take Portuguese Malacca.
1636年：The Portuguese are expelled again from their Solor fort by the Dutch following a reoccupation.
1646年：Sultan Agung of Mataram dies – and is buried at his graveyard at Imogiri

1667年：As a result of the Treaty of Breda between Dutch and England, the Dutch secured a worldwide monopoly on nutmeg by forcing England to give up their claim on Run, the most remote of the Banda Islands. While the Dutch did not press their claims on New Netherland.

1674年：The Trunajaya rebellion. Followers of the Madurese prince Trunajaya rebelled against the Mataram Sultanate. After initial defeats, Mataram requested help from the VOC in exchange for various concessions. VOC-Mataram forces ultimately defeated the rebellion.
1700年：With the decline of the spice trade, textiles are now the most important trade item in the Dutch East Indies.
1704年：First Javanese War of Succession.
1712年：The first shipment of coffee from Java reaches Amsterdam.
1717年：Surabaya rebels against the VOC.
1719年：Second Javanese War of Succession.
1735年：Governor-General Dirk van Cloon dies, one of many victims of disease in Batavia.
1740年10月9日：A massacre of Batavia's ethnic Chinese begins after they are suspected by the VOC of planning a rebellion. Approximately 10,000 are killed and the Chinese quarter is burned.
1743年：The capital Kartasura fell under Geger Pecinan uprising — Raden Mas Garendi (Sunan Kuning) led Chinese mercenaries revolted against Pakubuwono II.
1745年2月17日：Pakubuwono II established a new kraton in Sala village and established Surakarta Sunanate.

1755年2月13日：The Treaty of Giyanti is signed, effectively partitioning the Mataram Sultanate. The VOC recognizes Mangkubumi as Sultan Hamengkubuwono I, who rules half of Central Java. Hamengkubuwono I then established Yogyakarta Sultanate, moves to Yogya and renames the city Yogyakarta
1757年3月17日：Salatiga treaty between Prince Sambernyawa with Pakubuwono III and Hamengkubuwono I further partitioning the remnant of Mataram Sultanate, the Mangkunegaran Grand Duchy was established.
1769年：French expeditions capture clove plants in Ambon, ending the VOC monopoly of the plant. (to 1772)
1770年：Captain James Cook stops at Onrust Island in the Bay of Batavia for repairs to his ship Endeavour on his round the world voyage.

1778年4月24日：Royal Batavian Society of Arts and Sciences was established by a group of Dutch intellectuals. This institution is the pioneer of scientific efforts in Indonesia and the founder of National Museum of Indonesia.
links: Royal Batavian Society of Arts and Sciences

items.text: 1792年3月：Hamengkubuwana I dies.
1795年：The Batavian Republic, a client state of the French First Republic, and successor state to the Republic of the Seven United Netherlands was proclaimed.
1800年1月1日：The bankrupt Dutch East India Company (VOC) is formally dissolved and nationalised by the Batavian Republic.
1803年：First phase of Padri War. (to 1825)
1806年：The Batavian Republic is dissolved and the Kingdom of Holland is created, a puppet kingdom set up by Napoléon Bonaparte.
1808年：Herman Willem Daendels the Governor-general of the Dutch East Indies, During the French interim (1806–1811) begins the construction of Java Great Post Road. against an Anglo-Dutch invasion.
links: Governor-General of the Dutch East Indies

items.text: 1811年8月：British invasion of Java during the Napoleonic Wars. Stamford Raffles was appointed as the Lieutenant-Governor of Java.
1814年11月：Raffles' wife, Olivia Mariamne Devenish died in Buitenzorg (now Bogor) in Java.
1814年：Dutch colonial possessions in the East Indian Archipelago returned to the Dutch following the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814.

1815年4月：Mount Tambora in Sumbawa island erupted, it was the largest volcanic eruption in recorded history that wiped out Tambora culture and killed at least 71,000 people in total (including the aftermath). The eruption created global climate anomalies known as "volcanic winter".
1825年：Java War (to 1830)
1831年：Second phase of Padri War (to 1838)
1864年6月：The first railway track in Indonesia was laid between Semarang and Tanggung, Central Java by the Dutch colonial government.
1868年：The Batavian Museum (today National Museum of Indonesia) was officially opened by Dutch East Indies government.
1870年：Official dismantling of the Cultivation System and beginning of a 'Liberal Policy' of deregulated exploitation of the Netherlands East Indies.
1873年：The beginning of the Aceh War.
1879年4月21日：Kartini was born in Jepara, today the date is commemorated as women's emancipation day in Indonesia.
1883年8月：Mount Krakatoa in Sunda Strait erupted, killed 36,417 people.
1888年：Founding of the shipping line Koninklijke Paketvaart-Maatschappij (KPM) that supported the unification and development of the colonial economy.

1894年：Dutch intervention in Lombok and Karangasem The Dutch looted and destroyed the Cakranegara palace of Mataram. J. L. A. Brandes, a Dutch philologist discovered and secured Nagarakretagama manuscript in Lombok royal library.
links: Dutch intervention in Lombok and Karangasem

items.text: 1898年：General van Heutz becomes chief of staff of Aceh campaign. Wilhelmina becomes queen of the Netherlands.
1898年：The Opiumregie begins operations in Batavia.
1901年：Ethical Policy is proclaimed.
1903年：Aceh declared conquered.
1904年：Jo van Heutsz becomes Governor General. Kartini established a school for women in Rembang, just like Dewi Sartika, she was considered as the pioneer of women's rights in Indonesia.
1904年1月16日：Dewi Sartika established the first school for women in Dutch East Indies in Bandung, she was considered as the pioneer of women's rights in Indonesia.
1906年：The Dutch intervention in Bali (1906) destroyed the southern Bali kingdom of Badung and Tabanan.
1907年：Tirto Adhi Soerjo founds civil servants' association Sarekat Priyayi.
1908年4月：During Dutch intervention in Bali (1908), the last Balinese rulers wiped out in puputan ('suicidal battle to death').
1908年5月：Budi Utomo is proclaimed as the first official nationalist movement.
1912年：Islamic League (Sarekat Islam) becomes the first mass-based nationalist party.
1912年：First scientific description ever of Komodo dragon by Peter Ouwens.
1912年11月18日：The modernist Islamic organization Muhammadiyah was established by Ahmad Dahlan in Yogyakarta.
1914年：World War I breaks out; the Netherlands is a neutral country in the war.
1917年：East Indies trade with Europe cut off by the war.
1919年5月：Mt Kelud in East Java erupts with a deathtoll of around 5,000 people.
1920年5月：Communist Party of Indonesia (PKI) is founded. Economic downturn.
1925年2月：Birth of Pramoedya Ananta Toer. A sharp rise in world commodity prices brings prosperity to the Indies.
1926年1月31日：Nahdlatul Ulama was established by Hasyim Asy'ari as the reaction to the modernist Muhammadiyah organization.
1929年：The Great Depression in America affected the economy of Dutch East Indies.
1930年：Sukarno's famous nationalist speech, 'Indonesia Accuses', given as defence in his political trial.
1941年12月8日：Netherlands declares war on Japan.
1941年12月8日：Dutch East Indies campaign (8 December 1941 – 9 March 1942) by forces from the Empire of Japan starts.

1942年2月27日：Battle of the Java Sea, Imperial Japanese Navy defeat Allied forces ABDACOM afterwards Imperial Japan occupies Indonesia during World War II, over throwing the Dutch East Indies and install their own imperial structure.
links: Japanese occupation of the Dutch East Indies

items.text: 1942年2月28日：The Japanese troops invade Java.
1942年3月7日：Dutch East Indies government in exile established in Australia by Dutch officials headed by Lieutenant Governor General Huib van Mook

1942年3月8日：Royal Netherlands East Indies Army on Java capitulates. At 09:00 on 8 March, the Commander-in-Chief of the Allied forces—Ter Poorten—announced the surrender of the Royal Netherlands East Indies Army in Java. Instrument of surrender signed in Bandung on 12 March
1942年12月31日：Merauke Force formed, to reinforce the KNIL garrison in Merauke, West New Guinea.
1944年4月22日：Start of the liberation of the Dutch East Indies by Allied forces
1944年4月：First Dutch NICA detachments land at Hollandia in New Guinea.

1944年5月16日：Van Mook–MacArthur Civil Affairs Agreement signed in London concerning the jurisdiction over and administration of civil affairs in Dutch East Indies territory liberated by an Allied expeditionary force during WWII.
1944年6月1日：1st Infantry Battalion (KNIL) founded at Camp Victory, near Casino, New South Wales. Australia.
1945年1月9日：Between January and July landing of Dutch KNIL troops at Biak, Tarakan and Balikpapan.
1945年6月1日：Sukarno's Pancasila speech.
1945年7月16日：Draft of constitution for the Republic completed.
1945年8月：Republican government established in Jakarta and constitution adopted. Central Indonesian National Committee (KNIP) established.
1945年8月15日：Japanese surrender to Allied powers.
1945年8月17日："Proclamation of Indonesian Independence," signed by Sukarno-Hatta.
1945年8月：Start of the Bersiap killings during the early stages of the Indonesian National Revolution.
1945年11月3日：Vice President Hatta proclaims right of the people to form political parties.
1945年11月10日：Battle of Surabaya.
1946年：Social revolutions, including the Three Regions (Tiga Daerah) Revolt.
1946年：Federal states, including the State of East Indonesia are set up by Dutch in the outer islands.
1947年3月25日：Linggadjati Agreement, first ceasefire.
1947年7月20日：Major Dutch military offensive to resolve differences by force.
1947年8月25日：United Nations Commission for Indonesia established.
1948年：Darul Islam rebellions begin in West Java, spread to other provinces but conclude with the execution of its leader Kartosuwiryo. (to 1962)
1948年1月19日：The Renville Agreement establishes the Van Mook line between Republican and Dutch held territories.
1948年8月：Fall of the Amir Syarifuddin government, largely from the Renville Agreement fallout.
1948年9月18日：Madiun Affair: Nationalist leaders launch a revolt in Central Java in an attempt to take over the Revolution but are suppressed by Communist troops.
1948年12月19日：Dutch undertake second military offensive capturing Republican capital at Yogyakarta and most of the Republican cabinet. Amir Syarifuddin executed by fleeing Republicans.
1949年2月：Tan Malaka executed by Republican Army.
1949年8月1日：Official ceasefire.
1949年12月：Netherlands Government transferres sovereignty to the United States of Indonesia (RUSI) at the Dutch-Indonesian Round Table Conference.

1950年：Military articulation of doctrines Dwifungsi and Hankamrata: a military role in sociopolitical development as well as security; a requirement that the resources of the people be at the call of the armed forces. (to 1960)
1950年1月29日：General Sudirman, commander of Indonesia's armed forces, dies aged 34
1950年3月24日：Activation of the Dutch Military Mission for Indonesia
1950年4月25日：The Republic of South Moluccas (RMS) is proclaimed in Ambon
1950年8月17日：Following RUSI endorsement of a new constitution, the federation is dissolved and Sukarno proclaims a unitary state, the 'Republic of Indonesia'.
1950年9月6日：The first cabinet of the unitary state is established. It is led by Prime Minister Mohammad Natsir.
1950年9月27日：Indonesia becomes the 60th member of the United Nations.
1950年9月28日：Invasion of Ambon by the Indonesian army to suppress the Republic of South Moluccas.
1951年3月21日：The Natsir cabinet falls.
1951年4月26日：The composition of the new cabinet is announced. The new Prime Minister is Dr. Sukiman Wirjosanjojo.
1952年2月25日：Amid bitter disputes over the signing of a Mutual Security Agreement with the US, the Sukiman cabinet resigns.
1952年4月3日：The new cabinet, led by Prime Minister Wilopo is inaugurated.

1952年10月17日：Army-organized demonstrations take place in Jakarta to demand the dissolution of the legislature. Tank guns and machine guns are trained on the presidential palace. This leads to the suspension of General Nasution as army chief of staff following army indiscipline over command and support that threatens the government.
1953年6月2日：The Wilopo cabinet resigns.
1953年7月31日：After lengthy negotiations, the composition of the new cabinet is announced. Serving his first term as prime minister is Ali Sastroamidjojo.
1955年3月：Regional rebellions in Sumatra and Sulawesi. (to August 1961)
1955年3月24日：The second cabinet to be led by Ali Sastroamidjojo takes office.

1955年4月18日：The city of Bandung hosts the Asia-Africa Conference. It is the first meeting of the Non-Aligned Movement and is attended by world leaders including China's Zhou Enlai, India's Nehru, Egypt's Nasser and Yugoslavia's Tito. (to 25 April)
1955年7月24日：After a dispute with the Army over appointments, the cabinet resigns.
1955年8月12日：Led by Prime Minister Burhanuddin Harahap, the new cabinet is sworn in.

1955年9月29日：Indonesia holds general parliamentary elections; the last free national elections until 1999; support for the parties is widely distributed with four parties each gaining 16–22% and the remaining votes split between 24 parties.
1955年12月15日：Elections are held for the Constitutional Assembly
1956年3月3日：The cabinet falls as a result of its policy toward the Dutch.
1956年5月3日：Indonesia unilaterally abrogates the Round Table Agreement signed with the Dutch in 1949.
1956年12月1日：Hatta resigns as vice-president.
1957年2月21日：President Sukarno announces his "Conception" (Konsepsi) of the nature of Indonesia. This will eventually lead to Guided Democracy
1957年3月：Regional rebellions in Sumatra and Sulawesi. (to August 1961)
1957年3月14日：Martial law is proclaimed. On the same day, the cabinet resigns.
1957年4月9日：Sukarno appoints a "Working Cabinet" with Djuanda as prime minister.
1957年11月30日：An assassination attempt on President Sukarno. Grenades are thrown at him as he visits a school in Cikini, Jakarta.

1958年5月18日：US Air Force pilot Allen Pope is shot down over Ambon, revealing covert American support of regional rebellions, and ends the Dulles brothers', Allen and John, efforts to subvert the Sukarno government.

1959年7月5日：With armed forces support, Sukarno issues a decree dissolving the Constituent Assembly and reintroducing the Constitution of 1945 with strong presidential powers, and assumes the additional role of Prime Minister, which completes the structure of 'Guided Democracy'.
1959年7月10日：President Sukarno appoints a "Working Cabinet" with himself as prime minister.
1960年2月18日：President Sukarno reshuffles the cabinet and appoints the second "Working Cabinet".

1960年3月9日：Second Lieutenant Daniel Alexander Maukar of the Indonesian Air Force uses a MiG-17 fighter to strafe the Presidential Palace in Jakarta, oil tanks at Tanjung Priok in North Jakarta and then the Bogor Palace.
1960年6月24日：The House of Representatives-Mutual cooperation (DPR-GR), composed of members chosen by President Sukarno is established.
1960年8月17日：Indonesia severs diplomatic links with the Netherlands in protest over its refusal to hand over Netherlands New Guinea.
1960年9月30日：President Sukarno addresses the United Nations General Assembly.
1961年3月4日：An agreement is signed in Jakarta with the Soviet Union to buy arms with long-term loans.
1961年8月17日：Building officially starts on the Monas National Monument in the center of Jakarta.
1962年1月2日：The Mandala Command to "free" Western (Netherlands) New Guinea from the Dutch is established. Its commander is Brigadier General Suharto.
1962年1月15日：Deputy chief of staff of the Indonesian Navy Commodore Yos Sudarso is killed in a Dutch air attack on the motor torpedo boat (MTB) force he is commanding.
1962年3月8日：President Sukarno again reshuffles his cabinet.
1962年8月15日：The New York Agreement, transferring Western New Guinea to Indonesia, is signed at the United Nations.
1962年8月24日：Jakarta hosts the Fourth Asian Games. (to 4 September)
1963年：Sole years of American Peace Corps program in Indonesia.
1963年：Sukarno leads the Konfrontasi campaign against the newly created Malaysia. (to 1965)
1963年5月1日：Western New Guinea is transferred to the temporary UN supervision.
1963年5月18日：Parliament elects Sukarno 'President-for-life'.
1963年7月27日：Sukarno declares Indonesian policy to oppose the creation of Malaysia which incorporate North Borneo, marking the Indonesia–Malaysia confrontation.
1963年9月18日：Following demonstrations in Jakarta to protest at the creation of Malaysia, the British Embassy is burned by a mob.
1963年11月13日：President Sukarno conducts the final reshuffle of the "Working Cabinet".
1964年8月17日：During his Independence Day speech, Sukarno for the first time publicly denounce the United States, and over the following months an anti-American campaign attacked American interests.
1964年8月27日：President Sukarno appoints the Dwikora Cabinet
1965年1月7日：Indonesia withdraws from membership of the UN.
1965年1月14日：The Indonesian Communist Party (PKI) calls for workers and peasants to be armed.
1965年4月11日：The Third Session of the Provisional People's Consultative Assembly is held in Bandung. (to 16 April)

1965年5月26日：Foreign Minister Subandrio reports to President Sukarno the existence of the Gilchrist Document, a letter purporting to be from the British ambassador which discusses western military involvement in Indonesia.
1965年9月30日：An abortive coup in Jakarta results in the murder of six army generals, and disposal of bodies at Lubang Buaya.
1965年10月：A violent anti-communist purge leads to the killing of approximately 1/2 million Indonesians. (to March 1966)
1965年10月1日：A counter-coup led by General Suharto that leads to the Overthrow of Sukarno
1965年10月14日：President Sukarno appoints Major General Suharto Minister/Commander of the Army.
1965年10月16日：The Jakarta Military Command temporarily suspends the activities of the PKI and its organizations in the Jakarta region.
1965年12月13日：The rupiah is devalued by a factor of 1,000 in an effort to control inflation.

1966年1月10日：Anti-communist organizations grouped under the Pancasila Front issue the "Three Demands of the People" (Tritura), namely the dissolution of the PKI, the cleansing of the cabinet of elements involved in 30 September Movement, and lower prices and economic improvements.
1966年2月14日：The Extraordinary Military Court trials of people allegedly involved in 30 September Movement begin.
1966年2月24日：President Sukarno reshuffles his cabinet, creating what becomes known as the "cabinet of 100 ministers".
1966年3月11日：Sukarno delegates key presidential powers to Suharto by signing the Supersemar. The following day Suharto dissolves the Indonesian Communist Party.
1966年3月18日：A total of 14 cabinet ministers are taken into "protective custody".
1966年5月2日：Following large scale demonstrations, the leadership of the Mutual-Assistance House of Representatives (DPR-GR) is replaced.

1966年6月20日：The Fourth Session of the Provisional People's Consultative Assembly is held in Jakarta. It raises the status of the Supersemar into a decree, meaning Sukarno cannot revoke it, bans the PKI and its teachings and rejects President Sukarno's accountability speech. (to 5 July)
1966年8月11日：Indonesia and Malaysia agree to normalize diplomatic relations.
1966年9月28日：Indonesia rejoins the United Nations.
1967年1月10日：New investment laws designed to bring in foreign capital are passed; restrictions are introduced regarding status of Indonesian Chinese, their names and their religions.

1967年2月20日：The Inter-Governmental Group on Indonesia (IGGI) is established as an international consortium of official donors to coordinate the provision of foreign assistance to Indonesia. The IGGI was chaired by The Netherlands until 1992.
1967年2月22日：In a ceremony at the presidential palace, Sukarno hands over authority to Suharto.
1967年3月7日：A Special Session of the Provisional People's Consultative Assembly strips Sukarno of his powers and appoints Suharto acting president. (to 12 March)
1967年8月8日：ASEAN established in Bangkok by Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand.
1967年10月1日：Diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China are suspended.
1968年：Soedjatmoko is Indonesian ambassador to the United States; bilateral relations warm. (to 1971)
1968年3月：Parliament confers full presidential title on Suharto; Sukarno is under effective house arrest.
1969年：Papuan representatives agree to join Indonesia in the Act of Free Choice.
1970年：Nurcholish Madjid, a young Muslim modernist, begins to lay out religious developmental principles for Indonesia—'Islam, yes; Islamic party, no'.
1970年6月21日：Sukarno dies. He is buried at Blitar, East Java.
1971年：Suharto's wife inspired by a visit to Disneyland, conceives a national cultural theme park.
1971年7月3日：Indonesia's second parliamentary election and the first under the New Order is held. Golkar wins an outright majority.

1973年：Government forces fusion of political parties; Nationalist and Christian parties are merged into the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) and Muslim parties into the United Development Party (PPP). The new three party system is dominated by Golkar.
1974年：The 'Malari' uprising in Jakarta against Japanese penetration of the economy, Chinese Indonesian influence, and official corruption.
1975年4月：Mrs Suharto dedicates the vast 'Beautiful Indonesia-in-Miniature Park' (Taman Mini) on the outskirts of Jakarta.
1975年4月：Civil war breaks out in the former Portuguese colony of East Timor.
1975年12月6日：U.S. President Gerald Ford and Secretary of State Kissinger, returning from China, make a hastily rescheduled one-day visit to Jakarta.
1975年12月7日：Indonesia launches an invasion of East Timor.
1976年3月：General Ibnu Sutowo is 'dismissed with honour' after a decade as head of Pertamina, the state oil corporation.
1976年7月8日：Palapa A1, Indonesia's first communication satellite launched from Cape Canaveral.
1976年7月17日：Suharto signs a bill integrating East Timor into Indonesia as its 27th province.
1976年11月19日：UN General Assembly rejects Indonesia's annexation of East Timor.
1977年：The United States surpasses Japan as Indonesia's biggest oil customer.
1977年10月：Sawito Kartowibowo's trial for 'subversion' begins.

1978年：The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) elevates Pancasila to the status of compulsory moral education of youth and government officials. Suharto appoints B.J. Habibie as state minister for research and technology.
1978年2月22日：Suharto inaugurated Istiqlal Mosque, Jakarta, the Indonesian national mosque.
1979年9月21日：Jakarta host the 10th SEA Games, it was the first time Indonesia host Southeast Asian Games. (to 30 September)
1979年12月：Writer Pramoedya Ananta Toer is released after fourteen years imprisonment with hard labour on Buru Island.
1980年5月：The Petition of Fifty—a statement of concern to parliament about the use of government power, propaganda, and presidential personality cult—is begun.
1982年：The height of Petrus ('mysterious shootings') of thousands of suspected criminals by government security forces. (to 1983)
1983年：Prabowo Subianto, then a major in ABRI marries Suharto's daughter Siti Hediati Hariyadi at Taman Mini.
1984年9月12日：Muslim concerned protesting over alleged insensitivities to Islam at Tanjung Priok; a riot ensues resulting in many deaths. Clamp down on Islamic political leaders.
1984年12月：Abdurrahman Wahid is elected chairman of Nahdlatul Ulama a position previously held by both his father and grandfather.
1985年：The Indonesian government require all organisations of any kind to adopt Pancasila as their sole basis.
1987年：Sukarno's daughter Megawati Sukarnoputri becomes a member of parliament; Suharto prohibits display of images of Sukarno although they appear frequently nonetheless.
1987年9月9日：Jakarta host the 14th SEA Games. (to 20 September)

1988年：Suharto is elected to a fifth term as president., Lilies Handayani, Nurfitriyana Saiman and Kusuma Wardhani won Indonesia's first medal in Olympic Games, a silver medal for women's team archery in 1988 Summer Olympics Seoul.
1989年：The Free Aceh Movement (GAM) reemerges following its 1976 founding; suppression of its guerilla activities leads to 2,000 deaths by 1991 in Aceh.
1991年：Indonesia wins presidency of the Non-Aligned Movement.
1991年11月12日：ABRI troops fire on demonstrative funeral procession in Dili, East Timor. TV images of the killings put East Timor high on the international human rights agenda.

1992年：Suharto successfully defies Dutch efforts to link human rights to aid administered since 1967 by the International Governmental Group on Indonesia (IGGI). Susi Susanti won Indonesia's first Olympic gold medal in 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, Spain.
1992年：East Timorese resistance leader Xanana Gusmão is captured by Brigadier General Theo Syafei and is tried and sentenced. (to 1993)
1993年：Suharto seeks a sixth term and is easily re-elected.
1994年6月：Suharto shuts down Tempo and two other publications for critical reporting of Habibie's purchase of the former East German navy.

1996年：The Free Papua Movement (OPM) kidnaps fourteen scientists and foresters in Iran Jaya garnering international attention. After four months, the abductees are rescued in a bloody operation led by Prabowo.
1996年4月：Ibu Tien Suharto, the president's wife of 48 years, dies of a heart attack.
1996年7月：Military-backed thugs burst into headquarters of PDI, Megawati's party, and evict her supporters in a violent climax to government efforts to vitiate her party's popularity.
1997年：Severe social unrest breaks out across Indonesian cities against Chinese Indonesians, Christians, symbols of wealth, the police and bureaucracy. (to 1998)
1997年2月：Alarmed at a dukun's prediction that 'the nail of Java has come loose', Suharto commands a massive Ruwat Dunia ceremony ('Cleansing of the world') near Borobudur.
1997年6月：Pacific Ocean trade winds shift heralding the onset of the El Niño; severe drought across much of Indonesia follows in the ensuing months accompanied by highly destructive forest fires.
1997年7月：The collapse of the Thai baht starts the East Asian financial crisis and over the ensuing months Indonesia is the country hardest hit.

1997年9月26日：Garuda Indonesia Flight 152, an Airbus A300, crashed in the mountains of a village called Buah Nabar. Killing all 222 passengers and 12 crew on board. One of the deadliest aviation accidents in Indonesian history.
1997年10月11日：Jakarta host the 19th SEA Games. (to 19 October)
1998年3月：Largely peaceful student demonstrations against the regime rise to national prominence.
1998年3月11日：Suharto unanimously elected by the MPR to his seventh presidential term.
1998年5月12日：Four student demonstrators at Trisakti University are shot dead by bullets unproven but thought likely to have been from army sources.
1998年5月13日：Memorial services for killed students leads to riots; vandalism, arson, looting and rape by roving mobs which continue unchecked by security forces for two days leaving 1,200 dead.

1998年5月20日：For National Awakening Day, Amien Rais pledges to bring a million protestors into the streets to demonstrate against at the National Monument in Jakarta. Faced with barbed wire and massed troops he calls off the rally fearing bloodshed.
1998年5月21日：After being deserted by his cabinet, Suharto resigns the presidency. Habibie assumes presidency.

1998年8月：General Wiranto announces the discharge of Lieutenant General Prabowo from active duty, with full pension benefits—and without court-martial for allegations of abduction and torture of student activist (some of whom remain missing as of 2003).

1998年11月10日：Megawati, Rais, and the sultan of Yogya, meet at Wahid's home in Ciganjur, and issue a series of statements including a demand for the military to end their role in politics within six years.
1998年11月13日：On the last day of the MPR sessions, soldiers open fire on demonstrating students killing at least fifteen and injuring hundreds.

1999年1月19日：A petty argument between in the city of Ambon triggers Christian-Muslim clashes that last for three years across Maluku. As many as 10,000 are killed and 700,000 or one third of the region are displaced.

1999年6月7日：Indonesia's first free and fair national elections since 1955 take place with almost no disruption and wide participation. Votes however are distributed across forty-eight parties with no party achieving a majority.

1999年9月：Timor-Leste votes to secede from Indonesia in a referendum conducted under UN auspices. Four-fifths of voters choose independence for East Timor over integration with Indonesia. Pro-integration militias trained and paid by ABRI immediately resort to a scorched earth policy that leaves 1,000 dead and most of the territory's infrastructure ruined.
1999年9月13日：President Habibie relents to international pressure and allows a UN peacekeeping force known as 'INTERFET' to enter East Timor and restore order.

1999年10月：The Indonesian parliament rejects President Habibie's accountability speech. Wahid whose party received one eighth of the popular vote is elected president by the MPR. Megawati whose party received one third of the vote (the highest) is elected vice president.

2000年：President Wahid's administration is marred by failures to stabilise the economy, patterns of political favouritism, economic corruption (although Wahid himself is not accused of corruption), inability to reform the military, personal eccentricity and pettiness, ineffectiveness in dealing with major religious violence in Maluku and Sulawesi, major ethnic violence (Dayaks vs. Madurese) in Kalimantan, and separatisms in Aceh and Irian Jaya.

2000年12月24日：In a coordinated attack involving more than three dozen sites across the country, churches are bombed and eighteen people killed. It is later proven to have been planned by Jemaah Islamiyah in retaliation for Christian killings of Muslims in the Maluku conflict.

2001年：Ethnic violence in Kalimantan as indigenous Dayaks force out Madurese transmigrants. Mass political demonstrations by Wahid's supporters and opponents. IMF stops further loans citing lack of progress in tackling corruption.

2001年7月：President Wahid is impeached chiefly on grounds of incompetence. The parliament elects Megawati president by 592 votes to 0. Hamzah Haz defeats Akbar Tandjung and Lieutenant General (ret.) Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono.

2001年9月：President Megawati visits President George Bush a week after the 9/11 terrorist attacks and welcomes American investment. On her return to Indonesia, the Islamic right criticises her cooperation with America's war in Afghanistan, and the nationalist left criticises here for being too suppliant to foreign investors.
2002年：Nahdlatul Ulama and Muhammadiyah, the largest Muslim organisations in Indonesia, issue joint statements critical of militant Islamists.
2002年2月：Peace talks in Malino, South Sulawesi appear to end three years of Christian-Muslim violence in Maluku and Poso.
2002年7月：Tommy Suharto is sentenced to fifteen years jail for illegal possession of arms, contempt of law, and masterminding the assassination of a Supreme Court judge who had convicted him for graft.
2002年9月：House Speaker Akbar Tandjung is sentenced to three years jail for corruption.

2002年10月12日：Bombs in the Kuta nightclub district in Bali kill 202 people, the deadliest terrorist attack in Indonesia's history. Indonesian police, aided by ten nations, track down Jemaah Islamiyah operatives.
2002年11月：Eurico Guterres is sentenced to ten years prison for crimes committed following the 1999 ballot in East Timor.
2002年12月：The Indonesian government and GAM sign a peace accord aimed at ending decades of violence in Aceh. The deal breaks down the following year.
2003年8月：Jemaah Islamiyah bomb Jakarta's Marriott hotel killing twelve. All but one of those killed are Indonesians.
2004年4月：Parliamentary and local elections: Golkar party of former President Suharto wins greatest share of vote, with Megawati Sukarnoputri's PDI-P coming second.
2004年9月9日：A bomb blast outside the Australian embassy in Jakarta kills 11 and injures up to 100 people.
2004年10月：Indonesia's first direct presidential election elects Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono following popular disillusionment with incumbent Megawati.
2004年12月26日：An earthquake-triggered tsunami kills an estimated 170,000 in Aceh and causes widespread devastation.

2005年8月15日：Government and Free Aceh Movement separatists sign a peace deal providing for rebel disarmament and the withdrawal of government soldiers from the province. Rebels begin handing in weapons in September; government completes troop pull-out in December.
2005年10月1日：Bombings in Bali kill 20 people.
2006年5月27日：The 6.4 Mw Yogyakarta earthquake shakes central Java with an MSK intensity of IX (Destructive), leaving more than 5,700 dead and 37,000 injured.
2007年1月1日：Adam Air Flight 574 crashes into the sea in Makassar Strait off Sulawesi, killing all 102 on board.
2007年3月7日：Garuda Indonesia Flight 200 overran the runway in Adisucipto International Airport killing at least 21 people.
2008年1月27日：Suharto dies from multiple organ failure. He is buried in the family Mausoleum near Solo.
2008年11月9日：Jemaah Islamiyah Operatives are executed when found guilty for the 2002 bombings after numerous appeals from their families.
2009年7月8日：Incumbent President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono won Indonesian presidential election.
2009年7月17日：Jemaah Islamiyah bomb two hotels in Jakarta, including the Marriott that was attacked in 2003.
2009年9月17日：Noordin Mohammad Top, the head of Jemaah Islamiyah, is shot in Solo, Central Java
2009年12月30日：Abdurrahman Wahid, the 4th president of Indonesia died because of complications from kidney disorders, heart disease and diabetes.
2010年10月25日：Merapi volcano erupted, over 350,000 people were evacuated, 353 people were killed, Borobudur was covered in volcanic ash. (to 17 November)
2011年5月7日：Jakarta host 18th ASEAN Summit, mark the beginning of Indonesian chairmanship in ASEAN 2011. (to 8 May)
2011年11月11日：Opening ceremony of the 26th Southeast Asian Games was held in Palembang. The largest multi-event sports in the region was held in Jakarta and Palembang. (to 22 November)
2012年5月9日：Russian Sukhoi Superjet 100 crashed against Mount Salak, West Java, killing 45 people abroad during a demonstrational flight.
2013年：Indonesia host the APEC Summit 2013 in Nusa Dua, Bali.
2014年4月9日：Indonesia held their legislative election, PDI-P dominate the People's Representative Council, followed closely by Golkar and Gerindra.
2014年7月9日：Indonesia held their presidential election, according to quick count Jakarta's Governor Joko Widodo won against former military general Prabowo Subianto, however both sides claims victory.
2014年7月22日：Indonesian Election Commission announced Joko Widodo wins Indonesian presidential election with 53.15% of the vote with his rival, ex-general Prabowo Subianto, on 46.85%.

2014年10月20日：Joko Widodo and Jusuf Kalla sworn in as Indonesian President and Vice President for the period of 2014–2019 in a plenary session of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR). Thousands of people celebrating the inauguration ceremony by attending parade along Sudirman and Thamrin avenue, followed by a concert in Merdeka Square featuring Slank, Arkarna, and various bands.

2014年12月28日：Indonesia AirAsia Flight 8501 on its way from Surabaya to Singapore, crashed in bad weather into Java Sea, off the coast of Pangkalan Bun, Central Kalimantan, killing all 155 passengers and seven crew on board.

2015年：Dozens of Indonesians are killed by respiratory illness and accidents due to poor visibility caused by severe haze. The haze occurs annually during dry season and is largely caused by illegal agricultural fires due to slash-and-burn practices in Indonesia, especially from the provinces of South Sumatra and Riau in Indonesia's Sumatra island, and Kalimantan on Indonesian Borneo. The haze also hit neighboring Singapore, Malaysia, and Brunei.

2016年1月14日：At least three militants reportedly detonated explosives in or near a Starbucks cafe in Central Jakarta. Then the militants threw grenade to a police post nearby, destroying the post and killing at least 3 men. Gunfire had ensued when police arrived shortly afterwards.

2018年：Indonesian cities of Jakarta and Palembang hosts 2018 Asian Games. The opening ceremony was held in Gelora Bung Karno Stadium. This was the second time Indonesia hosted this Asian multi-sports event, the last time had been in 1962.
2019年4月17日：Joko Widodo has been re-elected as Indonesia's president in 2019 Indonesian general election.

2019年8月26日：President Joko Widodo has announced that the country's new capital city will be located in East Kalimantan on Borneo island. The new capital will replace Jakarta and will be built in part of Penajam North Paser regency and part of Kutai Kertanegara regency.

2020年3月2日：President Joko Widodo confirmed the first two cases of COVID-19 in Indonesia. According to the Minister of Health Terawan Agus Putranto, the patients contracted the virus from an infected Japanese person in Depok and later tested positive in Malaysia.
2020年10月6日：Protests erupt throughout Indonesia after Indonesian House of Representatives passes the controversial Omnibus Law on Job Creation.
2021年1月9日：Sriwijaya Air Flight 182 crashed into the Java Sea, 4 minutes after takeoff, killing all 62 people on board.
前709000年：The arrival of the first Homo species to the early Chibanian.
前400000年：People belonging to the species Homo erectus set foot on the Philippines.
前250000年：Human habitation is said to be began.
前55000年：The first Homo sapiens in the Philippines.
前50000年：Early humans made stone tools in the Tabon Caves in Palawan.
前40000年：Negritos start to settle.

前35000年：At the old Kapampangan region was 10 times larger than the present borders, years ago, a series of eruptions from Mount Pinatubo dumped lava, ashes, tephra and lahar into the sea, forming the present landmass of the region.
前20000年：Tabon Man made stone tools in the Tabon Cave.
前8000年：The ancestors in the other caves: Batangas, Bulacan and Rizal. The other caves of Palawan: Guri and Duyong cave where the Homo sapiens lived.
前4500年－前300年：Multiple Austronesian migrations from Taiwan.
約前4000年：Earliest evidence of rice growing, domesticating chickens and pigs.
約前3000年：Presumed date of the Angono Petroglyphs.
約前2000年：The Igorots built forts made of stone walls that averaged several meters in width and about 2 to 3 times the width in height around

約前1000年：The Late Neolithic period in the Philippines, evidence shows by a Yawning Jarlet on the Burial site in Leta-leta caves in Palawan by Robert Fox which had later become National treasure in the Philippines.

約前1000年：First mining in the Philippines began. The early Filipinos worked various mines of gold, silver, copper and iron. Jewels, gold ingots, chains, calombigas and earrings were handed down from antiquity and inherited from their ancestors. Gold dagger handles, gold dishes, tooth plating, and huge gold ornaments were also used.

前890年－前710年：The Sa Huỳnh culture, evidence can be found in Manunggul Jar which is a secondary burial jar excavated from a Neolithic burial site in Manunggul cave of Tabon Caves at Lipuun Point. The depiction of sea-waves on the lid places this Manunggul jar in the Sa Huỳnh culture pottery tradition. These are people that migrated in an East to West migration from the Borneo-Palawan area to Southern Vietnam.

前600年：The people of Palawan, Cordillera and Batanes become ancient goldsmith's. An ancient goldsmith shop had discovered that made the 20-centuries-old lingling-o, or omega-shaped gold ornaments in Batanes.

約前400年：Larger villages came about- usually based near water, which made traveling and trading easier. The resulting ease of contact between communities meant that they began to share similar cultural traits, something which had not previously been possible when the communities consisted only of small kinship groups.
前300年－前200年：The start of the Carabao (Water buffaloes) domestication and husbandry.

約200年：The Maitum Jars are anthropomorphic jars that were depicting children (head is the lead of the jar with ears and the body was the jar itself with hands and feet as the handle) with perforations in red and black colors, had been used as a secondary burial jars in Ayub Cave, Pinol, Maitum Sarangani province, each of the jars had a "facial expression". Another example of funeral pottery in the Philippines.

約200年：Since at least the 3rd century, the indigenous peoples were in contact with other Southeast Asian and East Asian nations. Fragmented ethnic groups established numerous city-states formed by the assimilation of several small political units known as barangay each headed by a Datu or headman (still in use among non-Hispanic Filipino ethnic groups) and answerable to a king, titled Lakan and Rajah.

約200年：Marks the end of the Sa Huỳnh culture, as people are merged into different Chiefdoms, Kingdoms and Thalassocracies, but the remnants of Sa Huỳnh has still practiced by the natives of Masbate the artifacts can be found in Kalanay Cave proof that the ancient Masbatenios still practiced the Sa Huyun culture until 1500 AD.
700年：The Birth of Kawi script, this Abugida are become widely used in the Maritime Southeast Asia, the word Kawi or Kawikaan means "Poetry" in Sanskrit.
8世紀：The Greater India.
8世紀：The spread of Hinduism.
8世紀：the Kawi script.
900年4月21日：End of prehistory. Laguna Copperplate Inscription, the earliest known Philippine document, is written in the region around Laguna de Bay in Kawi script.

971年－982年：The earliest date suggested for direct Chinese contact with the Philippines was 982. At the time, merchants from "Ma-i" (now thought to be either in Bulalacao, Mindoro or Bay, Laguna on the shores of Laguna de Bay).

1000年：Buddhism and Hinduism along with the Animism became the religion of the most of Philippine archipelago by the influence of its neighbors. Around the feet of Mt. Kamhatik near Mulanay town in Quezon Province once stood a 280-hectare ancient village where the archeologists found a 1000-year-old limestone coffins on a jungle-covered mountain top from 2011 to 2012 proof of the advance burial rituals of the early Filipinos.
10世紀：Expansion of Buddhism, originated from India in the 6th century BCE to the rest of Asia until present.
10世紀：The Laguna Copperplate Inscription (LCI).
1000年：People from Central Vietnam called Orang Dampuan established trade zones in Sulu
1000年：The construction of Idjangs in Batanes Islands (mountain fortress-cities) built by Ivatans.
1001年3月17日：Song Shih document records tributary delegation from the Indic Rajahnate of Butuan.

約1155年：At the time, the trade in large native Ruson-tsukuri (literally Luzon made in Japanese: 呂宋製 or 呂宋つくり) clay jars used for storing green tea and rice wine with Japan flourished in the 12th century, and local Tagalog, Kapampangan and Pangasinense potters had marked each jar with Baybayin letters denoting the particular urn used and the kiln the jars were manufactured in.
1174年－1175年：Raiders coming from Visayas conducted a series of raids on Formosa (modern-day Taiwan), which was part of Song dynasty China.

約1180年：Before the establishment of the Sultanate of Sulu, The Indianized chiefdom of Lupah Sug (which is the present day Jolo, Sulu) was flourishing. Dwelling of the Buranun peoples under the rule of Rajah Sipad the Older.
12世紀：The Ruson-tsukuri (literally Luzon made in Japanese:呂宋製 or 呂宋つくり) clay jars used for storing green tea and rice wine.
12世紀：An ancient battleship called Karakowa, similar to the Balangay.
1200年：The process of Kabayan mummification had begun in Ibaloi Benguet which is also called Fire mummies.
1240年：Tuan Masha'ika, an Arab, travels and introduces Islam to Sulu.

13世紀：Chinese porcelain-ware, Kangxi era (1662–1722), Qing dynasty. Ancient Chinese porcelain excavated in Mindoro, Philippines; proves the existence of trade between the island and Imperial China. This consequently validates Chinese historical records of the area.
約1300年：The adoption of Baybayin, a Brahmic script.

1369年：Sulu attacked the Majapahit and its province Po-ni (Brunei), looting it of treasure and gold. A fleet from Majapahit succeeded in driving away the Sulus, but Po-ni was left weaker after the attack.
1380年：Sheikh Karim-ul Makhdum arrives in Jolo and builds a Mosque.
1390年：Baguinda Ali arrives in Buansa, Sulu and the people named him Rajah.
14世紀：The Baybayin.
14世紀：The Sulus attacked Majapahit and its province Po-ni (Brunei), looting it of treasure and gold.

約1400年：Cebu was founded after the arrival of Sri Lumay from Sumatra. Namayan instated Lakantagkan as its sovereign. The vast domain comprised what are now Quiapo, San Miguel, Santa Mesa, Paco, Pandacan, Malate, Santa Ana in Manila, Mandaluyong, San Juan, Makati, Pasay, Pateros, and portions of Pasig.

1405年：The Yongle Emperor instituted a Chinese envoy on Luzon during Zheng He's voyages and appointed Ko Ch'a-lao to that position in 1405. China also had vassals among the leaders in the archipelago. China attained ascendancy in trade with the area in Yongle's reign.

1411年：Paduka Pahala reigned as the King of Lupah Sug in Sulu. He and his family and 300 other people of noble descent sailed to China, he was to pay tribute to the Yongle Chinese emperor, Zhu Di, who was of the Ming dynasty. While he was welcomed by the emperor upon his arrival in China, he nevertheless contracted a mysterious disease on his way home and died at Dezhou, a town in Shandong province in China.
1411年12月11日：The Yongle Emperor holds a banquet in honor of Pangasinan and its Huang Liyu.
1457年：Sultanate of Sulu founded by Sayyid Abubakar Abirin.

1458年－1459年：The Lucoes, or warriors from Luzon send soldiers to the Burmese Siamese wars and faced the White elephants of the Royal Burmese Army, at the same time also aiding the Burmese King for the conquest of the Siamese capital, Ayuthaya.
15世紀：Flag of the Sultanate of Sulu
1500年：Rajah Salalila of Maynila married the daughter of Sultan Bolkiah of Brunei, effectively uniting the royal families of Maynila and Brunei.
1500年：The eruption of Mount Pinatubo in recorded history, The Buag Eruptive Period, Its eruptions were roughly the same size as those of 1991.

1521年3月16日：Discovery of the Philippines: Portuguese Ferdinand Magellan lands on Homonhon with three small ships, named the Concepcion, Trinidad and Victoria. Magellan calls the place the Archipelago de San Lazaro since March 16 is the feast day of Saint Lazarus. He also lands on Samar island.
1521年3月28日：Magellan reaches the Philippines
1521年3月29日：Blood compact between Magellan and Rajah Kulambo of Limasawa
1521年3月31日：The first mass on Philippine soil is celebrated.
1521年4月7日：Magellan lands on Cebu; meets Rajah Humabon of Cebu and enters into another blood compact.
1521年4月14日：The first Mass in Cebu province is celebrated, with about 500 natives, including Rajah Humabon and his wife, baptized into the Catholic Church.
1521年4月27日：Magellan is killed by Lapu-Lapu in the battle of Mactan; Spaniards defeated.
1525年：Spain sends an expedition under Juan Garcia Jofre de Loaysa to the Philippines. The Loaysa Expedition failed
1526年：Spain sends another expedition under Juan Cabot to the Philippines. The Cabot Expedition also failed
1527年：Spain sends a fourth expedition under Álvaro de Saavedra Cerón to the Philippines.
1529年：Saavedra's expedition returns to Spain without Saavedra who died on the way home.
1536年：The Loaysa expedition returns to Spain. One of its survivors is Andres de Urdaneta, its chronicler.
1543年：Spain sends a fifth expedition under Ruy López de Villalobos to the Philippines. The Expedition succeeds.

1543年2月2日：Villalobos arrives in the Philippines and names the islands of Samar and Leyte as Las Islas Filipinas in honor of the crown prince of Spain, Philip of Asturias; he also becomes the first to explore Mindanao island, naming it "Cesarea Caroli."
1565年：Arrival of the Augustinians
1565年2月13日：Miguel López de Legazpi arrives in the Philippines, landing in Cebu, with four ships and 380 men
1565年4月27日：Legazpi returns to Cebu; settlement established.
1565年5月8日：Legazpi established the first permanent Spanish settlement in the country
1565年6月4日：Legazpi, representing King Philip II of Spain, and Rajah Tupas of Cebu signed the Treaty of Cebu, effectively establishing Spanish suzerainty over Cebu.
1565年：Philippines was governed as a territory of the Viceroyalty of New Spain.
1567年：Dagami Revolt (1567)
1568年：The Portuguese, under the command of General Gonzalo de Pereira, attack Cebu and blockade its port.
1569年：Present-day Capiz Province becomes a Spanish settlement.
1569年：Legazpi moves the seat of government from Cebu to Iloilo.

1569年8月6日：King Philip II of Spain, through a royal decree, creates Cebu as the country's first Spanish province; he also appoints Miguel Lopez de Legazpi as governor and captain general of the territory.
1570年：The Portuguese attacked a Spanish colony in Cebu but were repulsed.
1570年5月：Legazpi sends an expedition under the leadership of Martin de Goiti to Manila.
1571年1月1日：Legazpi establishes municipality of Cebu and names it "Villa del Santisimo Nombre de Jesus" (Town of the Most Holy Name of Jesus).
1571年5月19日：The ruler of Manila, Rajah Suliman, wages war against the Spaniards
1571年6月24日：Legazpi establishes the Spanish Colonial Government in Manila and proclaims it the capital of the colony
1571年12月11日：Provincehood of Pampanga, first province in Luzon to be inaugurated by the Spaniards.
1572年8月20日：Legazpi dies and Guido de Lavezaris succeeds him as Governor-General (1572–1575)
1574年11月7日：Enslavement of Filipinos is prohibited by a royal cedula from the Spanish king, as a response to a protest against it a day earlier.
1574年：Chinese pirate Limahong, with his men, invades Luzon; proceeds later to Manila.
1574年11月23日：The Chinese pirate captain Limahong attacks Manila but fails
1574年12月2日：Limahong again attacks Manila with 1500 soldiers but again fails to defeat the Spaniards
1574年12月：Lakandula lead a short revolt against the Spanish.
1575年：Ciudad de Nueva Cáceres (later renamed as Naga City) established by Captain Pedro de Sanchez
1575年：Juan de Salcedo defeats Limahong and his men in Pangasinan, forcing them to flee into the mountains.
1575年8月25日：Francisco de Sande appointed Governor-General (1575–1580)
1577年：Arrival of the Franciscans
1579年：Diocese of Manila established
1580年4月：Gonzalo Ronquillo de Peñaloza appointed Governor-General (1580–1583)
1580年4月5日：Establishment of Pangasinan as a provincial unit.
1580年：King Philip II of Spain becomes King of Portugal, ending the Portuguese harassment of the Philippines
1580年：The Spaniards institute forced labor on all male natives aged 16 to 60.
1581年：Arrival of the country's first bishop, Salazar.
1581年：Arrival of the Jesuits
1581年3月：Arrival of the first Dominicans in the Philippines
1582年：Battles take place between Spanish forces and Japanese Ronin
1583年3月10日：Diego Ronquillo appointed Governor-General (1583–1584)
1583年8月：A great fire destroys Manila.
1584年5月16日：Santiago de Vera appointed Governor-General (1584–1590)
1585年：Pampangos Revolt (1585)
1586年：The construction of San Agustin Church in Intramuros.
1587年7月21日：Arrival of Miguel de Benavides with the second batch of Dominicans in the Philippines, and the establishment of the Province of the Most Holy Rosary of the Philippines
1587年：Conspiracy of the Maharlikas (1587–1588)
1589年：Revolts Against the Tribute (1589)
1590年：Missionaries from the Society of Jesus established the Colegio de Manila in Intramuros.
1590年6月1日：Gómez Pérez Dasmariñas appointed Governor-General (1590–1593)
1592年：Miguel de Benavides's Doctrina Christiana in Chinese published

items.text: 1762年9月22日：British fleet entered seizes Manila Bay as part of the Seven Years' War

1762年10月8日：Gov. Gen. de Anda moves the seat of the Spanish government to Bacolor, Pampanga, becoming the temporary capital of the Philippines (1762–1764).

1762年11月14日：Silang Revolt (1762–63)
1763年：Dabo and Marayac Revolt (1763)
1763年：Isabela Revolt (1763).
1763年2月10日：Treaty of Paris implicitly returns Manila to Spain.
1763年5月28日：Death of Diego Silang
1763年9月：Execution of Gabriela Silang, the only Filipina to have led a revolt
1764年3月17日：Simón de Anda y Salazar hands over the control of the colonial government to Francisco Javier de la Torre, newly appointed Governor-General (1764–1765)
1764年6月11日：The last of the British ships that sailed to Manila leaves the Philippines for India, ending the British occupation.

1765年2月10日：Royal Fiscal of Manila Don Francisco Léandro de Viana writes the famous letter to King Charles III of Spain, later called as "Viana Memorial of 1765". The document advised the king to abandon the colony due to the economic and social devastation created by the Seven Years' War. The suggestion was not heeded.

1769年：The closure of the Jesuit Universidad de San Ignacio leaves the University of Santo Tomas as the only institution of higher learning in the colony.

1886年5月10日：Felix Manalo, founder of Iglesia ni Cristo is born.
1887年5月29日：Noli Me Tangere published.
1887年10月：Rizal starts writing the El Filibusterismo
1887年：The Manila School of Agriculture is established.
1888年3月1日：A massive anti-friar demonstration took place in Manila (led by Doroteo Cortés, José A. Ramos, and Marcelo H. del Pilar)
1888年3月10日：Antonio Molto and Federico Lobaton became acting Governor-General (1888)
1888年：Valeriano Wéyler appointed Governor-General (1888–1891)
1888年12月10日：La Solidaridad established
1888年12月12日：A petition, seeking permission for a night school, is submitted by 21 young women of Malolos, Bulacan, to the Governor-General.
1889年：La Solidaridad is first published in Spain as the Propaganda Movement's organ.
1889年：El Ilocano is established; country's first local newspaper (1889–1896).
1891年3月28日：Rizal finishes writing El Filibusterismo in Biarritz, France
1891年：El Filibusterismo published in Ghent, Belgium
1891年：Eulogio Despujol appointed Governor-General (1891–1893)
1892年：Diariong Tagalog is published; first native daily paper, lasted at least three months.
1892年6月26日：Rizal arrives in the Philippines from Europe via Hong Kong
1892年7月3日：Rizal forms the La Liga Filipina
1892年7月7日：Rizal is arrested for establishing the La Liga Filipina
1892年7月7日：Andres Bonifacio secretly established the Katipunan.
1892年7月7日：Rizal is exiled to Dapitan
1892年9月23日：Filipino painter Juan Luna shot dead his wife Paz Pardo De Tavera.
1892年11月24日：Ferrocaril de Manila-Dagupan is opened, country's first railroad line with route of Manila–Dagupan, the forerunner of the Philippine National Railways.
1893年：El Hogar is established; country's first publication for and by women.
1893年3月10日：Federico Ochando becomes acting Governor-General (1893)
1893年：Ramón Blanco appointed Governor-General (1893–1896)
1894年7月8日：Bonifacio forms the Katipunan
1894年10月17日：Sorsogon province was separated from Albay province.
1895年：First local (municipal) elections

1895年4月12日：Recorded "earliest" day of celebration of independence, when Andres Bonifacio and other Katipuneros go to Pamitinan Cave in Montalban (now Rodriguez), Rizal to initiate new Katipunan members.
1896年：Republic of Kakarong de Sili is established in Pandi, Bulacan.
1896年7月1日：Rizal is recruited as a physician for the Spanish Army in Cuba by Governor Ramon Blanco
1896年8月6日：Rizal returns to Manila from Cuba
1896年8月19日：Katipunan is discovered by the Spanish authorities. Katipuneros flee to Balintawak
1896年8月23日：Revolution is proclaimed by Bonifacio at the Cry of Balintawak. Katipuneros tear up their cedulas
1896年8月26日：Andres Bonifacio, Emilio Jacinto and other Katipuneros board Rizal's ship to Barcelona. They offer his rescue but Rizal refused
1896年8月30日：Revolutionary Battle at San Juan del Monte. Governor Ramon Blanco proclaims a state of war in Manila, Laguna, Cavite, Batangas, Pampanga, Bulacan, Tarlac and Nueva Ecija.
1896年8月30日：Battle of San Juan del Monte took place.
links: Battle of San Juan del Monte

items.text: 1896年9月2日：Rizal Boards the ship Isla de Panay for Barcelona
1896年9月2日：Gen. Mariano Llanera leads the Filipino revolutionaries in a three-day battle against the Spanish forces in San Isidro, Nueva Ecija.
1896年9月4日：Four members of Katipunan involved in the Battle of San Juan del Monte, were executed on the Campo de Bagumbayan.
