1172年：Ayyubid forces commanded by Turan-Shah invade Banu Kanz lands in Nubia, seizing the strategic frontier fortress of Qasr Ibrim.
1272年：King David of Makuria launches a military offensive against the Egyptian maritime port of Aidhab on the Red Sea coast.
1276年：Mamluk forces under Sultan Baibars invade Makuria, capture Old Dongola, and displace King David to install a puppet ruler subject to tribute payments.
1317年5月29日：The Throne Hall of Old Dongola is formally converted into a mosque.
1323年：The Christian dynasties of Makuria effectively disintegrated.
約1504年：The Funj Sultanate (Kingdom of Sennar) is founded by Amara Dunqas following the final collapse of the tribal monarchy of Alodia.
約1612年：The Keira dynasty consolidates the Sultanate of Darfur under Sulayman Solong, establishing Islam as the official state religion.
1744年：Battle of the Dindar River: The Funj Sultanate successfully repels a major invasion army launched by the Ethiopian Empire under Emperor Iyasu II.
1762年：The Hamaj Coup occurs as military commander Muhammad Abu Likaylik overthrows the ruling Funj monarch, instating the Hamaj Regency and precipitating internal state decay.
1881年：Mahdist War: A war began against the United Kingdom and Egypt
links: United Dinggdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1899年：Sudan fell under the rule of an Anglo-Egyptian condominium.
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1955年：First Sudanese Civil War begins
1956年：The country becomes independent as the Republic of the Sudan
1983年：Second Sudanese Civil War begins
1998年8月20日：Al-Shifa pharmaceutical factory destroyed in a missile strike by the United States
2001年2月：Al-Turabi was arrested for signing a memorandum with the SPLA.
2001年3月：The United Nations (UN) World Food Programme struggled to feed millions facing starvation.
2001年4月：The SPLA threatened to attack foreign oil workers.
2001年6月：Peace talks in Nairobi broke down.
2001年7月：Egypt and Libya proposed a peace plan for Sudan.
2001年9月：The UN lifted sanctions against Sudan.
2001年10月：United States Senator John Danforth was appointed Special Envoy to Sudan.
2001年11月：The United States imposed sanctions on Sudan.
2002年1月：A ceasefire was agreed between the government and the SPLA.
2002年7月20日：Second Sudanese Civil War: The Machakos Protocol ended the nineteen-year civil war.
2003年2月：War in Darfur: The war began.
2004年1月：The army moved into Darfur to quell the rebellion, prompting hundreds of thousands of refugees to flee into neighbouring Chad.
2004年3月：A UN official accused pro-government Janjaweed militias of carrying out systematic killings in Darfur.
2004年9月：United States Secretary of State Colin Powell described the Darfur killings as genocide.
2005年1月9日：The Comprehensive Peace Agreement was signed between the SPLA and the government.
2005年3月：The United Nations Security Council authorised sanctions against any violators of the Darfur ceasefire.
2005年6月：Al-Turabi was freed.
2005年7月：John Garang was sworn in as vice-president.
2005年8月1日：Garang died in a plane crash and was succeeded by Salva Kiir Mayardit.
2005年9月：A power-sharing government was established.
2005年10月：An autonomous government was formed in southern Sudan.
2006年5月：The government signed a peace accord with a Darfur rebel group, the Sudan Liberation Movement.
2006年10月：Jan Pronk, head of the United Nations Mission in Sudan, was expelled from the country.
2006年11月：African Union peacekeepers extended their stay in Darfur for a further six months.
2007年5月：The United States placed fresh sanctions on Sudan.
2007年7月31日：United Nations Security Council Resolution 1769 authorised twenty-six thousand peacekeepers for Darfur.
2007年8月：2007 Sudan floods: Floods began.
2007年9月：2007 Sudan floods: The floods ended.
2007年11月：Sudanese teddy bear blasphemy case: A British teacher was imprisoned for naming a teddy bear Muhammad.
1482年：the Portuguese become first Europeans to set up trading settlement in Ghana and Sub-Saharan Africa.
1598年：the Dutch joined the Portuguese in trading gold to establish Dutch Gold coast.
1701年：The Battle of Feyiase marks the rise of the Ashanti Empire
1874年：the British declare coastal area of the Gold Coast as a colony as British Gold coast.
1946年：First legislative council elections take place.
1960年：Ghana becomes a republic. Kwame Nkrumah becomes the country's first elected president.
1964年：Kwame Nkrumah declares that there will be no other political party apart from the Convention People's Party (CPP), the one party state system.
1966年：Nkrumah is overthrown in military coup by Emmanuel Kwasi Kotoka.
1969年：Kofi Busia is elected prime minister after a new constitution is drawn.
1972年：Busia is overthrown by Col. Ignatius Kutu Acheampong, in military coup.
1978年：Acheampong is made to resign; General Frederick Akuffo takes over.
1979年：Akuffo overthrown in another coup by Flight Lieutenant Jerry Rawlings. Acheampong and Akuffo tried and executed on charges of corruption.
1981年：Limann is overthrown by Rawlings in military coup. This was after two years of weak government and economic stagnation.
1983年：Rawlings implements conservative economic policies.
1992年：Referendum approves new constitution introducing a multiparty system.
1992年：Rawlings is elected president of Ghana.
1994年：1000 Ghanaians killed and with 150,000 displaced in the Northern Region after a tribal conflict between the Konkomba and the Nanumba ethnic groups over land ownership.
1994年：Grand Orange Lodge of Ghana leader Emmanuel Aboki Essien became the first black and African Imperial Grand President of the Orange Order.
1994年：They later sign peace agreements with seven other ethnic groups.
1995年：Curfew imposed in the Northern Region after ethnic violence re-erupts leads to 100 deaths.
1996年：Jerry Rawlings re-elected as president of Ghana.
2000年：December - John Kufuor is elected president of Ghana after defeating John Atta Mills in the presidential elections.
2006年：Ghana National football team, the black stars play in the 2006 FIFA World Cup.
2010年：Census by Ghana statistical service.
407年：Resistance of Honorius cousins in Spain. Constantine III sends his son Constans II with an army.
408年：Gerontius, Roman general (magister militum) ends the revolt in Hispain.
409年：Gerontius, who had been a partisan of Constantine III, revolts in Hispania. He elevates Maximus, his domesticus, as emperor.

409年10月13日：The Vandals, led by King Gunderic, cross the Pyrenees into the Iberian Peninsula. They receive land from the Romans, as foederati, in Baetica (Southern Spain). The Alans occupy lands in Lusitania and the Suebi control parts of Gallaecia.
410年：Gerontius successfully defended himself against Constans II.
411年：The Alans establish their rule in the Roman province of Lusitania (Portugal south of the Duero River and Spain).
416年：Wallia is campaigning against the Vandals and Alans on behalf of Emperor Honorius.
418年：Emperor Honorius bribes Wallia, king of the Visigoths, into regaining Hispania for the Roman Empire. His victory over the Vandals forces them to retire to Baetica.
420年：Comes Asterius conducts campaign in Gallaecia and ends the usurpation of Maximus. A Roman army under command of vicar Maurocellus suffers a defeat at Braga in Gallaecia.
422年：Vandal war: The Roman commander-in-chief Castinus leads a defeat against the Vandals at Baetica.
429年：The Vandals including Alans, led by Genseric ("Caesar King"), cross the narrow Strait of Gibraltar with their families from the Iberian Peninsula.
439年：Rechila conquers the city Mérida.
441年：Rechila invades Baetica and conquers the capital Seville
456年：the Gothic king Theoderic II starts a war commissioned by the West Roman emperor Avitus.
460年：The fleet Emperor Majorian assembles in Nova Carthago (Cartagena) in preparation for an invasion of the Vandal Kingdom in Africa becomes destroyed by the Vandal king Geiseric.
464年：The Suevic nation in Galicia (Northern Spain) is unified under King Remismund.
473年：The Gothic king Euric orders his army to conquer the province of Tarragonenses.
475年：The comes Hispaniarum Vincentius capitulates against the Aquitanian Goths. The Goths complete their conquest of Spain.

507年：The Franks attacked allied with the Burgundians to the Visigothic Kingdom of Toulouse. Alaric II was killed at the Battle of Vouillé, and Toulouse was sacked. The Visigoths had lost most of their Gallic holdings and are retreated to Hispania and Septimania, helped by Ostrogoths. Kingdom of Toulouse ended and The Arian Kingdom of Hispania began. Barcelona was the new capital of the Visigoths. From this moment, little by little, Visigothic Hispania will be the first effective realisation of an independent Kingdom or State of wholly Hispanic territories and scope.
552年：Byzantine Empire conquered part of the south of the Visigothic kingdom.
567年：Toledo. Capital of the Visigothic kingdom by the end of the reign of Athanagild.

568年：Liuvigild began his reign. He is among the greatest Visigothic kings of the Arian period because he consolidated Visigothic power in Spain. He is known for his Code of Leovigild, a law that allowed equal rights between the Visigothic and Hispano-Roman populations, and for expanding the territory of the Visigothic Kingdom. Since Leovigild, the Visigoth kings minted their own Tremissis coin.
585年：Liuvigild conquered the Suebic Kingdom.
589年5月8日：The Third Council of Toledo marks the entry of Visigothic Spain into the Catholic Church, after Reccared I converted in 587. The Catholic Kingdom of Toledo began.
624年：Swinthila reconquered the south of Byzantine Hispania.

624年："History of the Kings of the Goths" is written by Isidore of Seville. In the prologue, "Laus Spaniae" (Praises to Spain), introduces the phrase mater Spania (mother Spain) and defends the Gothic identity of a unified Spain.
links: Historia de regibus Gothorum, Vandalorum et Suevorum

items.text: 625年：The entire Hispania and Septimania is under the Visigothic Kingdom. Swinthila defeated the Basques.
654年：Recceswinth was responsible for the promulgation of a law code, Liber Iudiciorum. The new laws applied to both Gothic and Hispano-Roman populations.
711年7月：The Battle of Guadalete was the first major battle of the Umayyad conquest of Hispania. Roderic, the last Visigoth king in Hispania under the rule from Toledo, died in the battle.
links: Muslim conquest of the Iberian Peninsula

items.text: 718年：The Visigothic nobleman Pelagius of Asturias rebelled against the Umayyad Caliphate.
722年：Battle of Covadonga: Forces loyal to Pelagius decimated an Umayyad army sent to reconquer them in a valley in the Picos de Europa.
722年：Pelagius was elected princeps of the independent Kingdom of Asturias with his capital at Cangas de Onís.
737年：Pelagius died. He was succeeded as princeps by his son Favila of Asturias.
739年：Favila was killed by a bear while hunting. He was succeeded by his brother-in-law Alfonso I the Catholic of Asturias, the son of Peter of Cantabria, the duke of Cantabria.
740年：Asturias conquered and annexed Galicia.
757年：Alfonso the Catholic died. He was succeeded as king by his son Fruela I the Cruel of Asturias.
768年1月14日：Fruela was assassinated.
768年：Fruela's cousin Aurelius of Asturias was crowned king of Asturias.
774年：Aurelius died. He was succeeded by his cousin-in-law, Silo of Asturias, husband of Alfonso the Catholic's daughter Adosinda. Silo established his capital at Pravia.
783年：Silo died.
783年：Adosinda engineered the election of her nephew Alfonso II the Chaste of Asturias, son of Fruela, as king of Asturias.
783年：A coalition of nobles elected Alfonso the Catholic's illegitimate son Mauregatus of Asturias king of Asturias. Alfonso the Chaste fled to Álava.
789年：Mauregatus died.
789年：Aurelius's brother Bermudo I the Deacon, the Monk of Asturias was elected king of Asturias.
791年：Battle of the Burbia River: An Asturian force attacked a Cordoban army near Villafranca del Bierzo on its return to Córdoba and was defeated.
791年：Bermudo abdicated the throne.
791年9月14日：Alfonso the Chaste was crowned king of Asturias in Oviedo, Spain.
791年：Alfonso the Chaste established his capital at Oviedo.
794年：Battle of Lutos: A Cordoban army returning from a scorched earth campaign in modern Álava was wiped out by an Asturian force.
795年9月18日：Battle of Las Babias: Córdoba attacked and routed an Asturian force near Astorga, Spain.
816年：Battle of Pancorbo (816): Córdoba slaughtered a Basque-Asturian force defending the Basque homeland in the Pyrenees at Pancorbo.

824年：Battle of Roncevaux Pass (824): A combined force of Basques and the Banu Qasi, both vassals of the emirate of Córdoba, defeated a Carolingian military expedition in the Roncevaux Pass. The Basque chieftain Íñigo Arista of Pamplona was crowned king of Navarre at Pamplona.
842年：Alfonso the Chaste died.
842年：The Asturian nobility elected Nepotian of Asturias, a relative of Alfonso the Chaste, king.
842年：Battle of the Bridge of Cornellana: Forces loyal to Bermudo's son Ramiro I of Asturias defeated Nepotian in modern Salas, Asturias.
links: Battle of the Bridge of Cornellana

items.text: 850年2月1日：Ramiro died. He was buried in the Pantheon of Asturian Kings in Oviedo. His son Ordoño I of Asturias succeeded him as king.
851年：Battle of Albelda (851): Ordoño suppressed a Basque revolt in northeastern Asturias and expelled an opportunistic Cordoban invasion near Albelda.
851年：Íñigo died. He was succeeded as king of Navarre by his son García Íñiguez of Pamplona.
852年：Battle of Guadalacete: Asturian and Pamplonan forces arriving in support of a revolt of the people of Toledo, Spain were routed by a Cordoban army.
859年：Vikings captured García and extorted a ransom of some seventy thousand gold dinars from Navarre for his return.
860年：Cordoban forces captured García's son and heir Fortún Garcés the One-Eyed, the Monk of Pamplona in Milagro, Navarre.
862年：An eastern march of Asturias was created the county of Castile under count Rodrigo of Castile.
865年8月9日：Battle of the Morcuera: Córdoba attacked Asturias, forcing the retreat of Asturian forces and their Castilian allies along the valley of the Ebro.
866年5月27日：Ordoño died. He was succeeded by his eldest son Alfonso III the Great of Asturias.
866年：Fruela seized the throne of Asturias and forced Alfonso the Great to flee to Castile.
866年：Fruela was assassinated in Oviedo.
868年：Asturias conquered Porto. Vímara Peres was created count of Portugal.
870年：García died. García Jiménez of Pamplona took power as regent, García's son and heir Fortún Garcés remaining in captivity in Córdoba.
873年11月5日：Rodrigo died. He was succeeded as count of Castile by his son Diego Rodríguez Porcelos.
878年：Asturias conquered Coimbra.
882年：First Battle of Cellorigo: Vela Jiménez, count of the Asturian county of Álava, repelled an attempted conquest by the Emirate of Córdoba of an important mountain pass at Cellorigo.
882年：Fortún Garcés was returned to rule in Navarre.
883年：Second Battle of Cellorigo: Vela Jiménez repelled an attempted conquest by the Emirate of Córdoba of an important mountain pass at Cellorigo.
885年1月31日：Rodríguez died.
901年7月：Day of Zamora: The Asturian defenders of Zamora, Spain dealt heavy casualties to a Cordoban force attempting to conquer it. The heads of the besiegers were displayed on the city walls.
905年：The Navarrese nobility removed Fortún Garcés from the throne, placing Sancho I of Pamplona there in his stead.

910年12月20日：Alfonso the Great died and was buried at Oviedo Cathedral. His kingdom was divided among his three sons, with his eldest, García I of León, receiving León, Ordoño II of León receiving Galicia, and Fruela II of Asturias receiving a rump Asturias including Castile.
914年1月19日：García I died. His lands passed to Ordoño II.
917年：Battle of San Esteban de Gormaz (917): Leonese forces broke a Cordoban siege of San Esteban de Gormaz.
links: Battle of San Esteban de Gormaz (917)

items.text: 920年7月26日：Battle of Valdejunquera: A Cordoban army invading Castile routed a joint Leonese-Navarrese force at Valdejunquera, probably between modern Estella-Lizarra and Pamplona, forcing the abandonment by León of Clunia.
922年：Navarre defeated Galindo Aznárez II, count of the County of Aragon, in battle and forced him into vassalage.
924年6月：Ordoño II died.
924年：The Leonese nobility elected Fruela II king of León.

925年7月：Fruela II died, possibly from leprosy. His will named his son Alfonso Fróilaz his successor. Ordoño II's sons Sancho Ordóñez, Alfonso IV the Monk of León and Ramiro II of León did not recognize Fróilaz's succession, however, leaving him in de facto authority only in Galicia.
925年：Fruela II's younger brother, a Ramiro, married his widow Urraca bint Abd Allah and claimed the royal title.
925年：Ordóñez, Alfonso the Monk and Ramiro II forced Fróilaz into exile in the eastern marches of Asturias.
925年：Ordóñez seized León, Spain.
925年：Alfonso the Monk, with the support of Navarre and the Leonese nobility, expelled Ordóñez from León, Spain.
925年12月10日：Sancho I died. He was succeeded by his young son García Sánchez I of Pamplona with his brother Jimeno Garcés of Pamplona acting as regent.
926年：Ordóñez was crowned princeps of Galicia.
929年8月16日：Ordóñez died. His territory passed to Alfonso the Monk.
931年：Fernán González of Castile became count of Castile.
931年：Álvaro Herraméliz, count of Lantarón and Álava, died. Fernán González inherited his territories and united them with Castile.
931年5月29日：Jimeno Garcés died.
931年：Alfonso the Monk was forced to abdicate the rule of León and Galicia to his brother Ramiro II.
939年7月19日：Battle of Simancas: A battle began near Simancas which would see a joint Leonese-Navarrese force repel an attempted Cordoban conquest of the lands around the Douro.
939年8月5日：Battle of Alhandic: Cordoban forces conquered the Leonese city of Zamora, Spain with great cost in lives to both sides.
951年1月1日：Ramiro II died and was buried in the Basílica de San Isidoro, León. He was succeeded by his son Ordoño III of León.
956年：Ordoño III died in Zamora, Spain. He was succeeded by his half-brother Sancho I the Fat of León.
958年：The Leonese nobility, led by Fernán González, deposed Sancho the Fat in favor of Alfonso the Monk's son Ordoño IV the Wicked, the Bad of León.
960年：Sancho the Fat was restored to the throne of León with the support of Navarre and Córdoba.

966年：Sancho the Fat was poisoned by count Gonzalo Menéndez of Portugal and buried in the Basílica de San Isidoro, León. He was succeeded by his young son Ramiro III of León, with the latter's aunt Elvira Ramírez and mother Teresa Ansúrez ruling as regents.
970年2月22日：García Sánchez I died. He was succeeded by his eldest son Sancho II of Pamplona. A small territory around Viguera he willed to another son as the Kingdom of Viguera.
970年：Fernán González died. He was succeeded as count of Castile by his son García Fernández of the White Hands of Castile.
981年7月9日：Battle of Torrevicente: A Cordoban force dealt a bloody defeat to a rebel Cordoban general and his Vigueran and Castilian allies, probably near Atienza.
981年：Battle of Rueda: A Cordoban force dealt a decisive defeat to a joint Leonese-Navarrese army in Rueda, Valladolid.
982年10月15日：The Galician nobility acclaimed Ordoño III's son Bermudo II the Gouty of León king of Galicia with the support of the Caliphate of Córdoba.
984年：Bermudo deposed Ramiro III and replaced him as king of León.
987年：León expelled Cordoban forces from Zamora, Spain.
991年11月：The Leonese nobility expelled Bermudo from the kingdom.
992年9月：Bermudo was allowed to return to León.
994年：Sancho II died and was buried at San Juan de la Peña. He was succeeded as king of Navarre and count of Aragon by his son García Sánchez II of Pamplona.
995年5月：Fernández was captured by a Cordoban raiding party.
995年6月：Fernández died of his wounds at Medinaceli. He was succeeded by his son Sancho García of the Good Laws of Castile.
996年：Córdoba conquered the Leonese city of Astorga, Spain.
999年：Castile declined to pay its annual tribute to Córdoba.

999年9月：Bermudo died. He was succeeded by his young son Alfonso V the Noble of León, with the latter's mother Elvira of Castile, Queen of León and the count Menendo González, count of Portugal and duke in Galicia, acting as regents.
links: Elvira of Castile, Queen of León

items.text: 1000年7月29日：Battle of Cervera: Córdoba defeated the combined forces of García of the Good Laws and García Gómez, count of Saldaña, Carrión and Liébana on a punitive expedition near modern Espinosa de Cervera.

1000年：García Sánchez II died. He was succeeded as king of Navarre and count of Aragon by his young son Sancho III the Great of Pamplona, with the latter's mother Jimena Fernández and grandmother Urraca Fernandez ruling with the bishops of Navarre as regents.
1005年：A Cordoban army under the caliph Hisham II invaded León with the intent of conquering Zamora, Spain.
1005年：García Ramírez of Viguera, king of Viguera, died without male heirs. His territory was absorbed by Navarre.
1008年10月6日：Menendo González died. Alfonso the Noble entered his majority.
1009年：Hisham was overthrown and imprisoned by his cousin Muhammad II of Córdoba.

1009年11月1日：Sulayman ibn al-Hakam, at the head of an army of disaffected Berbers and with the help of García of the Good Laws, defeated Muhammad, forcing the latter to flee to Toledo, Spain, and freed Hisham.
1011年：Sancho the Great married García of the Good Laws's daughter Muniadona of Castile.
1015年：Sancho the Great conquered the county of Sobrarbe.

1017年2月5日：García of the Good Laws died. He was succeeded as count of Castile and Álava by his young son García Sánchez of Castile, with Urraca of Covarrubias, the latter's aunt and Fernández's daughter, acting as regent with the Castilian nobility.
1018年：Sancho the Great annexed half of the county of Ribagorza.
1025年：Raymond III of Pallars Jussà, count of Pallars Jussà and the rump Ribagorza, pledged submission to Sancho the Great as his vassal.
1028年8月7日：Alfonso the Noble died. He was succeeded as king of León by his son Bermudo III of León.
1029年：García Sánchez was assassinated in León, Spain by the sons of a noble he had expelled from the lands between the Cea and the Pisuerga.
1029年：Sancho the Great appointed Ferdinand I the Great of León, his son and grandson of García of the Good Laws on his mother's side, count of Castile.
1031年：Hisham III of Córdoba, the caliph of Córdoba in exile, was overthrown and his title abolished by the local nobility, resulting in the immediate de jure independence of the taifas of Al-Andalus.
1032年：Alfonso the Noble's daughter Sancha of León was married to Ferdinand the Great.
1034年：Navarre conquered León, Spain. Bermudo III fled to modern Galicia.

1035年10月18日：Sancho the Great died. His kingdom was divided among his sons. Gonzalo of Sobrarbe and Ribagorza received Sobrarbe and Ribagorza. The illegitimate Ramiro I of Aragon was granted the title of bailiff and some property in Aragon. García Sánchez III of Pamplona succeeded his father as king of Navarre and held suzerainty over his brothers.
1035年：Battle of Tafalla: García Sánchez III repelled an invasion of his kingdom by Ramiro I.
1037年9月4日：Battle of Tamarón: Bermudo III of León fell from his horse and was slain by forces loyal to Ferdinand the Great.
1038年6月22日：Ferdinand the Great was crowned king of León and Castile in León, Spain.
1043年6月26日：Gonzalo of Sobrarbe and Ribagorza was assassinated by one of his knights.
1043年：Ramiro I annexed Sobrarbe and Ribagorza.

1054年9月1日：Battle of Atapuerca: Navarrese and Leonese forces met near modern Atapuerca, Province of Burgos. García Sánchez III and his tutor Fortún Sánchez were killed. García Sánchez III's son Sancho IV of Peñalén of Pamplona succeeded him as king under the regency of Stephanie, Queen of Navarre. León annexed Navarrese territories south of the Ebro.
1056年：Ferdinand the Great crowned himself Imperator totius Hispaniae.
1058年5月25日：Stephanie died.
1062年12月29日：Sancho of Peñalén and Ferdinand the Great signed a treaty defining their border.
1063年：Synod of Jaca (1063): Ramiro I presided over a synod in Jaca which reestablished the Roman Catholic Diocese of Huesca.
1063年5月8日：Battle of Graus: Ramiro I died in a failed attempt to take Graus from the taifa of Zaragoza. He was succeeded by his son Sancho Ramírez.
1064年8月：Crusade of Barbastro: At the urging of the pope Pope Alexander II, a coalition of Aragon, Urgell, Aquitaine and the Papal States conquered Barbastro from the taifa of Lérida.
1065年：Battle of Paterna: Valencian forces pursuing the army of Ferdinand the Great, then in retreat from a failed siege of Valencia, were ambushed and wiped out at Paterna.

1065年12月24日：Ferdinand the Great died. His kingdom was divided among his three children. The eldest, Sancho II the Strong of Castile and León, received Castile. León was divided; Galicia went to García II of Galicia, and the remainder went to Alfonso VI the Brave, the Valiant of León and Castile.
links: Sancho II of Castile and León
Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1065年：War of the Three Sanchos: Sancho the Strong began ordering border raids on Navarre.
links: Sancho II of Castile and León

items.text: 1067年：War of the Three Sanchos: The war reached a stalemate. Castile remained in possession of the Navarrese territories in modern Álava, Montes de Oca, Pancorbo, Burgos and La Rioja.
1068年：Alfonso the Brave invaded the taifa of Badajoz.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1068年7月19日：Battle of Llantada: Sancho the Strong defeated Alfonso the Brave at Llantadilla, in the taifa of Badajoz near modern Melgar de Fernamental.
links: Sancho II of Castile and León
Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1071年6月：Sancho the Strong and Alfonso the Brave invaded Galicia from the north and south, respectively, partitioning the kingdom and forcing García II into exile in Seville.
links: Sancho II of Castile and León
Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1072年1月：Battle of Golpejera: Sancho the Strong defeated and captured Alfonso the Brave near Carrión de los Condes. The latter was released and sent into exile in Toledo.
links: Sancho II of Castile and León
Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1072年1月12日：Sancho the Strong was crowned king of León.
links: Sancho II of Castile and León

items.text: 1072年10月7日：Sancho the Strong was betrayed and murdered by a Zamoran noble during his assault on Zamora, Spain.
links: Sancho II of Castile and León

items.text: 1072年：Alfonso the Brave succeeded his brother Sancho the Strong as king of León and Castile.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile
Sancho II of Castile and León

items.text: 1074年：The taifas of Toledo and Granada were forced to pay the parias to Alfonso the Brave.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1076年6月4日：Sancho of Peñalén was thrown from a cliff in Peñalén by his brother and sister. Alfonso the Brave recognized his young son García Sánchez as his successor.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1076年：The Navarrese nobility elected Sancho Ramírez king. The latter ceded some territory in Navarre's west to Alfonso the Brave.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1076年：The Emir of Zaragoza began to pay the parias to Alfonso the Brave.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1077年：Alfonso the Brave took the title Imperator totius Hispaniae.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1079年：Battle of Cabra: Seville defeated the invading forces of Granada. Both sides were aided by Castilian knights.
1079年：Alfonso the Brave conquered Coria, Cáceres.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1083年4月28日：Sancho Ramírez conquered Graus.
1083年：Under the pretense of surrender, the occupants of the castle of Rueda de Jalón, a Zaragozan stronghold, invited important nobles of León to the castle and murdered them.
1084年8月14日：Battle of Morella: A Zaragozan army led by the general El Cid decisively defeated the forces of Sancho Ramírez near Tortosa.
1084年12月25日：Battle of Piedra Pisada: A Zaragozan army skirmished with the forces of Alfonso the Brave, then following the valley of the Cinca from Naval, Huesca to El Grado.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1085年5月25日：Alfonso the Brave conquered Toledo, Spain.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1085年：Alfonso the Brave conquered modern Madrid.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1086年3月：Alfonso the Brave installed his vassal, an al-Qádir, as king of Valencia.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1086年10月23日：Battle of Sagrajas: Yusuf ibn Tashfin, the sultan of the Almoravid dynasty, at the head of a coalition of Andalusian taifas, defeated León and Castile and Aragon in a bloody battle near Badajoz. The taifas renounced payment of the parias.

1087年：Siege of Tudela: Alfonso the Brave, Sancho Ramírez, Odo I, Duke of Burgundy, the duke of Burgundy, and William the Carpenter, viscount of Melun, laid siege to the Zaragozan fortress at Tudela, Navarre.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1087年：Sancho Ramírez conquered Estada.
1088年：Sancho Ramírez took the Castle of Montearagón.
1089年6月24日：Sancho Ramírez conquered Monzón.
1090年：Yusuf overthrew the king of Valencia and sent him into exile.
1094年6月4日：Sancho Ramírez died during a siege of Huesca. He was succeeded as king of Aragon and Navarre by his eldest son Peter I of Aragon and Pamplona.
links: Peter I of Aragon and Pamplona

items.text: 1094年6月：El Cid reconquered Valencia, Spain for Castile.
1094年11月：Alfonso the Brave lost Lisbon, Sintra and Santarém, Portugal to Almoravid conquests.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1095年3月16日：The pope Pope Urban II issued a bull forbidding the excommunication of Peter I or his queen Agnes of Aquitaine, Queen of Aragon and Navarre without his express authorization.
links: Peter I of Aragon and Pamplona
Agnes of Aquitaine, Queen of Aragon and Navarre

items.text: 1096年：Battle of Alcoraz: Peter I defeated the Zaragozan forces sent to relieve his siege of Huesca.
links: Peter I of Aragon and Pamplona

items.text: 1096年11月27日：Peter I conquered Huesca.
links: Peter I of Aragon and Pamplona

items.text: 1097年：Battle of Bairén: An Aragonese army pinned between Almoravid forces and the Mediterranean Sea routed their enemies near modern Gandia.
1097年8月15日：Battle of Consuegra: An Almoravid force defeated one of Alfonso the Brave's armies near Consuegra.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1097年8月16日：Peter I married Bertha of Aragon in Huesca, marking the transfer of the Aragonese capital from Jaca.
links: Peter I of Aragon and Pamplona

items.text: 1102年：Alfonso the Brave ordered Valencia evacuated and burned in the face of an Almoravid threat.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1104年：Alfonso the Brave conquered the Almoravid city of Medinaceli.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1104年：Peter I died. He was succeeded as king of Aragon and Navarre by his brother Alfonso I the Battler of Aragon.
links: Peter I of Aragon and Pamplona

items.text: 1105年：Alfonso the Battler conquered the Almoravid cities of Ejea de los Caballeros and Tauste.
1107年：Alfonso the Battler conquered Tamarite de Litera and San Esteban de Litera from the Almoravid dynasty.

1108年5月29日：Battle of Uclés (1108): The Almoravids dealt a decisive defeat to the forces of Alfonso the Brave at Uclés, reconquering the city as well as Cuenca, Spain, Huete and Ocaña, Spain. Alfonso the Brave's son and heir Sancho Alfónsez was killed in flight by local Muslims.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1109年7月1日：Alfonso the Brave died in Toledo, Spain. His daughter Urraca the Restless of León succeeded him as queen regnant of León and Castile.
links: Alfonso VI of León and Castile

items.text: 1109年10月：Urraca the Restless married Alfonso the Battler.

1111年10月26日：Battle of Candespina: Alfonso the Battler, joined by Henry, Count of Portugal, the count of Portugal, defeated forces loyal to the former's wife Urraca the Restless at Fresno de Cantespino.

1111年：Battle of Viadangos: The noble Pedro Fróilaz de Traba and Diego Gelmírez, archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Santiago de Compostela, marching in support of Urraca the Restless, were routed at Villadangos del Páramo by a superior force led by Alfonso the Battler.
links: Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Santiago de Compostela

items.text: 1112年：The pope Pope Paschal II annulled the marriage of Urraca the Restless to Alfonso the Battler. The two agreed to a truce.
1117年：Alfonso the Battler conquered the Almoravid cities of Fitero, Belchite, Corella, Spain, Cintruénigo, Murchante, Monteagudo, Navarre, and Cascante.
1118年：Alfonso the Battler, joined by French soldiers following the declaration of a crusade, conquered the Almoravid cities of Almudévar, Gurrea de Gállego and Zuera and laid siege to Zaragoza.
1118年12月18日：Alfonso the Battler conquered Zaragoza.

1119年：Alfonso the Battler conquered Cervera, Tudejen, Castellón, Tarazona, Ágreda, Magallón, Borja, Zaragoza, Alagón, Zaragoza, Novillas, Mallén, Rueda, Valladolid and Épila from the Almoravid dynasty.
1120年：Battle of Cutanda: Alfonso the Battler defeated forces of the Almoravid dynasty at Cutanda near Calamocha, conquering that town as well as Calatayud and Daroca for Aragon.
1120年：Alfonso the Battler conquered the Almoravid cities of Calatayud, Bubierca, Alhama de Aragón, Ariza, Zaragoza and Daroca.
1122年：Alfonso the Battler established the Confraternity of Belchite, a military order at Belchite devoted to war with Muslims.
1123年：Alfonso the Battler conquered the Barcelonan city of Lleida.

1126年3月8日：Urraca the Restless died in childbirth at Saldaña de Burgos. Alfonso VII the Emperor of León and Castile, her son by her first husband Raymond of Burgundy, succeeded her as king of Castile and León, though Alfonso the Battler remained in control of the former kingdom.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1127年：Alfonso the Battler conquered the Almoravid city of Longares.

1127年6月：Alfonso the Emperor and Alfonso the Battler signed the Peace of Támara at Támara de Campos. The treaty recognized Alfonso the Emperor's sovereignty over Castile and reestablished the 1054 border between Castile and Aragon. Alfonso the Battler renounced the title of emperor.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1129年4月6日：Afonso I the Conqueror of Portugal, the count of Portugal, took the title prince.

1130年10月：Siege of Bayonne: Alfonso the Battler laid siege to the Aquitainian city of Bayonne, probably with the intent of impressing Alfonso the Emperor's vassal Alfonso Jordan, the count of Toulouse.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1131年10月：Alfonso the Battler drafted a will leaving his kingdom to the Knights Templar, the Knights Hospitaller, and the Order of the Holy Sepulchre.
1131年10月：Siege of Bayonne: Alfonso the Battler withdrew after failing to conquer Bayonne.
1133年：Alfonso the Battler conquered the Almoravid city of Mequinenza.
1134年7月17日：Battle of Fraga: The Almoravids broke an Aragonese siege of Fraga. Alfonso the Battler was wounded.
1134年9月7日：Alfonso the Battler died of wounds suffered at the Battle of Fraga.
1134年：The Navarrese nobility elected García Ramírez of Navarre, a grandson of García Sánchez III's illegitimate son, king of Navarre.
1134年：The Aragonese nobility elected Ramiro II the Monk of Aragon king of Aragon.
1135年5月26日：Alfonso the Emperor took the title Imperator totius Hispaniae.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1137年8月11日：Ramiro the Monk's daughter Petronilla of Aragon was betrothed to Ramon Berenguer IV the Saint, Count of Barcelona, the count of Barcelona. Under the terms of the contract, Petronilla was appointed Ramiro the Monk's heir, and in the event of her childless death, Ramon Berenguer the Saint was to inherit all her territories.
links: Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Barcelona

items.text: 1137年11月13日：Ramiro the Monk retired to the monastery, retaining the royal title but granting Ramon Berenguer the Saint royal authority under the title prince of the Aragonese people.
links: Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Barcelona

items.text: 1138年7月：Siege of Coria (1138): Alfonso the Emperor failed to take the Almoravid city of Coria, Caceres. His commanding general Rodrigo Martínez was killed in the assault.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1139年4月：Siege of Oreja: Alfonso the Emperor laid siege to the Almoravid castle at Colmenar de Oreja.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1139年7月25日：Battle of Ourique: Afonso defeated an Almoravid force deep inside Almoravid territory at Ourique. His soldiers proclaimed him king of Portugal.
1139年10月：Siege of Oreja: The Almoravid garrison surrendered.
1141年：Battle of Valdevez: Afonso invaded Galicia. Alfonso the Emperor met him at Arcos de Valdevez and was defeated.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1142年5月：Siege of Coria (1142): Alfonso the Emperor laid siege to the Almoravid city of Coria, Caceres.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1142年6月：Siege of Coria (1142): The Almoravid garrison surrendered.
1143年10月5日：Afonso and Alfonso the Emperor signed the Treaty of Zamora in Zamora, Spain, under which the latter recognized the independence of Portugal and pledged peace between Portugal and León.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1147年10月：Second Crusade: Alfonso the Emperor, Ramon Berenguer the Saint and García Ramírez, with the support of the Genoese and Pisan navies, conquered the Almoravid port city of Almería. One-third of the city was granted to Genoa, the rest to Castile.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile
Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Barcelona

items.text: 1151年：Alfonso the Emperor and Ramon Berenguer the Saint signed the Treaty of Tudilén, recognizing recent Aragonese conquests as well as any further conquests in the Taifa of Murcia.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile
Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Barcelona

items.text: 1157年：The Almohad Caliphate conquered Almería.
1157年8月16日：Ramiro the Monk died. Petronilla succeeded him as queen regnant of Aragon.
1157年8月21日：Alfonso the Emperor died. His kingdom was divided between his two sons. The elder, Sancho III the Desired of Castile, received Castile; the younger, Ferdinand II of León, received León.
links: Alfonso VII of León and Castile

items.text: 1158年8月31日：Sancho the Desired died. He was succeeded as king of Castile by his young son Alfonso VIII the Noble of Castile. A number of Castilian nobles began to vie for the regency.
1162年8月6日：Ramon Berenguer the Saint died. He was succeeded as count of Barcelona by his young son Alfonso II the Chaste, the Troubadour of Aragon.
links: Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Barcelona

items.text: 1164年7月18日：Petronilla abdicated the throne of Aragon in favor of her young son Alfonso the Chaste.
1166年：Alfonso the Chaste conquered the county of Provence.
1168年：Alfonso the Chaste conquered Cerdanya.

1168年12月19日：Alfonso the Chaste and Sancho VI the Wise of Navarre, king of Navarre, signed the Treaty of Sangüesa providing for a twenty-year truce between their countries and agreeing to a division of the Taifa of Murcia.
1171年：Alfonso the Chaste conquered Teruel and Caspe.
1172年：Girard II of Roussillon, count of Roussillon, died without heirs. The nobles of his county elected Alfonso the Chaste to succeed him.
1173年：Alfonso the Chaste gifted Provence to his brother Ramon Berenguer III, Count of Provence.
links: Ramon Berenguer III, Count of Provence

items.text: 1174年：Alfonso the Noble ceded Uclés to the Order of Santiago.
1177年9月21日：Castile conquered Cuenca, Spain.
1179年：Alfonso the Noble and Alfonso the Chaste signed the Treaty of Cazola, setting out their respective zones of conquest in Andalusia. Aragon ceded the right to Murcia.
1188年：Alfonso the Noble recognized Alfonso IX of León as king of León. In exchange, Alfonso IX recognized the supremacy of Castile over León.

1195年7月18日：Battle of Alarcos: The Almohad Caliphate decisively defeated a Castilian force in what is now the province of Ciudad Real, forcing the latter's retreat to Toledo, Spain and cession of Trujillo, Cáceres, Montánchez and Talavera de la Reina.
1196年4月25日：Alfonso the Chaste died. He was succeeded as king by his son Peter II the Catholic of Aragon.
1209年：Albigensian Crusade: The pope Pope Innocent III called for a crusade to exterminate Catharism in Languedoc.

1212年：Alfonso the Noble, Peter the Catholic, Sancho VII the Strong, the Prudent of Navarre, king of Navarre, and the papal legate Arnaud Amalric, at the head of an army of Franks, conquered the Almohad cities of Calatrava la Vieja, Alarcos and Benavente, Zamora.

1212年7月16日：Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa: A coalition of Castilian, Aragonese, Portuguese and Navarrese forces, joined by the Order of Santiago, the Order of Calatrava, the Knights Templar and French and Leonese volunteers, decisively defeated an Almohad army in what is now the Province of Jaén. The caliph Muhammad al-Nasir was forced into flight.
links: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa

items.text: 1213年9月12日：Battle of Muret: Peter the Catholic was killed in battle at Muret in an attempt to reinstall his vassal Raymond VI, Count of Toulouse, count of County of Toulouse. His army was routed. Peter the Catholic was succeeded by his young son James I the Conqueror of Aragon.
1214年10月5日：Alfonso the Noble died. He was succeeded by his young son Henry I of Castile, whose elder sister Berengaria of Castile ruled as regent.
1217年6月6日：Henry I was killed by a tile falling off a roof. Berengaria succeeded him as queen regnant of Castile.
1217年8月31日：Berengaria resigned in favor of her son Ferdinand III the Saint of Castile.
1224年：The Almohad caliph Yusuf II, Almohad caliph was gored to death while playing with his pet cows, leaving no heir.
1224年：The Almohad governor of Andalusia took the majority of his forces across the Strait of Gibraltar to contest the succession to the caliphate.
1224年：An Abdallah al-Bayyasi established the Taifa of Baeza with himself at its head and appealed to Ferdinand the Saint to help him conquer Andalusia.
1225年：Siege of Jaén (1225): Castile and Baeza failed to take the city of Jaén, Spain.
1225年：Ferdinand the Saint established al-Bayyasi at Córdoba, Spain in exchange for Baños de la Encina, Capilla, Badajoz and Salvatierra Castle.
1226年11月：Al-Bayyasi was killed in Córdoba, Spain in a popular uprising. Castile annexed some of his territory including Baeza.
1229年9月5日：Conquest of Majorca: James the Conqueror led a fleet of some two hundred vessels and twenty thousand men from Salou, Cambrils and Tarragona to Majorca.
1229年9月12日：Battle of Portopí: Aragonese forces defeated an Almohad force in the Serra de Na Burguesa, forcing the latter to retreat to Palma, Majorca.
1229年12月31日：Conquest of Majorca: James the Conqueror took the last redoubt of the Almohad forces at Palma, Majorca and captured the vali Abu Yahya.
links: Abu Yahya Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abi Imran al-Tinmalali

items.text: 1230年：James the Conqueror issued the Llibre del Repartiment (Majorca), granting territory in Majorca according to participation in its conquest. Half became crown lands; the rest was divided primarily between Catalan and Marseillais knights and the Knights Templar.
1230年6月24日：Siege of Jaén (1230): Ferdinand the Saint laid siege to Jaén, Spain.
1230年9月24日：Alfonso IX died. He was succeeded as king of León by his son Ferdinand the Saint.
1230年9月：Siege of Jaén (1230): On hearing of the death of Alfonso IX, Ferdinand the Saint abandoned his siege of Jaén, Spain to be crowned king of León in León, Spain.
1231年：Ferdinand the Saint conquered Cazorla.
1231年：Battle of Jerez: A Castilian army defeated an army of the emir Ibn Hud near modern Jerez de la Frontera, deep in the latter's territory.
1232年：James the Conqueror conquered Menorca.
1233年：Ferdinand the Saint conquered Úbeda.
1233年5月：Siege of Burriana: James the Conqueror laid siege to Borriana, Castellón.
1233年7月：Siege of Burriana: The city fell.
1235年：James the Conqueror conquered Ibiza.
1236年2月7日：Siege of Córdoba (1236): Ferdinand the Saint arrived in Córdoba, Spain following its fall at the hands of local knights and internal fifth columnists.
1237年8月15日：Battle of the Puig: The Valencian king Zayyan ibn Mardanish met an Aragonese invasion force at El Puig, where he was decisively defeated.
1238年：Ferdinand the Saint conquered Huelva and obtained the vassalage of Niebla, Andalusia.
1238年9月28日：James the Conqueror captured Valencia and created himself king of the Kingdom of Valencia.
1240年：Ferdinand the Saint conquered Écija and Lucena, Córdoba.
1243年：Ferdinand the Saint captured Orihuela and obtained the vassalage of Murcia.
1244年3月26日：James the Conqueror signed the Treaty of Almizra, establishing Valencia's border with Castile.
1244年：Ferdinand the Saint conquered Arjona, Spain, Mula, Spain and Lorca, Spain.
1245年：Ferdinand the Saint conquered Cartagena, Spain.
1245年：Siege of Jaén (1245–46): Ferdinand the Saint, joined by the Order of Santiago, laid siege to Jaén, Spain.
1246年2月28日：Siege of Jaén (1245–46): Muhammad I of Granada, king of Granada, surrendered the city to Castile and agreed to tributary relationship. He was created king of the Kingdom of Jaén.
1247年7月：Siege of Seville: Ferdinand the Saint laid siege to Seville.
1248年：Ferdinand the Saint obtained the vassalage of Alicante.

1248年11月23日：Siege of Seville: Seville, the last Muslim polity on the Iberian Peninsula apart from the Emirate of Granada, surrendered to Castile, promising that the city would be turned over no later than the following month. Ferdinand the Saint created himself king of the Kingdom of Seville.
1252年5月30日：Ferdinand the Saint died. He was succeeded by his son Alfonso X the Wise of Castile.
1253年：Alfonso the Wise captured the Algarve from Portugal.
1253年：Alfonso the Wise gave his daughter Beatrice of Castile to the Portuguese king Afonso III of Portugal, and promised to cede the Algarve to their firstborn son on his seventh birthday.
1256年1月28日：King of the Romans William II of Holland was killed in battle with the Frisians near Hoogwoud.
1257年1月15日：Imperial election, January 1257: Richard, 1st Earl of Cornwall, count of Poitou and earl of Cornwall, was elected King of the Romans.
1257年4月1日：Imperial election, April 1257: Alfonso the Wise, who claimed the title through descent from his grandfather Philip of Swabia, was elected King of the Romans.
1257年：Alfonso the Wise debased the Castilian coinage and introduced a tariff to raise money for a campaign in support of his claim to the rule of the Holy Roman Empire, against that of Richard.
1261年：Siege of Jerez (1261): Castile and Granada laid siege to Jerez de la Frontera.
1261年：Siege of Jerez (1261): The citizens of Jerez de la Frontera agreed to resume tribute payments to Castile.
1262年：James the Conqueror created the Kingdom of Majorca in his will.
1262年：Niebla, Andalusia was incorporated into Castile.
1264年：Mudéjar revolt of 1264–1266: The Muslim subjects of Castile, encouraged by Muhammad I, rebelled in Andalusia and Murcia.
1264年8月8日：Mudéjar revolt of 1264–1266: Nuño González de Lara, head of the Castilian garrison at Jerez de la Frontera, fled his post. The Alcázar of Jerez de la Frontera was taken.
links: Alcázar of Jerez de la Frontera

items.text: 1264年10月9日：Mudéjar revolt of 1264–1266: Castilian forces retook Jerez de la Frontera.
1265年8月28日：The Siete Partidas, a code of law, was completed in Castile.
1265年10月：Conquest of Murcia (1265–66): James the Conqueror entered Muslim-held territory in support of the Castilian suppression of the Mudéjar revolt.
1266年1月2日：Conquest of Murcia (1265–66): James the Conqueror laid siege to Murcia.
1266年1月31日：Conquest of Murcia (1265–66): Murcia surrendered.
1266年2月26日：Battle of Benevento: Manfred, King of Sicily, the king of Sicily, was killed during the conquest of the kingdom by Charles I of Anjou, count of Anjou.
1266年：Alicante was incorporated into Castile.

1267年2月16日：Alfonso the Wise and Afonso III signed the Treaty of Badajoz, a pact of friendship and mutual assistance. The treaty established the border between Castile and Portugal to the latter's disadvantage.
1272年：The Castilian nobility rebelled against Alfonso the Wise following his mismanagement of the economy.
1275年：Battle of Écija (1275): Granadan forces routed a Castilian army moving through their territory to meet a Marinid advance.

1276年7月27日：James the Conqueror died. He was succeeded as king of Aragon and Valencia and count of Barcelona by one son, Peter III the Great of Aragon, and as king of Majorca by another, James II of Majorca.
1278年7月：Siege of Algeciras (1278–79): Castile laid siege to the Marinid port city of Algeciras.
1278年7月25日：Battle of Algeciras (1278): A combined Marinid-Granadan fleet destroyed the Castilian navy in the Strait of Gibraltar.
1279年：James II agreed by treaty to become a vassal of Aragon.
1279年8月5日：Siege of Algeciras (1278–79): A Marinid force destroyed the Castilian navy in port in the Bay of Gibraltar and captured and executed the soldiers besieging the city.
1280年6月23日：Battle of Moclín (1280): A force consisting of Castilian soldiers and most of the Order of Santiago was wiped out by a Granadan army at Moclín while returning from a raid.
1282年：Alfonso the Wise, facing military pressure from his nobility, was forced to accept his son Sancho IV the Brave of Castile as his heir.
1282年3月30日：Sicilian Vespers: A number of French officers were killed by locals in rioting near Palermo.

1282年：War of the Sicilian Vespers: Sicilian rebels appealed to Peter the Great to overthrow Charles of Anjou's administration and rule by right of his wife Constance of Sicily, Queen of Aragon, Manfred's daughter.
links: Constance of Sicily, Queen of Aragon

items.text: 1283年7月8日：Battle of Malta: An Aragonese fleet surprised and sank a Neapolitan fleet in the Grand Harbour, delaying the latter's planned invasion of Sicily.
1284年2月2日：Aragonese Crusade: The pope Pope Martin IV called for a crusade against Peter the Great, and declared him deposed in Aragon in favor of Charles, Count of Valois, the count of Valois.
1284年4月4日：Alfonso the Wise died. He was succeeded by Sancho the Brave, though his will appointed his grandson Alfonso de la Cerda his successor in León.
1284年6月5日：Battle of the Gulf of Naples: The Aragonese and Sicilian navies drew out a Neapolitan fleet in the Gulf of Naples and captured Charles of Anjou as well as some ten galleys.
links: Battle of the Gulf of Naples

items.text: 1285年9月4日：Battle of Les Formigues: A Sicilian-Aragonese fleet decisively defeated the French and Genoans, probably near the Formigues Islands.
1285年9月30日：Battle of the Col de Panissars: An Aragonese force massacred the French army during its retreat over the Pyrenees.
links: Battle of the Col de Panissars

items.text: 1285年11月11日：Peter the Great died at Vilafranca del Penedès. He was succeeded as king of Aragon by his eldest son Alfonso III the Liberal, the Free of Aragon and as king of Sicily by his second son James II the Just of Aragon.
1285年：Alfonso the Liberal conquered Mallorca.
1286年：Alfonso the Liberal conquered Ibiza.
1287年1月17日：Alfonso the Liberal conquered Menorca and annexed it to the Kingdom of Majorca, dissolving its autonomous government.
1287年6月23日：Battle of the Counts: A Sicilian-Aragonese fleet defeated a superior Angevin force at Naples, breaking the latter's attempted invasion of Sicily.

1287年12月20日：The Union of Aragon, a political organization of nobles and townspeople in Aragon, won the Privilege of the Union, a devolution of many royal powers to the Aragonese nobility, from Alfonso the Liberal.
1288年：Alfonso the Liberal released Alfonso de la Cerda from captivity in the fortress at Xàtiva and declared him king of Castile and León.

1291年2月19日：Aragonese Crusade: The pope Pope Nicholas IV, Philip IV the Fair, the Iron King of France, king of France, Charles II the Lame of Naples, king of Naples, and Alfonso the Liberal signed the Treaty of Tarascon, ending the crusade. Alfonso the Liberal agreed to remove all Aragonese troops from Sicily. In return, the pope recognized him as king of Aragon and lifted his excommunication.
1291年6月18日：Alfonso the Liberal died. He was succeeded by James the Just.
1295年：Battle of Iznalloz: The Emirate of Granada expelled a Castillian garrison and the Order of Calatrava from their fortress overlooking the border at Iznalloz.

1295年4月25日：Sancho the Brave died of tuberculosis in Toledo, Spain. He was succeeded by his young son Ferdinand IV the Summoned of Castile as king of Castile and León, with his wife María de Molina acting as regent.

1295年6月20日：The pope Pope Boniface VIII, James the Just, Philip the Fair, Charles the Lame and James II of Majorca signed the Treaty of Anagni. Under the treaty, James the Just granted Sicily to the pope, who in turn gifted it to Charles the Lame, and agreed to aid the latter in its reconquest.
1295年：War of the Sicilian Vespers: The people of Sicily rejected the Treaty of Anagni and acclaimed James the Just's younger brother Frederick III of Sicily their king.
1296年4月：Aragonese troops invaded Castile in support of Alfonso de la Cerda's claim to the throne.
1296年：John of Castile, Lord of Valencia de Campos, a son of Alfonso the Wise, was crowned king of León, Seville and Galicia in León, Spain.
links: John of Castile, Lord of Valencia de Campos

items.text: 1296年：Alfonso de la Cerda was crowned king of Castile, Toledo, Córdoba, Murcia and Jaén at Sahagún.

1297年9月13日：María de Molina and Denis of Portugal, king of Portugal signed the Treaty of Alcañices. Denis agreed to support Ferdinand the Summoned against the rebels Alfonso de la Cerda and John of Castile and to give him the hand of his daughter Constance of Portugal in marriage. In exchange, he received some Castilian territory along the Portuguese border.
links: John of Castile, Lord of Valencia de Campos

items.text: 1299年7月4日：Battle of Cape Orlando: An Aragonese-Angevin fleet defeated the Sicilian navy near Sicily.

1299年12月1日：Battle of Falconaria: A Sicilian fleet decisively defeated the Neapolitan navy off the shore between Marsala and Trapani and captured its commander, Charles the Lame's son Philip I, Prince of Taranto.
1300年6月14日：Battle of Ponza (1300): An Aragonese-Angevin fleet defeated a Sicilian one near Ponza.
1300年6月26日：John of Castile renounced his royal titles and declared his fealty to Ferdinand the Summoned.
links: John of Castile, Lord of Valencia de Campos

items.text: 1331年：In the city of Alicante, Moorish forces attempted a siege.
1339年：The Treaty of Madrid was signed in Madrid.
1366年：A civil war was started against Enrique de Trastamara, son of Alfonso XI.
1469年10月19日：Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon were married, laying the foundation for the unification of the kingdoms of Castile and Aragon into Spain.
1474年12月10日：The reign of Isabella began.
1475年：The War of the Castilian Succession began. Vasco Nunez de Balboa was born.
1478年：The Spanish Inquisition was founded.
1479年：War of the Castilian Succession: The war ended.
1479年1月20日：The reign of Ferdinand began, marking the foundation of the Kingdom of Spain.
1479年9月4日：By the Treaty of Alcáçovas, Portugal recognized Spanish control of the Canary Islands.
1492年10月12日：Spanish conquerors discover (encounter) America
1492年：The Reconquista ended.
1492年：Jews were expelled from Spain by the Alhambra Decree.
1492年8月3日：Columbus sets sail.
1493年：Spanish colonization of the Americas began.
1494年：The Treaty of Tordesillas was signed.
1499年：Italian War of 1499–1504: Ferdinand allied with the French King Louis XII of France.
1501年4月：The Rebellion of the Alpujarras (1499–1501), a series of uprisings by the Muslim population of the Kingdom of Granada against their Catholic rulers was defeated.
1504年：Isabella I of Castile died. Her daughter, Joanna of Castile succeeded her with her father, Ferdinand as regent
1506年：Christopher Columbus died at the age of 51 from an illness.
1512年：Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre began.
1516年：Ferdinand died.
1516年：Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor, became King of Castile and Aragon.
1519年：Vasco Nunez de Balboa died.
1535年3月8日：New Spain began till 1821.
1554年7月25日：English Queen Mary I of England married Spanish Prince Philip.
1556年：Charles abdicated in favor of Philip, who became King Philip II of Spain.
1557年：Battle of St. Quentin (1557): Spain won the battle.
1561年：Philip moved his court to Madrid.
1568年：Dutch Revolt: A revolt began against Habsburg control of the Netherlands. This started the Eighty Years' War
1571年10月7日：Battle of Lepanto (1571): The Holy League was victorious.
1578年：Dutch Revolt: The revolt ended.
1580年8月25日：The Iberian Union of the crowns of Aragon, Castile and Portugal was established.
1581年7月26日：Dutch Republic, the Republic of the Seven United Netherlands, declared their independence against Spanish rule.
1585年：Anglo–Spanish War (1585): The war began. It was an intermittent conflict
1588年8月8日：The Spanish Armada was defeated in the English Channel.
1589年：The English Armada (known as the Counter Armada) was defeated.
1598年9月13日：Philip II died in El Escorial, near Madrid, of cancer. He was succeeded by his 20-year-old son, Philip III.
1604年：Anglo-Spanish War (1585): The war ends with the treaty of London, which is beneficial to both the Spanish and the English side.
1605年：The Treaty of London (1604) was signed concluding the nineteen-year Anglo-Spanish War on peace terms.
1609年4月9日：The Expulsion of the Moriscos was decreed. The Moriscos were descendants of Spain's Muslim population that had converted to Christianity in the early 16th century.
1618年：Thirty Years' War: The war, one of the most destructive conflicts in human history, began.
1621年：Philip IV of Spain was crowned.
1640年：Portuguese Restoration War: The war began.
1640年：The Iberian Union was dissolved.

1648年：The Treaty of Westphalia was signed. Habsburg supremacy was curtailed. Recognition of the independence of the Dutch Republic by the Spanish Empire. Recognition of Spanish sovereignty of Southern Netherlands and Luxembourg by the Dutch Republic.
1659年：The Peace of the Pyrenees was signed to end the 1635–1659 war between France and Spain. Spain lost French Flanders and northern part of the Principality of Catalonia.
1665年：Philip IV died. The Spanish Empire had reached approximately 12.2 million square kilometers (4.7 million square miles) in area
1668年：The Treaty of Lisbon was signed. Spain recognized the sovereignty of Portugal's new ruling dynasty, the House of Braganza.
1675年：Charles II of Spain, the last Habsburg ruler of the Spanish Empire, was crowned.
1700年11月1日：Charles II died childless .
1700年：House of Bourbon began with Philip V.
1701年：War of the Spanish Succession: The war began.
1707年6月29日：Nueva Planta decrees: Kingdom of Spain as an absolute monarchy and a centralized state, abolishing the political differences of the two crowns (Crown of Castile, Crown of Aragon).
1713年：Peace of Utrecht till 1715. The Kingdom of Spain lost Spanish Netherlands, Spanish viceroyalty of Naples and Sicily, Duchy of Milan, Menorca and Gibraltar.
1717年5月27日：Viceroyalty of New Granada began.
1761年：Seven Years' War: Spain declared war on Great Britain.
1763年2月10日：Treaty of Paris. Spain recovers Florida and obtains Louisiana till 1801.
1778年：American Revolutionary War: Spain supported the United States.
1789年：Spain during this time opened up the slave trade to Havana.
1790年：Spanish base in Nootka Sound. Maximum extension of the Spanish Empire.
links: Spanish expeditions to the Pacific Northwest

items.text: 1801年：Louisiana given to France
1806年：British invasions of the Río de la Plata: The invasions began.
links: British invasions of the Río de la Plata

items.text: 1807年：British invasions of the Río de la Plata: The invasions ended.
1808年：Peninsular War: The war began.
1808年5月2日：Dos de Mayo Uprising: An uprising took place in Madrid against the French occupation of the city.
1809年：Bolivian Independence War: The war began.
1811年：Venezuelan War of Independence: The war began.
1812年：The Spanish Constitution of 1812 was issued.
1814年：Peninsular War: The war ended.
1815年：Spanish reconquest of New Granada: The reconquest began.
1816年：Spanish reconquest of New Granada: The reconquest ended.
1820年：Trienio Liberal: The period began.
1823年：Trienio Liberal: The period ended.
1824年：Bolivian Independence War: The war ended.
1833年：First Carlist War: The war began.
1839年：First Carlist War: The war ended.
1846年：Second Carlist War: The war began.
1849年：Second Carlist War: The war ended.
1864年：Chincha Islands War: The war began.
1866年：Chincha Islands War: The war ended.
1868年：Ten Years' War: A war with Cuba began.
1872年：Third Carlist War: The war began.
1873年：The First Spanish Republic was established.
1874年：Spain under the Restoration: The period began.
1874年：The First Spanish Republic was disestablished.
1876年：Third Carlist War: The war ended.
1878年：Ten Years' War: The war ended.
1879年：Pablo Iglesias founds the Partido Socialista Obrero Español or PSOE in Casa Labra, a bar from Madrid
1898年4月25日：Spanish–American War: The war began.
1898年8月12日：Spanish–American War: The war ended.
1912年11月27日：Spanish protectorate in Morocco till 1956.
1914年7月28日：Spain remained neutral throughout World War I.
1920年：Rif War: The war began.
1923年9月13日：Dictatorship of Primo de Rivera till 1930.
1927年7月10日：Rif War: The war ended.
1931年12月9日：The Second Spanish Republic was established.
1931年：Spain under the Restoration: The period ended.
1936年：Spanish Civil War (to 1939)
1939年：Francoist Spain: The period began. Spain stays neutral through World War II
1953年：Spain and the United States signs the Pact of Madrid.
1955年：Spain joins the United Nations.
1959年：Spanish miracle: A period of economic growth began.
1973年：Spanish miracle: The period ended.
1975年：History of Spain (1975–present)
1975年11月6日：The Green March forced Spain to hand over its last remaining colonial possession, Spanish Sahara, to Morocco.
1975年11月20日：Francisco Franco died; the monarchy was restored to Juan Carlos I.
1976年11月18日：Spanish transition to democracy: The transition began.
1977年6月15日：First democratic election since 1934.
1978年12月27日：The Spanish Constitution of 1978 was signed by the King.
1981年：Spanish society after the democratic transition: A democratic society was established.
links: Spanish society after the democratic transition

items.text: 1981年2月23日：1981 Spanish coup attempt: An attempted coup took place.
1982年：Spain joins NATO.
1986年：Spain joined the European Union.
1992年：1992 Summer Olympics: The Summer Olympics were held in Barcelona.
1997年7月：Spain hosts the 1997 Madrid summit.
1998年：Judge Baltasar Garzón issued an international arrest warrant for former Chilean dictator Augusto Pinochet.
1999年1月1日：Spain joins Economic and Monetary Union of the European Union. Euro is a real currency, and a single monetary policy is introduced under the authority of the ECB.
links: Economic and Monetary Union of the European Union

items.text: 2003年8月22日：Fernando Alonso wins the Hungarian Grand Prix, marking him F1's youngest winner.
2004年3月11日：2004 Madrid train bombings: Madrid train bombings killed one hundred and ninety-one and injured over two thousand. Prime Minister José María Aznar blamed the Basque terrorists ETA.
2004年3月14日：Aznar's People's Party lost an election after the Partido Social-Obrero Español of José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero promised to withdraw Spanish troops from Iraq.
2005年：PADICAT (archive) established.
2005年9月25日：Fernando Alonso wins the Championship against Kimi Räikkönen in Brazil, marking him F1's youngest world champion.
2006年12月30日：2006 Madrid–Barajas Airport bombing: A bombing by ETA ended an active ceasefire and peace negotiations.
2008年：Moroccan national Jamal Zougam was found guilty of the 2004 train bombings in Madrid.
2008年：Garzón was charged with criminal conduct in three cases, causing an international scandal and protests.
2008年：Spain won the UEFA European Championship Final, establishing the team as an international soccer power house.
2010年7月：Spain won the FIFA World Cup.
2010年：Garzón was granted leave to work as a consultant to the International Criminal Court at The Hague.
2015年：Artur Mas defies Spain by calling early elections on independence of the region of Catalonia.
2017年：2017 Barcelona attacks: Barcelona, Cambrils, Alcanar and Subirats were attacked by terrorists from Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL).

2017年10月1日：2017 Catalan independence referendum: An unconstitutional referendum of independence were called by Generalitat de Catalunya, as Parliament of Catalonia approved the Law on the Referendum of Self-determination of Catalonia. In early September the High Court of Justice of Catalonia had issued orders to the police to try to prevent it, including the detention of various persons responsible for its preparation.

2017年10月27日：Catalan declaration of independence: Catalan unilateral declaration of independence was ratified by Parliament of Catalonia as the results of the referendum were in favor. Spain considers this action illegal and article 155 of the constitution was applied.
2017年10月29日：Carles Puigdemont flee from Spain to avoid being arrested after his dismissal by Spain, after proclaiming the independence of Catalonia.
2018年6月：Pedro Sánchez is sworn in as Prime Minister after winning a motion of censure.

2019年：Trial of Catalonia independence leaders: Takes place over several months, following the 2017 declaration of independence of Catalonia. Nine defendants sentenced to 9 to 13 years in prison on sedition and misuse of public funds charges; three other defendants fined for disobedience. This sparked subsequent protests by independence citizens.

2020年1月13日：Sánchez II Government: It become the first nationwide coalition government to be formed in Spain since the Second Spanish Republic. The parties were Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) and Unidas Podemos.

2020年1月31日：COVID-19 pandemic starts in Spain with the first confirmated case in La Gomera (Canary Islands). You can view the confirmed cases, recovered and deaths in this link: COVID-19 pandemic in Spain.
2022年6月28日：Spain hosts the 2022 Madrid Summit.
前218年－前201年：The Second Punic War would bring the Roman Republic's influence to Iberia. The Roman conquest of the Iberian Peninsula begins.
links: Roman conquest of the Iberian Peninsula

items.text: 前197年：The Iberian Peninsula is divided into Hispania Ulterior (which will include all of Portugal) and Hispania Citerior.
前155年：Resistance to the Roman conquest by the Lusitanians starts in the Lusitanian War.
前148年：Viriathus becomes the Lusitanian leader.

前140年：After being defeated by Fabius Maximus Caepius, Viriathus sends his most trusted friends Audax, Ditalcus and Minurus to negotiate peace terms with Caepio. They are bribed by Caepius to kill Viriathus and do. After the death of Viriathus, the Lusitanians attempt to raid Saguntum, but fail. On crossing the river Baetis on their return, they are defeated by Caepio and accept to become Rome's subjects. This marks the end of the Lusitanian War.
前80年－前72年：The Sertorian War takes place, with Quintus Sertorius, a Roman general, rebelling against Rome with the support of the Lusitanians.

前27年：The Roman Republic is over and the Roman Empire begins in the aftermath of the War of Actium, in which Augustus wins and becomes Emperor. He replaces the old Hispania Ulterior and Citerior division with a new one: Lusitania (Centre and South of modern Portugal and some territory of Modern Spain, namely the capital of Lusitania, Mérida), Hispania Baetica (only territories in Modern Spain, mostly around Seville), and everything else, including the North of Portugal, in Hispania Tarraconensis.

293年：Diocletian reorganises the provinces of Hispania, creating some new ones. Of interest, Gallaecia is split from the Tarraconensis province. Gallaecia includes the North of Portugal (starting with Portus Cale/Porto) and extending to the North of Spain (Galicia). Bracara Augusta (Braga) is the administrative centre of Conventus Bracarensis, one of the three conventus of Gallaecia.
357年：Potamius, the first recorded bishop of Lisbon, takes part in the Councils of Sirmium, in which he is recorded as having defended Arianism.

409年：In the context of the Migration Period, the Kingdom of the Suebi is established with King Hermeric, a believer of Germanic paganism, as its leader and Braga as its capital. The Kingdom includes Gallaecia and varying other parts of Portugal. Other groups that enter the Portuguese area are the Germanic Vandals, led by Gunderic, and the Iranic Alans, led by Respendial.
416年：In the first Gothic War in Spain (416–418), the Western Roman Empire commissions the Visigoths to take back Spain for the Roman Empire from the Suebi and Alans.

418年：The first Gothic War in Spain ends, with a win for the Visigoths and Rome, who take back a considerable portion of the Iberian Peninsula, with the Kingdom of Suebi being restricted to the North of Spain (Gallecia). Attaces, who had taken over leadership of the Alans from Respendial (date unknown), is killed in battle. The Alans appealed to Gunderic, King of the Vandals, who then became also king of the Alans.
409年－418年：Cindazunda, daughter of King Hermeric, marries Attaces, King of the Alans as part of a peace deal after a battle in Coimbra.
419年：Asterius, a Roman general, campaigns in Gallecia to suppress an uprising by Maximus and a war between Suebi against the Vandals and Alans.
428年：Following Gunderic's death, Gaiseric, his half-brother, becomes King of the Vandals and Alans.
429年：Gaiseric leads the Vandals and Alans out of Iberia and into North Africa. They would later conquer many islands in the Mediterranean Sea and go on to sack Rome but would not return to Iberia.
438年：Rechila, King of the Suebi, leads several campaigns against the Romans and Visigoths.
439年：Emerita Augusta, capital of Lusitania, is captured by Recila, ending its Roman rule.

456年：The second Gothic War in Spain (456) takes place between the Suebi (led by Rechila's son, Rechiar) and the Romans, Visigoths, Franks and Burgundians. Rechiar flees to Porto, where he is killed. The Battle of Órbigo culminates with the sacking of (Suebi) Braga and nearby cities.
約468年：Hydatius, bishop of Aquae Flaviae, finishes writing his Chronicon, a chronicle written in Latin which is our only contemporary source for the history of Hispania between 427 and 468.

506年2月2日：The Breviary of Alaric is published by the order of Alaric II, King of the Visigoths. This collection of Roman law applied, not to the Visigothic nobles who lived under their own law, but to the Hispano-Roman and Gallo-Roman population, living under Visigoth rule.
550年：Around this year, Martin of Braga, who played an important role in the conversion of the Suevi from Arianism to Chalcedonianism, settles in Gallecia.
552年：Emperor Justinian I, of the Byzantine Empire, establishes the province of Spania. In its greatest extent, Spania would include parts of modern-day Algarve.
561年：The First Council of Braga takes place, taking aim at Priscillianism, a Christian sect that had emerged in Spain.
585年：King Liuvigild of the Visigothic Kingdom (capital in Toletum), an Arian, conquers the Suevi Kingdom, thus controlling most of the Iberian Peninsula (and all of Portugal).
586年：King Liuvigild dies and is followed by his son, Reccared I.
587年：King Reccared I renounces Arianism for Chalcedonianism and suppresses several Arian revolts in his kingdom.
589年：In the Third Council of Toledo, the Visigothic Kingdom joins the Catholic Church. The bishops of Viseu and of Porto attend the council.
601年：King Reccared I dies and is succeeded by his son, Liuva II.

602年：Witteric, who had been involved as a conspirator in the Arian uprisings of 585, is given command to lead the Visigothic army against the Byzantine Empire. Instead, he has Liuva II executed and becomes King of the Visigoths.
610年4月：King Witteric is murdered by a faction of Catholic nobles. They proclaim Gundemar as King of the Visigoths.
612年：King Gundemar dies of natural causes. He is succeeded by Sisebut. He took back most of the province of Spania from Byzantine control, except for the Algarve and would persecute Jews.

621年2月：Upon the death of King Sisebut, his young son takes the throne as Reccared II. The length of the reign exactly is debated to last from several days to just over a year, Reccared II dies and Suintila, son of Reccared I, takes the throne.
624年：King Suintila takes back Algarve, ending the Byzantine presence in Iberia.

631年3月26日：A rebellion over confiscations of lands and distribution of privileges between the nobility and clergy results in King Suintila being deposed and Sisenand proclaiming himself King of the Visigoths.
632年：There was an attempted uprising within the kingdom, led by Iudila, but the revolution failed and Iudila was later killed.
633年：King Sisenand convened the IV Council of Toledo. The Council did not grant him hereditary rights.
636年3月12日：King Sisenand dies of natural causes, Chintila succeeds him.
636年6月30日：King Chintilla convenes the Fifth Council of Toledo in an attempt to bring political stability.
638年1月9日：King Chintilla convenes the Sixth Council of Toledo in a second attempt to create internal stability.
639年或641年：King Chintilla dies and is succeeded by his son Tulga.
642年：Chindasuinth, a veteran of the Liuvigild campaigns, is elected by the Visigothic nobles as the King of the Visigoths.
646年11月18日：King Chindasuinth convenes the Seventh Council of Toledo. Its main aim was to further harden the laws against treason.
649年1月20日：King Chindasuinth proclaims his son, Recceswinth, as co-king in yet another attempt to establish a hereditary monarchy in the Visigothic Kingdom.
653年12月16日：King Chindasuinth, and his co-king son, convene the Eighth Council of Toledo.
653年：King Chindasuinth dies, leaving his son Recceswinth as sole king.

654年：King Recceswinth published the Visigothic Code, which abolished the old tradition of having different laws for Romans (leges romanae) and Visigoths (leges barbarorum), and under it all the subjects of the Visigothic kingdom would stop being romani and gothi instead becoming hispani.
656年：King Recceswinth summons the Tenth Council of Toledo.
672年：King Recceswinth dies and is succeeded by Wamba. He would face a revolt from Hilderic of Nîmes that he would successfully deal with.
675年：The Third Council of Braga and the Eleventh Council of Toledo are held.
680年：Erwig succeeds Wamba as the King of the Visigoths.
681年1月9日：The Twelfth Council of Toledo is summoned by Erwig to legitimize his power. It also revised the Visigothic Code and oppressed Jews.
683年11月4日：The Thirteenth Council of Toledo is convened, pardoning the rebels against King Wamba and King Chintila.

684年11月14日：The Fourteenth Council of Toledo is convened, in response to a request by Pope Leo II to confirm the decisions of the ecumenical Third Council of Constantinople against monothelitism. The Council confirms the decisions of the Constantinople Council.
687年11月14日：King Erwig dies and appoints Egica, his son-in-law, as the successor King of the Visigoths.

688年：King Egica summons the Fifteenth Council of Toledo to reaffirm the XIV Council of Toledo and to release him from the duty to protect Erwig's children. The Council releases Egica from his oath to Erwig to protect his children, but do not revert the protection they had due to the XIII Council of Toledo, as King Egica had hoped.
693年：Sisebert, the metropolitan of Toledo, led a rebellion against Egica in favor of raising a man named Suniefred to the throne. The rebellion would fail.

693年4月25日：King Egica summons the Sixteenth Council of Toledo to punish the rebellion of the previous year. The council also altered the Visigothic code, including laws repressing Jews and homosexuality.
694年：King Egica appoints his son, Wittiza, as co-ruler.
約702年：King Egica dies, leaving his son Wittiza as sole ruler.

710年：Roderic, often known as the last king of the Visigoths (although officially that title belongs to Ardo), a grandson of Chindaswinth, usurps the throne. The Visigothic kingdom breaks into two factions, one (the provinces of Lusitania and western Carthaginiensis around the capital Toledo) in support of Roderic, the other in support of Achila II.

711年：The Umayyad conquest of Hispania begins with Tariq ibn Ziyad crossing the Strait of Gibraltar and entering the Visigothic Kingdom. King Roderic of the Visigoths dies in the Battle of Guadalete. By 716, most of the Iberian Peninsula is under Islamic rule.

714年：Abd al-Aziz ibn Musa becomes Governor of al-Andalus, with al-Andalus constituting a single province within the Umayyad Caliphate. Al-Andalus was formally a province subordinate to the Umayyad governor of Kairouan in Ifriqiya, rather than directly dependent on the Umayyad Caliph in Damascus, with Kairouan appointing most of the governors of al-Andalus.
718年或722年：Following the Battle of Covadonga, the Visigothic nobleman Pelagius of Asturias founds the Kingdom of Asturias. He begins the Astur-Leonese dynasty.
737年：Pelagius dies and Favila of Asturias, his only son, becomes King of the Asturias.
739年：Favila is killed by a bear in a hunt and is succeeded by his brother-in-law, Alfonso I of Asturias, who had married Pelagius' daughter Ermesinda.

740年：Alfonso I of Asturias conquers Galicia, taking advantage of the Berber Revolt. The Berber revolt started in Tanger, led by Maysara al-Matghari, over unequal taxation treatment of Berber converts to Islam.
741年10月：The Berber Revolt expands into Iberia, with a mutiny by Berber garrisons on the Douro who form a rebel army and march South. This allowed Alfonso I to expand his kingdom southward.

743年：The Berber revolt ends, with a limited victory for the Berber who establish independent Berber polities in the western and central Maghreb. They had failed to take Iberia, but managed to cut if off from the rest of the Umayyad caliphate. Syrian troops who helped fight against the rebels remain in Iberia.
750年：Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri, who had been appointed governor of al-Andalus in 747, rules independently, given the collapse of the Umayyad rule following the Abbasid revolution.
755年9月：A Umayyad prince, Abd al-Rahman I, escapes to al-Andalus in the aftermath of the Abbasid revolution.
756年3月：Abd al-Rahman I defeats Yusuf ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Fihri in the Battle of Alameda.
756年5月14日：Abd al-Rahman I proclaims the Emirate of Córdoba with himself as the Emir.
757年：After the death of Alfonso I of Asturias, Fruela I of Asturias, his older son, ascends to the throne. He would suppress uprisings in Galicia, laying waste to the Galician country.

762年：The Abbasid, who now control Damascus, appoint Al-Ala ibn Mughith al-Judhami as governor of al-Andalus. He would set his government in Beja, but would be unsuccessful in gaining control of al-Andalus, being killed in battle by the forces of Abd al-Rahman I.
768年1月14日：Fruela I is assassinated by his own men, as a result of their discontentment over the fact he killed his own brother Vimarano, and is succeeded by his cousin, Aurelius of Asturias.
774年：Aurelius dies of natural causes and is succeeded by his cousin-in-law, Silo of Asturias, the husband of Alfonso I's daughter Adosinda. Silo would stamp down a second rebel revolt in Galicia.

777年：The Abbasid appoint a second governor, Abd al-Rahman ibn Habib al-Siqlabi, to dispute control of al-Andalus against Abd al-Rahman I. Ibn Ḥabīb was also unsuccessful and was the last al-Andalus governor appointed by Damascus.
783年：Silo dies and is succeeded by Alfonso II of Asturias, although immediately deposed by the nobility in favor of his uncle Mauregatus.
788年10月6日：Hisham I becomes Emir of Córdoba.
