1910年8月31日：Gafanha da Nazaré is founded by Prior Sardo and is bestowed to become a parish by the king Manuel II. Officially being the last town to receive such royal distinction by a Portuguese monarch.
1910年10月4日：Beginning of the Republican Revolution.
1910年10月5日：The Portuguese Republic is officially proclaimed in Lisbon. End of the Monarchy. Teófilo Braga is the president of the Provisional Government.
1910年10月5日：The last King of Portugal, Manuel II of Portugal, and the Portuguese Royal Family embark in Ericeira for exile in England.
1911年5月28日：Constituent National Assembly election, the Democratic Party wins a majority of 229 of the 234 seats.
1911年8月24日：Indirect presidential election. Manuel de Arriaga wins in the 1st round.
1911年9月3日：João Pinheiro Chagas is appointed prime-minister.
1911年11月13日：Augusto de Vasconcelos is appointed prime-minister.
1911年：East Timorese rebellion.
1912年6月16日：Duarte Leite is appointed prime-minister.
1912年7月8日：The royalist attack on Chaves, led by Henrique Mitchell de Paiva Cabral Couceiro, fails to reinstate the Monarchy.
links: Henrique Mitchell de Paiva Cabral Couceiro

items.text: 1912年9月23日：Augusto de Vasconcelos becomes interim prime-minister.
1913年1月9日：Afonso Costa is appointed prime-minister.
1913年11月16日：Legislative election, the Democratic Party wins a plurality of 68 of the 153 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 24 of the 71 seats in the Senate.
1914年2月9日：Bernardino Machado is appointed prime-minister.
1914年12月12日：Victor Hugo de Azevedo Coutinho is appointed prime-minister.
1915年1月28日：Pimenta de Castro is appointed prime-minister.
1915年5月14日：A revolt brings the end of Pimenta de Castro's government. A Constitutional Junta is formed.
1915年5月15日：João Pinheiro Chagas is appointed prime-minister for a second time, but he did not take office.
1915年5月17日：José de Castro is appointed prime-minister.
1915年5月29日：Indirect presidential election to select someone to complete Manuel de Arriaga's term. Teófilo Braga wins in the 1st round.
1915年8月6日：Indirect presidential election. Bernardino Machado wins in the 3rd round.
1915年6月13日：Legislative election, the Democratic Party wins a majority of 106 of the 163 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 45 of the 69 seats in the Senate.
1915年11月29日：Afonso Costa is appointed prime-minister a second time.
1916年3月16日：António José de Almeida is appointed prime-minister.
1916年8月7日：The Portuguese Parliament accepts the participation of Portugal in the first world war, following the invitation of the British government to join the allied forces
1917年2月2日：The first members of the Portuguese Expeditionary Corps arrive in France.
1917年4月25日：Afonso Costa is appointed prime-minister a third time.
1917年10月7日：José Norton de Matos is appointed prime-minister.
1917年10月25日：Afonso Costa is appointed prime-minister a fourth time.
1917年11月17日：José Norton de Matos becomes interim prime-minister.
1917年：The December 1917 coup d'état marks the beginning of Sidónio Pais' rise to power. He leads the Military Junta.
1918年4月28日：Sidónio Pais (National Republican Party) wins the 1918 Portuguese general election. He ran unopposed.
1918年11月11日：The Armistice of 11 November 1918 marks the end of World War I.
1918年12月14日：Sidónio Pais is assassinated in the Rossio railway station. João do Canto e Castro succeeds Pais in leading the government.
1918年12月16日：Indirect presidential election. João do Canto e Castro wins in the 2nd round.
1918年12月23日：João Tamagnini Barbosa is appointed prime-minister.
1919年1月15日：The Monarchy of the North is proclaimed in Porto, and the restoration of the Portuguese monarchy lasts for about a month before being crushed by republican forces.
1919年1月22日：The Monarchy is proclaimed in Lisbon, in the Assault of Monsanto.
1919年1月24日：The Monarchic forces in Monsanto surrender, leading to the resignation of João Tamagnini two days later.
1919年1月27日：José Relvas is appointed prime-minister.
1919年3月30日：Domingos Leite Pereira is appointed prime-minister.
1919年5月11日：Legislative election, the Democratic Party wins a majority of 86 of the 163 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 36 of the 71 seats in the Senate.
1919年6月30日：Alfredo de Sá Cardoso is appointed prime-minister.
1919年12月6日：Indirect presidential election. António José de Almeida wins in the 3rd round.in the 3rd round.
1920年1月15日：Francisco José Fernandes Costa is appointed prime minister. He did not take office and Alfredo de Sá Cardoso is re-appointed prime-minister.
1920年1月21日：Domingos Leite Pereira is appointed prime-minister a second time.
1920年3月8日：António Maria Baptista is appointed prime-minister.
1920年6月6日：José Ramos Preto is appointed prime-minister, after António Maria Baptista suddenly dies.
1920年6月26日：António Maria da Silva is appointed prime-minister.
1920年7月19日：António Granjo is appointed prime-minister.
1920年11月20日：Álvaro de Castro is appointed prime-minister.
1920年11月30日：Liberato Pinto is appointed prime-minister.
1921年3月2日：Bernardino Luís Machado Guimarães is appointed prime-minister a second time.
1921年3月6日：The Portuguese Communist Party was founded from the ranks of the Portuguese Maximalist Federation as the Portuguese Section of the Communist International.
1921年5月23日：Tomé de Barros Queirós is appointed prime-minister.
1921年7月10日：Legislative election, the Republican Liberal Party wins a plurality of 79 of the 163 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 32 of the 71 seats in the Senate.
1921年8月6日：Indirect presidential election. Manuel Teixeira Gomes wins in the 3rd round.
1921年8月30日：António Granjo is appointed prime-minister a second time.

1921年10月19日：In the Bloody Night, then-head of Government António Granjo (Republican Liberal Party) is killed, along with other politician associates of his. Manuel Maria Coelho is appointed prime-minister.
1921年11月5日：Carlos Maia Pinto is appointed prime-minister.
1921年12月16日：Francisco Cunha Leal is appointed prime-minister.
1922年1月29日：Legislative election, the Democratic Party wins a plurality of 74 of the 163 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 37 of the 70 seats in the Senate.
1922年2月7日：António Maria da Silva is appointed prime-minister a second time.
1922年8月1日：Portugal receives the Balfour Note, requiring that the loan Portugal had from the UK be paid back.
1923年11月15日：António Ginestal Machado is appointed prime-minister.
1923年12月18日：Álvaro de Castro is appointed prime-minister a second time.
1924年7月7日：Alfredo Rodrigues Gaspar is appointed prime-minister.
1924年11月22日：José Domingues dos Santos is appointed prime-minister.
1925年2月15日：Vitorino Guimarães is appointed prime-minister.
1925年3月5日：First failed coup attempt by Filomeno da Câmara.
1925年4月18日：Second failed coup attempt by Filomena da Câmara, now with the aid of Raul Esteves.
1925年7月1日：António Maria da Silva is appointed prime-minister a third time.
1925年7月19日：Failed coup attempt by Mendes Cabeçadas.
1925年8月1日：Domingos Leite Pereira is appointed prime-minister a third time.
1925年11月8日：Legislative election, the Democratic Party wins a majority of 83 of the 163 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 39 of the 65 seats in the Senate.
1925年12月11日：Indirect presidential election. Bernardino Machado is elected President of the Republic for the 2nd time.
1925年12月18日：António Maria da Silva is appointed prime-minister a fourth time.
1926年5月27日：The General Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa arrives at Braga with the purpose of initiating a Coup d'état.
links: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa

items.text: 1926年5月27日：The Republican Government and Prime Minister António Maria da Silva, knowing of the forthcoming coup, try to organise resistance believing the uprising can be defeated.
1926年5月28日：A Military coup d'état (henceforth known as the 28th May 1926 coup d'état) begins in Braga led by Gomes da Costa. Believing to have failed, Gomes da Costa announces his surrender.
links: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa

items.text: 1926年5月29日：The Portuguese Communist Party interrupts its 2nd Congress due to the political and military situation.
1926年5月29日：The Confederação Geral do Trabalho (national trade union centre) declares its neutrality in the military confrontations.

1926年5月29日：The Military Coup spreads to the rest of the country, by influence of Mendes Cabeçadas, Sinel de Cordes and Óscar Carmona, and establishes the Ditadura Nacional (National Dictatorship) against the democratic but unstable 1st Republic.
1926年5月29日：The Government of Prime Minister António Maria da Silva resigns.
1926年5月30日：The General Gomes da Costa is acclaimed in Porto.
links: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa

items.text: 1926年5月30日：The President of the Republic, Bernardino Machado, resigns.
1926年5月30日：José Mendes Cabeçadas Júnior becomes Prime Minister and President of the Republic.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1926年6月3日：António de Oliveira Salazar becomes Minister of Finance, he resigns 16 days after nomination.
1926年6月3日：The Congress of the Republic of Portugal (National Assembly) is dissolved by dictatorial decree.
links: Congress of the Republic of Portugal

items.text: 1926年6月3日：All heads of Municipalities are substituted.
1926年6月3日：The Carbonária (the Portuguese section of the Carbonari) is banned.
1926年6月3日：All Political parties are banned.
1926年6月17日：General Gomes da Costa provokes a military coup.
links: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa

items.text: 1926年6月19日：General Gomes da Costa becomes Prime Minister.
links: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa
List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1926年6月22日：Censorship is instituted.
1926年6月29日：General Gomes da Costa becomes President of the Republic.
links: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa

items.text: 1926年7月9日：General Gomes da Costa is obliged to step down and goes into exile.
links: Manuel de Oliveira Gomes da Costa

items.text: 1926年7月9日：General António Óscar de Fragoso Carmona, of the conservative military wing, becomes Prime Minister.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1926年9月15日：Failed military coup.
1926年9月18日：Failed military coup.
1926年11月29日：General António Óscar Carmona becomes President of the Republic.
1926年12月16日：The Police of Information of Lisbon, a Political Police, is created.
1927年：The Confederação Geral do Trabalho (national trade union centre) is dissolved.
1927年2月：Failed Republican coup attempt against the Ditadura Nacional in Porto (2 to 7) and Lisbon (7 to 9).
1927年3月26日：The Police of Information of Porto, a Political Police, is created.
1927年5月17日：Minimum School years are reduced from the 6th to the 4th grade; in all levels of non-university schooling students are divided by sex.
1927年8月：Failed right wing military coup.
1927年12月1日：Students demonstrate in Lisbon against the Ditadura Nacional.
1928年：General António Óscar de Fragoso Carmona remains President of the Republic.
1928年：Acordo Missionário (Missionary Agreement) between the Catholic Church and the Portuguese Republic, giving special status to the action of the Catholic Church in Portugal's colonies.
1928年：Failed Republican revolutionary attempt against the Ditadura Nacional.
1928年：The Portuguese Communist Party's Main Office is closed.
1928年2月：The Comissão de Propaganda da Ditadura (Commission for the Propaganda of the Dictatorship) is created.
links: Commission for the Propaganda of the Dictatorship

items.text: 1928年3月17日：The Police of Information of Porto and Lisbon are fused.
1928年4月18日：General José Vicente de Freitas becomes Prime Minister.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1928年4月26日：António de Oliveira Salazar becomes Minister of Finance for the 2nd time.
1928年7月20日：Failed Republican coup attempt against the Ditadura Nacional.
1929年：Catholic religious institutes are again permitted in Portugal.

1929年：The Portuguese Communist Party is reorganised under Bento Gonçalves. Adapting the Party to its new illegal status, the reorganisation creates a net of clandestine cells to avoid the wave of detentions.
1929年7月8日：Artur Ivens Ferraz becomes Prime Minister.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1930年：The Acto Colonial (Colonial Act) is published, defining the status of Portuguese colonies (Angola, Cabinda, Cape Verde, Portuguese Guinea, São Tomé and Príncipe, Mozambique, Portuguese India, Portuguese Timor and Macau).
1930年：The fundamental principles of the new regime are presented by António de Oliveira Salazar in the 4th anniversary of the 28 May Revolution.
1930年1月21日：Domingos da Costa e Oliveira becomes Prime Minister.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1930年4月4日：A Republican coup attempt against the Ditadura Nacional starts in Madeira. It would then expand to Azores and Portuguese Guinea, before dying out on 2 May 1931.
1931年8月26日：Failed Republican coup attempt against the Ditadura Nacional in Lisbon. There would be no remaining coup attempts during the Ditadura Nacional.
1932年7月5日：António de Oliveira Salazar becomes Prime Minister.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1933年：A new Constitution is approved in a false referendum, defining Portugal as a Corporative, Single Party and Multi-continental country (in Europe, Africa, Asia and Oceania).
1933年：A fascist-leaning right-wing Dictatorial regime entitled Estado Novo is installed.
1933年：The Single Party União Nacional (National Union) is created.
1933年：The Estatuto do Trabalho Nacional (Code of National Labour) is published, prohibiting all free trade unions.
1933年：A Political Police, the PVDE (Polícia de Vigilância e de Defesa do Estado; State Defence and Vigilance Police) is created.
1933年：Censorship, particularly of the Mass media, is systematic and generalised.

1935年：The Portuguese Communist Party's Secretary General Bento Gonçalves participates in the 7th Congress of the Comintern. Soon after returning to Portugal he is arrested by the Political Police PVDE.
1936年：The concentration camp for political prisoners of Tarrafal is created in the colony of Portuguese Cape Verde, under direct control of the political police PVDE.

1936年：The political police PVDE focuses its action against Communism and the underground Portuguese Communist Party. During this pre-World War II period, several Italian Fascist and German Nazi advisors came to Portugal, to help the PVDE adopt a model similar to the Gestapo.
1936年5月19日：Creation of the Mocidade Portuguesa (Portuguese Youth), a compulsory paramilitary youth organisation similar to the Hitler Youth.

1936年7月：Beginning of the Spanish Civil War; Portugal promptly supports Nationalist Spain under General Francisco Franco and sends military aid (the Battalion of the Viriatos) in their fight against the Spanish Republicans.
1937年12月：The female section of the Mocidade Portuguesa is created.
1939年：The Iberian Neutrality Pact is put forward by Salazar to Francisco Franco.
1942年：Salazar meets with Spanish dictator Francisco Franco.
1942年2月19日：Japanese forces invade Portuguese Timor in the Battle of Timor.
1942年：The Portuguese Communist Party's Secretary General Bento Gonçalves dies in the concentration camp of Tarrafal.

1944年：An international embargo on tungsten, which Portugal initially exported to both factions of World War II, and the longest drought on mainland Portugal lead to an economic recession that would last until 1945.
1945年：The Political Police PVDE is reorganised and renamed PIDE (Polícia Internacional e de Defesa do Estado; International Police for the Defence of the State).
1945年10月8日：The MUD (Movimento de Unidade Democrática – Movement of Democratic Unity) is created with official permission.
1948年1月：The MUD is banished.
1949年：The President António Óscar Carmona meets with Spanish dictator Francisco Franco.
1949年：Spanish dictator Francisco Franco receives a Doctorate honoris causa by the University of Coimbra.
1949年：In the (forged) Presidential elections, General Norton de Matos, backed by the oppositionist illegal organisation MUD tries and fail to win the Presidency of the Republic.
1949年4月4日：Portugal is a founding member of NATO.
1949年：For the first time, a Portuguese citizen is awarded with the Nobel Prize: Egas Moniz, with the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
links: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine

items.text: 1951年：António de Oliveira Salazar becomes Provisional President of the Republic due to the death of President António Óscar de Fragoso Carmona.
1951年：Francisco Higino Craveiro Lopes becomes President of the Republic.
1951年：The Portuguese government overhauls the entire colonial system in an attempt to curb criticism on Portuguese Colonialism, all Portugal's colonies were renamed Portuguese Overseas Provinces.
1951年：Due to a bad harvest year and lower external demand for Portuguese goods, Portugal enters an economic recession that would last until 1953.
1954年：The Dadra and Nagar Haveli Portuguese enclave, dependent of Daman, is occupied by India.
1956年：Amílcar Cabral founds the PAIGC (Partido Africano da Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde, African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde).
links: Partido Africano da Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde

items.text: 1956年12月：The MPLA, Movimento Popular de Libertação de Angola (Popular Movement for the Liberation of Angola), is founded by Agostinho Neto.
links: Popular Movement for the Liberation of Angola

items.text: 1957年：Frente Nacional de Libertação de Angola (National Front for the Liberation of Angola), is founded as União das Populações do Norte de Angola (Union of the Populations of Northern Angola).
1957年3月7日：First live event of the Portuguese National Television and the beginning of the regular broadcasting. It was opened by the famous and former BBC war reporter, Fernando Pessa.
1958年：Américo Thomaz becomes President of the Republic.
1959年：Pijiguiti Massacre – Portuguese soldiers open fire on protesting dockworkers in Bissau (Portuguese Guinea), killing 50.
1960年1月：A group of ten Portuguese Communist Party members escaped from the high-security prison in Peniche. Among the escapees was Álvaro Cunhal.
1960年1月4日：Portugal is one of the founding member of the EFTA – European Free Trade Association.
1961年：The Prime Minister António de Oliveira Salazar takes on himself the office of Minister of National Defence and reorganises the Government to face the war in Africa.
1961年2月4日：The Portuguese Colonial War starts in Portuguese Angola with the attacks to the Prison, Police headquarters and Radio central in Luanda.
1961年3月15日：Attacks in northern Angola by the UPA (União do Povo Angolano; Union of the Angolan People), against Portuguese colonists and African populations, provoking hundreds of deaths.
1961年3月29日：Portugal joins the International Monetary fund.
links: Portugal and the International Monetary Fund

items.text: 1961年12月12日：The Indian army conquers Portuguese Goa.
1961年12月19日：The Indian army conquers Portuguese Daman and Diu.
1962年：The PAIGC Guerrilla warfare against the Portuguese begins with an abortive attack on Praia.
1962年3月24日：The Academic Crisis of '62 culminates in a huge student demonstration in Lisbon brutally repressed by the shock police, which caused hundreds of students to be seriously injured.
1962年6月25日：The FRELIMO – Frente de Libertação de Moçambique (Mozambican Liberation Front) is founded in Dar es Salaam (Tanzania).
1963年：The FLEC (Frente para a Libertação do Enclave de Cabinda; Front for the Liberation of the Enclave of Cabinda) is founded.
links: Frente para a Libertação do Enclave de Cabinda

items.text: 1963年1月：Amílcar Cabral and PAIGC declare full-scale war against the Portuguese in Portuguese Guinea.
1964年：The FRELIMO controls most of Northern Portuguese Mozambique.

1964年2月：The first Party Congress of the PAIGC takes place at liberated Cassaca, in which both the political and military arms of the PAIGC were assessed and reorganised, with a regular army (The People's Army) to supplement the guerrilla forces (The People's Guerillas).

1965年：6th Congress of the Portuguese Communist Party, one of the most important congresses in the Party's history, after Álvaro Cunhal released the report The Path to Victory – The tasks of the Party in the National and Democratic Revolution, which became an important document in the anti-dictatorship struggle.
1966年：The UNITA – União Nacional para a Independência Total de Angola (National Union for Total Independence of Angola) is founded by Jonas Savimbi.
links: National Union for Total Independence of Angola

items.text: 1966年8月6日：The Salazar Bridge is inaugurated in Lisbon above the Tagus river. It is the longest suspension bridge in Europe and a replica (made by the same engineers) of the Golden Gate bridge in San Francisco.
1967年：By this time the PAIGC had carried out 147 attacks on Portuguese barracks and army encampments, and effectively controlled 2/3 of Portuguese Guinea.
1968年：Reorganisation of the Government.
1968年：Portugal begins a new campaign against the guerrillas in Portuguese Guinea with the arrival of the new governor of the colony, General António de Spínola.
1968年9月25日：António de Oliveira Salazar leaves the Government due to health problems.
1968年9月28日：Marcello das Neves Alves Caetano becomes Prime Minister.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1969年：The Single Party União Nacional is renamed Acção Nacional Popular (National Popular Action).
1969年：The Political Police PIDE is renamed DGS (Direcção Geral de Segurança, Directorate-General of Security).
1969年：Beginning of the Primavera Marcelista (Marcelist Springtime), a timid and failed opening of the regime.
1970年：Portugal invades Conakry, in the Republic of Guinea, 400 amphibious troops attacked the city and freed dozens of Portuguese Prisoners of war kept there by the PAIGC.
1970年7月27日：Death of António de Oliveira Salazar.
1973年1月：Amílcar Cabral, leader of the PAIGC, is assassinated in Conakry by a disgruntled former associate under influence of the Portuguese Political Police DGS.
links: Partido Africano da Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde

items.text: 1973年9月24日：Independence of Guinea-Bissau (Portuguese Guinea) is unilaterally declared.

1973年11月：A United Nations' General Assembly vote recognises the Independence of Guinea-Bissau, unprecedented as it denounced illegal Portuguese aggression and occupation and was prior to complete control and Portuguese recognition.
1973年：An economic recession starts, in the context of the international 1973–1975 recession.
1974年：The Carnation Revolution of 25 April puts an end to five decades of dictatorship.
1974年4月25日：The Carnation Revolution puts an end to the authoritarian regime of Estado Novo. Prime-minister Marcello Caetano exiled to Brazil
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1975年：Independence is granted to all Portuguese colonies in Africa and independence is promised to Portuguese Timor.
1975年3月11日：A right-wing coup fails: A turn to the left in the revolution happens and major industries and big properties are nationalised by government

1975年8月2日：A meeting takes place in Haga (near Stockholm in Sweden) where the Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with Democracy and Socialism in Portugal is created. This Committee supported democratic trends in Portugal and opposed pro-soviet communist tendencies. In the meeting were present Olof Palme, Harold Wilson, Helmut Schmidt, Bruno Kreisky, Joop den Uyl, Trygve Bratteli, Anker Jørgensen, Yitzhak Rabin, Hans Janitschek, Willy Brandt, James Callaghan, François Mitterrand, Bettino Craxi and Mário Soares.
links: Committee for Friendship and Solidarity with Democracy and Socialism in Portugal

items.text: 1975年11月25日：A coup removes far-left influence in politics.
1975年12月7日：East Timor (Portuguese Timor) is violently annexed by Indonesia.
1976年4月2日：A new Constitution is approved. The Constitutional Assembly disestablishes itself.
1976年4月25日：The Constitution of 1976 enters into force.
1976年11月19日：Jaime Ornelas Camacho becomes the first President of the Regional Government of Madeira.
1977年：Portugal requests International Monetary Fund aid for the first time since joining in 1961, in consequence of the 1973–1975 recession.
1980年12月4日：Prime minister Francisco Sá Carneiro and the Minister of Defence Amaro da Costa died in the 1980 Camarate plane crash, in strange circumstances.
links: List of Prime Ministers of Portugal

items.text: 1983年：An economic recession starts in Portugal, within the context of the early 1980s recession. It would last until around 1984.
1984年：Carlos Lopes wins the first Olympic gold medal for Portugal in the Los Angeles '84 marathon.
1986年1月1日：Portugal becomes a member of the European Economic Community, today's European Union'.
1987年3月26日：Portugal and China sign the Sino-Portuguese Joint Declaration establishing the process and conditions of the transfer of Macau from Portuguese rule to the People's Republic of China.
1992年：An economic recession starts in Portugal, within the context of the early 1990s recession, which affected most of the Western world. It would last until 1993.

1995年10月1日：The 1995 Portuguese legislative election would bring an end to 10 years of Social Democratic Party (PSD) rule by Aníbal Cavaco Silva. After the only two elections in which a party or pre-electoral coalition ever received more than 50% of votes since the Estado Novo, PSD lost with 34.1% of votes to PS' 43.8%.
1998年：Lisbon organises the World's Fair Expo '98.

1998年6月28日：In the first Portuguese abortion referendum, the proposal to allow the abortion until 10 weeks of pregnancy is rejected by 50.91% of the voters. This is the first referendum in the History of the Portuguese democracy.
1998年10月8日：For the very first time, a Portuguese Language author is awarded with the Nobel Prize of Literature: José Saramago.

1998年11月8日：in the regionalisation referendum, a proposal to establish, in mainland Portugal, 8 administrative regions and to disestablish the 18 districts, is rejected in the polls: in the first question, the simple institution of the administrative regions is rejected by 60.67% of the voters; in the second question, the proposal to create 8 regions is rejected by 60.62% of the voters. This is the first referendum in the History of Portugal to have more than 1 question.
1999年12月20日：Macau, the last overseas Portuguese colony, is returned to China
2001年3月4日：Hintze Ribeiro Bridge disaster: 59 people die in the collapse of an old bridge on the Douro river. Hours after the accident, Jorge Coelho, Minister of Transportation, resigns.
2002年1月1日：Portugal adopts the euro as currency.
2004年：2004 European Football Championship is held in Portugal.
2005年12月31日：The 2006 Dakar Rally, the longest and, arguably, the hardest off-road rally in the world starts in Lisbon.

2007年2月11日：In the second Portuguese abortion referendum, almost 9 years after the first, the proposal to allow the abortion until 10 weeks of pregnancy is now approved by 59.25% of the voters. The law is published in April.
2010年5月17日：The law that allows the same-sex marriage is approved by the Portuguese President of the Republic, Aníbal Cavaco Silva.

2010年：In 2010, the official infant mortality rate was 2.53 per mil, the lowest ever recorded in Portugal (1.6‰ below the UE-27, 2010 average), placing the country among the top-5 in the European Union in this particular value of Human Development.
2016年7月10日：Portugal national football team wins the 2016 UEFA European Football Championship, in Stade de France in Paris, France.
2017年5月13日：Salvador Sobral wins the 62nd edition of the Eurovision Song Contest, with the song Amar pelos dois, composed by Luísa Sobral, in Kyiv, Ukraine.
2018年：Lisbon hosts the 63rd edition of the Eurovision Song Contest, after Portugal's win in the previous year.
2020年3月2日：The arrival date of COVID-19 in Portugal.
前57年：Roman General Julius Caesar invades and conquers the lands of the Belgae: Battle of the Sabis; Siege of the Atuatuci
前56年：Julius Caesar campaigns unsuccessfully against the coastal tribes of the Morini and Menapii.
前55年：Julius Caesar subdues the Morini.
前54年－前53年：Ambiorix's revolt under Ambiorix and Cativolcus.
前53年－前51年：Punitive campaigns subdue Nervii and Treveri; exterminate Eburoni.
前50年：Julius Caesar completes writing Commentarii de Bello Gallico, his account of his campaigns in Gaul.
前29年：Marcus Nonius Gallus suppresses revolt among Treveri.
前27年：Augustus creates the province Gallia Belgica.
約前15年：Probable origins of the city of Tongeren.
前12年：Augusta Treverorum becomes a city.
前12年：Nero Claudius Drusus, commander in chief of Roman forces in Gallia Belgica, has a series of canals dug in the Rhine–Meuse–Scheldt delta.
約前10年：Probable origins of the city of Aarlen.
前9年：Nero Claudius Drusus dies after falling from his horse. Command of Rome's northern armies passes to Tiberius.
前4年：Monument honouring Tiberius erected in Bagacum.
13年：Germanicus becomes commander of the Roman army of the Rhine.
16年：Roman invasion of Germany under command of Germanicus launched from Fectio in Gallia Belgica.
19年10月10日：Death of Germanicus.
21年：Treveri revolt at high taxes.
39年10月：Galba becomes commander of the armies in Lower Germany.
47年：Gnaeus Domitius Corbulo becomes commander of the armies in Lower Germany. Orders canals dug in the Rhine–Meuse–Scheldt delta.
47年－48年：Roman law replaces customary law in Gallia Belgica; druids outlawed; Gaulish aristocracy given senatorial rank.
69年1月：Armies of the Rhine proclaim Aulus Vitellius as emperor.
70年：Treveri, Menapii, Nervii and Tungrii come out in support of the Batavian Revolt, some under compulsion.
77年：Pliny the Elder starts writing his Historia Naturalis, book 4 of which contains a description of Gallia Belgica.
約85年：Northern border fortified with series of castra.
約90年：Domitian restructures provinces of the Roman Empire: Gallia Belgica divided into the provinces of Belgica Prima, Belgica Secunda, Germania Superior and Germania Inferior.
172年－174年：Chauci launch maritime raids on the coasts of Gallia Belgica.
286年：Carausius, a Menapian general in the Roman army, declares himself emperor of Britain and Gaul.
293年：Death of Carausius, brings the end of the Carausian revolt 3 years later.
343年：Servatius, bishop of Tongeren, attends the Council of Serdica.
357年：Land south of the Rhine delta ceded to Frankish foederati
359年：Servatius, bishop of Tongeren, attends the Council of Ariminum.
431年：Salian Franks take possession of Tournai.
約481年：Childeric I buried in Tournai.
561年：Sigebert I inherits the Frankish kingdom of Austrasia.
659年3月17日：Death of Gertrude of Nivelles
679年：Death of Amandus.
679年12月23日：Murder of Dagobert II in the Ardennes Forest.
687年：Pepin of Herstal and his wife Plectrude found what will become the Abbey of Saint-Hubert.
693年12月17日：Death of Begga.
705年9月17日：Death of Lambert of Maastricht: murdered at a site that would become Liège.
717年：See of Maastricht moved to the location of Lambert of Maastricht's murder, now Liège.
727年5月30日：Death of Hubertus, Bishop of Liège.
748年4月2日：Birth of Charlemagne, first Holy Roman Emperor.
819年4月13日：Louis the Pious confirms the liberties granted to St Bavo's Abbey by Charlemagne (oldest extant original charter in a Belgian archive).
820年：First recorded Viking raid on the Flemish coast.
825年9月30日：The remains of St Hubert (died 727) installed in the monastery that would become the Abbey of Saint-Hubert.

843年8月：Treaty of Verdun divides the Carolingian Empire between the three sons of Louis the Pious: Lothair I, Louis the German and Charles the Bald, creating the kingdom of Middle Francia (including most of the Low Countries) for Lothair and assigning Flanders to Charles the Bald.
850年：Norsemen raid Flanders.
855年9月：Treaty of Prüm divides Middle Francia into the Kingdom of Lotharingia (including most of the Low Countries), the Kingdom of Provence and the Kingdom of Italy.
861年：Norsemen raid Flanders.
864年：Norsemen raid Flanders.
870年8月：Treaty of Meerssen partitions Lotharingia (including most of the Low Countries) between East Francia (Germany) and West Francia (France).
879年：Norsemen raid Taxandria.
880年：Norsemen raid Tournaisis.
881年：Norsemen plunder Cambrai and encamp near Maastricht, extorting tribute from Maastricht, Tongeren, Liège, Sint-Truiden, Malmedy, Stavelot, and Prüm.
891年：Norse invaders defeated in Battle on the Dijle.
895年：Holy Roman Emperor Arnulf of Carinthia appoints his illegitimate son Zwentibold as king of Lotharingia.
900年8月13日：Zwentibold slain by Count Reginar I of Hainault; Lotharingia reincorporated into East Francia.
908年：Bishop of Liège granted right to levy a toll in Maastricht.
910年：Count Reginar I of Hainault appointed margrave of Lotharingia; historically regarded as the first Duke of Lorraine.
915年：Death of Reginar, Duke of Lorraine, at his palace in Meerssen; succeeded by his son Giselbert.
918年9月10日：Death of Baldwin II, Margrave of Flanders at Blandijnberg; succeeded by his son Arnulf.
925年：Henry the Fowler invades Lotharingia and receives oaths of loyalty from the local aristocracy.
936年8月7日：Gilbert, Duke of Lorraine, attends the coronation of Otto I in Aachen.
939年10月2日：Battle of Andernach: death of Gilbert, Duke of Lorraine; end of independence of Lotharingia (referred to as "Belgica" in the 10th-century histories of Richer of Rheims).
約940年：Saint-Ghislain Abbey reformed by Gérard of Brogne
948年：Death of Isaac, Count of Cambrai; powers of count transferred to Fulbert, Bishop of Cambrai.
953年：Bruno the Great, Archbishop of Cologne, appointed Duke of Lotharingia.
954年：Hungarian attackers raid Lower Lotharingia, besiege Cambrai.
959年：Bruno the Great divides Lotharingia into Upper Lotharingia (the later Duchy of Lorraine) and Lower Lotharingia (the later Duchy of Lothier).
959年10月3日：Death of Gérard of Brogne.
964年：Godfrey I, Duke of Lower Lorraine, dies in Italy; no immediate successor.
links: Godfrey I, Duke of Lower Lorraine

items.text: 965年3月28日：Death of Arnulf I, Count of Flanders; succession of Arnulf II, Count of Flanders
965年6月2日：Otto I, Holy Roman Emperor, confirms Godfrey of Lower Lotharingia's gift to Saint-Ghislain Abbey of 18 mansi of land in Villers-Saint-Ghislain.
links: Godfrey I, Duke of Lower Lorraine

items.text: 965年10月11日：Death of Bruno the Great, Duke of Lotharingia.
966年5月5日：Lothar, King of the Franks, confirms the possessions of St. Peter's Abbey, Ghent, including those bequeathed by Arnulf I, Count of Flanders, and contested by his heirs.
968年：Richar, Count of Mons, appointed Duke of Lower Lotharingia.
972年10月：Richar, Duke of Lower Lotharingia, dies; no immediate successor.
977年：Otto II, Holy Roman Emperor, appoints Charles, brother of Lothair of France, as Duke of Lower Lotharingia.

980年：Otto II, Holy Roman Emperor, confirms all previous endowments to Notker, Bishop of Liège, and issues a general immunity for the bishopric's lands: beginning of the establishment of the Prince-Bishopric of Liège.
985年：Otto III, King of Germany, endows Notker, Bishop of Liège, with the County of Huy: full establishment of the Prince-Bishopric of Liège.
987年3月30日：Death of Arnulf II, Count of Flanders; succession of Baldwin IV, Count of Flanders.
990年：Death of Hildegard of Flanders, daughter of Arnulf II, Count of Flanders, and wife of Dirk II, Count of Holland.
1008年4月：Baldrick II succeeds Notger as prince-bishop of Liège

1018年7月29日：Battle of Vlaardingen: imperial forces commanded by Godfrey II, Duke of Lower Lorraine, and Baldrick II, bishop of Liège, defeated by the army of Dirk III, Count of Holland. Baldrick died after a sudden illness on the journey; Godfrey was captured in the battle.
links: Godfrey II, Duke of Lower Lorraine

items.text: 1018年11月：Wolbodo consecrated bishop of Liège.
1021年：Durandus succeeds Wolbodo as prince-bishop of Liège
1025年：Reginard succeeds Durandus as prince-bishop of Liège
1035年5月30日：Death of Baldwin IV, Count of Flanders; succession of Baldwin V, Count of Flanders
1037年：Nithard succeeds Reginard as prince-bishop of Liège
1042年：Wazo succeeds Nithard as prince-bishop of Liège
1047年：Baldwin V, Count of Flanders, seizes control of the imperial castle at Ename
1048年：Theodwin succeeds Wazo as prince-bishop of Liège
1049年1月13日：Forces of Theodwin of Liège defeat forces of Dirk IV, Count of Holland, killing Dirk and restoring imperial authority in the Rhine delta.
1060年：Baldwin V, Count of Flanders, becomes regent of France
1063年：Ename Abbey founded
1066年：Theodwin of Liège grants city rights to Huy, the oldest such charter to survive from what is now Belgium.
1067年9月1日：Death of Baldwin V, Count of Flanders; succession of Baldwin VI, Count of Flanders
1067年：Genealogia comitum Flandrensium compiled.
1070年7月17日：Death of Baldwin VI, Count of Flanders; succession of Arnulf III, Count of Flanders
1071年2月22日：Battle of Cassel between Robert the Frisian and his nephew, Arnulf III, Count of Flanders. Arnulf was killed in the battle and Robert succeeded him as count.
1074年4月29日：Pope Gregory VII issues bull of protection for the Abbey of Saint-Hubert.
1075年3月23日：Pope Gregory VII writes to Theodwin, bishop of Liège, urging him to leave the abbot of Saint-Hubert unmolested.
1075年6月23日：Death of Theodwin of Liège.
1077年4月28日：Pope Gregory VII issues bull of protection for Watten Abbey.
1080年：Adela of Flanders marries Canute IV of Denmark
1081年2月1日：Traditional date of the first apparition of Our Lady of Tongre.
links: Basilica of Our Lady of Tongre

items.text: 1086年：Adela of Flanders, queen consort of Denmark, returns to the Low Countries after her husband's murder
1087年：Godfrey of Bouillon becomes Duke of Lower Lorraine
1093年10月13日：Death of Robert I, Count of Flanders; succession of Robert II, Count of Flanders
1096年8月：Godfrey of Bouillon, Duke of Lower Lorraine, sets off as one of the leaders of the First Crusade.
1100年7月18日：Death of Godfrey of Bouillon
1105年：Baldric of Noyon, Bishop of Tournai, awards the right of presentment for Tielt to the chapter of St Salvator in Harelbeke.
1105年：St Michael's church, Hekelgem becomes a dependency of Affligem Abbey.
1106年5月13日：Godfrey I, Count of Louvain, invested as Duke of Lower Lotharingia in Worms Cathedral.
1107年：The hermit Ligerius founds a community that would become Ten Duinen Abbey (the Abbey of Dunes).
1111年10月5日：Death of Robert II, Count of Flanders; succession of Baldwin VII, Count of Flanders
1119年7月17日：Death of Baldwin VII, Count of Flanders; succession of Charles I, Count of Flanders (Charles the Good)
1125年：Godfrey I, Count of Louvain confirms the agreement of Ava of Waver and her sons with the priory of Forest, transferring ownership of an allod in Woluwe.
1127年3月2日：Murder of Charles the Good, Count of Flanders
1128年1月1日：Albero I of Louvain, prince-bishop of Liège, dies; succeeded by Alexander of Jülich
1129年：Foundation of Park Abbey.
1139年1月25日：Godfrey I, Count of Louvain, dies; succeeded by Godfrey II
1141年：Siege of Bouillon Castle by Albero, prince-bishop of Liège.
1142年6月13日：Godfrey II, Count of Louvain dies; succeeded by Godfrey III
1146年6月24日：Pope Eugene III confirms Wibald, Abbot of Stavelot and Malmedy, in possession of the goods of the abbey.
1147年：Henry II of Leez, Bishop of Liège, confirms Affligem Abbey in possession of its property in the diocese of Liège.
1159年10月1日：Godfrey III, Count of Louvain, takes Grimbergen

1163年6月：Henry the Blind, Count of Namur and of Luxembourg, being childless, names his sister Alice of Namur with her husband Baldwin IV, Count of Hainaut, and their son Baldwin, as heirs of all his allodial possessions, "with sod and twig", retaining usufruct during his own lifetime.
1164年9月4日：Henry II of Leez, prince-bishop of Liège, dies
1167年：Rudolf of Zähringen becomes prince-bishop of Liège
1168年1月17日：Death of Thierry, Count of Flanders; succession of Philip of Alsace as count of Flanders
1171年11月8日：Baldwin IV, Count of Hainaut, dies; succeeded by Baldwin V
1178年：Gislebert of Mons becomes chancellor to Baldwin V, Count of Hainaut.
1183年：Godfrey III, Count of Louvain, departs for Jerusalem

1184年4月1日：Henry the Blind, Count of Namur and of Luxembourg, being childless, names his nephew, Baldwin V, Count of Hainaut, already heir to all his allodial possessions, as heir equally to all his feudal possessions, "with sod and twig", retaining usufruct during his own lifetime.
1185年：Saint Lambert's Cathedral, Liège, destroyed by fire.
1186年7月：birth of Ermesinde, later countess of Luxembourg, only child of Henry the Blind. As a female heir she would inherit his allodial possessions, but not his feudal possessions.
1190年8月21日：Godfrey III, Count of Louvain dies; succeeded by Henry I, Duke of Brabant
1191年8月1日：Death of Philip of Alsace, Count of Flanders; succession of his daughter Margaret I, Countess of Flanders, and her husband and co-ruler Baldwin V, Count of Hainaut
1192年11月24日：Murder of Albert of Louvain, prince-bishop of Liège, by supporters of Emperor Henry VI
1193年5月19日：Relics of Saint Alena enshrined in Forest Priory.
1194年8月20日：Peace treaty between Henry I, Duke of Brabant and Baldwin V, Count of Hainaut, ending twelve years of conflict between the Duchy of Brabant and the County of Hainaut.
1195年12月17日：Death of Baldwin V, Count of Hainaut; succession of his son Baldwin VI as count of Flanders and Hainaut
1197年：Henry I, Duke of Brabant, departs for Jerusalem.
1198年：Baldwin VI, Count of Hainaut, donates all his possessions in the village of Horrues to the collegiate church of Soignies to endow a Lady chapel and a chantry.
1205年4月14日：Battle of Adrianople: Baldwin I of Constantinople, count of Flanders and Hainaut, captured by the Bulgarians
1213年4月22日：Henry I, Duke of Brabant, marries Marie of France in Soissons.
links: Marie of France, Duchess of Brabant

items.text: 1214年7月27日：Battle of Bouvines: decisive French victory against the forces of Ferdinand, Count of Flanders, Henry I, Duke of Brabant, and Otto IV, Holy Roman Emperor. Count of Flanders carried captive to Paris.

1224年8月12日：Guy of Saint-Pol and his brother, Hugo of Saint-Pol, stand surety for a loan of 3693 pounds borrowed from citizens of Arras by Daniel, Lord of Béthune: an early example of the use of French rather than Latin in legal documents.
1229年6月10日：Henry I, Duke of Brabant, issues charter of city rights for Brussels.
1232年9月20日：Ferdinand, Count of Flanders and Joan, Countess of Flanders release inhabitants of the Brugse Vrije from the feudal relief of "best beast".
1235年9月5日：Henry I, Duke of Brabant, died; succeeded by Henry II
1236年：Statutes of the Ghent Leper Hospital translated from Latin: the earliest known example of a legal document entirely in Dutch.
1237年：Charters of the city of Ghent translated into Dutch.
1238年：Benedictine priory at Vorst, a dependency of Affligem Abbey, becomes the independent Forest Abbey.
1245年6月14日：Pope Innocent IV authorizes the canons regular of St Augustine to establish a grammar school in Leuven.
1248年2月1日：Henry II, Duke of Brabant, died; succeeded by Henry III
1255年：Gothic choir of Tournai Cathedral completed
1261年2月28日：Henry III, Duke of Brabant, dies; succeeded by Henry IV

1270年9月1日：Margaret of Constantinople, Countess of Flanders, impounds wares of English merchants in Flanders in retaliation for their king's non-payment of a money fief, sparking a trade war between Flanders and England.
1272年：Henry IV, Duke of Brabant, died; succeeded by John I

1274年7月28日：Treaty of Montreuil-sur-Mer between Edward I of England and Guy, Count of Flanders, ending four years of economic warfare and providing for free movement of merchants between their territories.
1275年9月27日：Future John II, Duke of Brabant, born.

1281年8月21日：Guy de Thourout does homage to Guy, Count of Flanders for lands in Wervik, Reninge and Rollegem. He also held land in Menen and Rekkem, a manor in Varsenare, and owned a number of houses within the city of Ypres.
1288年6月5日：Battle of Worringen
1293年5月7日：Aldermen of Nieuwpoort accept the mediation of Guy, Count of Flanders in their dispute with the abbeys of Duinen and Bourbourg concerning a dyke built near the town.
1294年5月3日：John I, Duke of Brabant, died; succeeded by John II
1295年8月16日：John II, Duke of Brabant, recognises that Affligem Abbey by immemorial custom has the right to appoint a panel of seven aldermen for the village of Hekelgem.
1296年11月2日：Edward I of England grants Flemish merchants the right to buy wool for export anywhere in the British Isles, rather than being limited to the wool staple.

1297年6月12日：Treaties of alliance between Philip IV of France and John of Avesnes, Count of Hainaut, culminate in a trade treaty allowing merchants from Hainaut to trade freely in the kingdom of France.
1302年7月11日：Battle of the Golden Spurs: Flemish forces defeat knights of Philip IV of France near Kortrijk
1303年7月9日：Aldermen of the city of Namur authorize formation of a butchers' guild with militia obligations, requiring members to arm themselves, follow their own banner, and bury their own dead.

1312年9月27日：The Charter of Kortenberg finalised at Kortenberg Abbey, establishing fundamental rights for the inhabitants of the Duchy of Brabant such as no punishment without due process. Council of four knights and ten representatives of the boroughs established (beginnings of representative institutions in the duchy).
1313年8月24日：Henry of Luxembourg died in Buonconvento while besieging Siena, reputedly of poison put in the chalice during mass.
1317年4月11日：Works begins on a new cloth hall in Leuven, which is now University Hall.
1322年6月24日：Joanna of Brabant born.
1323年6月：Rebellion of the commoners in maritime Flanders, sparked by Louis I, Count of Flanders, ceding Sluis to John I, Marquis of Namur.
1327年8月30日：Pope John XXII provides a dispensation for the marriage of Philippa of Hainault and Edward III of England. The marriage itself took place by proxy in Valenciennes in October.
1328年1月24日：Marriage of Philippa of Hainault and Edward III of England celebrated in York Minster.
1328年8月23日：Battle of Cassel: Philip VI of France defeats Flemish rebels led by Nicolaas Zannekin.

1339年12月3日：Treaty of mutual support between John III, Duke of Brabant and Louis I, Count of Flanders, and the cities subject to them, providing for offensive and defensive alliance and free trade between their territories.
1340年6月24日：Battle of Sluys
1345年7月24日：Jacob van Artevelde killed in Ghent.

1355年3月8日：The boroughs of the Duchy of Brabant and the Duchy of Limburg undertake to remain united under a single prince after the death of John III, Duke of Brabant, not allowing the territory to be divided among his heirs.
1356年1月3日：Joyous Entry of 1356: Joanna, Duchess of Brabant and her husband Wenceslaus I of Luxembourg sign the great charter of liberties of the Duchy of Brabant.
1370年：Extirpation of small Jewish population of Brabant after accusations of profaning eucharistic hosts.
1379年：Ghent Revolt led by Philip van Artevelde begins
1382年5月3日：Battle of Beverhoutsveld – men of Ghent take Bruges and gain control over most of the county of Flanders
1383年5月25日：Battle of Dunkirk

1384年1月30日：Louis II, Count of Flanders, last count of the House of Dampierre, dies; succeeded by his daughter Margaret III, Countess of Flanders, whose husband Philip the Bold ruled on her behalf: beginning of period of Burgundian rule in the Low Countries
1385年12月18日：Peace of Tournai ends the Ghent Revolt
1386年2月15日：Philip the Bold founds the Lille Chamber of Accounts to audit the accounts of his functionaries in the county of Flanders.
1387年11月2日：Oldest record of the incorporation of the Brussels guild of painters, goldbeaters and glassmakers.
1389年：John of Bavaria elected Prince-Bishop of Liège (resigned 1418).
1390年9月28日：Joanna, Duchess of Brabant secretly relinquishes possession of the Duchy of Brabant to her niece, Margaret of Male, and offspring thereof.
1392年11月1日：John of Bavaria, bishop-elect of Liège, writes to Philip the Bold to intercede for merchants from Liège arrested by the officers of Rethel.

1408年9月9日：John the Fearless takes fiscal measures to pay Alexander Stewart, Earl of Mar's archers joining him on the Liège campaign. (Letter bearing only known surviving signature of John the Fearless).
1411年：Suppression of the Homines Intelligentiae in Brussels.
1421年4月23日：Philip the Good transfers usufruct of the County of Namur to John of Flanders, Lord of Béthune, for the duration of his life.
1425年12月9日：Pope Martin V issues papal bull founding University of Leuven.
1441年：Tapestry weavers of Oudenaarde form the Guild of St Barbara.
1450年2月28日：Tournament held on the main square in Leuven in the presence of Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy and Brabant.
1451年10月28日：Guilds of Ghent take up arms against the Count of Flanders, Philip the Good.
1452年5月31日：Philip the Good declares war on the city of Ghent.
1453年7月23日：Battle of Gavere: forces of Philip the Good defeat rebels of Ghent, ending their rebellion.
1454年2月17日：The Feast of the Pheasant, a banquet given by Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy, held in Lille.
1458年8月3日：Tower of St. Peter's Church, Leuven, catches fire.
1464年：Estates General of 1464: first joint meeting of representatives of various territories of the Burgundian Netherlands.
1465年10月20日：Battle of Montenaken: forces of Philip the Good defeat Liège militiamen.
1466年：Dinant sacked by the forces of Philip the Good, commanded by Charles the Bold
1467年6月15日：Death of Philip the Good; Charles the Bold succeeds as Duke of Burgundy.
1468年7月3日：Marriage of Charles the Bold and Margaret of York (Now commemorated with the five-yearly Procession of the Golden Tree)
1469年7月1日：Charles the Bold grants Prince-Bishop Louis of Bourbon permission to begin rebuilding Liège.
links: Louis de Bourbon, Bishop of Liège

items.text: 1473年4月24日：Charles the Bold appointed mediator in the peace negotiations between Poland and Hungary.
1477年1月5日：Charles the Bold dies in the Battle of Nancy.
1478年7月22日：Birth of Philip the Fair
1479年8月7日：Battle of Guinegate: forces of Mary of Burgundy and her husband Maximilian I of Habsburg defeat forces of Louis XI of France.
1480年1月10日：Birth of Margaret of Burgundy
links: Margaret of Austria, Duchess of Savoy

items.text: 1482年3月27日：Mary of Burgundy dies as a result of having fallen from her horse while hawking some weeks earlier. Leaving an infant heir and a foreign husband, this set the scene for the Flemish revolts against Maximilian of Austria (1483–1485).
links: Flemish revolts against Maximilian of Austria

items.text: 1493年5月23日：Treaty of Senlis: Charles VIII of France cedes the County of Flanders and County of Artois to the House of Habsburg.
1495年1月20日：Wedding contracts concluded for the double marriage of Philip the Fair and Margaret of Burgundy to Joanna of Castile and John, Prince of Asturias.
links: Margaret of Austria, Duchess of Savoy

items.text: 1496年10月20日：Henry of Bergen, Bishop of Cambrai, celebrates nuptial mass of Philip the Handsome and Joanna of Castile at St Gummarus Church, Lier.
1500年2月24日：Birth of the future Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor, in Ghent.
1501年7月18日：Birth of Isabella of Austria, daughter of Philip of Burgundy and Joanna of Castile, future Queen of Christian II of Denmark.
1502年：Katherine Hasselet commissioned to produce a series of tapestries on the life of St Anatoile — now the oldest known Flemish tapestries extant
1509年6月25日：Pope Julius II grants indulgence for those contributing to the rebuilding of the collegiate church of Dinant, equal to the indulgence for a pilgrimage to Rome.
1511年4月2日：Érard de La Marck, Prince-Bishop of Liège, orders publication of Julius II's bull granting an indulgence for those contributing to the rebuilding of the collegiate church of Dinant.

1521年5月8日：Charles V issues decree for the Habsburg Netherlands prohibiting Lutheran preaching, teaching, printing or disputation, largely parallel to the Edict of Worms that he was to sign for the Empire as a whole on 26 May but providing more repressive powers to secular authorities.
1523年7月1日：Johann Esch and Heinrich Voes burned at the stake in Brussels for their adherence to Lutheran doctrines.

1526年1月14日：Peace of Madrid temporarily ends the war between Charles V and Francis I of France, with France briefly relinquishing all claim to the County of Flanders, County of Artois, Tournai and the Tournaisis, and the Duchy of Burgundy.
1531年9月26日：Mary of Hungary appointed regent over the Habsburg Netherlands.
1532年9月11日：Charles V issues decree establishing protocols and procedure of the reorganized Council of Luxembourg.
1540年10月4日：New edict requiring printers and booksellers to provide local magistrates with inventories of their stock.
1546年5月9日：University of Leuven issues the first index of prohibited books.
1542年8月：French forces plunder Arlon.
1544年：Peace of Crépy ends the war between Charles V and Francis I of France, returning status quo of 1538: Duchy of Luxembourg restored to the Habsburg Netherlands.
1549年9月12日：Edict regulating the organization of markets throughout the Habsburg Netherlands.
1559年4月12日：King Philip establishes the Royal Library of the Low Countries.
links: Royal Library of the Low Countries

items.text: 1566年4月5日：Compromise of Nobles petition Margaret of Parma to suspend the laws on heresy.
1567年3月15日：Attempted Calvinist coup in Antwerp.

1568年5月18日：Duke of Alva banishes thirty inhabitants of the city of Antwerp and their spouses, with forfeiture of property, for supporting or disseminating Calvinism – including the pensionary of the city, Jacques van Wesenbeke, and the head of the Calvinist consistory in Antwerp, the Portuguese merchant Marcus Perez.
links: Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, 3rd Duke of Alba

items.text: 1569年5月17日：Maximilien Morillon founds the first diocesan seminary in Mechelen.
1570年5月30日：Abraham Ortelius' Theatrum Orbis Terrarum published in Antwerp.
1572年7月3日：Gerard van Groesbeeck, Prince-Bishop of Liège, promulgates a new codification of the legal procedures in the principality's courts.
1574年6月6日：Don Luis de Requesens, Governor of the Habsburg Netherlands, issues general pardon to rebels willing to return to loyalty.

1575年6月16日：Philip II of Spain decrees that the change of year is to be counted from 1 January throughout the Habsburg Netherlands, rather than from Christmas (25 December), the Feast of the Annunciation (25 March) or Easter day, as was the custom in various parts.
1576年11月4日：Sack of Antwerp by Spanish mutineers from the Army of Flanders.

860年：Naddoðr discovers Iceland.He was heading to the Faroe Islands but drifted off course and landed near Reyðarfjörður in Iceland. As he returned to his boat it started to snow and thereby he reputedly named the land Snæland (lit. Snowland).

860年：Garðarr Svavarsson discovers Iceland.Blown from a storm near the Orkney Islands. He circumnavigated Iceland, thus the first to establish that the landmass was an island. He stayed for one winter in Skjálfandi. He praised the new land and called it Garðarshólmi (lit. Garðar's Islet).

1602年：The King of Denmark grants Danish merchants monopoly on trade with Iceland.
1615年：The Slaying of the Spaniards take place.
1625年：The first person, Jón Rögnvaldsson, is burnt alive for witchcraft.
1627年：The Turkish Abductions occur.Hundreds of Icelanders are kidnapped by Barbary pirates.
1639年：Brynjólfur Sveinsson becomes bishop of Skálholt.
1656年：Kirkjuból witch trial.
1656年：The Flateyjarbók manuscript is sent to Denmark.
1662年：Icelanders are made to accept the absolute monarchy of the King of Denmark.
1666年：The Passion Psalms are composed by Hallgrímur Pétursson.
1703年：First Icelandic census.
1707年：The Bubonic plague spreads in Iceland. A quarter of the population dies.
1712年：Jarðabók is completed.
1720年：The manuscripts of Árni Magnússon are moved to Denmark.
1760年：Icelanders start exporting salted fish to Spain.
1783年：The Mist Hardships occur.A volcanic eruption at Laki destroys a great deal of the livestock in Iceland, causing famine and misery. 20-25% of Iceland perishes.
1787年：Danish trade monopoly ceases.
1800年6月6日：The Althing is abolished.
1801年：The bishoprics of Skálholt and Hólar are united, located in Reykjavík.
1805年：The Bessastaðaskóli is founded.

1807年：Trade with Danish Iceland all but disappears due to the invasion of the English and their capture of the neutral Danish fleet at Copenhagen; they had credible intelligence that Napoleon using the Continental System was going to seize that fleet and invade England. It was part of the Napoleonic Wars.
1809年：Jørgen Jørgensen seizes power in Iceland and declares independence, but is deposed by the Danes shortly afterwards.
1835年：The first copy of Fjölnir is published.
1841年：Jón Sigurðsson starts publishing New Associated Writings.
1843年3月8日：The King of Denmark orders the Althing to be resurrected.
1845年7月1日：The Althing is resurrected, and the house of the Menntaskóli í Reykjavík is opened.
1851年：National Assembly of 1851.
1855年：The Danes grant Icelanders free trade.
1871年：The Danish Parliament passes the Stöðulög laws. First women's secondary school Kvennaskólinn í Reykjavík is founded by Thora Melsted.
1874年：The King of Denmark visits Iceland and grants Icelanders a constitution. 1000 years of settlement celebrated throughout the country.
1875年：First session of the restored Althing which has the power to pass laws. The Askja volcano erupts. The women's association Thorvaldsensfélagið is founded.
1880年：The climate grows much colder, driving many Icelanders to emigrate to the New World.
1894年：Foundation of the Hið íslenska kvenfélag and the start of the women's movement on Iceland.
1907年：Foundation of the Icelandic Women's Rights Association.
1915年：Universal suffrage.
1916年：The political parties Social Democratic Party and Progressive Party are founded.
1918年12月1日：Iceland becomes a sovereign, independent nation. The Danish King remains head of state.
1922年：Jarðræktarlögin.
1929年：The Icelandic Independence Party is founded.
1930年12月20日：The Icelandic Communist Party is founded. The Icelandic State Radio begins broadcasting.
1939年：Following the occupation of Denmark by Nazi Germany, a national emergency government is formed under Sveinn Björnsson.
1940年5月10日：The British invade, violating Icelandic neutrality.
1941年7月7日：The United States Army, still officially neutral, replaces the British occupation force.
1944年6月17日：Iceland becomes an independent republic, severing the last political ties to Denmark. Sveinn Björnsson becomes president.
1946年：The Keflavik Agreement.
1948年：Iceland receives Marshall Aid from the United States.
1949年3月30日：Riots break out on Austurvöllur.
1949年4月4日：Iceland joins the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.
1951年：The United States Army establishes a base in Keflavík.
1952年8月1日：Exclusive economic zone extended to 4 nautical miles. Ásgeir Ásgeirsson becomes president.
1958年：Exclusive economic zone extended to 12 nautical miles.
1963年11月14日：Volcanic eruption forms Surtsey.
1966年9月30日：The Icelandic State Television begins its first broadcasts.
1968年8月1日：Kristján Eldjárn becomes president. Collapse of the fishing industry.
1970年1月1日：Iceland joins the European Free Trade Association.
1972年：Exclusive economic zone extended to 50 nautical miles.
1973年1月23日：Volcanic eruption in Vestmannaeyjar.
1975年：Exclusive economic zone extended to 200 nautical miles.
1980年8月1日：Vigdís Finnbogadóttir becomes president of Iceland, the first woman in the world to become elected head of state.
1994年1月1日：Iceland joins the European Economic Area.
1996年8月1日：Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson becomes president.

2000年：Southern Iceland is hit by two earthquakes, the first 6.6 ML and the second 6.5 ML. There were no fatalities but a few people were injured and there was some considerable damage to infrastructure.
2004年6月2日：The president of Iceland, Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson, refuses to sign a bill from the parliament for the first time in the nation's history.
2005年3月21日：Bobby Fischer moves to Iceland after being granted an Icelandic passport and full citizenship.
2006年9月30日：The United States Army abandons the military base in Keflavík, thus ending a 55-year U.S. military presence in Iceland.
2008年5月29日：A doublet earthquake strikes southern Iceland with a composite magnitude of 6.1 MW.
2008年9月：Iceland faces financial crisis following the collapse of the country's three major commercial banks.
2009年1月26日：After months of rallies outside the parliament building, the Icelandic government resigns.
2009年2月1日：After the collapse of the government, Jóhanna Sigurðardóttir becomes the first female Prime Minister of Iceland and the world's first openly gay head of government of the modern era.
2009年7月16日：The parliament narrowly passes a bill authorising the government to apply for EU membership.
2010年1月5日：The president of Iceland, Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson, refuses to sign a bill from the parliament for the second time in the nation's history.
2010年：Volcanic eruption of Eyjafjallajökull.
2011年2月20日：The president of Iceland, Ólafur Ragnar Grímsson, refuses to sign a bill from the parliament for the third time in the nation's history.
2011年：Volcanic eruption of Grímsvötn.
2016年4月4日：Panama Papers reveal that Prime Minister Sigmundur Davíð Gunnlaugsson had links to private companies dealing in offshore tax havens, resulting in a call for a snap election.
2016年8月1日：Guðni Th. Jóhannesson becomes president of Iceland.
2024年6月1日：Halla Tómasdóttir won the 2024 Icelandic presidential election and assumed office in August.
前850000年：Oldest human habitation is discovered in Italy at Monte Poggiolo.
前50000年：Neanderthal presence in Italy.
前33000年：Paglicci 33 is discovered in Italy, the earliest evidence of Haplogroup I-M170.
前12000年：Villabruna 1 is discovered in Italy, the earliest evidence of Haplogroup R1b.
前6000年：Neolithic Italy begins with the spread of Cardium pottery.
前3345年：Otzi is born.
前3300年：Otzi is killed.
前3000年：Remedello culture. This is the first evidence of copper use in Italy.
前3000年：The Rinaldone culture appears.
前1800年：Nuragic civilization in Sardinia.
前1700年：Terramare culture. Recent archeology, along with ancient Greek accounts, links this culture to the Etruscans.
前1500年：Apennine culture.
前1300年：Canegrate culture.
前1200年：Proto-Villanovan culture appears in Italy. It is likely a southern extension of the Urnfield culture. This is possibly the introduction of Italic peoples into the peninsula.
前1194年：According to tradition, the beginning of the Trojan War.
前1184年：According to tradition, the end of the Trojan War and the beginning of the Trojan hero Aeneas's journey when he escaped the Greeks with others in search of a new land.
前1181年：According to legend, Aeneas lands in Italy, marries Lavinia, the daughter of Latinus, king of the Latins.
前1151年：Alba Longa is founded. According to legend, Alba Longa was founded by Ascanius, the son of Aeneas.
前800年：Etruscan civilization. First evidence of Old Italic script.
前753年：Rome was founded. According to Roman legend, Romulus was the founder and first king of Rome, beginning the Roman Kingdom.
前720年：The first Greek colony of Magna Graecia in mainland Italy, Kyme, is founded.
前715年：Numa Pompilius became the second King of Rome.
前706年：Spartan immigrants found the colony of Taranto in Magna Graecia, Southern Italy.
前673年：Tullus Hostilius became the third King of Rome.
前667年：Byzantium was founded by Megarian colonists.
前642年：Tullus Hostilius died.
前642年：The Curiate Assembly, one of the legislative assemblies of the Roman Kingdom, elected Ancus Marcius King of Rome.
links: Legislative Assemblies of the Roman Kingdom

items.text: 前630年：The lyric poet Stesichorus is born in Calabria in Southern Italy.
前617年：Ancus Marcius died.
前616年：The Curiate Assembly elected Lucius Tarquinius Priscus King of Rome.
前579年：Lucius Tarquinius Priscus was killed in a riot instigated by the sons of Ancus Marcius.
前575年：The Senate accepted the regent Servius Tullius as king of Rome.
前540年：The Ancient Greek city of Elea is founded in Southern Italy.
前535年：Servius Tullius was murdered by his daughter Tullia Minor and her husband Lucius Tarquinius Superbus, who declared himself King of Rome on the steps of the Curia Hostilia.
前509年：The patrician Lucretia was raped by Lucius Tarquinius Superbus's son Sextus Tarquinius.

前509年：Overthrow of the Roman monarchy: Following Lucretia's suicide, Lucius Junius Brutus called the Curiate Assembly, one of the legislative assemblies of the Roman Kingdom who agreed to the overthrow and expulsion of Lucius Tarquinius Superbus and to a provisional constitution.
links: Legislative Assemblies of the Roman Kingdom

items.text: 前509年：Battle of Silva Arsia: Tarquinian and Veientine forces loyal to Lucius Tarquinius Superbus were defeated in the Silva Arsia by a Roman army. Lucius Junius Brutus was killed. Publius Valerius Publicola, returning to Rome with the spoils of war, was awarded the first Roman Triumph on 1 March.

前509年：The consul Publius Valerius Publicola promulgated a number of liberal reforms, including opening the office of consul to all Roman citizens and placing the treasury under the administration of appointed quaestors.
前509年：The Temple of Jupiter Optimus Maximus was ceremonially dedicated to the Capitoline Triad.
前508年：Roman–Etruscan Wars: A Clusian army failed to conquer Rome.

前501年：In the face of a potential Sabine invasion, the Senate passed a senatus consultum authorizing the consuls to appoint a dictator, a magistrate who held absolute power during a national emergency. The dictator would in turn appoint the Magister equitum, the commander of the cavalry. The consuls Titus Larcius and Postumus Cominius Auruncus selected the former as dictator.
前496年：Battle of Lake Regillus: Latin League invasion near modern Frascati which sought to reinstall Lucius Tarquinius Superbus.
前494年：First secessio plebis: Lucius Sicinius Vellutus, the plebs abandoned Rome for the nearby Monte Sacro.
前474年：The Battle of Cumae occurs, resulting in a Siracusani and Cumaea victory against the Etruscans and ending Etruscan expansion in Southern Italy.
前471年：After a law allowing organization of the plebs tribe, the Plebeian Council was reorganized by tribes rather than curiae.
前459年：Under popular pressure, the Senate increased the tribunes of the plebs from two to ten.

前458年：During the first dictatorship of Cincinnatus, the Aequians staged an offensive, breaking a truce. Cincinnatus defeated the Aquians at the Battle of Mount Algidus and after a triumph, returned to his farm after sixteen days.
前449年：Resolutions of the Plebeian Council were given the full force of law subject to Senate veto.
前449年：The second of two decemviri, specially-elected ten man commissions, issued the last of the Twelve Tables, the fundamental laws of the Republic.
前447年：The Tribal Assembly was established, and granted the right to elect quaestors.
前445年：Marriage between patricians and plebeians was legalized.

前443年：The offices of the Tribuni militum consulari potestate were established. A collegium of three patrician or plebeian tribunes, one each from specific Roman tribes (the Titienses, the Ramnenses, and the Luceres), would hold the power of the consuls from year to year, subject to the Senate.
前443年：The office of the censor, a patrician magistrate responsible for conducting the census in years without a consul, was established.

前439年：Cincinnatus accepted second dictatorship to prevent Spurius Maelius from seizing power; the patricians suspected Spurius of plotting to set himself up as a king. Gaius Servilius Ahala was appointed magister equitum and slew Maelius. Cincinnatus again resigned his dictatorship and returned to his farm after 21 days.
前435年：Fidenae, an important trade post on the Tiber, was captured from the Veii.
前408年：The Tribuni militum consulari potestate held office.
前396年：Battle of Veii: Roman forces led by the dictator Marcus Furius Camillus conquered Veii.
前396年：Roman soldiers first earned a salary ("salary" from Latin for "salt").
前394年：The consuls held office.
前391年：The Tribuni militum consulari potestate held office.
前390年：Battle of the Allia: The Senones routed a Roman force at the confluence of the rivers Allia and Tiber.
前390年：The Senones sacked Rome.
前367年：The consuls held office.
前366年：Lucius Sextius was elected the first plebeian consul.
前366年：The office of Praetor, which took the judiciary responsibilities of the consul and could be held only by a patrician, was established.
前351年：The first plebeian dictator was elected.
前351年：The first plebeian censor was elected.
前343年：Samnite Wars: Rome marched against the Samnites, probably after an appeal from the Campanians.
前343年：Battle of Mount Gaurus: A Samnite force was routed by a Roman army near Mount Barbaro.
前342年：The Leges Genuciae were passed, banning a person from holding two offices at the same time, or during any ten-year period; charging interest on loans was also banned.
前341年：Samnite Wars: The Senate agreed a peace, following an appeal by the Samnite to a previous treaty of friendship.
前340年：Latin War: The Latin League invaded Samnium.
前339年：A law was passed which required the election of at least three plebeian censor every five years.
前338年：Latin War: Rome defeated the Latin League armies.
前337年：The first plebeian Praetor was elected.
前328年：Samnite Wars: Rome declared war on the Samnites after their failure to prevent their subjects raiding Fregellae.
前321年：Battle of the Caudine Forks: After being trapped in a mountain pass near Caudium without a water supply, Roman forces were allowed to retreat by a Samnite army.
前315年：Battle of Lautulae: A decisive Samnite victory near Terracina split Roman territory in two.
前311年：Samnite Wars: The Etruscans laid siege to Sutri.
前310年：Battle of Lake Vadimo (310 BC): Rome inflicted a substantial military defeat on the Etruscans at Lake Vadimo.
前308年：Samnite Wars: The Umbri, Picentes and Marsi joined the Samnites against Rome.
前306年：The Hernici declared their independence from Rome.
前305年：Battle of Bovianum: A Roman force destroyed the majority of the Samnite army.
前304年：Rome conquered the Aequi.
前304年：Samnite Wars: The treaty of friendship between the Romans and Samnites was restored.
前304年：The Greek tyrant Agathocles takes the title of king of Sicily.
前300年：The Lex Ogulnia was passed, allowing plebeians to become priests.
前298年：Samnite Wars: Rome declared war on the Samnites after an appeal by the Lucani.
前298年：Samnite Wars: Rome captured the Samnite cities of Bojano and Castel di Sangro.
前297年：Battle of Tifernum: A Roman army defeated a numerically superior Samnite force at Città di Castello.

前295年：Battle of Sentinum: A Roman army decisively defeated a numerically superior force of Samnites, Etruscans, Umbri and Senones in coalition at Sentinum. The consul Publius Decius Mus (consul 312 BC) was killed.
前294年：Samnite Wars: Roman and Samnite forces battled at Lucera.
前293年：Battle of Aquilonia: A Roman army destroyed the majority of Samnite forces, probably in modern Agnone.
前293年：A census counted about 270,000 residents of Rome.
前291年：Samnite Wars: Rome conquered and colonized the Samnite city of Venosa.
前290年：Samnite Wars: The last effective Samnite resistance was eliminated.
前289年：Agathocles dies, and democracy is restored in Syracuse due to his wish to not have his sons succeed him as king.
前287年：Conflict of the Orders: A secessio plebis took place.
前287年：Conflict of the Orders: The Lex Hortensia was passed, ending the power of the Senate to veto resolutions of the Plebeian Council.
前283年：Battle of Lake Vadimo (283 BC): A Roman army defeated a combined force of Etruscans, Boii and Senones near Lake Vadimo.
前281年：Taranto appealed to Epirus for aid against Rome.
前280年：Pyrrhic War: An Epirote army of some 25,000 landed at Taranto.
前280年：Battle of Heraclea: A Greek coalition force led by the Epirote king Pyrrhus of Epirus defeated a Roman army after their deployment of war elephants at Heraclea Lucania.
前279年：Battle of Asculum: A Greek force led by the Epirote king Pyrrhus defeated a Roman army at modern Ascoli Satriano, despite suffering heavy losses.
前275年：Battle of Beneventum (275 BC): Roman and Epirote armies met in a bloody battle at Benevento.
前272年：Pyrrhic War: Pyrrhus withdrew with his army to Epirus.
前272年：Pyrrhic War: Taranto surrendered to Rome.
前267年：The number of quaestors was raised from four to ten.
前264年：Battle of Messana: A Roman force defeated a Carthaginian and Siracusani garrison at Messina.
前242年：The office of the praetor qui inter peregrinos ius dicit, a Praetor with jurisdiction over foreigners, was created.
前241年：First Punic War: Sicily was organized as the province of Sicilia.
前238年：Mercenary War: Carthage surrendered its claims on Sardinia and Corsica to Rome.
前229年：Illyrian Wars: Rome invaded the territory of the Ardiaei.
前228年：Illyrian Wars: The Ardiaei surrendered some territory, including strategically significant ports, to Rome, ending the war.
前225年：Battle of Telamon: A Roman army decisively defeated a Gallic invasion near modern Talamone. The consul Gaius Atilius Regulus was killed.
前219年：Illyrian Wars: Rome invaded Hvar.
前218年：Second Punic War: A Carthaginian army departed Cartagena.
前218年：Illyrian Wars: Demetrius of Pharos fled to Macedonia.
前216年：Battle of Cannae: The Carthaginian general Hannibal decisively defeated a numerically superior Roman force at Cannae.
前214年：First Macedonian War: A Macedonian fleet captured Oricum.
前214年：Siege of Syracuse (214–212 BC): Rome laid siege to Syracuse.
前212年：Siege of Syracuse (214–212 BC): Roman forces breached the inner citadel of Syracuse and slaughtered its inhabitants.

前205年：First Macedonian War: Rome and Macedonia signed the Treaty of Phoenice, according to which Macedonia renounced its alliance with Carthage in exchange for Roman recognition of its gains in Illyria.
前205年：All the cities of Magna Graecia lost their independence and were annexed to the Roman Republic.
前204年：Second Punic War: The consul Scipio Africanus landed an invasion fleet at Utica.
前202年：Battle of Zama: A Roman army decisively defeated Carthage, probably near modern Sakiet Sidi Youssef.
前202年：Scipio defeats Hannibal in Africa at the Battle of Zama ending the Second Punic War
前201年：Second Punic War: Carthage accepted Roman conditions for peace, including disarmament, a war indemnity of ten thousand talents, and the cession of Iberia, ending the war.
前200年：Second Macedonian War: A Roman fleet arrived in Illyria to relieve a Macedonian siege of Abydos.
前197年：The provinces of Hispania Ulterior and Hispania Citerior were organized.
前197年：The number of quaestors was increased to twelve.
前197年：The number of Praetors was increased to six.
前196年：Second Macedonian War: Macedonia surrendered its conquests in Greece and agreed to pay a war indemnity, ending the war.
前192年：Roman–Seleucid War: The Seleucid Empire invaded Greece.

前188年：Roman–Seleucid War: The Seleucid Empire signed the Treaty of Apamea, under which it surrendered all territory west of the Taurus Mountains to the Roman clients Rhodes and Pergamon and agreed to disarm its navy and pay a war indemnity of fifteen thousand talents of silver to Rome.
前180年：The Lex Villia annalis, which established minimum ages for high office and required a minimum of two years in private life between offices, was passed.
前172年：Third Macedonian War: Rome declared war on Macedonia.
前167年：Third Macedonian War: The Macedonian king Perseus of Macedon was captured. Macedonia was divided into four districts subject to Rome.
前155年：Lusitanian War: The Lusitanians of Hispania Ulterior rebelled against Rome.
前150年：Fourth Macedonian War: An Andriscus rebelled against Rome, claiming to be Perseus's son and the rightful king of Macedonia.
前149年：Third Punic War: Rome declared war on Carthage.
前149年：The Lex Calpurnia was passed, establishing a Praetor-led court to hear appeals against extortionate taxes levied by governors in the provinces.
前148年：Fourth Macedonian War: Andriscus was surrendered to Rome to be executed.
前146年：Third Punic War: Roman forces breached the city of Carthage, burned it, and enslaved its surviving inhabitants.
前146年：Battle of Corinth (146 BC): Roman forces decisively defeated the armies of the Achaean League at Corinth.
前146年：The province of Macedonia was organized.
前146年：The province of Africa was organized on captured Carthaginian territory.
前139年：Lusitanian War: The Lusitanian leader Viriatus was assassinated by his three ambassadors to Rome Audax, Ditalcus and Minurus.
前135年：The First Servile War, an unsuccessful slave revolt against the Roman Republic, begins.
前133年：The Tribune of the Plebs Tiberius Gracchus was beaten to death by a mob of senators led by the Pontifex Maximus Publius Cornelius Scipio Nasica Serapio (consul 138 BC).
links: Publius Cornelius Scipio Nasica Serapio (consul 138 BC)

items.text: 前121年：The province of Gallia Narbonensis was organized.
前121年：The first Senatus consultum ultimum was passed, granting the consul Lucius Opimius emergency powers to defeat the partisans of Gaius Gracchus.
前112年：Jugurthine War: Rome declared war on Numidia.
前107年：Gaius Marius was elected consul.
前106年：Marius was reelected consul.
前106年：Jugurthine War: The Numidian king Jugurtha was imprisoned in the Mamertine Prison.
前105年：Battle of Arausio: A coalition of the Cimbri and Teutons inflicted a serious defeat on the Roman army at modern Orange. Some hundred thousand Roman soldiers were killed.
前104年：Marius was elected consul for the first of three years in a row.
前104年：The Second Servile War, another failed slave rebellion against the Romans, begins.
前102年：Battle of Aquae Sextiae: Rome decisively defeated the forces of the Teutons and Ambrones and killed some ninety thousand soldiers and civilians.

前101年：Battle of Vercellae: An invasion of Italy by the Cimbri was decisively defeated by a numerically inferior Roman force. Some hundred thousand Cimbri soldiers and civilians were killed along with their king Boiorix.
前100年：Julius Caesar is born.
前100年：Marius was elected consul.
前100年：Assassin hired by Lucius Appuleius Saturninus and Gaius Servilius Glaucia beat to death Gaius Memmius, a candidate for the consulship.
前91年：The assassination of a tribune named Marcus Livius Drusus helps spark the Marsic War.

前91年：Social War (91–88 BC): The Roman clients in Italy the Marsi, the Paeligni, the Vestini, the Marrucini, the Picentes, the Fretani, the Hirpini, the Iapyges, Pompeii, Venosa, Lucania and Samnium rebelled against Rome.
前88年：The Marsic War ends in a Roman military victory, though the rest of Italians were granted rights.
前88年：The Roman consul Sulla led an army of his partisans across the pomerium into Rome.
前88年：Social War (91–88 BC): The war started.
前87年：First Mithridatic War: Roman forces landed at Epirus.
前85年：First Mithridatic War: A peace was agreed between Rome and Pontus under which the latter returned to its prewar borders.
前83年：Sulla's civil war: Sulla landed with an army at Brindisi.
前83年：Second Mithridatic War: The Roman general Lucius Licinius Murena invaded Pontus.
前82年：Sulla's civil war: Sulla was declared dictator.
前81年：Second Mithridatic War: Murena withdrew from Pontus.
前80年：Sertorian War: Quintus Sertorius landed on the Iberian Peninsula in support of a Lusitanian rebellion.
前73年：The Third Servile War begins; one of the participants is the famous Thracian gladiator known as Spartacus.
前73年：Third Mithridatic War: Pontus invaded Bithynia.
前73年：Third Servile War: Some seventy gladiators, slaves of Lentulus Batiatus in Capua, made a violent escape.
前72年：Sertorian War: Marcus Perpenna Vento, by now the leader of the Romans in revolt in Iberia, was executed by the general Pompey.
前71年：Like the other Servile Wars, the Third Servile War ends in a Roman victory against the uprising slaves.
前71年：Third Servile War: The slaves in rebellion were decisively defeated by Roman forces near Petelia. Their leader Spartacus was killed.
前66年：The last of the Cilician pirates were wiped out by Pompey.
前63年：Third Mithridatic War: Defeated, the Pontic king Mithridates VI of Pontus ordered his friend and bodyguard to kill him.
前63年：Siege of Jerusalem (63 BC): Pompey conquered Jerusalem and entered the Holy of Holies of the Second Temple.
前63年：Cicero was elected consul.
