前63年：Second Catilinarian conspiracy: A conspiracy led by the senator Catiline to overthrow the Republic was exposed before the Senate. The five conspirators present were summarily executed in the Mamertine Prison.
前59年：Pompey joined a political alliance, the so-called First Triumvirate, with the consul Julius Caesar and the censor Marcus Licinius Crassus.
前58年：Gallic Wars: Roman forces barred the westward migration of the Helvetii across the Rhône.
前53年：Battle of Carrhae: A Parthian army decisively defeated a numerically superior Roman invasion force near Harran. Crassus was killed.
前50年：Gallic Wars: The last Gaulish rebels were defeated.
前49年：Caesar's Civil War: Caesar illegally crossed the Rubicon into Italy with his army.
前48年：Caesar's Civil War: Caesar landed at Durrës in pursuit of Pompey and his partisans the optimates.
前46年：Caesar left Africa for Iberia in pursuit of Pompey's sons Gnaeus Pompeius (son of Pompey the Great) and Sextus Pompey.
links: Gnaeus Pompeius (son of Pompey the Great)

items.text: 前44年：Assassination of Julius Caesar: Caesar was assassinated in the Theatre of Pompey by a conspiracy of senators.
前44年：Julius Caesar is assassinated.
前43年：The Lex Titia was passed, granting the Second Triumvirate of Augustus, Mark Antony and Marcus Aemilius Lepidus (triumvir) the power to make and annul laws and appoint magistrates.
前42年：Liberators' civil war: Augustus and Antony led some thirty legions to northern Greece in pursuit of Caesar's assassins Marcus Junius Brutus the Younger and Gaius Cassius Longinus.
前42年：Liberators' civil war: Brutus committed suicide after being defeated in battle.
前33年：Antony's Parthian War: A campaign led by Antony against the Parthian Empire ended in failure.
前33年：The Second Triumvirate expired.
前31年：Battle of Actium: Forces loyal to Augustus defeated Antony and his lover Cleopatra, queen of Egypt, in a naval battle near Actium.
前30年：Final War of the Roman Republic: Antony's forces defected to Augustus. He committed suicide.
links: Final War of the Roman Republic

items.text: 前30年：Cleopatra committed suicide, probably in Roman custody and by snakebite.
前30年：The province of Egypt was organized. Augustus took the title pharaoh.
前29年：Moesia was annexed to Rome.
前29年：Cantabrian Wars: Rome deployed some eighty thousand soldiers against the Cantabri in Iberia.
前27年：The Senate granted Augustus the titles augustus, majestic, and princeps, first.
前25年：Augustus indicated his nephew Marcus Claudius Marcellus (Julio-Claudian dynasty) as his chosen successor by marrying him to his only daughter Julia the Elder.
前25年：The Roman client Amyntas of Galatia died. Augustus organized his territory as the province of Galatia.
前24年：Augustus' campaigns against the Cantabrians in Hispania Tarraconensis, the Cantabrian Wars, ended.
前23年：Coinage reform of Augustus: Augustus centralized the minting of and reformed the composition and value of the Roman currency.
前23年：Marcellus died.
前21年：Augustus married Julia to his general Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa.
前19年：Cantabrian Wars: The last major combat operations ended. The Cantabri and Astures were pacified.
前17年：Augustus adopted the sons of Agrippa and Julia, his grandsons Gaius Caesar and Lucius Caesar, as his own sons.
前16年：Raetia and Noricum were conquered and annexed to Rome.
前12年：Germanic Wars: Roman forces crossed the Rhine into Germania.
前12年：Agrippa died of fever.
前11年：Augustus married Julia to his general and stepson Tiberius.
前9年：The Roman general Nero Claudius Drusus died from injuries sustained falling from a horse.
前9年：Pannonia was annexed and incorporated into Illyricum.
前6年：Augustus offered Tiberius tribunician power and imperium over the eastern half of the Empire. Tiberius refused, announcing his retirement to Hodson.
前2年：Augustus was acclaimed Pater Patriae, father of the country, by the Senate.
前2年：Augustus convicted Julia of adultery and treason, annulled her marriage to Tiberius, and exiled her with her mother Scribonia to Ventotene.
10年：Tiberius assumed command of Roman forces in Germania.
10年：Illyricum was divided into the provinces of Pannonia and Dalmatia.
13年：Tiberius was granted power equal to Augustus as co-princeps.
14年8月19日：Augustus died.
14年：Germanicus, son of Nero Claudius Drusus and adoptive son of Tiberius, was appointed commander of Roman forces in Germania.
14年：Germanicus and Tiberius's natural son Drusus Julius Caesar were sent to suppress mutinies in Germania and Pannonia, respectively.
15年：Lucius Seius Strabo was appointed governor of Egypt. His son Sejanus remained as the sole prefect of the Praetorian Guard.
16年：Battle of the Weser River: A Roman army led by Germanicus decisively defeated a Germanic force on the Weser.
17年：Archelaus of Cappadocia, king in Cappadocia and a Roman client, died. Tiberius annexed his territory, organizing it as the province of Cappadocia.
17年：Antiochus III of Commagene, king of Commagene and a Roman client, died. Tiberius annexed his territory to the province of Syria.
18年：Tiberius granted Germanicus imperium over the eastern half of the Empire.
19年10月10日：Germanicus died in Antioch, possibly after being poisoned on Tiberius's orders.
22年：Tiberius granted Drusus Julius Caesar tribunician power, marking him as his choice as successor.
23年9月14日：Drusus Julius Caesar died, possibly after being poisoned by Sejanus or his wife Livilla.
26年：Tiberius retired to Capri, leaving Sejanus in control of Rome through his office.
28年：The Frisii hanged their Roman tax collectors and expelled the governor.
29年：Livia, Augustus's widow and Tiberius's mother, died.
31年10月18日：Sejanus was executed on Tiberius's orders.
31年：Tiberius invited Germanicus's son Caligula to join him on Capri.
37年3月16日：Tiberius died. His will left his offices jointly to Caligula and Drusus Julius Caesar's son, his grandson Tiberius Gemellus.
38年：Tiberius Gemellus was murdered on Caligula's orders.
40年：Ptolemy of Mauretania, king of Mauretania and a Roman client, was murdered on Caligula's orders during a state visit to Rome. His slave Aedemon rose in revolt against Roman rule.
41年：The general Gaius Suetonius Paulinus was appointed to suppress the rebellion in Mauretania.
41年1月24日：Caligula was assassinated by the centurion Cassius Chaerea.
41年1月24日：The Praetorian Guard acclaimed Nero Claudius Drusus's son Claudius princeps.
41年：Claudius restored the Judean monarchy under king Herod Agrippa.
42年：The territory of the former Mauretania was organized into the provinces of Mauretania Caesariensis and Mauretania Tingitana.
43年：Roman conquest of Britain: The senator Aulus Plautius led four legions into Great Britain in support of king Verica of the Atrebates.
43年：Claudius annexed Lycia into the Empire as a province.
46年：The Odrysian king Rhoemetalces III, a Roman client, was killed by anti-Roman insurgents.
46年：Odrysia was incorporated into the Empire as the province of Thracia.
48年：Claudius's wife Messalina was executed for conspiracy.
48年：Claudius appointed Herod Agrippa's son Herod Agrippa II king of Judea.
49年：Claudius married his niece, Germanicus's daughter Agrippina the Younger.
50年：Claudius adopted Agrippina's son Nero as his own son.
54年10月13日：Claudius died after being poisoned by Agrippina. Nero succeeded him as princeps.
55年2月11日：Claudius's young natural son Britannicus died, probably by poison.
58年：Roman–Parthian War of 58–63: Roman forces attacked Armenia in support of their preferred king Tigranes VI of Armenia against the Parthian candidate Tiridates I of Armenia.
59年3月23日：Agrippina died, probably murdered by her son Nero.
60年：Boudica, a queen of the Iceni, was appointed to lead a revolt of the Iceni and the Trinovantes against Rome.
61年：Battle of Watling Street: Some eighty thousand soldiers and civilians among the Iceni and Trinovantes were killed, probably in the modern West Midlands, ending Boudica's revolt.
63年：Roman–Parthian War of 58–63: The Roman and Parthian Empires agreed that Tiridates and his descendants would remain kings of Armenia as Roman clients, ending the war.
64年7月18日：Great Fire of Rome: A fire began which would cause massive property damage and loss of life over six days in Rome.
64年：Nero began construction of his large and extravagant villa the Domus Aurea.
65年4月19日：Pisonian conspiracy: Nero was informed of a broad conspiracy to assassinate him and appoint the senator Gaius Calpurnius Piso leader of Rome.
66年：First Jewish–Roman War: The Jewish population of Judea revolted against Roman rule.

68年6月9日：Nero, then in hiding in the villa of the freedman Phaon (freedman), was notified that the Senate had declared him an enemy of the state and ordered him brought to the Forum to be publicly beaten to death. He ordered his secretary Epaphroditos to kill him.
68年6月9日：The Senate accepted Galba, governor of Hispania Tarraconensis, as ruler of Rome.
68年：Zealot Temple Siege: The forces of Ananus ben Ananus, the Jewish former High Priest of Israel, laid siege to the Zealots in the Second Temple.
69年1月15日：The Praetorian Guard assassinated Galba and acclaimed Otho ruler of Rome.
69年4月16日：Following his defeat by Vitellius, the commander of the Roman army on the lower Rhine, near modern Calvatone, and to prevent further civil war, Otho committed suicide.
69年：Revolt of the Batavi: Gaius Julius Civilis, commander of the Batavi auxiliaries in the Rhine legions, turned against Rome.
69年12月：The Senate recognized Vespasian, the commander of Roman forces in Egypt and Judea, as ruler of Rome.
69年12月22日：Vitellius was executed in Rome by troops loyal to Vespasian.
70年：Revolt of the Batavi: Following a series of battlefield reversals, Civilis accepted peace terms from the Roman general Quintus Petillius Cerialis.
70年9月：Siege of Jerusalem (70 CE): The Roman general Titus breached the walls of Jerusalem, sacked the city and destroyed the Second Temple.
71年：Roman conquest of Britain: Roman forces entered modern Scotland.
73年4月16日：Siege of Masada: Roman forces breached the walls of Masada, a mountain fortress held by the Jewish extremist sect the Sicarii.
77年：Gnaeus Julius Agricola was appointed consul and governor of Britain.
79年6月23日：Vespasian died. He was succeeded by his son Titus.

79年8月24日：Eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79: Mount Vesuvius erupted, destroying the cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum. The eruption of Mount Vesuvius spews massive amounts of volcanic gas, ash, and molten rock. Several Roman settlements, including Pompeii and Herculaneum, are annihilated and buried under colossal amounts of ashfall deposits and rock fragments.
80年：Rome was partially destroyed by fire.
80年3月：The Colosseum was completed.
81年9月13日：Titus died of fever. He was succeeded by his younger brother Domitian.
85年：Agricola was recalled to Rome.
86年：Domitian's Dacian War: The Dacian king Decebalus invaded Moesia.
88年：Domitian's Dacian War: Decebalus agreed to return all Roman prisoners of war and accept his status as a Roman client in exchange for an annual subsidy of eight million sestertii, ending the war.
89年1月1日：Lucius Antonius Saturninus, governor of Germania Superior, revolted against Domitian's rule.
89年：Saturninus was executed.
96年9月18日：Domitian was assassinated by members of the royal household.
96年9月18日：Nerva was declared ruler of Rome by the Senate.
97年：Nerva adopted the general and former consul Trajan as his son.
98年1月27日：Nerva died. Trajan succeeded him.
101年：First Dacian War: Rome invaded Dacia.
101年9月：Second Battle of Tapae: Dacian forces retreated from contact with the Romans at Tapae.
102年：First Dacian War: The Dacian king Decebalus reaffirmed his loyalty to Rome, ending the war.
105年：Second Dacian War: Trajan responded to the resumption of raids on Roman settlements in Moesia by invading Dacia.
106年：Battle of Sarmisegetusa: Roman forces breached the Dacian capital Sarmizegetusa Regia. The Dacian king Decebalus escaped to the east.
106年：The Nabatean king Rabbel II Soter died.
106年3月22日：Nabatea was annexed to the Roman empire as the province of Arabia Petraea.
106年：Second Dacian War: The Dacian king Decebalus committed suicide in his fortification at Ranisstorum to avoid capture.
107年：The province of Dacia was organized.
112年：Trajan's Forum was inaugurated.
113年：Roman–Parthian Wars: Trajan launched an expedition against Parthia.
113年：Trajan's Column was erected in Trajan's Forum to commemorate the victory over Dacia.
114年：Trajan deposed the Armenian king Parthamasiris of Armenia, a Roman client, and organized the province of Armenia on his territory.
115年：Kitos War: The Jews in Cyrene rose up against Roman authority.
116年：The provinces of Mesopotamia and Assyria were organized on territory conquered from Parthia.
116年：Trajan captured the Parthian capital Ctesiphon and deposed its shah Osroes I in favor of his son Parthamaspates of Parthia.
117年：Kitos War: Roman forces captured the rebel stronghold of Lod and executed many of its inhabitants.
117年8月8日：Trajan died.
117年8月10日：The Senate accepted the general Hadrian as ruler of Rome, following the appearance of documents indicating he had been adopted by Trajan.
117年：Osroes I deposed his son Parthamaspates of Parthia and replaced him as shah of Parthia.
118年：Hadrian withdrew from the territories of Armenia, Assyria and Mesopotamia, allowing the return of their respective client monarchies.
119年：A rebellion took place in Britain.
122年：The construction of Hadrian's Wall at the northern border of Britain began.
123年：Hadrian arrived in Mauretania to suppress a local revolt.
124年：Hadrian travelled to Greece.
126年：Hadrian returned to Rome.
126年：The rebuilt Pantheon was dedicated to Agrippa, its original builder.
132年：Bar Kokhba revolt: Simon bar Kokhba, believed by his followers to be the Messiah, launched a revolt against Roman authority in Judea.

135年：Bar Kokhba revolt: The revolt ended at a cost of tens of thousands of Roman soldiers and some six hundred thousand Jewish rebels and civilians, including bar Kokhba, killed. Judea and Syria were combined into the single province of Syria Palaestina.
136年：Hadrian adopted Lucius Aelius as his son and successor.
138年1月1日：Lucius Aelius died.
138年2月25日：Hadrian adopted Antoninus Pius as his son and successor and granted him tribunician power and imperium, on the condition that he in turn adopt Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus as his sons.
138年7月10日：Hadrian died, probably from heart failure.
138年7月11日：Antoninus succeeded Hadrian.
141年：Roman conquest of Britain: Roman forces invaded modern Scotland under the command of the British governor Quintus Lollius Urbicus.
142年：The construction of the Antonine Wall at the northern border of Britain began.
161年3月7日：Antoninus died. He was succeeded by Marcus and Lucius Verus.
161年：Roman–Parthian War of 161–166: The Parthian Empire deposed the Armenian king Sohaemus of Armenia, a Roman client, and installed Bakur.
165年：Antonine Plague: A pandemic, probably of smallpox or measles, began which would kill some five million people throughout the Roman Empire.
166年：Roman–Parthian War of 161–166: Roman forces sacked the Parthian capital Ctesiphon.
169年：Lucius Verus died of disease, leaving Marcus the sole ruler of Rome.
169年：Marcomannic Wars: A coalition of Germanic tribes led by the Marcomanni invaded the Roman Empire across the Danube.
175年：Marcomannic Wars: Rome and the Iazyges signed a treaty under which the latter agreed to return Roman prisoners of war and supply troops to the Auxilia, ending the war.
177年：Marcus named his natural son Commodus co-ruler with himself.
180年3月17日：Marcus died.
180年：Antonine Plague: The pandemic ended.
184年：The Antonine Wall was abandoned by Roman forces.
192年12月31日：Commodus was strangled to death.
193年1月1日：The Praetorian Guard acclaimed the consul Pertinax ruler of Rome at the Castra Praetoria.
193年3月28日：Pertinax was assassinated by the Praetorian Guard.
193年3月28日：The Praetorian Guard acclaimed the former consul Didius Julianus, who had provided the highest bid, ruler of Rome.
193年4月9日：Pescennius Niger, the legatus Augusti pro praetore of Syria Palaestina, was proclaimed ruler of Rome by his legions.
193年4月14日：The Legio XIV Gemina acclaimed its commander Septimius Severus ruler of Rome at Carnuntum.
193年5月：The Senate recognized Septimius Severus as ruler of Rome and sentenced Julianus to death.
194年：Battle of Issus (194): Niger's forces were decisively defeated by the armies of Septimius Severus at Issus.
196年：Clodius Albinus, the commander of Roman troops in Britain and Iberia, took the title Imperator Caesar Decimus Clodius Septimius Albinus Augustus.
197年2月19日：Battle of Lugdunum: Septimius Severus and Albinus met in battle at Lugdunum.
197年2月19日：Albinus committed suicide or was killed.
197年：Roman–Parthian Wars: Septimius Severus sacked the Parthian capital Ctesiphon.
198年：Septimius Severus appointed his eldest natural son Caracalla co-ruler with himself.
208年：Roman invasion of Caledonia 208–210: Septimius Severus invaded modern Scotland.
209年：Septimius Severus named his youngest natural son Publius Septimius Geta co-ruler with himself and Caracalla.
211年2月4日：Septimius Severus died.
211年：Roman invasion of Caledonia 208–210: Caracalla ended the campaign.
211年12月26日：Geta was murdered in his mother's arms by members of the Praetorian Guard loyal to Caracalla.
217年4月8日：Caracalla was assassinated by a member of his bodyguard.
217年4月8日：The Praetorian Guard acclaimed their prefect Macrinus ruler of Rome.
218年6月8日：Macrinus was captured and executed by an army loyal to Elagabalus, supposedly the illegitimate son of Caracalla.
222年3月11日：Elagabalus was assassinated by the Praetorian Guard, which installed his young cousin Severus Alexander as ruler of Rome.
230年：Roman–Persian Wars: The Sasanian shah Ardashir I invaded Mesopotamia and Syria.
232年：Roman–Persian Wars: Alexander repelled the Sasanian invasion.
235年3月19日：Alexander was killed in a mutiny of the Legio XXII Primigenia at Mainz.
235年3月20日：The army elected Maximinus Thrax, commander of the Legio IV Italica, ruler of Rome.

235年：In 235 AD, Maximinus Thrax leads a rebellion against 26-year-old Emperor Alexander Severus. Thrax's men approached Alexander who pleads with his soldiers to take up arms, but instead abandon a weeping Severus to the Imperial tent and his mother's arms there to await capture and execution. Civil wars would follow with the first breaking out in 238, another in 249 followed by a third in 253. From 235 through 284 the average reign of a Roman Emperor was just 18 months, down from average just over 9 years during the first centuries of the Empire.
238年3月22日：Gordian I, governor of Africa, accepted the rule of Rome at the urging of rebels in his province. He appointed his son Gordian II to rule jointly with him.
238年4月2日：The Senate accepted Gordian I and Gordian II as rulers of Rome.

238年：Battle of Carthage (238): Forces loyal to Gordian I and Gordian II were defeated by the army of Capelianus, the governor of Numidia, who claimed fealty to Maximinus. Gordian II was killed. Gordian I committed suicide.
238年4月22日：The Senate elected two senators, Pupienus and Balbinus, as joint rulers of the Empire.
238年4月22日：Facing popular opposition to Pupienus and Balbinus, the Senate gave Gordian I's young grandson Gordian III the title Caesar.
238年5月：Maximinus was murdered with his son during a mutiny of the Legio II Parthica at Aquileia.
238年7月29日：Pupienus and Balbinus were tortured and murdered by the Praetorian Guard in their barracks.
243年：Battle of Resaena: Roman forces defeated the Sasanian Empire at Resaena.

244年：Battle of Misiche: The Sasanian Empire decisively defeated a Roman force at Misiche, near modern Fallujah. Gordian III was killed, probably by a fellow Roman. He was succeeded by Philip the Arab, the prefect of the Praetorian Guard, who was forced to cede Mesopotamia and Armenia to the Sasanian Empire.
249年：Philip was killed at Verona in battle with Decius, commander of Roman forces in Pannonia and Moesia.
251年：Decius appointed his natural son Herennius Etruscus co-ruler of Rome jointly with himself.
251年：Battle of Abritus: Roman forces were dealt a bloody defeat by the Goths near modern Razgrad. Decius and Herennius were killed.
251年：The armies of the Danube region acclaimed their commander Trebonianus Gallus ruler of Rome.
251年：The Senate recognized Decius's son Hostilian as ruler of Rome. Gallus adopted Hostilian as his son.
251年：Plague of Cyprian: Hostilian died, probably of plague.
251年：Gallus appointed his natural son Volusianus co-ruler jointly with himself.
253年：Battle of Barbalissos: A Sasanian force destroyed a Roman army at Barbalissos.
253年8月：Gallus and Volusianus were killed in a mutiny at Terni. The army acclaimed Aemilianus, governor of Pannonia and Moesia, ruler of Rome.
253年：Aemilianus was killed by his own soldiers in the face of the army of the general Valerian (emperor).
253年10月22日：Valerian gave his son Gallienus the title Caesar.
256年：The Sasanian Empire conquered and sacked Antioch.
257年：Valerian reconquered Antioch.
258年：The Goths invaded Asia Minor.
260年：Death of Dacian king Regalianus that became Roman emperor for a brief period.
260年：Valerian was taken prisoner by the Sasanian Empire during truce negotiations.
260年9月：The general Postumus was declared ruler of Rome in the Gallic Empire.
264年：Valerian died in captivity.
267年：Odaenathus, the king of Palmyra and a Roman client, was assassinated. His widow Zenobia took power as regent for their son Vaballathus.
268年：Gallienus was murdered by his soldiers during a siege of Pontirolo Nuovo.
268年9月：The general Claudius Gothicus was declared ruler of Rome by his soldiers.
269年：Postumus was killed by his soldiers, who in turn acclaimed one of their own, Marcus Aurelius Marius, emperor of the Gallic Empire.
269年：Marius was murdered by Victorinus, formerly prefect of Postumus's Praetorian Guard, who replaced him as emperor of the Gallic Empire.
269年：Zenobia conquered Egypt.
269年：Battle of Naissus: Roman forces decisively defeated the Goths at modern Niš, stalling an invasion of the Balkans.
270年1月：Claudius Gothicus died. He was succeeded by his brother Quintillus.
270年4月：Quintillus died at Aquileia.
270年9月：Aurelian became ruler of Rome.
271年：Battle of Fano: A Roman force defeated the Juthungi on the Metauro.
271年：Victorinus was murdered by an officer he had cuckolded.
271年：Tetricus I, praeses of Gallia Aquitania was acclaimed emperor of the Gallic Empire. He appointed his natural son Tetricus II to rule jointly with him.
272年：Zenobia was arrested en route to refuge in the Sasanian Empire.
273年：Palmyra rebelled against Roman authority and was destroyed.
274年：Battle of Châlons (274): Aurelian defeated the forces of Tetricus I and Tetricus II at modern Châlons-en-Champagne.
275年9月：Aurelian was murdered by the Praetorian Guard.
275年9月25日：The Senate elected Tacitus (emperor) ruler of Rome.
276年6月：Tacitus died.
276年：Marcus Aurelius Probus, commander of Roman forces in the east and Tacitus's half-brother, was acclaimed ruler of Rome by his troops.
276年：Florianus, prefect of the Praetorian Guard and commander of Roman forces in the west, was acclaimed ruler of Rome by his troops.
276年9月：Florianus was assassinated near Tarsus by his troops following a defeat at the hands of Probus.
279年：Probus launched a campaign against the Vandals in Illyricum.
282年：The Praetorian Guard elected their prefect Carus ruler of Rome.
282年：Probus was assassinated.
282年：Carus gave his sons Carinus and Numerian the title Caesar.
283年：Carus died.
284年：Numerian died.
284年11月20日：Roman forces in the east elected the consul Diocletian their ruler and proclaimed him augustus.
285年7月：Battle of the Margus: Forces loyal to Diocletian defeated Carinus in battle on the Morava. Carinus was killed.
285年7月：Diocletian gave Maximian the title Caesar.
286年：Carausian Revolt: The naval commander Carausius declared himself emperor in Britain and northern Gaul.
286年4月2日：Diocletian proclaimed Maximian augustus of the west, ruling himself as augustus of the east.
293年：Diocletian established the Tetrarchy, appointing Constantius Chlorus to hold the office of Caesar under Maximian in the west and Galerius to hold the title under himself in the east.
293年：Carausian Revolt: Constantius Chlorus conquered Carausius's Gallic territories.
293年：Carausius was murdered by his finance minister Allectus, who replaced him as emperor in Britain.
296年：Carausian Revolt: Allectus was defeated in battle and killed at Calleva Atrebatum.
301年：Diocletian issued the Edict on Maximum Prices, reforming the currency and setting price ceilings on a number of goods.

303年2月24日：Diocletianic Persecution: Diocletian issued his first edict against Christians, calling for the destruction of Christian holy books and places of worship and stripping Christians of their government positions and political rights.

305年5月1日：Diocletian and Maximian abdicated. Constantius and Galerius were elevated to augusti in the west and east. Galerius appointed Flavius Valerius Severus Caesar in the west and Maximinus II Caesar in the east.
306年7月25日：Constantius died at Eboracum. By his dying wish, his troops acclaimed his son Constantine the Great augustus.
306年：Galerius recognized Flavius Valerius Severus as augustus in the west and granted Constantine the Great the lesser title of Caesar, which he accepted.
306年：Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: Rioters in Rome acclaimed Maximian's son Maxentius ruler of Rome. He took the title princeps invictus, undefeated prince.
306年：Maxentius invited Maximian to reclaim the title augustus.
307年：Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: Flavius Valerius Severus surrendered to Maximian at Ravenna.
307年：Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: Galerius laid siege to Rome. Many of his soldiers defected to Maxentius and he was forced to flee.
308年：Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: After a failed coup against his son Maxentius, Maximian was forced to flee to Constantine's court.
308年11月11日：Maximian resigned as augustus. Galerius appointed Licinius augustus of the west and confirmed his recognition of Constantine the Great as Caesar of the west.
310年7月：Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: Maximian was forced to commit suicide following a failed coup against Constantine the Great.
311年5月：Galerius died. Licinius and Maximinus agreed to divide the eastern Empire between themselves.
311年：Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: Constantine the Great concluded an alliance with Licinius, offering his half-sister Flavia Julia Constantia to him in marriage.
311年：Civil wars of the Tetrarchy: Maximinus entered a secret alliance with Maxentius.
311年12月3日：Diocletian died, possibly from suicide.

312年10月28日：Battle of the Milvian Bridge: Constantine the Great had a vision of the cross appearing over the sun at the Ponte Milvio with the words "in this sign, conquer." His forces defeated and killed Maxentius.
313年2月：Constantine the Great and Licinius issued the Edict of Milan, providing for restitution to Christians injured during the persecutions.
313年3月：Licinius married Constantia.
313年4月30日：Battle of Tzirallum: Licinius defeated a vastly numerically superior force loyal to Maximinus at modern Çorlu. Maximinus fled to Nicomedia.
313年8月：Maximinus died at Tarsus.
314年10月8日：Battle of Cibalae: Constantine the Great dealt a bloody defeat to Licinius's forces at modern Vinkovci.
317年：Battle of Mardia: After a bloody battle, probably at modern Harmanli, Licinius retreated from contact with Constantine the Great.
317年3月1日：Licinius recognized Constantine the Great as his superior, ceded all his territories outside of Thrace, and agreed to depose and execute Valerius Valens, whom he had raised to augustus.
324年7月3日：Battle of Adrianople (324): Licinius suffered a bloody defeat at the hands of Constantine the Great on the Maritsa.
324年9月18日：Battle of Chrysopolis: Constantine the Great dealt a decisive defeat to the remnants of Licinius's army. Licinius surrendered.

325年5月20日：First Council of Nicaea: An ecumenical council called by Constantine the Great at Nicaea opened which would establish the Nicene Creed, asserting Jesus to be equal to and of the same substance as God the Father.
325年：Licinius was executed.
326年：Constantine the Great ordered the death of his oldest son Crispus.
330年5月11日：Constantine the Great moved his capital to Byzantium and renamed the city Constantinople, city of Constantine.
332年：Constantine the Great campaigned against the Goths.
334年：Constantine the Great campaigned against the Sarmatians.
337年：Roman–Persian Wars: The Sasanian shah Shapur II invaded Armenia and Mesopotamia.
337年5月22日：Constantine the Great died.

337年9月9日：Constantine the Great's three sons declared themselves augusti and divided their father's empire into three parts, with Constantine II (emperor) receiving Britain, Iberia, Gaul and Illyria, Constantius II Asia, Syria Palaestina and Egypt, and Constans Italy and Africa. The young Constans was placed under Constantine II's guardianship.
338年：Constantine II campaigned against the Alemanni.
338年：Constantine II granted Illyria to his brother Constans.
340年：Constantine II invaded Italy. He was ambushed and slain at Aquileia by Constans, who inherited his territory.
341年：Constans and Constantius II issued a ban against pagan sacrifice.
344年：Siege of Singara: Sasanian forces failed to capture the Roman fortress of Singara.
350年1月18日：Magnentius, commander of the Jovians and Herculians, was acclaimed ruler of Rome by his legions.
350年：Constans was killed in Elne by followers of Magnentius.
350年6月3日：Constantius Chlorus's grandson Nepotianus entered Rome with a band of gladiators and there declared himself imperator.
350年6月30日：Marcellinus (magister officiorum), one of Magnentius's generals, entered Rome and executed Nepotianus.
351年3月15日：Constantius II granted his cousin Constantius Gallus the title Caesar.
351年9月28日：Battle of Mursa Major: Constantius II defeated Magnentius in a bloody battle in the valley of the Drava.
353年：Battle of Mons Seleucus: Constantius II dealt Magnentius a decisive defeat at modern La Bâtie-Montsaléon. Magnentius committed suicide.
354年：Gallus was put to death.
355年11月6日：Constantius II declared Julian (emperor) Caesar and granted him command in Gaul.
357年：Battle of Strasbourg: Julian defeated a vastly superior Alemanni force near Argentoratum, solidifying Roman control west of the Rhine.
360年2月：The Petulantes, ordered east from Paris in preparation for a war with the Sasanian Empire, instead mutinied and proclaimed Julian augustus.
361年11月3日：Constantius II named Julian as his successor before dying of fever.
363年3月5日：Julian's Persian War: Roman forces embarked from Antioch on a punitive expedition against the Sasanian Empire.
363年6月26日：Battle of Samarra: Sasanian forces harassed a Roman army in retreat at Samarra from a failed siege of their capital Ctesiphon. Julian was killed.
363年6月27日：Julian's army declared one of their generals, Jovian (emperor), augustus.
363年7月：Julian's Persian War: Jovian agreed to cede the five provinces east of the Tigris to the Sasanian Empire, ending the war.
364年2月17日：Jovian died.
364年2月26日：The army acclaimed the general Valentinian I the Great augustus.
364年3月28日：Valentinian the Great appointed his younger brother Valens augustus with rule over the eastern Empire, and continued as augustus in the west.
365年7月21日：An earthquake near Crete with a magnitude of at least eight affects the Eastern Mediterranean. Combined with a subsequent tsunami, residents of Sicily are among the casualties.
375年11月17日：Valentinian the Great died of a stroke. His son Gratian, then junior augustus in the west, succeeded him as senior augustus.
375年11月22日：The army acclaimed Valentinian the Great's young son Valentinian II augustus of the west.
376年：Fleeing Hunnic aggression, the Goths, under the leadership of the Thervingi chieftain Fritigern, crossed the Danube and entered the eastern Empire as political refugees.
376年：Gothic War (376–382): Following the deaths of several Roman soldiers during civil unrest in Thrace, the officer Lupicinus arrested Fritigern and the Greuthungi chieftain Alatheus.
378年8月9日：Battle of Adrianople: A combined Gothic-Alanic force decisively defeated the Roman army near Edirne. Valens was killed.
379年1月19日：Gratian named the general Theodosius I the Great augustus in the east.
380年2月27日：Theodosius the Great issued the Edict of Thessalonica, making Christianity the state church of the Roman Empire.
links: State church of the Roman Empire

items.text: 382年10月3日：Gothic War (376–382): The Goths were made foederati of Rome and granted land and autonomy in Thrace, ending the war.
383年8月25日：Gratian was delivered by mutineers to the Magister equitum Andragathius and executed.
392年5月15日：Valentinian II was found hanged in his residence. He may have been murdered by his guardian, the Frankish general Arbogast (magister militum).
392年8月22日：Arbogast declared Eugenius augustus and ruler in the west.
393年1月23日：Theodosius the Great appointed his younger son Honorius (emperor) augustus in the west.
394年9月6日：Battle of the Frigidus: Forces loyal to Theodosius the Great defeated and killed Arbogast and Eugenius, probably near the Vipava.

395年1月17日：Theodosius the Great died. His elder son Arcadius succeeded him as augustus in the eastern Byzantine Empire. The young Honorius became sole augustus in the Western Roman Empire under the regency of Magister militum Stilicho.
398年：Gildonic War: Gildo, comes of Africa, was killed following a failed rebellion against the Western Roman Empire.
402年：The capital of the Western Roman Empire was moved to Ravenna.
405年：War of Radagaisus: Invasion of Radagaisus in the Northern part of Italy.
406年12月31日：Crossing of the Rhine: A coalition of foreign tribes including the Germanic Vandals, Suebi and Iranian Alans invaded the Western Roman Empire across the Rhine.
408年5月1日：Arcadius died.
410年8月24日：Sack of Rome (410): Rome was sacked by the Visigoths under their king Alaric I.
421年2月8日：Honorius appointed his brother-in-law and Magister militum Constantius III co-ruler of the Western Roman Empire with himself.
421年9月2日：Constantius III died.
423年8月15日：Honorius died.
423年：The Western Roman patrician Castinus declared the primicerius Joannes augustus.

424年10月23日：The Byzantine augustus Theodosius II the Younger, the Calligrapher named the young Valentinian III, his cousin and Constantius III's son, Caesar with rule over the west. His mother Galla Placidia was appointed regent.
425年：Joannes was executed in Aquileia.
427年：Roman civil war of 427–429
432年：Roman civil war of 432
447年：Battle of the Utus: The Huns under Attila defeated a Byzantine army in a bloody battle near the river Utus.
450年7月28日：Theodosius the Younger died in a riding accident.
452年：Attila abandoned his invasion of Italy following a meeting at the Mincio with the pope Pope Leo I.
455年3月16日：Valentinian III was assassinated on orders of the senator Petronius Maximus.
455年3月17日：The Senate acclaimed Maximus augustus of the Western Roman Empire.
455年5月31日：Maximus was killed by a mob as he attempted to flee Rome in the face of a Vandal advance.
455年6月2日：Sack of Rome (455): The Vandals entered and began to sack Rome.
455年7月9日：The Magister militum Avitus was pronounced augustus of the Western Roman Empire at Toulouse by the Visigothic king Theodoric II.
456年10月17日：Avitus was forced to flee Rome following a military coup by the general Ricimer and the domesticus Majorian.
457年：Avitus died.
457年1月27日：The Byzantine augustus Marcian died.
457年2月28日：The Byzantine augustus Leo I the Thracian appointed Majorian Magister militum in the west.
457年4月1日：The army acclaimed Majorian augustus of the Western Roman Empire.
461年8月7日：Majorian was killed after torture near the Staffora on Ricimer's orders, followed by a civil war.
461年11月19日：The Senate elected Libius Severus from among their number as augustus of the Western Roman Empire.
465年8月15日：Severus died.
467年4月12日：Leo the Thracian elevated the comes Anthemius to Caesar with rule over the Western Roman Empire.
468年：Battle of Cap Bon (468): The Vandal Kingdom destroyed a combined Western Roman and Byzantine invasion fleet at Cap Bon.
472年7月11日：Anthemius was killed in flight following Ricimer's conquest of Rome. Maximus's son Olybrius was acclaimed augustus of the Western Roman Empire.
472年8月18日：Ricimer died.
472年：Ricimer's nephew Gundobad succeeded him as Magister militum and took the title Patrician.
472年：Olybrius died.
473年3月3日：The Germanic elements of the army elected the domesticus Glycerius augustus of the Western Roman Empire.
473年：Gundobad relinquished his Western Roman titles to succeed his father as king of Burgundy.
474年：Leo the Thracian appointed Julius Nepos, his nephew and governor of Dalmatia, ruler of the Western Roman Empire in opposition to Glycerius.
474年1月18日：Leo the Thracian died. He was succeeded by his grandson Leo II (emperor).
474年2月9日：Zeno (emperor) became co-augustus of the Byzantine Empire with his young son Leo II.
474年7月：Nepos deposed Glycerius.
474年11月17日：Leo II died, possibly after being poisoned by his mother Ariadne (empress).
475年1月：Zeno was forced to flee Constantinople for his homeland Isauria in the face of a popular revolt.
475年1月9日：Basiliscus, brother of Leo the Thracian's widow Verina, was acclaimed augustus of the Byzantine Empire by the Byzantine Senate.
475年：Nepos appointed Orestes (father of Romulus Augustulus) Magister militum and commander-in-chief of the Western Roman military.
475年8月28日：Orestes took control of the Western Roman capital Ravenna, forcing Nepos to flee to Dalmatia.
475年10月31日：Orestes declared his young son Romulus Augustulus augustus of the Western Roman Empire.
476年8月：Zeno recaptured Constantinople and accepted Basiliscus's surrender.
476年8月23日：Germanic foederati under the command of the general Odoacer renounced Western Roman authority and declared Odoacer their king.
476年8月28日：Odoacer captured and executed Orestes at Piacenza.
476年9月4日：Odoacer conquered the Western Roman capital Ravenna, forced Romulus to abdicate and declared himself king of Italy, the first King of Italy
476年：The Senate sent Zeno the imperial regalia of the Western Roman Empire.
480年4月25日：Nepos was murdered in his residence in Split.
491年4月9日：Zeno died.
493年：An Ostrogoth known as Theoderic the Great succeeds Odoacer as King of Italy.
508年：The East-Roman Emperor Anastasius I sends a fleet of 100 warships to raid the coasts of Italy.
518年7月9日：Augustus Anastasius I Dicorus died.
527年4月1日：Augustus Justin I appointed his older son Justinian I the Great co-augustus with himself.
527年8月1日：Justin I died.
529年4月7日：The Codex Justinianus, which attempted to consolidate and reconcile contradictions in Roman law, was promulgated.
529年：St. Benedict of Nursia establishes his first monastery at the hill of Monte Cassino.
532年：Justinian the Great ordered the construction of the Hagia Sophia in Constantinople.
533年6月21日：Vandalic War: A Byzantine force under the general Belisarius departed for the Vandal Kingdom.
533年9月13日：Battle of Ad Decimum: A Byzantine army defeated a Vandal force near Carthage.
533年12月15日：Battle of Tricamarum: The Byzantines defeated a Vandal army and forced their king Gelimer into flight.

534年3月：Vandalic War: Gelimer surrendered to Belisarius and accepted his offer of a peaceful retirement in Galatia, ending the war. The territory of the Vandal Kingdom was reorganized as the praetorian prefecture of Africa.
535年：Gothic War (535–554): Byzantine forces crossing from Africa invaded Sicily, then an Ostrogothic possession.
536年12月：Gothic War (535–554): Byzantium took Rome with little Ostrogothic resistance.
537年12月27日：The Hagia Sophia was completed.
552年7月：Battle of Taginae: A Byzantine army dealt a decisive defeat to the Ostrogoths at Gualdo Tadino. The Ostrogoth king Totila was killed.
553年：Battle of Mons Lactarius: An Ostrogothic force was ambushed and destroyed at Monti Lattari on its way to relieve a Byzantine siege of Cumae. The Ostrogoth king Teia was killed.
565年3月：Belisarius died.
565年11月14日：Justinian the Great died.
568年：The Lombards invade the Italian Peninsula and establish the Kingdom of the Lombards.
573年：The general Narses died.
574年：Augustus Justin II began to suffer from fits of insanity.
577年：The Duchy of Benevento is established.
578年10月5日：Justin II died.
582年8月14日：Augustus Tiberius II Constantine died.
602年：Byzantine–Sasanian War of 602–628: The Sasanian Empire declared war on Byzantium.
607年8月1日：Augustus Phocas dedicated the Column of Phocas in the Roman Forum.
626年6月：Siege of Constantinople (626): Sasanian and Avar forces laid siege to Constantinople.
634年4月：Muslim conquest of the Levant: A Rashidun army departed Medina for the Levant.
640年1月：Muslim conquest of Egypt: A Rashidun force laid siege to Pelusium.
640年：The legions of the East Roman army were reorganized into themes.
641年11月8日：Siege of Alexandria (641): Byzantine authorities in the Egyptian capital Alexandria surrendered to the besieging Rashidun army.
661年：Brothers Perctarit and Godepert share the ruling power of King of the Lombards.
661年：The Duchy of Naples is established as a Byzantine province in the coastal territory that the Lombards had not conquered during their invasion in the sixth century.
662年：Grimoald, King of the Lombards.
663年：Basileus Constans II visited Rome.
698年：Battle of Carthage (698): An Umayyad siege and blockade of Carthage forced the retreat of Byzantine forces. The city was conquered and destroyed.
730年：Basileus Leo III the Isaurian promulgated an edict forbidding the veneration of religious images, beginning the first Byzantine Iconoclasm.
774年7月10日：Charlemagne is crowned in Pavia and becomes King of the Lombards.
787年10月23日：Second Council of Nicaea: An ecumenical council in Nicaea ended which endorsed the veneration of images, ending the first Byzantine Iconoclasm.
813年：Charlemagne crowns his son Louis the Pious of Aquitaine as co-emperor.
814年1月28日：Charlemagne dies in Aachen of pleurisy.
851年：The Principality of Salerno is established.
861年：The Principality of Capua is established.
961年12月25日：Otto I becomes King of Italy.
965年：The Byzantine Empire establishes the Catepanate of Italy.
973年5月7日：Otto I succumbs to a fever and dies.
980年12月25日：Otto II becomes the King of Italy.
983年12月7日：Otto II dies due to an outbreak of malaria.
996年4月12日：Otto III becomes King of Italy.
999年：The Normans begin migrating to Italy where they primarily work as mercenaries serving the Byzantines and Lombard nobles.
1002年1月23日：Otto III dies of a sudden fever in a castle near Civita Castellana.
1030年：Aversa is established, marking the start of permanent Norman settlements in Italy.
1043年：William of Hauteville and the Normans found the County of Apulia and Calabria composed of the territories of Gargano, Capitanata, Apulia, Vulture, and most of Campania.
1046年：Italian feudal ruler and militant noblewoman Matilda of Tuscany is born.

1053年6月18日：The Normans, led by the Count of Apulia, Humphrey of Hauteville defeat a Swabian-Italian-Lombard army organized by Pope Leo IX and led on the battlefield by Gerard, Duke of Lorraine and Rudolf, Prince of Benevento at the Battle of Civitate. The Norman victory marked the climax of the conflict between the Normans who began to migrate to southern Italy at the end of the tenth century and the local Lombard princes.
1053年：The Duchy of Benevento ends.

1059年8月23日：The Treaty of Melfi is signed between Pope Nicholas II and the Norman princes Robert Guiscard and Richard I of Capua. Per the accord, Pope Nicholas recognizes the Norman conquest of Southern Italy and Robert Guiscard as the Duke of Apulia and Calabria, and the Count of Sicily.
1061年：Robert Guiscard and the Normans first invade Sicily.
1063年6月：Roger I of Sicily and the Normans defeat a Muslim alliance of Sicilian and Zirid troops at the Battle of Cerami, the most significant battle of the Norman conquest of Sicily.
1071年：The Byzantine Catepanate of Italy ends.
1077年：The Principality of Salerno ends.
1087年：In the Mahdia campaign of 1087, seafaring vessels from the Italian maritime republics of Genoa and Pisa attack the North African town of Mahdia, burning Mahdia's Muslim fleet in the harbour.
1091年2月：The Norman conquest of Sicily is complete.
1115年7月24日：Matilda of Tuscany dies of gout.

1130年12月25日：Roger II of Sicily, the Norman, founds the Kingdom of Sicily which includes the island of Sicily, the southern portion of the Italian Peninsula, and for a time, territory in Northern Africa.
1137年：The Duchy of Naples ends when Duke Sergius VII is forced to surrender to Roger II of Sicily and the Normans.
1139年：The Principality of Capua ends.
1170年：Leonardo of Pisa, an Italian mathematician more famously known as Fibonacci, is born.

1176年5月29日：Battle of Legnano: the troops of the Lombard League defeated forces of the Holy Roman Empire. The battle is alluded to in the Canto degli Italiani by Goffredo Mameli and Michele Novaro, which reads: «From the Alps to Sicily, Legnano is everywhere» in memory of the victory of Italian populations over foreign ones. Thanks to this battle, Legnano is the only city, besides Rome, to be mentioned in the Italian national anthem.
1194年：Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor conquers the Kingdom of Sicily.

1202年：Fibonacci's Liber Abaci, a book on arithmetic, helps to popularise the Hindu–Arabic numeral system and brings the idea of the integer sequence known as the Fibonacci number to locations outside India.
1254年：Marco Polo is born in the Republic of Venice.
1265年：Dante Alighieri is born. He is considered the father of the Italian language for writing works in his dialect, which would become standardized into Modern Italian.
1282年3月30日：The War of the Sicilian Vespers begins.
1302年8月31日：The War of the Sicilian Vespers ends.
1302年：Sicily is given to Frederick III of the House of Barcelona.
1308年：Dante Alighieri begins writing the Divine Comedy.
1320年：Dante Alighieri finished writing his Divine Comedy.
1323年：Alfonso IV of Aragon begins the conquest of Sardinia.
1377年：Filippo Brunelleschi, a famous Italian architect, is born in Florence, Italy.
1451年10月：Christopher Columbus is born.
1452年4月15日：Leonardo da Vinci is born
1475年3月6日：Michelangelo is born
1494年：The Italian War of 1494–1498, or First Italian War, begins, marking the first major battle in the Italian Wars.
1498年：The First Italian War ends in a victory for the League of Venice.
1499年：The Italian War of 1499-1504, or Second Italian War, begins.
1501年－1504年：Michelangelo creates the David
1503年－1513年：Reign of pope Julius II
1525年5月6日：The Sack of Rome (1527) by mutinous troops of Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor during the War of the League of Cognac. It's considered one of the causes of the decline of the High Renaissance.
1551年：The Italian War of 1551-1559, or Last Italian War begins.
1545年－1563年：Council of Trent
1559年4月3日：The Last Italian War ends with a peace treaty signed between Henry II of France, Elizabeth I of England, Ferdinand I, Holy Roman Emperor, and Philip II of Spain at Le Cateau-Cambrésis.
1564年2月15日：Galileo is born in Pisa.
1633年：The Palio di Siena is held for the first time.
1678年3月4日：Antonio Vivaldi, a famous Italian Baroque composer, is born in Venice.
1725年：Antonio Vivaldi publishes a now-famous set of concertos entitled The Four Seasons as part of a set of twelve concerti called Il cimento dell'armonia e dell'inventione.
1741年7月28日：Without a sustainable source of income or royal protection, the impoverished Antonio Vivaldi dies of infection during the night.
1768年：Corsica passes from the Republic of Genoa to France after the Treaty of Versailles.
1789年8月21日：The national colours of Italy first appear on a tricolour cockade.
1796年：Napoleon Bonaparte and his French Army of Italy invade Italy.
1796年11月17日：Napoleon defeats József Alvinczi at the Battle of Arcole.
1797年1月7日：The Italian tricolour is adopted for the first time as official flag, by the government of the Cispadane Republic.
1797年5月12日：Fall of the Republic of Venice.
links: Fall of the Republic of Venice

items.text: 1809年：Napoleon Bonaparte occupies Rome, exiles Pope Pius VII to Savona and then to France, and takes the Papal States' art collections to the Louvre.
1813年10月10日：Giuseppe Verdi is born
1821年：A revolt in Piedmont, led by Annibale Santorre di Rossi de Pomarolo, takes place in an attempt to remove the Austrians from Italy and unify the Italian territories under the House of Savoy.
links: Annibale Santorre di Rossi de Pomarolo, Count of Santarosa

items.text: 1830年：A series of uprisings along the Italian Peninsula occur, calling out for the merging of the different territories in the peninsula into one unified nation.
1831年：Austrian troops gradually crush political resistance along the Italian peninsula.
1831年7月：The political movement Young Italy is formed by activist Giuseppe Mazzini, promoting insurrection in Italian states and Austrian lands to help unify Italy.
1834年5月28日：Mazzini is arrested in Solothurn and exiled from Switzerland.
1846年：Pope Pius IX is elected, and his support of the unification of Italy helps to further popularise the movement.
1847年11月29日：Charles Albert of Sardinia implements the Perfect Fusion of the Savoyard state extending the reforms carried out on the mainland to the island of Sardinia
1847年12月10日：Il Canto degli Italiani, the Italian national anthem since 1946, makes its public debut.

1848年：Fuelled by the revolutionary republican ideology of Mazzini, uprisings lead to revolutionary governments being briefly installed in Rome, Milan (see Cinque giornate di Milano), and Venice, and the establishment of constitutions in the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, the Papal States, and Tuscany. Takeover by reactionary forces and the defeat of Piedmont-Sardinia by Austria lead to a failure in the First Italian War of Independence.
1849年2月9日：A Roman Republic is declared following an election.
1849年3月：Mazzini arrives in Rome and is appointed Chief Minister of the Roman Republic.

1856年：The Congress of Paris, a peace conference held between Austria, France, Prussia, the Kingdom of Great Britain, the Ottoman Empire, the Russian Empire, and the Kingdom of Sardinia, is held to make peace after the Crimean War.
1856年：Italian statesman Camillo Benso of Cavour disparages Austria's intrusive presence in the Italian Peninsula.

1858年：Napoleon III and Cavour meet secretly in France, in Plombières-les-Bains, where they make the Plombières Agreement. They decide that Cavour will provoke rebellion in Austrian territories in Northern Italy so as to tempt Austria into making a military decision.

1859年：After having allied with France, under the lead of Cavour, the Kingdom of Piedmont-Sardinia provokes Austria to war and secure the takeover of Milan and Lombardy (Second Italian War of Independence). Plebiscites subsequently guarantee the annexation of Tuscany, Emilian dukedoms, and Papal-controlled central Italy. Savoy and Nice are ceded to France in exchange for recognition. (to 1860) The annexation of Nice to France caused the Niçard exodus, or the emigration of a quarter of the Niçard Italians to Italy, and the Niçard Vespers.

1860年：The Expedition of the Thousand takes place, in which volunteers led by Giuseppe Garibaldi set out to conquer the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, which collapses. The Papal States are reduced to Latium.
1861年3月17日：Most of the states of the Italian Peninsula are united under King Victor Emmanuel II of the Savoy dynasty, proclamated King of Italy.
links: Proclamation of the Kingdom of Italy

items.text: 1865年：The capital of Italy is moved from Turin to Florence, in order to approach it to Rome, considered the natural capital, but still under Papal rule and French protection.
1866年：The Third Italian War of Independence, between the Kingdom of Italy and Austrian Empire, occurs, resulting in no true victory by either side.

1866年10月3日：After some heavy losses, like Custoza and Lissa, and few wins (most of them by Giuseppe Garibaldi), thanks to Prussian victories the Kingdom of Italy gains Veneto and western Friuli by the Treaty of Vienna. Trento and Trieste remains "irredeemed".
1870年9月20日：Following the defeat of Napoleon III in the French-Prussian War, Italian forces occupy Rome. The Italian Army breaks into the walls of Rome by the breach of Porta Pia.
1870年10月2日：Rome replaces Florence as the capital city of Italy.
1870年10月2日：Italian Prime Minister Lanza holds a plebiscite in Rome and the citizens overwhelming vote in favor of union with Italy.
1870年10月9日：A royal decree confirms the incorporation of Rome and surrounding Lazio into the Kingdom of Italy.
1878年1月3日：King Victor Emmanuel II of Italy dies.
1878年1月9日：Victor Emmanuel II's son, Umberto I, takes the throne.
1882年7月5日：The bay of Assab (Eritrea) becomes the first official Italian colonial possession in Africa.
1889年：Somalia is established as the second Italian colony in Africa.
1895年：21-year-old Guglielmo Marconi invents the radio telegraph.

1896年：The French Lumière brothers publicly screen some of the earliest films in the history of cinema in various locations in Italy. The first Italian director is considered to be Vittorio Calcina, a collaborator of the Lumière Brothers, who filmed Pope Leo XIII in 1896, giving birth to the cinema of Italy.
1900年：the population is about 32.4 million
1900年7月29日：King Umberto I is assassinated. Umberto I's son, Victor Emmanuel III, takes the throne
1906年：The poet Giosuè Carducci is the first Italian to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.
1907年：Maria Montessori establishes her first Casa dei Bambini in Rome.
1907年：Ernestina Prola becomes the first Italian woman to get a driving licence.
1908年12月28日：The 7.1 Moment mag. scale"}]]}'>Mw Messina earthquake shakes Southern Italy with a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme), killing between 75,000 and 200,000.
1911年：Italy defeats the Ottoman Empire and gains control over Libya and the Rhodes archipelago.
1911年：The Anniversary of the Unification of Italy is established.
links: Anniversary of the Unification of Italy

items.text: 1911年6月4日：The Altare della Patria is solemnly inaugurated.
1915年5月23日：Although initially aligned with Germany and Austria-Hungary, Italy enters World War I on the side of the Anglo-French Allies after the Treaty of London.
links: Italian entry into World War I

items.text: 1918年11月4日：Armistice of Villa Giusti, with which Austria-Hungary surrenders to Italy, ending the war. After World War I, Italy expands its borders well beyond Trento and Trieste, including Bolzano/Bozen, Pola/Pula, Fiume/Rijeka and Zara/Zadar.
1919年：Benito Mussolini and his supporters found the Fasci Italiani di Combattimento, the predecessor of the National Fascist Party.

1919年：Enzo Ferrari, having no other job perspective, eventually settles for a job at a small car company called CMN (Costruzioni Meccaniche Nazionali) redesigning used truck bodies into small passenger cars.
1919年：The National Unity and Armed Forces Day is established.
links: National Unity and Armed Forces Day

items.text: 1921年11月4日：The body of the Italian Unknown Soldier is solemnly buried at the Altare della Patria.
1922年：After the lack of a compromise between socialists and Christian-democrats, and the March on Rome of the fascist militias, Benito Mussolini is named by the King as prime minister of Italy.
1926年：Mussolini assumes dictatorial powers.
1926年：The novelist Grazia Deledda is the first Italian woman who is awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature.
1929年1月3日：Italian film director Sergio Leone is born.
1934年：The Italy national football team wins its first FIFA World Cup.
1936年：Following the invasion of Ethiopia, Italy is expelled from the League of Nations. Mussolini and Hitler signed the Rome-Berlin Axis.
1938年：The Italy national football team wins its second FIFA World Cup.
1938年：Enrico Fermi is awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on induced radioactivity.
1940年：Italy enters World War II by invading Greece from Albania, which had been occupied in 1939.

1941年：While they are confined on the island of Ventotene by the Fascist regime, Altiero Spinelli and Ernesto Rossi compile the Ventotene Manifesto, entitled "Towards a Free and United Europe". With his Manifesto, Spinelli gives the major contribution to the formulation of the Federalist thinking and is later one of the main figures of the European Parliament.

1943年：Nazi troops occupy Northern Italy, release Mussolini from prison and have him leading the puppet Italian Social Republic. Allied troops fight in the following two years to free the whole peninsula. The Italian Resistance plays a growing role in harassing German occupation forces.
1943年7月25日：After the Allied occupy Sicily, the government of Mussolini is overthrown by the same Grand Council of Fascism.
1943年9月8日：General Badoglio signs the Armistice of Cassibile.

1945年4月25日：Milan is finally liberated on 25 April 1945. Resistance fighters catch Benito Mussolini as he flees north in the hope of reaching Switzerland. They shoot him along with his lover, Clara Petacci. The corpses are brought back to Milan and hang in a gas station in Piazzale Loreto.
1945年5月2日：Surrender of Caserta, whereby the German forces in Italy surrender, ending the Italian Campaign of World War II and the Italian Civil War.
1945年12月10日：Alcide De Gasperi becomes prime minister, holding the office until 1953. He is one of the Founding Fathers of the European Union and the first republican prime minister of Italy.
links: Founding fathers of the European Union
List of Prime Ministers of Italy

items.text: 1946年4月22日：The Liberation Day is established.
1946年6月2日：Italians vote to abolish the monarchy and establish a new republic; King Umberto II, who succeeded his father Victor Emmanuel III on 9 May 1946, goes into exile.

1946年6月10日：Birth of the Italian Republic: Italy becomes a republic after the results of a popular referendum. The Constituent Assembly is elected to draft the Republican Constitution and women are granted suffrage.
1947年：Primo Levi publishes If This Is a Man, based on his experiences in Auschwitz.

1947年2月10日：Treaty of Paris between Italy and the Allied Powers, with which Istria, Kvarner, most of the Julian March as well as the Dalmatian city of Zara was annexed by Yugoslavia from Italy causing the Istrian-Dalmatian exodus, which led to the emigration of between 230,000 and 350,000 of local ethnic Italians (Istrian Italians and Dalmatian Italians), the others being ethnic Slovenians, ethnic Croatians, and ethnic Istro-Romanians, choosing to maintain Italian citizenship.
links: Treaty of Paris between Italy and the Allied Powers

items.text: 1947年：The Festa della Repubblica is established.
1948年4月18日：The general election sanctions the supremacy of the Christian Democracy party, and the belonging of Italy to the Western side.
1948年11月24日：The film Bicycle Thieves is released.
1948年12月22日：The Constitution of the Italian Republic, agreed between Christian-democrats, Socialists and Communists, comes into force.
1949年：Italy joins NATO.
1952年：Italy becomes a founding member of the European Coal and Steel Community.

1953年2月10日：The national oil company ENI (Ente Nazionale Idrocarburi) is established, with Enrico Mattei as his first President. The ENI will become a strong actor in Italian foreign policy towards Arab countries.
1954年：The state-owned RAI broadcasts the first Italian official TV program.
1955年：The Messina Conference achieves the basic agreement on the European Economic Community
1955年：Italy joins the United Nations, along with fifteen other states, after years of stalemate due to opposed vetoes between the United States and the Soviet Union.
1957年：The Treaty of Rome founds the European Economic Community.
1958年9月22日：Singer-songwriter Andrea Bocelli is born in Lajatico.
1959年：Valentino opens his first atelier, in Rome on Via Condotti.
1960年：Italian film director Federico Fellini shoots La Dolce Vita, an episodic study of life along Via Veneto in Rome.
1960年：Rightist riots in Reggio Calabria against the regional capital being set in Catanzaro.
1960年：Leftist riots in Genoa and Reggio Emilia against the Tambroni Cabinet led by Fernando Tambroni, a coalition between DC and post-fascist Italian Social Movement.
1960年8月25日：The 1960 Summer Olympics opens in Rome.
1963年：The DC switches to a strategy of alliance with the socialist PSI. Electric energy is nationalised and the high school system is reformed.
1963年6月30日：Ciaculli massacre: a bomb intended for the mafia boss Salvatore Greco "Ciaschiteddu" explodes in Ciaculli, killing seven police and military officers.
1963年10月9日：Two thousand people die when a landslide causes the overtopping of the Vajont Dam north of Venice; the flooding wave completely wipes out several villages.
1964年：Singer-songwriter Cristina d'Avena is born.
1964年9月12日：Sergio Leone's A Fistful of Dollars, the first of three films in his Dollars Trilogy of Spaghetti Westerns starring Clint Eastwood, is released.
1964年：An attempted coup (Piano Solo) is defused.
1964年：Michele, the son of Mastro Pietro Ferrero, modifies his father's recipe for the "supercrema gianduja" (invented in 1946) and renames it Nutella.
1965年11月18日：The film For a Few Dollars More is released.
1965年12月8日：End of Second Vatican Council.
1966年10月30日：Socialist and Democratic Socialist Party joined forces in the Unified Socialist Party.
1966年12月15日：The film The Good, the Bad and the Ugly is released. The film is now considered to be one of the greatest films of all time.
links: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
List of films considered the best

items.text: 1968年1月14日：The Belice earthquake sequence took place in Sicily between 14 and 15 January. The largest shock measured 5.5 on the moment magnitude scale, with five others of magnitude 5+. The maximum perceived intensity was X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. The earthquake sequence, centred between the towns of Gibellina, Salaparuta and Poggioreale, killed at least 231 people, possibly more than 400, with between 632 and about 1,000 injured and left 100,000 homeless.
1968年1月31日：The University of Trento is occupied by students.
1968年6月10日：The Italy national football team wins its first UEFA European Championship at Rome, against Yugoslavia.
1968年6月24日：Giovanni Leone was appointed First Minister: remains in office until December.
1968年12月2日：In Sicily clashes between strikers and police.
1968年12月12日：Mariano Rumor reconstitutes a center-left government.
1969年7月：Published the first issue of Il manifesto (it will become daily in 1971).
1969年7月4日：New split the Unified Socialist Party: reborn PSI and PSDI.
1969年：The "Hot Autumn" of 1969 features occupations of factories and universities, and violence between right and left-wing students.

1969年11月19日：During the disorders of far-left peoples of lyrical theatre, in Milan, policeman Antonio Annarumma was hit by an iron tube, according to the court inquiry. After his death his vehicle without guidance hit another police officer. Students believe it is the accident which killed him, but this claim was repudiated by the medical examination. Annarumma considered to be the first victim of the Years of Lead, a period of social and political upheaval in Italy.
1969年11月20日：Agreement between Italy and Austria for a system of self-government in South Tyrol.

1969年12月12日：Far-right terrorists bomb the Banca Nazionale dell'Agricoltura in Milan (Piazza Fontana bombing), killing 17 people and wounding 88. Four more bombs detonate without victims. Investigations are blurred, and no responsible party has been held accountable.
1970年8月6日：After the resignation of Mariano Rumor (6 July), Emilio Colombo forms a new Government.
1970年：Serious incidents of violence across Italy.
1970年12月1日：Parliament approved the law on divorce.
1970年：Another rightist coup attempt is defused (golpe Borghese).
1971年2月16日：The regional council of Calabria recognizes Catanzaro regional capital.
1971年2月：In Italy resume violent riots.
1971年6月13日：Partial local elections showed a decline of the Christian Democrats and an advanced of MSI.

1971年10月：The band Pink Floyd films performances for their songs "Echoes", "One of These Days", and "A Saucerful of Secrets" in Pompeii. The footage was included in their concert documentary film Pink Floyd: Live at Pompeii.
1971年12月24日：Giovanni Leone is elected President of the Republic at the twenty-third ballot.
1974年5月12日：A referendum asking voters to repeal a government law allowing divorce is defeated. The result of Italian divorce referendum, 1974 is the retention of the law allowing divorce.
1975年11月22日：The controversial Italian-French art film Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom, is first released.
links: Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom

items.text: 1978年3月16日：Kidnapping of the former prime minister Aldo Moro by the Red Brigades.

1978年5月9日：Aldo Moro is killed after the government refuses to negotiate with the Communist group. The "historic compromise" is stopped and Giulio Andreotti steps down from government. The Red Brigades begin falling apart.
1978年6月15日：President Giovanni Leone resigned.
1978年7月：Socialist Sandro Pertini is the new President of the Republic.
1979年4月7日：Arrest of several academics accused of subversive and terrorist activities.
1979年：In the early parliamentary elections fall of PCI, advanced the Radical party and stability of DC.
1979年：First election for the European Parliament.
1979年8月：First government led by Francesco Cossiga.
1979年12月：First transmissions of the third RAI channel, Rai 3.
1980年：Umberto Eco publishes The Name of the Rose, a medieval murder mystery.

1980年6月27日：Ustica Massacre: a DC-9 operated by Itavia crashes into the Tyrrhenian Sea between Ponza and Ustica, killing all 81 people on board. The disaster led to numerous investigations, legal actions, and accusations, and continues to be a source of speculation, including claims of conspiracy by the Italian government and others.

1980年8月2日：Bologna massacre: a terrorist bombing of the Central Station at Bologna kills 85 people and wounds more than 200. This was found to be a neo-fascist bombing, mainly organized by the Nuclei Armati Rivoluzionari: Francesca Mambro and Valerio Fioravanti were sentenced to life imprisonment. In April 2007 the Supreme Court confirmed the conviction of Luigi Ciavardini, a NAR member associated closely with close ties to Terza Posizione. Ciavardini received a 30-year prison sentence for his role in the attack.
1980年9月：Broadcaster Canale 5 starts to broadcast on a national scale. This is the first national private television.

1980年11月23日：Irpinia earthquake, took place in Southern Italy with a moment magnitude of 6.9 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme). The shock was centered on the village of Conza and left at least 2,483 people dead, at least 7,700 injured, and left 250,000 homeless.
1981年3月17日：The prosecutors of Milan and the police discovered the existence of the P2 lodge. Head of loggia is Licio Gelli.
1981年6月：Giovanni Spadolini (PRI) is premier of a coalition (PRI-DC-PSI-PSDI-PLI) called Pentapartito. Spadolini is the first non-Christian Democrat minister since 1945. His government lasts one year.
1982年5月29日：Parliament approves law on "collaborators of justice". It was officially created the figure of Pentito.
1982年6月18日：Roberto Calvi was found hanged in London.
1982年7月11日：The Italy national football team wins in Spain its third FIFA World Cup.
1982年9月3日：General Carlo Alberto Dalla Chiesa and his wife are killed by the mafia in Palermo.

1983年8月：Bettino Craxi (PSI) is premier of a PSI-DC coalition until 1987. Under his government, a television reform allows Berlusconi to build up his media empire. The Concordat with the Vatican is revised, and salary indexation is abolished to curb inflation from 12% to 5%, but public debt raises up to 90% of GDP.
1984年6月：At the European Parliament elections, in the wake of the death of the leader Enrico Berlinguer, the PCI gains 33.3% of votes and overcomes the DC as first party in Italy.

1984年12月23日：Sicilian Mafia bomb the 904 express train between Bologna and Florence, killing 16 people and wounding 267. Mafia boss Giuseppe Calò, also known as "Pippo", was convicted for ordering and organising the attack in November 1992.
1985年：Franco Modigliani receives the Nobel Prize for Economics for his work on household savings and the dynamics of financial markets.
1985年6月9日：A referendum on abolishing the wage escalator was defeated by margin of 54.3% to 45.7% on a voter turnout of 77.9% out of 45 million eligible Italian electors.
1985年6月：Francesco Cossiga is elected President of the Republic.
1985年12月27日：Rome airport is attacked by Palestinian terrorists; 16 people die.

1986年：The start of the Maxi Trial against the Sicilian Mafia that took place in Palermo, Sicily. It lasted until 1992 (the final day of the Supreme Court of Cassation). Sicilian prosecutors indicted 475 mafiosi for a multitude of crimes, of which 338 were convicted and sentenced to a total of 2,665 years, not including life sentences handed to 19 bosses. It is considered to be the most significant trial ever against the Sicilian Mafia, as well as the biggest trial in world history.

1986年：Italy-US relations are strained by the Libyan retaliation after the American bombing of Tripoli, and by the Sigonella crisis following the kidnapping of the Achille Lauro liner ship by the Palestinian Liberation Front.

1986年：The neurologist Rita Levi-Montalcini, together with Stanley Cohen, receives the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their discovery of Nerve growth factor (NGF). Since 2001, she has also served in the Italian Senate as a Senator for Life.
1987年7月：Giovanni Goria is the new prime minister. His Cabinet lasts up to April 1988.
1987年11月：In the wake of the Chernobyl disaster, a referendum put off the use of nuclear plants. The three working plants are slowly decommissioned. The Green party establishes itself in Italy.
1988年4月：Ciriaco De Mita replaces Goria as prime minister. His Cabinet lasts one year.
1988年6月11日：Former President Giuseppe Saragat dies.
1988年6月21日：Achille Occhetto is the new leader of PCI.

1988年8月14日：Enzo Ferrari, founder of Ferrari and Scuderia Ferrari, died at the age of 90. Weeks after his death, both Ferrari drivers Gerhard Berger and Michele Alboreto dedicated the 1–2 finish for Enzo at Monza.
1989年4月30日：Sergio Leone dies of a heart attack.
1989年7月22日：Giulio Andreotti is premier of a coalition until 1992.
1989年10月：New Code of Criminal Procedure shall enter into force.
1990年2月24日：Former President Sandro Pertini dies.
1990年5月：Italian regional elections. Umberto Bossi's Lega Nord obtained a stunning result in the main election of this round of vote, the choice of the Lombard Regional Council.
1990年：Italy hosts the World Football Cup, but loses in the semi-final against Argentina at penalties.

1990年10月：Prime Minister Giulio Andreotti reveals the existence of Operation Gladio. Gladio was the codename for a clandestine North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) "stay-behind" operation in Italy during the Cold War. Its purpose was to prepare for, and implement, armed resistance in the event of a Warsaw Pact invasion and conquest. Although Gladio specifically refers to the Italian branch of the NATO stay-behind organizations, "Operation Gladio" is used as an informal name for all of them.
1991年1月：Italy takes part in the Operation Desert Storm, during the Gulf War, for the liberation of Kuwait.
1991年2月3日：The Italian Communist Party split into the Democratic Party of the Left (PDS), led by Achille Occhetto, and the Communist Refoundation Party (PRC), headed by Armando Cossutta.
1991年6月9日：A referendum abolished the multiple preferences for the election of Chamber of Deputies's members, in favor of the single preference.
1991年9月19日：A man found frozen high in the Alps is discovered, and is later found to be a Neolithic hunter who lived approximately 5,000 years ago.
1991年10月1日：The Simpsons is aired on the Italian TV for the first time.

1992年：Mani pulite (clean hands), a nationwide judicial investigation into political corruption and influence-peddling, leads to the fall and dissolution of the Christian Democracy, and of the Socialist party, which had been the most influential political parties in Italy since 1948. Bettino Craxi flees to Tunisia to avoid prosecution.

1992年：General elections. Lega Nord's first electoral breakthrough was at the 1990 regional elections, but it was with the 1992 general election that the party emerged as a leading political actor. Having gained 8.7% of the vote, 56 deputies and 26 senators, it became the fourth largest party of the country and within Parliament.
1992年4月25日：President Francesco Cossiga resigned.
1992年5月25日：Oscar Luigi Scalfaro is elected President of the Republic.
1992年6月28日：Giuliano Amato (PSI) is premier of a PSI-DC-PLI-PSDI coalition.
1992年：Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino, two Italian anti-Mafia magistrates, are assassinated by the mafia.
1992年12月15日：Bettino Craxi is under investigation in Milan for corruption.
1993年3月27日：Giulio Andreotti is under investigation for collusion with the mafia.
1993年4月18日：The public overwhelmingly backed the abrogation of the existing proportional representation parliamentary electoral law in a referendum, for the benefit of a majority system.
1993年4月21日：Prime Minister Giuliano Amato resigns.
1993年4月26日：Carlo Azeglio Ciampi, former governor of the national bank, was appointed head of the government and appointed a technical government without political influences.

1993年4月29日：Italian Parliament denied permission to proceed against Bettino Craxi, accused of corruption. Several members of the government, having been in office just three days, resigned in protest; among them were Francesco Rutelli, Minister of the Environment and Vincenzo Visco, Minister of Finance.
1993年：The Sicilian Mafia organizes some attacks in Rome, Florence and Milan.
1993年8月4日：A mixed system was introduced by the Parliament.
1993年8月：Parliament grants authorization to proceed against Bettino Craxi.

1994年4月27日：Media magnate Silvio Berlusconi becomes prime minister for a rightist coalition. However, the pact between northern autonomists and southern post-fascists collapsed late in the year, and Berlusconi is forced to resign as prime minister.
1994年9月1日：The Italian film Il Postino: The Postman premieres at the Venice Film Festival.
1996年5月17日：Romano Prodi becomes prime minister for the Olive Tree coalition, voted into power with the external support of the communists.
1996年12月31日：The Tricolour Day is established.
1997年：Valentino Rossi wins his first World Championship at the 1997 Grand Prix motorcycle racing season.

1997年10月：Dario Fo, an Italian avant-garde playwright, manager-director, and actor-mime, is awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature. A theatrical caricaturist with a flair for social agitation, he has often faced government censure.
1997年12月20日：Roberto Benigni's film Life Is Beautiful is released.

1998年2月3日：20 skiers (of which 3 Italians) die in the Cavalese cable car disaster, when a US EA-6B Prowler military jet severed the cables supporting the Cermis mountain cable car. Pilots will be later found not guilty by an American court.
1999年1月1日：Italy is accepted in the eurozone.

1999年3月21日：The film Life is Beautiful is nominated for seven Academy Awards. The film wins the awards for Best Actor (the first for a male performer in a non-English-speaking role, and only the third overall acting Oscar for non-English-speaking roles), the Best Original Dramatic Score and the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film.

1999年3月24日：Italy takes part in the Kosovo War, a NATO-led aerial operation against Milosevic's Yugoslavia to prevent genocide in Kosovo. The premier is Massimo D'Alema, of the post-communist Partito Democratico della Sinistra.
1999年5月13日：Carlo Azeglio Ciampi is elected President of the Republic.
2000年1月20日：Bettino Craxi dies at Hammamet, Tunisia.
2001年6月11日：Berlusconi's second term as prime minister begins.
2001年7月20日：Violence erupts at the G8 demonstrations in Genoa. The police are accused of severe abuses; one demonstrator is shot dead.
2001年10月：Italy takes part in the Afghanistan War.
2001年11月：Former President Giovanni Leone dies.
2002年1月1日：The euro begins circulating as new official currency of Italy.
2003年3月：Italy takes part in the Iraq War, although populations show disapproval through peace flags.
2004年3月30日：It is established the National Memorial Day of the Exiles and Foibe.
links: National Memorial Day of the Exiles and Foibe

items.text: 2005年3月4日：Nicola Calipari, Italian secret agent, is shot dead by friendly fire from a US patrol during the rescue of journalist Giuliana Sgrena from kidnappers in Baghdad. US later refused the extradition of the identified shooter, Mario Lozano.
2006年2月10日：The 2006 Winter Olympics are held in Turin (to 26 February).
2006年5月17日：Prodi's second term as prime minister begins.
2006年7月9日：The Italy national football team wins its fourth FIFA World Cup in Germany.
2006年9月：Italy's engagement is pivotal in the deployment of the UNIFIL peace force after the 2006 Lebanon War.
2006年12月：Italian government withdraws its troops from Iraq, ending the Operation Ancient Babylon.
2008年：Berlusconi's third term as prime minister begins.
2009年4月6日：An earthquake strikes L'Aquila, causing the death of 307 people and making about 65,000 homeless.
2010年8月：Former President Francesco Cossiga dies.
2012年1月：Former president Oscar Luigi Scalfaro dies.
2013年5月6日：Former prime minister Giulio Andreotti dies at 94 years old in Rome.
2015年1月：President Giorgio Napolitano resigns.
2015年1月31日：Sergio Mattarella is the new President of the Italian Republic.
2016年9月：Former President Carlo Azeglio Ciampi died in Rome.
2018年3月4日：Italian general election, 2018
2020年2月：COVID-19 pandemic hits Italy among the first countries in Europe. COVID-19 virus originated in China, spreads in Italy without being clearly detected in the winter of 2019.

2020年3月：In March 2020, the government imposed a national quarantine as a measure to limit the spread of the coronavirus pandemic in the country. Later that month, Italy became the country with the highest total number of deaths in the worldwide coronavirus pandemic.
2020年12月：On 27 December 2020, the COVID-19 vaccination campaign in Italy starts. The first Pfizer - BioNTech COVID-19 vaccines are sent to Italy.
2021年2月：Mario Draghi appointed Prime Minister.
2022年7月：2022 Italian government crisis.
2022年9月25日：Italian general election, 2022
2022年10月22日：Giorgia Meloni appointed Prime Minister, the first woman to hold this position.
links: List of elected and appointed female heads of state and government

items.text: 955年8月10日：Battle of Lechfeld (955): An East Frankish army under king Otto I, Holy Roman Emperor trapped a Hungarian army behind the Lech and wiped it out, saving the city of Augsburg and extending East Frankish territory eastward.

960年：Burkhard, Margrave of Austria was created margrave of the Eastern March, comprising territories recently conquered from the Hungarians, under the lordship of the Duchy of Bavaria and its duke, his sister-in-law's husband Henry II, Duke of Bavaria.
976年：Henry II, duke of Bavaria, launched a revolt in his duchy against Otto II, Holy Roman Emperor, the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire. Burkhard joined him.
976年：Otto II, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, conquered Regensburg, the Bavarian capital, then in revolt.

976年：An Imperial Diet of the Holy Roman Empire at Regensburg formally stripped Henry II, Duke of Bavaria of his duchy and appointed Otto I, Duke of Swabia and Bavaria, nephew of Otto II, the Holy Roman Emperor, and already duke of Swabia, duke of Bavaria.
links: Otto I, Duke of Swabia and Bavaria

items.text: 976年7月21日：Leopold I the Illustrious, Margrave of Austria, a count of Babenberg, replaced Burkhard as margrave of the Bavarian Eastern March.
984年：Leopold the Illustrious captured the fortress at Melk, the last redoubt of Burkhard's partisans, and established his capital there.
987年：Leopold the Illustrious conquered territory extending to the Vienna Woods.
