991年：Leopold the Illustrious conquered territory extending to the Fischa.
994年7月8日：Leopold the Illustrious was struck in the eye by an arrow at a tournament in Würzburg.
994年7月10日：Leopold the Illustrious died.
994年：Otto III, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Kingdom of Germany, appointed Leopold the Illustrious's son Henry I the Strong, Margrave of Austria margrave of the Eastern March.
996年11月1日：The term Ostarrîchi was first used, possibly in reference to a small fief within the Eastern March.
1002年：Henry II, Holy Roman Emperor, then duke of Bavaria and King of the Romans, added the land between the Kamp and Morava rivers and some territory southwest of Vienna to the territory of Austria.

1018年6月23日：Henry the Strong died from wounds he suffered in battle against Bolesław I the Brave, duke of Poland. He was succeeded as margrave by his younger brother Adalbert the Victorious, Margrave of Austria.
1055年5月26日：Adalbert the Victorious died in the Austrian capital Melk. He was succeeded by his son Ernest the Brave, Margrave of Austria.

1062年4月：Coup of Kaiserswerth: Anno II, archbishop of Cologne, kidnapped the young Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, then King of the Romans, and demanded that his mother and regent Agnes of Poitou hand over the Imperial Regalia to his coconspirators.
links: Imperial Regalia of the Holy Roman Empire

items.text: 1065年3月29日：An accolade ceremony was held in Mainz recognizing the majority of Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor.

1073年6月29日：Saxon Rebellion: The Saxon nobility, at the head of a large army, came to the Imperial Palace of Goslar to protest the frequent stays of Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Germany, on their territory and his promotion of local ministeriales. The king fled.
1074年2月2日：Saxon Rebellion: Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Germany signed the Treaty of Gerstungen agreeing to restore the rebel duke Otto of Nordheim in Bavaria.

1075年6月9日：Battle of Langensalza (1075): Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Kingdom of Germany, and a number of his vassals, including Ernest the Brave, destroyed a Saxon army composed largely of peasant draftees near what is now Bad Langensalza. Ernest the Brave was killed. He was succeeded by his son Leopold II the Fair, Margrave of Austria.

1075年：Investiture Controversy: The pope Pope Gregory VII composed the Dictatus papae, declaring that his office was granted by God, and that he had the right to depose emperors, as well as the sole authority to appoint and transfer bishops.

1075年：Investiture Controversy: Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Germany, reasserted his right to appoint bishops in a letter in which he addressed the pope, Pope Gregory VII, as a false monk and called for his removal.
1078年：Investiture Controversy: Altmann of Passau, bishop of Passau, fled to Austria following the invasion of his diocese by supporters of Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, the king of Germany.
1079年：Investiture Controversy: Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Germany, invaded Austria in pursuit of the fugitive bishop Altmann of Passau.
1081年8月6日：Leopold the Fair supported the election at Forchheim of Hermann of Salm, count of Salm, as king of Germany in opposition to Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor.
1081年：Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Germany, deposed Leopold the Fair and granted his territory to Vratislaus II of Bohemia, duke of Bohemia.
1082年5月12日：Battle of Mailberg: A Bohemian army invading in support of the claim of Vratislaus II of Bohemia decisively defeated the Austrians at Mailberg.
1095年10月12日：Leopold the Fair died. He was succeeded as margrave of Austria by his son Leopold III the Good, Margrave of Austria.
1103年：Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, issued the Landfrieden, establishing some rules on the resolution of disputes between rulers of states of the Empire.

1104年：Investiture Controversy: Henry V, Holy Roman Emperor, king of Germany and son and heir of Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, rebelled against his father at the urging of the pope Pope Paschal II.
1104年12月：Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, was forced at an Imperial Diet at Mainz to abdicate in favor of his son Henry V, Holy Roman Emperor, then king of Germany.
1106年：Leopold the Good married Agnes of Waiblingen, sister of Henry V, Holy Roman Emperor, the king of Germany.
1136年11月15日：Leopold the Good died. He was succeeded as margrave of Austria by his son Leopold the Generous, Duke of Bavaria.
1137年：Leopold the Generous granted the Peterskirche in Vienna to the prince-bishop of Passau in exchange for some territory outside the city.
1138年3月7日：1138 Imperial election: Conrad III of Germany was elected King of the Romans at Koblenz, defeating Henry X, Duke of Bavaria, duke of Bavaria, Saxony and Spoleto and margrave of Tuscany.

1138年7月：Henry X, Duke of Bavaria announced his refusal to recognize Conrad III of Germany as King of the Romans. In return, Conrad banned him and deprived him of both of his German duchies, granting Bavaria to his supporter Leopold the Generous.
1141年10月18日：Leopold the Generous died. He was succeeded as margrave of Austria and duke of Bavaria by his younger brother Henry II Jasomirgott, Duke of Austria.
1145年：Henry Jasomirgott established his residence in Vienna.
1156年：Frederick I, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, restored the House of Welf to the Duchy of Bavaria in the person of Henry the Lion, son of Henry X, Duke of Bavaria.

1156年9月17日：To compensate Babenberg for their loss of Bavaria, Frederick I, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, issued the Privilegium Minus, elevating Austria to an independent duchy.
1176年11月：Henry Jasomirgott broke his hip falling with his horse from a bridge near Melk.
1177年1月13日：Henry Jasomirgott died in Vienna. He was succeeded by his son Leopold V the Virtuous, Duke of Austria.

1186年8月17日：Leopold the Virtuous and Ottokar IV, Duke of Styria, duke of Styria, signed the Georgenberg Pact, under which the former was to succeed the latter on his death. In exchange, Leopold the Virtuous promised to maintain the rights of the Styrian estates and citizens.
1187年10月2日：Siege of Jerusalem (1187): The city of Jerusalem fell to an Ayyubid siege. The capital of the Kingdom of Jerusalem was moved to Tyre, Lebanon.
1187年10月29日：Third Crusade: The pope Pope Gregory VIII issued the audita tremendi calling for a crusade to reconquer Jerusalem from the Ayyubid dynasty.
1189年8月：Siege of Acre (1189–1191): Guy of Lusignan, jure uxoris king of Jerusalem, laid siege to the Ayyubid city of Acre, Israel.
1191年：Siege of Acre (1189–1191): Leopold the Virtuous took command of the crusader army at Acre, Israel.

1191年7月：Siege of Acre (1189–1191): Acre, Israel fell to the crusaders. The flags of Jerusalem, France, England and Austria were raised on the ramparts. Richard I of England, king of England, ordered the Austrian flag torn down.
1192年5月8日：Ottokar IV, Duke of Styria, duke of Styria, died of leprosy. He was succeeded by Leopold the Virtuous.
1192年：Richard I of England, king of England, was arrested in Vienna for the April murder of Conrad of Montferrat, the king of Jerusalem and cousin to Leopold the Virtuous.
1193年4月19日：English king Richard I of England was released from his captivity at Trifels Castle following the payment of a substantial ransom to Austria and the Holy Roman Empire.

1194年12月31日：Leopold the Virtuous died of gangrene after a botched amputation of his foot, injured at a tournament in Graz. He was succeeded as duke of Austria by one son, Frederick I the Catholic, Duke of Austria, and as duke of Styria by another, Leopold VI the Glorious, Duke of Austria.
1196年：The pope Pope Celestine III censured the late Leopold the Virtuous and his house for his imprisonment and ransoming of Richard I of England, king of England and a fellow crusader.

1197年4月：Crusade of 1197: Frederick the Catholic left Austria on a crusade organized by Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, to reconquer Jerusalem for the Kingdom of Jerusalem and convince the pope Pope Celestine III to support his claim to Sicily.
1197年12月：An army of Austrians and Hungarian nobles loyal to Andrew II of Hungary, then without title, defeated a Hungarian royal army at Mački.
1198年：Emeric, King of Hungary, king of Hungary, was forced to appoint his younger brother Andrew II of Hungary duke in Croatia and Dalmatia.
1198年4月16日：Frederick the Catholic died of illness at Acre, Israel. He was succeeded as duke of Austria by his younger brother Leopold the Glorious.
1199年：Emeric, King of Hungary, king of Hungary, defeated his brother Andrew II of Hungary, duke in Croatia and Dalmatia, at Lake Balaton and forced him to flee into Austria.
1200年：Andrew II of Hungary, then a refugee in Austria, was peacefully restored to power as duke in Croatia and Dalmatia.
1205年：Leopold the Glorious accepted the five-year-old Ladislaus III of Hungary, king of Hungary, and his court as refugees from his uncle and regent Andrew II of Hungary.

1205年5月7日：Ladislaus III of Hungary, the five-year-old king of Hungary, died in Vienna. His uncle and regent, Andrew II of Hungary, whose cruel treatment had forced him to flee into exile, succeeded him as king.

1209年：Albigensian Crusade: The pope Pope Innocent III called for a crusade against Catharism, a gnostic heresy prevalent in Languedoc, and the sympathetic count of Toulouse, Raymond VI, Count of Toulouse.

1212年：Leopold the Glorious took part in an Imperial Diet at Nuremberg which deposed Otto IV, Holy Roman Emperor and elected Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor as King of the Romans with the support of the pope Pope Innocent III.
1212年8月：Albigensian Crusade: Leopold the Glorious left Vienna to participate in the crusade.
1212年：Albigensian Crusade: Leopold the Glorious returned to Austria.
1213年7月12日：Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, King of the Romans, issued the Golden Bull of 1213, a Golden Bull ceding some ecclesiastical rights to the Catholic Church.
1217年7月：Fifth Crusade: Leopold the Glorious left Vienna to take part in another crusade to reconquer Jerusalem from the Ayyubid dynasty.
1218年5月29日：Siege of Damietta (1218–1219): Crusader forces, including Austrian and Styrian forces, landed near the fortress of the Ayyubid city of Damietta.
1218年8月：Fifth Crusade: Leopold the Glorious returned to Austria.
1221年：Vienna was granted the staple right, the right to require merchants passing through to offer their goods for sale.
1230年7月28日：Leopold VI the Glorious, Duke of Austria died. He was succeeded as duke of Austria and Styria by his son Frederick II the Quarrelsome, Duke of Austria.
1235年：Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, invited Bohemia to invade and conquer Austria as punishment for the aggression and impertinence of Frederick the Quarrelsome.
1235年：The residents of Vienna opened the gates of the city to the Bohemian army. Frederick the Quarrelsome fled to Wiener Neustadt.
1235年：Vienna was raised to a free imperial city.
1237年：Mongol invasion of Europe: The army of the Golden Horde arrived at Ryazan.
1238年：Frederick the Quarrelsome created two administrative divisions of Austria: Upper Austria, above the Enns, and Lower Austria below.
1239年：Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, restored Frederick the Quarrelsome as duke of Austria.
1241年4月15日：Battle of Mohi: Austrian forces defeated a small Golden Horde raiding party near Muhi, then withdrew. Hungarian and Templar forces remained in the theater.

1246年6月15日：Battle of the Leitha River: The Kingdom of Hungary defeated an Austrian invasion near the banks of the Leitha. Frederick the Quarrelsome was killed. His sister Margaret of Austria, Queen of Bohemia and his niece Gertrude of Austria both claimed the succession in Austria and Styria.
links: Margaret of Austria, Queen of Bohemia

items.text: 1246年：Wenceslaus I of Bohemia, king of Bohemia, married his son and heir Vladislaus III of Moravia, margrave of Moravia, to Gertrude.
1246年：The Austrian nobility gave homage to Vladislaus in support of his claim by right of his wife Gertrude.
1247年1月3日：Vladislaus died.

1248年：Herman VI, Margrave of Baden, margrave of Baden, married Gertrude. He laid claim to Austria and Styria by right of his wife and left his brother Rudolf I, Margrave of Baden-Baden to govern Baden.
1250年10月4日：Herman died.
1250年：Wenceslaus I of Bohemia, king of Bohemia, invaded Austria, possibly at the invitation of the local nobility.
1251年：The Austrian nobility acclaimed Ottokar II the Iron and Golden King of Bohemia, son and heir of the king of Bohemia Wenceslaus I of Bohemia, duke.
1252年2月11日：Ottokar the Iron and Golden King married Margaret.
links: Margaret of Austria, Queen of Bohemia

items.text: 1252年6月27日：Gertrude married Roman Danylovich, son and heir of Daniel of Galicia, knyaz of Galicia and a relative of Béla IV of Hungary, king of Hungary.
1253年9月23日：Wenceslaus I of Bohemia, king of Bohemia, died. He was succeeded by Ottokar the Iron and Golden King, his son.
1253年：Béla IV of Hungary, king of Hungary, claimed ownership of Styria.
1253年：Gertrude and Roman Danylovich were divorced.

1254年：After mediation by the pope Pope Innocent IV, Ottokar the Iron and Golden King agreed to cede much of Styria to Béla IV of Hungary, king of Hungary, in exchange for the latter's recognition of his claims in Austria.
1258年：Stephen V of Hungary, son and heir of Béla IV of Hungary, king of Hungary, was appointed duke of Styria.
1260年：Ottokar the Iron and Golden King invaded Styria in support of a revolt by the local nobility.
1260年7月：Battle of Kressenbrunn: Austrian and Bohemian forces repulsed a Hungarian attack over the Morava near modern Engelhartstetten. Many Hungarian soldiers drowned in the river.
1261年：Béla IV of Hungary, king of Hungary, renounced his claim to Styria in favor of Ottokar the Iron and Golden King.
1266年10月29日：Margaret died.
links: Margaret of Austria, Queen of Bohemia

items.text: 1273年10月1日：1273 Imperial election: Rudolf I of Habsburg of Germany, count of Habsburg, was elected King of the Romans in Frankfurt, defeating Ottokar the Iron and Golden King, who refused to recognize his election.
1274年11月：An Imperial Diet at Nuremberg held that all territories which had changed hands in the interregnum following the death of Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor had to be returned.

1276年：Rudolf I of Germany, King of the Romans, banned Ottokar the Iron and Golden King for failing to recognize his election and for failing to cede Austria, Styria and Carinthia to imperial administration after the extinction of the male line in each of those duchies.
1276年6月：Rudolf I of Germany, King of the Romans, declared war on Ottokar the Iron and Golden King.

1276年11月：Ottokar the Iron and Golden King ceded Austria, Styria, Carinthia and Carniola to the direct administration of the Holy Roman Empire. King of the Romans Rudolf I of Germany rescinded the imperial ban and restored him to the Kingdom of Bohemia.
1278年：Ottokar the Iron and Golden King invaded Austria.

1278年8月26日：Battle on the Marchfeld: A Holy Roman Empire and Hungarian army decisively defeated a Bohemian, Głogów and Lower Bavarian force near Dürnkrut, Austria and Jedenspeigen. Ottokar the Iron and Golden King was killed.

1282年12月27日：A Hoftag at Augsburg recognized the appointment of Rudolf I of Germany's sons Albert I of Habsburg of Germany and Rudolf II, Duke of Austria as dukes jointly and severally of Austria and Styria and margraves jointly and severally of Carniola and the Windic March.

1283年6月1日：The Treaty of Rheinfelden was signed at Rheinfelden, establishing the succession of Rudolf I of Germany. Albert of Habsburg was to receive the sole rule of Austria and Styria. In exchange, Rudolf II would receive some territories in Further Austria. The treaty also established primogeniture as the Habsburg order of succession.

1286年：Meinhard, Duke of Carinthia, count of Tyrol and Albert of Habsburg's father in law, was made duke of Carinthia and margrave of Carniola and the Windic March as compensation for his earlier support of Rudolf I of Germany against Ottokar the Iron and Golden King.
1290年5月10日：Rudolf II died.
1291年7月15日：Rudolf I of Germany died.
1291年11月29日：Albert II, Duke of Saxony, duke of Saxony, agreed to support the candidate of Wenceslaus II of Bohemia, king of Bohemia, in the upcoming imperial election.

1292年4月27日：Adolf, King of the Romans, count of Nassau and Siegfried II of Westerburg, archbishop of Cologne signed the Treaty of Andernach, under which the latter agreed to support the former in the upcoming imperial election in exchange for significant territorial concessions.

1292年5月5日：1292 Imperial election: Adolf, King of the Romans, count of Nassau, was elected King of the Romans at Frankfurt, denying the wishes of Rudolf I of Germany to see his son Albert of Habsburg elected.

1292年6月30日：Adolf, King of the Romans, King of the Romans, agreed to depose Albert of Habsburg in Austria and Styria and to grant those duchies to Wenceslaus II of Bohemia, king of Kingdom of Bohemia, by force if necessary.
1292年11月：Adolf, King of the Romans, King of the Romans, recognized Albert of Habsburg as duke of Austria and Styria, margrave of the Windic March, and lord of Pordenone.
1294年：Adolf, King of the Romans, King of the Romans, purchased the landgraviate of Thuringia and the margravate of Meissen from Albert II, Margrave of Meissen.

1298年6月23日：The Elector of Mainz, acting on behalf of himself and that of Wenceslaus II of Bohemia, king of Bohemia and Wigbold von Holte, the archbishop of Cologne, declared Adolf, King of the Romans, King of the Romans, deposed at a meeting in Mainz in the presence of some lesser nobility.
1298年7月2日：Battle of Göllheim: Albert of Habsburg personally killed Adolf, King of the Romans, King of the Romans in battle at Göllheim.
1298年7月27日：Albert of Habsburg was elected King of the Romans in Frankfurt.
1298年8月24日：Albert of Habsburg was crowned King of the Romans at Aachen Cathedral in Aachen.
1298年11月21日：Albert of Habsburg appointed his son Rudolf I of Bohemia duke of Austria and Styria jointly with himself.
1306年8月4日：Wenceslaus III of Bohemia, the last king of Bohemia of the Přemyslid dynasty, was stabbed to death in Olomouc by an unknown assassin.
1306年：The Bohemian nobility elected Henry of Bohemia king.
1306年：The Holy Roman Emperor Albert of Habsburg invaded Bohemia and installed Rudolf I of Bohemia on the throne.
1307年5月31日：Battle of Lucka: Frederick I, Margrave of Meissen defeated the forces of the Holy Roman Empire at Lucka, preserving the rule of the House of Wettin over Thuringia.

1307年7月4日：Rudolf died, probably due to complications from a preexisting gastrointestinal disease, while besieging a Bohemian rebel fortress at Horažďovice. Albert became sole duke of Austria and Styria.

1308年5月1日：Albert of Habsburg was murdered at Windisch by his nephew, Rudolf II's son John Parricida, who felt that the Treaty of Rheinfelden had deprived him of his inheritance. He was succeeded by two of his sons, Frederick the Fair and Leopold I, Duke of Austria, ruling jointly as dukes of Austria and Styria.

1313年：Frederick the Fair invaded Lower Bavaria in a dispute with Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, duke of Upper Bavaria, over who would tutor the sons of the late Stephen I, Duke of Bavaria, duke of Lower Bavaria.

1313年11月9日：Battle of Gammelsdorf: The forces of Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, duke of Upper Bavaria, defeated those of Frederick the Fair at Gammelsdorf. Frederick the Fair was forced to renounce the tutelage of the children of the late Stephen I, Duke of Bavaria, duke of Lower Bavaria.
1314年10月19日：Imperial election, October 19, 1314: Four electors of the Holy Roman Empire selected Frederick the Fair as King of the Romans at Frankfurt.

1314年10月20日：Imperial election, October 20, 1314: Five electors of the Holy Roman Empire selected Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, duke of Upper Bavaria, as King of the Romans at Frankfurt in opposition to Frederick the Fair.
1314年11月25日：Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, duke of Upper Bavaria, was crowned King of the Romans at Aachen.
1314年11月25日：Frederick the Fair was crowned King of the Romans at the Bonn Minster in Bonn.
1315年11月15日：Battle of Morgarten: A Swiss force ambushed and destroyed a Habsburg army at Ägerisee, saving the Swiss Confederacy from possible annexation to Austria.

1316年：Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, a claimant against Frederick the Fair to the title of King of the Romans, granted the Waldstätte of the Old Swiss Confederacy independence from the House of Habsburg.

1322年9月28日：Battle of Mühldorf: The forces of Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, duke of Upper Bavaria and a claimant to the title King of the Romans, defeated those of his rival Frederick the Fair in battle at Ampfing. Frederick the Fair was captured.
1324年：The pope Pope John XXII excommunicated Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, duke of Upper Bavaria and a claimant in opposition to Frederick the Fair to the title King of the Romans.

1325年3月13日：Frederick the Fair signed the Treaty of Trausnitz at Trausnitz Castle with his captor Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, duke of Upper Bavaria. Under its terms, he agreed to recognize his captor as King of the Romans in exchange for his liberty, and to convince his partisans to lay down their arms.

1325年：Having failed to convince Leopold I, Duke of Austria, his younger brother and co-ruler of Austria and Styria, to abandon his war against Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor, King of the Romans, Frederick the Fair returned to captivity in Munich.

1326年1月7日：Louis IV, Holy Roman Emperor and Frederick the Fair signed the Treaty of Ulm, under which the former was to be crowned Holy Roman Emperor, but the latter would administer the Holy Roman Empire as King of the Romans.
1326年2月28日：Leopold I, Duke of Austria died. Frederick the Fair left the administration of the Holy Roman Empire to return to rule Austria and Styria.

1330年1月13日：Frederick the Fair died. He was succeeded by his younger brothers Albert II the Wise, the Lame, Duke of Austria and Otto the Merry, Duke of Austria, ruling jointly as dukes of Austria and Styria.
1335年4月2日：Henry of Bohemia, duke of Carinthia and margrave of Carniola, died, leaving no male heirs.

1335年5月2日：Albert the Wise and Otto the Merry, whose mother, Elizabeth of Carinthia, Queen of Germany was sister to Henry of Bohemia, the late duke of Carinthia, were jointly appointed dukes of Carinthia and margraves of Carniola.
links: Elizabeth of Carinthia, Queen of Germany

items.text: 1339年：Otto the Merry died. He was survived by two young sons.
1344年8月10日：Otto the Merry's younger son, the sixteen-year-old Leopold II, Duke of Austria, died, possibly due to poisoning.
1344年12月11日：Otto the Merry's surviving son, the seventeen-year-old Frederick, died, possibly after being poisoned.
1358年8月16日：Albert the Wise died. According to his will, he was succeeded by his eldest son, Rudolf IV the Founder, Duke of Austria.

1359年：Rudolf the Founder ordered the creation of the Privilegium Maius, a set of forged documents, some purportedly issued by Julius Caesar, which raised Austria to an archduchy and granted it additional rights including the privilegium de non evocando, the right to issue judgments which could not be appealed to the Holy Roman Emperor.
1363年：Rudolf the Founder and the childless Margaret, Countess of Tyrol signed a treaty providing for the former's inheritance of the County of Tyrol on the latter's death.
1363年：Stephen II, Duke of Bavaria, duke of Bavaria, invaded Tyrol.
1364年：Rudolf the Founder took the title duke of Carniola.
1365年：The town of Novo Mesto was established.
1365年：Albert III, Count of Gorizia died. His territories in Istria, White Carniola and the Windic March were inherited by Rudolf the Founder and added to Carniola.

1365年7月27日：Rudolf the Founder died. He was succeeded by his younger brothers Albert III with the Braid, Duke of Austria and Leopold III the Just, Duke of Austria, ruling jointly as dukes of Austria, Styria and Carniola.
1368年：Leopold the Just expelled Bavarian forces from County of Tyrol.
1368年：The citizens of Freiburg im Breisgau purchased their independence from the count of Freiburg and submitted to Habsburg protection. The city was added to Further Austria.
1369年10月3日：Margaret, Countess of Tyrol died. Albert with the Braid and Leopold the Just succeeded her jointly as counts of Tyrol.
1375年12月：The mercenary Gugler army crossed the Jura Mountains into Habsburg territory.
1376年1月：The Gugler were forced to retreat into France.
1376年8月6日：Albert with the Braid agreed to Leopold the Just's right to make separate treaties with foreign powers.

1379年：Albert with the Braid and Leopold the Just signed the Treaty of Neuberg at Neuberg Abbey, dividing their father's possessions. Albert and his descendants were to rule Austria, Leopold and his descendants Styria, Carinthia, Carniola, Tyrol, Further Austria and Friuli.
1382年：The Imperial Free City of Trieste seceded from the Patriarchate of Aquileia and became part of Leopold the Just's domains in exchange for his protection.

1386年7月9日：Battle of Sempach: A Swiss force decisively defeated an invasion by Leopold the Just at Sempach. Leopold was killed, along with a number of his vassals. He was succeeded by his young sons William the Courteous, Duke of Austria and Leopold IV the Fat, Duke of Austria, with his brother Albert with the Braid acting as regent.
1387年3月11日：The citizens of Glarus declared themselves independent of Austrian rule.
1388年4月9日：Battle of Näfels: Swiss forces decisively defeated an Austrian invasion of Glarus at Näfels.
1395年8月29日：Albert with the Braid died. He was succeeded in his lands by his son Albert IV, Duke of Austria.
1401年：Appenzell Wars: A popular uprising took place in Appenzell against the rule of the prince-abbot of the Abbey of Saint Gall, an ally of the Habsburgs.
1404年9月14日：Albert IV died. He was succeeded as duke of Austria by his young son Albert II the Magnanimous of Germany, with his cousin William the Courteous acting as regent.

1406年7月15日：William the Courteous died without heirs. He was succeeded in Upper Austria by Leopold the Fat and in Carinthia, Styria and Carniola by another brother, Ernest the Iron, Duke of Austria. Leopold ceded Tyrol to yet another brother, Frederick IV of the Empty Pockets, Duke of Austria and replaced William as regent for Albert the Magnanimous.
1411年6月3日：Leopold the Fat died. His territories were divided between Ernest the Iron and Frederick of the Empty Pockets. Albert the Magnanimous was granted his majority.
1411年：Appenzell Wars: Appenzell signed a mutual defense treaty with Switzerland to secure its independence from the Abbey of Saint Gall.
1419年7月30日：Hussite Wars: A Hussite procession led by the priest Jan Želivský threw seven government officials, including the burgomaster, from the New Town Hall in Prague, killing them.
1420年5月23日：Albert the Magnanimous ordered the imprisonment and forcible conversion of the Jews in Austria.
1420年6月12日：Battle of Vítkov Hill: A crusader force including some Austrian soldiers laid siege fortifications on a hill outside Prague.
1420年7月14日：Battle of Vítkov Hill: The crusader forces were surprised and routed, ending the siege. Several hundred were killed.
1421年3月12日：Two hundred Jews, the last practicing in Austria, were burned at the stake outside Vienna.
1423年：Sigismund, Holy Roman Emperor, King of the Romans, king of Hungary, king of Croatia and Bohemia and Albert the Magnanimous's father-in-law, appointed Albert margrave of Moravia.

1424年6月10日：Ernest the Iron died. He was survived by six children including his young sons Frederick III, Holy Roman Emperor and Albert VI, Archduke of Austria. Frederick of the Empty Pockets appointed himself regent over Ernest's territories.

1431年8月14日：Battle of Domažlice: A Holy Roman Empire force, including some troops led by Albert the Magnanimous, was driven from its siege positions at Domažlice and wiped out in the nearby Bohemian Forest.
1431年10月14日：Battle of Waidhofen: A Taborite raiding party was attacked and defeated by Austrian and Bohemian forces at Waidhofen an der Thaya.
1435年：Frederick III claimed his majority with the support of Albert the Magnanimous.
1436年：Albert VI was granted his majority.

1437年6月：Transylvanian peasant revolt: A peasant revolt broke out in eastern Hungary following a demand by the local bishop György Lépes that the locals pay several years' overdue tithe in a single lump sum in the new currency.

1437年12月9日：Sigismund, Holy Roman Emperor, emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, king of Hungary and king of Croatia and Bohemia, died. Albert the Magnanimous, his son-in-law, succeeded him in Hungary, Croatia and Bohemia, though the Hussite nobles in Bohemia remained in open revolt.
1438年1月：Transylvanian peasant revolt: The last of the rebels, besieged in Cluj-Napoca, surrendered.
1438年3月18日：1438 Imperial election: Albert the Magnanimous was elected King of the Romans at Frankfurt.
1439年6月24日：Frederick of the Empty Pockets died. He was succeeded as duke of Further Austria and count of Tyrol by his young son Sigismund, Archduke of Austria, with Frederick III acting as regent.
1439年10月27日：Albert the Magnanimous died at Neszmély defending Hungary against an Ottoman invasion. He was survived by two daughters and by his pregnant wife Elizabeth of Luxembourg.
1440年2月2日：1440 Imperial election: Frederick III was elected King of the Romans at Frankfurt.
1440年2月22日：Elizabeth of Luxembourg, Albert the Magnanimous's wife, gave birth to a son, Ladislaus the Posthumous.
1440年5月15日：Ladislaus was crowned king of Hungary with the Holy Crown of Hungary by his mother in Székesfehérvár.
1440年6月29日：The Diet of Hungary declared Ladislaus's coronation invalid.
1440年7月17日：Władysław III of Poland, the king of Poland, was crowned king of Hungary under the eye of the Diet at Visegrád.
1440年11月2日：Old Zürich War: Zürich was expelled from the Old Swiss Confederacy due to a dispute over the succession in Toggenburg.

1440年11月22日：Elizabeth of Luxembourg granted Frederick III guardianship over her son Ladislaus. In exchange, she received financial support to defend her son's claim to the throne of Hungary against Władysław III of Poland.
1442年：Old Zürich War: Zürich concluded an alliance with the Holy Roman Empire.

1442年3月18日：Battle of Hermannstadt: A Hungarian force was defeated by a numerically superior Ottoman force near Sântimbru, Alba and force to withdraw. One of the Hungarian commanders, the bishop György Lépes, was captured and beheaded.
1442年12月19日：Elizabeth of Luxembourg, mother to Ladislaus the Posthumous, died, possibly after having been poisoned.
1443年1月1日：Crusade of Varna: The pope Pope Eugene IV called for a crusade to expel the Ottoman Empire from the Balkans.
1443年7月22日：Battle of St. Jakob an der Sihl: A Swiss army forced imperial and Zürich forces to abandon a defensive position on the Sihlfeld outside of Zürich.
links: Battle of St. Jakob an der Sihl

items.text: 1443年11月3日：Battle of Nish (1443): Hungarian, Polish and Serbian forces captured the Ottoman city of Niš.
1443年12月12日：Battle of Zlatitsa: The Hungarian, Polish and Serbian armies were defeated near modern Zlatitsa, in a pass of the Balkan Mountains, halting their advance into Ottoman territory.
1444年1月2日：Battle of Kunovica: An Ottoman army pursuing Hungarian, Polish and Serbian forces after their retreat from Zlatitsa were ambushed and defeated in the shadow of Suva Planina.

1444年11月10日：Battle of Varna: The Ottoman Empire decisively defeated an inferior Polish-Hungarian-Wallachian force at Varna. Władysław III of Poland, king of Poland and claimant against Ladislaus the Posthumous to the throne of Hungary, was killed.

1445年6月1日：The Diet of Hungary offered the throne of Hungary to Ladislaus on the condition that Frederick III release him and the Holy Crown of Hungary to their care. Frederick refused their terms and invaded.
1446年：Sigismund, Archduke of Austria was granted his majority.
1446年6月1日：The Hungarian nobility accepted Frederick III's guardianship over Ladislaus in exchange for a truce.
1446年6月6日：The Diet of Hungary elected John Hunyadi governor of Hungary during Ladislaus's minority.
1446年6月12日：Old Zürich War: Zürich and the Old Swiss Confederacy agreed to an armistice.
1448年2月17日：Frederick III and the Holy See signed the Concordat of Vienna, recognizing the right of the Holy Roman Emperor to appoint bishops.
1448年9月3日：The Hussite rebel George of Poděbrady captured the Bohemian capital Prague.
1448年10月17日：Battle of Kosovo (1448): An allied force of Hungarians, Poles, Wallachians and Moldavians met a numerically superior Ottoman force on Kosovo field, near modern Kosovo Polje.
1448年10月20日：Battle of Kosovo (1448): The Christian forces were dispersed after heavy losses.

1450年10月22日：John Hunyadi and Frederick III agreed that the latter would be Ladislaus's guardian until his eighteenth birthday, in defiance of local customs which granted majority at twelve or sixteen.
1451年：Frederick III recognized George of Poděbrady as governor of Bohemia.
1451年：Sigismund, Archduke of Austria annexed the County of Bregenz and took the title count of Bregenz.
1452年3月19日：Frederick III was crowned Holy Roman Emperor with the Imperial Crown of the Holy Roman Empire in Rome by the pope Pope Nicholas V.
links: Imperial Crown of the Holy Roman Empire

items.text: 1452年9月4日：The Austrian nobility forced Frederick III to renounce his guardianship of Ladislaus and allow him to enter Hungary as its king.
1453年1月：John Hunyadi resigned as governor of Hungary but remained in charge of collecting tax.
1453年：In his capacity as Holy Roman Emperor, Frederick III confirmed the authenticity of the Privilegium Maius and raised Ladislaus the Posthumous to archduke of Austria.
1453年10月28日：Ladislaus the Posthumous was crowned king of Bohemia in Prague.
1454年10月2日：Battle of Kruševac: While Ottoman forces mobilized further north for an invasion of Serbia, Serbian and Hungarian forces surprised and defeated a smaller contingent at Kruševac.
1456年7月4日：Siege of Belgrade (1456): Ottoman forces laid siege to what is now Belgrade.
1456年7月22日：Siege of Belgrade (1456): A mostly peasant crusader force dispersed the Ottoman army and forced their withdrawal to Constantinople.
1456年8月11日：John Hunyadi died of plague at what is now Zemun.
1457年11月23日：Ladislaus the Posthumous died of plague or leukemia in Prague. Frederick III and Albert VI claimed his inheritance.
1458年1月24日：John Hunyadi's young son Matthias Corvinus was unanimously elected king of Hungary by the Hungarian nobility.
1458年3月2日：George of Poděbrady was unanimously elected king by the Bohemian estates.
1458年：Albert VI conquered some territory from Frederick III in what is now Upper Austria.
1460年：Sigismund, Archduke of Austria was excommunicated by the pope Pope Pius II over a territorial conflict with cardinal Nicholas of Cusa, the prince-bishop of Brixen.
1462年：Albert VI supported an urban revolt in Frederick III's capital Vienna, enabling him to take possession of what is now Lower Austria.

1463年7月19日：Hungary and the Holy Roman Empire signed the Peace Treaty of Wiener Neustadt. Frederick III released the Holy Crown of Hungary to the Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus in exchange for eighty thousand florins and the promise that, if Matthias died without heirs, the throne would pass to Frederick or his son Maximilian I, Holy Roman Emperor.
1463年12月2日：Albert VI died. His conquests fell back to his older brother Frederick III.
1468年：Bohemian–Hungarian War (1468–1478): Matthias Corvinus, the king of Hungary, invaded Bohemia on the pretext of restoring it to Catholicism.
1469年：Sigismund, Archduke of Austria sold some territories on the Rhine to Charles the Bold, duke of Burgundy.

1473年：Cologne Diocesan Feud: The Landstände of the Electorate of Cologne declared the archbishop, Ruprecht of the Palatinate, deposed and elevated Hermann IV of Hesse in his stead as diocesan administrator.
links: Ruprecht of the Palatinate (Archbishop of Cologne)

items.text: 1474年：Sigismund, Archduke of Austria purchased the County of Sonnenberg.
1474年7月29日：Siege of Neuss: Burgundian forces laid siege to the free imperial city of Neuss as part of an invasion of Cologne in support of the deposed archbishop Ruprecht of the Palatinate.
links: Ruprecht of the Palatinate (Archbishop of Cologne)

items.text: 1474年：Burgundian Wars: Sigismund, Archduke of Austria joined Switzerland in alliance against the Duchy of Burgundy.
1474年11月13日：Battle of Héricourt: An anti-Burgundian alliance including some of Sigismund, Archduke of Austria's forces defeated the Duchy of Burgundy in battle.
1474年12月：Burgundian Wars: Frederick III and Louis XI of France, the king of France, signed the Treaty of Andernach, under whose terms France joined the anti-Burgundian alliance.

1475年5月：Siege of Neuss: The arrival of Frederick III's forces compelled the Duchy of Burgundy to lift the siege of Neuss. The Burgundian duke Charles the Bold promised the hand of his only child, Mary of Burgundy, to Maximilian.

1477年1月5日：Battle of Nancy: The Burgundian army was surrounded and wiped out by Swiss and Lorrain forces while besieging the Lorrain capital Nancy, now Nancy, France. Charles the Bold, the duke of Burgundy, was killed.

1477年2月11日：The States General of the Netherlands recognized Mary of Burgundy, the daughter and only child of the deceased duke Charles the Bold, as ruler of Burgundy in exchange for her grant of the Great Privilege, which restored the ancient rights and privileges of Flanders, Brabant, Hainaut, and Holland.
1477年：Frederick III raised Sigismund, Archduke of Austria to an archduke.
1477年8月16日：Mary of Burgundy, the duchess regnant of Burgundy, married Maximilian.
1477年：Austrian–Hungarian War (1477–1488): Hungary invaded Austria as punishment for the latter's diplomatic support of Hussite Bohemia in the Bohemian–Hungarian War.

1478年3月：Bohemian–Hungarian War (1468–1478): Matthias Corvinus, king of Hungary and Vladislaus II of Hungary, king of Bohemia signed the Treaty of Brno, ending the war. Vladislaus accepted Matthias's conquests in Bohemia. Each recognized the other's right to use the title king of Bohemia.
1479年8月7日：Battle of Guinegate (1479): Burgundian forces defeated a smaller French army at Enguinegatte, defending Maximilian's claim against that of the French king Louis XI of France.

1482年3月27日：Mary of Burgundy died. Philip I the Handsome, the Fair of Castile, her young son and Maximilian's, succeeded as duke of Burgundy. Maximilian took over the rule of Burgundy as regent for his son.
1482年7月4日：Siege of Hainburg: Hungarian forces laid siege to the Austrian city of Hainburg an der Donau.
1482年：Maximilian renounced the Great Privilege.
1482年9月30日：Siege of Hainburg: The garrison at Hainburg an der Donau surrendered to the Hungarian besiegers.

1482年12月23日：Maximilian and the French king Louis XI of France signed the Treaty of Arras. Maximilian promised his daughter Margaret of Austria, Duchess of Savoy and the County of Burgundy to the Dauphin Charles VIII of France. In exchange, Louis recognized Philip the Handsome's rule over the rump Burgundy, consisting mostly of the County of Flanders, and Maximilian's regency.
links: Margaret of Austria, Duchess of Savoy

items.text: 1483年6月5日：Flemish revolts against Maximilian of Austria: The cities of Flanders established a regency council for the young Philip the Handsome.
links: Flemish revolts against Maximilian of Austria

items.text: 1483年：Austrian–Hungarian War (1477–1488): The Hungarian advance into Austria forced Frederick III to flee Vienna and establish his court at Wiener Neustadt.
1484年：Battle of Leitzersdorf: A Hungarian army forced a numerically superior Austrian force from the battlefield at Leitzersdorf.
1485年1月29日：Siege of Vienna (1485): The Hungarian army laid siege to Vienna.
1485年6月1日：Siege of Vienna (1485): Vienna surrendered to the Hungarian besiegers. The Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus entered the city and established his court there.
1485年7月6日：Flemish revolts against Maximilian of Austria: The rebels released Philip the Handsome to his father Maximilian.
1486年：Siege of Wiener Neustadt: Hungarian forces laid siege to the Austrian city of Wiener Neustadt.
1486年2月16日：1486 Imperial election: Frederick III's son Maximilian was elected to succeed him as King of the Romans.
1486年：The Guldengroschen, a fine one-ounce silver coin, was first minted under Sigismund, Archduke of Austria.
1486年10月4日：Siege of Retz: The Hungarian army laid siege to the Austrian city of Retz.
1486年10月10日：Siege of Retz: The Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus entered the city.
1487年：Frederick III fled Wiener Neustadt for Graz.
1487年：The Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus took the title duke of Austria at a diet of the Lower Austrian estates in Ebenfurth.

1487年7月2日：Siege of Wiener Neustadt: The Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus and the defenders of Wiener Neustadt agreed that if imperial reinforcements arrived by August 16, the besiegers would withdraw; otherwise, the city would surrender.
1487年8月17日：Siege of Wiener Neustadt: Wiener Neustadt surrendered to its Hungarian besiegers.
1487年11月：Flemish revolts against Maximilian of Austria: A second revolt against Maximilian's rule over Burgundy began, in Ghent.
1488年1月8日：Maximilian issued a decree establishing the Royal Netherlands Navy.
1488年2月14日：At the urging of Frederick III, the Swabian League, a mutual defense association of imperial estates, was established at Esslingen am Neckar.
1488年12月16日：Austrian–Hungarian War (1477–1488): Representatives of Hungary and the Holy Roman Empire signed an armistice at Sankt Pölten, ending the war.

1489年9月11日：The pope Pope Innocent VIII excommunicated and deposed Ferdinand I of Naples, the king of Naples, following his refusal to pay feudal dues and offered the kingdom to Charles VIII of France, the king of France, who had a claim through descent from his grandfather.
1490年：The Tyrolean nobility forced Sigismund, Archduke of Austria to abdicate in favor of Maximilian.
1490年4月6日：The Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus died, probably from a stroke. He was survived by one child, his illegitimate son John Corvinus.
1490年7月15日：Vladislaus II of Hungary, king of Bohemia, was elected king of Hungary by the Hungarian diet.

1491年11月7日：Maximilian and Vladislaus II of Hungary, the king of Hungary, signed the Peace of Pressburg in what is now Bratislava. Vladislaus renounced Hungary's conquests in Austria and promised the throne to Maximilian in the event of his death without heirs. In return, Maximilian recognized Vladislaus's rule in Hungary.
1491年12月6日：Charles VIII of France, the king of France, married Anne of Brittany, duchess of Brittany.
1492年：Flemish revolts against Maximilian of Austria: The second revolt was suppressed.

1493年5月：Maximilian and Charles VIII of France, the king of France, signed the Treaty of Senlis at Senlis, under whose terms the French king returned the Burgundian territories he had won by the Treaty of Arras. Philip the Handsome was granted his majority and became ruler of the disputed territories.
1493年8月19日：Frederick III bled to death following the amputation of his infected left leg.
1494年1月25日：Ferdinand I of Naples died of colorectal cancer. He was succeeded as king of Naples by his son Alfonso II of Naples.
1494年3月16日：Maximilian married Bianca Maria Sforza, the niece of Ludovico Sforza, the regent of Milan, receiving a dowry of four hundred thousand ducats.
1494年10月21日：Gian Galeazzo Sforza, the duke of Milan, died, probably poisoned on the orders of his uncle and regent Ludovico Sforza.

1494年10月22日：Ludovico Sforza was crowned duke of Milan over the objection of Alfonso II of Naples, the king of Naples, who claimed the duchy by his daughter's marriage to the previous duke Gian Galeazzo Sforza. Ludovico Sforza invited Charles VIII of France, the king of France, to pass through Milanese territory on the way to a planned invasion of Naples.
1495年2月2日：Diet of Worms (1495): A session of the Imperial Diet opened at Worms, Germany.
1495年2月：Italian War of 1494–1498: French forces conquered the Neapolitan capital Naples.
1495年3月31日：Italian War of 1494–1498: The Papal States, Venice, Aragon and Sicily and the Holy Roman Empire established the League of Venice, an anti-French military alliance.

1495年8月7日：Diet of Worms (1495): The Diet concluded with the publication of three major reforms to the constitution of the Holy Roman Empire. The Ewiger Landfriede banned the use of violence to resolve disputes between the lesser nobility. The Reichskammergericht, a permanent high court which heard civil cases, was established. The Common Penny, a tax reform, was passed, which established a poll tax, income tax and property tax on all residents of the Empire.
1496年：The Jews were expelled from Styria and Wiener Neustadt.
1496年10月20日：Philip the Handsome married Joanna of Castile, the third child of Isabella I of Castile, the queen regnant of Castile, and Ferdinand II of Aragon, the king of Aragon.
1497年10月4日：John, Prince of Asturias, the heir apparent to the thrones of Castile and Aragon, died without issue. His older sister Isabella of Aragon, Queen of Portugal succeeded as heir apparent.
links: Isabella of Aragon, Queen of Portugal

items.text: 1498年4月7日：Italian War of 1494–1498: Charles VIII of France, the king of France, died, probably from an epidural hematoma after bumping his head on a doorframe, effectively ending the war.

1498年8月23日：Isabella of Aragon, Queen of Portugal, the heir apparent to the thrones of Castile and Aragon, died giving birth to a son, Miguel da Paz, Prince of Portugal, who became the new heir to the two thrones.
links: Isabella of Aragon, Queen of Portugal
Miguel da Paz, Prince of Portugal

items.text: 1499年1月20日：Swabian War: Imperial and Swabian League forces occupied the Val Müstair, a strategically important pass in the Three Leagues.
1499年2月20日：Battle of Hard: A Swiss force routed a Holy Roman Empire army at Hard, Austria.
1499年3月22日：Battle of Bruderholz: A Swabian League raiding party was surprised and defeated by a numerically inferior Swiss force near Basel.
1499年4月11日：Battle of Schwaderloh: The Swiss surprised and defeated a significantly larger Swabian League force as they burned and looted the area around Triboltingen.
1499年4月20日：Battle of Frastanz: Swiss troops flanked a Swabian Letzi in the Montafon and drove out their forces.
1499年5月22日：Battle of Calven: An Austrian force in the Val Müstair was attacked simultaneously in the front and rear by Three Leagues forces. Nearly half were killed, and the rest fled.
1499年7月22日：Battle of Dornach: A Swiss force dispersed a division of the Holy Roman Empire near Dornach, with heavy losses on both sides. The Imperial commander was killed.

1499年9月22日：Swabian War: The Swabian League and the Old Swiss Confederacy signed the Treaty of Basel, ending the war. An imperial ban placed on the Swiss cantons following their refusal to pay the Common Penny was revoked.

1500年：An Imperial Diet at Augsburg established six imperial circles, administrative divisions over many of the states of the Holy Roman Empire, in order to better organize military forces and tax collection in the Empire. It also established an Imperial Government, a permanent government seated at Nuremberg composed of representatives of twenty princes of the Empire.
links: Princes of the Holy Roman Empire

items.text: 1500年7月19日：Miguel da Paz, Prince of Portugal, the infant heir to the thrones of Castile and Aragon, died. His aunt Joanna of Castile became the new heir apparent.
links: Miguel da Paz, Prince of Portugal

items.text: 1502年：Maximilian dissolved the Imperial Government of the Holy Roman Empire.

1504年11月26日：Isabella I of Castile, the queen of Castile, died. She was succeeded by her daughter, Philip the Handsome's wife, Joanna of Castile. The Castilian nobility refused the regency of Ferdinand II of Aragon, king of Aragon, Isabella's widower and father to the purportedly mentally ill Joanna, and summoned Philip to take the throne.
1506年1月：Philip the Handsome was shipwrecked off the coast of Dorset on his way to claim the throne of Castile and taken into the custody of Henry VII of England, the king of England.

1506年4月30日：Philip the Handsome and Henry VII of England, the king of England, signed the Malus Intercursus, under which the former agreed to return to the latter all Yorkist fugitives in Burgundy and to open Burgundy completely to English trade in textiles.

1506年6月28日：Philip the Handsome signed the Treaty of Villafáfila, under which he recognized the incapacity of his wife Joanna of Castile, and was recognized in turn by his father-in-law Ferdinand II of Aragon, king of Aragon, as jure uxoris king of Castile and lord of the Spanish West Indies.
1506年9月25日：Philip the Handsome died of typhoid at Burgos. He was succeeded as duke of Burgundy by his young son Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor.
1506年：Ferdinand II of Aragon, king of Aragon, with the support of Francisco Jiménez de Cisneros, the archbishop of Toledo, became regent of Castile for his daughter Joanna of Castile.
1507年：Maximilian appointed his daughter Margaret of Austria, Duchess of Savoy regent of the Netherlands for the young Charles.
links: Margaret of Austria, Duchess of Savoy

items.text: 1508年2月：War of the League of Cambrai: Maximilian invaded Venice with the aim of reconquering the Romagna for the Papal States.
links: War of the League of Cambrai

items.text: 1508年2月4日：Unable to reach Rome, and with the consent of the pope Pope Julius II, Maximilian took the title elected Holy Roman Emperor at Trento.

1508年12月10日：War of the League of Cambrai: The Papal States, the Holy Roman Empire, France and Aragon concluded a military alliance for the destruction and partition of Venice. The House of Habsburg would receive Istria, Verona, Vicenza, Padua and Friuli.
1509年2月：Joanna of Castile, the queen of Castile, was sequestered in the Royal Convent of Santa Clara in Tordesillas.

1509年5月：War of the League of Cambrai: Following the collapse of the Venetian army at the hands of the French, forces of the Holy Roman Empire entered the territory granted to them under the partition.
1509年7月17日：War of the League of Cambrai: A revolt in Padua expelled the garrison of the Holy Roman Empire and returned the city to Venetian control.
1509年9月15日：Siege of Padua: French and Holy Roman Empire forces laid siege to Padua.
1509年9月30日：Siege of Padua: Unable to pay his mercenaries, Maximilian lifted the siege.
1511年10月：Maximilian joined Venice and the Papal States in a military alliance against the French.

1513年8月16日：Battle of the Spurs: French forces attempting to break an English and Holy Roman Empire siege of Thérouanne were met by the besiegers at modern Enguinegatte and routed with heavy casualties.
1513年10月7日：Battle of La Motta (1513): An Aragonese and Holy Roman Empire force decisively defeated a Venetian attack at Schio.

1515年7月22日：First Congress of Vienna: Philip the Handsome's younger son Ferdinand I, Holy Roman Emperor married Anne of Bohemia and Hungary, the eldest child of Vladislaus II of Hungary, king of Hungary as well as king of Bohemia and Croatia. Philip's daughter Mary of Hungary married Vladislaus's other child, his son Louis II of Hungary.
links: Mary of Hungary (governor of the Netherlands)

items.text: 1516年1月23日：Ferdinand II of Aragon, the king of Aragon, died. He was succeeded in Aragon, Catalonia, Valencia, Naples, Sicily and Sardinia by his daughter Joanna of Castile and as regent of Castile by Francisco Jiménez de Cisneros, the archbishop of Toledo.

1516年3月：Charles was proclaimed king of Castile and Aragon and the Aragonese kingdoms Valencia, Naples, Sicily and Sardinia and prince of Catalonia ruling jointly with his mother Joanna of Castile, who remained imprisoned.
1516年3月12日：A rebellion by John III of Navarre, the deposed jure uxoris king of Navarre, against the rule of Charles was defeated.
1516年3月13日：Vladislaus II of Hungary died. He was succeeded as king of Hungary and king of Bohemia and Croatia by his son Louis II of Hungary.

1516年8月13日：War of the League of Cambrai: Charles and Francis I of France, the king of France, signed the Treaty of Noyon, under which the former accepted France's conquests in Northern Italy and the latter recognized Spain's possessions in Southern Italy. Charles further agreed to an audience with Catherine of Navarre, the deposed queen of Navarre, regarding the restoration of her territories.

1517年10月31日：Martin Luther, a professor of moral theology at the University of Wittenberg, now part of the Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg, published the Ninety-five Theses, which criticized the Church practice of selling indulgences.
1518年2月：The Castilian Cortes accepted Charles in exchange for his promise to learn Spanish and to refrain from taking precious metals out of Castile or appointing foreign officers.
1519年1月12日：Maximilian died. He was succeeded as archduke of Austria by Charles.
1519年：Revolt of the Brotherhoods: A council consisting of one representative from each of the thirteen Germanies of Valencia expelled the municipal government of Valencia, Spain.
1519年6月28日：1519 Imperial election: Charles was elected King of the Romans.

1520年4月16日：Revolt of the Comuneros: Rioters in Toledo, Spain, opposed to Charles' election as King of the Romans and his burdensome tax policy, expelled his appointed city councilors and elected a citizens' committee.
1520年5月20日：Charles left Castile for Germany to accept his election as King of the Romans, leaving Pope Adrian VI, then Grand Inquisitor of Castile and Aragon, in charge in Spain.
1520年6月15日：The pope Pope Leo X issued the papal bull Exsurge Domine, calling on Martin Luther to recant the Ninety-five Theses or face excommunication.
1521年1月28日：Diet of Worms: An Imperial Diet of the Holy Roman Empire convened at Worms, Germany to address the writings of Martin Luther.
1521年：Diet of Worms: Charles abdicated as archduke of Austria in favor of his younger brother Ferdinand I, Holy Roman Emperor.
1521年4月23日：Battle of Villalar: Forces loyal to Charles, in command of superior cavalry and firepower, dispersed a force of rebel comuneros at Villalar de los Comuneros and captured their leaders.
1521年5月：A force of Navarrese and Gascon exiles led by Henry II of Navarre, son of the deposed queen Catherine of Navarre, invaded Navarre from France.
1521年5月25日：Diet of Worms: Charles issued the Edict of Worms, making outlaws of Martin Luther and anyone who would harbor him or defend his writings.
1521年6月：Italian War of 1521–1526: The Imperial Army of the Holy Roman Empire invaded northern France.
1521年6月30日：Battle of Noáin: The bulk of the army dedicated to Navarrese independence under Henry II of Navarre was defeated by a vastly superior Castilian-Aragonese force.
1521年7月18日：Battle of Almenara (1521): Forces of the rebel Germanies of Valencia were defeated by a royal army at Almenara, Castellón.
1521年8月30日：Battle of Oriola (1521): The Germanies, now riven by internal dissent, were decisively defeated by a royal army at Orihuela, suffering two thousand dead.
1521年10月25日：Revolt of the Comuneros: Charles agreed to respect the lives and property of the remaining comuneros in Toledo, Spain in exchange for their surrender.
1521年11月1日：Revolt of the Brotherhoods: Valencia, Spain was reconquered by Valencian royal forces.
1521年11月28日：Italian War of 1521–1526: Henry VIII of England, the king of England, and Pope Leo X, the pope, joined a treaty of alliance with the Holy Roman Empire against France.
1522年4月27日：Battle of Bicocca: A French force of Swiss mercenaries advancing under heavy artillery fire failed to dislodge Holy Roman Empire forces from Bicocca in Milan.
1523年：Siege of Fuenterrabía (1523–1524): Castilian and Aragonese forces laid siege to Hondarribia, where remained forces loyal to Henry II of Navarre and to the independence of Navarre.
1523年10月：Italian campaign of 1524–25: The French king Francis I of France crossed the Alps into Northern Italy at the head of army forty thousand strong.
1524年：Siege of Fuenterrabía (1523–1524): The occupants of the castle at Hondarribia surrendered to the besiegers.
1524年4月30日：Battle of the Sesia (1524): Holy Roman Empire forces intercepted and decisively defeated a French force withdrawing from Lombardy.
1525年2月24日：Battle of Pavia: After a precipitate attack, a French force was surrounded and destroyed by Holy Roman Empire artillery at Visconti Park. The French king Francis I of France was captured.

1526年1月14日：Italian War of 1521–1526: The French king Francis I of France, in captivity in Madrid, and Charles, the Holy Roman Emperor, signed a treaty under which Francis renounced all his claims in Italy, Flanders and Artois, surrendered Burgundy to Charles, and agreed to withdraw his support from Henry II of Navarre, claimant to the throne of Navarre.
1526年2月27日：A group of Lutheran princes of the Holy Roman Empire concluded the League of Torgau, a mutual agreement not to abide by the Edict of Worms, at Torgau.
links: Princes of the Holy Roman Empire

items.text: 1526年5月22日：The pope Pope Clement VII released Francis I of France, the king of France, from his obligations under the Treaty of Madrid, which he had signed under duress, and concluded an anti-Habsburg alliance which also included Venice, Florence and Milan.
1526年6月25日：Diet of Speyer (1526): An Imperial Diet of the Holy Roman Empire convened at Speyer to address the rise of Lutheranism.

1526年8月27日：Diet of Speyer (1526): The Imperial Diet unanimously suspended the Edict of Worms, which had placed a death sentence on Martin Luther and his followers, until a council could be convened to resolve the dispute between Luther and the Catholic Church.

1526年8月29日：Battle of Mohács: A Hungarian army met an Ottoman invasion at Mohács. After breaking the Hungarian left flank, the Ottoman army surrounded and destroyed the Hungarian and killed Louis II of Hungary, the king of Hungary and king of Bohemia.
1526年10月24日：The Bohemian diet elected Ferdinand king.
1526年11月10日：John Zápolya, the voivode of Transylvania, was elected king of Hungary by the Diet at Székesfehérvár.
1526年12月17日：A rump Diet elected Ferdinand king of Hungary at Bratislava.
1527年1月1日：Election in Cetin: The Croatian nobility unanimously elected Ferdinand king at Cetin Castle.
1527年：Hungarian campaign of 1527–1528: Ferdinand invaded Hungary to press his claim to the throne against John Zápolya, then tied up suppressing a rebellion in the country's south.
1527年4月30日：War of the League of Cognac: England joined the anti-House of Habsburg League of Cognac.
links: War of the League of Cognac

items.text: 1527年5月1日：Battle of Szőlős: The Serb commander Jovan Nenad defeated an army loyal to John Zápolya, the claimant against Ferdinand to the throne of Hungary, near Seleuș.

1527年5月6日：Sack of Rome (1527): After the failure of the Holy Roman Empire to pay them, the Landsknechte mutinied, sacked Rome and forced the pope Pope Clement VII to fortify himself inside the Castel Sant'Angelo.

1527年6月6日：Sack of Rome (1527): The pope Pope Clement VII surrendered to his besiegers, promising four hundred thousand ducati to the Landsknechte and the cities of Parma, Piacenza, Civitavecchia and Modena to the Holy Roman Empire in exchange for his life.
1527年7月25日：Battle of Sződfalva: The Serb commander Jovan Nenad was defeated and killed by a Hungarian army of John Zápolya.
1527年9月27日：Battle of Tarcal: Ferdinand's partisans routed an army led by John Zápolya, his rival claimant to the Hungarian throne.
1528年3月20日：Battle of Szina: Ferdinand's forces decisively defeated the army of John Zápolya, his rival in the struggle for the Hungarian succession. Zápolya was forced to flee into Poland.
1528年4月：Siege of Naples (1528): French and allied forces laid siege by land and sea to Naples, capital of the Aragonese kingdom of Naples.
1528年4月28日：Battle of Capo d'Orso: In a four-hour battle, a Spanish fleet attempting to break the French blockade of Naples was decisively defeated, losing nine ships and over a thousand men.
1528年8月：Siege of Naples (1528): The League of Cognac abandoned the siege due to an outbreak of disease and were intercepted by Holy Roman Empire forces during their retreat

1529年3月15日：Diet of Speyer (1529): An Imperial Diet of the Holy Roman Empire was convened at Speyer to address Ottoman gains in Europe and the rise of Lutheranism. Ferdinand, on behalf of his brother Charles, the Holy Roman Emperor, called for the reinstatement of the ban on Martin Luther and his followers and condemned the religious innovations that had taken place in the Imperial Estates.

1529年4月19日：Protestation at Speyer: Six princes of the Holy Roman Empire and the representatives of fourteen free imperial cities issued a letter to the Imperial Diet declaring their refusal to accept its authority in spiritual matters.
links: Princes of the Holy Roman Empire

items.text: 1529年5月10日：Suleiman I's campaign of 1529: The Ottoman Empire invaded Hungary in support of John Zápolya's claim to the throne against Ferdinand.
1529年6月21日：Battle of Landriano: A Spanish force destroyed the French army in Italy at Landriano.

1529年8月5日：War of the League of Cognac: France and the Holy Roman Empire signed a treaty at Cambrai ending the former's participation in the war and affirming its 1526 cession of Artois, Flanders and Tournai.

1529年8月：War of the League of Cognac: The pope Pope Clement VII signed a treaty at Bologna with Charles, ending their conflict. Clement received the cities of Ravenna and Cervia and in exchange agreed to crown Charles Holy Roman Emperor and to join him in the overthrow of the republican government in Florence.
1529年9月8日：Suleiman I's campaign of 1529: Ottoman forces captured Buda. John Zápolya was again crowned king of Hungary.
1529年9月27日：Siege of Vienna: Some hundred thousand Ottoman soldiers led by the sultan Suleiman the Magnificent laid siege to the Austrian capital Vienna.
1529年10月15日：Siege of Vienna: Following the failure of a massive assault on the city and several weeks of bad weather, Ottoman forces withdrew from Vienna.
1529年10月24日：Siege of Florence (1529–30): Spanish, Holy Roman Empire and papal forces made camp outside of Florence.
1530年：Siege of Florence (1529–30): The Holy Roman Empire took the city of Volterra, cutting off Florence's primary supply line.
1530年8月3日：Battle of Gavinana: After some early successes against forces of the Holy Roman Empire, the Florentine army was beaten and destroyed by their reinforcements.
1531年1月5日：1531 Imperial election: Ferdinand was elected King of the Romans. The prince-electors agreed to elect Charles's preferred candidate, his young son Philip II of Spain, to succeed Ferdinand.

1531年2月27日：Philip I, Landgrave of Hesse, the landgrave of Hesse, and John Frederick I, Elector of Saxony, the elector of Saxony, established the Schmalkaldic League, a mutual defense treaty of Lutheran princes against the Holy Roman Empire.
links: John Frederick I, Elector of Saxony

items.text: 1532年8月5日：Siege of Güns: Ottoman forces laid siege to Kőszeg, a Hungarian town loyal to Ferdinand, on the border of Austria.
1532年8月23日：Siege of Güns: The Ottoman army withdrew into eastern Hungary following the failure of the siege and the mustering of a formidable Holy Roman Empire army in Vienna.

1532年9月19日：Battle of Leobersdorf: An Ottoman cavalry brigade attempting to join the advance of the main army into eastern Hungary was intercepted and wiped out by Austrian forces in a mountain pass near Leobersdorf.

1533年7月22日：Austria and the Ottoman Empire signed the Treaty of Constantinople, ending their conflict. Ferdinand recognized John Zápolya as king of Hungary in exchange for Ottoman recognition of his conquests in the west of the kingdom, signaling its de facto division into the Eastern Hungarian Kingdom, a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire, and Royal Hungary.
links: Vassal and tributary states of the Ottoman Empire

items.text: 1601年8月3日：Battle of Guruslău: A force of Hungarians, Wallachians and Cossacks defeated the rebel Transylvanian prince Sigismund Báthory on the plain of the Guruslău River.
1604年9月28日：Bocskai uprising: The Hungarian nobleman Stephen Bocskai launched a revolt against Habsburg dominion over Hungary.

1606年6月23日：Bocskai uprising: The Hungarian nobleman Stephen Bocskai and Rudolf II, Holy Roman Emperor, the Holy Roman Emperor, king of Bohemia, Hungary and Croatia and archduke of Austria, signed the Treaty of Vienna, naming the former prince of Transylvania and granting some additional rights to religious minorities in Hungary.

1606年11月11日：Long Turkish War: The Peace of Zsitvatorok was signed in what is now Radvaň nad Dunajom, ending a long conflict between the Ottoman Empire and the Holy Roman Empire. The obligations of the Hungarian nobility to their Ottoman suzerains were reduced.

1608年6月25日：Rudolf's younger brother Matthias, Holy Roman Emperor, the governor of Austria, with the support of the nobility in Austria, Hungary and Moravia, forced him to cede the rule of those lands.
1701年7月9日：Battle of Carpi: An Austrian army dispatched a small French force at Carpi, near Legnago, during its crossing into Italy.
1701年9月1日：Battle of Chiari: An Austrian force dealt severe and disproportionate casualties to a French army attempting to dislodge it at Chiari, Lombardy.

1701年9月7日：England, the Holy Roman Empire and the Dutch Republic signed the Treaty of The Hague, reestablishing the Grand Alliance and setting out their primary goals: the establishment of Austrian control over Spanish territories in Italy and the Spanish Netherlands and Dutch and English access to markets in the Spanish Empire.
1702年2月1日：Battle of Cremona: Austrian forces entered the French-held city of Cremona but, failing to take the citadel of the city and facing the arrival of French reinforcements, withdrew.

1702年8月15日：Battle of Luzzara: An Austrian force under the general Prince Eugene of Savoy crossed the Po at Luzzara but failed to dislodge the French from their position despite heavy casualties on both sides.

1801年2月9日：War of the Second Coalition: France and Francis II, Holy Roman Emperor, the latter acting as emperor of the Holy Roman Empire and as king of Hungary, Bohemia and Croatia and archduke of Austria, signed the Treaty of Lunéville, ending their conflict. France made territorial gains, including the extension of its border with the Holy Roman Empire east to the Rhine.
1804年8月11日：Francis took the title Emperor of Austria.
1805年9月25日：Ulm Campaign: A French-Bavarian force crossed the Rhine into Germany.
1805年10月8日：Battle of Wertingen: A French army surprised and defeated a much smaller Austrian force at Wertingen.

1947年1月19日：Legislative election rigged, 100,000 ORMO men deployed to intimidate voters
1947年2月19日：Adoption of Small Constitution of 1947
1947年4月28日：Operation Vistula begins
1947年11月24日：Auschwitz trial begins in Kraków
1948年2月25日：The General Youth Organization "Service to Poland" was established.
1948年3月10日：During the joint meeting of the Central Committee of the PPR and the Central Electoral Commission of the PPS, the formal decision was made to unite the parties.
1948年4月25日：The Higher Marxist School was established at the Central Committee of the PZPR.
1949年1月1日：State Agricultural Farms were established (since 1976 operating under the name of State Agricultural Enterprises).
1949年：The 2nd Trade Union Congress took place

1949年：The Congress of the Unity of the People's Movement took place, which resulted in the merger of PSL and SL into the United People's Party. The chairman of the Supreme Council was Józef Niećko, and the chairman of the Supreme Executive Committee was Władysław Kowalski.
1950年1月23日：Communists establish administration over the church charity organization "Caritas"
1950年7月21日：The law on the 6-year plan for economic development and building the foundations of socialism for the years 1950-1955 was passed
1950年3月10日：A Special Bureau was established within the MPB, entrusted with the task of combating provocations in the workers' movement.

1950年3月20日：A new administrative organization was established. Thus, the provincial offices, county offices, and the positions of governors, starosts, and city presidents were liquidated and were replaced with voivodeship, powiat and city National Councils. The act transformed them into local state administration bodies, which was another stage in the centralization of power.
1950年4月19日：The Office for Religious Affairs was established, and soon its local agencies were established at the provincial, city and district national councils.

1950年6月28日：A new administrative division of the country was formed, and the number of voivodeships increased to seventeen. This division into voivodeships remained until the administrative reform carried out in 1975
1950年7月6日：Treaty of Zgorzelec signed in the border with East Germany
1950年10月14日：The verdict in the trial of the 4th Main Board of WiN has been announced: Leader Łukasz Cieplinski and his six associates were sentenced to death, three people to long-term imprisonment
1950年10月16日：The Institute for Training of Scientific Cadres at the Central Committee of the PZPR began its operations.
1951年2月15日：The Treaty on the Exchange of Territories was signed in Moscow between the Polish and Soviet governments
1951年7月31日：Trial of the Generals who served in the anti-Nazi resistance during World War II
1951年8月2日：Władysław Gomułka is arrested
1951年9月9日：Stefan Matryka, the narrator of the propaganda radio program Fala-49, was shot dead
1951年11月6日：In Żerań, in the northern part of Warsaw's Praga district, the Fabryka Samochodów Osobowych, which had been under construction since 1949, was launched
1952年4月16日：August Emil Fieldorf is sentenced to death
1952年7月22日：Adoption of Constitution of the People's Republic of Poland by the Legislative Sejm
links: Constitution of the People's Republic of Poland

items.text: 1952年8月30日：The All-Polish Committee National Front was established under the chairmanship of Boleslaw Bierut.
1952年10月26日：First Legislative election by the one-party rule
1953年2月9日：The Council of State issued a decree on the appointment of church clergy, in which the communists gave themselves the right to directly interfere in the personnel policy of the Church
1953年3月14日：Michał Rola-Żymierski is arrested in a political struggle

1953年6月3日：One of the changes in the management of the Soviet sphere of influence was the decision - formally taken by the Commission for National Defense of the Polish People's Republic - to send some of the Red Army generals who had been recommended to the Polish People's Army in previous years to the USSR.

1953年12月5日：A clear signal of the "thaw" was the recall of Dymitr Woźnienski and Antoni Skulbaszewski from the Polish People's Republic to the USSR. Both were sentenced to 10 years in prison in the USSR for violating the rule of law.
1953年12月17日：Józef Światło, deputy director of Department X of the MBP, fled to West Berlin. The fugitive surrendered to American intelligence
1954年：During the Second Congress of the Polish United Workers' Party, where Nikita Khrushchev was a special guest, a decision was made to imitate the changes introduced in the USSR.

1954年3月18日：The State Council implemented the decisions of the 2nd Congress of the Polish United Workers' Party, dismissing Bolesław Bierut from the position of Prime Minister and entrusting this position to Józef Cyrankiewicz. At the same time, Władysław Dworakowski ceased to be Deputy Prime Minister, and Hilary Minc was dismissed from the position of Chairman of the State Economic Planning Commission to be replaced by Eugeniusz Szyr.
links: State Council of the Polish People's Republic

items.text: 1954年8月3日：The operation codenamed X-2 began, the aim of which was to displace about 1,400 nuns from Lower and Upper Silesia. They were moved to 8 labour camps located in convent buildings in the Krakow and Poznan regions.

1954年9月25日：An administrative reform was carried out, in which the four-level structure was replaced by a three-level division. The changes consisted of the liquidation of communes, while the administrative boundaries of the gromadas were simultaneously extended.

1954年：A secret meeting of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Polish United Workers' Party was held. Cliques began to emerge within the Polish United Workers' Party leadership, representing different possibilities of getting out of the political and economic crisis that was plaguing the Polish People's Republic.
1954年12月7日：The MBP was dissolved, and in its place the Committee for Public Security and the Ministry of Internal Affairs were established.
1955年4月30日：The broadcast of TVP's regular programme has begun.
1955年5月14日：Signing of the Warsaw Pact

1956年2月19日：The first public criticism of Stalin's actions in the Polish People's Republic. "Trybuna Ludu" published a statement signed by the central committees of the Polish United Workers' Party, the Communist Party of Poland.
1956年3月12日：Death of Bolesław Bierut
1956年3月20日：The 6th Plenum of the Central Committee of the Polish United Workers' Party was held, during which the memory of Bierut was honored
1956年6月28日：Poznań 1956 protests
1956年10月21日：Polish October, return of Władysław Gomułka
1957年1月20日：Legislative election
1957年：The tram drivers in Łódź went on strike. It was one of 11 strikes in Łódź and one of many taking place in the country at that time.
1959年10月18日：Price increase of average 25% for meat, animal fats and meat products was introduced

1959年10月28日：Jerzy Morawski, a member of the reformist Puławians group in the Polish United Workers' Party, resigned from his membership in the Political Bureau and the Secretariat of the Central Committee.
1959年：The congress of delegates of the Polish Writers' Union was in session. Jarosław Iwaszkiewicz was elected the new president
1960年5月30日：Stormy protests took place in Zielona Góra in response to the authorities' attempt to close down the Catholic House inhabited by priests.
1961年4月16日：Legislative election

1964年：The 4th Congress of the Polish United Workers' Party took place, which strengthened the so-called small stabilization. Gomułka outlined economic plans for the coming years, assuming a 50% increase in industrial production. In the five-year period of 1966-1970, 1.5 million new jobs were to be created, and the national income was to increase by 30%. Gomułka, who was formally re-elected to the position of the First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Polish United Workers' Party, sharply criticized the leaders of the Chinese communists for the split.
1964年8月13日：Edward Ochoba was appointed Chairman of the State Council after Aleksander Zawadzki's death on August 7.
links: State Council of the Polish People's Republic

items.text: 1964年11月9日：The Provincial Court for the Capital City of Warsaw sentenced the famous writer Melchior Wankowicz to three years in prison, which was changed to one and a half years under an amnesty.

1965年2月2日：The court sentenced to death Stanisław Wawrzecki, director of the Municipal Meat Trading Company - the main defendant in the so-called meat affair. The sentence was carried out on April 9, it was the only one carried out after 1956 in the Polish People's Republic for a crime of an economic nature.
1965年5月30日：Legislative election
1965年7月20日：Gen. Tadeusz Pietrzak became the new commander-in-chief of the Citizens' Militia.
1965年11月18日：Letter of Reconciliation of the Polish Bishops to the German Bishops
links: Letter of Reconciliation of the Polish Bishops to the German Bishops

items.text: 1965年12月3日：In Zabrze, during the Miner's Day celebrations, Gomułka summed up the second five-year plan (1961-1965)
1968年3月：Political crisis
1968年8月20日：End of Prague Spring with the invasion of Czechoslovakia
1970年12月7日：Signing of Treaty of Warsaw; Warschauer Kniefall
1970年12月14日：1970 protests begin
1974年2月4日：The 1st National Conference of the PZPR
1978年10月16日：Election of Pope John Paul II
1980年：Gdańsk Agreement
1980年3月14日：LOT Polish Airlines Flight 007
1980年8月17日：21 demands of MKS
1981年5月28日：Death of Primate Poland Stefan Wyszyński
1981年12月13日：Martial law begins
1983年：Solidarity leader Lech Wałęsa receives the Nobel Peace Prize.
1983年7月22日：Martial law ends
1984年：Father Jerzy Popiełuszko murdered by Polish secret police.
1989年4月4日：Signing of the Round Table Agreement
1989年4月7日：April Novelization
1989年6月4日：Parliamentary election
1989年7月19日：Lech Wałęsa becomes President
1989年8月24日：Tadeusz Mazowiecki becomes first non-communist prime minister in the Eastern Bloc
1989年：Prison riots
31年12月：The People's Republic of Poland becomes the Republic of Poland
1990年5月27日：Local elections
1990年11月14日：Signing of German–Polish Border Treaty
1990年11月25日：Presidential election
1990年12月22日：Lech Wałęsa becomes President
1991年6月27日：Mława riot after Romani youth kills pedestrian in a hit-and-run
1991年7月1日：Dissolution of Warsaw Pact
1991年10月27日：Parliamentary election
1992年10月17日：Adoption of Small Constitution
1992年12月21日：Signing of Central European Free Trade Agreement
1993年9月14日：Lufthansa Flight 2904
1993年9月19日：Parliamentary election
1994年5月2日：Poland bus disaster of 1994 killed 32 people.
1994年6月19日：Local elections
1995年11月：Presidential election
1995年12月23日：Aleksander Kwaśniewski becomes President
1997年4月2日：Adoption of Constitution
1997年9月21日：Parliamentary election
1998年10月11日：Local elections
1999年1月1日：16 new voivodeships created in Polish local government reforms
1999年3月12日：Poland joins NATO
2000年10月8日：Presidential election
2001年9月23日：Parliamentary election
2002年：Census
2002年10月27日：Local elections
2003年4月16日：Signing of the Treaty of Accession
2003年6月：European Union membership referendum
2004年5月1日：Poland joins in the European Union
2004年6月13日：European Parliament election
2005年4月2日：Death of Pope John Paul II
2005年9月25日：Parliamentary election
2005年10月：Presidential election
2005年12月23日：Lech Kaczyński becomes President
2006年1月28日：Katowice Trade Hall roof collapse
2006年11月：Local elections
2007年10月21日：Parliamentary election
2010年4月10日：Polish Air Force Tu-154 crash killing Polish President Lech Kaczyński
2010年7月4日：Bronisław Komorowski elected president.
2011年8月5日：Suicide of Andrzej Lepper
2011年10月9日：Parliamentary election
2012年3月3日：A train crash near Szczekociny, Poland, kills 16 people.
2014年4月27日：Canonization of Pope John Paul II
links: Canonization of Pope John XXIII and Pope John Paul II

items.text: 2014年5月25日：Death of Wojciech Jaruzelski
2015年5月：Presidential election
2015年8月6日：Andrzej Duda becomes President
2020年10月22日：Women's strike protests. Part of the Polish constitutional crisis.
2023年10月15日：Parliamentary election
約前16000年：During the Last Glacial Maximum, Ireland is covered in ice sheets
約前12000年：A narrow channel forms between Prehistoric Ireland and southwest Scotland
約前10000年：Carbon-dating on bear bones indicate the presence of Paleolithic people in County Clare.
約前8000年：Mesolithic hunter-gatherers migrate to Ireland
約前6500年：Mesolithic hunter-gatherers occupy sites such as that at Mount Sandel in Ulster
約前4000年：Agriculture (including the keeping of livestock, and crop farming) has its beginnings in Ireland, at sites such as the Céide Fields in Connacht
約前3500年：The Neolithic peoples of the Boyne Valley built a complex of chamber tombs, standing stones and enclosures over a period of hundreds of years. (Newgrange itself is dated to 3300–2900 BC).
約前2000年：Bronze Age technologies start to arrive in Ireland, including the moulding of Ballybeg-type flat axes, and the beginnings of copper mining at Ross Island, Killarney and Mount Gabriel.
約前500年：During the Iron Age in Ireland, Celtic influence in art, language and culture begins to take hold.
約前300年：Murder of Clonycavan Man, according to radiocarbon dating
