1914年7月30日：World War I: Russia mobilized its army to defend Serbia.
1915年：Škrlec reconvened the Sabor.

1915年4月26日：World War I: The secret Treaty of London (1915) was signed, under which Russia, France and the United Kingdom recognized Italian territorial claims (including some in Croatia) in return for Italy's joining the war on the side of the Triple Entente.
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1916年11月21日：Franz Joseph I of Austria died. He was succeeded as king by his grandnephew Charles I of Austria.
1917年6月29日：Skerlecz resigned. Antun Mihalović became Ban.
1918年10月29日：The Sabor dissolved Croatia's union with Austria-Hungary and incorporated the Kingdom of Dalmatia into the new State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs.
1918年12月1日：The State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs joined with Serbia to form the new Kingdom of Yugoslavia under King Peter I of Serbia.
1919年1月20日：Mihalović left office.
1920年11月12日：Yugoslavia signed the Treaty of Rapallo (1920), acceding to Italian claims on some of its territory.

1920年11月28日：Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes Constitutional Assembly election, 1920: The Democratic Party, People's Radical Party and Communist Party were the three most successful parties by number of seats received in the Assembly.
links: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes Constitutional Assembly election, 1920

items.text: 1920年12月29日：The government issued a decree banning Communist propaganda and ordering the dissolution of all Communist organizations until approval of the Constitution.
1921年6月28日：The Vidovdan Constitution, which abolished the traditional divisions of the region in favor of thirty-three oblasts ruled by royal appointees, was approved.
1921年8月16日：Peter died. He was succeeded as king by his son Alexander I of Yugoslavia.
1923年3月18日：Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes parliamentary election, 1923: The People's Radical Party won a plurality of seats in Parliament.
links: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes parliamentary election, 1923

items.text: 1925年2月8日：Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes parliamentary election, 1925: The People's Radical Party won a plurality of seats in Parliament.
links: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes parliamentary election, 1925

items.text: 1927年9月11日：Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes parliamentary election, 1927: The People's Radical Party won a plurality of seats in Parliament.
links: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes parliamentary election, 1927

items.text: 1928年6月20日：Puniša Račić of the People's Radical Party shot five members of the Croatian Peasant Party (HSS) during a session of Parliament. Two were killed instantly, and Party leader Stjepan Radić was fatally wounded.
1928年8月8日：Radić died.
1929年1月6日：6 January Dictatorship: Alexander issued a decree dissolving Parliament and abolishing the Constitution.
1929年10月3日：Alexander replaced the thirty-three oblasts with nine banovinas.
1931年9月3日：6 January Dictatorship: Alexander issued the 1931 Yugoslav Constitution, ending the dictatorship.

1934年10月9日：Alexander was assassinated by a Bulgarian mercenary, Vlado Chernozemski, with the Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organization; Chernozemski had been contracted by the Ustaše, which was formed in 1929. Alexander was succeeded by his eleven-year-old son, Peter, with his cousin, Prince Paul, leading a regency council of three.
1935年5月5日：Yugoslavian parliamentary election, 1935: The Yugoslav National Party won a majority of seats in Parliament.
1938年12月11日：Yugoslavian parliamentary election, 1938: The Yugoslav Radical Union won a majority of seats in Parliament.
1939年8月23日：The Cvetković–Maček Agreement was approved, establishing the autonomous Banovina of Croatia with an elected Sabor and a crown-appointed Ban.
1939年8月26日：Ivan Šubašić was appointed Ban of Croatia.
1941年3月25日：World War II: Prince Paul signed the Tripartite Pact, pledging support to the Axis powers.
1941年3月27日：Yugoslav military coup of 27 March 1941: A military coup overthrew the Regency and declared Peter II to be of age.
1941年4月6日：World War II in Yugoslavia begins
1941年4月6日：Invasion of Yugoslavia: Germany opened an invasion of Yugoslavia with an air attack on Belgrade.
1941年4月10日：Independent State of Croatia declared by Ante Pavelić of the Ustaše.
1941年5月13日：Croatia signed a treaty establishing its borders with Germany.
1941年5月18日：Prince Aimone, Duke of Aosta was crowned King Tomislav II of Croatia by the Italian King Victor Emmanuel III of Italy.
1941年5月19日：Croatia ceded land, including most of Dalmatia, to Italy by signing the treaty of Rapallo.
1941年6月7日：Croatia's borders with Serbia were established.
1941年6月22日：Operation Barbarossa: Germany launched an invasion of the Soviet Union.
1941年7月4日：A call by the Communist Party of Yugoslavia to resist the Ustaše government marked the birth of the Yugoslav Partisans.
1941年8月：Glina massacre: The Ustaše killed several hundred Serb civilians in a church in Glina.
1941年10月27日：Croatia's borders with Montenegro were established.
1942年10月5日：Operation Alfa: Italian and Chetnik forces attacked the Partisan-held town of Prozor.
1942年10月10日：Operation Alfa: The battle ended in a Partisan defeat.
1942年11月26日：The Anti-Fascist Council of the People's Liberation of Yugoslavia (AVNOJ) was established as the political organization of the Yugoslav Partisans.
1943年5月15日：Battle of the Sutjeska: Axis troops surrounded the main Partisan force on the east bank of the Sutjeska river in Bosnia.
1943年6月14日：The National Anti-Fascist Council of the People's Liberation of Croatia (ZAVNOH), composed of Croatian members of the AVNOJ, held its first session and declared Vladimir Nazor President.
1943年6月16日：Battle of the Sutjeska: The Partisans escaped across the Sutjeska.
1943年7月25日：Italian King Victor Emmanuel III of Italy dismissed his Prime Minister Benito Mussolini.
1943年7月31日：Tomislav abdicated on the orders of the Italian King Victor Emmanuel III of Italy.
1943年9月8日：World War II: An armistice between Italy and Allied armed forces was published, voiding Croatia's territorial concessions of 1941 and the Treaty of Rapallo (1920).
links: Armistice between Italy and Allied armed forces

items.text: 1943年11月15日：Operation Delphin: Croatian forces undertook a campaign to capture several islands in the Adriatic Sea off the cost of central Dalmatia.

1943年11月21日：The second session of the AVNOJ established the National Committee for the Liberation of Yugoslavia, the government-in-waiting of a federal, democratic Yugoslavia under Prime Minister Josip Broz Tito.
links: National Committee for the Liberation of Yugoslavia

items.text: 1943年12月1日：Operation Delphin: The operation concluded successfully.
1944年5月9日：The Federal State of Croatia was established at the third session of the ZAVNOH.
1944年5月13日：The Department for the Protection of the People (OZNA) was established under Aleksandar Ranković.
links: Department for the Protection of the People

items.text: 1944年5月25日：Raid on Drvar: German paratroopers attacked Partisan headquarters near Drvar. Tito escaped.
1944年6月16日：Tito and Šubašić signed the Treaty of Vis, which provided for a coalition of royalists and Communists in the government of the future Yugoslavia.
1945年3月30日：Battle on Lijevče field: Croatian and Chetnik forces met at Lijevče.
1945年4月8日：Battle on Lijevče field: The Chetniks surrendered.
1945年5月6日：Pavelić fled the country.
1945年5月8日：World War II in Yugoslavia formally ends with the German Instrument of Surrender, but fighting continues.
1945年5月14日：Battle of Poljana: Retreating Axis troops were forced to surrender to the Partisans.

1945年5月15日：Bleiburg repatriations: After the retreating Axis column is stopped at Bleiburg, Austria, and forced by the British Army to surrender instead to the Yugoslav Partisans, the Yugoslav Partisans commit thousands of reprisals against the remnants of the Ustaše and the civilians who fled Croatia alongside them, as well as some Slovene, Serb, and Montenegrin collaborators.
1945年6月10日：Tito agreed to the separation of Allied and Partisan forces at the Morgan Line.
1945年8月21日：ZAVNOH declared itself the People's Parliament of Croatia.
1945年8月25日：The People's Parliament elected Nazor President of Croatia.
1945年10月：The royalists in the Yugoslavian government resigned.
1945年11月11日：The Communist Party won an overwhelming majority of votes to the Constituent Assembly of Yugoslavia.
1945年11月29日：The Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia was declared and King Peter deposed.
1946年1月31日：The 1946 Yugoslav Constitution came into force.

1947年2月10日：The Paris Peace Treaties, 1947 were signed, solidifying Yugoslavia's border with Italy and establishing the Free Territory of Trieste, half of which was to be under Yugoslavian military occupation.
1947年9月：The Cominform was established.
1948年5月：Tito–Stalin split: Croatian Communist Party member Andrija Hebrang was arrested after supporting the Soviet Union in a dispute with Yugoslavia.
1948年6月28日：Tito–Stalin split: Yugoslavia was expelled from the Cominform.
1949年6月19日：Nazor died.
1950年6月26日：Tito announced the introduction of workers' self-management in Yugoslavia.
1953年1月13日：The 1953 Yugoslav Constitution came into force.
1953年12月：Vladimir Bakarić became President of Croatia.
1963年4月7日：The 1963 Yugoslav Constitution came into force.
1967年3月13日：Croatian Spring: The Declaration on the Status and Name of the Croatian Literary Language was published, demanding equal status for the Croatian language.
links: Declaration on the Status and Name of the Croatian Literary Language

items.text: 1971年11月23日：Croatian Spring: A student protest began in Zagreb.
1971年12月：Croatian Spring: Tito forced Chair of the Croatian Communist Party Savka Dabčević-Kučar to resign.
1974年2月21日：The 1974 Yugoslav Constitution came into force, establishing a nine-member Presidency of Yugoslavia of which Tito was president for Life.
1974年4月：Ivo Perišin became President of Croatia.
1974年5月8日：Perišin was succeeded by a rotating Croatian Presidency under the 1974 Yugoslav Constitution.
1975年11月10日：The Treaty of Osimo was signed, under which Italy and Yugoslavia were allowed to annex their respective occupation zones in Trieste.
1980年5月4日：Tito died. He was succeeded as President of the Presidency of Yugoslavia by the Macedonian Lazar Koliševski.
1980年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Bosnian Cvijetin Mijatović.
links: Socialist Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina

items.text: 1981年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Slovenian Sergej Kraigher.
1982年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Serbian Petar Stambolić.
1983年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Croatian Mika Špiljak.
1984年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Montenegrin Veselin Đuranović.
1985年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Vojvodin Radovan Vlajković.
1986年5月10日：Ante Marković assumed the Presidency of Croatia.
1986年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Kosovar Sinan Hasani.
1987年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Macedonian Lazar Mojsov.
1988年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Bosnian Raif Dizdarević.
links: Socialist Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina

items.text: 1989年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Slovenian Janez Drnovšek.
1990年1月23日：A Communist Party Congress ended the party's legal monopoly in Croatia.
1990年4月22日：Croatian parliamentary election, 1990: The first round of elections was held.
1990年5月6日：Croatian parliamentary election, 1990: The second round of elections was held. The Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ) won a majority of seats in all houses of Parliament.
1990年5月15日：The Yugoslavian Presidency rotated to the Serbian Borisav Jović.
1990年5月30日：The Serb Democratic Party (SDS) quit the Croatian Parliament.
1990年7月25日：A Serbian Assembly led by the SDS declared the establishment of the Serbian Autonomous Oblast of Kninska Krajina.
1990年8月17日：Log Revolution: Secessionist Serbs barricaded roads connecting Kninska Krajina to the rest of Croatia.
1990年10月：Kninska Krajina was superseded by the larger Serbian Autonomous Oblast of Krajina.
1990年12月22日：The current Constitution of Croatia was ratified. Franjo Tuđman of the HDZ was made President of Croatia.
1991年3月2日：Pakrac clash: Croatian police arrested 180 Serb rebels who had occupied the town of Pakrac.
1991年3月25日：Presidents of Croatia and Serbia partake in the Milošević–Tuđman Karađorđevo meeting
1991年3月31日：Plitvice Lakes incident: Croatian police entered the Plitvice Lakes National Park to expel the secessionist forces of Krajina. Two combatants were killed.
1991年4月1日：Plitvice Lakes incident: The Yugoslavian army intervened to end the crisis.
1991年5月1日：Two Croatian police officers were taken prisoner by Serb secessionists in Borovo Selo.
1991年5月2日：The Croatian Parliament voted to hold a referendum on independence from Yugoslavia.
1991年5月2日：Borovo Selo killings: An attempt to free the captives resulted in a firefight between Serb rebels and police. Twelve Croatian policemen killed, with an unknown number of rebel casualties.
1991年5月15日：Serbia blocked the accession of Croatian Stjepan Mesić to the Yugoslavian Presidency.
1991年5月19日：Croatian independence referendum, 1991: Croatian independence from Yugoslavia was approved in referendum, with 93% support.
1991年6月25日：The Croatian Parliament declared Croatia independent from Yugoslavia.
1991年6月25日：Serb secessionists declared the Serbian Autonomous Oblast of Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia.
links: SAO Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia

items.text: 1991年7月：Battle of Osijek: JNA forces began shelling the town of Osijek.
1991年7月15日：Operation Coast-91: JNA and SAO Krajina forces attacked the town of Biograd but were rebuffed.
1991年8月：Operation Opera Orientalis: Yugoslavian intelligence bombed Jewish cemeteries in an attempt to turn international opinion against Croatian independence.
1991年8月1日：Dalj massacre: Serb rebels killed twenty-eight police officers and eleven Croat civilians in Dalj.
1991年8月12日：Serb secessionists declared the Serbian Autonomous Oblast of Western Slavonia.
1991年8月25日：Battle of Vukovar: The Yugoslavian army and Serb militias laid siege to the town of Vukovar.
1991年9月9日：Battle of the Barracks: The Yugoslavian barracks in Sisak surrendered to Croatian forces.
1991年9月16日：Battle of Šibenik (1991): The Yugoslavian army attacked Croatian forces in Šibenik.
1991年9月22日：Battle of Šibenik (1991): Yugoslavian forces were made to retreat.
1991年10月1日：Siege of Dubrovnik: Yugoslavian forces surrounded Dubrovnik.
1991年10月6日：Operation Coast-91: A truce was agreed.
1991年10月7日：Bombing of Banski dvori: The Yugoslavian army bombed the government residence, the Banski dvori in Zagreb.
1991年10月13日：Široka Kula massacre: Serb forces killed thirty-four civilians.
1991年10月16日：Gospić massacre: A three-day massacre began during which Serb forces killed between twenty-three and one hundred civilians.
1991年10月18日：Lovas massacre: Serbs forced a group of Croat civilians to walk across a minefield, killing twenty-one.
1991年10月21日：Baćin massacre: Serb rebel forces killed some fifty-six civilians.
1991年10月31日：Operation Otkos 10: Croatian forces moved to block a Yugoslavian advance on Zagreb.
1991年11月4日：Operation Otkos 10: The operation concluded successfully.
1991年11月10日：Erdut massacre: Serb rebels executed the first ten of the thirty-seven Hungarian and Croat civilians they would eventually massacre in Erdut.
1991年11月12日：Saborsko massacre: Serb rebel forces killed twenty-nine civilians in Saborsko.
1991年11月14日：Battle of the Dalmatian channels: A Yugoslavian ship was sunk by the Croatian navy near Split.
1991年11月16日：Battle of the Dalmatian channels: The Yugoslavian blockade of Split was broken.
1991年11月18日：Battle of Vukovar: The last Croatian forces surrendered.
1991年11月18日：Škabrnja massacre: Serb forces took the town of Škabrnja and began a massacre which would eventually claim eighty-six lives.

1991年11月18日：Bosnian War: The Croatian Democratic Union of Bosnia and Herzegovina (HDZBiH) established Croatian Community of Herzeg-Bosnia at municipalities with majority of Croatian people on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
links: Croatian Democratic Union of Bosnia and Herzegovina
Socialist Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina

items.text: 1991年11月20日：Vukovar massacre: Some 264 civilians, mostly Croats, were murdered by Serb militias near Vukovar.
1991年12月12日：Operation Orkan 91 The Croatian Army began an advance into Krajina.
1991年12月12日：Operation Whirlwind: The Croatian army attempted to cross the Kupa river against Krajina forces.
1991年12月13日：Voćin massacre: A Serb paramilitary group, the White Eagles, killed several dozen people before retreating from Voćin.
1991年12月13日：Operation Whirlwind: The Croatian advance was stopped.
1991年12月16日：Joševica massacre: Serb forces killed twenty-one civilians in Joševica.
1991年12月19日：Krajina declared independence from Croatia, proclaiming itself the Republic of Serbian Krajina.
1991年12月21日：Bruška massacre: Serb forces killed ten civilians in Bruška.
1992年1月2日：Operation Orkan 91: A ceasefire was negotiated.
1992年1月2日：Battle of Osijek: A ceasefire was negotiated.
1992年2月26日：Krajina invested SAO Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia and Western Slavonia.
links: SAO Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia

items.text: 1992年5月6日：Bosnian War: The Graz agreement was drafted, delineating the demarcation between Herzeg-Bosnia and the Republika Srpska in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
1992年5月26日：Siege of Dubrovnik: Croatian forces broke the siege.
1992年6月：Operation Vrbas '92: Military offensive of the Army of Republika Srpska against the HVO and ARBiH in Jajce.
1992年6月14日：Operation Corridor: The Army of Republika Srpska launched an offensive against the joint forces of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia and Herzeg-Bosnia.
1992年6月21日：Miljevci plateau incident: Croatian forces captured some thirty square miles in a surprise attack on Krajina forces.
1992年6月26日：Operation Corridor: The operation ended with the successful linking of the two parts of Republika Srpska.
1992年8月2日：Croatian parliamentary election, 1992: The HDZ won a majority of seats in the Sabor.
1992年8月2日：Croatian presidential election, 1992: Tuđman was reelected with 57% of the vote.
1992年8月12日：Hrvoje Šarinić of the HDZ was elected prime minister.
1992年10月18日：Croat–Bosniak War: First armed clashes between the Croatian Defence Council (HVO) and the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH).
links: Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina

items.text: 1992年10月27日：Operation Vrbas '92: The operation concluded with the conquest of Jajce.
1993年1月22日：Operation Maslenica: The Croatian army launched an offensive to reconquer Krajina territory in northern Dalmatia.
1993年2月1日：Operation Maslenica: The Croatian government halted the offensive.
1993年9月：Operation Neretva '93: ARBiH forces attack the HVO in Herzegovina and central Bosnia.
1993年9月9日：Operation Medak Pocket: Croatian forces launched a southeastward offensive against Krajina towards the village of Medak.
1993年9月17日：Operation Medak Pocket: Croatia negotiated a ceasefire under international pressure.
1994年2月23日：Croat–Bosniak War: The war was effectively ended with a ceasefire.
1994年3月18日：Croat–Bosniak War: The Washington Agreement was signed, establishing the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina within Bosnia and Herzegovina.
1994年11月29日：Operation Winter '94: Croatian forces launched an offensive into western Bosnia and Herzegovina.
1994年12月24日：Operation Winter '94: The offensive ended to Croatian territorial advantage.
1995年5月1日：Operation Flash: The Croatian Army launched an offensive which would reconquer the territory of the former Western Slavonia in Krajina.
1995年5月2日：Zagreb rocket attacks: A two-day series of rocket attacks by Serb forces on Zagreb began which would kill seven civilians.
1995年5月3日：Operation Flash: The offensive came to a successful conclusion.
1995年7月25日：Operation Summer '95: Croatian forces launched a northward offensive from Bosnia and Herzegovina against Krajina forces.
1995年7月30日：Operation Summer '95: The operation ended to Croatian territorial advantage.
1995年8月4日：Operation Storm: One hundred and fifty thousand Croatian soldiers launched an offensive across a three hundred-mile front into Krajina.
1995年8月9日：Operation Storm: The operation concluded with the surrender of Krajina forces at Vojnić.
1995年9月8日：Operation Mistral 2: Croatian and Bosnia and Herzegovina forces attacked Republika Srpska forces in western Bosnia and Herzegovina.
1995年9月15日：Operation Mistral: The battle ended in a Republika Srpska defeat.
1995年10月29日：Croatian parliamentary election, 1995: The HDZ won a majority of seats in the Sabor.
1995年11月7日：Zlatko Mateša of the HDZ was elected prime minister.

1995年11月12日：The Erdut Agreement was signed by representatives of Croatia and Krajina, establishing a Joint Council of Municipalities in Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia (1995-1998), which would guarantee Serb rights under the protection of the United Nations Transitional Authority for Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium (UNTAES) and later under Croatian sovereignty.
links: Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia (1995-1998)
United Nations Transitional Authority for Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium

items.text: 1995年12月14日：Bosnian War: The Dayton Agreement was signed, establishing Bosnia and Herzegovina as an indivisible federation, with an alternating presidency, of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Republika Srpska.
1996年1月15日：The UNTAES mission began.
links: United Nations Transitional Authority for Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium

items.text: 1996年9月5日：1996 Ston–Slano earthquake: A strong Mw6.0 earthquake struck north of Dubrovnik. The worst of the damage occurred in the old town of Ston. There were no fatalities, but there was extensive damage to houses and cultural heritage.
1997年6月15日：Croatian presidential election, 1997: Tuđman was reelected with 61% of the vote.
1998年1月15日：The UNTAES mission ended.
links: United Nations Transitional Authority for Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium

items.text: 1999年11月26日：Tuđman was declared incapacitated due to illness. Speaker of the Croatian Parliament Vlatko Pavletić became acting president.
1999年12月10日：Tuđman died of cancer.
2000年1月3日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2000: The Social Democratic Party of Croatia (SDP) won a plurality of seats in the Sabor.

2000年1月24日：Croatian presidential election, 2000: Mesić, running with the Croatian People's Party – Liberal Democrats (HNS), and Dražen Budiša of the Croatian Social Liberal Party (HSLS) qualified for the second round.
2000年1月27日：Ivica Račan of the SDP was elected prime minister, with the HSLS joining the SDP in coalition.
2000年2月2日：Zlatko Tomčić of the HSS was elected Speaker of the Croatian Parliament, replacing Pavletić in that role and as acting president.
2000年2月7日：Croatian presidential election, 2000: Mesić won with 56% of the vote.
2001年3月28日：Chamber of Counties was abolished by Constitutional amendment.
links: Speaker of the Chamber of Counties of Croatia

items.text: 2003年11月23日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2003: The HDZ won a plurality of seats in the Sabor.
2003年12月23日：Ivo Sanader of the HDZ was confirmed prime minister by the Sabor, with the Croatian Party of Pensioners (HSU) and Independent Democratic Serb Party (SDSS) joining the HDZ in coalition.
2005年1月2日：Croatian presidential election, 2005: Mesić, running as an independent, and Jadranka Kosor of the HDZ qualified for the second round.
2005年1月16日：Croatian presidential election, 2005: Mesić was reelected with 66% of the vote.
2007年11月25日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2007: The HDZ maintained its plurality in the Sabor.
2007年：Sanader was again confirmed prime minister, with the HSS and HSLS now supporting his candidacy.
2009年4月1日：Croatia joins NATO.
2009年7月1日：Sanader resigned. Deputy Prime Minister Kosor became prime minister.
2009年7月3日：2009 flu pandemic in Croatia. First case confirmed with its origin from Australia. 526 people were infected and 22 people died from the Swine Flu.
2009年12月27日：Croatian presidential election, 2009–10: Ivo Josipović of the SDP and the independent Milan Bandić qualified for the second round.
2010年1月10日：Croatian presidential election, 2009–10: Josipović won with 60% of the vote.
2011年12月4日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2011: The SDP won a plurality of seats in the Sabor.
2013年7月1日：Croatia becomes the 28th member state of the European Union.
links: Member state of the European Union

items.text: 2015年1月11日：Croatian presidential election, 2014–15: Kolinda Grabar-Kitarović was voted to be the president of Croatia with 50,74% of the vote, becoming Croatia's first female president.
2015年11月8日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2015: The Patriotic Coalition won a plurality of seats in the Sabor, with Croatia is Growing coalition coming second and MOST third.
2016年9月11日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2016: The HDZ-led coalition won a plurality of seats in the Sabor. Andrej Plenković confirmed as the prime minister.
2020年1月5日：Croatian presidential election, 2019–20: Zoran Milanović (SDP) won with over 52% popular vote against Kolinda Grabar-Kitarović (HDZ).
2020年：2020 coronavirus outbreak in Croatia. At the time over 210 cases of COVID-19 confirmed.
2020年3月22日：2020 Zagreb earthquake. At 6:24 AM, an 5.4 magnitude earthquake hit Zagreb and killed 1 teenager from the falling bricks. Its shock traveled few hundred kilometers.
2020年7月5日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2020: The HDZ-led coalition won a plurality of seats in the Sabor, with Andrej Plenković continuing to be the prime minister.
2020年12月29日：An earthquake hit near village of Petrinja at 12:19 PM with magnitude 6.2ML killing 7 people.
2021年：GDP growth in Croatia increased by hitting record high 10.4% after contracting 8.1% in 2020.
2022年7月12日：European Union formally approved Croatia to become 20th Eurozone member by start of 2023.
2022年：Croatia showed prices in both kunas and euros.
2022年：Euro packages available to buy in commercial banks, Financijska agencija [hr], Hrvatska pošta d.d. and Croatian National Bank.
2023年1月1日：Croatia officially joined Eurozone as 20th member and Schengen area as 27th member.
2023年：Dual kuna/euro circulation was in effect.

2024年4月17日：Croatian parliamentary election, 2024: The HDZ-led coalition won a plurality of seats in the Sabor, with Andrej Plenković continuing to be the prime minister for the third consecutive time.
2025年1月12日：Croatian presidential election, 2024–25: Zoran Milanović (Independent) won with over 74% popular vote against Dragan Primorac (HDZ).
1526年－1868年：(Shown in Red)
1868年－1918年：(Shown in Red)
650年：The Curonians and Livonians were paying tribute to king Ivar Vidfamne of Scania

750年：In the legendary Battle of Brávellir Curonians were fighting at the side of Sigurd Hring, king of Sweden, and Livonians under their duke Ger (Ger Livicus) at the side of Harald Wartooth, king of Denmark. According to Norna-Gests þáttr Sigurd Hring fought against the invading Curonians (Kúrir) in the southern part of what today is Sweden
800年：The Curonians had rebelled against the Swedes and refused to pay them tribute.

850年：The Danish king marshalled a great fleet and sailed to Courland in order to take over their goods and to make the Curonians pay tribute to instead. The Curonians gathered forces from all five of their towns and butchered half the Danish army and plundered their war ships.
854年：King Olaf of Sweden with 7,000 armed men attacked towns of Seeburg and Apulia. Curonians declared that they wished to be the subjects of the Swedish kings as in former times.

870年：The legendary Danish king Hadingus wages wars in the Baltic and achieves victory against king Handwanus of Duna (Duna urbs), however, suffering defeat against Curonian tyrant Loker (Loker, Curetum tyrannus)
890年：The Curonian king Dorno (Curetum rex Dorno), one of the legendary kings in Saxo Grammaticus' Gesta Danorum, fights against the legendary Danish king Frotho I.

925年：Egils Saga describes the expedition of Icelandic vikings Thorolf and Egill Skallagrímsson by the Eastern route (Austrvegr), where they won much wealth and had many battles. In Courland they made a peace for half a month and traded with the men of the land.
950年：The Norse prince Ragnvald (Rogvolod of Polatsk) came from overseas and subjugated hillforts along the river of Daugava. His capital was established at Polatsk.
1106年：Semigallians completely destroyed united armies of the sons of Prince Vseslav of Polotsk in the lowlands of Daugava.
1111年：Prince of Novgorod Mstislav Vladimirovich invaded eastern part of Tālava (Adzele) and Ugandi.
1180年：Prince Mstislav Rostislavich led the Novgorodians against the Letts of Tālava.
1184年：The monk Saint Meinhard began missionary work among the Livonian people.
1186年：Meinhard was appointed bishop of Livonia by the Pope.
1198年：Bishop Berthold of Hanover arrived at the mouth of the Daugava River accompanied by crusaders and was killed in battle with Livonians.
1199年：Albert of Riga was elected the third bishop of Livonia.
1199年：Pope Innocent III proclaimed a second Baltic Crusade.
1201年：Albert founded Riga on the site of earlier Livonian settlement.
1202年：The Catholic military order of Livonian Brothers of the Sword was founded by Bishop Albert.
1206年：The Brothers of the Sword and their Semigallian allies defeated Livonians at Turaida
1217年：The Brothers of the Sword and their Livonian and Latgalian allies defeated Estonians at the Battle of St. Matthew's Day near Viljandi.
1229年：Bishop Albert died.
1236年：Battle of Saule: The Brothers of the Sword were defeated in the Land of Saule (terra Sauleorum) by combined forces of Samogitians and Semigallians.
1242年：Alexander Nevsky defeated the Livonian Order on Lake Peipus.
1255年：The Bishopric at Riga was elevated to become the Archbishopric of Riga.
1282年：Riga became a member of the Hanseatic League.
1378年：The Livonian Order raided Upytė, and another campaign threatened the Lithuanian capital in Vilnius.
1422年：A Livonian Diet first met.
1452年：The Livonian Order and Archbishopric of Riga began to rule jointly in Livonia.
1481年：Muscovy attacked Livonia.
1501年：The Livonian Order, aided by Lithuania, launched an attack on Pskov.
1502年：Russian troops were defeated at the Battle of Lake Smolina near Palkino.
1558年：Ivan the Terrible launched an attack on Livonia.
1561年：Livonian War: Livonia fell to Lithuania.
1569年：Lithuania and Poland joined to form the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Livonia became a joint domain administered directly by both realms.
1629年：The Peace of Altmark was reached, under which Sweden annexed Livonia and several Courland territories to Swedish Livonia.
1689年：The Old and New Testaments were published in Latvian translation by Pastor Ernst Glück.
1700年：Great Northern War: A war began which involved the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, Sweden, and Russia.
1710年：Riga fell to the Russians, though Courland remained under the control of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
1721年：Great Northern War: The Treaty of Nystadt ended the war.
1841年：A famine occurred in Livonia.
1873年：The first Latvian Song and Dance Festival took place.
1887年：Russification measures began in the Baltic governorates of the Russian Empire.
1905年1月13日：Russian army troops opened fire on demonstrators in Riga, killing seventy-three and injuring two hundred people.
1905年：A revolution took place in the Baltic region directed primarily against German landowners and Russian autocracy.
1914年8月1日：World War I: The war began.
1918年11月18日：An independent Latvia was proclaimed.
1919年：Latvian rouble currency introduced.
1920年8月11日：The Latvian–Soviet Peace Treaty was signed.
1921年9月22日：Latvia became a member of the League of Nations.
1922年2月：A Latvian constitution was adopted.
1934年5月15日：Prime Minister Kārlis Ulmanis took power in a bloodless coup d'état.
1939年8月23日：The Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact was signed between the Soviet Union (USSR) and Nazi Germany.
1940年6月16日：An ultimatum was presented by the USSR to Latvia.
1940年6月17日：Soviet occupation of Latvia in 1940: Soviet troops occupied the country.
1940年8月5日：Latvia was incorporated into the Soviet Union, becoming the Latvian Soviet Socialist Republic (SSR).
1941年6月14日：The first mass deportations of Latvians to various sites in the Soviet Union began.
1941年7月1日：Occupation of Latvia by Nazi Germany: Nazi troops occupied Riga.
links: Occupation of Latvia by Nazi Germany

items.text: 1944年10月：Occupation of Latvia by Soviet Union 1944-1945: The Soviet army reentered Riga.
links: Occupation of Latvia by Soviet Union 1944-1945

items.text: 1955年：About thirty thousand deportees returned to Latvia from the USSR under a general amnesty.
1981年：The modern Vanšu Bridge was opened across the Daugava River in Riga.
1987年6月14日：The first demonstration in Riga to commemorate the 1941 deportations took place.
1988年8月23日：Mass demonstrations took place against the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact.
1990年5月4日：The Latvian SSR Supreme Council adopted the declaration On the Restoration of Independence of the Republic of Latvia.
links: On the Restoration of Independence of the Republic of Latvia

items.text: 1991年1月：The Barricades: Pro-Communist political forces attempted to restore Soviet power in Latvia.
1991年9月6日：The Soviet Union recognized Latvian independence.
1991年9月17日：Latvia became a member of the United Nations.
2004年3月29日：Latvia became a member of NATO.
2004年：2003 september- latvia referendum vote gives strong backing to eu membership.
前3000年：Finno-Ugric peoples (ancestors of Estonians) started to move from eastern Europe to northeastern coast of Baltic Sea.
98年：Roman historian Tacitus writes in the book Germania about aesti tribes.
600年：Vikings from Gotland sail to Hiiumaa (Dagö) island and build a fortification there.
600年：King Ingvar of Sweden invades Estonia, but is killed. His son Anund avenges his father and raids the country.
800年：Estonians participate in the Battle of Brávellir on the side of the Swedes and against the Danes.
967年：Olaf Tryggvason, the future King of Norway, is captured by Estonian vikings, and sold as a slave.
972年：A battle between Estonian and Icelandic Vikings in Saaremaa.
1008年：Olaf Haraldsson, the future King of Norway, wins a battle in Saaremaa.
1030年：Prince Yaroslav the Wise of Kiev defeats Chuds and founds a fort named Yuryev (modern Tartu).
1050年：Estonians started trading and raiding Viking expeditions over Baltic Sea to Sweden.
1061年：Sosols (Estonian tribe) destroy the Yuryev castle and attack Pskov.
1113年：Prince Mstislav I of Kiev wins a battle against the Chuds (Estonians or people related to Estonians).
1116年：Prince Mstislav of Kiev, aided by Pskov and Novgorod, makes a raid against the Chuds and conquers the Otepää stronghold.
1132年：Prince Vsevolod of Novgorod is defeated by Estonians of Vaiga county.
1134年：Prince Vsevold of Novgorod fights against the Chuds and briefly captures the fortification of Tartu (Yuryev).
1154年：Arab geographer Al Idrisi mentions Estonian places, also marking the foundation of Tallinn.
1165年：The Benedictine bishop Fulco is named Bishop of the Estonians by the Archbishop of Lund.
1170年：Valdemar I of Denmark fights with Curonian and Estonian pirates near Öland island.
1177年：Fulco second missionary journey to Estonia.
1177年：Estonians attack and burn Pskov during winter.
1187年：Estonians, Karelians or/and Karelians ravage the Mälaren area in Sweden, pillage town of Sigtuna, and kill the archbishop Johannes.
1191年：Cistercian monk Theoderich, future Bishop of Estonia, makes an unsuccessful missionary journey to Estonia.
1192年：Prince Yaroslav Vladimirovich of Novgorod makes two raids against Estonians, burning down the Tartu and Otepää strongholds.
1193年：Pope Celestine III calls for a crusade against pagans in Northern Europe.
1200年：Bishop Albert and his crusaders capture Riga in Latvia.
1202年：Pope Innocent III declares Crusade to Christianize Old Livonia. The crusader Livonian Brothers of the Sword are founded.
1203年：Saaremaa islanders ravage areas of Southern Sweden, then belonging to Denmark. The returning pirates skirmish with the German settlers of Riga near the town of Visby in Gotland.
1206年：Valdemar II of Denmark builds a fortress in Saaremaa, but burns it down after finding no volunteers to man it.
1207年：The Terra Mariana ("Land of St Mary) is established as the political unit of crusaders in Livonia.
1208年：Sword Brothers, Letts and Livs invade Sakala and Ugandi in Southern Estonia, starting the Estonian Ancient Fight for Freedom (1208-1227).
1209年：Sword Brothers and Letts attack Ugandi.
1210年：Estonians besiege the Cēsis stronghold in Latvia.
1210年：Estonians defeat the Sword Brothers and Livs in the Battle of Ümera in Latvia.
1210年：Pskov and Novgorod troops besiege the Otepää stronghold.
1210年－1211年：First recorded plague in Estonia.
1211年：Pskov troops raid Western Estonia.
1211年：Estonians are defeated by Sword Brothers in the Battle of Turaida in Latvia.
1211年：Sword Brothers are defeated by Estonians in the Battle of Viljandi.
1211年：Estonians raid crusader areas in Latvia.
1211年：Three-year truce between Estonians and Germans is signed at Turaida.
1212年：Russian troops besiege the Varbola Stronghold.
1212年：Troops from Sakala, led by Lembitu of Lehola, burn Pskov.
1213年：Lithuanians raid the Sakala area.
1215年：Sword Brothers defeat Estonians in the Battle of Lehola.
1215年：Troops from Saaremaa besiege Riga.
1215年：Troops from Sakala raid crusader areas in Latvia.
1216年：Pskov troops capture the Otepää stronghold.
1217年2月：Sword Brothers are defeated by Estonians and Russians in the Battle of Otepää.
1217年9月21日：Sword Brothers, Latgalians and Livs defeat Estonians in the Battle of St. Matthew's Day, where the Estonian leader Lembitu of Lehola is killed.
1219年6月15日：Valdemar II of Denmark conquers Tallinn in the Battle of Lindanise and builds the Toompea Castle.
1220年8月8日：John I of Sweden invades Läänemaa, but is defeated by troops from Saaremaa in the Battle of Lihula.
1221年：Estonians besiege Tallinn.
1222年：The invading Danish troops are defeated by Estonians in Saaremaa.
1223年1月29日：Estonians defeat the Sword Brothers in the Battle of Viljandi and the entire Southern Estonia is liberated.
1223年：Estonians are defeated by Sword Brothers in Ümera, Latvia.
1223年：Pskov and Novgorod troops raid most of mainland Estonia.
1224年8月15日：Sword Brothers capture the Tartu stronghold from joint Estonian and Russian troops - mainland Estonia falls to the crusaders.
1224年：The Bishopric of Dorpat is established in Southeastern Estonia.
1227年1月：Sword Brothers conquer stronghold of Muhu, and last pagan stronghold of Valjala surrenders.
1227年：Sword Brothers conquer Northern Estonia from Denmark.
1228年10月1日：The Bishopric of Ösel–Wiek is established in Western Estonia.
1234年：Pskov and Novgorod troops invade the Bishopric of Dorpat, that is forced to pay tribute for four years.
1234年：De Lode brothers in Kullamaa Parish refuse to recognize the new Bishop of Ösel-Wiek.
1236年9月22日：Sword Brothers are defeated by Samogitians in the Battle of Saule. Saaremaa islanders rebel against German rule.
1237年：Livonian Brothers of the Sword merge into the Teutonic Order and become known as the Livonian Order, autonomous of the Teutonic Order State.
1238年：The Livonian Order helps restore the power of the Bishop of Ösel Wiek in Kullamaa Parish.
1239年：The Liber Census Daniae is compiled. The book also gives first recorded data on northern Estonia.
1242年4月5日：The Livonian Order and Estonians are defeated by Novgorod in the Battle of the Ice.
1249年：St. Michael's Convent is founded in Tallinn.
1251年：first mentioning of a school in Estonia (the cathedral school in Pärnu).
1268年2月18日：Pskov and Novgorod defeat the Livonian Order in the Battle of Rakvere, ending the Order's attempts to invade Russia.
1270年2月16日：Lithuanians defeat the Livonian Order in the Battle of Karuse.
1285年：Tallinn becomes a member of the Hanseatic League.
1298年：A border war between the Livonian Order and the Bishopric of Ösel-Wiek.
1305年：Padise Abbey is founded.
1343年：St.George's Night Uprising (1343–1345) in Northwestern Estonia and Saaremaa.
1346年：King Valdemar IV of Denmark sells Northern Estonia to the Teutonic Order.
1347年：The Teutonic Order gives Northern Estonia to Livonian Order.
1407年：Pirita convent is built.
1419年：The Livonian Diet is formed to solve internal disputes in Livonia.
1433年：First recorded great fire in Tallinn.
1435年：The Livonian Confederation is established to solve internal disputes in Livonia.
1440年：The Livonian Order becomes self-governing from the Teutonic Order.
1464年：Plague kills 2/3 of population of Tallinn.
1480年－1481年：First war between Old Livonia and Muscovite Russia.
1500年：Estonian population exceeds 250,000.
1500年－1502年：Second Livonian-Russian war.
1504年－1505年：Plague ravages Estonia.
1507年：Old Livonian peasants are not allowed to own weapons.
1523年：The Reformation comes to Estonia.
1524年9月14日：Catholic churches are pillaged in Tallinn.
1525年：The Teutonic Order is secularized and the Livonian Order becomes de facto independent.
1552年：First library is founded in Tallinn.
1558年：Russian forces invade Eastern Estonia, starting the Livonian War.
1558年：The Bishopric of Dorpat and several bailiwicks of the Livonian Order in Eastern Estonia surrender to Russian forces.
1558年：Tartu surrendered to Russian troops in the Livonian War
1559年：The Bishop of Ösel-Wiek sells his bishopric to King Frederick II of Denmark, who gives the land to his brother Duke Magnus of Holstein. Lutheranism prevails in Western Estonia.
1560年：Duke Magnus of Holstein takes power in the Bishopric of Ösel-Wiek.
1560年：Russian troops defeat the Livonian Order in the Battle of Härgmäe.
1560年：Russian troops capture Central Estonia from the Livonian Order.
1560年：Ivan the Terrible decimated the Livonian Order in the Battle of Ergeme.
1560年：Uprising of Wiek's peasants. (:et)
1561年：The Commandery of Tallinn and the nobility of other North Estonian bailiwicks of the Livonian Order swear allegiance to Sweden.
1561年：The Treaty of Vilnius gives lands of the Livonian Order in Southern Estonia and Northern Latvia to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania as the Duchy of Livonia.
1561年6月6日：The city council of Reval surrendered to Sweden.
1562年：The Livonian Order is dissolved.
1562年：The Bailiwick of Maasilinna of the former Livonian Order in Saaremaa and Hiiumaa refuses to recognize Lithuanian power.
1564年：The Bailiwick of Maasilinna gives itself under Danish rule.
1573年1月1日：The Russians occupied Pärnu (Pernau) in Western Estonia and the fortress of Weissenstein (Paide).
1578年：Balthasar Russow publishes his cronicles about the Livonian War.
1581年9月6日：A mercenary army of Sweden under Pontus de la Gardie captured Narva from Russia.
1582年：By the armistice of Jam Zapolski, Dorpat together with Southern Estonia was incorporated into the state of Poland-Lithuania.
1595年：Treaty of Teusina: Sweden's right to Narva and Estonia was signed.
1625年：Swedish commander Jacob De la Gardie took Dorpat (Tartu) and Southern Estonia from Poland
1628年：First glass manufacturer is established in Estonia on Hiiumaa (operates until 1664).
1629年：Truce of Altmark: Sweden acquired the territory of Livonia.
1630年：First gymnasium is established in Estonia in Tartu.
1630年：Gustav Adolf Gymnasium is established in Tallinn (being the oldest continuously operating secondary school in Estonia).
1630年：First printer is established in Estonia in Tallinn.
1632年：Foundation of the University of Tartu under Swedish king Gustavus Adolphus.
1645年8月13日：Saaremaa (Ösel) island was ceded from Denmark to Sweden by the Treaty of Brömsebro.
1684年：Forselius Seminar for schoolmasters is opened near Tartu (operated until 1688).
1687年：Over the Estonia, widespread opening of village schools for peasants, starts.
1690年：Tartu University is re-opened, but 1699–1710 operates in Pärnu.
1695年－1697年：Great Famine of Estonia.
1700年11月20日：Battle at Narva, where the Swedish army under King Charles XII defeats the Russian army.
1704年：Russian troops under czar Peter the Great captured Dorpat (Tartu) in the Great Northern War.
1708年：Fearful of Swedish attack, Russians burned down the city of Tartu.
1710年：Whole Estonia was included in Russian empire.
1710年－1713年：Last great plague in Estonia. About 200,000 people dies (about half of population).
1718年：Construction of Kadriorg Palace begins.
1721年8月30日：Estonia was formally ceded by Sweden to Russia by the Treaty of Nystad.
1730年：Herrnhut sects arrives in Estonia. Amongst the other things, they propagate reading among peasants.
1782年：The customs border between Russia and Baltic governorates is abolished.
1792年：First mirrors producing factory is opened in Estonia.
1802年：Tartu University is re-opened (was closed until 1710).
1816年：Serfdom was abolished in Estonia (Estonian Governorate).
1819年：Serfdom was abolished in Livonia (Livonian Governorate).
1823年：Johann August Hagen forms the first choir of native Estonians in Tallinn.
1834年：agricultural institute is opened in Vana-Kuuste (operated until 1838).
1838年：Estonian Learned Society is founded.
1839年：Cimze seminary for schoolmasters is opened in Valmiera.
1843年：Eduard Ahrens publishes his Estonian grammar book. The book is a base of for written Estonian language.
1849年：New peasant farm law is proclaimed in Livonian Governorate. This allows peasants to purchase their tenant farms as freeholds.
1850年：Narva Linen Mill (predecessor of Kreenholm Manufacturing Company) is founded.
1853年：Estonian Naturalists' Society is established.
1854年：Peasant farm law (1849) is also extended to Estonian Governorate.
1855年：The first Estonian permanent newspaper Perno Postimees is founded.
1855年：Kreenholm Manufacturing Company is founded.
1858年：peasant revolt: Mahtra War.
1861年："Kalevipoeg", Estonia's national epic, was published in both Estonian and German.
1861年：Prophet Maltsvet followers migrate to Crimea, in hope to find the promised land.
1863年：Preparatory works to establish the first Estonian-language secondary school (Estonian Aleksander School) begin. (school opened in 1888).
1864年11月21日：On Johann Köler's initiative, the a major Estonian peasants' petition (Estonian: 1864. aasta palvekirjaaktsioon) is presented to the imperator.
1865年：Vanemuine Cultural Society is founded in Tartu.
1865年：Estonia is founded in Tallinn.
1866年：The Law of Local Self-Government (Estonian: vallaseadus) comes into force. Noble estate owners' rights over peasants are severely reduced.
1867年－1870年：Three influential patriotic speeches by Carl Robert Jakobson.
1869年：Estonian Song Festivals established.
1870年：First Estonian-language play Saaremaa onupoeg by Lydia Koidula is published.
1870年11月5日：First railroad is opened in Estonia. The railroad connects Paldiski, Tallinn, Narva and St. Petersburg.
1870年－1871年：First agricultural societies are founded in Tartu, Pärnu and Viljandi.
1872年：Society of Estonian Literati is founded.
1875年：Cultural society Endla is founded in Pärnu.
1876年：Rail traffic between Tartu and Tapa is opened.
1880年：Eduard Bornhöhe short story Tasuja ('The Avenger') is published. Due to the book, patriotic fervor remarkably intensifies.
1880年：Third Estonian Song Festival, first time in Tallinn.
1884年6月4日：Blue-black-white tricolor (later the flag of Estonia) of the Estonian Students' Society is blessed at Otepää Church.
1886年：Russian language is decreed to be official language of communication in urban and rural administrations in Estonia.
1887年：Russian language is decreed to be official language of instruction in all public schools since grade three.
1888年：Jakob Hurt initiates the collection of national folkloric poetry.
1888年：Estonian Aleksander School is opened.
1888年8月10日：The first horse-drawn tram route is opened in Tallinn .
1889年：Policy of Russification introduced where Baltic German legal and educational institutions are abolished or transformed into Russian.
1889年：First temperance society is founded in Tori.
1893年：First hydroelectric power plant is opened in Kunda.
1896年：First cinematic presentations in Tallinna and Tartu.
1896年：First automobile is arrived in Estonia.
1896年：First narrow-gauge railroad is opened. It connects Pärnu and Valga.
1900年：First Estonian symphony orchestra is formed in Tartu.
1900年：Volta electric motor factory is established.
1900年－1903年：Economic crisis.
1901年：Konstantin Päts founds the newspaper Teataja in Tallinn.
1902年：First commercial bank in Estonia is established in Tartu.
1903年：Ants Laikmaa founds the first arts academy in Estonia.
1904年：Noor-Eesti is established.
1904年：Keila-Haapsalu rail line is opened.
1904年：Local elections in Tallinn. Estonian-Russian joint group (led by Konstantin Päts) takes power from Baltic Germans group in city council.
1905年11月：Russian Revolution of 1905 swept through Estonia. Estonian nationalist feeling is widespread, and autonomy from Russia is demanded.
1906年：The first fully Estonian-language school (Estonian: Eesti Noorsoo Kasvatuse Seltsi tütarlastegümnaasium, nowadays Miina Härma Gymnasium) is opened in Tartu.
1907年：First small-scale electric plant starts operating in Pärnu. Plant provides electric power to nearby households.
1908年：First radio transmission station in Estonia is opened. It is located at the Russian Imperial Baltic Fleet's Tallinn port.
1908年：Mihhail Rostovtsev opens Tartu Private University. University operates until 1918.
1909年4月14日：Estonian National Museum is opened in Tartu.
1912年4月27日：First airplane lands in Estonia.
1913年8月24日：Estonia Theatre and Concert Halls building is opened.
1914年8月1日：Russian Empire enters WW I.
1915年8月20日：Retreating Russian forces burn the Waldhof pulp mill. Then the largest pulp mill in Europe.
1915年11月15日：Steam trams begin operating in Tallinn.
1917年3月30日：Russian Provisional Government granted Estonia its autonomy.
1917年4月8日：40,000 Estonians are demonstrating in Petrograd. Their main slogan is that divided Estonia (two governorates) should be merged to Province of Estonia.
1918年2月24日：Estonian Declaration of Independence
1918年3月3日：Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. Bolshevist Russia cedes sovereignty over Estonia to Germany.
1918年11月11日：Germans begin withdrawal and turn over power to the provisional government of Estonia (headed by Konstantin Päts).
1918年11月22日：Estonia is invaded by Bolshevist Russian forces. Beginning of Estonian War of Independence.
1919年：Bolsheviks are driven out of Estonia.
1919年10月10日：Agrarian Law passed redistributing many of the estates owned by Baltic Germans and Estonian landowners.
1920年2月2日：Treaty of Tartu which gives Estonia recognition by Soviet Russia.
1920年6月15日：Adoption of the Constitution of Estonia, which came into effect on 21 December.
1921年1月：Estonia is recognized as an independent state, and starts its pursuit to join League of Nations.
1922年9月22日：Estonia joins the League of Nations.
1933年：Plebiscite in favour of constitutional reform giving wide powers to a new office of the president.
1934年1月24日：New constitution in effect.
1934年3月12日：Konstantin Päts with the help of General Johan Laidoner set up a virtual dictatorship. Parliament is prorogued and political parties banned. Many members of the Vaps Movement are arrested.
1937年2月24日：Election sees National Front winning 63 seats and all the opposition winning 17 seats.
1937年7月29日：A new constitution in force with civil liberties and democracy restored but with a very strong presidency.
1938年4月24日：Konstantin Päts elected president.
1938年5月9日：Kaarel Eenpalu becomes prime minister of Estonia.
1939年8月23日：The Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact is signed, promising mutual non-aggression between Germany and the Soviet Union and agreeing to a division of much of Europe between these two countries.
1939年10月12日：Jüri Uluots becomes prime minister of Estonia.
1940年6月17日：The Red Army occupies Estonia and Latvia.
1940年8月6日：Estonia is unlawfully declared the Estonian SSR and incorporated into the Soviet Union.
1941年：German troops (with help of Forest Brothers) take over Estonia from the Soviets.
1941年6月7日：German troops begin to carry out The Holocaust in Estonia.
1941年6月14日：Mass deportations by Soviet Union authorities take place in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.
1941年6月22日：Germany attacks Soviet Union; Estonian partisans (Forest Brothers) start revolt in Southern Estonia.
1941年8月28日：Sinking of a Soviet steamer with 3500 Soviet-mobilized Estonian men on board; 598 of them die.
1941年12月1日：Estonian Self-Administration, headed by Hjalmar Mäe, is inaugurated by German military administration.
1944年：Otto Tief is captured by Soviet forces; Jüri Uluots and members of the Tief government escape to Sweden.
1944年1月30日：Battle of Narva: The first Soviet units cross Estonian border.
1944年2月24日：Battle of Narva: Estonian volunteers launch a counterattack at Narva river.
links: 20th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS (1st Estonian)

items.text: 1944年3月6日：World War II: Soviet Army planes attack Narva in Estonia, destroying almost the entire old town.
1944年3月9日：World War II: Soviet Army planes attack Tallinn, Estonia.
1944年7月26日：Battle of Narva: The Soviets capture Narva.
1944年7月29日：Battle of Tannenberg Line: The Estonian and German counterattack stops Soviet advance towards Tallinn.
1944年8月26日：The Soviets capture most of Tartu, which becomes the frontline city for almost a month.

1944年9月18日：Jüri Uluots, prime minister in capacity of president of Estonia, asks Otto Tief to form a government on the eve of the withdrawal of German forces; official gazette published proclaiming the Tief government.
1944年9月20日：Otto Tief attempts to organise the defence of Tallinn against the arrival of the Red Army two days later.
1944年9月22日：The Soviets capture Tallinn.
1944年12月19日：The entire territory of Estonia is captured by the Red Army.

1949年3月25日：Operation Priboi: An extensive deportation campaign is conducted in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. The Soviet authorities deport more than 92,000 people from the Baltics to remote areas of the Soviet Union.
1955年7月19日：Estonian Television (ETV) began broadcasting.
1978年9月28日：One of the last Forest Brother guerilla movement fighter, August Sabbe, is discovered and killed in Estonia.
1980年：Youth riots in the capital of the Soviet Republic of Estonia are quickly suppressed.
1988年：In Estonia, 300,000 people demonstrate for independence.
1988年：Estonian becomes the official language of Estonia.
1988年11月16日：The Supreme Soviet of the Estonian SSR declares that Estonia is "sovereign" but stops short of declaring independence.
1989年：After 44 years, the Estonian flag is raised on the Pikk Hermann castle tower.

1989年8月23日：Two million indigenous people of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, at this time still occupied by the Soviet Union, join hands to demand freedom and independence, forming an uninterrupted 600km human chain called the Baltic Way.
1991年：Latvia and Estonia vote for independence from the Soviet Union.
1991年：The United States recognizes the independence of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.
1991年8月20日：The Supreme Council of the Republic of Estonia proclaims the restoration of Estonian independence from the Soviet Union.
1991年9月6日：The Soviet Union recognizes the independence of the Baltic States.
1992年：Estonia holds a referendum on its constitution.
1992年：Heinrich Mark and the government in exile appointed by him cede their credentials to the newly elected Riigikogu.
1992年6月20日：The Soviet ruble is replaced by the kroon.
1992年10月6日：Lennart Meri is elected President of Estonia.
1994年：The Russian army leaves Estonia.
1994年9月28日：Car ferry MS Estonia sinks in the Baltic Sea, killing 852.
2001年：68 people died in Estonia after drinking bootleg alcohol that contained methanol.
2002年：Estonia hosted the first Eurovision Song Contest in a former Soviet republic.
2002年：North Atlantic Treaty Organization Summit in Prague: Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia were invited to join NATO.
2003年：Estonia approved joining the European Union in a referendum with 66% agreed with joining and 34% were against it.
2004年3月29日：The largest expansion of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization to date takes place, allowing Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia into the organization.

2004年5月1日：The largest expansion to date of the European Union took place, extending the Union by 10 member-states: Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Slovenia, Hungary, Malta and Cyprus.
2005年：The same storm which pounded the U.S. earlier in the month hit England, Scandinavia and the Baltic States, leaving 13 dead with widespread flooding and power cuts.
2005年8月10日：A passenger helicopter en route to Helsinki, Finland crashed into the sea near Tallinn, Estonia, killing 14.
2006年10月9日：Toomas Hendrik Ilves was elected President of Estonia.
2007年4月27日：Russians riot in Tallinn, Estonia, about moving the Bronze Soldier. Two nights of rioting left one dead. Cyber attacks launched against Estonia.
2011年8月：Toomas Hendrik Ilves is re-elected president for a second five-year term.
2016年10月10日：Kersti Kaljulaid was elected as the first female President of Estonia since independence.
2021年10月11日：Alar Karis was elected President of Estonia.

150年：Ptolemy's map shows the city of Albanopolis (located northeast of Durrës). Ptolemy also mentions the Illyrian tribe named Albanoi, who lived around this city. The area was part of the Roman province of Macedonia.

244年－311年：Epirus Nova or New Epirus or Illyria Graeca or Illyris proper was a province of the Roman Empire established by Diocletian during his restructuring of provincial boundaries. The province, belonged to the Roman province of Macedonia. Later it became a theme of the Byzantine Empire. Dyrrachium was established as the capital of Epirus nova. The Roman administrative region of Epirus Nova corresponded to southern Illyria, which was in part subject to ancient Greek influence.

1000年－1018年：The Arbanasi people are recorded as being 'half-believers' (non-Orthodox Christians) and speaking their own language in the Fragment of Origins of Nations between 1000 and 1018 by an anonymous author in a Bulgarian text of the 11th century.

1043年：In History written in 1079–1080, Byzantine historian Michael Attaliates referred to the Albanoi as having taken part in a revolt against Constantinople in 1043 and to the Arbanitai as subjects of the duke of Dyrrachium. It is disputed, however, whether the "Albanoi" of the events of 1043 refers to Albanians in an ethnic sense or whether "Albanoi" is a reference to Normans from Sicily under an archaic name (there was also tribe of Italy by the name of "Albanoi"). However a later reference to Albanians from the same Attaliates, regarding the participation of Albanians in a rebellion in 1078, is undisputed.
1081年－1118年：Arbanitai of Arbanon are recorded in an account by Anna Comnena of the troubles in that region during the reign of her father Alexius I Comnenus by the Normans.
1190年：The Principality of Arbanon was created.
1200年：Local Albanian noble families began to emerge and Serbia occupies parts of northern Albania.
1204年：Fourth Crusade: Venice won control over most of Albania.
1204年：Fourth Crusade: The Byzantines regained control of the southern portion of Albania and established the Despotate of Epirus.
1258年：The Angevin Kingdom of Sicily seized the Albanian coast and much of the Epirus hinterland.
1272年：Forces allied to Angevin Charles I of Naples occupied Durrës and established the Kingdom of Albania.
1280年：Siege of Berat (1280–1281): An Angevin offensive against Constantinople was repulsed by the Byzantines.
1290年：Albania began to come under Serbian attack.
1304年：The Angevins recaptured the Kingdom of Albania.
1368年：Karl Thopia captured Durrës from the Angevins.
1385年：Thopia invited the Ottoman Empire to intervene against his rival Balsha II.
1389年6月15日：Battle of Kosovo: Albanians, as part of a Serbian-led Balkan army, were crushed by Ottoman forces.
1405年：George Kastrioti, later Skanderbeg, was born.
1430年：Gjon Kastrioti led an unsuccessful uprising against the Ottoman Empire.
1433年：Gjergj Arianiti rebelled against the Ottoman Empire with some success.
1443年：After being sent into battle near Niš, Skanderbeg entered Albania and embraced Roman Catholicism, marking the beginning of a long war against the Ottoman Empire.
1444年：Skanderbeg was proclaimed chief of the League of Lezhë.
1450年：The Albanians, led by Skanderbeg, routed Ottoman forces.
1466年：The Albanians, led by Skanderbeg, began the defense of Krujë against massive Ottoman armies.
1467年：The defense of Krujë ended.
1468年1月17日：Skanderbeg died.
1478年：Fourth Siege of Krujë (1478): Krujë fell to the Ottoman Empire, causing many Albanians to flee to southern Italy, Greece, Egypt, and elsewhere.
1479年：Shkodër fell to the Ottoman Empire in Fourth siege of Shkodra the Albanians were helped by Venice but still lost.
1700年：Some Albanians who converted to Islam found careers in the government and military services of the Ottoman Empire.
1700年：A mass conversion of Albanians began which would see some two-thirds of them become Muslims.
1785年：Kara Mahmud Bushati, an Albanian noble from the Bushati family based in Shkodër, attacked Montenegrin territory and was named governor of Shkodër by Ottoman authorities.
1800年：Most Albanian conversion to Islam came to an end.
1822年：Albanian leader Ali Pashë Tepelena was assassinated by Ottoman agents for promoting an autonomous state.
1830年：Five hundred Albanian leaders, accepting an invitation to meet with an Ottoman general in Monastir, were trapped and killed in an ambush.
1835年：The Ottoman Sublime Porte divided Albanian-populated lands into the Ottoman-administered vilayets of Janina and Rumelia.
1848年：Albanians rose up against the Tanzimat reforms.
1861年：The first school known to use the Albanian language in modern times opened in Shkodër.
1877年4月24日：Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878): The war began.
1878年3月3日：Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878): The Ottoman Empire was defeated by its rival Russian Empire, seriously weakening Ottoman power over Albanian-populated areas.
1878年6月10日：Albanian leaders meeting in Prizren formed the League of Prizren to advocate a unified Albania under Ottoman suzerainty.
1879年10月12日：The Society for Printing of Albanian Writings, composed of Roman Catholic, Muslim, and Eastern Orthodox Albanians, was founded in Constantinople.
1881年：Ottoman forces crushed Albanian resistance fighters at Prizren. The leaders of the League of Prizren and their families were arrested and deported.
1897年：Ottoman authorities disbanded a reactivated League of Prizren.
1906年：Albanians began joining the Committee of Union and Progress in the hope of gaining autonomy for their nation within the Ottoman Empire.
1908年：Albanian intellectuals meeting in Bitola chose the Latin alphabet as the standard script for the Albanian language.
1911年4月6日：Albanian Highlanders under Ded Gjo Luli defeated Ottoman forces in the town of Tuzi.
1912年5月：Albanians rose against Ottoman authority and seized Skopje.
1912年10月8日：First Balkan War: The war began, encouraging Albanian leaders to affirm the independence of their state.
1912年11月：Muslim and Christian delegates declared Albania independent at Vlorë and established a provisional government.
1912年12月：An ambassadorial conference in London gave half of Albanian territory to Serbia and Greece.
1913年5月30日：First Balkan War: The Treaty of London ended the war.
1913年6月29日：Second Balkan War: The war began.
1913年8月10日：Second Balkan War: The Treaty of Bucharest ended the war and recognized an independent Albanian state ruled by a constitutional monarchy.
1914年2月21日：William, Prince of Albania, of Wied was installed as head of the new Principality of Albania by the International Commission of Control.
1914年9月：World War I: The new Albanian state collapsed.
1918年11月11日：World War I: The war ended with Albanian territory divided under Italian, Serbian, Greek and French military occupation.
1918年12月：Albanian leaders met at Durrës to discuss presentation of Albanian interests at the upcoming Paris Peace Conference.
1919年1月：Serbia attacked Albania, forcing Albanians to adopt guerrilla warfare.
1919年6月：Paris Peace Conference, 1919: Albania was divided between Greece, Italy and Yugoslavia at the conference, which did not admit Albanian representation.
1920年1月：Albanian leaders meeting at Lushnjë rejected the partition of Albania, warned that Albanians would take up arms in defense of their territory, and created a bicameral parliament.
1920年2月：The Albanian government under Sulejman Delvina moved to the new capital Tirana.
1920年9月：Albania forced Italy to withdraw its troops and abandon territorial claims to almost all Albanian territory.
1920年12月：Albania was admitted to the League of Nations as a sovereign and independent state.
1921年11月：The Yugoslavian army invaded the Albanian territories they had not previously occupied.
1921年11月：A League of Nations commission forced a Yugoslavian withdrawal and reaffirmed the 1913 borders of Albania.
1921年12月：The Popular Party headed by Xhafer Bej Ypi formed a government, with the future King Zog of Albania acting as internal affairs minister.
1922年8月：Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople Patriarch Meletius IV of Constantinople recognized the Orthodox Autocephalous Church of Albania.
1922年9月：Zog became Prime Minister.
1923年：The Sunnis of Albania broke the last of their ties with the dissolving Ottoman Empire, pledging primary allegiance to their native country.
1924年3月：Zog's party won elections to the National Assembly.
1924年3月：Zog stepped down after a financial scandal and an assassination attempt.
1924年7月：A peasant-backed insurgency won control of Tirana, installed Fan S. Noli as Prime Minister and forced Zog of Albania to flee to Yugoslavia.
1924年12月：Zog, backed by the Yugoslavian army, returned to power and forced Noli to flee to Italy.
1925年5月：Italy began to penetrate Albanian public and economic life.
1926年11月27日：Italy and Albania signed the First Treaty of Tirana, guaranteeing Albanian boundaries and the political position of Zog.
1928年8月：Zog pressured the parliament to dissolve itself and called a constituent assembly which declared him King.
1931年：Zog refused to renew the First Treaty of Tirana despite Italian political and economic pressure.
1934年：Italy suspended economic support to Albania.
1935年：Italian Prime Minister Benito Mussolini renewed economic aid to Albania.
1939年3月17日：The German ambassador assured Mussolini of German support for an Italian invasion of Albania.
1939年3月25日：The Italian ambassador demanded that Albania become an Italian protectorate.
1939年4月：The Albanian army mobilized.
1939年4月5日：Leka, Crown Prince of Albania, the heir to the Albanian throne, was born.
1939年4月5日：Zog appealed to the democracies.
1939年4月6日：Zog appealed to the Balkan Pact.

1939年4月7日：Italian invasion of Albania: Fifty thousand Italian marines landed in the ports of Durrës, Vlorë, Shëngjin and Sarandë. See also: Albania under Italy, Albania under Nazi Germany, Albanian resistance during World War II
links: Albanian resistance during World War II

items.text: 1939年4月7日：Zog fled with his wife, Queen Géraldine Apponyi de Nagyappony, and their infant son Leka, to Greece.
1939年4月8日：Italian troops occupied Tirana.
1939年4月12日：A constituent assembly summoned in Tirana by pro-Italian notables approved a personal union with Italy.
1939年4月12日：Shefqet Bej Verlaci became Prime Minister and acting Head of State.
1939年4月14日：Albania withdrew from the League of Nations.
1939年4月16日：Italian King Victor Emmanuel III of Italy was crowned King of Albania.
1939年4月22日：Francesco Jacomoni di San Savino was appointed the viceroy of Albania.
1940年：The Albanian constitution was voided.
1940年：The Albanian Fascist Party was established.
1940年：The Albanian army was merged into the Italian army.
1940年10月28日：Greco-Italian War: The war began. The Italian army invaded Greece through Albania.
1941年4月：Invasion of Yugoslavia: Germany, Italy, Hungary, Bulgaria, Romania and the Croatian Ustaše invaded Yugoslavia.
1941年4月：Battle of Greece: Germany invaded Greece.
1941年4月：Axis occupation of Greece during World War II: Greece was partitioned between Germany, Italy and Bulgaria, with Italy occupying the bulk of the Greek mainland and most of the islands.
links: Axis occupation of Greece during World War II

items.text: 1941年10月：Josip Broz Tito, leader of the Communist Party of Yugoslavia, began to organize Albanian Communists.
1941年11月8日：The Albanian Communist Party was founded under First Secretary Enver Hoxha.
1941年12月3日：Mustafa Merlika-Kruja became Prime Minister.
1942年9月16日：Conference of Pezë: The National Liberation Movement (Albania) was established.
1942年10月：Noncommunist nationalist groups appeared to resist Italian occupation.
1943年8月：Italy signed the Armistice between Italy and Allied armed forces, dissolving much of its armed forces and loosening its hold over Albania.
links: Armistice between Italy and Allied armed forces

items.text: 1943年9月：German forces invaded and occupied Albania. The Albanian Kingdom became a German puppet state.
1944年1月：The National Liberation Movement, supplied with British weapons, gained control of southern Albania.
1944年5月：The Communists met to organize an Albanian government and appointed Hoxha chairman of the executive committee and supreme commander of the National Liberation Movement.
1944年7月：Communist forces enter central and northern Albania.
1944年10月：The Communists established a provisional government with Enver Hoxha as Prime Minister.
1944年11月：The Communists entered the capital in the wake of a German withdrawal.
1944年12月：The Communist provisional government adopted laws allowing state regulation of commercial enterprises and foreign and domestic trade.
1945年1月：The Communist provisional government agreed to restore Kosovo to Yugoslavia as an autonomous region.
1945年1月：The government began to condemn thousands of "war criminals" and "enemies of the people" to death or to prison, and to nationalize industry, transportation, forests, and pastures.
1945年4月：Yugoslavia recognized the government of Albania.
1945年8月：Sweeping agricultural reforms began under which about half of arable land was eventually redistributed to peasants from large landowners and most church properties were nationalized.
1945年8月：The United Nations Relief and Rehabilitation Administration began sending supplies to Albania.
links: United Nations Relief and Rehabilitation Administration

items.text: 1945年11月：The Soviet Union recognized the Albanian provisional government.
1945年11月：Britain and the United States made full diplomatic recognition of Albania conditional.
1945年12月：Elections for the People's Assembly were held in which only candidates from the Democratic Front (Albania) were on ballot.
1946年1月：The People's Assembly proclaimed the People's Republic of Albania, signalling the beginning of purges of noncommunists from positions of power.
1946年7月：A treaty of friendship and cooperation was signed with Yugoslavia, marking the beginning of a flow of Yugoslavian advisers and grain into Albania.
1946年10月26日：Corfu Channel Incident: Two British ships were destroyed by mines off the Albanian coast in the Straits of Corfu.
1946年11月：Albania broke diplomatic relations with the United States.

1947年：Corfu Channel Incident: United Nations Security Council Resolution 22 recommended that the International Court of Justice settle the dispute between the UK and Albania regarding the sinking of two British ships in the Straits of Corfu.
1947年4月：The Economic Planning Commission first drew up an economic plan with production targets for mining, manufacturing and agricultural enterprises.
1947年5月：Greek Civil War: A United Nations commission concluded that Albania, together with Bulgaria and Yugoslavia, supported Communist guerrillas.
1947年5月：Yugoslavian leaders launched a verbal offensive against anti-Yugoslavian Albanian Communists, including Hoxha, empowering the pro-Yugoslavian faction.
1947年7月：Albania refused to participate in the Marshall Plan of the United States.
1948年2月：Albanian Communist Party leaders began voting to merge the Albanian and Yugoslavian economies and militaries.
1948年3月：The measure to merge the Albanian and Yugoslavian economies and militaries passed.
1948年6月：The Cominform expelled Yugoslavia, triggering the souring of Albanian relations with that country.
1948年9月：Hoxha began purging high-ranking party members accused of Titoism.
1948年9月：Albania abrogated its treaty of friendship with Yugoslavia.
1948年9月：The Soviet Union began giving economic aid and sending advisers to Albania.
1948年11月：The first Party Congress changed the name of the Communist Party to the Party of Labour of Albania.
1949年1月：The regime issued a Decree on Religious Communities.
1949年2月：Albania joined the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance (Comecon), a free trade area separate from the rest of the world.
1949年12月：Albanian Communists thought to be supporters of Yugoslavian Prime Minister Tito were purged.
1950年：Britain and the United States begin inserting unsuccessful anticommunist Albanian guerrilla units into Albania.
1950年7月：A new constitution was approved by the People's Assembly, under which Hoxha became minister of defense and foreign minister.
1951年2月：Albania and the Soviet Union signed an agreement on mutual economic assistance.
1954年7月：Hoxha relinquished the post of Prime Minister to Mehmet Shehu but retained primary power as First Secretary of the Communist Party.
1955年5月：Albania became a founding member of the Warsaw Pact.

1956年2月：Communist Party of the Soviet Union chief Nikita Khrushchev delivered the speech "On the Personality Cult and its Consequences" in which he criticized his predecessor Joseph Stalin, and caused a chill in relations with Albania under the pro-Stalin Hoxha.
links: Communist Party of the Soviet Union
On the Personality Cult and its Consequences

items.text: 1959年：Large amounts of economic aid from the Soviet Union, Eastern European countries and China began pouring into Albania.
1959年5月：Khrushchev visited Albania.
1960年6月：Soviet–Albanian split: Albania sided with the People's Republic of China, causing the Soviet Union to dramatically curtail economic support.
1960年11月：Hoxha railed against Khrushchev and supported China during an international Communist conference in Moscow.
1961年2月：Hoxha harangued against the Soviet Union and Yugoslavia at Albania's Fourth Party Congress.

1961年12月：The Soviet Union broke diplomatic relations with Albania, spurring Eastern European Communist countries to severely reduce their Albanian contacts and Albania to improve its relationship with China.
1962年：The Albanian regime introduced an austerity program in an attempt to compensate for the withdrawal of Soviet economic support.
1962年：Albania became the spokesman for China at the UN.
1964年10月：Khrushchev was forced to resign, to the delight of Hoxha.
1966年2月：Hoxha initiated a Cultural and Ideological Revolution.
1966年3月：The Albanian Communist Party issued an "open letter" establishing an egalitarian wage and job structure for all workers.
1967年：The Hoxha regime began to conduct a violent campaign against religious life which would close or convert to other uses over two thousand religious buildings by the end of the year.
1968年8月：Warsaw Pact invasion of Czechoslovakia: Albania condemned the invasion and withdrew from the Warsaw Pact.
1976年9月：Chinese Communist Party Chairman Mao Zedong died, leading eventually to a cooling of relations with Albania known as the Sino-Albanian split.
1976年12月：A new constitution superseded the 1950 version and renamed Albania the Socialist People's Republic of Albania.
1977年：Top military officials were purged after a "Chinese conspiracy" was uncovered.
1978年7月：China terminated all economic and military aid to Albania.
1980年：Hoxha selected Ramiz Alia as the next party head, bypassing Mehmet Shehu.
1981年12月：Shehu died, either by his own hand or on the orders of Hoxha.
1982年11月：Alia became Chairman of the Presidium of the People's Assembly.
1983年：Hoxha began his retirement, leaving more administrative power to Alia.
1985年4月：Hoxha died.
1986年11月：Alia was featured as the undisputed leader of the country and Party at the Ninth Party Congress.
1987年8月：Greece ended the state of war.
1987年11月：Albania and Greece signed a series of long-term agreements.
1989年9月：Alia, addressing the Eighth Plenum of the Central Committee, signalled that radical changes to the economic system were necessary.
1990年1月：Demonstrations against the Ninth Plenum of the Central Committee at Shkodër forced authorities to declare state of emergency.
1990年4月：Alia declared his willingness to establish diplomatic relations with the Soviet Union and the United States.
1990年5月：Javier Pérez de Cuéllar, Secretary-General of the United Nations, visited Albania.

1990年5月：The regime announced its desire to join the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe with the passage of laws liberalizing the criminal code, reforming the court system, lifting some restrictions on freedom of worship, and guaranteeing the right to travel abroad.
links: Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe

items.text: 1990年7月：Young people demonstrated against the regime in Tirana, causing five thousand citizens to seek refuge in foreign embassies.
1990年7月：Albania and the Soviet Union signed a protocol normalizing relations.
1990年8月：The government abandoned its monopoly on foreign commerce and began to open Albania to foreign trade.
1990年9月：Alia addressed the United Nations General Assembly in New York City.
1990年10月：Tirana hosted the Balkan Foreign Ministers' Conference.
1990年10月：Ismail Kadare, Albania's most prominent writer, defected to France.
1990年12月：Alia met with university students demonstrating against his dictatorship.
1990年12月：The Thirteenth Plenum of the Central Committee of the Communist Party authorized a multiparty system.
1990年12月：The opposition Democratic Party of Albania was established.
1990年12月：A draft constitution was published.
1991年1月：The opposition newspaper Rilindja Demokratike began publishing.
1991年1月：Thousands of Albanians seek refuge in Greece.
1991年3月：Albania and the United States reestablished diplomatic relations.
1991年3月：Thousands of Albanians attempt to gain asylum in Italy.
1991年3月：Multiparty elections were held.
1991年4月：The elections came to a close. With 99 percent turnout the Communist Party won over 67 percent of vote for seats in the People's Assembly. The Albanian Democratic Party won about 30 percent.
1991年4月：The People's Assembly reelected Ramiz Alia to a new presidential term.

1991年4月：A reorganization replaced the Ministry of Internal Affairs with the Ministry of Public Order and placed the Frontier Guards and Directorate of Prison Administration under the Ministry of Defense and the Ministry of Justice, respectively.
1991年4月：The People's Assembly passed a Law on Major Constitutional Provisions providing for fundamental human rights and separation of powers, invalidating the 1976 constitution.
1991年4月：The People's Assembly appointed a commission to draft a new constitution.
1991年6月：Prime Minister Fatos Nano and his cabinet resigned in the face of trade unions call for general strike.
1991年6月：A coalition government led by Prime Minister Ylli Bufi took office.
1991年6月：The Tenth Congress of the Communist Party disbanded the party and established the new Socialist Party of Albania (SPA).
1991年6月：Albania was accepted as a full member of the OSCE Minsk Group.
1991年6月：United States Secretary of State James Baker visited Albania.
1991年7月：The Sigurimi was abolished and replaced by the National Information Service.
1991年8月：Up to eighteen thousand Albanians crossed the Adriatic Sea to unsuccessfully seek asylum in Italy.
