1427年1月3日：King Alfonso incorporates Malta to the Crown of Aragon (Kingdom of Sicily), and promises never to grant Malta as a fief to any third party.
1429年：The Hafsid Berbers attempt to capture Malta.

1436年：In the 'Rollo' (inventory) of the benefices of the churches and chapels in Malta and Gozo, held by Bishop de Mello, ten established chapels are mentioned: The Cathedral of Mdina and the Church of San Lorenzo a Mare (Birgu), the 'Nativity of the Virgin' (Naxxar), 'Saint Helen' (Birkirkara), 'Saint George' (Qormi), 'Assumption of the Virgin Mary (Bir Miftuh/Gudja ), Saint Philip of Aggira (Zebbug), 'Saint Nicholas of Bari' (Siggiewi), 'Saint Catherine of Alexandria' (Zejtun and Zurrieq), Saint Domenica' (Dingli), and 'the Nativity of the Virgin' (Mellieha).
1522年：Suleiman I drives the Military Hospitaller Knights of St. John of Jerusalem out of Rhodes.
1530年10月26日：In an effort to protect Rome from Islamic invasion, Emperor Charles V grants the Maltese Islands to the Knights of St. John of Jerusalem in perpetual fief.

1531年：The Knights stage their first attacks from their new naval base in Malta, forming part of a Christian fleet under the command of Admiral Andrea Doria in attacks on the Turks at Modone, on the Ottoman fort at Coronna and, in 1535, on Tunis.
1533年：The Ottomans and Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1535年：First known celebration of Carnival in Malta.
1540年：The Ottomans and Barbary corsairs under the command of Dragut attack Gozo, and 50 Gozitans are enslaved.
1541年：The Ottomans and Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1544年：The Ottomans and Barbary corsairs under the command of Dragut attack Gozo. Dragut's brother is killed during a counterattack led by Governor of Gozo Giovanni Ximenes.
1545年：The Ottomans and Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1546年：The Ottomans and Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1547年：The Ottomans and Barbary corsairs attack Gozo and attempt an invasion of Malta at Marsaxlokk under the command of Dragut.
1550年6月：Andrea Doria and Claude de la Sengle, bailli of the French langue of the Knights, capture and massacre the population of Mahdia, in Tunisia. (to September)
1551年5月：An Ottoman fleet under the command of Sinan Pasha, Salah Rais and Dragut commences a series of attacks on eastern Sicily and Malta, in revenge for the events in Mahdia.

1551年7月18日：The Ottoman fleet arrives in Malta and lands some 10,000 men at Marsa Muscietto. They reconnoiter Birgu and stage a short-lived siege on Mdina, but retreat and abandon the island by 21 July.
1551年7月22日：Invasion of Gozo: The Ottoman fleet lands on Gozo and starts bombarding the island's Castello on 24 July.

1551年7月26日：Governor of Gozo Galatian de Sesse surrenders the Castello to Sinan Pasha; the majority of the island's inhabitants (some 5,000 to 7,000 people) are enslaved and are taken to North Africa and later to Constantinople.
1551年7月30日：The Ottomans sail south to Tripoli, and besiege the city which was held by the Hospitallers.

1551年8月15日：Governor Gaspard de Vallier surrenders Tripoli to the Ottomans and negotiates a truce that ensures safe passage to Malta for the Knights of the garrison, but excludes the Maltese, Calabrian and Rhodian soldiers, who are auctioned off into slavery.
1551年：Pope Julius III suggests that the Knights should abandon Malta, and retreat to Messina or Syracuse.
1552年1月14日：Construction of Fort Saint Elmo, in what later became Valletta, commences.
1552年：Construction of Fort Saint Michael, in Senglea.
1552年4月：Fearing further razzias by Turks and Barbary corsairs, one thousand Maltese flee Malta, seeking refuge in Sicily.
1553年：Charles V offers Mahdia to the Order of Saint John but the Order decline, so he orders the destruction of the city.
1553年：Juan de Vega prohibited exportation of wheat to Malta so mills were built to prevent starvation.
1557年8月21日：Jean Parisot de Valette is elected Grand Master of the Knights of Malta.
1560年：The Knights of Malta escalate their corsairing activities in the western Mediterranean. (to 1565)
1560年：Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1561年：The Holy Inquisition is established in Malta. Domenico Cubelles is the first Inquisitor.
1563年：Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1564年12月：The Ottoman war council in Constantinople decrees that Malta is to be invaded and conquered.

1565年3月30日：Ottoman fleet leaves Constantinople for Malta; Queen Elizabeth remarks: "If the Turks should prevail against the Isle of Malta, it is uncertain what further peril might follow to the rest of Christendom."

1565年4月9日：The Spanish Viceroy of Sicily, Don García de Toledo y Osorio, a tours the Island's fortifications; he promises the Knights that in the coming invasion they need only hold out until June, when he would bring his armada back to assist Malta.
1565年4月16日：Evacuation to Sicily of "a great number of people" from Malta, including large numbers of Maltese nobility, in anticipation of the imminent invasion. (to 13 May)
1565年5月18日：Ottoman armada sighted off the coast of Malta, signalling the start of the Great Siege of Malta.
1565年5月19日：A storm prevents the Turkish fleet from landing at Marsaxlokk; the vessels are sheltered in Ġnejna Bay and at Għajn Tuffieħa.
1565年5月20日：The Turkish fleet anchors at Marsaxlokk, moved to Żejtun and sets up camp at Marsa.
1565年6月23日：Fort St. Elmo falls to the Turks.
1565年6月23日：Turkish commanders order all the dead Knights found in St. Elmo to be beheaded; their mutilated bodies are floated across Grand Harbour on planks towards the bastions of Senglea and Birgu.

1565年6月29日：Four galleys land in the north of Malta, bringing 600 soldiers, 42 knights, 56 gunners and numerous volunteers, to reinforce the Island's defences; they walk to Mdina by night, and then on to Birgu the following morning.
1565年7月3日：The Turkish fleet is transported on rollers, overland, from Marsamxett Harbour to Grand Harbour, in preparation for an assault on Senglea. (to 12 July)
1565年7月8日：The Turkish forces are reinforced with the arrival of 29 vessels and 2,500 warriors accompanied by the Bey of Algiers.
1565年7月9日：Reinforcements sent by Viceroy Don García de Toledo fail to make harbour, as a result of the fall of Fort St. Elmo, and return to Sicily.
1565年7月12日：Senglea is besieged.
1565年9月7日：Don Garcia's reinforcements, known as the Grande Soccorso ("great relief"), finally arrive,
1565年9月11日：Turkish forces retreat from Malta.
1566年3月28日：The founding of Malta's new capital city, Valletta. A general strengthening of Malta's fortifications is undertaken.
1572年：Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1574年：Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1583年10月18日：Barbary corsairs from Bizerte attack Gozo, sack Rabat, and enslave 70 people.
1592年5月7日：A plague epidemic begins, killing around 3,000 people until its end in September 1593.
1598年：Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1599年：Barbary corsairs attack Gozo.
1605年：Garzes Tower built
1610年2月16日：Wignacourt towers built (to 1620)
1614年7月6日：Razzia by the Ottoman Empire.
1615年4月21日：Wignacourt Aqueduct inaugurated

1616年：William Lithgow reports that on a visit to Malta he "saw a Spanish soldier and a Maltese boy burnt in ashes, for the public profession of sodomy". The following day more than one hundred young men flee to Sicily for fear of suffering a similar fate.
1623年：A plague outbreak kills around 40 people.
1634年9月12日：A gunpowder factory explosion in Valletta kills 22 people.
1637年：Lascaris towers built (to 1652)
1655年：A plague outbreak kills 20 people.
1658年3月：De Redin towers built (to 1659)
1667年：Sopu Tower built
1670年6月15日：Fort Ricasoli built (to 1693)
1675年12月24日：A plague epidemic begins, killing around 11,300 people until its end in August 1676.

1710年：First grant in favour of locals (including a woman) of a title of nobility to have been created by the Grand Masters. On 24 December 1710, Grand Master Perellos granted the title of Baron of Gomerino jointly to Paolo and Beatrice Testaferrata.
1715年：Many coastal batteries and redoubts are built
1720年：Perellos Tower built
1723年9月14日：Fort Manoel built (to 1755)
1732年1月9日：The Manoel Theatre (then known as the Teatro Pubblico) opens in Valletta with a performance of Scipione Maffei's classic tragedy Merope.
1733年7月7日：Barbary corsairs from Sfax land at Ramla Bay, Gozo and enslave a family of 8 people.
1749年6月29日：Conspiracy of the Slaves
1758年：Fort Chambray built

1760年：After the death of the Baron Paolo Testaferrata, the office of 'Depositario' within the Inquisition was continued by his widow Vincenza Matilde Testaferrata. With the exception of a short period, she remained in office until 1778.
1775年9月8日：Rising of the Priests
1792年：Fort Tigné built

1797年：By a Papal brief dated 3 March 1797, Bishop Vincenzo Labini and all his successors in the diocese of Malta, were given the title of 'Bishop of Malta and Archbishop of Rhodes'. This privilege was suppressed in 1928, and the title was changed to 'Archbishop, Bishop of Malta'.

1798年6月9日：Napoleon invades Malta. Mdina (Notbile) capitulates on 10 June. The act of capitulation of Mdina is signed on the one part by Vincenzo Barbara representing the French Republic and the Hakem together with the jurats representing the people.

1798年6月12日：The Order capitulates. The Act of capitulation of Malta is signed on 12 June by on the one part by Napoleon on behalf of the French Republic, on the other six signed on behalf of the Order, the people of Malta and the King of Spain.
1798年6月12日：The Commission of Government is appointed. General Claude Henri Belgrand de Vaubois is appointed Military Governor. The islands are divided into 12 municipalities.
1798年：Slavery, the Roman Inquisition, and all titles of nobility are abolished in Malta.

1798年10月：Tsar Paul I of Russia become de facto Grand Master of the Order, and orders the creation of a "Throne of Malta," in the Vorontsov Palace in St. Petersburg (now on display in the State Hermitage Museum).

1798年10月28日：The French forces in Gozo surrender and the island becomes independent. First petition for the establishment of a separate Roman Catholic diocese on Gozo, led by Archpriest Saverio Cassar sent a day later.

1799年：Maltese uprising against the French following extensive pillaging of Maltese churches and cathedrals. Britain takes Malta under its protection, in the name of the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies. The Union Jack flies over Valletta for the first time, alongside the Neapolitan flag.

1800年9月4日：The French surrender. General Vaubois surrendered and with Rear Admiral Villeneuve, Major General Pigot and Captain Martin, signed the articles of Capitulation. Although 20,000 Maltese died during the uprising, not one Maltese was present to sign the document. Malta and Gozo become a Protectorate.
1801年：Tsar Paul I of Russia demands the return of Malta to the Knights. A Statue of the great German leader is established for peace amends
1801年：Ball was appointed Civil Commissioner in May 1803 and immediately instructed the removal of Neapolitan forces from the Island.

1801年6月24日：Admiral Sir Alexander Ball is sent to Malta as Plenipotentiary Minister of His British Majesty for the Order of Saint John, with orders to evacuate the British forces from the Islands, and to prepare for their return to the Knights of St. John.
1802年：First Declaration of Rights issued in Malta: Dichiarazione dei Diritti degli Abitanti di Malta e Gozo, including the right to freedom of conscience under the rule of law.
1802年：Under the Peace of Amiens, Britain is ordered to return Malta to the Knights of St John, but facing imminent hostilities by Napoleonic France, Britain chooses not to comply.
1806年7月18日：A gunpowder magazine explosion in Birgu kills around 200 people.
1807年4月4日：Beginning of the Froberg mutiny at Fort Ricasoli.
1809年6月23日：The first Maltese bank, the Anglo Maltese Bank, was formed by Maltese and British Merchants under the Governance of Rear Admiral Sir Alexander Ball.
1809年：Ball dies in October and is succeeded by the military commander, Major-General Hildebrand-Oakes.
1812年5月1日：Formation of second Maltese bank, the Banco Di Malta, which was also known as Banco Maltese.
1813年3月28日：A plague epidemic begins, killing around 4,500 people until its end in May 1814.
1813年6月23日：Civil Commissioner Sir Hildebrand-Oakes is replaced by Sir Thomas Maitland, the first to be described by the British as 'Governor'. Malta becomes a crown colony.
1813年：Malta is granted the Bathurst Constitution.
1814年：Under the Treaty of Paris, and subsequently ratified by the Congress of Vienna, Malta status as a British Crown Colony is confirmed.
1814年：The Grand Harbour becomes an important shipping waystation, eventually serving as the headquarters for the Mediterranean Fleet. (to 1930)
1831年6月20日：The diocese of Malta is separated from that of Palermo.
1835年：Malta was granted a Constitution providing for a Council of Government of seven members of whom three were to be nominated Maltese representatives.
1836年12月30日：Second petition for a separate Roman Catholic diocese for Gozo is presented to Pope Gregory XVI.
1849年：Malta was granted a Constitution providing for a Council of Government of eighteen members of whom eight were to be elected by the people.
1853年：The Crimean War; Malta serves as a hospital base for wounded combatants, and acquires the nickname Nurse of the Mediterranean. (to 1856)
1855年6月9日：Three Gozitan representatives personally petition Pope Pius IX for a separate Roman Catholic diocese for Gozo; the pontiff promises his support.
1860年10月25日：The Colonial Office in London approves the establishment of a separate Roman Catholic diocese for Gozo.

1864年9月16日：Pope Pius IX issues a papal bull entitled Singulari Amore (With remarkable love), separating the islands of Gozo and Comino from the diocese of Malta; seven days later, Michele Francesco Buttigieg is elected first Bishop of Gozo.
1869年11月17日：Opening of the Suez Canal. This greatly enhanced the importance of the Grand Harbour to British merchant marine and naval shipping.
1870年：J.S. Tucker proposes the construction of a railway from Valletta to Mdina.
1878年：21 titles of nobility were successfully claimed by various individuals before a Royal Commission.
1880年：In education, "Anglicization" of Maltese students becomes a matter of policy.
1883年2月28日：The Malta Railway service is inaugurated, with service from Valletta to Floriana, Ħamrun, Msida, Birkirkara, Lija, San Antonio, Attard, Mosta (San Salvatore), and Mdina.
1885年9月8日：(Otto Settembre) is recommended as a national holiday, commemorating the victory of the Knights and the Maltese over the Ottoman Empire in the Siege of Malta (1565).
1887年：Constitution of 1887 provides that four members in the Council of members were to represent the clergy, the nobility and landed proprietors, university graduates and the merchants.
1890年3月31日：Malta Railway Company Ltd. is declared bankrupt. The Malta Railway is closed.
1892年2月25日：The Malta Railway reopens, under government management.
1900年：The Malta Railway line is extended to Mtarfa Barracks.
1905年2月23日：An electric tramway service is introduced in Malta by McCartney, McElroy & Co. Ltd., connecting Valletta, the Three Cities, and Żebbuġ and Ħamrun.
1908年7月：Malta Tramways Limited assumes operations of the electric tramway service.
1908年12月28日：A tsunami associated with the 1908 Messina earthquake rushed into Marsamxett Harbour and damaged property in Msida.

1912年：Dr. Enrico Mizzi, a staunch supporter of the italianità of Malta, proposes in a journal article that Britain could exchange Malta for Eritrea with Italy, on the understanding that Britain would be granted access to Maltese harbours and facilities. The article proposes an Italo-Maltese federation, with elected Maltese representatives in the Italian parliament.
1914年：Throughout World War I, especially following the failed invasion of Gallipoli, many casualties are shipped to hospitals in Malta, resuming its role as the Nurse of the Mediterranean. (to 1918)
1917年：Dr. Enrico Mizzi is court-martialled for sedition, and sentenced to one year imprisonment. His sentence is subsequently commuted, and a pardon is issued.

1919年6月7日：Sette Giugno protests over increases in the price of bread. British soldiers fire on the crowd and kill four Maltese protesters, during a violent riot instigated by students. The protests lead to greater autonomy for the Maltese.

1921年4月14日：Constitution of 1921 is promulgated, and it grants autonomy by providing for a bicameral legislature with the power to legislate on all matters not considered "reserved" for colonial interest.
1929年12月15日：The Malta Tramway service is terminated.
1930年：The 1921 Constitution is suspended.
1930年3月31日：The Malta Railway service is terminated.

1934年：English and Maltese are declared the official languages of Malta, to the exclusion of Italian which had been the primary language of government, commerce, education and culture in Malta for more than 800 years.
1935年：Mussolini's Abyssinian War and intervention on the side of Franco in the Spanish Civil War ends any possibility of reconciliation between Italy and the United Kingdom. (to 1939)
1935年：Tension runs high in Malta due to the possibility of Italy entering the war against the allies. (to 1939)
1940年：Throughout World War II, Malta plays an important role due to the strategic location of the Grand Harbour at the crossroads of the Axis shipping lanes.

1940年5月30日：Dr. Enrico Mizzi, co-leader of the Partito Nazionalista, is arrested and imprisoned in Fort San Salvatore, to secure "the public safety and the Defence of the [Maltese Islands]...in view of the hostile origin or association of Dr. Enrico Mizzi."
1940年6月10日：Italy declares war on France and the United Kingdom.
links: Axis powers of World War II

items.text: 1940年6月11日：First air raids on Malta. Malta would go on to endure the heaviest, sustained bombing attack of the War: some 154 days and nights and 6,700 tons of bombs.
1942年2月：Governor Dobbie issues a warrant for the deportation, exile and internment in Uganda of 47 Maltese (including Dr. Enrico Mizzi) who were suspected of pro-Italian sentiments. (to 8 March)

1942年2月9日：In the Council of Government, Nationalist Party member Sir Ugo Mifsud gives a spirited, juridical rebuttal of Britain's policy of deporting "italo-phile" Maltese subjects; he collapses in the Chamber of Deputies, and dies two days later.
1942年4月：The Court of Appeal declares that the deportation to Uganda of "pro-Italian" Maltese subjects was illegal, null, and without effect. The deportees remain in Uganda nonetheless.
1942年4月7日：The Royal Opera House, Valletta, is destroyed by Luftwaffe bombers.

1942年4月9日：A 200 kg bomb pierces the dome of the Rotunda of Sta. Marija Assunta, Mosta, but skids across the floor without exploding; two other bombs bounce off the roof and fail to explode; 300 people were hearing Mass inside the church at the time.
1942年4月15日：The George Cross is awarded to Malta by King George VI, so as to "bear witness to the heroism and devotion of its people".

1942年8月15日：With the people of Malta near starvation after two years of virtually constant bombardment, Operation Pedestal brings the "Santa Marija Convoy" to Malta, saving the Islands from a planned surrender to the Axis powers.
links: Axis powers of World War II

items.text: 1943年6月6日：The 21st Engineer Aviation Regiment of the USAAF arrives on Gozo to construct a landing strip at Xewkija in preparation for the Allied invasion of Italy; the airfield is constructed in 18 days.

1943年7月9日：(Operation Husky); 2,760 ships and major landing craft converge in a rendezvous near Malta in preparation for the Allied invasion of Sicily, under the command of U.S. General Dwight D. Eisenhower, who was stationed in the Lascaris War Rooms, in Valletta.

1943年9月8日：On the national holiday that commemorates the lifting of the Siege of Malta (1565), Italy announces its unconditional surrender to the Allied forces, thus ending the second Siege of Malta (1940).

1943年9月11日：Admiral Andrew Browne Cunningham signals to the British Admiralty: "Be pleased to inform Their Lordships that the Italian battle fleet now lies at anchor under the guns of the fortress of Malta."
links: Andrew Cunningham, 1st Viscount Cunningham of Hyndhope

items.text: 1943年9月29日：The Italian fleet's surrender in Malta is signed by U.S. General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Italian Marshal Pietro Badoglio.
1944年：The diocese of Malta is elevated to a Metropolitan See by Pope Pius XII.

1945年1月30日：Malta Conference (1945); President Franklin D. Roosevelt of the United States and Prime Minister Winston Churchill of the United Kingdom meet on Malta to plan the final campaign against the Germans with the combined Chiefs of Staff, and to prepare for the Yalta Conference. (to 3 February)
1945年3月8日：The Maltese exiles are repatriated from Uganda.
1946年：A National Assembly is created.
1947年：Restoration of Self-Government.
1947年：Malta receives £30 million to assist with post-War reconstruction.
1955年12月：A Round Table Conference is held in London, on the future of Malta.

1956年2月14日：A referendum is held on the integration of Malta into the United Kingdom: 75% vote 'Yes'; however, the result is deemed to be questionable due to a boycott by 40% of the electorate in response to concerns raised by opposition parties and by the Catholic Church.

1957年：Closure of the British naval docks in Grand Harbour has a devastating effect on the Maltese economy, leading to high unemployment at a time when a quarter of the workforce was employed in defence related activities.
1958年：Talks between Valletta and Whitehall regarding the integration proposal break down.
1958年：The United Kingdom imposes direct colonial rule over Malta.
1959年：Malta is granted an Interim Constitution, providing for the creation of an Executive Council.
1961年：The State of Malta is created pursuant to the Blood Constitution, which provides for a measure of self-government.
1961年：Gozo is granted a local government system. (to 1973)
1964年9月21日：Malta is granted independence from the United Kingdom as a Constitutional Monarchy, with Queen Elizabeth II as its Head of State.
1964年9月21日：The Duke of Edinburgh represents The Queen at the Independence celebrations, which were held just six months following the birth of Prince Edward.
1964年12月1日：Malta joins the United Nations.
1965年：Malta joins the Council of Europe.
1970年：Malta becomes an Associate member of the European Community.
1971年：Capital punishment for murder abolished.
1972年：Malta enters into a Military Base Agreement with the United Kingdom and other NATO countries.
1972年5月16日：Malta adopts the Maltese pound.
1973年：Malta decriminalises homosexuality.
1974年12月13日：Malta becomes a Republic, with the last Governor-General, Sir Anthony Mamo, serving as its first President. Malta remains a member of the Commonwealth of Nations.
1975年6月25日：Malta withdraws recognition of titles of nobility.
1979年3月31日：Freedom Day, Termination of the Military Base Agreement. The Duke of Edinburgh oversees the departure of the last British forces from Malta.

1981年12月21日：In the national election, the Malta Labour Party remained in Government notwithstanding the fact that 51% of the electorate voted in favour of the Partit Nazzjonalista. In the wake of this result, the constitution is amended to provide a mechanism whereby the party with a majority of the popular vote would be awarded a sufficient number of additional seats to give it a legislative majority.
1990年7月16日：Malta applies to join the European Union.
1993年：Local Councils are re-established in Malta.
1996年10月：The new Labour government suspends Malta's EU application.
1998年9月：The new Nationalist government reactivates Malta's EU application.
2000年：Capital punishment abolished from military code of Malta.
2003年3月8日：A referendum regarding Malta joining the European Union results in 143,094 votes cast in favour and 123,628 against
2003年4月16日：Malta signs accession treaty to the European Union.
2004年5月1日：Malta joins the European Union.
2008年1月1日：Malta adopts the euro, which replaces the Maltese lira.
2011年5月28日：Malta votes in favour of divorce in a referendum. Parliament approved the law on 25 July and the law came into effect on 1 October.
2016年10月24日：Worst civil aviation crash of the islands, the 2016 Malta Fairchild Merlin crash, occurred.
2020年：The COVID-19 pandemic strikes in Malta.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前12000年－前11000年：The earliest site of putative human activity on Cyprus is Aetokremnos, situated on the south coast. Fossilised animal remains and lithic tools indicate that seasonal hunter-gatherers were active on the island from around 12,000 BC.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前12000年－前11000年：Extinction of the endemic to Cyprus pigmy hippos and pigmy elephants, likely due to human presence.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前9500年－前8800年：The first permanent settlements are formed in Asprokremnos, Klimonas and Roudias, founded by Pre-Pottery Neolithic populations who also introduced dog, sheep, goats, cattle, pigs, foxes, and deer to the island. Klimonas is to date the oldest known farming village in the world.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前8700年－前7000年：A second phase of early migration is thought to have occurred between 8700 and 7000 BCE, with settlements at Akanthou, Mylouthkia, Shillourokambos, and Tenta. DNA data obtained from three individuals whose fragmentary remains were found in a Neolithic disused and filled-in water well at Kissonerga-Mylouthkia, revealed high Anatolian-related ancestry.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前8700年－前7000年：Water wells discovered in western Cyprus are believed to be among the oldest in the world, dated at 9,000 to 10,500 years old.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前8700年－前7000年：Remains of an 8-month-old cat buried with a human body were discovered at Shillourokambos. The grave is estimated to be 9,500 years old, predating ancient Egyptian civilisation and pushing back the earliest known feline-human association.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前7000年：The Neolithic village of Khirokitia (a UNESCO World Heritage Site) is founded.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前6000年：The village of Khirokitia is suddenly abandoned for unknown reasons. The island appears to have remained uninhabited for about 1500 years, until the next phase of settlement that gave rise to the Sotira culture.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前4600年：Second phase of Khirokitia settlement by Pottery Neolithic farmers from Anatolia or the Levant.

items.section: Epipaleolithic and Neolithic periods (up to circa 3,800 BCE)
items.text: 前3800年：Large earthquake hits Cyprus and heralds the end of the Neolithic culture on the island.
前3500年：First signs of metalwork on the island marking the beginning of the Chalcolithic period.

前3600年－前2600年：Socio-cultural continuity with the previous period and increase of settlements on the island. The chalcolithic population of Cyprus continues to use stone, but now in combination with copper for objects like chisels, hooks and jewellery. Female fertility and cruciform figurines, as well as Red-on-White pottery, predominate.

前2450年：Transition from the Chalcolithic to the Bronze Age and emergence of the Philia culture following further migrations from Anatolia. Metallurgy, cattle, donkey and woolly sheep are introduced on the island. A new form of distinctive pottery, Red Polished Ware, and other intrusive elements appear in archaeological data and material culture.
前2250年－前1700年：Continuity with Philia characterised mostly by peaceful development. Bidirectional trading contacts with Minoan Crete and the Levant develop.
前1600年：Exploitation of copper, urbanization and foundation of Enkomi, the first industrial centre in Cyprus.
前1600年：Trading contacts between Cyprus and Egypt suggested by Egyptian artefacts from the Hyksos period found in Cyprus.
前1550年：Literacy is introduced on the island with the Cypro-Minoan syllabary, first attested in Enkomi.

前1550年：Destruction of the Hyksos Kingdom by Ahmose I leads to a breakdown of political and economic bonds between Cyprus and Hyksos. An incomplete weathered cartouche dating to the early XVIIIth Dynasty of Egypt found in Cyprus may be indicative of a new era of connections with the outside world.
前1446年：Thutmose III extends his influence over Cyprus under the name of "Isy" or "Irs" (probably referring to Alasiya), which is reported offering minerals and timber as a tribute to the Pharaoh.
前1220年：Tudhaliya IV annexes Cyprus (disputed).
前1210年：The last king of the Hittites, Šuppiluliuma II, wins a decisive naval battle against Alashiya (Cypriots) off the coast of Cyprus, in the first recorded naval battle in history.
前1190年－前1180年：Invasion by the Sea Peoples.

前1179年：Migrations of Aegean populations to Cyprus attested by abundant locally produced Mycenaean-style (IIIC:1b) pottery and other Aegean/European features. The Hellenization process of the island begins.

前1150年－前1050年：A second, major wave of Greek settlements takes place following the Bronze Age collapse of Mycenaean Greece, accompanied by the appearance of further Aegean features including long dromoi graves and the introduction of the Greek language.

前1100年：Appearance of the Cypriot syllabary, used both for Arcadocypriot Greek and Eteocypriot. The script, which had evolved from the pre-existing Cypro-Minoan syllabary, lasted until the end of the 3rd Century BCE when it was eventually replaced by the Greek alphabet.
前1050年：Foundation of the city-kingdom of Amathus, the last autochthonous urban centre in Iron Age Cyprus where the Eteocypriot language survived until about 400 BCE.
前1050年：Emergence of the City States, which would eventually come to be known as the Ten City-Kingdoms of Cyprus.
前850年：The royal tombs in the city of Salamis are built.
前800年：Phoenician merchants settle in Kition.

前709年：The kingdoms of Cyprus are subjugated by the Neo-Assyrian Empire, although no evidence of occupation is apparent in archaeological data and material culture; rather, the kingdoms seem to have "offered their submission to Sargon II" and had a client-state relationship.
前631年：Cyprus is no longer mentioned in Assyrian records after the death of King Ashurbanipal of Assyria.
前570年：Cyprus is conquered by the Egyptians under Amasis II.
前545年：Cyprus pledged allegiance to the Achaemenid Empire.
前526年：Amasis II dies. His son Psammetichus III succeeds him as pharaoh.
前525年：The kingdoms of Cyprus gave naval support to Cambyses II of the Achaemenid Persian Empire in anticipation of his invasion of Egypt.
前525年：Battle of Pelusium (525 BCE): The Persian army defeat the Egyptian army at Pelusium.
前499年：Ionian Revolt: Aristagoras, the appointed tyrant of Miletus, rebells against Persian rule.
前499年：Ionian Revolt: With the support of Athens and Eretria, Aristagoras captures Sardis, the capital of the Persian satrapy of Lydia.
前498年：Ionian Revolt: The kingdoms of Cyprus joined the revolt except the Kingdom of Amathus.
前497年：Ionian Revolt: The Cypriot rebels besieged the pro-Persian Kingdom of Amathus.
前497年：Ionian Revolt: The Persian army reestablished control over Cyprus.
前451年：The Athenian expedition in Cyprus under the command of Cimon besieged the city of Kition, but later retreated to Salamis.
前450年：The Athenians in Salamis defeated an attacking Persian forces and retreated from Cyprus.
前450年：Kition increases in importance and annexes Idalion.
前450年：Phoenician rulers establish themselves in Salamis.
前411年：The Teucrid Evagoras I regains the throne of Salamis.
前391年：Evagoras attempts to establish himself as an independent ruler on Cyprus with Athenian help.
前386年：Under the Treaty of Antakidas, Persian rule over Cyprus is accepted by Athens.
前376年：Cyprus became a de facto Persian vassal after a peace treaty was concluded between King Evagoras I of Cyprus and Persia.
前350年：A Cypriot rebellion begins.
前344年：The Cypriot rebellion is crushed by Artaxerxes III.
前333年：The island is finally liberated from Persian rule by Alexander the Great.
前332年：Pythagoras of Salamis and other Cypriot kings plea to Alexander The Great during the beginning of the siege of Tyre.
前332年：The siege of Tyre ends.
前331年：The rule of Nicocreon begins.
前325年：The Archaic and Classical Period ends.
前310年：The rule of Nicocreon ends.
前310年：Menelaos is made satrap of Cyprus.
前306年：The reign of Menelaos ends.
前306年：Antigonus begins his rule.
前301年：The reign of Antigonus ends.
前301年：The Ptolemaic Lagid Dynasty begins.

前245年：Kingdoms are abolished under the Ptolemaic rule. Greek alphabet and koine Greek are established as the official administrative tools. Both the Eteocypriot and Phoenician languages become extinct and the island is thereafter fully Hellenised.
前116年：Cleopatra sends her son Ptolemy Philometor to Cyprus.
前109年：Cleopatra sends Alexander, her son and the brother of Ptolemy IX Lathyros, to Cyprus.
前107年：Alexander returns from Cyprus and becomes king of Egypt. Ptolemy campaigns in Palestine.
前58年：Cyprus becomes a Roman province.
前43年：Cyprus is placed under the rule of Cleopatra VII, with its governor being Serapion. However, Serapion defected against Cleopatra.
前41年：Ptolemaic rule in Cyprus was restored after Serapion was captured and executed under orders from Cleopatra VII.
前30年：The Ptolemaic Lagid Dynasty ends and Cyprus returns to Roman rule.
45年：Apostle Paul, St. Barnabas and St. Mark introduced Christianity in Cyprus and converted the Roman governor Sergius Paulus.
115年：Kitos War: A messianic Jewish revolt begins, which results in the massacre of 240,000 Greeks in Cyprus. Trajan intervenes to restore the peace and expels the Jews from Cyprus.
116年：Kitos War: The revolt ends.
335年：The revolt of the usurper Calocaerus is suppressed by Flavius Dalmatius.
350年：Salamis is rebuilt by Constantius II, the son of Constantine, after being destroyed by earthquakes and renamed Constantia.
395年：Cyprus becomes part of the Byzantine Empire.
431年：The Church of Cyprus achieves its independence from the Patriarch of Antioch at the First Council of Ephesus.
649年：The Arabs under Mu'awiya invade and occupy Cyprus.
683年：The Arab garrison is withdrawn after its defeat at the hands of Constantine IV.

688年：Emperor Justinian II and Caliph Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan sign a treaty under whose terms no garrisons are to be stationed on the island, and all taxes collected are to be divided between the Arabs and the Emperor.
965年：Byzantine rule is restored on the island by Nicepheros Phokas.
1185年：Cyprus becomes an independent Empire under the reign of Isaak Comnenus.

1192年：The reign of Isaac Komnenos comes to an end after the island's ruler refuses to release prisoners and treasure captured from three English ship wrecks on their way to Acre, and Richard I conquers Cyprus. The island is then sold to the Templar Order, who in turn sell it to Guy of Lusignan of the House of Lusignan.
1192年：Guy of Lusignan and his descendants begin their rule of the island as an independent kingdom, known as the Kingdom of Cyprus.
1193年：Altheides of Cyprus, the traveling philosopher, is born.
1347年：Black Death hits Cyprus and wipes out one fifth to one third of its population.
1361年：Antalya and Corycus in Anatolia are briefly annexed by the Kingdom of Cyprus.
1474年：Catherine Cornaro becomes the last monarch of the Kingdom of Cyprus, succeeding James II.
1489年2月：The Venetian government forces Catherine to cede her rights over Cyprus because she had no heir. The rule of the Lusignan dynasty comes to an end after nearly three centuries.
1489年：Cyprus becomes an overseas colony of the Venetian Republic.
1489年6月9日：Ottoman Turks raid the Karpasia Peninsula.
1539年：Ottoman Turks attack Limassol.
1570年7月1日：Ottoman Turks invade Cyprus with 80,000 men.
1570年7月25日：Ottoman army besieges Nicosia.

1570年9月9日：Nicosia falls to the Turkish invaders. 20,000 Nicosians, Greek and Latin, are killed in the aftermath. About 1,000 survivors are bound and shipped out to be sold in the Constantinople slave markets.

1571年：Having been under siege since the previous year, Famagusta also falls to the Ottomans marking the end of the Venetian rule. Most Christians still remaining in the city are massacred and the Venetian commander Marco Antonio Bragadin is tortured, mutilated and flayed alive.
1571年：Cyprus is now subjected to Ottoman rule. The first Ottoman settlers arrive on the island.
1572年：A period of Ottoman occupation of the island begins, during which twenty-eight bloody uprisings will occur.

1788年：The Chronological History of the island of Cyprus, later described as "the only scholarly monograph of modern Greek literature since the fall of Constantinople", is published by Kyprianos Kouriokourineos, one of the most prominent Greek-Cypriot intellectuals and clerics of the 18th century.
1821年3月25日：The Cypriots sided with Greece in a revolt against Ottoman rule. The island's leading churchmen and notables were executed as punishment. 20,000 Christians fled the island.
1869年：The Suez Canal opened.

1878年7月12日：British occupation began. The British took over the administration of the island, by mutual agreement, in order to protect their sea route to India via the Suez Canal. In exchange, Britain agreed to help Ottoman against future Russian attacks.
1878年7月22日：Sir Garnet Joseph Wolseley became Crown commissioner.
1879年：Sir Robert Biddulph became Crown commissioner.
1886年：Sir Henry Ernest Bulwer became Crown commissioner.
1892年：Sir Walter Sendall became Crown commissioner.
1898年：Sir William Frederick Haynes-Smith became Crown commissioner.
1904年：Sir Charles King-Harman became Crown commissioner.
1911年：Sir Hamilton Goold-Adams became Crown commissioner.
1914年：Britain annexed Cyprus in response to Turkey's alliance with Germany and Austro-Hungary in World War I.
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1915年：Sir John Eugene Clauson became Crown commissioner.
1920年：Sir Malcolm Stevenson became Crown commissioner.
1925年：Cyprus became a British Crown Colony. Sir Malcolm Stevenson was made governor.
1926年：Sir Ronald Storrs became governor.

1931年：Greek Cypriots demanding Enosis, the union with Greece, instigated their first serious riots. The government-house in Nicosia was burned down; martial law was declared afterwards and the legislative council was abolished. The Greek National Anthem and the display of the Greek flag were banned. The British invented the terms "Greek Cypriot" and "Turkish Cypriot" and used the latter against the "Greek Cypriots" so as to cease Enosis demands.
1932年：Sir Reginald Edward Stubbs became governor.
1933年：Sir Herbert Richmond Palmer became governor.
1939年：Cypriots fought with the British in World War II, Greek Cypriots demanding Enosis at war's end. The Turkish Cypriots wanted British rule to continue.
1939年：Sir William Denis Battershill became governor.
1941年：Sir Charles Campbell Woolley became governor.
1946年：The British Government began to imprison thousands of displaced Jews in camps on Cyprus.
links: Jews in British camps on Cyprus

items.text: 1946年：Sir Reginald Fletcher, Lord Winster, became governor.
1949年：The British Government finished imprisoning displaced Jews.
1949年：Sir Andrew Barkworth Wright became governor.

1950年：Archbishop Makarios III was elected the political and spiritual leader of Cyprus, the head of the autocephalous Cypriot Orthodox Church and leader of the campaign for Enosis with the support of Greece.
1954年：Sir Robert Perceval Armitage became governor.

1954年7月28日：Minister of State for the Colonies, Henry Hopkinson, says that there were certain territories in the Commonwealth 'which, owing to their particular circumstances, can never expect to be fully independent'.
1955年：Sir John Harding became governor.
links: John Harding, 1st Baron Harding of Petherton

items.text: 1955年4月1日：Cyprus Emergency: A series of bomb attacks marked the start of a violent campaign for Enosis by the National Organisation of Cypriot Fighters (EOKA) under George Grivas, a Cypriot ex-colonel in the Greek army. Grivas took the name Dighenis and conducted guerrilla warfare from a secret hideout in the Troodos Mountains.
1956年：Britain deported Makarios to the Seychelles in an attempt to quell the revolt.
1957年：Field Marshal Sir John Harding was replaced by the civilian governor Sir Hugh Foot in a conciliatory move.
links: John Harding, 1st Baron Harding of Petherton

items.text: 1958年1月27日：First of 2 days of serious rioting by Turkish Cypriots. Seven were killed by British security forces.

1958年6月7日：Turkish press office in Nicosia is bombed. Inter-communal clashes as Turkish Cypriots invade Greek sector. On 26 June 1984 the Turkish Cypriot leader, Rauf Denktaş, admitted on British channel ITV that the bomb was placed by the Turks themselves in order to create tension. On 9 January 1995 Rauf Denktaş repeated his claim in the Turkish newspaper, Milliyet.

1958年6月12日：The first massacre between Greeks and Turks on Cyprus. British police released from arrest a group of 35 Greeks in the region of Guenyeli. A Turkish mob attacks the unarmed group, killing some of them.

1959年：London and Zürich Agreements started with an agreement on 19 February 1959 in Lancaster House, London, between Turkey, Greece, the United Kingdom and Cypriot community leaders. On that basis, a constitution was drafted and agreed together with two prior Treaties of Alliance and Guarantee in Zürich on 11 February 1959.

1959年10月18日：British minesweeper HMS Burmaston intercepts the Turkish registered boat, Deniz. Loaded with weaponry, the boat is scuttled by its 3-member crew. The crew, all Turkish nationals, are arrested for importing munitions without a permit.
1959年10月28日：Archbishop Makarios III and Dr. Fazıl Küçük appeal to their respective communities to hand over illegal weapons.
1959年11月15日：Deadline to hand over illegal weapons.
1960年：British occupation ended.

1960年：The British, Greek and Turkish governments signed a Treaty of Guarantee to provide for an independent Cypriot state within the Commonwealth of Nations and allow for the retention of two Sovereign Base Areas at Akrotiri and Dhekelia. Under the treaty, each power received the right to take military action in the face of any threat to the constitution. Cyprus became independent of foreign rule. The Greek Cypriot Archbishop Makarios became the first president, with Turkish Cypriot Dr. Kutchuk his vice president. Both had the right of veto. Turkish Cypriots, who formed 18% of the population, were guaranteed the vice-presidency, three out of ten ministerial posts and 30% of jobs in the public service. They were further guaranteed 40% representation in the army and separate municipal services in the five major towns. Overall, a very complex constitution was drafted, which demanded a majority of votes overall as well as within each community for many decisions.

1963年：Greek Cypriots began to view the constitution as unworkable and proposed changes abolishing all veto rights and many ethnic clauses; these proposals were rejected by Turkish Cypriots and the Turkish government. Inter-communal fighting erupted. Tylliria was bombarded with napalm bombs. A UN Peace Keeping Force was sent in, but soon proved powerless to prevent incidents. Thousands of Turkish Cypriots retreated into enclaves where they were embargoed by the Greek Cypriots. The UN attempted to supply them with food and medicine. Akritas plan
links: United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus

items.text: 1964年：The Battle of Tylliria takes place. Greek-Cypriot forces storm the Turkish-held Kokkina enclave, prompting a Turkish military intervention and airstrikes on the Greek forces. However, Soviet pressure prevented the Turks from going any further, and when the battle ended after four days of fierce fighting, the Kokkina enclave had been reduced to 50-40% of its original size.
1971年：EOKA B' is being created
1973年：The Turks emerged from their enclaves.
1974年：Turkish invasion of Cyprus
1975年：Turks announced a Federate State in the north, with Rauf Denktaş as leader. UN Forces remained as buffer between the two zones.
links: United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus

items.text: 1977年：Makarios died. He was succeeded by Spyros Kyprianou.

1983年：The Turkish Federated State declared itself the independent Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC), with Denktaş as president. The new state was not recognised by any country except Turkey and was officially boycotted.
1992年：UN sponsored talks began between the two sides.
1995年：The UN talks ran into the sand, but with a commitment to resume.
2001年：The European Court of Human Rights found Turkey guilty of continuing human rights violations against the Greek Cypriots.
2003年：Cyprus was set to join the European Union in May 2004. Renewed negotiations about the status of the island took place.
2003年4月23日：The line which divided the two parts of Cyprus was partly opened. Thousands of Turkish and Greek Cypriots crossed the buffer zone to the "other side" after 30 years.
2004年4月24日：2004 Annan Plan Referendum: The Annan Plan was accepted by the majority of Turkish Cypriots but overwhelmingly rejected by the Greek Cypriots.
2004年5月1日：The sovereign Republic of Cyprus joined the European Union, however the EU acquis was suspended in the occupied north, Akrotiri and Dhekelia and the United Nations Buffer Zone.
links: United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus

items.text: 2008年：Demetris Christofias replaced Tassos Papadopoulos as president of the Republic of Cyprus. It was the first time that a leader of the Greek Cypriot communist party, AKEL, had entered the presidential race. He was at the time the only communist leader in the European Union.
前8000年：Beginning of the Jeulmun pottery period.
前2337年：Legendary establishment of Tamna by Go, Yang, and Bu on Jeju Island.
前2333年：Legendary establishment of Gojoseon by Dangun.
前1500年：Beginning of the Mumun pottery period.
前800年：Historian Richard McBride posits that the historical founding of Old Chosŏn as a polity likely began around this time.
前700年：Beginning of the Liaoning bronze dagger culture.
前323年：Estimated beginning of the Gojoseon-Yan War that eventually ends in Gojoseon's loss of the Liaodong peninsula to Yan.
前300年：Beginning of the Iron Age.
前300年：Establishment of Jin in southern Korean peninsula.
前200年：Buyeo, which Goguryeo and Baekje claim descent from, is established sometime around the 2nd century BC.
前195年：Establishment of Wiman Joseon.
前108年：Han dynasty destroys Wiman Joseon, establishing four commanderies in northern Korean Peninsula.
前57年：Traditional date for the founding of Silla by Bak Hyeokgeose, who is elected leader.
前37年：Traditional date for the founding of Goguryeo by Jumong, a Prince of Buyeo.
前18年：Traditional date for the founding of Baekje by Onjo, a Buyeo Nobleman or the third son of Jumong according to different sources.
前17年：The oldest known Korean song, Song of the Yellow Bird is written by Yuri of Goguryeo.
42年：Traditional date for the founding of Gaya by Suro.
53年：Goguryeo begins to become a centralized kingdom under Taejo's reign.
234年：Baekje begins to become a centralized kingdom under Goi's reign.
244年：Goguryeo is defeated by Cao Wei in the Goguryeo–Wei War.
313年：Goguryeo destroys Lelang Commandery, ending the last of the four Han Chinese commanderies established by the Han Dynasty.
356年：Silla becomes a centralized kingdom under Naemul's reign.
371年：Baekje's King Geunchogo invades Goguryeo and kills King Gogugwon.
372年：Under Sosurim, Goguryeo imports Buddhism from Former Qin of China and adopts it as state sponsored religion.
372年：Sosurim also establishes Korea's first National Confucian Academy.
384年：Chimnyu of Baekje officially adopts Buddhism.
392年：Gwanggaeto the Great of Goguryeo begins his reign, expanding Goguryeo into a major regional power.
413年：Jangsu of Goguryeo erects the Gwanggaeto Stele.
433年：Baekje and Silla form an alliance against Goguryeo's aggression.
475年：Goguryeo attacks Baekje and captures Hanseong (modern day Seoul). Baekje moves its capital south to Ungjin (modern-day Gongju) due to Goguryeo's pressure.
494年：Last remains of Buyeo absorbed by Goguryeo.
498年：Baekje attacks Tamna (modern-day Jeju Province), which enters into a tributary relationship with Baekje as a result.
512年：Silla vassalizes Usan (modern-day Ulleungdo).
520年：Silla formalizes the Bone-rank system, an aristocratic rank system that acted as a caste system under the reign of Beopheung of Silla.

527年：Silla formally adopts Buddhism after Beopheung of Silla executes Ichadon, a Buddhist convert who had tried to persuade the king to adopt Buddhism. Before he was executed, Ichadon predicted that milk colored blood would spill from his body after his death. This supposed miracle allegedly occurred according to the Samguk yusa and convinced Silla's royal court to adopt Buddhism as its state religion.
538年：Baekje moves its capital to Sabi (modern-day Buyeo).
553年：Silla attacks Baekje, breaking the alliance.
562年：Silla completes annexation of Gaya.
598年：First of a series of major Sui dynasty attacks in the Goguryeo–Sui War, which ends in 614 in a costly defeat for Sui.
612年：Goguryeo repulses second Sui invasion at the Salsu.
631年：Goguryeo builds the first Cheolli Jangseong following Tang incursions into Goguryeo's northwestern border.
645年：First campaign in the Goguryeo–Tang War.
links: First campaign in the Goguryeo–Tang War

items.text: 648年：Silla establishes alliance with Tang.
660年：Baekje falls to the Silla-Tang forces.
662年：As a result of the fall of Baekje, Tamna enters into a tributary relationship with Silla.
663年：Battle of Baekgang, the remnants of Baekje allied with Japanese expeditionary forces are defeated by the Silla-Tang alliance, ending all hopes for the restoration of the kingdom.
668年：Goguryeo falls to the Silla-Tang forces.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 676年：Silla repels Chinese forces from the Korean peninsula, completes unification of much of the Three Kingdoms following the Silla-Tang War and successfully defends its independence.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 698年：The founding of Balhae by former Goguryeo general Dae Joyeong.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 751年：Silla, at its cultural peak, constructs Seokguram and Bulguksa.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 828年：Chang Pogo establishes Cheonghaejin, a major center of trade with China, Japan, and Vietnam.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 830年：Balhae reaches its peak under King Seon of Balhae.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 892年：Silla begins to lose control of parts of the peninsula as the brief Later Three Kingdoms period begins.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 897年：Queen Jinseong of Silla dies. She was the third and last queen regnant in Korean history.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 900年：Hubaekje ("Later Baekje") established in the southwest of the peninsula.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 901年：Taebong ("Later Goguryeo") established in the northwest of the peninsula.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 918年：Founding of Goryeo by Taejo of Goryeo.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 926年：Balhae falls to Khitan forces.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 935年：Silla formally surrenders to Goryeo.

items.section: North–South States period and Later Three Kingdoms
items.text: 936年：Hubaekje formally surrenders to Goryeo.
936年：Goryeo completes the reunification of the Later Three Kingdoms, absorbing the entirety of Hubaekje and parts of former Balhae territory.
937年：Tae Kwanghyŏn, the last Crown Prince of Balhae, flees to Goryeo with a great portion of the Balhae royalty and aristocracy and settles with tens of thousands of Balhae households there.
938年：Goryeo subjugates Tamna.
956年：Emperor Gwangjong forces major land and slavery reforms, and in 958 implements civil service examinations.
979年：According to the Goryeosa, tens of thousands of Balhae refugees from Jeongan flee to Goryeo, marking the largest Balhae migration since the 936 exodus.
986年：Jeongan falls to the Liao Dynasty.
993年：The first of three Goryeo–Khitan Wars.
1010年：The second ravages the northern border.
1018年：The third, Khitan successfully repelled.
1033年：Goryeo builds the second Cheolli Jangseong (lit. "Thousand Li Wall"), also known as the Goryeo Jangseong, a massive wall running along the northern border.
1135年：Buddhist monk and geomancer Myocheong rebels in a failed attempt to move the capital to Pyongyang and pursue aggressive expansion against the Jin Dynasty.
1145年：Kim Pusik compiles the Samguk sagi, Korea's oldest extant history text.
1170年：Yi Ŭi-bang overthrows Uijong of Goryeo, beginning a century of military rule known as the Goryeo military regime.
1231年：The Mongol invasions of Korea begin and will continue intermittently until 1259.
1234年：Ch'oe Yun-ŭi's Sangjeong Gogeum Yemun is published, world's first metal-block printed text.
1251年：Goryeo completes the Tripitaka Koreana, the most comprehensive and oldest intact version of the Buddhist canon in Chinese script.
1270年：Goryeo signs a peace treaty with the Mongols, beginning an 80-year period of Yuan overlordship. The Sambyeolcho Rebellion lasts for three more years.
1274年：Goryeo helps the Mongol Empire during the Mongol invasions of Japan.
1285年：Il-yeon compiles the Samguk yusa, record of history and legends.
1356年：Goryeo regains its independence under the reign of King Gongmin of Goryeo and momentarily conquers Liaoyang.
1388年：General Yi Sŏng-gye, ordered to engage China in a border dispute, turns his troops against the Goryeo court.
1392年：Yi Sŏnggye is crowned King Taejo, officially beginning the Joseon dynasty.
1394年：Capital moved to Hanyang (now Seoul).
1395年：The palace Gyeongbokgung is established in Hanyang.
1398年：The First Strife of the Princes occurs.
1398年：The capital is moved back to Kaesong.
1400年：The Second Strife of the Princes [ko] occurs.
1402年：Paper currency initiated
1405年：The capital is moved back to Hanyang.
1405年：The palace Changdeokgung is established in Hanyang.
1412年－1414年：Namdaemun Market, now the oldest extant market in Korea, is established.
1418年：Sejong the Great ascends the throne.
1420年：The government research institute Hall of Worthies is established.
1424年：Goryeosa compiled.
1426年：Two fires destroy much of Hanyang.
1446年：The Hangul alphabet, created 3 years earlier, is promulgated by King Sejong the Great.

1586年：Local nobleman Yi Ŭngt'ae dies, leaving a pregnant widow and a child named Wŏn behind. His widow leaves a grief-stricken letter in his tomb that is later discovered in 1998 and becomes famous internationally.
1592年：4th month. All the palaces in Seoul are burnt down.
1597年：The Chŏngyu War begins.
1592年：The Imjin War begins.
1593年：The war causes the Kyegap Famine (계갑대기근; 癸甲大飢饉) to begin. It lasts until 1594.

1597年：António Corea, a Korean slave kidnapped and taken to Japan, is sold to an Italian master. He is then taken to Italy at latest by 1600, and becomes possibly the first Korean to set foot in Europe.
1626年－1627年：Pyŏngjŏng Famine (병정대기근; 丙丁大飢饉).
1627年：The Later Jin invasion of Joseon occurs.
1636年：The Qing invasion of Joseon ends in Joseon's defeat, and Korea is made a tributary of Qing China.

1653年：Dutch mariner Hendrick Hamel becomes stranded on Jeju Island. The isolationist Joseon government prevents him from leaving, although he is given relative freedom to live normally on the peninsula.
1666年：Hamel and some of his crew escape Korea to Japan, then back to the Netherlands. Hamel then publishes the first eyewitness description of Korea by a Westerner.
1762年：Crown Prince Sado is ordered to commit suicide by his father Yeongjo of Joseon.
1791年：Persecution of Catholicism begins.
1809年：A crop failure leds to famine that lasts until 1815 and kills around 2,000,000.
1810年：A Moment mag. scale"}]]}'>Mw 7.3 earthquake strikes present-day North Hamgyong Province, damaging towns and killing residents.
1866年：11 October – 22 November. The French conduct a punitive campaign in Korea, but eventually retreat without concessions from the Korean government.
1869年：Famine in northern Korea that causes Koreans to flee to Russia.
1871年：United States expedition to Korea.
1873年：The palace Gyeongbokgung is reconstructed after having been abandoned since the Imjin War.
1876年：Korean ports are formally opened under the Treaty of Ganghwa with Imperial Japan.
1881年：10 December. Japanese newspaper Chōsen shinpō becomes the first newspaper to be published in Korea.
1882年：Imo Incident: Mutiny by Korean soldiers in Seoul against the modernization policies of King Gojong.

1883年：July to October. The first Korean diplomatic mission to the United States also gives rise to the first Koreans to set foot in North America, the first Korean to study abroad in the United States (Yu Kil-chun), and the first Koreans to circumnavigate the globe (Min Yong Ik [ko], Pyŏn Su [ko], and Soh Kwang-pom).
links: 1883 Korean special mission to the United States

items.text: 1883年：31 October. The first native Korean newspaper, Hansŏng sunbo, is established by the Joseon monarchy. It is written in Classical Chinese.
1884年：The three-day Kapsin Coup begins and fails.

1885年：11 October. The first Methodist church in Korea, Chungdong First Methodist Church, is established. The church's main chapel, built in 1897, is now the oldest extant church in Korea, and the only extant one built in the 19th century.

1886年：25th day, 1st month. The government newspaper Hansŏng jubo is established. It is the first newspaper written primarily in the Korean language (mixed script) and the first weekly newspaper in Korea.
1887年：The first electric light in Korea is lit in Gyeongbokgung.

1894年：The beginning of the Donghak Peasant Rebellion prompts the Kabo Reforms in an attempt to prevent Korea's colonization, and China and Japan fight over sovereignty of Korea in the First Sino-Japanese War.
1895年：Ae Kwan Theater, the first movie theater in Korea, is established in Incheon.
1895年：April. After Japanese victory in the Sino–Japanese War, China recognizes Korean independence in the Treaty of Shimonoseki.
1895年：8 October. Empress Myeongseong is assassinated by Japanese agents.
1896年：1 January. Joseon begins to use the Gregorian calendar.
1896年：7 April. Tongnip sinmun, the first private modern Korean newspaper, is founded.
1896年：11 February. Gojong's internal exile to the Russian legation.
links: Gojong's internal exile to the Russian legation

items.text: 1897年：20 February. King Gojong leaves the Russian legation and makes Deoksugung his official palace.
1897年：11 October. King Gojong proclaims the Korean Empire and is crowned at the religious shrine Hwangudan in Seoul.
1898年：January. Independence Gate is constructed in Seoul.
1903年：The first Korean immigrants to the United States arrive in Hawaii.
1904年：18 July. Landmark newspaper The Korea Daily News, predecessor to today's Seoul Shinmun, is founded by British journalist Ernest Bethell.
1904年：Philip Jaisohn becomes the first ethnic Korean to obtain a Western doctorate degree.
1904年：Imun Seolnongtang, now the oldest continually operating restaurant in South Korea, opens around this time in Seoul.
1905年：8 May. Koreans arrive in Mexico for the first time.
1905年：Treaty of Portsmouth ends the Russo-Japanese War in Russian defeat and leads to uncontested Japanese dominance of Korean politics
1905年：Japan–Korea Treaty of 1905. After being forced to sign the treaty, Korea becomes a protectorate of the Empire of Japan.
1906年：Kim Ransa becomes the first Korean woman to receive a bachelor's degree from the United States.
1906年：1 September. The historic Japanese newspaper in Korea Keijō nippō is founded. The newspaper becomes the de facto official paper of the Japanese Residency-General and later Government-General.
1907年：February. The National Debt Repayment Movement begins. It ends by 1908.
1907年：June. The Hague Secret Emissary Affair occurs, in which emissaries from Gojong attempt to assert Korea's independence in Europe, but are rebuffed.
1907年：18 July. Gojong is forced by Japan to abdicate in favor of his son, Emperor Sunjong.
1907年：9 September – 15 November. The Kyŏngsŏng Exhibition (경성박람회; 京城博覽會) is held in Seoul.
1908年：23 March. Durham Stevens, an American diplomat and Japanese sympathizer, is assassinated by Korean independence activists.
1909年：15 October. The first Korean-owned private regional newspaper Gyeongnam Ilbo is established.
1909年：26 October. The Japanese Resident-General of Korea Itō Hirobumi is assassinated by Korean independence activist An Jung-geun.
1910年：29 August. The Japan–Korea Treaty of 1910 started the annexation of the Korean Empire by Imperial Japan.
1911年：The 105-Man Incident occurs, in which the Japanese arrest over 700 Koreans in connection to alleged assassination attempts on the Governor-General of Korea, Terauchi Masatake.
1911年：The Korean enclave Sinhanch'on is established in Vladivostok in Russia. It becomes a hub of the Korean independence movement until it is dissolved in 1937.

1911年：Kwŏnŏphoe, which became the de facto representative organization for Koreans in the Russian Empire, is founded in Sinhanch'on. They secretly operate the Korean Independence Army Government [ko] and build an army using Russian government funds, but are eventually dissolved in 1917 after Japanese pressure on Russia.
1915年：9 September – 30 October. The Chōsen Industrial Exhibition is held at the former royal palace Gyeongbokgung.
1919年：21 January. Gojong suddenly dies. He was and is still widely believed to have been poisoned by Japan [ko].

1919年：1 February. The Muo Declaration of Independence [ko] is issued in Manchuria. It is the first such declaration of independence issued by Koreans, although its existence was then and remains relatively unknown.

1919年：8 February. Inspired by the promotion of self-determination laid out in the Fourteen Points statement, Korean independence activists in Japan publish a February 8 Declaration of Independence. This directly inspires a similar act in Korea three weeks later.
1919年：1 March. With the proclamation of the Korean Declaration of Independence, the March First Movement begins.
1919年：11 April. The Korean Provisional Government (KPG) is established in exile in Shanghai, and Syngman Rhee is elected its first leader.
links: Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea

items.text: 1919年：15 April. The Jeamni massacre occurs, during which Japanese soldiers lure Korean civilians into a church, kill them, and burn the building to destroy their bodies.
1919年：September. Governor-General of Chōsen Hasegawa Yoshimichi resigns and Saitō Makoto replaces him. The period of "cultural rule [ja; ko]" (文化政治; bunka seiji) begins.

1919年：27 October. The kino-drama, Righteous Revenge, widely considered the first Korean film, premieres at Dansungsa. This marks the anniversary of the modern Korean Film Day, although whether it is truly the first Korean film has been disputed.

1920年：As part of the cultural rule [ja; ko] policies, permission is granted for several Korean-owned newspapers to be founded. The Chosun Ilbo is established on 5 March and The Dong-A Ilbo on 1 April.
1920年：4 April. The Shinhanchon Incident occurs, in which an estimated several hundred Koreans are massacred by the Japanese army in Vladivostok, Far Eastern Republic.
4年：6 June. The Battle of Samdunja occurs between Korean rebels and the Empire of Japan.
6年：7 June. The Battle of Fengwudong occurs between Korean rebels and the Empire of Japan.
1920年：September. The controversial Hunchun incident . Japanese authorities claim Korean rebels attacked a Japanese consulate in Manchuria on this date, but debate continues as to what happened.
1920年：October. The Gando Massacre occurs in Manchuria, where Japanese soldiers kill, rape, and steal from thousands of Korean civilians.
21年：26 October. The Battle of Qingshanli between the Imperial Japanese Army and the Korean Independence Army (led by Kim Chwajin) takes place. Both sides claim victory.

1920年：November. The first time a Korean journalist is killed while reporting: The Dong-a Ilbo journalist Chang Tŏk-chun [ko] is killed by Japanese soldiers while investigating a Japanese massacre of Koreans in Hunchun, Manchuria.

1921年：The first golf course in Korea at what is now Hyochang Park. It was established by the Japanese, who left the graves of Korean royal family members directly on the course (fenced-off area in center of photo; photo published 1925)June. The first golf course in Korea is established at Hyochangwon by the Japanese colonial government. The tombs of Joseon royal family members are controversially left directly on the course.
1921年：28 June. The Free City Incident occurs, where Soviet forces kill Korean militants who refuse to surrender to them.
1922年：The Chōsen Art Exhibition is held for the first time. After 1945, it was succeeded by the Republic of Korea Art Exhibition [ko].
1922年：10 December. An Chang-nam becomes the first Korean to fly a plane in Korea.

1923年：1 March. The Koryo-saram newspaper Sŏnbong is established. It changed names to the Lenin Kichi in 1938 and Koryo Ilbo in 1991. As of 2023[update], it is the oldest active Korean-language newspaper outside of the Korean peninsula.
1923年：1 September. In the immediate aftermath of the Great Kantō earthquake in Japan, the Kantō Massacre occurs, and thousands of ethnic Koreans and others are massacred based on false rumors.
1923年：1 December. The Government-General of Chōsen Library is established as part of the cultural rule movement. It is eventually succeeded by the National Library of Korea after liberation.
1924年：9 April. The Chōsen Folk Art Museum is established at Gyeongbokgung.
1925年：February. Kwon Ki-ok becomes the first female Korean aviator after attending a pilot training school in China.
1926年：10 June. The June Tenth Movement pro-independence protests occur and are suppressed.
1926年：1 October. The Government-General of Chōsen Building is completed in Gyeongbokgung.
1929年：12 September – 31 October. The Chōsen Exhibition is held at Gyeongbokgung.
1929年：30 October. The Gwangju Student Independence Movement begins, and is suppressed soon afterwards.
1931年：The Korean Patriotic Organization (KPO) is founded.
1932年：9 January. The Sakuradamon incident occurs, in which KPO member Lee Bong-chang fails in his attempt to assassinate Emperor Hirohito in Tokyo.

1932年：29 April. The Hongkou Park Incident occurs, in which Yun Bong-gil sets off a bomb in a park in Shanghai (now Lu Xun Park), killing several Japanese colonial and military leadership. In the aftermath, the KPG is forced to flee Shanghai.

1932年：Japan begins the "comfort women" program, in which civilian women were coerced or forced into prostitution for the Japanese military. By the end of World War II, an estimated 100,000–200,000 Korean women would be forced into sexual slavery by Imperial Japan.

1935年：3 November. Runner Sohn Kee-chung becomes the first Korean to win an Olympic gold medal, and sets a world record time. However, Sohn begrudgingly competed as an athlete of the Empire of Japan. The Dong-A Ilbo removes the Japanese flag from his uniform in an image, which leads to retaliation from the colonial government.
1937年：4 June. Kim Il Sung leads 150–200 guerrillas in the Battle of Pochonbo.
1937年：September. The deportation of Koreans in the Soviet Union occurs, in which roughly 172,000 Koryo-saram are forced to move from the Russian Far East to Central Asia. Many die on the journey.
links: Deportation of Koreans in the Soviet Union

items.text: 1937年：November/December. The KPG flees Nanjing just weeks before the Nanjing Massacre.
1938年：1 March. Samsung is established in Daegu.
1938年：The Governor-General of Korea enacts the Sōshi-kaimei policy, under which Koreans are pressured and incentivized to adopt Japanese-style names.
1939年：The State General Mobilization Law is passed, and millions of Koreans are forcefully conscripted to work for Japan. Tens of thousands die due to poor work conditions.
1939年：The KPG settles in Chongqing, where they would remain until the end of the war.

1940年：The Japanese colonial government enacts the One Province, One Company (1道1社; 1도 1사) policy, under which both Japanese and Korean newspapers are forced to consolidate or close. The pro-Japanese Maeil Sinbo becomes the only major Korean-language newspaper left in Korea.
1940年：1 September. The Chōsen Grand Exposition is held.
1940年：17 September. The KPG establishes the Korean Liberation Army, a guerrilla army that was intended to eventually fight to liberate the Korean peninsula.
1940年：Kim Il Sung and a few surviving rebels escape from China into the USSR.
1942年：October. The Korean Language Society incident occurs, under which members of the Korean Language Society are arrested and tortured on suspicion that they are Korean independence activists.

1943年：27 November. The Cairo Declaration between China, the United States, and the United Kingdom announces the intention of the Allies to liberate Korea after World War II, but place it under a trusteeship. This both excites and angers Koreans.
1944年：Starting in 1944, Japan started the conscription of Koreans into the armed forces.
13年：17 August. The Seishin Operation is fought between the Soviet Union and Japan, with the Soviets winning.
1946年：4 January. Cho Man-sik, Kim's main rival for leadership in the North, is removed from office and placed under house arrest by the Soviets.

1946年：8 February. The Provisional People's Committee of North Korea is established, and Kim Il Sung is made its chairman. While it supposedly represents all political groups in the North, it is dominated by the Soviet-backed Communist Party.
links: Provisional People's Committee of North Korea

items.text: 1946年：1 July. North Korea creates its first film: Our Construction.

1946年：December. A coalition is made in the North among all major political parties, including representatives of left-leaning parties in the South. This coalition is again dominated by the Communists.
1947年：Hyundai is established, initially as a construction company.

1947年：19 July. Lyuh Woon-hyung, whom some Americans had been eyeing as a more moderate alternative candidate for leadership in the South, is assassinated by a member of the far-right terrorist group the White Shirts Society.

1947年：14 November. The United Nations passes General Assembly Resolution 112, which creates the United Nations Temporary Commission on Korea. The Soviets dispute the authority of the commission and ignore it.
links: United Nations Temporary Commission on Korea

items.text: 1948年：April. Protests occur in Jeju that lead to the Jeju Uprising and are violently suppressed by 1949. The estimated death toll is uncertain, but a significant portion (up to 30%) of the population is killed. This event and its aftermath significantly threaten the Jeju language, which as of 2023[update], is considered critically endangered.
1948年：10 May. Despite significant controversy, elections for the National Assembly are held in South Korea, and Syngman Rhee becomes its chair.
1948年：15 August. Establishment of South Korea with Syngman Rhee as president.
1948年：9 September. Establishment of North Korea with Kim Il Sung as premier.
1948年：October. The Yeosu–Suncheon rebellion occurs. While being shipped off to Jeju to suppress the unrest, left-leaning soldiers launch a rebellion in South Jeolla Province. Thousands are killed.

1948年：20 November. The South Korean National Assembly passes the National Security Law. The law has been consistently criticized for its broad scope and historical use by South Korean dictatorships to quash political resistance.
1949年：26 June. Kim Ku is murdered in his home by Ahn Doo-hee. The exact motives behind the murder still remain unclear.

1950年：25 June. The Korean War begins with a surprise attack from the North. While minor border skirmishes had happened prior to the war, they are not comparable in scale of the invasion the North launches. The First Battle of Seoul begins with the deaths of hundreds of civilians; Seoul falls within a few days.

1950年：7 July. The UN Security Council creates the United Nations Command under the United States to support the South. Over the following years, tens of thousands of soldiers from a number of countries fight for the South.

1950年：26 to 29 July. The No Gun Ri massacre occurs. Unarmed South Korean civilians near the village of Nogeun-ri are deliberately killed by the US Army; the death toll and cause of the massacre is disputed.
1950年：August. UN forces are driven back to the south-east corner of the Korean Peninsula ("The Pusan Perimeter").

1950年：September. The Battle of Inchon occurs after UN Troops make a surprise amphibious landing on the west coast. Despite the death toll, the UN resolution's original goal of returning to the status quo borders, and the concerns of the US's allies that China or the USSR could enter the war, MacArthur and Rhee decide to push North and reunify the peninsula. The UN approves this on 7 October, and troops move North on 9 October. This prompts the Chinese to begin planning a counteroffensive.
1950年：19 October. Chinese forces as the People's Volunteer Army under Peng Dehuai secretly enter the North.
1950年：27 November. Chinese forces launch a massive offensive from the North, which puts the UN and ROK forces into a full retreat.
1950年：6 December. The Chinese retake Pyongyang.

1950年：December. The National Defense Corps incident begins and lasts until February 1951. The Rhee government drafts hundreds of thousands of civilians into a militia, but fail to provide them adequate supplies. Tens of thousands die or disappear.
1951年：4 January. The North and China take Seoul.
1951年：31 January the UNSC votes unanimously to cease interest in the conflict, per UNSC Resolution 90.
1951年：15 March. Seoul is retaken by the ROK and UN Forces.

1951年：July. Armistice talks begin. While the establishment of a demilitarized zone and the creation of an armistice commission are agreed on, the talks stall on the issue of prisoner exchanges. Over the following two years of more stalled talks, the US and UN Forces drop more bombs on North Korea than the Allies did on Germany and Japan in World War II. Both the North and the South commit atrocities against their own citizens and civilians on the other side. Over a million and up to two million Koreans die.
1953年：January. The South Korean newsreel Korean News is established. It serves as an arm of the South Korean government until it closes in 1994.
1953年：27 July. The Korean War is halted by the Korean Armistice Agreement that has remained in force until now.
1955年：May. Chongryon, an association for Koreans in Japan that are aligned with North Korea, is created.
1956年：April. Chongryon assists in establishing the North Korean-aligned Korea University in Tokyo.
1956年：September. The August Faction Incident occurs, in which pro-Soviet and pro-Chinese North Koreans attempt to purge Kim Il Sung. Kim then conducts a counter-purge.
1960年：A student uprising begins the April Revolution which overthrows the First Republic of South Korea. Syngman Rhee resigns and goes into exile.
1961年：16 May. The May 16 coup occurs, in which General Park Chung Hee overthrows the Second Republic of Korea.
1961年：12 November. Summit conference for normalization of Korean-Japanese relations.
1962年：January. Start of the first Five-Year Plan of South Korea.

1962年：12 October. The Sino-Korean Border Agreement is signed, beginning the process of establishing the modern border between China and North Korea. The process finishes with the agreement's 1964 companion, the Protocols on the Sino–Korean Border.
1964年：South Korea joins the Vietnam War.
1965年：22 June. The signing of Treaty on Basic Relations between Japan and the Republic of Korea. Earned both much controversy and procurement of budgets for later economic developments.
links: Treaty on Basic Relations between Japan and the Republic of Korea

items.text: 1967年：Start of the second five-year plan.
1968年：January. The Blue House raid, an unsuccessful attempt of North Korean commandos to assassinate South Korean president Park Chung Hee occurs.
1968年：April. In retaliation for the Blue House raid, a South Korean group is created (Unit 684) to assassinate Kim Il Sung, but the group eventually mutinies on 23 August.
1970年：22 April. Start of the Saemaul Undong.
1970年：Gyeongbu Expressway is completed and opened to traffic.
1972年：Start of the third five-year plan.
1972年：12 August. The first Red Cross talks between North and South Korea are held.
1972年：President Park Chung Hee declares emergency martial law and changes the constitution in August, which allows for him to become the permanent ruler.
1974年：15 August. The assassination of first lady Yuk Young-soo by North Korean sympathizer Mun Se-gwang.
1976年：The Koreagate scandal breaks out in the United States.
1976年：18 August. The Axe Murder Incident in Panmunjom, Joint Security Area. Triggers former North Korean leader Kim Il Sung's first official apology to the South.
1977年：Start of the fourth five-year plan
1979年：26 October. The assassination of Park Chung Hee.
1979年：The Coup d'état of December Twelfth sees Chun Doo-hwan seize power.

1980年：Gwangju Uprising. Martial law is declared throughout the nation. The city of Gwangju becomes a battleground between dissenters and the Armed Forces (18–27 May). The official death toll was set at 200 people but some reports claim over 1000 casualties.
1985年：A South Korean expedition team becomes the first Koreans to set foot in Antarctica.

1987年：The June Democratic Struggle begins, which eventually overthrows the autocratic Fifth Republic of South Korea. The ruling party of Fifth Republic, Democratic Justice Party, then declares democratic elections.
1988年：17 February. The King Sejong Station becomes the first South Korean research station in Antarctica.

1988年：17 September – 2 October. The 24th Olympic Games are held in Seoul. This event has since become viewed as a watershed moment that showcased South Korea's rapid economic development to the world.
1990年：11 September. South Korea and the USSR establish diplomatic relations.
1991年：17 September. North Korea (DPRK) and South Korea (ROK) join the United Nations (UN).
1991年：26 December. The end of the Cold War as the Soviet Union collapses and North Korea loses military and economic aid.
1992年：11 August. South Korea's first satellite, KITSAT-1, a.k.a. 우리별 (Uri Byol) is successfully launched from Guiana Space Centre.
1992年：24 August. South Korea and the People's Republic of China (PRC) establish diplomatic relations.
1993年：Test of Rodong-1, a single-stage, mobile liquid propellant medium-range ballistic missile by the North Korea.
1994年：8 October. Kim Jong Il becomes leader of North Korea upon the death of his father.
1994年：21 October. The Seongsu Bridge disaster occurs in Seoul.
1994年：Start of the North Korean famine, which ends in 1998.
1995年：29 June. The Sampoong Department Store collapses in Seoul.
1996年：The Central Government Building, formerly known as the Government-General of Chōsen Building, begins to be demolished.
