1997年：The Asian Financial Crisis (or "IMF Crisis", as it was called in Korea) affects Korea
1998年：Taepodong-1, a two-stage intermediate-range ballistic missile is developed and tested by the DPRK.
1998年：The Shimonoseki Trial, the first ever lawsuit against the Japanese government by comfort women or forced laborers by Koreans, ends with the denial of compensation for the three women.
1999年：The DPRK promises to freeze long-range missile tests.
2002年：14 January – 19 March. TV series Winter Sonata achieves significant international viewership in the Philippines and Japan, bolstering the growing Korean Wave.
2002年：The 2002 FIFA World Cup jointly held by Korea & Japan. South Korea national football team reaches the semi-finals for the first time in Korean football history.
2004年：The DPRK reaffirms moratorium.
2007年：The second summit between DPRK and ROK leaders is held, with Roh Moo-hyun representing the south and Kim Jong Il the north. The DPRK fires short-range missile into the Sea of Japan.
2008年：8 April. A Korean woman, Yi So-yeon, becomes the first Korean to fly to outer space.
2010年：South Korean island Yeonpyeongdo is bombarded by North Korea.

2011年：Kim Jong Il dies, Kim Jong Un takes over as the Supreme Leader of North Korea. The National Intelligence Service accuses pro-unification lawmakers of being spies. One of the members was a former Democratic Party representative. In a move indicative of the heavy-handedness of the Park regime, the party is outlawed and key party members are imprisoned.
2012年：19 December. Park Geun-hye, a daughter of Park Chung Hee, is elected as first female and the 11th president of South Korea.
2013年：12 December. North Korean Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un, executes his uncle and major North Korean politician, Jang Song-thaek.
2014年：16 April. Sinking of MV Sewol, where 304 people, mostly students, die.
2016年：9 December. President Park Geun-hye is impeached.
2017年：10 March. The court upheld the impeachment in a unanimous 8–0 decision, removing Park from office.
2017年：10 May. Moon Jae-In is sworn into office immediately after official votes were counted on 10 May, replacing Acting President and Prime Minister Hwang Kyo-Ahn.

2019年：21 May. The South Korean film Parasite premieres at the 2019 Cannes Film Festival, and becomes the first Korean film to win the top prize. At the 2020 Academy Awards, it becomes the first Korean film to receive any recognition from the academy, and the first non–English language film to win Best Picture.
2021年：17 September. Premiere of the TV series Squid Game, which becomes an international sensation with hundreds of millions of viewers around the world.
2022年：10 May. Yoon Suk Yeol is sworn into office, succeeding former President Moon Jae-in.

2022年：5 July. American mathematician of Korean descent June Huh is awarded the Fields Medal, which is considered the most prestigious award in mathematics. He is the first ethnic Korean to receive the award.
2022年：29 October. Seoul Halloween crowd crush, 159 people are killed and another 197 injured in the deadliest accident since the sinking of the Sewol.
2024年：3 December. In the evening, President Yoon Suk Yeol declares martial law, but it is overturned by 04:30 the following morning. A political crisis begins.
2024年：10 December. South Korean writer Han Kang becomes the first ethnic Korean and first Asian woman to receive the Nobel Prize in Literature.
links: List of Korean Nobel laureates and nominees

items.text: 2024年：14 December. President Yoon is impeached, although confirmation of this pended approval by the Constitutional Court of Korea.
2024年：27 December. Acting president Han Duck-soo is impeached, making deputy prime minister and finance minister Choi Sang-mok the acting president.
2025年：15 January. Yoon Suk Yeol is arrested after multiple previous failed attempts and an hours-long standoff at his residence. He is South Korea's first sitting president to be arrested.
2025年：18 January. Yoon supporters storm the Seoul Western District Court in an attempt to block his legal proceedings. The attempt fails and order is restored.
2025年：24 March. Han Duck-soo's impeachment is overturned by the Constitutional Court, making him acting president again.
2025年：4 April. Yoon's impeachment is confirmed by the Constitutional Court.
2025年：4 June. Lee Jae Myung is sworn into office, succeeding former President Yoon Suk Yeol.
215年：Qin armies evict Xiongnu nomadic tribes from their pastures on the Yellow River in the Ordos Loop. Xiongnu leader Touman forced to flee far into the Mongolian Plateau.
209年：Modu Chanyu found the Xiongnu Empire. These nomadic peoples would inhabit the eastern Asian Steppe from the 3rd century BCE to the late 1st century CE.
203年：Xiongnu launch second war against the Yuezhi, seizing a large swath of Yuezhi territory (modern day Xinjiang).
200年：At the Battle of Baideng, Emperor Gaozu of Han was ambushed reputedly by 300,000 elite Xiongnu cavalry, only narrowly escaping capture.
198年：Modu Chanyu and the emperor Gaozu of China's Han dynasty sign a peace treaty, recognizing equality of the Xiongnu.

176年：Modu Chanyu leads a Xiongnu invasion of the Gansu region and soundly defeats last remnants of the Yuezhi, killing the Yuezhi king in the process and asserting their presence in the Western Regions.
174年：Death of Xiongnu leader Modu Chanyu.
133年：The Battle of Mayi, an abortive ambush operation by Emperor Wu of Han (Han Wudi) against the invading Xiongnu forces, begins a decades-long Han dynasty offensive against the nomads.

119年：The Battle of Mobei, Han forces invade the northern regions of the Gobi Desert forcing the Xiongnu to flee into Siberia. After a series of further defeats, the Xiongnu are expelled from the Ordos Desert and Qilian Mountains.
71年：Various tribes invade the Xiongnu territory from all fronts; Wusun from the west, Dingling from the north, Wuhuan from the east, and Han forces from the south.
60年：Xiongnu civil war as factions fight for power following the death of Xulüquanqu, the 12th Chanyu
53年：The southern Xiongnu surrender and become tributaries to the Han after splitting into northern and southern dynasties.

36年：At the Battle of Zhizhi General Chen Tang and Protector General Gan Yanshou, acting without explicit permission from the Han court, kill Northern Xiongnu leader Zhizhi Chanyu at his capital city (present-day Taraz, Kazakhstan)
49年：Tsi Yung, allied with the Wuhuan and Xianbei, attacked the northern Xiongnu kingdom. Xianbei move into Xiongnu territory.
93年：The northern Xiongnu are dispersed by the Xianbei and the Chinese during the Battle of Ikh Bayan. The last Northern Chanyu is defeated and flees over to the north west with his subjects.
147年：The Xianbei, who gain strength beginning from the 1st century CE, are consolidated into a state under Tanshihuai.
167年：The Xianbei successfully repel an invasion of the Han dynasty.
180年：The Xianbei conquer areas of northern China.

235年：The last khagan of the Xianbei, Kebineng, is assassinated by Cao Wei, successor state of the Eastern Han (25–220). The Xianbei state disintegrates into a number of smaller independent domains (Murong, Tuoba, Khitan people, Shiwei, and Rouran Khaganate).

330年：A branch of the Xianbei, the Rouran (also known as Nirun) establish a powerful nomadic empire over modern day Mongolia, eastern Kazakhstan, part of Gansu, northern Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, parts of Northeast China and southern Siberia.
402年：Yujiulü Shelun assumes the title of Khagan, landmarking the establishment of the state of the Rouran Khaganate.
555年：The Göktürks join the Western Wei, successor state of the Northern Wei, to defeat the Rouran.
570年：The Chinese Northern Qi and Northern Zhou dynasties begin paying tribute to the Göktürks.
584年：The Göktürk Empire, which stretches west to Crimea, is partitioned into Eastern and Western Turkic Khaganates. Eastern Turk Göktürks recognize Sui dynasty suzerainty.
615年：Turkic Khaganate revolts against Emperor of Sui and besiege the command seats at present-day Daixian in Shanxi
630年3月27日：A Tang army under the command of Li Jing defeats the Eastern Turkic Khaganate under the command of Illig Qaghan at the Battle of Yinshan

648年：A reunited China—under the Tang dynasty (618–906) destroys the Eastern Türk north of the Gobi and establishes the Anbei Protectorate in the Mongolian Steppes. Uyghurs khagan are installed as Anbei protector.
links: Protectorate General to Pacify the North

items.text: 682年：Ilterish Qaghan (682–91) founds the Second Turkic Khaganate by uniting the tribes and subjugating the nine Turkic tribes of the Toquz Oghuz (which included the Uyghurs) and joining with the Sir tribes, Basmyls and Karluks to the west. He would later defeat Chinese armies and raid China.
691年：Ilterish Qaghan of the Second Turkic Khaganate dies and is succeeded by his brother Qapaghan Qaghan.
696年：Qapaghan Qaghan of the Second Turkic Khaganate defeats the Khitans to the east and raids the Tang dynasty.
711年：Qapaghan Qaghan of the Second Turkic Khaganate defeats the Turgesh
742年：The Basmyl, Uyghurs, and Karluks revolt against the Second Turkic Khaganate
745年：The Uyghurs kill the last khagan of the Göktürks, Kulunbeg, and sent his head to the Tang.
756年：Uyghur Bayanchur Khan aids Emperor Suzong of the Tang dynasty against the An Lushan rebellion. Approximately 4,000 Uyghur horsemen assisted Tang armies in retaking Chang'an and Luoyang in 757.
758年：Uyghurs destroy several northern Yenisei Kyrgyz trading outposts before slaughtering a Kyrgyz army and executing their Khan
840年：The Tang dynasty surreptitiously encouraged the Yenisei Kirghiz and the Karluks to attack the Uyghurs and the Uyghur Khaganate fell under an invasion of the Yenisei Kirghiz
907年：Ambagyan founds the Khitan Liao dynasty which covered a significant portion of what is now Mongolia including the basins of the three rivers Kherlen, Tuul and Orkhon.
925年：The Khitan ruled eastern Mongolia, most of Manchuria, and much of China north of the Yellow River.
944年：Emperor Taizong launches an invasion of the Jin.
947年：Khitan chieftains had established themselves as emperors of northern China. The Khitan state is renamed the Liao dynasty
951年10月7日：Emperor Shizong of Liao is murdered by a relative and is succeeded by Yelü Jing, son of Emperor Taizong of Liao, who becomes Emperor Muzong of Liao
960年2月：Zhao Kuangyin declares himself Emperor Taizu of Song, replacing Later Zhou
964年：Liao dynasty assists Northern Han in repelling Song dynasty
969年3月12日：Emperor Muzong of Liao is murdered by his attendants and is succeeded by Yelü Xian, son of Emperor Shizong of Liao, who becomes Emperor Jingzong of Liao
979年：Liao dynasty attempts to assist Northern Han in repelling Song dynasty but is defeated at the Battle of Gaoliang River
980年10月13日：Emperor Jingzong of Liao dies and his son Yelü Longxu succeeds him as Emperor Shengzong of Liao; Empress Xiao Yanyan becomes regent
983年：The Liao dynasty reverts to calling itself the Khitans
993年：First conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War: Khitans invade Goryeo and acquire nominal tributary status over Goryeo
links: First conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War

items.text: 1004年：Emperor Shengzong of Liao conducts a full-scale invasion of the Song dynasty which ends in stalemate and the Chanyuan Treaty, an agreement to an annual payment of silk and silver from the Song to the Khitans
1009年：Empress Xiao Yanyan dies
1010年：Second conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War: Mokjong of Goryeo is murdered by Kang Cho and the Khitans send an expedition to punish him; Kang Cho is killed
links: Second conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War

items.text: 1018年：Third conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War: Khitans invade Goryeo but are defeated
links: Third conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War

items.text: 1019年：Third conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War: Khitans prepares another army to attack Goryeo
links: Third conflict in the Goryeo–Khitan War

items.text: 1031年6月25日：Emperor Shengzong of Liao dies and his son Yelü Zongzhen succeeds him as Emperor Xingzong of Liao; Empress Dowager Xiao Noujin becomes regent
1055年8月28日：Emperor Xingzong of Liao dies and is succeeded by his son Yelü Hongji, who becomes Emperor Daozong of LiaoAll officials are required to wear Chinese court dress
1066年：Khitans revert to calling their state the Liao dynasty
1082年：Unusually heavy snowfall kills 70 percent of livestock and horses
1093年：Mogusi of the Zubu and the Dilie tribes of western Heilongjiang raid the Liao dynasty
1101年2月12日：Emperor Daozong of Liao dies and his grandson Yelü Yanxi succeeds him as Emperor Tianzuo of Liao
1117年：Emperor Taizu of Jin defeats the Khitan army of the Liao dynasty

1122年：Emperor Tianzuo of Liao flees the Southern Capital and his uncle Yelü Chun is declared emperor of Northern Liao, however he dies three months later and the title is passed down to Yelü Ding, the son in hiding with his father the emperor also in hiding; real power goes to Empress Dowager Xiao Puxiannu
1129年：Yelü Dashi annexes two Jin tribes
1130年：Yelü Dashi leaves the Orkhon River with 20,000 followers and travels to the Kingdom of Qocho where the ruler welcomes him
1131年：Yelü Dashi attacks the Karakhanids at Kashgar but is repelled
1141年9月9日：Battle of Qatwan: Yelü Dashi annihilates the army of Ahmad Sanjar of the Seljuk Empire and vassalizes the Khwarazmian dynasty
1143年：Yelü Dashi dies and his wife Xiao Tabuyan succeeds him as regent
1151年：Yelü Yilie, son of Yelü Dashi, becomes gurkhan of the Qara Khitai
約1162年：Temüjin (the future Genghis Khan) is born in the Khentii mountains of today's Mongolia.
1186年11月7日：Ögedei Khan, third son of Temüjin (Genghis Khan) is born.
1189年：Temüjin becomes Khan of the Khamag Mongol.
1205年：Temüjin unites all nomadic tribes who settled around at Lake Baikal to China's Great Wall.
1206年：Temüjin given the title Genghis Khan (Chinggis Khaan), first Khagan (Great Khan) of the Mongol Empire.
1215年9月23日：Kublai Khan, son of Tolui and grandson of Genghis Khan, is born.
1227年8月18日：Genghis Khan, 1st Khagan of the Mongol Empire, dies in Western Xia during the fall of Yinchuan aged c. 65.
1229年9月13日：Ögedei Khan, third son of Genghis Khan, becomes second Khagan of the Mongol Empire.
1241年12月11日：Ögedei Khan, second Khagan of the Mongol Empire, dies aged 55.
1243年：Zhenjin, second son of Kublai Khan and later founder of the Yuan dynasty, is born.
1246年8月24日：Güyük Khan, eldest son of Ögedei Khan and grandson of Genghis Khan, becomes third Khagan of the Mongol Empire.
1248年4月20日：Güyük Khan, third Khagan of the Mongol Empire, dies aged 42.
1251年7月1日：Möngke Khan, eldest son of Tolui and grandson of Genghis Khan, becomes fourth Khagan of the Mongol Empire.
1259年8月11日：Möngke Khan, fourth Khagan of the Mongol Empire, dies aged 50.

1260年5月5日：Kublai Khan, son of Tolui and grandson of Genghis Khan, becomes fifth Khagan of the Mongol Empire. However, the Toluid Civil War begins as various members of the Tolui family line fight for the title of Khagan resulting in the division of the Mongol Empire.
1268年：The Kaidu–Kublai war breaks out, which lasts until 1301 and deepens the fragmentation of the Mongol Empire. All later Khagans of the Mongol Empire were nominal due to the empire's division.
1269年：Birth of the 'Phags-pa script, designed by Drogön Chögyal Phagpa for Kublai Khan.
1271年：Kublai Khan officially proclaims the founding of the Yuan dynasty with himself as first emperor. Khanbaliq (modern Beijing) named the dynasty's capital.
1273年：Zhenjin designated Crown Prince by Kublai Khan.

1294年2月18日：Death of Kublai Khan (aged 78). By this time the Mongol Empire had already fractured into four khanates: the Yuan dynasty based in China, the Golden Horde based in Russia, the Chagatai Khanate based in Central Asia, and the Ilkhanate based in Iran, although the Yuan emperors held the nominal title of Khagan.
1294年5月10日：Temür Khan, son of Crown Prince Zhenjin and grandson of Kublai Khan, becomes sixth Khagan of the Mongol Empire and second emperor of the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty.
1295年：Enthronement of Ilkhan Ghazan. Islamization of the Ilkhanate.

1304年：A peace among the Mongol khanates establishes the nominal supremacy of the Yuan dynasty over the three western khanates (the Golden Horde, the Chagatai Khanate and the Ilkhanate). However, the peace itself was short-lived and the war soon resumed.

1307年6月21日：With the death of Temür Khan (aged 41), Külüg Khan, first son of Darmabala and Dagi of the Khunggirad clan, and a great-grandson of Kublai Khan, becomes seventh Khagan of the Mongol Empire and third Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

1311年4月7日：Külüg Khan dies (aged 29). Ayurbarwada Buyantu Khan, second son of Darmabala and Dagi of the Khunggirat, and a great-grandson of Kublai Khan, becomes eighth Khagan of the Mongol Empire and fourth Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.
1313年：Enthronement of Öz Beg Khan. Islamization of the Golden Horde.
1315年：Revival of the imperial examination system within the Yuan dynasty under Ayurbarwada Buyantu Khan.

1320年4月19日：Ayurbarwada Buyantu Khan dies (aged 34), Gegeen Khan, eldest son of Ayurbarwada Buyantu Khan and Radnashiri, becomes ninth Khagan of the Mongol Empire and fifth Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

1323年10月4日：Death of Gegeen Khan (aged 20). Yesün Temür, son of Gammala, grandson of Zhenjin and great-grandson of Kublai Khan, becomes tenth Khagan of the Mongol Empire and sixth Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

1328年10月：With the death of Yesün Temür (aged 34), Ragibagh Khan, eldest son of Yesün Temür, becomes 11th Khagan of the Mongol Empire at the age of 7-8 and designated seventh Emperor of the Yuan dynasty before being deposed in a coup before his succession.

1328年10月16日：Jayaatu Khan Tugh Temür, second son of Khayishan, becomes 12th Khagan of the Mongol Empire and eighth Emperor of the Yuan dynasty. The War of the Two Capitals begins. His forces defeated, Ragibagh Khan disappears or dies at the age of 7–8, possibly murdered.

1329年2月27日：Jayaatu Khan Tugh Temür abdicates and his elder brother Khutughtu Khan Kusala becomes 13th Khagan of the Mongol Empire and ninth Emperor of the Yuan dynasty. However, he dies on August 30 at age 28, four days after a banquet with brother Jayaatu Khan Tugh Temür, presumed to have been poisoned. Jayaatu Khan Tugh Temür regaines the throne on September 8.

1332年10月23日：With the death of Jayaatu Khan Tugh Temür (aged 28), Rinchinbal Khan, second son of Khutughtu Khan Kusala, becomes 14th Khagan of the Mongol Empire and tenth Emperor of the Yuan dynasty at the age of six.

1333年7月19日：Rinchinbal Khan dies nine months later (aged 6), Toghon Temür, (1320–1370) eldest son of Khutughtu Khan Kusala and older brother of Rinchinbal, becomes 15th Khagan of the Mongol Empire and eleventh Emperor of the Yuan dynasty.
1335年：Disintegration of the Ilkhanate after the death of Ilkhan Abu Sa'id.
1368年9月14日：Toghon Temür flees Beijing for Shangdu in advance of approaching Ming dynasty forces. Yuan dynasty falls. The remnants of the Yuan known as the Northern Yuan dynasty continue in Mongolia.
1370年：Biligtü Khan Ayushiridara (1340–1378), son of Toghon Temür, is declared Khan of Mongolia at Karakorum. Timur (Tamerlane) gains control of the western Chagatai Khanate.
1378年：Uskhal Khan Tögüs Temür (1342–1388) succeeds his brother Ayuushridar as Khan of Mongolia.
1380年：The Golden Horde is defeated at the Battle of Kulikovo. Karakorum is destroyed by Chinese troops.

1388年：Uskhal Khan Tögüs Temür is murdered by an ally of the Oirats, thus launching the Oirat-Mongol wars in Northern Yuan dynasty. Jorightu Khan Yesüder (1358–1391) becomes Khan of a fractured and diminished Mongol Khanate.
1394年：Elbeg Nigülesügchi Khan (1361–1399) overthrew Engke Khan from the House of Ariq Böke succeeds as Khan of the Mongols.
1395年：Timur invades the Golden Horde and sacks Saray and Astrakhan.
1399年：Elbeg Nigülesügchi Khagan is defeated by the Four Oirats and killed by their leaders, Ugetchi Khashikha and Batula.
1405年：Timur dies of illness at Farab (present day Kazakhstan) while preparing for war against Ming China.
1408年：Öljei Temür Khan (1379–1412) succeeds his father Elbeg Nigülesügchi Khan and older brother Gün Temür Khan as Khan of the Yuan dynasty.
1415年：Oirat nobles place Oyiradai (died 1425) on the throne of Khagan of the Mongol Khan of the Northern Yuan dynasty following the death of Delbeg Khan
1425年：Adai Khan (1390–1438) assumes throne of Northern Yuan dynasty, unifies both the central and eastern Mongol territories but then suffers major defeats by Oirats in 1430 and 1434.
1433年：Oirats crown Toghtoa Bukha (Taisun Khan) as Khagan of the Northern Yuan. He later proclaims himself of Khagan of the Great Yuan enraging the Ming dynasty.

1449年：Esen Taishi (Taisun Khan's military commander and later successor as Khan) captures the Zhentong Emperor of the Ming dynasty at the Battle of Tumu Fortress and lays siege to Beijing, but is pushed back.
1473年：The Ming begin construction of the Great Wall at the southern edge of the Ordos Desert to contain resurgent Mongol tribes.

1480年：Madukhai Khatun, widow of the previous Chinggisid khan, marries Batu-Möngke Dayan Khan who defeats the Oirats, beginning a Chinggisid revival in Mongolia. The Great Horde's attempt to invade Muscovy failed. Their leader Akhmat Khan dies.
links: Great stand on the Ugra river

items.text: 1510年：Dayan Khan defeats the Ordos and Tümed Mongols at the Battle of Dalan Terigün (Inner Mongolia), reunifying the Six Tümens of the Mongols.
1513年：Dayan Khan launches successive invasions of China that continue through 1526 and include an unsuccessful assault on Beijing in 1517

1542年：Following his brother's death in 1542, Altan Khan (grandson of Dayan Khan) becomes the de facto leader of the whole of the "Right Wing" (western Inner Mongolia and Ordos) and is given the title, "Tüsheet Sechen Khan."
1550年：Altan Khan launches large scale incursions into Ming territory, surrounds Beijing.
1551年：Altan Khan and the Ming strike accords on peace and border trade.
1571年：Altan Khan founds the city of Guihua or Köke Khota (Hohhot, meaning "The Blue City"), now the capital of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of the People's Republic of China.
1577年：Altan Khan meets Sodnam Gyatso in northeast Tibet and bestows on him the Mongolian title "Dalai Lama". The Mongols’ “Second Conversion” to Buddhism begins
1585年：Abtai Sain Khan of the Tüsheet Khanate and nephew of Altan Khan founds Erdene Zuu Monastery, the first Buddhist monastery in Mongolia, adjacent to the ancient Mongol capital of Karakorum
1601年：Yonten Gyatso, great-grandson of Altan Khan, becomes the 4th Dalai Lama in Lhasa, Tibet.
1604年：Ligdan Khan becomes ruler of the northern Yuan.
1619年：Several Mongol tribes defect to the Qing due to Ligdan Khan's oppressive rule.
1632年：Ligdan Khan flees to Tibet to evade the Manchus and conquer the Gelug.
1634年：Ligdan Khan dies at Qinghai Lake.
1640年：Zanabazar, four-year-old son of the Tüsheet Khan of the Khalkha, is recognized as the first Jebtsundamba Khutughtu.
1642年：Establishment of the Khoshut Khanate in the Tibetan Plateau by Güshi Khan.
1661年：Irkutsk fort founded.
1671年：Galdan Boshigt becomes leader of the western Dzungar Khanate.
1685年：Galdan Khan founds the town of Khovd.
1687年：Outbreak of the decades-long Dzungar–Qing War between the Dzungar Khanate and Khalkha-Mongols / Qing dynasty.
1688年：The Dzungars invade Khalkha and force Khalkha nobility to flee to Inner Mongolia.
1691年：Khalkha nobles pledge fealty to the Kangxi Emperor of the Qing dynasty.
1696年：The Qing dynasty seizes de facto control of Khalkha by defeating the Dzungars in the Battle of Jao Modo.
1705年：The Khoshut Lha-bzang Khan deposes the Sixth Dalai Lama in Tibet and kills the regent Sangs-rgyas rGya-mtsho.
1709年：Khalkha jirum (Khalkha regulations) replaces the Mongol-Oirat Code among the Khalkha Mongols.
1717年：Acting on an appeal by the Tibetan monasteries, the Dzungar army occupies Lhasa and kills The Khoshut Lha-bzang Khan.
1718年：The Qing armies establish a garrison and military farm near modern Khovd city in western Mongolia.
1720年：Qing dynasty's Kangxi Emperor drives Dzungar forces from Tibet.
1723年：Death of Zanabazar. Upper Mongols under rule of the prince Lubsan Danzan revolt against the Qing but are defeated.
1727年：Kyakhta Treaty defines Russo-Qing frontier and divides the Buriats under Russia from the Khalkha Mongols under the Qing.
1752年：Dawaachi and Amursanaa overthrow the Dzungar ruler in Xinjiang; Dawaachi becomes new Khong Tayiji (ruler).
1755年：The Qing armies occupy Dzungaria in Xinjiang.
1756年：Chingünjav and Amursana lead failed rebellions which ended in the destruction of the Dzungars by the Qing dynasty.
1758年：Third Jebtsundamba Khutuktu identified in Tibet (first outside of Mongolia)
1779年：Nom-un Yekhe Khüriye, the great monastery of the Jebtsundamba Khutuktus, finally settles at the present location of Ulaanbaatar in Mongolia.
1789年：Qing law replaces the native code, Khalkha jirum.
1809年：The 5th Jebtsundamba Khutuktu orders construction of Gandantegchinlen (Gandan) Monastery in Ikh Khuree.
1811年：First tsam religious dances performed in Ikh Khuree
1822年：Russian statesman Mikhail Speransky reforms administration of the Buriats and other Indigenous peoples of Siberia.
1833年：Opening of the Russian-Mongol school in Kyakhta
1836年：The Jebtsundamba Khutuktu relocates from east Khüriye (now central Ulaanbaatar) to Gandantegchinlen (Gandan) Monastery to avoid Chinese merchants.
1838年：Completion of Gandantegchinlen (Gandan) Monastery in Ikh Khuree
1846年：The Buriat Cossack Dorzhi Banzarov becomes first person of Mongol ancestry to earn a European Ph.D. at University of Kazan in Russia.
1861年：Russian Consul takes up residence in Ikh Khuree
1869年：Agvaanl Uvsanchoijinyam Danzan Vanchüg is born in Lithang, Kham. He will later be formally installed as the Bogd Khan of the new Mongolian state
1880年：Anti-Manchu mutiny by Uliastai garrison
1891年：Chinese rebels of the Jindandao (Way of the Golden Pill) sect launch massive pogroms against Mongols in southeastern Inner Mongolia.
1892年：Agreement to build a telegraph line from Russia to China via Ikh Khuree. Construction of Trans-Siberian Railway begins.
1907年：The Qing government implemented sinification policies.
1911年12月1日：Outer Mongolia declared independence from the Qing dynasty under Bogd Khan.
1911年12月29日：The Bogdo Khanate of Mongolia was proclaimed and Bogd Khan enthroned.
1912年11月3日：The Russian Empire recognized Mongolian independence and the rule of Bogd Khan.
1913年11月11日：Mongolia and Tibet concluded treaty on mutual recognition and mutual assistance.
1915年5月29日：Russia, China and Mongolia signed a treaty at Kyakhta under which China was recognized as sovereign over an autonomous Mongolia.
1919年10月：Outer Mongolia was occupied by the Republic of China.
1920年6月25日：The Mongolian People's Party was formed between two secret revolutionary groups in occupied Niislel Khüree.
1921年2月：Roman von Ungern-Sternberg drove Chinese troops out of Niislel Khüree.
1921年2月22日：All remaining Chinese troops were defeated by Ungern and driven from Mongolia, allowing the reassertion of Mongolian independence and the restoration of the Bogd Khanate of Mongolia.
1921年3月13日：The People's Provisional Government of seven men was formed in Soviet Russia.
1921年3月18日：People's Revolution of 1921: Revolutionary guerrillas headed by Damdin Sükhbaatar, with the assistance of Red Army troops, defeated the Chinese garrison in Kyakhta.
1921年7月：People's Revolution of 1921: The Russian Red Army, with the support of Damdin Sükhbaatar, defeated the forces of Ungern-Sternberg.
1921年7月11日：A revolutionary government led by Dogsomyn Bodoo was officially established; the Bogd Khan was installed as a constitutional monarch.
1921年8月20日：Ungern-Sternberg was captured by a Soviet detachment.
1921年9月15日：The show trial of Ungern sentenced him to execution by firing squad. Ungern was shot the following night.
1922年8月31日：High-ranking figures, accused of anti-revolutionary conspiracy by Soliin Danzan, were shot dead. Notable victims included Dogsomyn Bodoo, Dambyn Chagdarjav, and Ja Lama.
1923年2月20日：Revolutionary commander Damdin Sükhbaatar mysteriously passed away. Rumours allege he was poisoned by Khorloogiin Choibalsan.
1924年5月20日：Death of the Bogd Khan.
1924年11月26日：After the Bogd Khan's passing, the 1924 Constitution was passed by the first State Great Khural. Subsequently, the Mongolian People's Republic was officially declared in Outer Mongolia.
links: Constitutions of the Mongolian People's Republic

items.text: 1928年：Collectivization began.
1932年：1932 armed uprising in Mongolia: The failure of collectivization led to widespread uprisings and a temporary thaw.
1936年：Prince Demchugdongrub formed the Mongol Military Government, a non-Communist state independent from China, in Inner Mongolia.
1937年：The Mongol Military Government was renamed the Mongol United Autonomous Government.
1937年9月：Stalinist purges in Mongolia: A Stalinist terror began which would lead to the deaths of more than thirty thousand people in the Mongolian People's Republic.
1939年4月：Stalinist purges in Mongolia: The terror ended.
1939年5月：Battle of Khalkhyn Gol: Large scale fighting took place between Japanese and joint Soviet-Mongolian forces along Khalkhyn Gol on the border between Mongolia and Manchuria.
1939年9月16日：Battle of Khalkhyn Gol: The battle ended in a Japanese defeat. A truce was negotiated between Japan and the Soviet Union.
1941年：The Mongol United Autonomous Government was renamed the Mongolian Autonomous Federation, or Mengjiang.

1945年8月：The Republic of China requested Soviet help in the war against Japan, and offered recognition of the independence of Outer Mongolia in exchange according to the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance.
links: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance

items.text: 1945年8月：The Mongolian People's Republic declared war on Japan, one day after the Soviet Union, and began to liberate Southern Mongolia from China and Japan.
1945年10月：A 1945 plebiscite yielded a 100% pro-independence vote.
1946年1月：The Chinese government recognized the independence of Mongolian People's Republic.
1949年10月6日：The newly established People's Republic of China recognized Mongolia and agreed to establish diplomatic relations.
1950年：Herds were successfully collectivized.
1952年：The Republic of China (ROC) on Taiwan renounced the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance.
links: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance

items.text: 1955年：The ROC blocked the accession of the Mongolian People's Republic's entry to the United Nations.
1961年10月23日：The Mongolian People's Republic was admitted to the United Nations.
1961年：The Trans-Mongolian Railway was finished.
1962年：Mongolia became a member of the Comecon.
1962年：Sino-Soviet split: The MPRP leadership sided with the Soviet Union in a falling-out with China.
1965年：Yumjaagiin Tsedenbal purged the intelligentsia.
1969年：Sino-Soviet split: The Soviet Union stationed a large army on Mongolian territory in response to threats of Chinese aggression.
1981年3月22日：Jügderdemidiin Gürragchaa became the first Mongolian in space as part of Soyuz 39.
1984年8月23日：Tsedenbal was ousted from all positions by the Politburo.
1987年1月27日：Mongolia established diplomatic relations with the United States.
1989年12月：The first popular reform demonstrations took place, sparking the Democratic Revolution of 1990; the Mongolian Democratic Union (MDU) was organized and established.
1990年1月：Large-scale pro-democracy demonstrations were held in sub-zero weather.
1990年3月2日：Mongolia and the Soviet Union announced that all Soviet troops would be withdrawn from Mongolia by 1992.
1990年3月7日：The MDU launched a mass hunger strike demanding the resignation of Jambyn Batmönkh and the Politburo.
1990年：The Politburo of the Central Committee of the MPRP and Batmönkh announced their resignation.
1990年5月：The constitution was amended to provide for a multi-party system and new elections.
1990年7月29日：The first democratic elections were held. The former sole legal MPRP won 343 out of 430 seats. Four other new parties were elected into parliament.

1990年9月3日：The first democratically elected People's Great Khural took office; the office of the President of the Mongolian People's Republic was created with then-chairman of the presidium Punsalmaagiin Ochirbat as its first officeholder.

1990年9月13日：The first session of the newly established State Little Khural, the lower house of the People's Great Khural, was convened with 50 members. The office of the Vice President of the Mongolian People's Republic was created with Little Khural chairman Radnaasümbereliin Gonchigdorj as its first and only officeholder.
1992年1月13日：A new constitution went into effect, effectively dissolving the Mongolian People's Republic.
1992年4月8日：A new election law was passed.
1992年6月28日：An election was held for the first unicameral legislature, the State Great Khural. The MPRP won a supermajority of 60 seats.
1992年7月29日：The State Little Khural and the office of the Vice President was dissolved as the first session of the State Great Khural convened.
1993年6月6日：The first direct presidential election took place. Opposition candidate Punsalmaagiin Ochirbat, a former MPRP member, won.
1996年6月30日：The opposition Democratic Union Coalition (DUC) won the 1996 parliamentary election. Subsequently, the first non-Communist government was elected into office.
1996年7月18日：Mendsaikhany Enkhsaikhan became the first Democratic prime minister.
1997年5月18日：MPRP candidate Natsagiin Bagabandi defeated incumbent president and DUC candidate Punsalmaagiin Ochirbat in the 1997 presidential election.
1998年4月：Prime Minister Enkhsaikhan was forced to resign due to internal party pressure.
1998年4月23日：DUC chairman Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj was elected (61–6) to succeed Enkhsaikhan.
1998年10月2日：Sanjaasürengiin Zorig, Minister of Infrastructure and one of the Democratic leaders of the 1990 revolution, was murdered in his home.
1998年12月9日：Janlavyn Narantsatsralt was nominated by the State Great Khural and accepted by president Bagabandi as the next prime minister.

1999年7月22日：Prime Minister Narantsatsralt was forced to resign after a controversial letter to the Russian Federation. Rinchinnyamyn Amarjargal was nominated to succeed Narantsatsralt and served until the 2000 election.

2000年7月2日：The MPRP won 72 out of 76 seats in the State Great Khural; a new government was formed by Prime Minister and MPRP chairman Nambaryn Enkhbayar. The DUC witnessed a major electoral wipeout, winning only a single seat.
2000年12月6日：The Democratic Party of Mongolia was founded after the merger of five former member parties of the now-dissolved DUC.
2001年5月20日：Incumbent Bagabandi was re-elected as the 2nd President of Mongolia in the 2001 presidential election.
2003年：Mongolian troops begin taking part in peace keeping operations in Afghanistan, Iraq and Sudan.
2004年：An election resulted in a draw. A coalition was formed between the MPRP and other parties which was headed by Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj.
2006年1月：The governing coalition was dissolved by the MPRP.
2006年1月25日：A new coalition between the MPRP and smaller parties and defectors was formed under Miyeegombyn Enkhbold.
2007年10月：The governing coalition was led by the MPRP and replaced by a coalition headed by Sanjiin Bayar.
2009年6月：Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj from the Democratic Party was selected 3rd President of Mongolia.
2009年10月：Sanjaagiin Bayar resigned from Primer Ministership due to declining health conditions and was replaced with Sükhbaataryn Batbold.
2010年11月：MPRP restored its 1921 name, Mongolian People's Party (MPP), during its 26th Party Congress.
2012年8月：After the 2012 parliamentary election, a coalition headed by Norovyn Altankhuyag from Democratic party was formed.
2013年6月：Tsakhiagiin Elbegdorj from Democratic Party, was re-elected in the 2013 presidential election.
2014年11月5日：Altankhuyag lost a motion of no confidence (36–30), thereby resigned as prime minister and Democratic party chairman
2014年11月21日：Chimediin Saikhanbileg succeeded Altankhuyag as next prime minister, Zandaakhüügiin Enkhbold succeeded as Democratic party chairman
2016年6月29日：In the 2016 parliamentary election, the MPP won a supermajority of 65 seats in the State Great Khural.

2016年7月：Party chairman Miyeegombyn Enkhbold was elected the next chairman of the State Great Khural, whilst Jargaltulgyn Erdenebat was appointed as the next prime minister during the first parliamentary session.
2017年6月26日：During the 2017 presidential election
2017年9月：Erdenebat was voted out of office for alleged incompetence and corruption.
2017年10月：Deputy Prime Minister Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh was nominated and appointed as Erdenebat's successor.
2017年11月：Khürelsükh succeeded speaker Enkhbold as the next MPP chairman.
前563年：Gautama Buddha is born in Kapilvastu in 563 BCE (died in 483 BCE) in Lumbini (present-day Nepal).
前250年：Emperor Ashoka visits Nepal.
205年：Establishment of the Soma dynasty.
305年：Bhaskar Varma, the last ruler of the Soma dynasty, having no sons or daughters adopts Bhoomi Varma to succeed him starting the rule of Licchavi dynasty.
464年：Manadeva reigns until 491 A.D. His reign is characterized by great architectural and sculptural achievements.
588年：Shivadeva I becomes the king.

598年：Amshuverma, who started as a feudal lord and now the prime minister, starts minting coins in his name and assumes the title of Maharajadhiraj reducing the king to a mere figurehead. Eventually, he marries the king's daughter and succeeds Shiva Deva I as the ruler after the king's death. Amshuverma's reign is also characterized by architectural achievements.
621年：Following the death of Amshuverma, Uday Deva becomes the king reviving the Licchavi dynasty's rule.
624年：Uday Deva is ousted by his brother Dhruva Deva, and Jishnu Gupta. He goes to Tibet for help. Dhruva Deva and Jishnu Gupta rule together.
631年：Bishnu Gupta, son of Jishnu Gupta, and Bhimarjuna Deva rule together.
643年：Narendradeva reclaims his ancestral throne with the Tibetan Empire's help.
649年：Narendradeva sends a cavalry of 7,000 troops to aid Tibet in the Battle of Chabuheluo against Arunasva who attacked the emissary Wang Xuance from China.
685年：Shivadeva II, the son of Narendradeva, starts his reign. He marries Batsa Devi, daughter of the prince Bhogvarma of Magadha.
705年：Jayadeva II starts his reign until up to 733. After him, Nepal enters into a dark era which lasts until 1200 C.E.
1097年：Nanyadeva establishes the Karnat dynasty in Simraungadh.
1147年：King Nanyadeva of the Karnat dynasty dies. He is succeeded by his son Gangadeva.
1201年：Arimalla, the first king of the Malla dynasty rules the Kathmandu valley.
1216年：King Arimalla is succeeded by his son Abhaya Malla.
1255年：King Abhaya Malla dies in a massive earthquake that killed one-third of the whole population. He is succeeded by his son Jayadeva Malla.
1244年：Doya from Mithila (Karnat dynasty) invades Nepal three times within two years.
1258年：A period of political struggle begins between the House of Bhonta (the region of Banepa) headed by Jayabhimadeva and the House of Tripura (Bhadgaon) headed by Jayasimha Malla.
1258年：King Jayadeva Malla dies. The two contending houses reach an agreement to share the throne alternately. Jayabhimadeva becomes the King following the agreement.
1271年：Jayasimha Malla becomes the King following the agreement between the two Houses.
1274年：King Jayasimha Malla is deposed with the help of House of Bhonta; Ananta Malla becomes the king.
1287年：Jitari Malla of the Khasa area in the Karnali region attacks Nepal three times until 1290.
1300年：Doya from Mithila invades Nepal again penetrating as far as Bhadgaon, and inflicting fines on the House of Tripura.
1308年：King Ananta Malla dies, leaving the throne vacant.

1311年：After Jayasaktideva of House of Bhonta is defeated by Jayatunga Malla of House of Tripura, Jayasaktideva calls the Doya for help. This backfires as the Doya imprisoned Brahmins, looted people and set houses on fire.
1312年：Following an agreement between the House of Tripura and the Tirhuts, along with other wealth, Devalakshmidevi, the daughter of Jayatunga Malla, is given in marriage to King Harisimhadeva.
1312年：Ripu Malla from the Khasa kingdom visits the Kathmandu valley.
1312年：Jayarudra Malla, the son of Jayatunga Malla, controls much of the valley.
1313年：After five years without a King, Jayarudra Malla installs Jayanandadeva, his rival from the House of Bhonta, as the ruler.
1320年：Jayarudra Malla withdraws support for Jayanandadeva and installs Jayari Malla, his relative and the son of Ananta Malla, as the King.
1324年：The Karnat Kingdom of Mithila is annexed by the King of Delhi. The invader then sets up a vassal state appointing from the Oiniwar dynasty a ruler of the region.

1324年：King Harisimhadeva of Mithila, along with his wife Devalakshmidevi and so Jagatsimha flees to Kathmandu Valley. Harisimha dies on the way and Devalakshmidevi, and Jagatsimha were welcomed by her brother, Jayarudra Malla.
1328年：Aditya Malla from the Khasa Kingdom invades the Kathmandu valley.
1330年：Jayarudra Malla dies at the age of 30, leaving Nayakadevi, his daughter, to assume the throne of House of Tripura.
1335年：Harischandra, the husband of Nayakadevi, was poisoned by the nobles.
1344年：King Jayari Malla dies.
1347年：Rajalladevi is born to Nayakadevi and Jagatsimha. Nayakadevi dies ten days later and Jagatsimha was thrown to prison leaving Rajalladevi to the care of Devalakshmidevi.

1347年：Devalakshmidevi comes to an agreement with the House of Bhonta on the condition that a king would be from the House of Bhonta while Devalakshmidevi would act as the de facto ruler. Following this agreement, Jayarajadeva, the illegitimate son of the late King Jayanandadeva, becomes the King. Devalakshmidevi, however, is given royal titles higher than the King himself.

1349年：Sultan Shams ud-din Ilyas of Bengal conquers Tirhut and leads raid in Kathmandu Valley destroying temples and damaging the images of gods and goddesses. This event is often cited as the one that destroyed much of the Lichchhavi era and early Malla era monuments and artifacts.
1354年：Rajalladevi marries Jayasthiti Malla. It is generally accepted that Jayasthiti Malla was brought from Mithila by Devalakshmidevi to marry Rajalladevi.
1361年：King Jayarajadeva dies. He is succeeded by his son Jayarjunadeva.
1366年：Devalakshmidevi dies. Jayasthiti Malla starts on gathering political power.
1382年：Jayasthiti Malla rules as king of the united Malla kingdom in Kathmandu Valley.
1395年：King Jayasthiti Malla dies. His three sons Dharma Malla, Jyoti Malla, and Kiti Malla rule together.
1408年：Jyoti Malla rules as the sole king of Kathmandu Valley after the death of both his brothers.
1428年：King Jyoti Malla dies. His son Yakshya Malla succeeds him.
1482年：King Yakshya Malla dies. His kingdom is divided in three between his sons with Ratna Malla controlling Kantipur, and Raya Malla controlling Bhaktapur.
1520年：King Ratna Malla dies. His son Surya Malla succeeds him as the king.
1526年：Mukunda Sen of Palpa attacks the entire Kathmandu valley and surrounds both Kantipur, and Patan. He is defeated by the combined forces of the valley.
1530年：King Surya Malla dies. He is succeeded by his son Amara Malla. Amara Malla annexed several villages north-west of Kantipur.
1560年：King Amara Malla dies. His son Mahendra Malla succeeds him. Mahendra Malla issued the first silver coins.
1574年：King Mahendra Malla is succeeded by his first son Sadashiva Malla.
1581年：Shivasimha Malla, the second son of Mahendra Malla, deposes his brother Sadashiva Malla and rules Kantipur. Sadashiva takes refuge in Bhadgaon where he dies.
1600年：King Shivasimha Malla annexes Patan and installs his son Harisimhadeva as the governor. Harisimhadeva dies shortly afterwards, and his son Siddhi Narasimha Malla succeeds him as the governor.
1606年：Ram Shah of Gorkha reigns; Gorkha kingdom experiences its first expansion (to 1633).
1619年：King Shivasimha Malla dies. His son Lakshmi Narasimha Malla succeeds him as the King of Kantipur, and his grandson Siddhi Narasimha Malla declares Patan independent from Kantipur.
1641年：King Lakshmi Narasimha Malla goes insane after executing his loyal minister. Pratap Malla imprisons him and rules Kantipur.
1674年：Nripendra Malla starts his reign after his Pratap Malla's death defying the wishes of his father to install Mahipatendra Malla as the king.
1680年：Parthibendra Malla, another son of Pratap Malla, starts his reign after the death of King Nripendra Malla.

1687年：King Parthibendra Malla is poisoned by the nobles and on his death, as many as twenty-four women went Sati. He is succeeded by his 14 years old son Bhupalendra Malla with his wife Riddhilakshmi acting as the regent.
1688年：Lakshminarayan, a minister, rises to the power of supreme authority and inscribes his name on the coin issued by the monarch. He also assassinates prominent nobles.
1690年：Lakshminarayan is assassinated following a rumor of illicit relationship with the regent and the king's mother, Riddhilakshmi.
1700年：King Bhupalendra Malla dies. He is succeeded by his son Bhaskara Malla.
1717年：King Bhaskara Malla proclaims the title of King of Patan and issues coins under the name Gajapati Mahindra Simha.
1720年：An epidemic breaks out in Kantipur killing approximately 20,000 people.

1722年：After about six months in confinement to be safe from the plague, King Bhaskara Malla returns to the palace after the death rate dropped. He dies some days later due to the plague. He is succeeded by Jagajjaya Malla, the grandson of Mahipatendra Malla.
1730年：King Jagajjaya Malla's first son Rajendra Malla dies.
1736年：Jayaprakash Malla succeeds King Jagajjaya Malla after the latter's death.
1743年：Prithvi Narayan Shah ascends to throne of Gorkha.
1764年：British East India Company gains control of Bengal.
1768年：Gorkha ruler Prithvi Narayan Shah conquers Kathmandu and lays foundations for unified kingdom.
1769年：Conquest of Chaudandi and Majh Kirant states.
1792年：Nepalese expansion is halted by the defeat at hands of Chinese in Tibet.
1806年：Bhimsen Thapa becomes the first Mukhtiyar (prime minister).
1809年：Nepalese troops lay siege to Kangra, farthest extent of Gurkha empire.
1814年：Anglo-Nepalese War (1814–1816) ends resulting in Sugauli Treaty which establishes Nepal's current boundaries and sows the seeds for political instability.
1837年：Bhimsen Thapa falls, beginning unstable period in court politics.
1846年：Kot massacre results in the killing of more than 40 members of the palace and starts the autocratic Rana dynasty in Nepal with Jung Bahadur Rana as its first prime minister.
1855年：War starts with China (until 1858).
1856年：Royal decree gives absolute power to prime minister and his family.
1857年：Sepoy Rebellion is waged against British in north India; Nepal aids British (until 1858).
1858年：Jang Bahadur receives the title of Rana.
1877年：Prime minister Jung Bahadur Rana dies; Ranodip Singh Kunwar becomes the prime minister.
1885年：Prime minister Ranodip Singh Kunwar is assassinated by his nephews; Bir Shumsher becomes the prime minister.
1901年3月5日：Prime minister Bir Shumsher dies; Dev Shumsher becomes the prime minister.
1901年3月27日：Prime minister Dev Shumsher is deposed by his relatives; Chandra Shumsher becomes the prime minister.
1914年：Thousands of Nepalese citizens (including the Gurkhas) fight as soldiers for British in World War I (to 1918)
1923年12月21日：Treaty with Britain affirms Nepal's sovereignty.
1935年6月2日：Nepal's first political party, Nepal Praja Parishad is founded (led by Tanka Prasad Acharya).
1939年：Tens of thousands of Nepalese citizens (including Gurkhas) fight as soldiers for the British in World War II (to 1945).
1946年1月25日：Nepali National Congress is formed (led by BP Koirala, Matrika Prasad Koirala, Ganesh Man Singh, etc.).
1948年：Prime Minister Padma Shamsher Rana announces first constitution of Nepal, then resigns; his replacement, Mohan Shamsher Rana, represses opposition
1951年1月7日：Tribhuvan returns from exile and reclaims the title of King putting an end to the autocratic Rana dynasty
1951年2月18日：Rana system is abolished. Democratic experiment inaugurated with the appointment of an interim government under Prime Minister Mohan Shamsher.
1951年11月16日：Matrika Prasad Koirala becomes the first commoner to be elected a prime minister
1953年5月29日：New Zealander Edmund Hillary and Nepal's Sherpa Tenzing Norgay become the first climbers to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
1955年3月15日：King Tribhuwan dies, King Mahendra ascends throne.
1955年12月14日：Nepal joins the United Nations.
1959年5月27日：Multi-party constitution is adopted and the first general elections in Nepal brings Nepali Congress to power with B.P. Koirala as the first democratically elected prime minister.
1960年12月15日：King Mahendra leads a coup d'état dismissing the cabinet of B.P. Koirala and introduces the Panchayat, a partyless political system.
1962年：New constitution provides for non-party system of councils known as Panchayat under which king exercises sole power. First elections to Rastrya Panchayat held in 1963.
1972年1月31日：King Mahendra dies, succeeded by Birendra.

1980年5月2日：In the 1980 Nepalese governmental system referendum, the people vote in favor of the Panchayat system against a multi-party system. The Panchayat system receives a total of 2.4 million votes, while the multi-party system receives 2 million votes.
1985年：Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist–Leninist) begins civil disobedience campaign for restoration of multi-party system.
1989年：Trade and transit dispute with India leads to border blockade by Delhi resulting in worsening economic situation.
1990年2月18日：1990 Nepalese revolution commences led by Nepali Congress and the communist parties.
1991年5月12日：First multi-party election is held. NC wins a majority of 110 seats. The communist parties gather a total of 82 seats. Girija Prasad Koirala becomes the prime minister.

1994年7月11日：Division within the NC results in Girija Prasad Koirala losing the support of 36 congress members in a parliamentary vote. He resigns and King Birendra dismisses the cabinet announcing a new election.

1994年11月15日：Second multi-party election is held. CPN (UML) led by Man Mohan Adhikari wins the election with 88 votes. NC led by Girija Prasad Koirala wins 83 votes. RPP led by Surya Bahadur Thapa wins 20 votes. Man Mohan Adhikari heads a minority government.

1995年：Radical leftist group, the CPN (MC), begins insurrection in rural areas aimed at abolishing monarch and establishing a people's republic, sparking a conflict that would drag on for over a decade.
1995年9月10日：Prime minister Man Mohan Adhikari resigns after losing in a Congress-led no-confidence motion. Sher Bahadur Deuba becomes the new prime minister.
1997年3月6日：Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba loses a no-confidence vote, ushering in a period of increased political instability, with frequent changes of the prime minister.
2000年3月16日：Girija Prasad Koirala returns as the prime minister, heading the ninth government in 10 years.
2001年6月1日：Nepalese royal massacre occurs; King Birendra and his family dies, and Dipendra is crownd king while in hospital.
2001年6月4日：King Dipendra is pronounced dead; His uncle Gyanendra becomes the king.
2001年7月26日：Maoist rebels step up campaign of violence. Prime Minister Girija Prasad Koirala quits over the violence; succeeded by Sher Bahadur Deuba.
2001年11月13日：Maoists end four-month-old truce with government, declare peace talks with government failed. Launch coordinated attacks on army and police posts.
2001年11月26日：The government declares a state of emergency throughout the country and full mobilization of the army against rebels listing the CPN (Maoist Centre) as a "terrorist organization".
2002年5月22日：King Gyanendra dissolves the parliament and called for early elections. Sher Bahadur Deuba heads the interim government, and renews the state of emergency.

2002年10月4日：Prime minister Deuba formally asks the king to defer the election dates until November 2003. King Gyanendra responds by dismissing the government headed by Deuba, removing Deuba as the prime minister, postponing the elections indefinitely, and assuming full executive power.
2002年10月11日：Lokendra Bahadur Chand is appointed as the prime minister.
2003年1月：Rebels, government declare ceasefire.
2003年6月5日：Lokendra Bahadur Chand resigns as PM; king appoints his own nominee Surya Bahadur Thapa as new premier (to June).
2003年8月：Rebels pull out of peace talks with government and end seven-month truce. The following months see resurgence of violence and frequent clashes between students/activists and police.
2004年4月：Nepal joins the World Trade Organisation (WTO).
2004年5月：Royalist Prime Minister Surya Bahadur Thapa resigns following weeks of street protests by opposition groups.
2004年6月5日：King Gyanendra reappoints Sher Bahadur Deuba as prime minister with the task of holding elections.

2005年2月1日：2005 Nepal coup d'état by King Gyanendra after which he assumes absolute direct power, sacks the government, and declares a state of emergency restoring absolute monarchy. Many prominent leaders including the prime minister were placed under house arrest.
2005年4月30日：King lifts the state of emergency amid international pressure.
2005年11月22日：Several political parties and the CPN (Maoist Centre) sign an agreement to work together against the rule of King Gyanendra.
2006年4月24日：King Gyanendra reinstates the dissolved parliament calling the Seven Party Alliance to lead the government.
2006年5月：Parliament votes unanimously to curtail the king's political powers. The government and Maoist rebels begin peace talks, the first in nearly three years.
2006年6月16日：Rebel leader Chairman Prachanda and PM Koirala hold talks – the first such meeting between the two sides – and agree that the Maoists should be brought into an interim government.
2006年11月：Comprehensive Peace Accord is signed between the Government of Nepal and Maoist Leader Prachanda which allows the Maoist to join mainstream politics.
2007年1月：Maoist leaders enter parliament under the terms of a temporary constitution. Violent ethnic protests erupt in the south-east; demonstrators demand autonomy for the region.
2007年4月：Former Maoist rebels join interim government, a move that takes them into the political mainstream.
2007年5月：Elections for a constituent assembly pushed back to November.
2007年5月：A US offer to resettle thousands of Bhutanese refugees in Nepal has raised hopes but has also sparked tension in the camps, says Human Rights Watch.
2007年9月：Three bombs hit Kathmandu in the first attack in the capital since the end of the Maoist insurgency.
2007年9月：Maoists quit interim government to press demand for monarchy to be scrapped. This forces the postponement of November's constituent assembly elections.
2007年10月：UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon urges Nepal's parties to sink their differences to save the peace process.
2007年12月：Parliament approves abolition of monarchy as part of peace deal with Maoists, who agree to re-join government.
2008年1月：A series of bomb blasts kill and injure dozens in the southern Terai plains. Groups there have been demanding regional autonomy.
2008年5月：Nepali Congress leader Bal Chandra Poudel attacked by maoists in Dandagaun, Rasuwa during election

2008年4月10日：The First Nepalese Constituent Assembly election is held where the CPN (MC) emerged victorious winning 220 out of the 575 seats. It forms the government with seven other communist parties including the CPN (UML).
2008年5月28日：Constituent Assembly abolishes monarchy in Nepal, and declares Nepal a federal republic.
2008年6月：Maoist ministers resign from the cabinet in a row over who should be the next head of state.
2008年7月23日：Dr. Ram Baran Yadav becomes the first president of Nepal.
2008年8月15日：Prachanda is elected as the prime minister by the constituent assembly.

2009年5月4日：Prime minister Prachanda sacks General Rookmangud Katawal. CPN (UML) withdraws its support from the government in protest. President Ram Baran Yadav overrides the decision resulting in the resignation of Prachanda the next day.
2009年5月25日：Madhav Kumar Nepal of CPN (UML) becomes the prime minister with support from 22 of the 25 parties.
2010年3月20日：Former prime minister and NCP leader Girija Prasad Koirala dies.
2010年6月30日：Prime minister Madhav Kumar Nepal announces his resignation blaming the CPN (MC) for their continuous obstruction in the government.

2011年2月3日：CPN (MC) withdraws its candidate and backs Jhala Nath Khanal of CPN (UML). Khanal becomes the prime minister after more than seven months of political gridlock and more than sixteen rounds of voting in the parliament.
2011年8月28日：Dr. Baburam Bhattarai is elected as the prime minister after he gets support from some smaller parties after the resignation of Jhala Nath Khanal.

2012年5月28日：Prime minister Baburam Bhattarai dissolves the constituent assembly after it failed to promulgate a new constitution four years after its election and calls for a fresh election for 22 November.

2013年3月14日：Prime minister Baburam Bhattarai resigns. Chief Justice Khil Raj Regmi becomes the interim prime minister until the elections after four main political parties agreed to form a CJ-led electoral cabinet.

2013年11月19日：The Second Nepalese Constituent Assembly election is held where the NC led by Sushil Koirala emerges as the largest party winning 196 out of the 576 seats. The CPN (UML) wins 175 seats while the CPN (MC) wins 80 seats.
2014年2月25日：Sushil Koirala of Nepali Congress is elected as the prime minister with CPN (UML) backing.

2015年4月25日：The 7.8 Moment mag. scale"}]]}'>Mw Nepal earthquake affected the country with a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent), the worst natural disaster to strike Nepal since the 1934 Nepal–Bihar earthquake, killing more than 8,000 people and injuring more than 20,000 people.
2015年9月20日：President Dr. Ram Baran Yadav promulgates the Constitution of Nepal (2015) replacing the Interim Constitution of 2007.
2015年10月11日：CPN (UML) leader KP Sharma Oli is elected as the prime minister by the parliament with the backing from CPN (MC).
2015年10月29日：Bidya Devi Bhandari becomes the second president of Nepal.
2017年：Nepal holds its first general election since the end of the civil war, with the Communist party's alliance winning.
2020年：The COVID-19 pandemic significantly impacts Nepal.
2021年：Prime Minister Khadga Prasad Sharma Oli was replaced by Sher Bahadur Deuba following a constitutional crisis within the government.
2023年：The population of Nepal reached 30.2 million people.

2025年：After weeks of deadly youth-led protests against corruption and a social media ban, Nepal's Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli resigned. In the resulting turmoil, protesters set fire to government buildings, and security forces clashed with demonstrators, killing dozens. Former Chief Justice Sushila Karki was sworn in as interim Prime Minister, with elections set for March 2026. Karki pledged to address the youth's demands and serve for a maximum of six months.
2026年8月26日：2026 Nepal–Tibet floods

前300000年－前100000年：Flake tools, microliths and other chopping tools have been found in Soan Valley. Most of these tools were composed of the metamorphic quartzite rocks. The stone tool artifacts in this assemblage have been identified as a part of the second inter-pluvial period in Pakistan.

前43000年：The archaeological site of Riwat 55 dates back to this period. It is modern form of Early Riwat Site. Riwat 55 contains a structure that includes a low wall footing, a pit, and a stone-lined niche, all associated with a freshly flaked stone assemblage that included blades.

前3500年－前3300年：Mature phases of the Indus Valley Civilization begins. The civilization used an early form of the Indus signs, also called Indus script. Over the course of next 1000–1500 years, inhabitants of the civilization developed new techniques in handicraft (carnelian products and seal carving) and metallurgy (copper, bronze, lead, and tin) had elaborate urban planning, baked brick houses, efficient drainage systems, water supply systems, and clusters of large non-residential buildings. The civilization depended significantly on trade, was the first civilization to use wheeled transport in form of bullock carts, and also used boats.
links: Periodisation of the Indus Valley Civilisation

items.text: 前2700年－前2600年：The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro become large metropolises and the civilization expands to over 2,500 cities and settlements across the whole region of modern-day Pakistan, covering a region of around one million square miles, which was larger than the land area of its contemporaries Egypt and Mesopotamia combined, and also had superior urban planning and sewage systems. The civilization began using the mature Indus script for its writing system.

前2500年－前2000年：The culture, artichetere, technology and educational system of Indus Valley civilization reached at its zenith with Harappa and Kot Diji as main centres. These fluctuations reflect complex and dynamic political, ideological, and economic processes that are an integral part of urban society.
前1900年－前1300年：Late Harappan Phase (Cemetery H Culture)
前1300年：Cemetery H culture comes to an end
前1000年：Middle and Late Vedic period (to 500 BCE)
前1000年：Iron Age of Indian subcontinent (including today's Pakistan)
前600年：Sixteen Maha Janapadas ("Great Realms" or "Great Kingdoms") emerge.
前600年：Vedic period ends.
前535年－前518年：Achaemenid Emperors launched Persian campaign of Indus Valley and in result parts of modern-day Pakistan became easternmost part of Achaemenid Empire
links: Achaemenid conquest of the Indus Valley

items.text: 前500年：Gandhara Civilization at first stage of its flourishness.
前500年－前450年：Persian rule is at its zenith.
前500年：Roruka as capital of Sauvira Kingdom become most important trading center of Indian subcontinent, also mentioned in early Buddhist literature.
前333年：Persian rule in the Pakistan ends after Darius III is defeated by Alexander the Great, who establishes the Macedonian Empire after inheriting the Persian Achaemenid Empire.
前326年：Ambhi king of Takshila surrenders to Alexander.
前326年：Porus who ruled parts of the Punjab, fought Alexander at the Battle of the Hydaspes River.
前325年：During the Mallian Campaign, Alexander was seriously wounded by an arrow in the chest and this became reason of his death.
前321年：Mauryan Empire is founded by Chandragupta Maurya.
前305年：Chandragupta Maurya defeats Seleucus Nicator of the Seleucid Empire.
前304年：Seleucus gives up his territories (Balochistan) to Chandragupta in exchange for 500 elephants. Seleucus offers his daughter in marriage to Chandragupta to seal their friendship.

前200年－前150年：Gandhara Civilization (present day Khyber Pakhtunkhwa) flourished in new way by combination of Hellenistic culture and Ancient Indian culture. Taxila became centre of Gandhara Civilization and religion of Buddhism.
前75年：Arrival of Scythians (Sakas) from Central Asia.
前58年：Beginning of Vikram Era.
20年－35年：Indo-Parthian Kingdom was established and conquered present northern Pakistan.
35年：Western Satraps formed.
68年：Establishment of the Kushan Empire by Kujula Kadphises.
240年：Sri Gupta starts the establishment of Gupta Empire in Indian subcontinent (including present Pakistan).
260年：Kushans decline and are dominated by Indo-Sassanians.
320年：Chandragupta I ascends the throne of Gupta Empire.
320年：Kidarite Kingdom came to power in the region of modern-day Pakistan.
335年：Samudragupta ascends the Gupta throne and expands the empire.
380年：Chandragupta II, Samudragupta's son becomes the Gupta Emperor.
450年：White Huns (Hephthalites) attacked Gandhara, sacked its cities and burnt down its many monasteries and centres of learning.
524年：Rai dynasty come to power in the region of Sindh.
554年：Collapse of Gupta Empire after the death of Skandagupta.
565年：Sassanians and Turks overthrow Huns.
601年：Rai dynasty reached at its zenith and covered whole of Pakistan and Afghanistan with the capital of Aror, Sindh.
632年：Brahman dynasty come into power and Chach of Aror become Maharaja of Sindh.
644年：Islam arrived in Indian subcontinent. Rashidun Caliphate defeated Rai dynasty in the Battle of Rasil and Balochistan become easternmost frontier of Rashidun Caliphate.
665年：Turk Shahi gained control west of the Indus River, including Gandhara.
671年：At the death of Chach of Alor, the Brahmin dynasty reached its zenith and he was succeeded by his brother Chandar of Sindh.
679年：Chandar of Sindh died and succeeded by his nephew Raja Dahir, last Hindu Maharaja of Sindh.
708年－709年：Al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf sent a force under Ubaidullah ibn Nabhan to raid Debal. Ubaidullah was defeated and slain in battle.

710年：Al-Hajjaj dispatched a second, larger force under Budail ibn Tahafe towards Debal. Budail’s army met the forces of Jaisiah (son of Raja Dahir) in a day-long battle. The Umayyad army was routed, and Budail was killed.
712年：Muhammad Bin Qasim defeated Raja Dahir and established Umayyad Islamic rule on Sindh and southern Punjab (Multan) on the orders of Al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf.
links: Muslim conquests in the Indian subcontinent

items.text: 747年－751年：Umayyad Era finished and Abbasid Era begins. Mansur ibn Jumhur al-Kalbi revolted against Umayyad Dynasty during Abbasid Revolution and after Abbasid victory in revolution, he was confirmed as Abbasid Governor of Sindh.
links: List of caliphal governors of Sind

items.text: 841年：Dynastic rule of Habbaris over Sindh begin under suzerainty of Abbasid Caliphate.
870年：Hindu Shahis captured Kingdom of Kabul Shahi and expanded their rule in Khyber Pukhtunkhwa and Punjab.
875年：Habbari dynasty rule expanded over whole of Sindh, Southern Balochistan and southern Punjab (Multan).
977年－997年：Sabuktigin of Ghaznavid dynasty defeated many times Hindu Shahi ruler Jayapala and became ruler of domains east of the Indus River.
1001年：Mahmud Ghazni defeated Raja Jayapala of Hindu Shahi; after that Jayapala commits suicide.

1021年：Mahmud Ghazni defeats Raja Tarnochalpal and Punjab becomes part of Ghaznavid dynasty. In this way whole of Pakistan comes under Muslim rule; Punjab and Khyber Pukhtunkhwa under Ghaznavid Empire, Sindh under Habbari dynasty while Makran (Balochistan) under Caliphate.
links: Muslim conquests in the Indian subcontinent

items.text: 1030年：Alberuni arrives in Indian subcontinent; death of Mahmud Ghazni.
1058年：Muslim Rajput Soomra Dynasty ends the rule of Habbari dynasty and starts to rule on the behave of Abbasid Caliph.
1092年：Reign of Zainab Tari begins; first absolute female ruler in the history of South Asia as well as only female who ruled Sindh.
1175年：Muhammad of Ghurid dynasty defeats Qarmatians rulers of Multan in 1175.
1186年：Muhammad Ghori along with Ghiyath al-Din Muhammad ends the rule of Ghaznavid dynasty after having captured Lahore.
1191年："Victory of Prithviraj Chauhan". First Battle of Tarain fought between Muhammad Ghori and Prithviraj III. Ghori is defeated by Prithivi Raj Chauhan III.
1192年："Victory of Muhammad Ghori". Second Battle of Tarain fought between Muhammad Ghori and Prithivi Raj Chauhan III. Chauhan is defeated by Muhammad Ghori.
1193年：Qutb al-Din Aibak becomes deputy of Ghurid Empire in Indian subcontinent.
1206年3月15日：Khukhrains kill Muhammad Ghori during a raid on his camp on the Jhelum River.
1206年6月12日：End of Ghurid Era.
1206年6月25日：Qutb-ud-din Aibak establishes Delhi Sultanate by becoming first Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate from Mamluk dynasty.
1210年11月：Qutb-ud-din Aibak died while playing polo.
1210年12月：Aram Shah becomes new Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1211年6月：Shams ud-Din Iltutmish defeats Aram Shah in the Battle of Delhi and become third Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1221年：Genghis Khan invades Punjab during rule of Iltutmish.
1236年4月30日：Iltutmish dies and Rukn ud din Firuz become fourth Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1236年10月10日：Razia Sultana abolishes the rule of Rukn ud din Firuz and become fifth Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1240年5月17日：Muiz ud din Bahram becomes sixth Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1240年10月14日：Murder of Razia Sultan by nobles of Chalisa.
1242年5月15日：Murder of Muiz ud din Bahram by army. Ala ud din Masud becomes seventh Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1246年6月10日：Nasiruddin Mahmud becomes eighth Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate with the support of Corps of Forty. Balban rules on the behave of Nasiruddin Mahmud as a deputy of empire.
1266年2月18日：Nasiruddin Mahmud dies without any hier. Ghiyas ud din Balban becomes ninth Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1285年：Delhi Sultanate decisively defeats the army of Mongol Empire at the battle of Beas River.
1287年3月：Muiz ud din Qaiqabad becomes tenth Sultan of Delhi Sultanate after the death of his grandfather Ghiyas ud din Balban.
1290年2月1日：Murder of Muiz ud din Qaiqabad by Jalaluddin Firuz Khalji, an army commander. Shamsuddin Kayumars becomes eleventh Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1290年6月13日：Jalaluddin Firuz Khalji ends the Mamluk Dynasty by murdering Shamsuddin Kayumars. Establishment of Khalji dynasty. Jalaluddin becomes twelfth Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1296年7月19日：Alauddin Khalji murders Jalaluddin Firuz Khalji and become thirteen Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1296年10月：Allauddin Khalji conquers Multan and eliminates all surviving members of his predecessor Jalaluddin Firuz Khalji.
1297年－1298年：Mongol Army invades Punjab and Sindh but Delhi Sultanate decisively defeats them and crushes away from Pakistan.
1298年：Mongols once again invades Sindh and occupies fort of Sivistan but Delhi Sultanate decisively defeats them.
1316年1月4日：Alauddin Khalji died due to severe illness.
1316年1月5日：Shihabuddin Omar succeeded Alauddin Khalji with the help of Malik Kafur and becomes the 14th Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1316年4月14日：After the assassination of Malik Kafur, Qutbuddin Mubarak Shah dethroned his brother Shihabuddin Omar and himself becomes 15th Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.
1351年：Samma Dynasty assumes rule over Sindh
1398年：Tamerlane plunders Lahore
1526年－1857年：Mughal ascendancy (1526–1707),
1541年－1545年：Sher Shah Sur builds the Rohtas Fort
1586年：Yusufzais defeat Akbar at the Karakar pass
1701年：Kalhoro Dynasty establishes its rule over Sindh
1707年－1857年：Nominal rule by Mughals
1739年：Nadir Shah of Persia invades Mughal Empire
1751年－1752年：Ahmed Shah Abdali annexes Punjab to his kingdom
1758年－1759年：Maratha conquest of North-west India
1782年：The Baloch tribe of Talpur defeats the last Kalhora ruler Mian Abdul Nabi in the battle of Halani
1801年4月12日－1839年6月27日：Sikhs become dominant force in Punjab, Ranjit Singh rules (1799–1839),
1843年：British defeat Talpurs in the battle of Miani and annex Sindh
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1849年3月29日：British defeat Sikhs and annex Punjab
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1849年：1 November 1857 The British control most present-day Pakistan region and incorporate it as part of the British Indian Empire.
1906年12月30日：A new political party All-India Muslim League formed to protect rights of Muslims in British Indian Empire.
1909年：Muhammad Ali Jinnah was elected to the Legislative Council in 1909

1913年：Prominent Muslim leader Muhammad Ali Jinnah, acknowledging that Hindu dominant Indian Congress failing to protect Indian Muslim rights, joined the All India Muslim League (AIML). Now he was member of both the political parties, later became leader of the All-India Muslim League and instrumental in the creation of Pakistan.
1920年：Having disagreement with Gandhi on the issue of Swaraj (self-rule), complete freedom from the British and on using extra-constitutional means, Jinnah resigned from the Congress in 1920
1921年：MAO College Aligarh upgraded to Aligrah Muslim University

1930年12月29日：Dr. Muhammad Allama Iqbal, a great Muslim philosopher and poet suggested creation of separate Muslim state in Indian sub-continent to protect Muslim population dominated by Hindu majority.
1935年5月31日：A strong earthquake with a magnitude of 7.7 jolted Quetta killing over 50,000 people
1947年8月14日：Pakistan gains independence from the United Kingdom.
1947年：3 June: British Government decides to separate British India, into two sovereign Dominions of India and Pakistan.
1947年：8 July: Constituent Assembly of Pakistan approves the design of Pakistan.

1947年：26 July: The Gazette of India publishes that the first Constituent Assembly of Pakistan was given shape with 69 members (later on the membership was increased to 79), including one female member.

1947年：14 August: Pakistan became independent. Quaid-a-Azam took oath as the first Governor General of Pakistan. Liaqat Ali Khan took oath as the first Prime minister of Pakistan. This is followed by the migration of 10 million people, Muslims to Pakistan, Hindus and Sikhs to India .

1947年：18 August: The Nawab Mohammad Mahabat Khanji III, ruler of the Princely state of Junagadh, and other small states of Bantva, Manavadar and Sardargadh, of the Kathiawar Peninsula despite an overall Hindu majority of the population all acceded to the Dominion of Pakistan, this was influenced by Shah Nawaz Bhutto the Dewan of the state. In response, the Dominion of India claimed that the accession was invalid and demanded a plebiscite . Pakistan agreed, on condition that votes also be held in Hyderabad State and Kashmir and Jammu; India rejected this proposal and also refused to allow the Government of Pakistan any role in administering a plebiscite. It was followed by Indian invasion of junagarh .
1947年：30 September: Pakistan becomes a member of the UN by a unanimous vote of the Security Council.
1947年：October: 1947 Poonch rebellion against Maharaja of Kashmir ends with rebel victory and Azad Kashmir is formed.
1947年：The Nawab (or Ameer) of Bahawalpur, Sadeq Mohammad Khan V, acceded his state to Pakistan.
1947年：The state of Khairpur also acceded to Pakistan.
1947年：3 October:
1947年：6 October: The Mehtar of Chitral, Muzaffar-ul-Mulk, acceded his state to Pakistan.
1947年：22 October: Battle of Muzaffarabad ends in a Pakistani victory and Muzaffarabad is made the capital of Azad Kashmir.
1947年：27 October: Indian Air troops land in Kashmir as the Maharajah declares accession of Kashmir to India.
1947年：November: Operation Datta Khel is carried out. Gilgit is annexed into Pakistan.
1947年：The Wāli of Swat, Miangul Abdul Wadud, acceded his state to Pakistan.
1947年：Hunza, a small princely state to the north of Jammu and Kashmir acceded to Pakistan.
1947年：Battle of Badgam ends in an Indian victory.
1947年：3 November:
1947年：7 November: Battle of Shalateng ends in an Indian victory.
1947年：18 November: Nagar, a small valley state to the north of Kashmir acceded to Pakistan.

1947年：27 December: A Douglas C-48C (VT-AUG) of Air India crashed into Korangi Creek en route from Karachi to Bombay, killing all 23 onboard (4 crew and 19 passengers). The crash was found to have been the result of poor visibility during night hours and the instrument lights not working, with serious fault assigned to the captain. The crash was Pakistan's first deadly airliner crash.
1947年：Muhammad Farid Khan, Nawab of Amb, acceded to Pakistan.
1947年：Khanate of Phulra acceded to Pakistan.
1947年：31 December:'
1948年：1 January: UNO cease-fire orders to operate in Kashmir. War stops accordingly.
1948年：8 February: The Nawab of Dir, Sir Nawab Shah Jahan Khan acceded to Pakistan.
1948年：11 February: The outposts at Tsari established by Col Thapa as an external defence and warning for Skardu garrison is defeated in an assault led by Gilgit scouts
1948年：24 February: Referendum approves Junagadh's accession to India.
1948年：11 February: Siege of Skardu begins.
1948年：25 February: Junagadh's Accession to India in effect.
1948年：Las Bela's ruler Ghulam Qadir Khan (1920–1988) acceded to Pakistan.
1948年：Makran acceded to Pakistan
1948年：17 March:
1948年：27 March: Kalat acceded to Pakistan after the 'strange help' of All India Radio and a period of negotiations and bureaucratic tactics used by Pakistan.
1948年：1 May: Indo-Pakistani War of 1947, Pakistan enters war on behalf of Kashmir against India.
1948年：29 June: Operation Eraze is successfully executed by Indian forces.
1948年：1 July: Quaid-e-Azam inaugurated the State Bank of Pakistan.

1948年：July: First Balochistan conflict Princes Karim Khan and Muhammad Rahim started a rebellion against Pakistan led the Dosht-e Jhalawan (numbering around 1000 militants), they captured Jhalawan and started unconventional attacks on the army.
1948年：24 July: Battle of Pandu ends in a Pakistani victory.
1948年：14 August: Siege of Skardu ends in a Pakistani victory.
1948年：Waziristan rebellion (1948-1954) The Faqir of Ipi supported by Afghanistan took control of North Waziristan's Datta Khel area and declared the establishment of an independent Pashtunistan.
1948年：11 September: Muhammad Ali Jinnah, the first governor general of Pakistan, passes away.
1948年：14 September: Khwaja Nazimuddin becomes 2nd Governor-General of Pakistan.
1948年：November: Operation Bison ends in an Indian victory.
1949年：1 January: United Nations Cease-fire Line established between Pakistan Administered Kashmir (GB & AJ&K) and Indian Administered Kashmir
1949年：8 February: Azad Kashmir Government shifts its capital to Muzaffarabad.
1949年：12 March: Objectives Resolution passed by Liaquat Ali Khan.

1949年：June: A Pakistan Air Force warplane inadvertently bombed the Afghan village of Mughalgai while chasing the Pashtunistan separatists who attacked Pakistani positions, this attack killed 23 people.
1949年：27 July: Pakistan and India sign the Karachi Agreement.
1950年：8 April: Liaquat and Nehru sign the Liaquat-Nehru Pact.
1950年：5 June: PC Pak Search Sudhan Operation is launched against Sudhan tribal insurgents.
1950年：11 July: Pakistan joins the International Monetary Fund and World Bank.
30年9月：Afghan troops cross into the Chaman District, before they are defeated and repulsed in just six days.
1950年：Princes Karim Khan and Muhammad Rahim surrender themselves to Pakistani authorities ending the First Balochistan conflict.
1951年：17 January: General Ayub Khan becomes the first non-British Chief of the Army Staff of Pakistan when he replaces General Sir Douglas David Gracey as the chief of army staff.

1951年：23 February: Rawalpindi conspiracy, Eleven military officers including Major General Akbar Khan and four civilians including prominent poet Faiz Ahmad Faiz and Communist Party of Pakistan leaders Syed Sajjad Zaheer and Muhammad Hussain Ata organise a plot to attempt a coup d'état against the government of Pakistan.
1951年：9 March: Prime Minister Liaquat Ali Khan announced the foiling of the Rawalpindi conspiracy coup and the conspirators were exposed.
1951年：16 October: First Prime Minister Liaqat Ali Khan assassinated in Liaqat National Bagh, Rawalpindi.

1951年：17 October: Finance Minister Malik Ghulam Mohammad (1895–1956) of Muslim League becomes the third Governor General. Governor-General Khawaja Nazimuddin of Muslim League becomes the second Prime Minister.
1951年：21 August: Pakistan and India agree on the boundary pact between East Bengal and West Bengal.
1951年：22 August: A 24-hour telegraph telephone service is established between East Pakistan and West Pakistan.
1951年：24 December: UN Security Council adopts the Anglo-American Resolution on Kashmir urging immediate demilitarization talks between India, Pakistan.
26年1月：At the Dhaka session of the ruling Muslim League party, prime minister Khawaja Nazimuddin declares Urdu the national language of the state of Pakistan.
6年2月：George VI, King of Pakistan, dies at Sandringham House aged 56. Queen Elizabeth II becomes Queen of Pakistan.
links: Death and state funeral of George VI

items.text: 21年2月：The first ethnic riots occur in Dhaka, East Pakistan against attempts to make Urdu the national language and lack of representation for Bengalis in central administration. This marks the start of the political struggle for the Bengali language movement.
