1953年：February- May: 1953 Lahore riots, Martial law was imposed in Lahore to control the sectarian riots against the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community. This was the first sectarian rioting in the country and the Pakistan Army was called for the first time to control a civil strife. 200 to 2000 Ahmadiyya are killed.
3年3月：CF-CUN, a de Havilland DH-106 Comet 1A of CPAL named Empress of Hawaii, crashed during takeoff from Karachi's Mauripur RAF Station.

1953年：17 April: 1953 Pakistani constitutional coup, Governor-General Ghulam Mohammad dismissed Pakistani Prime Minister Khawaja Nazimuddin's despite the Prime Minister enjoying the support of the Constituent Assembly. Muhammad Ali Bogra is sworn as the new prime minister.

1953年：1954 PAF's No. 14 Squadron led an operation from Miramshah airbase and heavily bombarded the Faqir of Ipi's compound in Gurwek ultimately causing the effective end of Waziristan rebellion (1948-1954)
1954年：2 April: Pakistan forms an alliance with Turkey which, although not including military cooperation, opens the way to the Middle-East alliance due to its allowance of the entry of other nations.
1954年：19 May: Pakistan and the United States sign a Mutual Defense Assistance Agreement.
1954年：7 August: Government of Pakistan approves the National Anthem, written by Abu Al-Asar Hafeez Jalandhari and composed by Ahmed G. Chagla.
1954年：21 September: Constituent Assembly unanimously passes the resolution in favour of Urdu and Bengali as national languages.
1954年：24 October: Malik Ghulam Muhammad dissolved first constitutional assembly.
1954年：Mehar Dil Khan Khattak, commander in chief of Pashtunistan armed forces, surrendered to the Pakistani authorities.
1955年：19 February: Pakistan signs SEA treaty and becomes a part of Southeast Asia Treaty Organization.
1955年：February: 1955 Poonch Uprising, A Civil revolt breaks out in Azad Jammu and Kashmir against the State of Pakistan, provoked largely by the dismissal of Sardar Ibrahim Khan
1955年：Constitutional crisis, Mohammad Ali Bogra removed, new assembly, new cabinet.
1955年：7 August: PM Mohammad Ali Bogra resigns after the election of Chaudhri Mohammad Ali.
1955年：6 October: Governor-General Ghulam Mohammad's resignation is succeeded by Iskander Mirza.
23年9月：Baghdad Pact treaty among Iraq, Turkey, the U.K., Pakistan, and Iran is ratified by Pakistan.
30年9月：One Unit Scheme is implemented, provinces in West Pakistan are abolished.
1956年：The Constituent Assembly promulgates first indigenous constitution.
1956年：Constituent Assembly decides the country shall be a Federal Republic known as Islamic Republic of Pakistan
23年3月：Iskander Mirza becomes the first President of Pakistan.
1956年：September: Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy becomes Prime Minister of Pakistan.
1956年：20 September: Treaty of Baral is signed with Sudhan insurgents ending the PC Pak Search Sudhan Operation.
1957年：October: Ibrahim Ismail Chundrigar replaces Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy as Prime Minister.
1957年：16 December: Malik Firoz Khan Noon is sworn in as seventh Prime Minister of Pakistan.
9年6月：Gen Muhammad Ayub Khan's term as the Commander-in-Chief of the Pakistan Army extended by PM Feroz Khan Noon on request of President Mirza
25年6月：Presidential rule imposed in East Pakistan

1958年：August: Second Balochistan conflict begins when the palace guards of Ahmad of Kalat attack deputy commissioner. It is followed by Pakistan army's bombardment and assault on Kalat palace and arrest of Ahmad of Kalat. Protests against the government break out in Balochistan.

7年8月：1958 East Pakistan-India Border Clashes, Armed skirmishes between East Pakistan and India took place between troops of the East Pakistan Rifles (EPR) and the Indian Army in the small village of Lakshmipur, located in Sylhet District
6年10月：All powers of Ahmad of Kalat are stripped off and he is jailed in Lahore.
7年10月：Iskander Mirza abrogates the constitution and enforces martial law. General Ayub Khan is named Chief Martial Law Administrator (CMLA). Political parties are banned.

27年10月：Ayub and his Cabinet takes oaths. In a dramatic turn of events late night, President Iskander Mirza resigned, giving over his office to Gen Ayub Khan. Ayub now becomes the country's 2nd President. He remained Prime Minister for around 13 hours only, thus becoming the shortest-serving Premier in the history of the country so far.
1958年：Nauroz Khan launches an insurgency against Pakistan government for abolishment of One Unit Scheme and release of Ahmad of Kalat. Battles erupt between militants and Pakistan army.
27年11月：Iskander Mirza is exiled to London
8年12月：Gawadar, formerly a feif of the Sultan of Oman, is handed over to Pakistan after its purchase.
1959年：10 April: 1959 Canberra shootdown, an English Electric Canberra of the Indian Air Force was shot down by an F-86F Sabre of the Pakistan Air Force over Rawat
1959年：18 April: The government takes over dailies The Pakistan Times, Imroze and weekly Lail-o-Nihar.

1959年：26 October: Ayub Khan announces his system of 80,000 Basic Democrats, who would further form the electoral college for the elections of the President and the members of the Central and Provisional Legislature.
1959年：Dir campaign, a Pakistan backed civilian revolt against the Nawab of Dir is crushed.
1960年：Ayub Khan becomes first elected president.
1960年：Nauroz Khan and his followers surrender to Pakistani authorities concluding the Second Balochistan conflict.

1960年：1 May: The U-2 Incident begins when an American U-2 spy plane, piloted by Francis Gary Powers, is shot down by Soviet Air Defence Forces. The clandestine flight had taken off from the U.S. base at Badaber near Peshawar, Pakistan.
1960年：1 August: Islamabad is declared as the principal seat of the Government of Pakistan.
1960年：19 September: Pakistan and India sign the Indus Waters Treaty, brokered by the World Bank.
1960年：September: Bajaur Campaign, Afghan troops and irregulars invade Bajaur district but they are repulsed by Pakistani tribesmen and airforce.
1960年：September: Dir campaign, Afghan troops and irregulars enter into Dir to support Nawab of Dir against a Pakistan backed revolt. Afghan forces are repulsed and 200 soldiers of Nawab are killed.
1960年：10 October: A severe cyclone hits Noakhali and Chittagong districts of East Pakistan, killing more than 5,000 people.
1960年：31 October: A cyclone more powerful than that which hit on 10 October sweeps across East Pakistan, killing 14,174 people.
1960年：October: Dir campaign, Pakistani special forces carry out a coup against Nawab Jahan khan of Dir, he is arrested and exiled. A constitutional government is established.
1961年5月6日：Constitution Commission, appointed by President Ayub Khan, presents its report, specifying pinpoints the failures of parliamentary government in Pakistan.
1962年：April: Elections for the National and provincial assembly were held on the basis of Basic Democracies.
1962年：8 June: 1962 Constitution is promulgated. National Assembly elected. Ayub Khan takes oath of first President of Pakistan under new constitution.
1962年：July: the National Assembly passes the Political Parties Act, legalizing the formation of political parties.
1963年：Start of Third Balochistan conflict by Baloch militants to persuade the government to share revenue form Sui gas fields with the tribal leaders and lifting of One Unit Scheme.
1964年：2 January: Fatima Jinnah lost the presidential elections, Ayub completes the second term.

1964年：2 January: Anti-Hindu riots begin in Khulna, East Pakistan. They and reciprocal riots in Calcutta would fuel waves of communal violence on either side of the border over the next few months killing thousands.
1964年：1 June: Pakistan acquires from the United States its first submarine, the PNS Ghazi
1964年：22 July: The heads of state of Iran, Pakistan and Turkey issue a joint communique from Istanbul, establishing the Regional Cooperation for Development (RCD).
1964年：26 November: The country's first television station goes on air in Lahore, operated on a pilot basis by NEC.
1965年：9 April: Pakistan starts Operation Desert Hawk in the Rann of Kutch
1965年：30 July: Operation Desert Hawk ends in a Pakistani victory.
1965年：August: Operation Gibraltar is initiated by Pakistan but it fails to complete its objective of inciting a rebellion.
1965年：28 August: Battle of Haji Pir pass ends in an Indian victory
1965年：1 September: Pakistan initiates Operation Grand Slam capturing more than 490 square kilometres of territory from Kashmir including the town of Chumb
1965年：6 September: Second Full-scale war erupts between Pakistan and India over Kashmir.
1965年：7-8 September: Operation Dwarka is carried out with no losses on either side
1965年：10 September: Battle of Asal Uttar ends in an Indian victory
1965年：Battle of Burki ends in an Indian victory
1965年：Battle of Ichogil Bund ends in a Pakistani victory
1965年：11 September:
1965年：12 September: Pakistan successfully defends Lahore in the Battle of Lahore
1965年：Battle of Chawinda concludes
1965年：Gujarat Beechcraft incident takes place and an Indian civilian aircraft is shot down by Pakistan air force.
1965年：19 September:
1965年：22 September: Battle of Dograi ends in an Indian victory
1965年：22-23 September: Battle of Phillora ends in an Indian victory
1965年：23 September: Indo-Pakistani air war of 1965 ends with Pakistan inflicting three times more losses to Indian forces (neutral claim)
1965年：23 September: A ceasefire comes into action and Indo-Pakistani war of 1965 ends.
1966年：10 January: Pakistan and India sign the Tashkent Declaration to end hostilities.

1966年：5 February: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, general secretary of the East Pakistan Awami League, announces the Six Point Program calling for limiting the federal government to defence and foreign affairs.

1967年：1 May: Five opposition parties: the National Democratic Front, Council Muslim League, Jamaat-e-Islami, Pakistan Awami League, and Nizam-e-Islam Party, form an alliance called the Pakistan Democratic Movement.
1967年：6 November: Pakistan is elected to the UN Security Council for a two-year term.
1967年：30 November: Pakistan Peoples Party founded by Zulfikar Ali Bhutto in Lahore.
1968年：7 November: Start of 1968–69 Pakistan revolution
1969年：25 March: Ayub Khan resigns; Yahya Khan declares martial law and assumes presidency.
1969年：End of Third Balochistan conflict, negotiations between Yahya Khan and militants led to ceasefire and general amnesty.
1969年：27 November - 6 December: Pakistan sends pilots to help Saudi Arabia against South Yemen in the Al-Wadiah War.

1970年：6 August: A Pakistan International Airlines F27 enters a steep dive and crashes about three minutes after a night takeoff from Rawalpindi in poor weather. All four crew members and 26 passengers are killed.
1970年：12 November: East Pakistan: The Bhola cyclone devastates East Pakistan and Eastern India, resulting in extreme loss of life. 300,000 to 500,000 people are killed.

1970年：7 December: 1970 Pakistani general election were held on 7 December 1970, although the polls in East Pakistan, originally scheduled for October, were delayed by disastrous floods and rescheduled for later in December and January 1971.
1970年：30 December: A Pakistan International Airlines F27 crashes about 300 feet (91 meters) short of the Shamshernagar Airport runway. Seven of the 31 passengers are killed.
1971年：1 March: General Yahya Khan calls off the session of National Council to be held on 3 March in a radio address.
1971年：7 March: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman announces informal independence of Bangladesh
1971年：9 March: Workers of Chittagong port refuse to unload weapons from the ship 'Swat'.
1971年：16 March: Yahya Khan starts negotiation with Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
1971年：19 March: Nearly 200 people are injured at Jaydevpur during clashes between protesters and the Pakistan Army.
1971年：24 March: The Pakistan Army opens fire on Bengali protesters in Syedpur and Rangpur. About 150 people are killed.
1971年：25-26 March: Pakistan Army starts crackdown on Bengali populace in the form of Operation Searchlight, starting Bangladesh liberation war.
1971年3月26日：Sheikh Mujibur Rahman is arrested by the Pakistani army.
1971年：27 March: Santahar massacre committed by the Mukhti Bahini
1971年：31 March: Kushtia resistance begins.
1971年：2 April: Jinjira massacre.
1971年：10 April: A provisional Bangladesh government-in-exile is formed.
1971年：18 April: Battle of Daruin, Comilla and Battle of Rangamati-Mahalchari waterway, take place in Chittagong Hill Tracts.
1971年：25 April: Operation Jackpot started by Mukti Bahini
1971年：5 May: Gopalpur massacre.
1971年：15 May: Indian army starts aiding Mukti Bahini.
1971年：20 May: The Chuknagar massacre takes place at Khulna where the Pakistan army kills nearly 10 thousand people
1971年：16 August: Operation Jackpot, Bangladesh naval commando operation concludes.
1971年：20 August: Flight Lieutenant Matiur Rahman's attempt to defect by hijacking a fighter foiled by Rashid Minhas.
1971年：30 August: Pakistan Army starts crackdown on Dhaka guerrillas.
1971年：5 September: Battle of Goalhati.
1971年：13 October: Dhaka guerrillas kill Abdul Monem Khan, governor of East Pakistan.
1971年：28 October-3 November: Battle of Dhalai
1971年：31 October-3 November: Battle of Dhalai: Allied attack from Tripura into East Pakistan to stop Pakistani cross-border shelling.
1971年：16 November: Battle of Ajmiriganj, an 18-hour encounter between Mukti Bahini and Pakistan army.
1971年：14 November-4 December: Battle of Kamalpur
1971年：20-21 November: Battle of Garibpur.
1971年：22 November-16 December: Battle of Hilli.
1971年：3 December: Bangladesh Air Force destroys Pakistani oil depots.
1971年：3 December: Pakistani pre-emptive airstrikes in India. As a result, India declares war against Pakistan starting Indo-Pakistani war of 1971.
1971年：3-6 December: Battle of Chamb; Pakistan attacks and takes over part of southern Kashmir from India.
1971年：4 December: Battle of Longewala; India stops a Pakistani invasion directed at Jaisalmer.
1971年：4-5 December: Battle of Gazipur in which Indian Army and Mukti Bahini captured Gazipur.
1971年：5 December: Battle of Basantar; India captures the Shakargarh Salient.
1971年：7-16 December: Battle of Sylhet.
1971年：8 December: Operation Python, Indian naval attacks on Karachi.
1971年：Battle of Kushtia
1971年：Meghna Heli Bridge captured from Pakistan
1971年：9 December:
1971年：10 December: Two Bangladeshi ships sunk mistakenly by an Indian air attack.
1971年：Tangail Airdrop
1971年：USS Enterprise is deployed by the US Navy in the Bay of Bengal to intimidate the Indian Navy.
1971年：11 December:
1971年12月13日：Soviet Navy deploys a group of warships to counter Enterprise. The Enterprise moves towards Southeast Asia, averting a confrontation.
1971年：14 December: Selective genocide of Bengali nationalist intellectuals.

1971年：16 December: End of the Bangladesh Liberation War. Mitro Bahini takes Dhaka. Approximately 93,000 troops of Pakistan Armed Forces surrenders to Mitro Bahini represented by Jagjit Singh Aurora of the Indian Army faction of the military coalition.
1971年：20 December: Yahya Khan resigns.
1972年：Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto becomes president.
1972年：20 January: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto publicly announces that Pakistan will immediately begin a nuclear weapons programme.
links: Pakistan and its Nuclear Deterrent Program

items.text: 1972年：January: Pakistan temporarily withdraws from the Commonwealth of Nations in protest at the international recognition of Bangladesh.
1972年：14 March: New education policy enforced. Free education in all private and public schools.
1972年：21 April: Martial Law lifted; constitutional rule is restored in the country. Hamoodur Rahman is sworn in as Chief Justice of Pakistan.
1972年：6 October: Karachi labour unrest of 1972, workers occupied factories
1972年：18 October: Karachi labour unrest of 1972 The police and military used bulldozers to break factory walls and fired upon workers killing 100.
1972年：7 July: 1972 Language violence in Sindh kills 47 people.
1973年：10 February: 1973 raid on the Iraqi embassy in Pakistan, Iraqi weapons for Baloch insurgents are discovered.
links: 1973 raid on the Iraqi embassy in Pakistan

items.text: 1973年：February: Provincial government in Balochistan is dismissed.
1973年：February: Start of the 1970s operation in Balochistan.
1973年：10 April: 1973 Constitution of Pakistan enacted by the National Assembly.
1973年：17 July: 1973 Afghan coup d'état strains relations between Pakistan and Afghanistan.
1973年：11 August: Chaudhry Fazal Ilahi is elected as president.
1973年：14 August: Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto becomes prime minister. Constitution of Pakistan 1973 promulgated.
1973年：1973 Pakistan coup attempt is foiled.
1974年：Pakistan recognised Bangladesh.
1974年：27 May: 1974 Anti-Ahmadiyya riots result in the death of 27 Ahmadiyyas and declaration of Ahmadiyyas as non Muslim.
1974年：September: Largest battle between Pakistani troops and Baloch insurgents.
1975年7月22日：Pakistan backed 1975 Laghman uprising is crushed by Afghan government.
1976年：Pakistan begins diplomatic relations with Bangladesh.
1976年：3-10 September: 1976 Dir rebellion is crushed, 300 people are killed.
1976年：Baloch insurgents, due to lack of ammunition start fleeing.
1977年：10 January: Nine opposition parties form joint election forum, Pakistan National Alliance (PNA).
1977年：7 March: 1977 Pakistani general election
1977年：7 March- July: 1977 Pakistan uprising occurs in response to the alleged rigging in elections. Military is deployed to crush the uprising. More than 150 are killed.
1977年：5 July: Operation Fair Play, General Muhammad Zia ul-Haq overthrows prime minister Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto and declares martial law.
1977年：July: General Rahimuddin Khan takes over Balochistan. General amnesty is declared. Fourth Balochistan conflict ends with about 25,000 deaths.
1978年：14 March Sardar Mohammad Daoud Khan visits Islamabad.
1978年：11 June: Altaf Hussain founded the All Pakistan Muhajir Student Organization (APMSO) in Karachi University starting the First MQM insurrection.

2年1月：1978 massacre at Multan Colony Textile Mills, On the orders of Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq, paramilitary forces opened fire on peaceful protesting workers in Multan killing 133-900 (official toll is 22).
links: 1978 massacre at Multan Colony Textile Mills

items.text: 1978年：12 September Zia-ul-Haq visits Noor Muhammad Tarakai, marxist leader of Afghanistan in Kabul.
1978年：16 September: General Muhammad Zia ul-Haq becomes Pakistan's sixth president.
1978年：22 September: Saur Revolution takes place and further strains Pakistan Afghanistan relations.
1979年：The military ruler Zia Ul-Haq enacts the Hudood Ordinances.
1979年：4 April: Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto hanged.
1979年：3 July: ISI, CIA and GIP Start Operation Cyclone to aid Mujahideen forces in Afghanistan.
1979年：3 November: 1979 U.S. embassy burning in Islamabad by Jamaat E Islami on false accusations of US involvement in Grand Mosque seizure by Khomeini.
1979年：24 December: Soviet–Afghan War begins after Soviet deployment.
1980年：The United States pledges military assistance to Pakistan following Soviet intervention in Afghanistan.
1980年：1 March: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations, A Soviet Ilyushin Il-26 entered Pakistani airspace and was intercepted by PAF Squadron 15 but the pilots were instructed not to engage.
1980年：23 March: 1980 Pakistan coup attempt, a plot by Maj. Gen. Tajammul Hussain Malik to assassinate Zia-ul-Haq on Pakistan Day on March 23, 1980, was exposed and thwarted.
1980年：26 May: Establishment of Federal Shariat Court is announced.
1981年：2 March: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 326 is hijacked by armed men belonging to Al-Zulfiqar.
1981年：23 March: Provisional constitutional order enforced, replacing the 1973 constitution.
1982年：Pakistan builds its first workable nuclear device.
1983年：12 February: 1983 women's march, Lahore, 50 women are arrested
1983年：August–September: Movement for the Restoration of Democracy arranges nationwide protests against Zia ul Haq.
links: Movement for the Restoration of Democracy

items.text: 1983年：The first F-16 supplied by the US to Pakistan Air Force (PAF).
1983年：11 March: Kirana-I, Pakistan conduct cold test of a nuclear device, proving the state as one of recognized nuclear weapons state. The test was not announced publicly until 1998.
31年12月：The 7.2 mb Hindu Kush earthquake affects northern Afghanistan and Pakistan with a maximum Mercalli intensity of VII (Very strong), killing 12–26 and injuring 60–483.
1984年：18 March: Azeem Ahmed Tariq & Altaf Hussain founded the MQM (Muhajir Qaumi Movement) in Karachi and Hyderabad.
1984年：1984 Pakistan coup attempt, second coup attempt against Zia ul Haq is thwarted by Inter services intelligence.
1984年：April: Operation Meghdoot, Start of Siachen conflict, The Indian Army captures Siachen in a military raid.
1985年：28 February: General elections held; Muhammad Khan Junejo becomes prime minister.
26年：27 April: Badaber uprising by Soviet and Afghan POWs near Peshawar is crushed.
1985年：KHAD-KGB campaign in Pakistan is started by KGB and KHAD, Hathora murders in Karachi begin
1985年：Anti Pashtun violence in Karachi kills more than 100.
1985年：August: Mujahideen under the command of Pakistani ISI brigadier general Mohammad Yousuf start Raids inside Soviet union
links: Raids inside the Soviet Union during the Soviet–Afghan War

items.text: 1985年：31 December: Martial Law is lifted, amended 1973 Constitution revived.
1986年：February: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations, PAF fighters intercepted a couple of Mig-21s.
1986年：1986:Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto's daughter Benazir returns from exile to lead the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) in a campaign for fresh elections.
1986年：April: During the Second Battle of Zhawar, an Afghan aerial assault group accidentally landed inside Pakistan. 120 personnel and 6 Mi-8 were captured by Pakistani forces.
1986年：29 April: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations, the Afghan Air Force claimed to have shot down a Pakistani Air Force F-16.
1986年：17 May: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations, Pakistan Air Force claimed to have destroyed two Su-22M3K belonging to Democratic Republic of Afghanistan Air Force, DRAAF confirmed loss of one.
1986年：5 September: Pan Am Flight 73, with 358 people on board, is hijacked at Karachi International Airport by four Abu Nidal terrorists.
1986年：14 December: Qasba Aligarh massacre, violence against Muhajirs by newly settled Pashtuns from KPK, Pakistan and Afghanistan.
1987年：16 April: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations, PAF shot down an Afghan Su-22.
1987年：30 March: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations PAF shot down a Soviet An-26.
1987年：June–July: Operation Rajiv ends in an Indian victory.
1987年：14 July: 1987 Karachi car bombing killed 72 and wounded 250.
1987年：In a clash with Soviet aircraft one PAF F-16 was due to friendly fire.
1987年：September: In aerial dogfights one Soviet Mig-23 is damaged and two are allegedly destroyed.
1987年：September: Operation Vajrasakti / Qaidat, two expeditions by Pakistani and Indian forces in siachen. Combat results in an Indian victory.
1987年：September 20 At least 5 people were killed and 16 injured when a bomb exploded in a bus station in Rawalpindi.
1987年：KHAD-KGB campaign in Pakistan, Bomb blast on the US consulate in Peshawar killed 30.
1988年：20 January: Prominent Pashtun leader Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan dies in Peshawar.
1988年：10 April: Ojhri Camp disaster, Army ammunition blown up in Ojhri camp, Rawalpindi; more than 100 people die.
1988年：29 May: Zia dismisses Junejo's government;
1988年：8 August: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations, Colonel Alexander Rutskoy's Sukhoi Su-25 was shot down by PAF.
1988年：14 August: Pakistan signs the Geneva Accords (1988) with Afghanistan under the mediation of United States and Soviet union respectively.
1988年：17 August: General Zia-ul-Haq is killed in a plane crash near Bahawalpur.
1988年：30 September: 1988 Hyderabad massacre
1988年：31 September: Anti-Sindhi violence kills more than 200 Sindhis in Karachi and Hyderabad .
1988年：3 November: Pakistan Soviet air confrontations, An Afghan Su-24 was shot down by PAF.
1988年：16 November: New elections held; Benazir Bhutto becomes prime minister after 1988 Pakistani general election
1988年：ISI personnel start Operation Midnight Jackal against Benazir Bhutto.

10年12月：An Antonov An-26 of Ariana Afghan Airlines was shot down in Pakistani territory by Pakistani fighters on a passenger flight from Khost to Kabul, killing all 25 occupants. Pakistan denied the shooting.
1989年：Pakistan returns to its status as a Commonwealth republic
1989年：15 February: Soviet withdrawal from Afghanistan is completed and Soviet-Afghan War ends.
1989年：15 February: First Afghan Civil War starts.
1989年：February–April: Operation Chumik/Operation Ibex, two expeditions by Pakistani and Indian forces result in the demilitarization of Chumik Glacier.
1989年：5 March: Battle of Jalalabad (1989) starts and 5000 Pakistani troops enter into Afghanistan.
1989年：6 April: Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan begin.
1989年：4 May: Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan, second strike takes place. 3 people are killed.
1989年：22 May: third Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan.
1989年：23-26 June: Three Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan.
1989年：31 June: Battle of Jalalabad (1989) commences with an Afghan government victory. ISI chief Hamid Gul is sacked by Pakistani authorities.
1989年：Operation Midnight Jackal by ISI personnel is exposed and they are trialed.
1989年：3 August: Seventh Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan.
1989年：15 August: Eighth Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan.
1989年：1 October: Ninth Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan.
1989年：27 October: Tenth Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan.
1990年：4 January: Sukkur rail disaster, more than 300 people are killed
1990年：10 January: 11th Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan
1990年：Clashes between Muhajirs and Sindhis lead to the death of 190 civilians
1990年：7 May: 21 people were killed and 30 injured in a train bombing near Lahore.
1990年：18 May: — 10 people were killed and 54 wounded in a bomb blast in Lahore.
1990年：26-27 May: Pucca Qila Massacre, about 200 muhajirs are killed massacre is stopped by military intervention.
1990年：14 June: 12th Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan
1990年：16 July: 43 people were killed and 110 injured in 7 bomb explosions in Hyderabad, Sindh.
1990年：26 June: 13th Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan
1990年：2 August: Gulf War starts, Pakistan joins the coalition to protect Kuwait.
1990年：6 August: President Ghulam Ishaq Khan dismisses Benazir Bhutto government; Mian Nawaz Sharif becomes the next prime minister
1990年：13 September: 14th Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan
1990年：24 October: 1990 Pakistani general election
1990年：20 November: 15th Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan
1990年：28 November: Last Afghan SCUD attacks in Pakistan
1990年：Mehrangate is exposed.
1991年：Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif begins economic liberalisation programme.
1991年：16 May: Islamic Shariah law formally incorporated into legal code.
1991年：December: A train travelling from Karachi to Lahore hits a parked freight train at Ghotki, killing over 100 of the 800 passengers.
1992年：28 April: Second Afghan Civil War starts with a heavy Pakistani involvement.
1992年：20 May: A 6.0 magnitude earthquake affects northern Pakistan causing moderate damage, killing 36 and injuring 100.
1992年：28 July – 3 August: Siachen conflict, Indian Army launched Operation Trishul Shakti, one Pakistani helicopter is shot down.
1992年：19 June: Pakistan Army started Operation Clean-up ending the MQM insurrection (1978-1992).

1992年：8 September: 1992 India–Pakistan floods, almost 1,000 people die and 3 million are evacuated due to flooding in Punjab province caused by torrential rains swelling the Indus river and its tributaries, a thousand more are also killed in the Kashmir region.

1992年：28 September: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 268, an Airbus A300B4-203, crashes into the southern slope of the Chure Hills on approach to Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu, Nepal, killing all 167 passengers and crew.
1992年：5 December: Pakistan joins Unified Task Force and participates in Operation Restore Hope.
1992年：Pakistan becomes fourth largest troop contributor to the United Nations Protection Force in Bosnia.
1992年：Inter-Services Intelligence activities in Bosnia and Herzegovina begin to support Bosniaks against Serbs.
links: Inter-Services Intelligence activities in Bosnia and Herzegovina

items.text: 1993年：7 March: Political groups from Afghanistan sign the Islamabad Accord in Pakistan, forming a coalition until elections can be held.
1993年：2 April: The Pakistan government vows to crack down on Arab militants.
1993年：8 April: After a crack down on illegal immigrants, hundreds of Arab nationals are arrested on suspected links to Islamic militants.
1993年：5 June: June 1993 attack on Pakistani military in Somalia, 25 Pakistani troops are massacred by SNA.
links: June 1993 attack on Pakistani military in Somalia

items.text: 1993年：13 June: June 1993 UN killings of Somali protestors, In response to attack on Pakistani military, Pakistani troops open fire on Somali civilians killing 20.
links: June 1993 UN killings of Somali protestors

items.text: 1993年：16 June: Bosnian Muslim refugees leave Croatia for Pakistan.
1993年：18 July: President Ghulam Ishaq Khan and Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif both resign under pressure from military. Benazir Bhutto becomes prime minister for the second time.
1993年：August–October: Pakistan participates in Operation Gothic Serpent but coalition is forced to withdraw.
1993年：3-4 October: Pakistan participates in Battle of Mogadishu (1993) but coalition is forced to withdraw.
1994年：May–June: Start of MQM insurrection (1994-present), 750 people are killed in riots
1994年：1 November: Malakand insurrection (1994-1995) by Islamist militants begins.
1994年：MQM insurrection (1994-present), General Naseerullah Babar started an operation against MQM.
1995年：9 January – 3 March 1995: Pakistan navy participates in Operation United Shield in Somalia.
1995年：May: Siachen conflict, Battle of Tyakshi Post ends in an Indian victory.
1995年：19 June: Malakand insurrection (1994-1995) ends after implementation of Sharia law in Malakand Division.
1995年：July: The Pakistani embassy in Kabul is attacked.
1995年：October: 1995 Pakistani coup attempt is foiled and coup plotters are arrested.
1995年：19 November: Attack on the Egyptian Embassy in Pakistan kills 13.
links: Attack on the Egyptian Embassy in Pakistan

items.text: 1995年：As a part of Second MQM insurrection, more than 2000 people are killed in 1995
1995年：21 December: — 1995 Peshawar bombing: At least 25 people were killed and 100 wounded.
1996年：28 April: Bhai Pheru bus bombing: 50 people were killed and 26 injured
1996年：22 July: A briefcase bomb killed 9 and wounded 20 people in the old terminal of Lahore International Airport
1996年：5 November: President Farooq Leghari dismisses Bhutto government.
1996年：Second operation against MQM is called off.
1997年：3 February: 1997 Pakistani general election, Nawaz Sharif becomes prime minister for the second time.
1997年：2 December: Pakistan's president, Farooq Leghari, resigns. Wasim Sajjad becomes interim president for the second time.
10年3月：On the Tuesday morning, a bomb blast occurred on Walton railway station, in a Lahore-bound train killed at least 10 and wounding more than 80 people.
28年5月：The first nuclear test — Codename Chagai-I was conducted and supervised by the PAEC at Ras Koh Chaghi, Baluchistan.
30年5月：The second nuclear test Chagai-II was conducted and supervised by the PAEC.
1998年：8 June: — 23 people were killed as a bomb exploded on moving Khyber Mail (Train) heading towards Peshawar, on Tando Masti Khan railway station.
1998年：MQM insurrection (1994-present), Governor rule was imposed by Nawaz Sharif in the Sindh province and military operation was initiated against MQM due to Hakeem Saeed's assassination
1999年：Pakistan tests its Ghauri II missile.
1999年：20 May: massive hurricane strikes Sindh killing 6000.
1999年：3 May: Start of Kargil war A Pakistani intrusion in the Kargil district is reported by local shepherds.
1999年：5 May: Indian Army patrols are sent out in response to earlier reports; 5 Indian soldiers are captured and subsequently killed.
1999年：9 May: Heavy shelling by the Pakistan Army damages Indian ammunition dumps in Kargil.
1999年：10 May: Multiple infiltrations across the LoC are confirmed in Dras, Kaksar, and Mushkoh sectors.
1999年：26 May: The Indian Air Force (IAF) begins airstrikes against suspected infiltrator positions.
1999年：27 May: One IAF MiG-21 and one MiG-27 are shot down by Pakistan Army's Air Defence Corps;
1999年：28 May: One IAF Mi-17 is shot down by Pakistani forces; four crew members are killed.
1999年：1 June: The Pakistan Army begins shelling operations on India's National Highway 1 .
1999年：6 June: The Indian Army begins a major offensive in Kargil.
1999年：9 June: Indian troops re-capture two key positions in the Batalik sector.
1999年：11 June: India releases intercepts of conversations between Pakistani COAS Gen. Pervez Musharraf and CGS Lt. Gen. Aziz Khan as proof of the Pakistan Army's involvement in the Kargil war.
1999年：13 June: Battle of Tololing ends in Indian victory.
1999年：15 June: United States President Bill Clinton forces then Prime Minister of Pakistan, Nawaz Sharif to immediately pull all Pakistani troops and irregulars out from Kargil.
1999年：20 June: Battle of point 5140 ends in an Indian victory.
1999年：29 June: Pakistani forces begin their retreat and the Indian Army advances towards Tiger Hill.
1999年：June: Siachen conflict, Indian Army captured pt 5770 from Pakistan troops.
1999年：4 July: Battle of Tiger Hill ends in an Indian victory.
1999年：5 July: Nawaz Sharif officially announces the Pakistan Army's withdrawal from Kargil following a meeting with President Clinton.
1999年：7 July: Battle of Point 4875 ends in an Indian victory.
1999年：11 July: Pakistani forces disengage from the region; India retakes key peak points in Batalik.
1999年：26 July: Kargil war officially comes to an end. Indian Army announces the complete withdrawal of Pakistani irregular and regular forces.
1999年：10 August: 1999 Pakistan Breguet 1150 Atlantic shootdown, a Breguet Atlantic maritime patrol aircraft of the Pakistan Naval Air Arm was shot down by a MiG-21 fighter of the Indian Air Force
1999年：11 August: Pakistani forces fire a missile on an Indian helicopter carrying journalists.
1999年：12 October: Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif overthrown in military coup led by General Pervez Musharraf.
2000年：April: After military takeover, Former Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif is sentenced to life imprisonment
2000年：12 May: Supreme Court validated the October 1999 coup and granted General Pervez Musharraf executive and legislative authority for three years.
2000年：December: Nawaz Sharif goes into exile to Saudi Arabia
2001年：20 June: General Pervez Musharraf dismissed the president and named himself to the post.
2001年：15 July: Agra Summit starts. President Pervez Musharraf and Indian Prime Minister Vajpayee holds talks over long-standing issues.
2001年：14 August: New Local Government system installed, after holding of elections in three phases.
2001年：15 September: The September 11 attacks in America result in Pakistan agreeing to cooperate with the campaign against Al Qaeda.
2001年：16 September: US Secretary of State Powell told that Pakistan's President Musharraf had agreed to support the U.S. anti-terrorist campaign.
2001年：7 October: United States invasion of Afghanistan
2001年：28 October: Bahawalpur church shooting, 18 Christians are killed in retaliation for United States invasion of Afghanistan
2001年：10 November: US President Bush meets President Musharraf in New York and assures additional aid of one billion dollars.
2001年：2001 Indian Parliament attack is blamed on Pakistan by India.
2001年：2002 India–Pakistan standoff begins and 800,000 Indian troops gather at Pakistani border.
2001年：13 December:
2001年：December: Pakistan and India moved ballistic missiles closer to each other's border, and mortar and artillery fire was reported in Kashmir.
2002年：1 January: an earthquake strikes northern Pakistan.
2002年：5 January: Musharraf stunned Vajpayee by a hand-shake at the last 11th SAARC summit in Kathmandu.
2002年：12 January: President Musharraf declares a war on extremism.
2002年：14 January: India calls off Operation Pakram.
2002年：22 February — The American journalist Daniel Pearl was kidnapped and murdered in Karachi.
2002年：26 February At least 11 Shi'a worshipers were killed by firing at the Shah-i-Najaf Mosque in Rawalpindi.
2002年：30 April: General Pervez Musharraf wins a referendum thus ensures 5 more years in office.
2002年：Operation al-Mizan is initiated by Pakistan and US against Islamist militants.
2002年：17 March — A grenade attack on a Protestant church in tdiplomatic enclave in Islamabad killed five persons, including a US diplomat's wife and daughter.
2002年：8 May: 2002 Karachi bus bombing, 15 killed.
2002年：24 August: President General Musharraf issues the Legal Framework Order 2002.
2002年：25 September — Gunmen attacked the offices of a Christian welfare organisation in Karachi killing 7.
2002年：10 October: 2002 Pakistani general election, First general elections since the 1999 military coup held.
2002年：21 November: A 6.3 Mw earthquake strikes northern Pakistan, leaving sixteen dead, forty injured, and more than 1,000 buildings damaged.
2002年：23 November: Mir Zafarullah Khan Jamali sworn in as Prime Minister.
2002年：26 November: The Pakistan army evacuates thousands of people following the earthquake
2002年：5 December: Three people were killed in an attack at the Macedonian Honorary consulate in Karachi.
2002年：25 December Grenade attack at a Presbyterian church in Pakistan's central Punjab province, killed three young girls.
2003年：24 February: Senate elections: Ruling party wins most seats in voting to the upper house.
2003年：23 March: AAJ TV, Pakistan's premier channel inaugurated.
2003年：8 June:- 11 Pakistani police trainees were shot dead in a sectarian attack on Sariab Road, Quetta, as they all belonged to Hazara Shi'a branch of Islam.
2003年：24 June: President Pervez Musharraf meets US President G.W. Bush in Camp David. US announces $3-billion five-year economic assistance package for Pakistan.
2003年：4 July: 2003 Quetta mosque bombing, 44 killed.
2003年：11 July: Lahore-Delhi bus service resumed after suspension of 18 months.
2003年：August: Floods in Sindh province result in tens of thousands of people fleeing to relief camps and a food crisis.
2003年：14 December: General Musharraf survived an assassination attempt in Rawalpindi.
2003年：25 December General Musharraf survives another assassination attempt
2004年：1 January: General Musharraf won a vote of confidence in the Senate, National Assembly, and provincial assemblies.
2004年：5 January: Musharraf meets Vajpayee in Islamabad, discusses Kashmir dispute.
2004年：18 January: Pakistani agents arrest seven Al-Qaida suspects and confiscate weapons during a raid in the southern city of Karachi.
2004年：16 March: War in North-West Pakistan begins.
2004年：16 March: Battle of Wanna begins
2004年：23 March: Battle of Wanna ends with a Pakistani victory.
2004年：22 April: The European Parliament voted in favour of a new trade and cooperation agreement with Pakistan, giving a vital boost to Islamabad's relations with the European Union.
2004年：22 May: Pakistan readmitted to Commonwealth.

2004年6月18日：Start of Drone strikes in Pakistan, The first known U.S. drone strike killed 5–8 people including Nek Muhammad Wazir and two children, in a strike near Wana, South Waziristan. Pakistan's Army initially claimed the attack as its own work.
2004年：26 June: Prime Minister Zafarullah Khan Jamali steps down and nominates Ch. Shujaat Hussain as his interim successor.
2004年：28 August: Shaukat Aziz becomes Prime Minister.
2004年：9 September: About 70 Taliban or Al Qaida militants, are killed when Pakistan's air force jets raid a terrorist training camp in a tribal region bordering Afghanistan.
2005年：8 January:- At least 10 people were killed in sectarian violence in the city of Gilgit, Gilgit-Baltistan.
2005年：Start of Fifth Balochistan conflict, Rape of a female doctor (Shazia Khalid) at the Sui gas facility and the resulting government response started the Fifth Balochistan conflict.
2005年：19 March:- At least 35 people were killed by a blast at the shrine of Pir Rakhel Shah in the village of Fatehpur in Jhal Magsi District.
2005年：14 May: 2 killed including Haitham al-Yemeni in a strike near the Afghan border in North Waziristan.
2005年：25 May:- Six members of a family were killed in an explosion at the village of Bandkhel in Makin Subdivision, South Waziristan.
2005年：27 May: 2005 Islamabad bombing, At least 20 people were killed and 82 wounded.
2005年：13 July: 136 people killed and about 170 injured in a collision of three passenger trains near Ghotki.
2005年：14 July: NWFP Assembly passes the Hasba bill with a majority vote.
2005年：19 July: Government of Pakistan launches country-wide crackdown against extremist elements.
2005年：7 October:- 2005 Mong shootings Eight Ahmadiyya are killed
2005年：8 October: The 7.6 Mw Kashmir earthquake affects Azad Kashmir with a maximum Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe), killing more than 79,000 people and displacing several million more.
2005年：10 October: The president of Pakistan appeals for international help following the earthquake, saying the country cannot deal with crisis on its own.
2005年：11 October: Renowned littérateur, linguist and poet, Shanul Haq Haqqee, passes away in Toronto. He was 88.
2005年：13 October: Clashes between the Rangers and civilians in Gilgit kill 12.
2005年：5 November: a strike destroys the house of Abu Hamza Rabia killing his wife, three children and four others.

2005年：30 November: Al-Qaeda's 3rd in command, Abu Hamza Rabia killed in an attack by CIA drones in Asoray, near Miranshah, the capital of North Waziristan along with 4 other militants. Among the deaths are 8 year old Noor Aziz and 17-year-old Abdul Wasit.

2005年：15 December: the inspector general of the Frontier Corps, Major General Shujaat Zamir Dar, and his deputy Brigadier Salim Nawazl were wounded after shots were fired at their helicopter by Baloch separatists ."
2005年：22 December: Seven killed in a battle between Islamists and bandits in Jandola.
2006年：2 January: Dr. Shamshad Akhtar assumes office of State Bank Governor having the first woman Governor of SBP.
2006年：13 January: Damadola airstrike kills 18 civilians, in Bajaur area but misses Ayman al-Zawahri, five women, eight men, and five children are among the dead.
2006年：25 January: Landmine blast in Dera Bugti District kills 6.
2006年：5 February:- 13 killed in a blast on Lahore-bound bus .
2006年：9 February: 36 killed in violence on the Day of Ashura.
2006年：2 March: A power suicide car bomb attack near the US Consulate, Karachi, killed four people including a US diplomat, a day before President George W. Bush was to reach Pakistan.
2006年：10 March: 2006 Pakistan landmine blast, 26 people, are killed.
2006年：26 April: Pervez Musharraf lays foundation-stone of Diamir-Bhasha dam.
2006年：11 April: 2006 Karachi Nishtar Park bombing Over 50 people are killed.
2006年：14 May: Charter of democracy (CoD) is signed by two former prime ministers of Pakistan, Nawaz Sharif and Benazir Bhutto in London.
2006年：12 June: Five people were killed in a bomb attack in Quetta hotel.
2006年：15 June Five police officers are killed by gunmen .
2006年：16 June: Two female teachers and two children were shot dead in Khoga Chiri village in Orakzai Agency.
2006年：8 July: Process to release over 1600 women prisoners from 55 jails across starts after Presidential Ordinance.
2006年：10 July: Noted poet, writer and columnist, Ahmed Nadeem Qasmi, passes away in Lahore. He was 89.
2006年：26 August: Prominent Baloch leader and politician Sirdar Akbar Bugti killed by military
26年：31 August:- Akbar Bugti's killing sparked five days of rioting that left six people dead, dozens wounded and 700 under arrest.
2006年：5 September: Waziristan Accords are signed.
2006年：8 September:- At least six people were killed in bomb blast in Barkhan District.
2006年：6 October:: 17 people were killed in sectarian violence .
2006年：20 October: A bomb blast killed six people in Peshawar.

2006年：30 October: Chenagai airstrike allegedly aimed at Ayman al-Zawahri destroys a madrassa in Bajaur area and kills 70–80 people. Pakistani military officials claim there were militants while provincial minister Siraj ul-Haq and a local eyewitness said they were innocent pupils resuming studies after the Muslim Eid holidays.
2006年：8 November:2006 Dargai bombing, 42 Pakistani Army soldiers are killed .
2006年：Operation al-Mizan ends in a US-Pakistani victory.
2007年：15 January: A blast in the Jalozai killed four people.
2007年：16 January: Up to 30 Taliban killed in a drone strike in Salamat Keley, Zamazola, South Waziristan.
2007年：26 January: Two people were killed in a suicide attack at the Marriott hotel in the capital Islamabad.
2007年：27 January: 13 people, including the Chief of Peshawar City Police Malik Saad, were killed in suicide bombing near a crowded Shiite mosque
2007年：29 January: January 2007 Dera Ismail Khan suicide bombing 2 people were killed
links: January 2007 Dera Ismail Khan suicide bombing

items.text: 2007年：6 February:- A suicide bomber detonated himself outside Islamabad International Airport.
2007年：17 February: A suicide bomber killed 15 people inside a courtroom in Quetta, Balochistan.
2007年：20 February: Punjab Minister for social welfare Zil-e-Huma Usman was shot and killed in Gujranwala.
2007年：9 March: President Musharraf dismissed Chief Justice of Pakistan, Iftikhar.
19年：22 March: Clashes between pro-government forces and al-Qaeda remnants in the Waziristan kill 135 people on both sides.
2007年：6 April: 2007 Kurram Agency conflict begins.
10年：11 April: 35 people were killed in secterian violence in Kurram Agency.
2007年：13 April: 2007 Kurram Agency conflict ends with a victory of Pakistani government and allied Shi'ite militias.
2007年：26 April: 4 people killed in the village of Saidgi in North Waziristan in an airstrike. Habib Ullah the owner of the destroyed house, said those killed were not terrorists.
2007年：28 April April 2007 Charsadda bombing An assassination attempt on Aftab Ahmad Khan Sherpao, Interior minister is unsuccessful but 28 others are killed .
2007年：12 May: 12 May Karachi riots 50 people were killed in clashes
2007年：13 May: Afghanistan–Pakistan border skirmishes, 3 Pakistani soldiers were wounded, 13-41 Afghans were killed.
2007年：15 May: 2007 Peshawar hotel bombing, 24 people are killed.
2007年：2 June; Five people are killed in road side bombing in Bajaur District
2007年：8 June: Three people were killed in a bus bombing in Lasbela District.
2007年：19 June: 30 killed in the village of Mami Rogha in an airstrike in North Waziristan
2007年：23 June: A barrage of artillery and missiles fired from Afghanistan hit residential compounds and a hotel in Mangrotai area of North Waziristan, killing 11 people.
2007年：President General Pervez Musharraf escaped yet another attempt on his life.
2007年：Four Pakistan Army troops were killed in an IED attack on a military convoy in Dir District
2007年：6 July:
2007年：8 July: 3 Chinese workers are killed by gunmen
2007年：11 July: Siege of Lal Masjid ends, which started on 3 July.
2007年：12 July: Seven people were killed in five attacks in Swat district.
2007年：14 July: 23 soldiers are killed in a car bombing.
2007年：15 July:- At least 49 are killed in multiple incidents across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
2007年：17 July:- At least 17 people were killed in a suicide bombing in Islamabad.
2007年：19 July:- More than 40 people were killed in three separate bomb attacks.
2007年：24 July:- Nine people were killed in rocket attacks in Bannu.
2007年：13 people are killed in a suicide bombing at Muzaffar hotel in Islamabad
2007年：The same day Raziq Bugti, former guerrilla commander turned spokesman for the Balochistan government, was assassinated in Quetta.
2007年：2 August:- A shootout in Sargodha killed a policeman and suspected bomber.
2007年：4 August:- Nine people were killed in suicide bombing in Parachinar, Kurram Agency.
2007年：25 August – Pakistan successfully tests a nuclear capable cruise missile named Hatf-VIII having a range of 350 km (220 mi).
2007年：26 August:- Four policemen were killed in a suicide attack in Shangla District.
2007年：4 September September 2007 bombings in Rawalpindi 25 people were killed

2007年：11 September:- 17 people are killed in a van bombing in Dera Ismail Khan district. The same day Omar Ayub Khan's protocol officer, Liaquat Hussain, was found shot dead near the Northern Bypass in Karachi.
2007年：13 September:- At least 20 off-duty commandos were killed in Haripur near Tarbela Dam.
2007年：15 September:Maulana Hassan Jan is assassinated .
2007年：20 September: Al-Qaeda declares war on Pakistan.
2007年：1 October Suicide bombing in Bannu killed 16 people
2007年：7 October: Battle of Mirali starts
2007年：10 October: Battle of Mirali ends in a Pakistani victory.
2007年：12 October: Mohmand Taliban publicly behead six "criminals".
2007年：18 October: Bhutto, Benazir returned to Pakistan, after exile of about 8 years.
2007年：19 October: 2007 Karsaz bombing, 180 killed.
2007年：20 October: Eight people were killed in a bomb blast in Dera Bugti.
2007年：20 people are killed in a suicide blast in swat.
2007年：First Battle of Swat begins
2007年：25 October:
2007年：30 October: 7 killed in a suicide attack on a checkpost in Rawalpindi.
2007年：1 November: A suicide bomber rammed his motorcycle into a PAF bus near Sargodha, killing 10
2007年：2 November: 5 killed in an airstrike on a madrasah in North Waziristan
2007年：3 November: Pervez Musharraf imposed emergency, most of the senior judges of Supreme Court ousted.
2007年：9 November: A suicide bomber killed 3 in Peshawar.
2007年：16 November: After completion of 5 years, National Assembly dissolved, Caretaker government of Muhammad Mian Soomro took oath.
2007年：24 November:- 30 people were killed in two suicide attacks in Rawalpindi.
2007年：25 November: Nawaz Sharif returned Pakistan after 7 years of forced exile.
2007年：8 December: First Battle of Swat ends in a Pakistani victory.
2007年：9 December: At least 10 people were killed in a car bombing near Matta, Swat District.
2007年：10 December:- A suicide attack on the school bus injuring 7.
2007年：13 December:- Two suicide bombings in Quetta killed seven people.
2007年：Emergency lifted, civil rights and suspended constitution restored
2007年：A suicide bombing on a military checkpost killed five people in Nowshera.
2007年：15 December:
2007年：17 December 2007 Charsadda mosque bombing 12 people were killed

2007年：21 December: On the eve of Eid ul-Adha, a suicide bomb blast again targeted Aftab Ahmad Sherpao killing at least 57 and injuring over 100 at Jamia Masjid Sherpao, in Charsadda District. Sherpao survived the blast; his younger son Mustafa Khan Sherpao, was injured.
2007年：23 December Seven people were killed in a suicide blast in Mingora.
2007年：27 December: Assassination of Benazir Bhutto, Benazir Bhutto assassinated, along with 20 others.
2007年：33 people are killed in the aftermath of the Assassination of Benazir Bhutto
2007年：A roadside bomb killed nine people including the grandson of Wali-e-Swat in Swat District.
2007年：28 December:
2007年：Second MQM insurrection Alleged Pashtuns with ties to Pakistani Taliban along with civilian Pashtuns are killed by MQM.
2008年：2 January: Elections are postponed following the assassination of Benazir Bhutto.
2008年：3 January: Pervez Musharraf denies any role in Benazir Bhutto's death. (CNN)
2008年：10 January: 24 people were killed in a suicide blast outside Lahore High Court.
2008年：24 January: Pakistan launched Operation Zalzala
2008年：31 January: The United States announces that Abu Laith al-Libi in a missile strike in northwest Pakistan
2008年：9 February: 2008 Charsadda bombing, 27 killed.
2008年：16 February: 2008 Parachinar bombing, 47 killed.
2008年：18 February: Elections are held amidst tight security. PPP, PML-N, PML-N and ANP win 124, 91, 54 and 13 seats respectively.
2008年：29 February Mingora funeral bombing, 38 killed
2008年：24 March: Yusuf Raza Gilani is elected as the new Prime Minister.
2008年：19 April: Taliban rebels release a video of Pakistan's ambassador to Afghanistan who they are holding as a hostage.
2008年：20 May: Operation Zalzala ends in a Pakistani victory.
2008年：10 June: Gora Prai airstrike accidentally hits a Pakistani post killing 10.
2008年：28 June: Pakistan launched Operation Sirat-e-Mustaqeem
2008年：6 July: 2008 Lal Masjid bombing, 18 policeman killed and 1 civilian.
2008年：9 July: Operation Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ends in a Pakistani victory followed by the launch of Operation Zarb E Kaleem.
2008年：7 August: Battle of Bajaur begins.
2008年：18 August: Pervez Musharraf resigns.
2008年：21 August: 2008 Wah bombing, 70 killed.
2008年：6 September: Asif Zardari wins presidential election with 481 votes.
2008年：9 September: Asif Zardari takes oath as President of Pakistan.
2008年：21 September: Lowara Madi incident, no fatalities reported
2008年：25 September: Tanai incident damages and American helicopter.
2008年：November–December: 2008 India–Pakistan standoff
2008年：Terrorist incidents in Pakistan in 2008 Pakistan saw 40 terrorist attacks, which caused 154 fatalities and 256 injuries.
2008年：Drone strike in Pakistan, 36 strikes killed 223 militants, 47 unknown and 28 civilians.

items.text: 2009年：16 February: Pakistan government announces a truce with Taliban, accepting a system of Islamic law in the Swat valley, conceding the area as a Taliban sanctuary.

2009年：9 March: Militants attack bus with the touring Sri Lankan cricket team. All international cricket matches in Pakistan are suspended. Pakistan also loses its status as hosts for the 2011 Cricket World Cup.
2009年：16 March: As the result of long march Lawyers' Movement succeeded. Iftikhar Mohammed Chaudhry was restored as Chief Justice of Pakistan and other judges dismissed by Musharraf.
2009年：27 March: 2009 Jamrud mosque bombing, 48–70 killed.
2009年：13 April: Nizam-e-Adl Regulation 2009 is passed.
2009年：26 April: Operation Black Thunderstorm is initiated by Pakistan
2009年：16 May: Second Battle of Swat starts

2009年：23 May: Pakistan Army launched Operation Rah-e-Rast and cleared Swat valley of all Taliban elements. It is regarded as one of the most successful counter-insurgency operations in modern age (to 15 July)
2009年：14 June: Operation Black Thunderstorm ends in a Pakistani victory.
2009年：4 April: 2009 Islamabad Frontier Corps post bombing, 5 killed.
2009年：5 April: 2009 Chakwal mosque bombing, more than 30 killed.
2009年：9 June: Pearl Continental hotel bombing, 17 killed.
2009年：19 June: Operation Rah-e-Nijat started by Pakistan.
2009年：3 July: military helicopter crash killed 41 people, Taliban claimed that they shot down the helicopter but Pakistani authorities denied the claim.
2009年：15 July: Second Battle of Swat ends in a Pakistani victory.
2009年：1 August: The 2009 Gojra riots began. Militant Islamists attacked Pakistan's Christian minority in a massive anti-Christian pogrom.
2009年：17 August: Pakistan joins the coalition for Operation Ocean Shield in Somalia.
2009年：1 September: 2009 Khyber Pass offensive is initiated by Pakistan
2009年：September: Orakzai and Kurram offensive initiated by Pakistan
10年：11 October: Operation Janbaz is successfully executed by Pakistani forces
2009年：20 October: 2009 International Islamic University bombing, 4 killed.
2009年：2 November: November 2009 Rawalpindi bombing, 35 killed.
2009年：3 November: Mohmand offensive is initiated by Pakistan.
2009年：30 November: 2009 Khyber Pass offensive ends in a Pakistani victory
2009年：4 December: December 2009 Rawalpindi attack, 40 killed.
2009年：12 December: Operation Rah-e-Nijat ends in a Pakistani victory.
2009年：Terrorist incidents in Pakistan in 2009, 50 terrorist, insurgent and sectarian-related incidents that killed 180 people and injured 300.
2009年：Drone strike in Pakistan, 54 strikes killed 387 militants, 92 unknown and 70 civilians.
links: List of drone strikes in Pakistan

2010年：Pakistan adopts the 18th amendment to the Constitution, stripping President Asif Ali Zardari of key powers.

2010年：17 April: April 2010 Kohat bombings, 58 killed.

20年1月：Pakistani military aircraft bomb suspected Taliban hideouts killing 25 militants in North Waziristan.

1905年：Partition of Bengal.
1907年：Haraprasad Shastri discovered Charyapad, the oldest known Bengali written form.
1921年：Establishment of Dhaka University, the first university of Bengal territory (now Bangladesh).
1930年4月18日：Chittagong Armoury Raid by Surya Sen.
1934年1月12日：Surya Sen was hanged on 12 January 1934 by the British rulers following the arrest in February 1933.
1936年9月：A. K. Fazlul Huq forms the Krishak Sramik Party.
1947年：Partition of British India, Pakistan and India become two independent states.
1948年3月11日：General strike by students protesting at the exclusion of Bengali as an official language.
1948年3月21日：Governor-General of Pakistan Muhammad Ali Jinnah declares in a civic reception that "Urdu, and only Urdu" will remain as the state language.
1948年3月24日：Jinnah reasserts his 'Urdu-only' policy in a speech at Curzon Hall at the University of Dhaka.
1948年3月28日：Jinnah reiterates his language policy on radio.
1949年6月23日：Formation of the Awami Muslim League
1952年2月21日：Bengali language movement reaches its peak as the police open fire on protesting students.
1953年4月17日：The Awami Muslim League becomes the Awami League.
1954年3月11日：The United Front wins most of the seats in the East Bengal Legislative Assembly.
1954年5月30日：Governor General Ghulam Muhammad deposes United Front government and establishes Governor-rule.
1955年6月6日：The United Front government is reinstated, Awami League does not participate.
1955年10月14日：'East Bengal' renamed 'East Pakistan'.
1956年2月29日：Bengali becomes one of the state languages of Pakistan.
1958年10月7日：Constitution abrogated and martial law declared in Pakistan.
1960年5月5日：Dhaka Residential Model College Established.
1963年2月21日：Inauguration of the Shaheed Minar language martyr memorial.
1966年2月5日：Six point Bengali nationalist movement led by Sheikh Mujibur Rahman emerges.
1968年：Agartala Conspiracy Case filed by the government of Pakistan accusing Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and others of sedition.
1969年1月：Mass Uprising of '69 (ঊনসত্তরের গণ-অভ্যুত্থান) in East Pakistan. (to February)
1969年3月25日：Ayub Khan resigns and Agha Mohammad Yahya Khan assumes power under martial law.
1970年11月12日：1970 Bhola cyclone
1970年12月7日：First general election in Pakistan. Awami League gains majority.
1971年3月2日：First hoisting of the National flag of Bangladesh (initial version) at the Dhaka University by Vice President of Dhaka University Students' Union (DUCSU) leader A. S. M. Abdur Rab.
1971年3月7日：Sheikh Mujibur Rahman makes his historic freedom speech.
links: This time the struggle is for our freedom

items.text: 1971年3月25日：Pakistan Army launches Operation Searchlight at midnight on the 25th, marking the start of the 1971 Bangladesh atrocities. Sheikh Mujib is arrested. (to 26 March)
1971年3月26日：Sheikh Mujib declares the independence of Bangladesh before his arrest by Pakistani Army.
1971年3月27日：Major Ziaur Rahman broadcasts the declaration of independence on behalf of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman over the radio.
1971年3月31日：Kushtia resistance begins.
1971年4月2日：Jinjira genocide
1971年4月10日：Formation of a provisional Bangladesh government-in-exile.
1971年4月18日：M. A. G. Osmani takes command of the Bangladesh Armed Forces.
1971年4月17日：The government-in-exile takes oath at Mujibnagar.
1971年4月18日：Battle of Daruin, Comilla and Battle of Rangamati-Mahalchari waterway, Chittagong Hill Tracts.
1971年5月5日：Gopalpur massacre, workers slain by the Pakistani Army
1971年5月20日：Chuknagar massacre by the Pakistan Army.
1971年5月24日：Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra radio station established in Kolkata.
1971年7月11日：Sector Commanders Conference 1971. (to 17 July)
1971年8月16日：Operation Jackpot, Bangladesh naval commando operation.
1971年8月20日：Flight Lieutenant Matiur Rahman attempts to defect after hijacking a fighter plane.
1971年9月5日：Battle of Goahati, Jessore.
1971年9月28日：Bangladesh Air Force functional.
1971年10月13日：Dhaka guerrillas kill Abdul Monem Khan, governor of East Pakistan.
1971年10月28日：Battle of Dhalai Outpost, Srimongol.
1971年11月9日：Six small ships constitute the first fleet of Bangladesh Navy.
1971年11月16日：Battle of Ajmiriganj, an 18‑hour encounter between Mukti Bahini Freedom Fighters and the Pakistan army.
1971年11月20日：Battle of Garibpur between India and the Pakistan Army. (to 21 November)
1971年11月21日：Mitro Bahini, a joint force of Bangladesh and Indian troops formed.
links: Mitro Bahini Order of Battle December 1971

items.text: 1971年11月22日：Battle of Boyra, involving Pakistani and Indian air force.
1971年12月3日：Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 breaks out. Bangladesh Air Force destroys Pakistani oil depots.
1971年12月4日：India officially invades East Pakistan.
1971年12月6日：India becomes the first country to recognize Bangladesh. Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra radio station becomes Bangladesh Betar.
1971年12月7日：Liberation of Jessore, Sylhet and the Moulovi Bazar.
1971年12月9日：Chandpur and Daudkandi liberated.
1971年12月10日：Liberation of Laksham. Two Bangladeshi ships sunk mistakenly by Indian air attack.
1971年12月11日：Liberation of Hilli, Mymensingh, Kushtia and Noakhali.
1971年12月14日：Selective genocide of Bengali intellectuals, liberation of Bogra.
1971年12月16日：Surrender of the Pakistan army and liberation of Dhaka.
1972年2月9日：The 25-year Indo-Bangladeshi Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Peace is signed in Dhaka.
links: Indo-Bangladeshi Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Peace

items.text: 1972年1月10日：Sheikh Mujibur Rahman returns to Bangladesh.
1972年3月17日：Indian Army leaves Dhaka.
1972年3月19日：The prime ministers of Bangladesh and India sign the Joint River Commission bilateral working group.
1972年11月4日：Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh is adopted by the Assembly.
1972年12月16日：Constitution of Bangladesh becomes effective.
1973年3月7日：First general election in Bangladesh is held, Bangladesh Awami League secures a majority.
1973年9月6日：Bangladesh joins the Non-Aligned Movement(NAM).
1973年12月15日：Gallantry awards for wartime service published in the Bangladesh Gazette.
1974年：Bangladesh famine of 1974 cause the deaths of over one million people.
1974年2月22日：Pakistan recognizes Bangladesh.
1974年4月9日：A tripartite agreement is signed between Bangladesh, India and Pakistan regarding post-war humanitarian issues.
1974年9月17日：Bangladesh joins the United Nations (UN).
1974年12月28日：Sheikh Mujibur Rahman declares a state of emergency.
1975年1月25日：A fourth amendment to the constitution abolishes the parliamentary system and establishes a presidential system in its place.
1975年2月25日：Bangladesh Krishak Sramik Awami League (BAKSAL) established under the leadership of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman as the single legitimate political party.
1975年8月15日：Assassination of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
1975年11月3日：On Jail Killing Day, four leaders of the liberation war are assassinated in prison.
1975年11月7日：Major General Ziaur Rahman becomes deputy Martial Law Administrator.
1976年7月21日：Lieutenant Colonel. Abu Taher was sentenced to death for overthrowing the government and destroying the armed forces.
1976年8月29日：Death of national poet Kazi Nazrul Islam.
1977年4月21日：Zia-ur Rahman replaces Sayem as president.
1977年5月30日：Zia-ur Rahman gains 98.9 percent of votes in a referendum on his continuance as president.
1977年6月3日：Supreme Court justice Abdus Sattar becomes vice president.
1977年9月1日：Formation of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party(BNP).
1977年9月28日：Japanese Red Army terrorist group forces a hijacked Japan Airlines Flight to land in Dhaka.
1978年：Bangladesh is elected to a two-year term on the UN Security Council.
1978年6月3日：Zia-ur Rahman wins presidential election and secures his position for a five-year term.
1979年2月18日：The 1979 General Election takes place. Bangladesh Nationalist Party led by Zia scores a decisive victory.
1981年5月30日：Assassination of Ziaur Rahman.
1982年3月24日：Lieutenant General Hussain Muhammad Ershad assumes power after a bloodless coup.
1982年10月4日：Bangladesh signs a memorandum of understanding with India on water sharing over the following two years.
1983年12月11日：Hussain Muhammad Ershad takes over as president.
1986年5月7日：At the 1986 General Election, a victory by the Jatiya Party consolidates Ershad's position.
1987年12月7日：Ershad dissolves parliament under opposition pressure.
1988年3月3日：Jatiya Party gains an overwhelming majority in the General Election with 68.44% of the votes.
1988年12月2日：A devastating cyclone strikes Bangladesh.
1990年12月6日：Ershad offers resignation.
1991年2月27日：1991 Bangladeshi general election, Bangladesh Nationalist party snatches victory.
1991年4月29日：1991 Bangladesh cyclone kills more than 138,000.
1996年5月14日：Over 400 are killed as a tornado strikes northern Bangladesh.
1996年5月19日：Failed attempt of coup d'état by Lt. Gen. Abu Saleh Mohammad Nasim, Bir Bikram.
1996年6月12日：General election of '96, Bangladesh Awami League gains majority.
1996年12月12日：India and Bangladesh sign a 30-year treaty on Ganges water sharing.
1997年12月2日：The 'Chittagong Hill Tracts Peace Accord' is signed between Bangladesh government and Parbatya Chattagram Jana Sanghati Samiti.
1999年5月28日：Veteran Bangladeshi actor-producer Shakib Khan made his debut with the film Ananta Bhalobasha.
1999年11月17日：21 February is declared International Mother Language Day in the 30th General Conference of UNESCO.
2000年3月20日：President Clinton becomes the first US president to visit Bangladesh.
2001年10月1日：Bangladesh Nationalist Party secures a decisive victory at the Eighth General Election.
2002年1月1日：Sale of polythene bags banned in Dhaka for environmental reasons.
2002年2月5日：Death penalty introduced for acid attacks.
2002年8月29日：Transparency International lists Bangladesh amongst the most corrupt nations.
2004年5月20日：Terrorist attack on British High Commissioner in Sylhet.
2004年8月21日：2004 Dhaka grenade attack by terrorist organization Harkat-ul-Jihad-al-Islami (HUJI).
2005年1月27日：Shah A M S Kibria assassinated in a grenade attack in the Habiganj District, Sylhet.
2005年2月25日：Bangladesh peacekeepers ambushed and killed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
2005年3月6日：Terrorist leader Siddique ul-Islam captured.
2005年8月17日：Terrorist group JMB simultaneously detonates 500 bombs in 300 different locations.
2006年：Grameen Bank and Muhammad Yunus are awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.
2006年3月2日：Terrorist leader Shaykh Abdur Rahman captured.
2006年4月24日：A training aircraft of the Bangladesh Air Force crashes in the Jhenaidah District.
2006年6月24日：Remains of Bir Sreshtho awardee Matiur Rahman are brought back to Bangladesh.
2007年1月11日：President Iajuddin Ahmed declares a state of emergency.
2007年1月12日：Fakhruddin Ahmed takes the oath as the Chief Adviser of the caretaker government.
2007年3月30日：Leaders of terrorist group JMJB are executed.
2007年7月16日：Sheikh Hasina arrested on extortion charges and denied bail.
2007年9月3日：Khaleda Zia arrested on corruption charges.
2007年11月15日：Cyclone Sidr hits the coast, causing the death of around 3,500 people.
2007年12月10日：Remains of Bir Sreshtho awardee Hamidur Rahman bought back to Bangladesh and reinterred next to Bir Shrestho Matiur Rahman.
2008年6月11日：Sheikh Hasina released on parole and flown out to the US for medical treatment.
2008年12月29日：Bangladesh Awami League secures a landslide victory in 2008 Bangladeshi general election. Sheikh Hasina becomes prime minister for the second time.
2009年：Mutiny staged by paramilitary force Bangladesh Rifles.
2009年5月25日：Cyclone Aila ravages the south-west coast.
2009年11月19日：Verdict on the assassination of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in the Bangabandhu Murder Case.
2010年1月28日：Execution of five condemned killers of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

2010年3月24日：Tiny South Talpatti Island off the coast of Bengal disappears, washed away thirty years after the mud flat island was created by delta currents, ending the Indian and Bangladeshi dispute over the territory.
2011年2月17日：Widespread outrage at the killing of Felani Khatun a 15-year-old Bangladeshi girl, who was shot and killed by India's Border Security Force (BSF), at India-Bangladesh border.
2011年2月17日：Bangladesh co-hosts the ICC Cricket World Cup with India and Sri Lanka.
2011年9月5日：India and Bangladesh sign a pact to end their 40-year border demarcation dispute.
2012年1月18日：Bangladesh Army claimed to have foiled a coup d'état attempt.
2012年11月24日：Garments factory fire at Tazreen Fashion factory in Ashulia kills 117.
2013年4月24日：Garments factory collapse at Savar claims 1,134 lives.
2014年1月5日：2014 Bangladeshi general election. Landslide Awami League victory. Sheikh Hasina elected for the third term as prime minister.
2016年：Terrorist attack and hostage crisis at Holey Artisan Bakery in Dhaka culminating in the death of 29.
2017年8月25日：Rohingya refugee crisis breaks out. Over 700,000 refugees flee to Bangladesh over the next four months.
2018年12月30日：2018 Bangladeshi general election. Landslide Awami League victory. Sheikh Hasina elected for the fourth term as prime minister.
2019年11月27日：Seven terrorists sentenced to death for the July 2016 Dhaka attack.
2020年3月8日：First three confirmed cases of COVID-19 in Bangladesh.
2020年3月18日：First confirmed COVID-19 death in Bangladesh.
2020年5月20日：Cyclone Amphan ravages West Bengal and south-western coast of Bangladesh.
2023年6月29日：The highest grossing Bangladeshi film of all-time Priyotoma was released.
2024年8月5日：Sheikh Hasina resigns as prime minister and flees to India because of 2024 Non-cooperation movement while her official residence is stormed by protesters.
2024年12月26日：Bangladesh Secretariat torched at 1:52 AM approximately
約500000年－300000年前：First human settlements in Sri Lanka.
約300000年前：Possible earliest occurrence of archaeological deposits dating back to the Middle Pleistocene.
約125000年前：Evidence of a flake industry characterized by unretouched small tools.
約125000年－75000年前：Occurrence of Pleistocene altithermals leading to increased atmospheric circulation and seasonality of precipitation.
約74000年前：Earliest radiometric dating of archaeological deposits in Sri Lanka.
約前50000年－前30000年：Prehistoric Period: primitive food-gathering.
約前30000年－前1000年：Mesolithic Period: food-gathering.
約28500年前：Artefacts layer recorded at Batadombalena site (7c).
約28000年前：Appearance of geometric microlithic stone tool assemblages (up to possibly ca. 2,500 BP).
約28000年前：Earliest evidence of anatomically modern man in South Asia from human remains.
約28000年前：Start of relative homogeneity in Wet Zone environmental and cultural sub-systems.
約22000年前：Artefacts layer recorded at Batadombalena site (7b).
約16700年前：Artefacts layer recorded at Batadombalena site (7a).
約16000年前：Human skeletal material displaying morphological continuity.
約14300年－16000年前：Artefacts layer recorded at Batadombalena site (6).
約13500年前：Artefacts layer recorded at Batadombalena site (5).
約12500年前：Human skeletal material displaying morphological continuity.
約11500年－13000年前：Artefacts layer recorded at Batadombalena site (4).
約前10000年：Austronesian migrations to Sri Lanka; production of microliths from heat-shattered quartz and evidence of urn burials.
約6500年前：Human skeletal material displaying morphological continuity.
約前1000年－前300年：Protohistoric Period: beginnings of agriculture and iron technology.

前900年：Archaeological evidence for the beginnings of the Iron Age in Sri Lanka is found at Anuradhapura, where a large city–settlement was founded before 900 BCE. The settlement was about 15 hectares in 900 BCE, but by 700 BC it had expanded to 50 hectares. A similar site from the same period has also been discovered near Aligala in Sigiriya.
前600年－前500年：Early Brahmi inscriptions and non-Brahmi symbols recorded from site contexts AMP-88(75) and ASW-88(88)

約前500年：Transition between the protohistoric Iron Age and the Lower Early Historic period, as instanced in context 17. Rim type 8 in necked vessels and roof-tile type 35a make their first appearance. This episode is inadequately defined and could have commenced as early as the 8th century BC, as per the evidence from the calibrated age range.
約前500年：Commencement of progressive spread of Sinhalese and Tamil speaking peoples equipped with iron technology and agricultural subsistence systems.

前543年：Prince Vijaya had his followers landed at a place called Supparaka; the women landed at a place called Mahiladipaka, and the children landed at a place called Naggadipa. Vijaya's ship later reached Sri Lanka, on the North west coast of present-day Puttalam, on the day of the Parinibbaana of The Buddha.
前543年：The Kingdom of Tambapanni is established.

前543年－前505年：During the reign of Vijaya, in addition to Tambapaṇṇī, the King and his ministers founded settlements like Anuraadhagaama, Upatissagāma, Ujjeni, Uruvelaa and Vijithapura located along the river banks of the Malwathu Oya and the Kala Oya in the northwestern region of Sri Lanka.
前505年：Prince Vijaya dies without a legitimate successor after a reign of 38 years. Upatissa, chief minister of Vijaya, becomes regent while a successor is brought over from Sinhapura.
前504年：The nephew of Prince Vijaya, Panduvasdeva, succeeds him to the throne. He arrives one year after the death of Vijaya and brings with him 32 sons of ministers.
前474年：Death of Panduvasdeva after a reign of 30 years. Abhaya, eldest son of Panduvasdeva, ascends the throne.
前454年：Deposition of Abhaya after a reign of 20 years; Prince Tissa, younger brother of Abhaya, becomes regent.

前454年－前437年：Prince Tissa was not acknowledged universally as the Sinhalese king, remained as regent during the Nineteen Years' War (458–439 BC), which ended with the Battle of Labugamaka where with the aid of the Yakkhas and others, Pandukabhaya slew eight of his uncles who were against him.
前437年：Pandukabhaya, nephew of Abhaya and Tissa, takes the capital Upatissagāma and is crowned the new Sinhalese king.
前438年：Pandukabhaya proceeded to Anuraadhagaama where he builds it as the new capital of Sri Lanka, renaming it Anuradhapura.
前400年：Abhaya Wewa built
前367年：Death of Pandukabhaya after a reign of 70 years. Mutasiva, son of Pandukabhaya, ascends the throne.
前375年：Total solar eclipse visible over northern Sri Lanka (Jaffna Peninsula).
前353年：Total solar eclipse visible over southeastern Sri Lanka.
前335年：Total solar eclipse visible across almost the entirety of Sri Lanka.
前307年：Death of Mutasiva after a reign of 60 years. Devanampiya Tissa, second son of Mutasiva, ascends the throne.
前250年：Theravada Buddhism is officially introduced to Sri Lanka by the Mahinda Thero, son of Ashoka, during the reign of Devanampiya Tissa.

前250年：Sanghamitta Theri, daughter of Emperor Ashoka, sister of Mahinda, arrives in Sri Lanka from India to establish the Bhikkhuni Sangha, bringing a sapling of the Sacred Bodhi Tree, which was planted in the Mahamevnāwa Uyana at Anuradhapura.
前267年：Death of Devanampiya Tissa after a reign of 40 years. Uttiya, younger brother of Devanampiya Tissa, ascends the throne.
前255年：Mahinda Thero passes away at the age of 80 in the eighth year of the reign of Uttiya.
前256年：Sanghamitta Therii passes away at the age of 79 in the ninth year of the reign of Uttiya.
前257年：Death of Uttiya after a reign of 10 years. Mahasiva, younger brother of Uttiya, ascends the throne.
前247年：Death of Mahasiva after a reign of 10 years. Suratissa, younger brother of Mahasiva, ascends the throne.
前237年：Suratissa is slain in battle after a reign of 10 years; South Indian invaders Sena and Guttika usurp the throne.
前215年：Asela, son of Mutasiva, overthrows Sena and Guttika in battle after a reign of 22 years reclaiming the throne.
前205年：Asela is slain in battle after a reign of 10 years; Elara, a Tamil prince from South India invades and ursurpes the throne.
前161年：Dutugamunu, a descendant of Mahanaga, Prince of Ruhuna brother of Asela, defeats and kills Elara at the Battle of Vijithapura and restores Sinhalese sovereignty after a reign of 44 years.
前140年：The Ruwanwelisaya (or Maha Thupa), the most celebrated stupa in Sri Lanka, is built by Dutugamunu and sends a monk to India to fetch relics to be enshrined in it.
前133年：Total solar eclipse visible across Sri Lanka except the far northern region, during the reign of King Dutugamunu.
前137年：Death of Dutugemunu after a reign of 24 years. Saddha Tissa, younger brother of Dutugemunu, ascends the throne.
前119年：Saddha Tissa dies and is succeeded by his younger son Thulatthana, whose ascension was endorsed and supported as a result of the decision made by royal advisors and Buddhist monks.

前119年：Death of Saddha Tissa after a reign of 18 years. Thulatthana, second son of Saddha Tissa, ascends the throne, but is deposed and killed after a reign of 1 month and 10 days; Lanjatissa, elder brother of Thulatthana, ascends the throne.
前119年：One month and ten days after his ascension, Lanja Tissa usurps his younger brother Thulatthana and takes the throne upon hear of his succession.
前109年：Death of Lanjatissa after a reign of 9 years and 15 days. Khallata Naga, younger brother of Lanjatissa, ascends the throne.

前103年：Khallata Naga is assassinated by his own commander-in-chief, Kammaharattaka. However, Kammaharattaka's rule last only a day and is killed by Prince Vattagamini, the youngest brother of Khallata Naga. Prince Vattagamini ascends the throne as Valagamba.

前103年：Only five months into his regin Valagamba faced internal threats from a Brahman named Tiya (or Tissa) from Ruhuna, South Lanka and external threats from Tamil forces from South India. The Tamil army vanquished Tiya and defeated Valagamba in battle forcing him to flee into exile for fourteen years. Pulahatha, the first of the The Five Dravidians seized and ruled the Sinhalese throne.

前103年－前89年：The fourteen years of rule of The Five Dravidians was disastrous for the country and its institutions. The Beminitiya Seya, an unprecedented famine during that period caused the rapid decline of Buddhism in the country with many thousands of monks and laymen dying of starvation.
前100年：Pulahatha is slain after a reign of 3 years; Bahiya ascends the throne.
前98年：Bahiya is slain after a reign of 2 years; Panaya Mara ascends the throne.
前91年：Panaya Mara is slain after a reign of 7 years; Pilaya Mara ascends the throne.
前90年：Pilaya Mara is slain after a reign of 7 months; Dathika ascends the throne.
前89年：After building and army during his 14 years in exile Valagamba launches a successful attack on Dathika, the last of the Five Dravidians defeating him and taking back control of the country.
前89年：Vattagāmanī Abhaya founds the Abhayagiri Vihāra.
前77年：Death of Valagamba after a second reign of 12 years. Mahakuli Mahatissa, nephew and adopted son of Valagamba (son of Khallata Naga), ascends the throne.
前63年：Death of Mahakuli Mahatissa after a reign of 14 years. Chora Naga, son of Valagamba, ascends the throne.
前51年：Chora Naga is poisoned after a reign of 12 years. Kuda Tissa, son of Mahakuli Mahatissa, ascends the throne.
前47年：Kuda Tissa is poisoned by Queen Anula after a reign of 3 years; Anula, widow of Chora Naga and Kuda Tissa, rules as queen regnant.
前42年：Anula is executed after a reign of 5 years; Kutakanna Tissa, second son of Mahakuli Mahatissa, ascends the throne.
前20年：Death of Kutakanna Tissa after a reign of 22 years. Bhatika Abhaya, son of Kutakanna Tissa, ascends the throne.
9年：Death of Bhatika Abhaya after a reign of 28 years. Mahadathika Mahanaga, younger brother of Bhatikabhaya Tissa, ascends the throne.
21年：Death of Mahadathika Mahanaga after a reign of 12 years. Amandagamani Abhaya, son of Mahadathika Mahanaga, ascends the throne.
30年：Amandagamani Abhaya is assassinated after a reign of 9 years and 8 months; Kanirajanu Tissa, younger brother of Amandagamani Abhaya, ascends the throne.
