33年：Death of Kaniraja Tissa after a reign of 3 years. Chulabhaya, son of Amandagamani Abhaya, ascends the throne.
35年：Death of Chulabhaya after a reign of 1 year. Sivali, sister of Chulabhaya, rules as queen regnant, but is deposed after 4 months; Ilanaga, nephew of Chulabhaya and Sivali, ascends the throne.
41年－54年：Annius Plocamus, a Roman tax collector, visits Sri Lanka during the reign of Claudius.
44年：Death of Ilanaga after a reign of 9 years. Chandamukha, son of Ilanaga, ascends the throne.
45年：Envoys from Sri Lanka visit Rome during the reign of Emperor Claudius.
52年：Chandamukha is killed after a reign of 8 years and 8 months; Yassalalaka Tissa, younger brother of Chandamukha Siva, ascends the throne.
60年：Yassalalaka Tissa is slain after a reign of 7 years and 8 months; Subharaja (Subha), royal gatekeeper, usurps the throne.
66年：Subharaja is slain after a reign of 6 years; Vasabha, member of the Lambakanna clan, ascends the throne, founding the First Lambakanna Dynasty.
110年：Death of Vasabha after a reign of 44 years. Vankanasika Tissa, son of Vasabha, ascends the throne.
113年：Death of Vankanasika Tissa after a reign of 3 years.
114年：Gajabahu I, son of Vankanasika Tissa, ascends the throne.
136年：Death of Gajabahu I after a reign of 22 years. Mahallaka Naga, father-in-law of Gajabahu I, ascends the throne.
142年：Death of Mahallaka Naga after a reign of 6 years. Bhatika Tissa, son of Mahallaka Naga, ascends the throne.
150年－250年：Construction of monumental architecture.
166年：Death of Bhatika Tissa after a reign of 24 years. Kanittha Tissa, younger brother of Bhatika Tissa, ascends the throne.
184年：Death of Kanittha Tissa after a reign of 18 years. Khujjanaga, son of Kanittha Tissa, ascends the throne.
186年：Khujjanaga is murdered after a reign of 2 years; Kunchanaga, younger brother of Khujjanaga, ascends the throne.
187年：Kunchanaga is deposed after a reign of 1 year; Siri Naga I, brother-in-law of Kunchanaga, ascends the throne.
206年：Death of Siri Naga I after a reign of 19 years. Voharika Tissa, son of Siri Naga I, ascends the throne.
228年：Voharika Tissa is overthrown and killed after a reign of 22 years; Abhaya Naga, younger brother of Voharika Tissa, ascends the throne.
236年：Death of Abhaya Naga after a reign of 8 years. Siri Naga II, nephew of Abhaya Naga (son of Voharika Tissa), ascends the throne.
238年：Death of Siri Naga II after a reign of 2 years. Vijaya Kumara, son of Sirinaga II, ascends the throne.
239年：Vijaya Kumara is slain after a reign of 1 year; Sangha Tissa I, noble of the Lambakanna clan, ascends the throne.
243年：Sangha Tissa I is poisoned after a reign of 4 years; Siri Sangha Bodhi I, noble of the Lambakanna clan, ascends the throne.
247年：Siri Sangha Bodhi I abdicates after a reign of 4 years; Gothabhaya, chief minister and Lambakanna noble, ascends the throne.
260年：Death of Gothabhaya after a reign of 13 years. Jettha Tissa I, elder son of Gothabhaya, ascends the throne.
274年：Death of Jettha Tissa I after a reign of 14 years. Mahasena, younger brother of Jettha Tissa I, ascends the throne.
301年：Death of Mahasena after a reign of 27 years. Sirimeghavanna, son of Mahasena, ascends the throne.
311年：Princess Hemamala and Prince Dantha bring the Sacred Relic of the tooth of the Buddha from Kalinga to Sri Lanka during the reign of Sirimeghavanna.
links: Relic of the tooth of the Buddha

items.text: 327年6月6日：Total solar eclipse visible over southeastern Sri Lanka during the Anuradhapura period.
328年：Death of Sirimeghavanna after a reign of 27 years. Jettha Tissa II, younger brother of Sirimeghavanna, ascends the throne.
337年：Death of Jettha Tissa II after a reign of 9 years. Buddhadasa, son of Jettha Tissa II, ascends the throne.
365年：Death of Buddhadasa after a reign of 28 years. Upatissa I, eldest son of Buddhadasa, ascends the throne.
5世紀：Composition of Mahāvamsa.
406年：Upatissa I is murdered after a reign of 41 years; Mahanama, younger brother of Upatissa I, ascends the throne.
410年－412年：Faxian, a Chinese Buddhist monk and traveller, visits Sri Lanka and stays for two years studying Buddhist texts.
425年－450年：During the reign of Mahanama, Buddhaghosa Thera arrived from India to compile the Pali Commentaries (Atthakathaa) and compose the Visuddhimagga at the Mahaavihaara.
425年：Dhammapala composes commentaries on remaining portions of the Canon (such as the Udana, Itivuttaka, Theragatha, and Therigatha) along with extensive sub-commentaries.

428年：Death of Mahanama after a reign of 22 years. Soththisena, son of Mahanama, ascends the throne and dies after a reign of 1 day; Chattagahaka Jantu, husband of Mahanama's daughter, ascends the throne.

429年：Death of Chattagahaka Jantu after a reign of 1 year. Mittasena, an outsider of unknown royal lineage, ascends the throne and is slain after a reign of 1 year by Pandyan invaders; Pandu captures the throne.
429年：Bhikkhuni Devasara leads a delegation of Sri Lankan nuns to China, carrying a sapling of the Bodhi tree to help establish the Bhikkhuni ordination line.
433年：A second delegation of Sri Lankan bhikkhunis arrives at Nanlin Temple in Nanjing, performing the first dual ordination for over 300 Chinese nuns.
434年：Death of Pandu after a reign of 5 years; Parinda, son of Pandu, ascends the throne.
437年：Death of Parinda after a reign of 3 years; Khudda Parinda, younger brother of Parinda, ascends the throne.
453年：Death of Khudda Parinda after a reign of 16 years; Tiritara ascends the throne and is slain after 2 months; Dathiya ascends the throne.
456年：Dathiya is slain after a reign of 3 years; Pithiya ascends the throne and is slain after 7 months; Dhatusena, member of the Moriya clan, ascends the throne (Moriya Dynasty).
459年－477年：Dhatusena repels Tamil invaders from South India but is later killed by his son Kassapa I.
473年：Dhatusena is murdered after a reign of 17 years; Kashyapa I, non-royal son of Dhatusena, usurps the throne and moves the capital to Sigiriya.
477年－495年：Kassapa I establishes his capital and fortress complex at Sigiriya.
495年：Kashyapa I commits suicide in battle after a reign of 22 years; Moggallana I, royal son of Dhatusena and half-brother of Kashyapa I, ascends the throne.
497年－515年：The Sacred Hair Relic of the Buddha was brought to Sri Lanka during the reign of Moggallana I.
512年：Death of Moggallana I after a reign of 17 years. Kumara Dhatusena, son of Moggallana I, ascends the throne.
520年：Death of Kumara Dhatusena after a reign of 8 years. Kittisena, son of Kumara Dhatusena, ascends the throne.

521年：Kittisena is murdered after a reign of 9 months; Siva II, maternal uncle of Kittisena, ascends the throne and is slain after 25 days; Upatissa II, brother-in-law of Kumara Dhatusena, ascends the throne.
522年：Upatissa II is slain after a reign of 1 year and 6 months; Silakala Ambasamanera, distant relative of the Moriya clan, ascends the throne.

535年：Death of Silakala Ambasamanera after a reign of 13 years. Dathappabhuti, second son of Silakala Ambasamanera, ascends the throne and is slain after 6 months; Jettha Tissa III (Dathaprabhati), younger brother of Dathappabhuti, ascends the throne and is slain after 5 months; Moggallana II, eldest brother of Rathathiyana and Jettha Tissa III, ascends the throne.

555年：Death of Moggallana II after a reign of 20 years. Kittisiri Meghavanna, son of Moggallana II, ascends the throne and is slain after 19 days; Maha Naga, prime minister under Silakala Ambasamanera, ascends the throne.
560年：Death of Maha Naga after a reign of 5 years. Aggabodhi I, maternal nephew and adopted son of Maha Naga, ascends the throne.
604年：Death of Aggabodhi I after a reign of 44 years. Aggabodhi II, nephew and son-in-law of Aggabodhi I, ascends the throne.

614年：Death of Aggabodhi II after a reign of 10 years. Sangha Tissa II, brother and sword-bearer of Aggabodhi II, ascends the throne and is slain after 2 months; Moggallana III, general under Aggabodhi II, ascends the throne.
619年：Moggallana III is slain after a reign of 5 years; Silameghavanna, general under Moggallana III, ascends the throne.

628年：Death of Silameghavanna after a reign of 9 years. Aggabodhi III, son of Silameghavanna, ascends the throne, but is deposed after a first reign of 6 months; Jettha Tissa III, son of Sangha Tissa II, ascends the throne.
629年：Jettha Tissa III commits suicide in battle after a reign of 5 months; Aggabodhi III regains the throne.
639年：Death of Aggabodhi III after a second reign of 10 years. Dathopa Tissa I, general under Jettha Tissa III, ascends the throne.
650年：Death of Dathopa Tissa I after a reign of 11 years. Kassapa II, younger brother of Aggabodhi III, ascends the throne.
653年6月1日：Total solar eclipse visible over southern Sri Lanka.
659年：Death of Kassapa II after a reign of 9 years. Dappula I, nephew of Silameghavanna and son-in-law of Kassapa II, ascends the throne.
662年：Deposition of Dappula I after a reign of 3 years; Dathopa Tissa II, nephew of Dathopa Tissa I, ascends the throne.
671年：Death of Dathopa Tissa II after a reign of 9 years. Aggabodhi IV, younger brother of Dathopa Tissa II, ascends the throne.

687年：Death of Aggabodhi IV after a reign of 16 years. Unhanagara Hatthadatha, royal prince of Unhanagara lineage, ascends the throne and is slain after 6 months; Manavanna, son of Kassapa II, ascends the throne, founding the Second Lambakanna Dynasty.
720年：Indian Esoteric Buddhist master Vajrabodhi visits Sri Lanka on his journey to China.
722年：Death of Manavanna after a reign of 35 years. Aggabodhi V, eldest son of Manavanna, ascends the throne.
728年：Death of Aggabodhi V after a reign of 6 years. Kassapa III, younger brother of Aggabodhi V, ascends the throne.
735年：Death of Kassapa III after a reign of 7 years. Mahinda I, youngest brother of Aggabodhi V and Kassapa III, rules as regent.
738年：Death of Mahinda I after a regency of 3 years. Aggabodhi VI, son of Kassapa III, ascends the throne.
741年：Amoghavajra, a disciple of Vajrabodhi, visits Sri Lanka to collect esoteric Buddhist scriptures.
769年：Polonnaruva becomes temporary capital.
778年：Death of Aggabodhi VI after a reign of 40 years. Aggabodhi VII, son of Mahinda I, ascends the throne.
789年：Death of Aggabodhi VII after a reign of 11 years. Mahinda II, son of Aggabodhi VI, ascends the throne.
794年：Death of Mahinda II after a reign of 5 years. Dappula II, son of Mahinda II, ascends the throne.
799年：Death of Dappula II after a reign of 5 years. Mahinda III, son of Dappula II, ascends the throne.
804年：Death of Mahinda III after a reign of 5 years. Aggabodhi VIII, younger brother of Mahinda III, ascends the throne.
815年：Death of Aggabodhi VIII after a reign of 11 years. Dappula III, younger brother of Aggabodhi VIII, ascends the throne.
831年：Death of Dappula III after a reign of 16 years. Aggabodhi IX, son of Dappula II and cousin of Dappula III, ascends the throne.
834年：Death of Aggabodhi IX after a reign of 3 years. Sena I, younger brother of Aggabodhi IX, ascends the throne.
834年9月7日：Total solar eclipse visible over southern Sri Lanka.
840年：Srimara Srivallabha invades the Anuradhapura kingdom and captures the northern provinces from Sena I.
850年：Persian Muslim traveler Sulaiman al-Tajir visits Sri Lanka and writes accounts of its trade and gems.
853年：Sena II starts construction on the Mihintale Hospital Complex, considered one of the oldest hospital ruins in the world and the oldest existing hospital ruins in Sri Lanka.
854年：Death of Sena I after a reign of 20 years. Sena II, nephew of Sena I (son of Kassapa), ascends the throne.
862年：Sinhalese forces led by Sena II invade the Pandyan kingdom and sack Madurai. Srimara is killed in battle.
866年6月16日：Total solar eclipse visible over northern Sri Lanka (Jaffna Peninsula) during the reign of King Sena II.
887年：Lankan expedition sacks Madurai.
889年：Death of Sena II after a reign of 35 years. Udaya I, younger brother of Sena II, ascends the throne.
898年：Death of Udaya I after a reign of 9 years. Kassapa IV, younger brother of Sena II and Udaya I, ascends the throne.
900年：Persian scholar Abu Zayd al-Sirafi compiles accounts of Sri Lanka based on maritime trade networks.
915年：Death of Kassapa IV after a reign of 17 years. Kassapa V, son of Sena II and nephew of Kassapa IV, ascends the throne.
925年：Death of Kassapa V after a reign of 10 years. Dappula IV, son of Kassapa IV, ascends the throne, dies after a reign of 7 months, and Dappula V, younger brother of Dappula IV, ascends the throne.
937年：Death of Dappula V after a reign of 12 years. Udaya II, cousin of Dappula V (son of Udaya I), ascends the throne.
940年：Death of Udaya II after a reign of 3 years. Sena III, brother of Udaya II, ascends the throne.
943年：Death of Sena III after a reign of 3 years. Udaya III, cousin of Sena III (son of Kassapa IV), ascends the throne.
946年：Death of Udaya III after a reign of 3 years. Sena IV, son of Kassapa V, ascends the throne.
947年：Coļas invade Sri Lanka.
953年：Death of Sena IV after a reign of 7 years. Mahinda IV, younger brother of Sena IV, ascends the throne.
953年4月6日：Total solar eclipse visible over the northern tip of Sri Lanka.
970年：Arab historian and traveler Al-Masudi visits Sri Lanka.
975年：Death of Mahinda IV after a reign of 22 years. Sena V, eldest son of Mahinda IV, ascends the throne.
977年12月13日：Total solar eclipse visible over the southern tip of Sri Lanka during the reign of Sena V.
987年：Death of Sena V after a reign of 12 years. Mahinda V, younger brother of Sena V, ascends the throne.
993年：Coļas invade Sri Lanka.
1014年－1017年：Chola conquest and occupation of Anuradhapura: The Cholas under Rajendra I attack and conquer parts of the Anuradhapura kingdom.
1014年－1017年：Mahinda V is captured, along with the crown, queen, daughter, and wealth by Chola invaders after ruling for 30 years; Chola Annexation begins.
1014年－1017年：The Sangha, and especially in Sri Lanka, the Bhikkhuni (Buddhist nuns) Order dies out due to invasions. The bhikkhu line in Sri Lanka is later revived with bhikkhus from Burma.

1029年：Chola conquest and occupation of Anuradhapura: Death of Mahinda V in captivity in India after 42 nominal years of reign. Kassapa VI (Vikramabahu), son of Mahinda V, leads southern resistance in Ruhuna.
1040年：Death of Kassapa VI after a reign of 11 years. Kirti, general under Kassapa VI, reigns in Ruhuna and is slain after 7 days; Mahalana Kitti, noble of Ruhuna, ascends the throne.
1043年：Death of Mahalana Kitti after a reign of 3 years; Vikrama Pandya, Pandyan prince living in Ruhuna, reigns.
1046年：Death of Vikrama Pandya after a reign of 3 years; Jagathpala, prince of Ayodhya, reigns in Ruhuna.
1049年：A Sinhalese chieftain named Lokeshwara, temporarily defeats the Chola forces and establishes a military base in Ruhuna.
1050年：The bhikkhu and bhikkhuni monastic communities at Anuradhapura die out following invasions from South India.
1052年：Death of Jagathpala after a reign of 6 years; Parakrama Pandya, Pandyan prince, reigns in Ruhuna.
1054年：Death of Parakrama Pandya after a reign of 2 years; Loka, prime minister of Ruhuna, reigns.
1054年：Keshadhatu Kasyapa, a pretender to the Sinhalese throne, establishes a dominion in Eastern Ruhuna after driving away Chola forces, which would last until 1055.
1055年：Death of Loka after a reign of 1 year; Vijayabahu I, royal prince of the Lambakanna lineage, ascends the throne in Ruhuna, expels the Chola Empire, and unifies Sri Lanka at Polonnaruwa.
1070年：Prince Kitti, who was given the title Vijayabahu, launches a seventeen-year campaign and successfully drives out the Cholas from Sri Lanka.
1070年：Vijayabahu is crowned as the first king of Polonnaruwa.
1070年：Vijayabahu I invites bhikkhus from Pagan (Burma) to Polonnaruwa to reinstate the Theravada ordination line in Sri Lanka.
1070年：Vijayabāhu I expels Colas from the island.
1073年：Construction of the stone Buddha sculptures at Gal Vihara following the expulsion of Chola forces from Polonnaruwa.

1084年：Velakkara Revolt: Tamil mercenaries named Velakkaras, mutiny against king Vijayabahu as he declared war with the Chola Empire due to arresting a group of Sinhalese ambassadors sent to Western Chalukya.

1084年－1112年：In Myanmar, during the reign of Kyansittha, completes the building of the Shwezigon Pagoda, a shrine for relics of the Buddha, including a tooth brought from Sri Lanka. Various inscriptions refer to him as an incarnation of Vishnu, a chakravartin, a bodhisattva, and dharmaraja.

1110年：Death of Vijayabahu I after a reign of 55 years, and the instalment of Jayabahu I as his successor without passing the throne to Vijayabahu son Vikramabahu I causes a power struggle between the two rulers.
1111年：Deposition of Jayabahu I after a reign of 1 year; Vikramabahu I, son of Vijayabahu I, ascends the throne.
1132年：Death of Vikramabahu I after a reign of 21 years. Gajabahu II, son of Vikramabahu I, ascends the throne.
1153年：Death of Gajabahu II after a reign of 21 years; Parakramabahu I (Parakramabahu the Great), cousin of Gajabahu II (grandson of Vijayabahu I), ascends the throne.
1157年：A revolt led-by Queen Sugala of Ruhuna against the Parakramabahu I. The rebellion was suppressed by the army and the kingdom of Ruhuna was annexed as a part of Polonnaruwa in 1158.
1160年：Ruhuna Rebellion
1164年：With the guidance of two forest monks – Ven. Mahākassapa Thera and Ven. Sāriputta Thera, Parakramabahu I reunites all bhikkhus in Sri Lanka into the Mahavihara sect.
1165年：Parakramabahu I unified the three Nikaayas (Mahaavihaara, Abhayagiri, and Jetavana) and purified the Sangha.
1168年：Rajarata Rebellion
1171年：Anawrahta of Pagan upon request of Vijayabahu I sends monks and scriptures to restart Buddhism in the Sri Lanka.
1186年：Death of Parakramabahu I after a reign of 33 years. Vijayabahu II, nephew of Parakramabahu I, ascends the throne.
1187年：Vijayabahu II is murdered after a reign of 1 year; Mahinda VI, Kalinga noble, usurps the throne, is slain after 5 days, and Nissanka Malla, prince of Kalinga lineage, ascends the throne.
1190年：Sithu II of Pagan realigns Burmese Buddhism with the Mahavihara school of Sri Lanka.

1196年：Death of Nissanka Malla after a reign of 9 years. Virabahu I, son of Nissanka Malla, ascends the throne, is slain after 1 night, Vikramabahu II, younger brother of Nissanka Malla, ascends the throne, is slain after 3 months, and Chodaganga, nephew of Nissanka Malla, ascends the throne.
1197年：Chodaganga is deposed after a reign of 9 months; Lilavati, widow of Parakramabahu I, ascends the throne for her first reign.
1200年：Lilavati is deposed after a first reign of 3 years; Sahassa Malla, half-brother of Nissanka Malla, ascends the throne.
1202年：Sahassa Malla is deposed after a reign of 2 years; Kalyanavati, widow of Nissanka Malla, rules as queen regnant.
1208年：Deposition of Kalyanavati after a reign of 6 years; Dharmasoka, infant relative of Nissanka Malla, ascends the throne.
1209年：Death of Dharmasoka after a reign of 1 year; Anikanga, father of Dharmasoka, ascends the throne, is slain after 17 days, and Lilavati ascends the throne for her second reign.
1210年：Lilavati is deposed after a second reign of 1 year; Lokissara, Tamil general, usurps the throne.
1211年：Lokissara is overthrown after a reign of 9 months; Lilavati ascends the throne for her third reign.
1212年：Lilavati is deposed after a third reign of 7 months; Parakrama Pandyan II, Pandyan prince, ascends the throne.

1215年：Parakrama Pandyan II is deposed after a reign of 3 years during the invasion of Kalinga Magha, prince of Kalinga, devastating Polonnaruwa leading to the fall of the Polonnaruwa kingdom resulting in the widespread destruction of monasteries and libraries.
1220年：Vijayabahu III, prince of the Siri Sangabo lineage, establishes the Kingdom of Dambadeniya.
1236年：Death of Vijayabahu III after a reign of 16 years. Parakramabahu II, eldest son of Vijayabahu III, ascends the throne at Dambadeniya.
1236年：The Jaffna kingdom is established.
1236年：Bhikkhus from Kanchipuram, India, arrive in Sri Lanka to revive the Theravada ordination line.
1236年－1270年：During his regin Parakramabahu II restored the Śāsana and oversaw a significant literary revival.
1247年：Chandrabhanu invades from Malay Peninsula.

1257年：Thai monks traveled to Sri Lanka to ordain in the Sinhalese Mahavihara Theravada sect (known as Lankavamsa/Lankavong in Thailand) lineage and to study the teachings. Sinhalese monks also traveled to Thailand to teach Theravada Buddhism.
1270年：Death of Parakramabahu II after a reign of 34 years. Vijayabahu IV, eldest son of Parakramabahu II, ascends the throne.
1272年：Vijayabahu IV is assassinated after a reign of 2 years; Bhuvanekabahu I, younger brother of Vijayabahu IV, ascends the throne and moves the capital to Yapahuwa.
1279年：Final inscriptional evidence recorded for a Theravada Bhikkhuni nunnery (located in Burma).
1284年：Death of Bhuvanekabahu I after a reign of 12 years.
1284年：Aryacakravartis rules Jaffna Kingdom as vassal of Pandyas.
1287年：Parakramabahu III, son of Vijayabahu IV and nephew of Bhuvanekabahu I, ascends the throne.
1292年：Venetian traveler Marco Polo visits Sri Lanka during his return voyage from China to Venice.
1293年7月5日：Total solar eclipse visible across almost the entire island.
1293年：Death of Parakramabahu III after a reign of 6 years. Bhuvanekabahu II, son of Bhuvanekabahu I and cousin of Parakramabahu III, ascends the throne at Kurunegala.
13世紀：A forest-based Sri Lankan ordination line spreads to Burma and Thailand, facilitating the broader expansion of Theravada Buddhism into Laos and Cambodia.
1302年：Death of Bhuvanekabahu II after a reign of 9 years. Parakramabahu IV, son of Bhuvanekabahu II, ascends the throne.
1322年：Franciscan friar Odoric of Pordenone stops in Sri Lanka on his pilgrimage to the East.
1324年：French Dominican missionary Jordan Catala visits Sri Lanka on his journey to India.
1326年：Death of Parakramabahu IV after a reign of 24 years. Bhuvanekabahu III, noble of the Siri Sangabo lineage, ascends the throne.
1335年：Death of Bhuvanekabahu III after a reign of 9 years. Vijayabahu V, nephew of Parakramabahu IV, ascends the throne.
1341年：Death of Vijayabahu V after a reign of 6 years. Bhuvanekabahu IV, son of Vijayabahu V, ascends the throne at Gampola.
1344年：Moroccan explorer Ibn Battuta arrives in Sri Lanka to make a pilgrimage to Sri Pada.
1348年：Papal envoy Giovanni de' Marignolli spends four months in Sri Lanka en route from China.
1351年：Death of Bhuvanekabahu IV after a reign of 10 years. Parakramabahu V, younger brother of Bhuvanekabahu IV, ascends the throne.
1359年：Death of Parakramabahu V after a reign of 8 years. Vikramabahu III, nephew of Bhuvanekabahu II IV and Parakramabahu V (son of Bhuvanekabahu IV), ascends the throne.
1360年：Theravada Buddhism becames the state religion of the Ayutthaya Kingdom under Uthong. Sri Lankan monks leave for Thailand to spread Buddhism.
1374年：Death of Vikramabahu III after a reign of 15 years. Bhuvanekabahu V, son of Parakramabahu V, ascends the throne.
1391年：Deposition of Bhuvanekabahu V after a reign of 17 years; Vira Bahu II, brother-in-law of Bhuvanekabahu V, ascends the throne.
1396年：Bhuvanekabāhu makes Kotțē his capital.
1405年：Zheng He, Ming dynasty admiral, lands in Sri Lanka during his treasure voyages; later returns in 1411 during the Ming–Kotte War.
1406年：Death of Vira Bahu II after a reign of 15 years; Vira Alakesvara (Vijaya Bahu VI), member of the Giri family, ascends the throne.
1408年－1438年：Chinese naval expeditions demand tribute, abduct Vīra Alakeśvara to China.
1411年：Vira Alakesvara is captured after a reign of 5 years during the Ming–Kotte War.
1412年：Parakramabahu VI, son of Vijaya Bahu VI, ascends the throne at Kotte, becoming the last native sovereign to unify the island.
1412年：Chiang Mai scholar Phra Ñāṇakitti Thera visits Sri Lanka to study Pali scriptures.
1419年：Italian merchant Niccolò de' Conti visits Sri Lanka during his travels across Asia.
1447年－1450年：Bhuvanaikabahu VI conquers the Jaffna kingdom, and is incoporated into the Kingdom of Kotte.
1467年：Death of Parakramabahu VI after a reign of 55 years. Jayabahu II, grandson of Parakramabahu VI, ascends the throne.
1467年：The Jaffna kingdom regains independence from the kingdom of Kotte.
1469年：Jayabahu II is deposed after a reign of 2 years; Bhuvanekabahu VI (Sapumal Kumaraya), adopted son of Parakramabahu VI, ascends the throne.
1469年：The lands of the Kande uḍa pas raṭa (‘the five regions of the hill country’) succeed from the Kingdom of Kotte, led by Sēnasammata Vikramabāhu.
1469年：Accession of Senasammata Vikramabahu as the first monarch of Kandy and reigns until 1511.
1476年：Dhammazedi of Burma sent an embassy to Sri Lanka to obtain Higher Ordination, establishing the Kalyani Nikaya in Burma.

1477年：Death of Bhuvanekabahu VI after a reign of 8 years. Parakramabahu VII, son of Bhuvanekabahu VI, ascends the throne, is deposed after several months, and Parakramabahu VIII, adopted son of Parakramabahu VI, ascends the throne.
1489年：Death of Parakramabahu VIII after a reign of 12 years. Parakramabahu IX, eldest son of Parakramabahu VIII, ascends the throne.
1502年10月1日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Galle.
1505年11月15日：Lourenço de Almeida, Portuguese explorer, lands at Galle.
1507年1月13日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Kandy, Colombo, and Galle.
1511年：Senasammata Vikramabahu dies and is succeeded by his son Jayavira as the second monarch of Kandy. Bandara reigns until 1552.
1513年：Death of Parakramabahu IX after a reign of 24 years. Vijayabahu VII, younger brother of Parakramabahu IX, ascends the throne.
1518年：Vijayabahu VI, insulted with after being demanded by the Portuguese that he should sell to them the royal stockpile of cinnamon at a fixed low price, went to war in 1518.
1519年：Cankili I rules in Jaffna.

1521年：Vijayabahu VI went to war with the Portuguese again on the same issue 3 years later. Losing the war, the king was forced to negotiate for peace after severe losses to his army, further weaking the state.

1521年：In an effort to enhace his and his supporter's power over the monarchy and the royal court, the Ekanayake of Kotte (head of the civil government), assisted by a noble named Kandure Bandara plotted to kill the three elder sons of Vijayabahu VI to ensure the succession of Vijayabahu's minor fourth son, by a second queen, Dewarajasinha. The three Princes, Bhuvanekabahu, Pararajasinha and Mayadunne escape to other parts of the island to rally support, leading to the beginning of the Vijayabā Kollaya.

1521年：Vijayabahu VI breaks a truce and attempts to assassinate the three princes as they enter the palace grounds. In retaliation the palace is sacked and Vijayabahu is put to death. The eldest rince Bhuvanekabahu is acclaimed the new king of Kotte while Pararajasinha and Mayadunne are installed as kings owing allegiance to their elder brother.

1521年：Pararajasinha becomes the King of the newly established Kingdom of Raigama which is made up of roughly 660 villages in the Rayigam, Pasdun and Wallalawiti korales less the seaports. Mayadunne becomes the King of the Kingdom of Sitawaka which included the Four Korales, Denawaka (or the Five Korales), half of Hewagam korale, Kuruwiti korale, Atulugam korale, Panawal korale, Handapandunu korale, Beligal korale, and Dehigampal korale. Bhuvanekabahu as the Kotte sovereign continued to be acknowledged as overlord by the kings of Raigama and Sitawaka.

1521年：Weerasuriya or Pilasse Vidiye Bandara, a nephew of Vijayabahu VI and Manamperi, the king's equerry, start a rebeillion in the Hapitigam korale a short time after the accession of the three monarchs. According to Fernao de Queyroz, with the Ekanayake of Vijayabahu VI, Weerasuriya proclaimed himself King of Kotte. However Weerasuriya is executed promptly after a battle with the three brothers, marking the end of organized opposition to the new regime in Kotte.

1538年：Pararajasinha dies. The lands of the Kingdom of Raigama are taken over by the Sitawaka kingdom. Bhuvanekabahu does not contest this and in fact legitimised Mayadunne's annexation by presenting him a formal grant of Raigama.
1543年：Cankili orders 600 Christians in Mannar killed.
1551年：Bhuvanekabahu VII is accidentally shot after a reign of 30 years; Dharmapala, grandson of Bhuvanekabahu VII, ascends the throne of Kotte.
1552年：Karalliyadde Bandara, son of Jayavira Bandara, succeeded his father as King of Kandy and regined until 1582.
1560年：Portuguese conquest of the Jaffna kingdom: The Portuguese invade and annex the Jaffna kingdom and take king Cankili II as a POW.
links: Portuguese conquest of the Jaffna kingdom

items.text: 1560年：Portuguese capture Nallur and build a fort on the island of Mannar.
1565年：Portuguese abandon Kotte and make Colombo the capital.
1580年：Dharmapala wills the whole island of Ceylon to Portugal.
1581年：Death of Mayadunne after a reign of 60 years; Rajasinha I, son of Mayadunne, ascends the throne of Sitawaka.
1582年：The reigning monarch Karalliyadde Bandara dies. Kusumasana Devi, daughter of Karalliyadde Bandara, is installed as Queen, by the Portuguese, succeeding her father.
1582年：Kusumasana Devi is deposed by Rajasinha I of Sitawaka beginning the Sitawaka occupation of Kandy.
1587年6月：Rajasinha I attacks the Potugese in the Siege of Colombo (1587–1588). The Portuguese attack Kandy in retaliation.
1591年：The Portuguese invade Jaffna and kill Puviraja Pandaram and set up Ethirimana Cinkam as a king.

1592年：Nephew of Karalliyadde Bandara and heir to the Kandyan throne Yamasinghe Bandara, who fled to the Portuguese, is installed as King of Kandy by the Portuguese but dies soon after his installation.

1592年：Konnapu Bandara, who was the Commander-in-Chief of the Portuguese forces in Kandy turns on the Portuguese and kills Yamasinghe Bandara and ascends the throne as Vimaladharmasuriya I beginning the Kandyan period of Sri Lanka.
1592年：Vimaladharmasuriya I restored higher ordination by obtaining monks from Arakan and brought the Tooth Relic to Kandy.
1593年：Rajasinha I dies and the Kingdom of Sitawaka falls. The majority of its lands are taken over by the Kandyan kindom while parts are occupied by the Portuguese.
1594年：The Kandyan Kingdom is invaded by the Portuguese Captain-general Pedro Lopes de Sousa, to reinstall Kusumasana Devi onto the throne.
links: List of captain-generals of Portuguese Ceylon

items.text: 1594年：Having defeated the Portuguese at Danture, Vimaladharmasuriya I marries Kusumasana Devi to establish a legal claim to the throne.
1594年：Vimaladharma Suriya I builds the Dalada Maligawa and palace in Kandy.
1597年5月27日：Dharmapala of Kotte dies, donating the Kingdom of Kotte, and with it the overloardship of the island to the king of Portugal.

1602年5月30日：Dutch naval officer Joris van Spilbergen lands in Batticaloa with three ships after a 12-month voyage seeking to establish trade between the two nations. He is the first Dutch envoy to make contact with Sri Lanka. They discussed the possibility that in exchange for Dutch military assistance to expel the Portuguese from the coastal areas.
1602年：van Spilbergen met with ruler of Batticaloa.
1602年7月：van Spilbergen undertook a trip to the interior of Sri Lanka to meet the king of Kandy Vimaladharmasuriya I
1602年11月28日：Sebald de Weert arrived two months after Spilbergen's departure, to follow through on implementing Spilbergen's negotiations.
1603年：1st Kuruvita Rala Revolt and Kangara Arachchi Revolt
1604年：Vimaladharmasuriya I dies and Senarat ascends the throne.
1604年4月29日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Anuradhapura.
1604年：Death of Vimaladharmasuriya I after a reign of 12 years. Senarat, cousin of Vimaladharmasuriya I, ascends the throne of Kandy.
1607年：French navigator François Pyrard de Laval is shipwrecked and visits Sri Lanka.
1612年：Kusumasana Devi dies.

1612年3月11日：Marcelis de Boshouwer , a Dutch merchant in the service of the East India Company, traveled to Kandy and concluded a new treaty of friendship there, with Senarat of Kandy, in which they agreed to support each other militarily against the Portuguese and in return the king granted the Dutch permission to construct a fortress, the right of unrestricted commerce, and a monopoly on cinnamon, pearls, and precious stones.
1614年：Portugal declares cinnamon trade a royal monopoly.

1615年：Senarat sent de Boshouwer to Holland to obtain the long-promised Dutch support, however was denied as the VOC was preoccupied with the Dutch East Indies and the States-General with the Thirty Years' War. Boschouwer then presented himself at the Danish court as a representative of the “Emperor of Ceylon”.

1615年3月：A three-tailed comet emerged, striking panic and anxiety across the nation. According to a Portuguese historian, the event was immediately succeeded by a widespread plague that struck down both humans and livestock. Furthermore, massive die-offs of fish left rotting bodies that severely contaminated the air.

1615年4月14日：A powerful earthquake completely leveled the city of Colombo. The convulsion released suffocating sulfur vapors from the deep cracks, while widespread fires further intensified the devastation of that catastrophic night.
1616年：Nikapitiye Bandara Revolt begins and lasts until 1617
1616年：2nd Kuruvita Rala Revolt begins and lasts until 1619
1617年：Sūriya Mahadassin dies.
1630年：Portuguese invade the Kandyan Kingdom.
1635年：Death of Senarat after a reign of 31 years. Rajasinha II, son of Senarat and Queen Dona Catherina, ascends the throne of Kandy.
1636年：Rajasinha II formally requests the Dutch to help rid the island of the Portuguese.
1638年3月28日：Battle of Gannoruwa between Kandyans and Portuguese.

1638年5月23日：A Kandyan–Dutch alliance is formed with the signing of the Kandyan Treaty of 1638 (also known as the Westerwolt Treaty of 1638) in Batticaloa, between Rajasinha II and the VOC commander Adam Westerwolt, with the primary objective being the expulsion of the Portuguese from the island.
1640年3月13日：The Dutch forces capture Galle.
1656年5月12日：After a siege of seven months Dutch forces capture Colombo and it is made the seat of the Dutch Political Council.
1657年：Dutch minister Philippus Baldaeus arrives, documenting the geography, history, and Religion of Ceylon.
1658年6月1日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Kandy, Colombo, and Galle.
1658年6月22日：Jaffna surrendered to Dutch.
1658年6月23日：The Portuguese are driven away from Sri Lanka with the help of the Dutch.
1658年：The establishment of Dutch power in the maritime provinces is complete.
1660年7月2日：Robert Knox, an English sea captain, is captured by King Rajasinghe II and held prisoner for 19 years, later publishing An Historical Relation of the Island Ceylon.
links: An Historical Relation of the Island Ceylon

items.text: 1662年：Dutch Golden Age painter Esaias Boursse lands in Sri Lanka as an officer of the Dutch East India Company.
1670年－1675年：First Kandyan–Dutch war between the Kandyan Kingdom and the Dutch.
1672年：German physician and botanist Paul Hermann arrives in Sri Lanka to document its flora, forming the basis of Carl Linnaeus's *Flora Zeylanica*.
1672年：Sieur de La Nérolle, French diplomat, arrives with a French fleet to establish a post at Trincomalee.
1687年：Joseph Vaz, Goan Catholic priest, secretly enters Sri Lanka during Dutch persecution to revive the Catholic Church.
1687年11月25日：Death of Rajasinha II after a reign of 52 years. Vimaladharmasuriya II, son of Rajasinha II, ascends the throne of Kandy.
1705年：Jacome Gonsalves, Goan missionary and linguist, arrives in Sri Lanka and authors foundational Catholic literature in Sinhala and Tamil.
1706年：1706 Kandyan Embassy to Madura to look for a bride for the heir to the throne Vira Narendra Sinha.
1707年6月4日：Death of Vimaladharmasuriya II after a reign of 20 years. Vira Narendra Sinha, son of Vimaladharmasuriya II, ascends the throne of Kandy.
1716年－1720年：Kandyan Kingdom closes its border to the Dutch.
1730年：1730–31 Dutch Embassy to Kandy
1731年：1731–32 Dutch Embassy to Kandy
1731年7月4日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Galle.
1736年：German Johann Wolfgang Heydt, who is in the service of the VOC, accompanies Dutch ambassador to Kandy and produces sketches of the city and palace.
1739年5月13日：Death of Vira Narendra Sinha after a reign of 32 years. Sri Vijaya Rajasinha, brother-in-law of Vira Narendra Sinha, ascends the throne.
1739年：1739 Kandyan Embassy to Madura to look for a bride for the heir to the throne Sri Vijaya Rajasinha.
1747年4月21日：Sri Vijaya Rajasinha marries another Madurai bride.
1747年8月11日：Death of Sri Vijaya Rajasinha after a reign of 8 years. Kirti Sri Rajasinha, brother-in-law of Sri Vijaya Rajasinha, ascends the throne.
1749年：Kirti Sri Rajasinha marries the daughter if Nadukattu Sami Nayakkar.

1753年7月20日：Under the patronage of Kirti Sri Raajasinha and the guidance of Velivita Sri Saranankara, Higher Ordination was re-established via an embassy from Siam (Thailand), founding the Siam Nikaya.
1754年：Leopold Immanuel Jacob van Dort, Dutch painter, works in Ceylon documenting local life and architecture.
1759年：Kromma Muen Thepphiphit, Siamese royal prince, arrives in Sri Lanka as a political exile.
1762年5月5日：The 1762 Pybus Embassy to Kandy is the first official connection between Kandyan Kindom and the British.
1764年－1766年：Second Kandyan–Dutch war between the Kandyan Kingdom and the Dutch.
1770年1月3日：Kirti Sri Rajasinha marries another South Indian bride.
1780年：Prince Kannasamy, the future Sri Vikrama Rajasinha is born in Madurai.
1782年1月2日：Death of Kirti Sri Rajasinha after a reign of 35 years. Sri Rajadhi Rajasinha, younger brother of Kirti Sri Rajasinha, ascends the throne.
1782年：1782 Boyd Embassy to Kandy.
1785年3月22日：Sri Lankan born Burgher pioneer of Dutch democracy and republic leader Quint Ondaatje demands democracy in speech at Utrecht city hall.
1795年：1795–96 Andrew Embassy to Kandy.
1796年2月15日：Colombo is taken over by British Forces
1796年2月16日：Dutch rule of Sri Lankan territory ends.

1798年7月26日：Death of Sri Rajadhi Rajasinha after a reign of 16 years. Sri Vikrama Rajasinha, nephew of Queen Upendra Ammani (wife of Sri Rajadhi Rajasinha), ascends the throne as the final monarch of Sri Lanka.
1800年：1800 MacDowall Embassy to Kandy.
1802年3月27日：Sri Lanka ceded to Britain by Treaty of Amiens and becomes the Crown Colony of Ceylon.
1803年：First Kandyan War: British forces attack the Kingdom of Kandy after the King's Adigar Pilimatalawe defected.
1803年5月5日：The Amarapura Nikāya was established by monks who obtained ordination in Burma.
1803年：Sri Lankan monks ordained in Amarapura, Burma, establish the Amarapura Nikaya in Sri Lanka to supplement the Siam Nikaya.
1805年：John D'Oyly is made the chief translator for the Kandyan government.
links: Sir John D'Oyly, 1st Baronet, of Kandy

items.text: 1813年：American Missionaries found the Batticotta Seminary.
1815年1月10日：The British Empire declares war on the Kingdom of Kandy.
1815年1月11日：British troops enter the Kandyan territory.
1815年2月14日：British Headquarters established in the city of Kandy.
1815年2月18日：The King of Kandy Sri Vikrama Rajasinha is taken prisoner.
1815年3月2日：Sri Vikrama Rajasinha is deposed after a reign of 17 years following the signing of the Kandyan Convention, ending native monarchical rule in Sri Lanka.
1815年3月2日：The Kingdom of Kandy is ceded to the British in an agreement signed between the Kandyan chiefs and the Governor of British occupied territory Sir Robert Brownrigg.
1815年3月5日：Sri Vikrama Rajasinha losses his throne.
1815年3月10日：Kandyan Convention signed.
1816年：John Davy, British physician and chemist, arrives in Ceylon and documents its geology, medicine, and history.
1817年10月：The Kandyans rebel against British rule in the Great Rebellion of 1817–1818.
1817年5月18日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Jaffna and Anuradhapura.
1823年：First coffee plantation at Sinhapitiya.
1832年：Colebrooke-Cameron Report; rājakāriya abolished.
1832年1月30日：Death of former monarch Sri Vikrama Rajasinha in exile at Vellore Fort, South India.

1833年3月13日：The final recommendations were officially instituted under a new Charter of Justice, which established the island's first Executive and Legislative Councils, among a list of other national reforms.
1833年：Sri Lanka brought under a unified government for the first time in years and administered through five provinces.
1834年：The Kandyan administrative and social structure is dismantled.
1835年10月9日：Royal College, the first government-run secondary school for boys is established with the name Hillstreet Academy in Colombo.
1844年：Slavery abolished in Sri Lanka.
1846年：Samuel Baker, English explorer, moves to Ceylon and establishes an agricultural settlement at Nuwara Eliya.

1848年7月26日：A peasant uprising led by popular leaders Gongalegoda Banda and Puran Appu takes place against oppressive colonial tax policies, marking a crucial transition from feudal revolts to modern independence struggles.
1848年10月10日：Martial law declared in Kandyan Provinces.
1858年：Telegraph communication with India begins.

1860年：In Sri Lanka, against all expectations, the monastic and lay communities bring about a major revival in Buddhism, a movement that goes hand in hand with growing nationalism; the revival follows a period of persecution by foreign powers. Since then, Buddhism has flourished, and Sri Lankan monks and expatriate lay people have been prominent in spreading Theravada Buddhism in Asia, the West, and even in Africa.
1862年：Forest monks led by Ven. Paññānanda receive re-ordination in Burma, returning to Sri Lanka in 1863 to establish the Ramañña Nikaya.
1863年6月12日：The Rāmañña Nikāya is established.
1867年：Opening of Colombo-Kandy Railroad.
1869年：Prince Alfred, son of Queen Victoria, makes the first British royal visit to Ceylon.
links: Alfred, Duke of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha

items.text: 1870年：A severe outbreak of coffee rust fungus (Hemileia vastatrix) devastates Ceylon's coffee plantations, forcing a transition to tea cultivation.

1871年3月27日：The first ever scientific Census of Sri Lanka was conducted by the Registrar General's Office, making it the first of any country in South Asia. The census enumarated a population of 2,400,380 people.
1871年12月12日：A total solar eclipse is visible over Jaffna.
1873年：The Pānadurā Vādaya, a public debate where Ven. Mohottiwatte Gunaananda Thera defeated Christian adversaries, sparked a national Buddhist re-awakening.

1873年：Ven. Hikkaduwe Sri Sumangala Thera establishes the Vidyodaya Pirivena and Ven. Ratmalane Sri Dharmaloka Thera establishes the Vidyalankara Pirivena (1875), launching a major modern revival of Buddhist monastic education.
1875年：British photographer Julia Margaret Cameron moves to Ceylon, continuing her pioneer portrait photography.
1878年－1883年：Coffee blight destroys plantations; replaced with tea.

1880年：Madame Blavatsky and Colonel Olcott became the first Westerners to receive the refuges and precepts, the ceremony by which one traditionally becomes a Buddhist; thus Blavatsky was the first Western woman to do so.
1880年：Henry Trimen arrives as Director of the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya.
1881年2月26日：P&O's SS Ceylon leaves Liverpool to begin the world's first round-the-world pleasure cruise.
1881年2月17日：The 2nd national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 2,759,738 people.
1881年：German biologist Ernst Haeckel visits Ceylon to conduct marine biological research.
1886年11月1日：Ananda College, the first Buddhist school in Sri Lanka is established with 37 students.
1887年：Japanese Zen Buddhist masters Soyen Shaku and Shaku Kozen arrive in Sri Lanka to study Theravada Buddhism and Pali.
1890年：Spearheaded by local figures, organized efforts against alcohol consumption began in the Southern Province.
1891年2月26日：The 3rd national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 3,007,789 people.
1891年：Anagarika Dharmapala establishes the Maha Bodhi Society in India to restore and reintroduce Buddhist heritage and sites.
1893年：Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria visits Ceylon during his world tour.
1895年：German Indologist Wilhelm Geiger makes his first research visit to Sri Lanka to translate the Mahavamsa.
1897年1月15日：Swami Vivekananda visits Sri Lanka, receiving a grand public reception in Colombo and Jaffna.
1897年：Waste Lands Ordinance enacted.
1900年8月9日：The Second Boer War prisoner-of-war camp is opened in Diyatalawa, housing thousands of captured Boers from South Africa.
1901年3月1日：The 4th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 3,565,954 people.
1901年11月11日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Jaffna, Anuradhapura, and Kandy.
1904年：First continental European, Anton Walther Florus Gueth, was accepted into the Sangha as Ñāṇatiloka Bhikkhu. Ñāṇatiloka went on to become the father of western monks in Ceylon.
1904年：Leonard Woolf arrives in Ceylon as a British civil servant, serving in Jaffna, Kandy, and Hambantota.
1905年8月1日：The Northern line is completed with trains from Colombo arriving at Jaffna Railway Station.
1908年：Eugénie de Montijo, former Empress of the French, visits Ceylon.
1911年3月1日：The 5th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 4,106,350 people.
1912年：The German monk Nyanatiloka founded the first monastery for Western Theravada monks, the Island Hermitage, in Sri Lanka.
1912年：First Election to Legislative Council.
1914年：Railway and ferry service between India and Ceylon begins.

1915年5月28日：Religious and cultural disputes over Buddhist processions near mosques escalates severely into riots due to a heavy-handed British military crackdown under martial law. Unrest ended on 8 August of that year. The event ultimately catalyzed the island's independence movement.
1915年：Martial law after Sinhalese-Muslim riots.
1921年3月18日：The 6th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 4,497,854 people.
1922年：Rabindranath Tagore, Indian Nobel laureate, visits Sri Lanka on a cultural tour (re-visited in 1928 and 1934).
1924年：Colombo radio station opened.
1925年12月16日：Radio broadcasting in Sri Lanka officially launched with Radio Ceylon, making it the very first radio broadcaster in Asia.
1927年11月12日：Mahatma Gandhi arrives in Sri Lanka for a three-week tour promoting non-violence, social reform, and khadi.
links: Visit by Mahatma Gandhi to Ceylon

items.text: 1927年11月13日：The commissioners for the Donoughmore Commission, a British parliamentary task force to set up a progressive new constitution for Sri Lanka, introducing universal adult suffrage and a unique executive committee system to foster power-sharing across ethnic lines, are appointed by Sydney Webb, the British Labour Secretary of State for the Colonies.
1929年：Chilean poet Pablo Neruda serves as Consul of Chile in Colombo.

1931年7月7日：Donoughmore Commission: The resulting Donoughmore Constitution officially went into effect with the opening of the first State Council of Ceylon and established Universal suffrage. The adult franchise was extended to women above the age of 21, regardless of their educational status. At the time Sri Lanka became one of the first Asian countries to allow voting rights to women. The Donoughmore Constitution remained in place until 1947.

1931年2月26日：The 7th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 5,306,863 people. Due to the global economic depression, this census was heavily restricted. A full census was only conducted for Colombo city, with a basic head count for the rest of the island.
1931年：First elections to State Council.

1933年11月11日：The Suriya-Mal Movement, a Sri Lankan anti-imperialist and social welfare initiative raising money by selling local suriya flowers (sunflower) for Ceylonese ex-servicemen begins in protests to funds from British Poppy Day going exclusively to British veterans

1934年9月：An initial uptick in malaria cases was first noticed at rural dispensaries in the latter half of September and spread further into October following heavy rains that disrupted a prolonged drought.
1935年12月18日：The major Trotskyist political party Lanka Sama Samaja Party is founded by Leslie Goonewardene, N. M. Perera, Colvin R. de Silva, Philip Gunawardena and Robert Gunawardena.
1936年：Second elections to State Council.
1938年：Ratmalana airport opened; Radio Ceylon broadcasts in Sinhala.
1939年：Bank of Ceylon established.
1939年9月1日：India bans emigration to Sri Lanka.
1942年4月5日：Ceylon in World War II: Colombo is attacked by air in the Easter Sunday raid by the Imperial Japanese Navy in an effort to destroy the British Eastern Fleet located at that port.

1942年4月9日：Ceylon in World War II: Trincomalee is attacked by air in a raid during the Indian Ocean raid by naval aircraft of the Imperial Japanese Navy in an effort to destroy the British Eastern Fleet located at that harbour.
1942年5月8日：Ceylon in World War II: Sri Lankan soldiers stationed in the Cocos (Keeling) Islands mutiny against British officers.
1942年7月1日：The University of Ceylon was established on by the Ceylon University Ordinance No. 20 of 1942, replacing University College.
1944年：The All Ceylon Tamil Congress (ACTC), the first Sri Lankan Tamil political party, is founded by G. G. Ponnambalam.
1945年9月：The final report of the Soulbury Commission, a constitutional reform initiative that drafted the framework for the island's eventual transition to independence, was published.
1946年3月19日：The 8th national Census of Sri Lanka, originally scheduled for 1941, was delayed by five years due to the war. This census enumarates a population of 6,657,339 people.
1946年5月15日：Ceylon granted a new constitution.
1947年8月15日：First election under Dominion Status.
1947年9月26日：Cabinet takes office.
1947年11月25日：Parliament opens.
1947年12月10日：The Soulbury Constitution comes into force, establishing a Westminster-style bicameral parliament for Ceylon.
1948年2月4日：The Sri Lankan people officially achieve independence from over 130 years of British colonial rule, transitioning into the self-governing Dominion of Ceylon within the British Commonwealth.

1948年11月15日：The Ceylon Citizenship Act is passed in parliarment, the first foundational law determining citizenship in newly independent Sri Lanka. It established citizenship by descent and registration, but controversially excluded large numbers of Indian Tamil plantation workers, rendering them stateless.

1949年8月24日：The Gal Oya Multipurpose Scheme, a landmark agricultural and river valley development project is initiated to harness the Gal Oya River in the Eastern Province. It aimed to achieve food security and resettle over 250,000 landless people from the wet zone into the underdeveloped dry zone.

1949年12月18日：A group of three Sri Lankan Tamil politicians, S. J. V. Chelvanayakam, C. Vanniasingam and Senator E. M. V. Naganathan, split from the All Ceylon Tamil Congress (ACTC) to form the Ilankai Tamil Arasu Kachchi (ITAK).

1950年1月：The Colombo Plan is established as a regional intergovernmental organization to boost economic and social development in the Asia-Pacific region. Centered on the concepts of self-help and mutual assistance, it operates through partnerships to enhance human capital and technical cooperation
1950年2月13日：A new national Flag is adopted.
1950年5月25日：World Fellowship of Buddhists is founded in Colombo, Sri Lanka.
1950年8月28日：Central Bank of Sri Lanka is established. Sri Lanka becomes member of International Monetary Fund and World Bank.
1951年3月2日：The Sri Lanka Air Force is founded as the Royal Ceylon Air Force (RCyAF), the aerial defense branch of the Sri Lanka Armed Forces.
1951年7月：S. W. R. D. Bandaranaike leaves the United National Party (UNP) to form the Sri Lanka Freedom Party (SLFP).
1951年：FP demands autonomy for Tamils of North and East.
1952年3月22日：Prime Minister D. S. Senanayake dies.
1952年5月24日：UNP wins second Parliamentary elections.
1952年12月18日：A landmark trade deal with China, the Rubber-Rice Pact, is signed.
1953年3月20日：The 9th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 8,097,845 people. The census was delayed until 1953 due to a severe global shortage of paper.
1953年：A nation-wide demonstration of civil disobedience and strike, was held organized to protest against the policies and actions of the incumbent United National Party government.
1953年10月12日：Prime Minister Dudley Senanayake resigns.
1954年2月13日：Indo-Ceylon agreement signed.
1954年4月10日：Elizabeth II visits Sri Lanka. Her second visit was in October 1981 to celebrate 50 years of universal adult franchise
1954年7月17日：Sir Oliver Goonetilleke becomes first Lankan Governor-General.
1955年6月20日：A total solar eclipse is visible over Anuradhapura, Kandy, and Colombo.
1955年12月14日：Sri Lanka is officially admitted as a member state of the United Nations under Resolution 109.
1956年4月5日：The Mahajana Eksath Peramuna (MEP), led by S. W. R. D. Bandaranaike wins the general elections in a landslide.
1956年5月23日：The 2500th Buddha Jayanti (anniversary of the Buddha's Parinibbaana) was celebrated, ushering in a period of significant religious activity and government support.
1956年6月15日：Parliament approves the Sinhalese Language Bill.

1956年7月7日：The Official Language Act (No. 33 of 1956), also known as the Sinhala Only Act, is passed by the Parliament of Ceylon. The act replaced English with Sinhala as the sole official language of Ceylon, with the controversial exclusion of Tamil.
1956年12月28日：Lester James Peries' masterpiece Rekava premieres.
1957年7月26日：Bandaranaike and Chelvanayakam Pact.
1957年9月19日：Rice and Rubber Pact with China.
1957年10月15日：Sri Lanka takes over the Trincomalee air and naval base.

1957年11月1日：The British Royal Navy officially hands over the strategic naval base of Trincomalee and Katunayake air base to the Sri Lankan Government, after Prime Minister S. W. R. D. Bandaranaike requested the removal of all British service personnel from the island.
1958年1月1日：Bus transportation nationalized.
1958年4月9日：Bandaranaike abandons Bandaranaike-Chelvanayakam pact.
1958年5月22日：Deteriorating relations between government policies and the Sri Lankan Tamils erupt into island-wide Riots.
1958年5月26日：A declaration of emergency is proclaimed as the riots intensify.
1958年8月：The Sinhala Only Act is amended and the Tamil Language (Special Provisions) Act of 1958 is passed in Ceylon, thus making Tamil an official language of Ceylon.
1958年：Ven. Nyanaponika Thera establishes the Buddhist Publication Society in Kandy to publish English-language Theravada literature.
1958年：A. T. Ariyaratne founds the Sarvodaya Shramadana Movement to apply Buddhist social principles to community development.
1959年2月18日：Under the Universities Act, Vidyodaya Pirivena is formally reconstituted as the Vidyodaya University (now the University of Sri Jayewardenepura).
1959年9月25日：Prime Minister S. W. R. D. Bandaranaike is assassinated while meeting the public at his private residence.
links: Assassination of S. W. R. D. Bandaranaike

items.text: 1960年3月19日：Fourth general elections.
1960年4月23日：Fourth Parliament Dissolved.
1960年7月21日：Sirimavo Bandaranaike, wife of S. W. R. D. Bandaranaike, becomes the world's first elected female head of government, as Prime Minister.
1960年12月：The government took over private Buddhist and Christian schools to ensure a national system of education.
1960年12月31日：Sinhala made the only official language of the country.
1961年4月：FP carries out civil disobedience campaign.
1961年7月1日：The People's Bank of Ceylon is officially established under Act No. 29 of 1961.
1961年5月29日：The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation is founded with the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act No. 28 of 1961.
1962年1月27日：A group of Christian officers in the military and police planned to topple the government of Prime Minister Sirimavo Bandaranaike
1963年4月30日：Emergency rule ends after more than two years.
1963年7月8日：The 10th national Census of Sri Lanka, originally scheduled for 1961 was pushed back two years as it faced faced administrative obstacles, enumarates a population of 10,582,064 people.

1964年10月30日：The Sirima–Shastri Pact a bilateral agreement between Sri Lankan Prime Minister Sirimavo Bandaranaike and Indian Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri is signed. It provides for the expatriation of 525,000 people of Indian origin and aimed to resolve the citizenship status of nearly 1 million stateless Tamils of Indian origin who were brought to Sri Lanka to work on plantations while under British occupation.
1964年12月3日：14 Members of Parliament resign.

1965年3月22日：The United National Party led by Dudley Senanayake wins the 1965 Ceylonese parliamentary election, with Senanayake becoming Prime Minister; PM Dudley Senanayake fails to implement agreement with FP.
1965年5月14日：The Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna is established.
1966年1月6日：The Tamil Language (Special Provisions) Act No. 28 of 1958 was passed to allow for the use of the Tamil language in administration, education, and public service exams
1966年1月11日：Act passed to allow use of the Tamil language in the northern and eastern provinces.

1966年5月：The World Buddhist Sangha Council is convened by Theravadins in Sri Lanka with the hope of bridging differences and working together. The first convention is attended by leading monks from many countries and sects, Mahayana as well as Theravada. Nine Basic Points Unifying the Theravada and Mahayana are written by Ven. Walpola Rahula are approved unanimously.
links: Basic Points Unifying the Theravada and Mahayana

items.text: 1966年5月2日：The Ceylon Tourist Board, now the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority, was created by the Ceylon Tourist Board Act No. 10 of 1966.
1966年7月：World Buddhist Congress in Colombo.
1966年7月7日：Major General Richard Udugama, Commander of the Army was detained under emergency regulations and suspended from command in the 1966 alleged Ceylonese coup attempt.
1966年12月：The four Poya days were officially made weekend holidays.
1967年1月5日：Radio Ceylon transitioned into a public corporation named the Ceylon Broadcasting Corporation
1967年11月22日：Devaluation of the rupee.

1968年：The United Front is founded as a socialist republican political alliance, a coalition formed by the Sri Lanka Freedom Party (SLFP), the Lanka Sama Samaja Party (LSSP), and the Communist Party of Ceylon.
1968年9月15日：The Federal Party (ITAK) resigns from Dudley Senanayake's cabinet and the eventual exit of the party from the ruling coalition.

1969年6月6日：The Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) is established, replacing the old government department and initiating a massive, coordinated masterplan to expand stable electricity grids to rural, off-grid communities.
1969年12月：Universities closed after a student strike.
1970年3月25日：Sixth Parliament dissolved.
1970年5月27日：The Sri Lanka Freedom Party led United Front alliance wins the 1970 Ceylonese parliamentary elections in a landslide victory with SLFP leader Sirimavo Bandaranaike becoming Prime Minister.
1971年3月16日：Emergency declared.

1971年3月：The State Pharmaceuticals Corporation of Sri Lanka commences operations in Ratmalana. Developed with Japanese assistance, the facility allows Sri Lanka to manufacture its own high-quality, essential, and affordable generic drugs.
links: State Pharmaceuticals Corporation of Sri Lanka

items.text: 1971年4月5日：1971 JVP insurrection: Marxist insurrection conducted by the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna against the government of Sri Lanka.
1971年10月9日：The 11th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 12,689,897 people.

1971年10月11日：The Indian Ocean Zone of Peace (IOZP) is a landmark diplomatic initiative led by Sri Lanka to prevent the militarization of the region by global powers. It aimed to denuclearize the ocean, eliminate military bases, and protect the maritime environments of developing coastal states
1971年：The Policy of standardisation, an affirmative action and university admissions system, is introduced by the government.
1972年5月22日：Prime Minister Sirimavo Bandaranaike promulgates the First Republican Constitution of Sri Lanka, renaming Ceylon to Sri Lanka and establishing a unicameral National State Assembly.
links: First Republican Constitution of Sri Lanka

items.text: 1972年5月22日：Sri Lankan civil war: Velupillai Prabhakaran founds the Tamil New Tigers, which would later be renamed as the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) in 1976, a Sri Lankan Tamil militant group which advocated for the creation of an independent state of Tamil Eelam in the Northern and the Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka.

1973年7月23日：The Associated Newspapers of Ceylon Limited is Nationalised by Prime Minister Sirimavo Bandaranaike’s United Front government, primarily targeting the press and privately held plantations to centralize the economy and eliminate foreign influence.

1974年：Prime Minister Sirimavo Bandaranaike and Indian Prime Minister Indira Gandhi signed the Indo-Sri Lankan Maritime Agreement, officially recognizing Sri Lanka's sovereignty over the small, strategically located island of Kachchatheevu in the Palk Strait.
1974年：University admission policies to increase Sinhalese representation in higher education.
1975年6月7日：The Sri Lanka national cricket team plays its first-ever official One Day International match at the inaugural Cricket World Cup.
1975年9月2日：LSSP expelled from the government.
1976年5月14日：TULF adopts Vaddukottai Resolution.
1976年：TNF reorganizes as LTTE.
1976年：Prime Minister Sirimavo Bandaranaike presides over the gathering of leaders from over 80 nations at the 5th Summit of the Non-Aligned Movement held in Colombo.
1976年：Nonaligned nations' conference held in Colombo.
1977年2月15日：Emergency declared.
1977年7月21日：J. R. Jayewardene wins a landslide victory, and TULF sweeps northern seats, and introduces "Open Economy" policies, shifting the country toward market liberalization.
1977年9月：National State Assembly establishes a presidential form of government.
1977年11月15日：The Katunayake Free Trade Zone is established becoming the first country in South Asia to liberalize its economy, driving export-oriented Foreign Direct Investment.
1978年2月4日：PM J. R. Jayawardene becomes the first executive president.
1978年5月19日：Tamil separatist organizations proscribed.
1978年8月31日：President J. R. Jayewardene promulgates the Second Republican Constitution, establishing an Executive Presidency and proportional representation.
1978年8月：National State Assembly renamed Parliament.
1978年11月20日：First Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, adjusting Supreme Court writ jurisdiction.
1979年2月26日：Second Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, governing party switching and expulsion of Members of Parliament.
1979年7月：Prevention of Terrorism Act passed.
1979年9月1日：Air Lanka, now SriLankan Airlines is officially incorporated as the country's new flag carrier.
1979年12月27日：Emergency declared in Jaffna.

1980年7月：The 1980 General Strike was initiated to demand a Rs. 300 monthly wage increase, it was brutally crushed by President J.R. Jayewardene's administration, resulting in the mass dismissal of 40,356 state and private sector employees.
1980年10月16日：Sirimavo Bandaranaike expelled from Parliament.
1981年3月17日：The 12th national Census of Sri Lanka, the last fully nationwide count for three decades, enumarates a population of 14,846,750 people.
1981年5月31日：The Jaffna Public Library is set alight by mobs, resulting in the loss of over 95,000 unique manuscripts and books.
links: Burning of the Jaffna Public Library

items.text: 1981年6月：State of Emergency declared during communal violence.
1981年7月21日：The Sri Lanka national cricket team was admitted by the ICC as a full member, becoming the eighth Test playing nation.
1982年2月15日：The Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation begins its transmission, beginning national public television broadcasting in the country.
1982年7月30日：State of Emergency declared throughout the country.
1982年8月27日：Third Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, allowing an incumbent President to seek re-election after four years of a term.
1982年10月20日：Jayewardene reelected President.
1982年：The Sacred City of Anuradhapura, the Ancient City of Polonnaruwa and the Ancient City of Sigiriya are officially designated as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
1982年12月23日：Fourth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, extending the term of the 1st Parliament for six years following a national referendum.
1983年2月25日：Fifth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, altering procedures for filling parliamentary vacancies.

1983年：Sri Lankan civil war: Triggered by a LTTE ambush on 13 soldiers, anti-Tamil rioting begins in the capital and spreads to other parts of the country. This event is widely considered the beginning of the Sri Lankan civil war.
1983年8月4日：TULF members lose their seats in Parliament when sixth amendment to constitution bans advocacy of separatism.
1983年8月8日：Sixth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, banning political separatism and requiring loyalty oaths for public officials.
1983年10月4日：Seventh Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, creating Kilinochchi District as the 25th administrative district.
1984年3月6日：Eighth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, enabling the appointment of President's Counsel.
1984年8月24日：Ninth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, modifying public officer qualification criteria for parliamentary elections.
1984年：All-Parties Conference meet throughout year.
1985年2月：Tamil groups propose diplomatic solution.
1985年6月3日：Rajiv Gandhi and Jayewardene meet.

1985年：Mediated by the Indian government, round one of the Thimphu Talks were held in Bhutan to resolve the escalating Sinhala-Tamil ethnic conflict. They marked the first time the Sri Lankan government and Tamil militant organizations sat at the negotiating table. Round two was held from 12–17 August.
1985年12月：Rajiv Gandhi says he would not accept a government military victory.
1986年5月3日：Air Lanka Flight 512
1986年6月：Jayewardene promises autonomy for the Tamil north.
1986年8月6日：Tenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, removing the two-thirds parliamentary majority requirement for states of emergency.
1986年12月19日：Jayewardene announces new peace proposals.
1987年4月15日：The 1987–1989 JVP insurrection, an armed revolt led by the Marxist–Leninist group begins against the government.
1987年5月6日：Eleventh Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, reorganizing judicial jurisdictions.
1987年5月26日：Government invasion of the city of Jaffna.
1987年7月5日：First LTTE suicide bomber kills 30 soldiers in Jaffna peninsula.
1987年7月：Prabhakaran meets with Rajiv Gandhi in Delhi.
1987年7月29日：Sri Lankan civil war: Signing of the Indo-Lanka Accord, leading to the arrival of the Indian Peace Keeping Force (IPKF) and the creation of Provincial Councils.]
1987年9月28日：India, Sri Lanka, and LTTE announced a settlement.
1987年10月5日：LTTE embarks on war against IPKF.
1987年11月14日：Thirteenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted under the Indo-Sri Lanka Accord, establishing nine Provincial Councils and recognizing Tamil as an official language.
links: Thirteenth Amendment to the Constitution of Sri Lanka

items.text: 1988年2月16日：Assassination of Vijaya Kumaratunga.
1988年5月24日：Fourteenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, expanding Parliament to 225 seats and creating 29 National List seats.
1988年5月：IPKF launches Operation Checkmate.
1988年11月：First Provincial Council elections held.
1988年：The Old Town of Galle and its Fortifications, the Sacred City of Kandy and the Sinharaja Forest Reserve is officially designated as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
links: Old Town of Galle and its Fortifications

items.text: 1988年12月17日：Fifteenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, lowering the vote threshold for proportional representation from 12.5% to 5%.
1988年12月17日：Sixteenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, implementing operational frameworks for Sinhala and Tamil as languages of administration and courts.
1988年12月19日：Ranasinghe Premadasa elected President.
1989年2月8日：The Sri Dalada Maligawa is attacked by the armed cadres affiliated to Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna (JVP).
1989年2月15日：UNP retains parliamentary majority.
1989年6月1日：Premadasa asks for Indian withdrawal by July 29.
1989年7月13日：LTTE assassinates A. Amirthalingam.
1989年9月：Cease-fire between LTTE and IPKF.

1989年10月：The "Gami Pubuduwa" (Village Reawakening) rural micro-finance scheme was launched by the Hatton National Bank, empowering hundreds of thousands of rural entrepreneurs and small businesses with credit.
1990年3月21日：Last Indian troops leave.
1990年6月10日：Sri Lankan civil war: Eelam War II, the second phase of the Sri Lankan civil war begins after the breakdown of peace talks.

1990年10月：The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) forcibly expelled an estimated 72,000-75,000 Muslims from the Northern Province in an act widely recognized as ethnic cleansing. The mass eviction occurred over several weeks, devastating the community and permanently altering the region's demographics.
links: Expulsion of Muslims from the Northern Province of Sri Lanka

items.text: 1990年12月：Sri Lanka emerged as the world's largest tea exporter.

1991年5月21日：Sri Lankan civil war: Former Indian Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi is assassinated by a female suicide bomber belonging to the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) at an election rally in Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu, killing Gandhi and 14 others.
1991年12月22日：Colombo hosts the 1991 South Asian Games for the second time.
1991年：The Dambulla cave temple is officially designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
1992年5月：India proscribes LTTE.
1992年8月：Land mine kills government generals in north.

1992年11月16日：Sri Lankan civil war: Vice Admiral Clancy Fernando, Commander of the Sri Lanka Navy is assassinated by a Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) suicide bomber becoming the highest-ranking military officer ever killed in action during the Sri Lankan civil war.
1993年4月23日：Lalith Athulathmudali shot to death.

1993年5月1日：Sri Lankan civil war: President Ranasinghe Premadasa is assassinated by a LTTE suicide bomber who detonated an explosive belt during a United National Party May Day rally in central Colombo.
1993年5月5日：Ranil Wickremasinghe becomes Prime Minister.
1994年8月16日：The People's Alliance wins the 1994 Sri Lankan parliamentary election with party leader Chandrika Kumaratunga becoming the new Prime Minister.
1994年10月23日：Bomb kills Gamini Dissanayake.

1994年11月9日：Prime Minister Chandrika Kumaratunga is elected President in a landslide victory, receiving 62% of the vote and becoming the first Sri Lankan female President. The election marked the end of 17 years of United National Party rule in Sri Lanka.

1995年1月：Sri Lankan civil war: Eelam War II ends following a ceasefire agreement and the start of peace talks between the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) and the newly elected government of President Chandrika Kumaratunga.

1995年4月19日：Sri Lankan civil war: Peace talks between the government and the LTTE end and Eelam War III, the third phase of the Sri Lankan civil war begins after the LTTE Bombing of SLNS Sooraya and SLNS Ranasuru.
links: Bombing of SLNS Sooraya and SLNS Ranasuru

items.text: 1995年7月28日：LTTE lose 400 cadres in raid on Weli Oya army camp.
1995年：Government offensive recaptures Jaffna.

1995年12月5日：Sri Lankan civil war: In a major military offensive launched by the Sri Lankan Armed Forces, the city of Jaffna is successfully captured from the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) marking a major turning point in the Sri Lankan civil war, ending five years of rebel control.

1996年1月31日：Sri Lankan civil war: A suicide truck bomb orchestrated by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) target the Central Bank of Sri Lanka in a bombing that kills 91 people, injures 1,400 others, and causes catastrophic destruction to the capital's financial district.
1996年3月17日：Sri Lanka wins the 1996 Cricket World Cup, defeating Australia by 7 wickets in the final at Lahore, Pakistan.
1996年7月18日：LTTE overruns Mullaitivu military base.

1996年12月8日：A Bhikkhuni (Buddhist nuns) Order and lineage is revived in Sarnath, India through the efforts of Sakyadhita, an International Buddhist Women Association. The revival is done with some resistance from some of the more literal interpreters of the Buddhist Vinaya (monastic code) and lauded by others in the community.
1997年5月13日：Government begins Operation Jaya Sikuru to open military supply route to Jaffna.
1997年10月15日：Sri Lankan civil war: The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam bomb the Galadari Hotel and the World Trade Center in Colombo.

1997年10月8日：Sri Lankan civil war: The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) was officially proscribed internationally when the U.S. Department of State designated the group as a Foreign Terrorist Organization.
1997年10月14日：Truck bomb blast in Colombo Fort.

1998年1月25日：Sri Lankan civil war: Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) terrorists commit a deadly suicide attack on Sri Lanka's most sacred Buddhist site and a UNESCO World Heritage centre: the Sri Dalada Maligawa, where Buddha's tooth relic is enshrined. Eight civilians are killed and 25 others are injured and significant damage is done to the temple structure, which was first constructed in 1592.
1998年1月26日：Government declares LTTE a banned organization.
1998年：A international dual-ordination ceremony is held at Bodh Gaya, re-establishing Theravada Bhikkhunis in Sri Lanka through the Dharmaguptaka lineage.
1998年12月：Operation Jaya Sikuru called off.
1999年12月18日：Sri Lankan civil war: Attempted assassination of Chandrika Kumaratunga three days before reelection.
2000年4月23日：The Sri Lankan government loses control of the strategic isthmus and the military Base at Elephant Pass in the Second Battle of Elephant Pass.

2000年8月8日：President Chandrika Kumaratunga's People's Alliance government abandon and indefinitely postpone the proposed draft constitution after. The Sri Lankan constitutional reform attempt of 2000 was a major legislative effort to replace the 1978 Constitution. It proposed transitioning from a unitary to a federal system to resolve the civil war with Tamil separatists, but ultimately failed in parliament due to political infighting and not being abe to secure the necessary two-thirds majority in parliament.
2000年9月28日：Sprinter Susanthika Jayasinghe wins the silver medal in the Women's 200 metres at the 2000 Summer Olympics held in Sydney Australia, winning Sri Lanka's second ever Olympic medal.
links: Athletics at the 2000 Summer Olympics – Women's 200 metres

items.text: 2000年10月10日：PA returned to power.

2001年7月17日：The originally scheduled 1991 census was cancelled entirely due to the conflict. When a census was finally attempted in 2001, it was incomplete, failing to cover areas in the Northern and Eastern provinces. The 13th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates an estimated population of 18,797,257 people.

2001年7月24日：The Bandaranaike International Airport and the adjoing SLAF Katunayake Air Force base is attacked by suicide bombers of the Black Tigers. The strike crippled national infrastructure and severely damaged the country's economy.
2001年10月10日：Kumaratunga dissolves Parliament hours before a no-confidence vote.

2001年11月14日：The 17th Amendment to the Constitution passes enabling the creation of the Constitutional Council a federal oversight body designed to depoliticize public service and restrain executive overreach.
links: Seventeenth Amendment to the Constitution of Sri Lanka

items.text: 2001年10月3日：Seventeenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, establishing a Constitutional Council and independent oversight commissions.
2001年12月5日：Ranil Wickremesinghe wins parliamentary elections on a pledge to open talks with the Tiger rebels.

2001年12月31日：Driven by a series of compounding crises nationally and internationally throughout the year, the Bandaranaike Airport attack, the September 11 attacks and the collapse of the government in December, Sri Lanka recorded negative GDP growth first time since gaining independence in 1948.
2002年2月21日：Government and LTTE agree to permanent cease-fire.

2002年2月22日：A Ceasefire Agreement mediated by Norway was formally signed between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam. This agreement ended major offensive military operations and established the Sri Lanka Monitoring Mission, which was composed of representatives from Nordic countries, to oversee the truce
2002年4月10日：Prabhakaran holds first press conference in 12 years.
2002年：First formal peace talks opened in Thailand.
2003年2月28日：Ayya Sudhamma Bhikkhuni became the first American-born woman to gain bhikkhuni ordination in the Theravada school in Sri Lanka.
2003年4月21日：LTTE suspends peace talks after sixth round.

2003年：The Tokyo Conference on Reconstruction and Development of Sri Lanka was held in Tokyo, Japan. International donors—including Japan, the US, the EU, and various multilateral organizations—pledged over $4.5 billion in aid to help rebuild the island following two decades of civil war.
2003年11月：President dismisses three key opposition party ministers.
2004年2月7日：Kumaratunga dissolves Parliament and calls for elections on April 2.

2004年3月3日：Vinayagamoorthy Muralitharan (widely known as "Colonel Karuna"), LTTE's military leader for the East, split from the LTTE, defecting with an estimated 6,000 fighters over alleged differences with leader Velupillai Prabhakaran. The break triggered internal violence but severely weakened the LTTE, ultimately leading Karuna to enter mainstream Sri Lankan politics
2004年4月2日：Kumaratunga's UPFA wins 105 seats in Parliament (UNF 82, TNA 22, JHU 9, SLMC 5, UCPF 1).
2004年4月2日：Buddhist monks candidates for the Jathika Hela Urumaya party win nine seats in elections.

2004年5月8日：Sri Lankan bowler Muttiah Muralitharan becomes the world's Leading wicket-taker dismissing Zimbabwe's Mluleki Nkala in Harare to claim his 520th Test wicket, officially surpassing Courtney Walsh.
2004年7月7日：Suicide bomb blast in Colombo.

2004年12月26日：A massive magnitude-9.1 undersea earthquake off the coast of Sumatra, Indonesia triggers an earthquake and tsunami which hits Sri Lanka without warning, becoming the deadliest natural disaster in the country's history causing over 35,000 deaths.

2005年8月12日：Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar was assassinated by a LTTE sniper, shot as he emerged from a swimming pool at his private residence in Colombo. A state of emergency is declared in the country as the assassination destabilized the fragile 2002 peace process.
2005年5月26日：Master composer Premasiri Khemadasa premieres his masterwork the Opera Agni (The Fire) at the Lionel Wendt Theater in Colombo.
2005年11月17日：Election of President Mahinda Rajapakse.
2006年2月：Government and LTTE meet in Geneva.
2006年5月：European Union bans LTTE; increased violence threatens resumption of war.
2006年7月20日：the LTTE closed the sluice gates of the Mavil Aru in the Trincomalee district, depriving Tamil and Muslim farming communities downstream of life-sustaining water.
2006年7月26日：Eelam War IV begins as a result of the closure of Mavil Aru.
2007年12月3日：Sri Lankan bowler Muttiah Muralitharan dismisses Paul Collingwood in Kandy to take his 709th Test wicket, permanently surpassing Shane Warne as the most successful Test bowler of all time.
2008年7月6日：Sri Lanka wins the Asia Cup cricket tournament in Karachi, Pakistan, defeating India by 100 runs in the final.
2009年5月17日：The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam conceded defeat and announced their plan to surrender.

2009年5月18日：The conclusion of the war drew heavy international scrutiny, with a UN Panel of Experts finding credible evidence that both the Sri Lankan armed forces and the LTTE committed serious violations of international humanitarian law, especially during the final stages.
links: War crimes during the final stages of the Sri Lankan civil war

items.text: 2009年5月18日：LTTE leader Velupillai Prabhakaran, his intelligence chief Pottu Amman and Soosai, the head of the LTTE naval wing, were killed in an ambush with the Sri Lankan military during an intense, multi-hour firefight while attempting to escape the war zone in an ambulance.
