2009年5月19日：The Sri Lankan government declares an end to the Sri Lankan civil war following a sweeping military victory by government forces over the separatist Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE). The final, intense phase of the 26-year conflict culminated in the northern coastal village of Mullivaikkal, where the LTTE's leadership was defeated
2010年1月15日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Jaffna and Anuradhapura.

2010年：In Northern California, 4 novice nuns were given the full bhikkhuni ordination in the Thai Theravada tradition, which included the double ordination ceremony. Bhante Gunaratana and other monks and nuns were in attendance. It was the first such ordination ever in the Western hemisphere. The following month, more bhikkhuni ordinations were completed in Southern California, led by Walpola Piyananda and other monks and nuns. The bhikkhunis ordained in Southern California were Lakshapathiye Samadhi (born in Sri Lanka), Cariyapanna, Susila, Sammasati (all three born in Vietnam), and Uttamanyana (born in Myanmar).
2010年7月22日：On his final delivery of his Test career, Muttiah Muralitharan dismisses Pragyan Ojha to reach a milestone of 800 Test wickets, a world record that remains unbroken.
2010年9月9日：Eighteenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, abolishing presidential term limits and repealing the Constitutional Council.
2011年11月27日：Sri Lanka inaugurates the Southern Expressway, the country's first-ever access-controlled toll highway, linking the capital with the southern coast while reducing travel times.
2012年3月20日：The 14th national Census of Sri Lanka was the first complete island-wide count in 31 years following the end of the civil war. It enumarated a population of 20,359,439 people.
2012年11月27日：Sri Lanka successfully launches its first communication satellite, SupremeSAT-1, into orbit from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center.
2013年：The Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) was held in Colombo.
2013年9月21日：Provincial Council elections are held, including in the Northern Province for the first time in 25 years.
2014年4月6日：Sri Lanka wins the ICC World Twenty20 tournament in Dhaka, Bangladesh, defeating India by 6 wickets in the final.
2015年1月9日：Senior figures from the Sirisena campaign alleged that, as initial vote counts made it clear he was losing, Mahinda Rajapaksa attempted to stage a coup d'état to remain in power.
2015年5月15日：Nineteenth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, restoring independent commissions, re-establishing presidential term limits, and reducing executive power.
2016年9月5日：The World Health Organization certifies Sri Lanka as malaria-free, making the country one of the first in the region to eliminate the disease.

2017年12月9日：The Sri Lankan government gave China Merchants Ports a controlling equity stake and a 99-year lease for the Hambantota International Port after it is unable to repay its debt to the Chinese government.

2018年10月26日：President Maithripala Sirisena abruptly dismissed Prime Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe starting a 52-day constitutional crisis. Sirisena illegally replaced him with former President Mahinda Rajapaksa.
2019年4月21日：Bombing of several churches and hotels by Islamic militants causing 269 deaths
2019年4月21日：Beginning of the Sri Lankan economic crisis (2019–2024)
2019年12月26日：An annular solar eclipse is visible over Jaffna.
2020年1月25日：The first reported case of COVID-19 in Sri Lanka was identified and the victim was reported to be a Chinese woman.
2020年6月28日：Former Sri Lankan cricketer Muttiah Muralitharan is named as the Most Valuable Test Player of the 21st Century by the Wisden Cricket Monthly magazine.

2020年8月5日：The 2020 Sri Lankan parliamentary elections were held. The incumbent Sri Lanka People's Freedom Alliance (led by the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna) won a landslide victory, claiming 145 seats and winning a two-thirds majority in the Parliament of Sri Lanka.
2020年8月11日：2020 Sri Lankan parliamentary election: Mahinda Rajapaksa is officially sworn in as the 13th Prime Minister of Sri Lanka at Temple Trees.
2020年10月22日：Twentieth Amendment to the 1978 Constitution is enacted, centralizing authority back into the Executive Presidency.

2021年4月5日：Driven by foreign exchange shortages, President Gotabaya Rajapaksa orders the immediately suspension palm oil imports to Sri Lanka to push for organic farming. This decision backfired drastically, causing widespread crop failures, soaring food inflation, and critical shortages of essential goods.

2021年8月30日：Dinesh Priyantha Herath clinches a historic gold medal for Sri Lanka in the men's javelin throw F46 category with a new world record of 67.79 m, claiming Sri Lanka's first ever paralympic gold medal and also securing Sri Lanka's first medal at the 2020 Tokyo Paralympics.
links: Athletics at the 2020 Summer Paralympics – Men's javelin throw

items.text: 2021年12月6日：Total number of COVID-19 deaths in Sri Lanka exceeds 14,500 with 21 more deaths.
2021年12月15日：Sri Lanka's traditional craftsmanship of making "Dumbara Ratā Kalāla" (Dumbara Weaving) is recognized by the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage.
2022年3月15日：Aragalaya: Protests erupt against the government's mishandling of the economic crisis

2022年3月31日：Aragalaya: Hundreds of protesters storm the residence of President Gotabaya Rajapaksa in Mirihana to protest against the government's poor handling of the economy, leading to shortages of fuel and power cuts that had reached over 12-hours a day.
2022年4月1日：Aragalaya: President Gotabaya Rajapaksa declares a State of Emergency in Sri Lanka, in effect from 1 April 2022.
2022年4月3日：Aragalaya: All 26 cabinet ministers resign en masse except for Prime Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa.
2022年4月7日：Aragalaya: Nandalal Weerasinghe is appointed as the new Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.
links: Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka

items.text: 2022年4月9日：Aragalaya: Tens of thousands of anti-government protestors occupy Galle Face Green in Colombo, in one of the largest street protests in the country's history, and rename the protesting area as "Gotagogama".

2022年4月11日：Sri Lankan actor Hiran Abeysekera wins the award for Best Actor at the Laurence Olivier Awards, held at the Royal Albert Hall in London, for his performance as the main protagonist in the West-End play 'Life of Pi'.
links: Laurence Olivier Award for Best Actor

items.text: 2022年4月25日：Yupun Abeykoon sets a new Asian record in the 150 meters men's event at an athletic meet held in Italy, where the sprinter clocked a time of 15.16 seconds to finish first place in the race.
links: List of Asian records in athletics

items.text: 2022年5月9日：Aragalaya: Mahinda Rajapaksa resigns from his post as Prime Minister amidst violent clashes and the worsening economic crisis. Rajapaksa loyalists stage a violent assault against anti-government protesters at the GotaGoGama protest site.
2022年5月12日：Aragalaya: Ranil Wickremesinghe is sworn in as the new Prime Minister. Saman Ekanayake is appointed as the secretary to Prime Minister.
2022年6月13日：The government officially lifts the colonial-era ban on the traditional, indigenous martial art of Angampora, restoring national pride, preserving heritage, and promoting cultural arts.
2022年6月21日：Sri Lankan economic crisis (2019–2024): The overall rate of inflation as measured by the National Consumer Price Index on Year-on-Year basis reaches a record high of 45.3% in May 2022.

2022年7月9日：Aragalaya: Hundreds of thousands of protesters breach the President's official residence and set fire to the Prime Minister's private residence in Colombo. Protesters claimed they would occupy the President's House until both the President and Prime Minister resign. President Gotabaya Rajapaksa announces he will resign on 13 July and Prime Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe announces his intention to resign once a new all-party government is formed.

2022年7月13日：Aragalaya: Despite his initial announcement, President Gotabaya Rajapaksa does not resign on the 13th as originally pledged. Instead Rajapaksa flees the country via military aircraft for the Maldives and appoints Prime Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe as Acting President to exercise Presidential duties during his absence. In reaction to this appointment, protesters storm the office of the Prime Minister demanding Acting President Ranil Wickremesinghe's resignation. In the evening, protesters reportedly attempted to breach the police barricades placed along the road leading to the Parliament. Wickremesinghe declared an island wide curfew until 5:00 am the next day.
2022年7月14日：Aragalaya: President Gotabaya Rajapaksa emails his resignation letter to the Speaker of the Parliament after fleeing to Singapore, officially ending his presidency.
links: Speaker of the Parliament of Sri Lanka

items.text: 2022年7月20日：Aragalaya: Ranil Wickremesinghe is elected as President of Sri Lanka by the Parliament, following the resignation of Gotabaya Rajapaksa. The following day, Wickremesinghe is sworn in as the 9th President of Sri Lanka.
2022年7月22日：Aragalaya: Dinesh Gunawardena is sworn as the new prime minister of Sri Lanka, and a new cabinet consisting of 18 ministers is appointed by the president.
2022年8月10日：Aragalaya: Protesters vacate Galle Face Green and Gotagogama, after occupying the premises for 124 days.
2022年9月2日：Aragalaya: Former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa returns to Sri Lanka after a 52-day self-exile.
2022年10月17日：Sri Lankan writer Shehan Karunatilaka wins the 2022 Booker Prize for his novel The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida. He is the second Sri Lankan to win the prize.
links: The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida

items.text: 2022年10月21日：The 21st Amendment to the Constitution of Sri Lanka is enacted following the 2022 Sri Lankan political crisis, curtailing executive presidential powers and banning dual citizens from holding parliamentary office..
links: 21st Amendment to the Constitution of Sri Lanka

items.text: 2022年11月14日：Protests of the Aragalaya ends.

2023年6月4日：Sri Lanka is unanimously elected as a vice president of the 78th session of the United Nations General Assembly which will assume the relevant position for the Asia Pacific region from September 2023 to September 2024.
2023年6月27日：The Mahāvaṃsa is listed among the 64 new items of documentary heritage inscribed on the UNESCO's Memory of the World International Register in 2023.
links: Memory of the World Register – Asia and the Pacific

items.text: 2023年7月29日：President of France Emmanuel Macron visits Sri Lanka during a series of visits to the South Pacific Region. It is the first instance in history where a French president has visited the country.

2024年2月24日：Red Sea crisis: The Sri Lanka Navy confirms that one of its ships has completed its maiden patrol in the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait and is set to return to the country. The vessel is later revealed to be SLNS Gajabahu and the Sri Lankan government confirms that patrols would continue.
2024年7月16日：Sri Lankan-born award-winning celebrity baker Tharshan Selvarajah becomes the first Sri Lankan to carry the Olympic Torch, carrying it out at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

2024年9月3日：2024 Summer Paralympics: Dulan Kodithuwakku wins Silver in the Men's Javelin Throw (F64) event with a personal best distance of 67.03 meters and also broke his own previous World Record (66.49m) in the process in the F44 category.
links: Athletics at the 2024 Summer Paralympics – Men's javelin throw

items.text: 2024年9月21日：2024 Sri Lankan presidential election: Over 17 million voters elect a new president. NPP candidate Anura Kumara Dissanayake wins a plurality of the vote with 42.31%, followed by Leader of the Opposition Sajith Premadasa with 32.76%. No candidate wins a majority in the first round, forcing a second round of vote counting for the first time in Sri Lanka's history.

2024年9月22日：2024 Sri Lankan presidential election: The second round concludes, with NPP candidate Anura Kumara Dissanayake being declared as president-elect of Sri Lanka. Dissanayake receives 55.89% of votes, defeating Sajith Premadasa with 44.11%.
2024年9月23日：Anura Kumara Dissanayake is inaugurated as the 10th President of Sri Lanka.

2024年9月24日：President Dissanayake appoints MP Harini Amarasuriya as Prime Minister of Sri Lanka and swears in a new three-member cabinet. Amarasuriya is the third woman to hold the position. President Dissanayake dissolves the current Parliament of Sri Lanka and calls for snap parliamentary elections in November 2024.

2024年11月14日：2024 Sri Lankan parliamentary election: The ruling National People's Power wins in a landslide victory, winning 61.56% of the popular vote and securing 159 seats, the most seats won by a single party in an election. The NPP becomes the first party to win a supermajority in parliament since 1977 and the first non-Tamil party to win the Jaffna district.

2024年12月19日：Delayed from its planned 2021 date by the COVID-19 pandemic, the 15th national census officially commenced in late 2023 and concluded its data collection in early 2024. The 15th national Census of Sri Lanka enumarates a population of 21,781,800 people.
2025年4月10日：The Vasavilan–Palaly road is officially reopened to the public, after being closed for 34 years due to the Sri Lankan civil war.
2025年4月18日：A special exposition of the Sacred Tooth Relic, titled “Siri Dalada Wandanawa”, begins at the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy. The exposition would go on for 10 days.
links: Relic of the tooth of the Buddha

items.text: 2025年7月27日：Padman Surasena is appointed as the 49th Chief Justice of Sri Lanka by President Dissanayake with the consent of the Constitutional Council.
2025年8月8日：Yevan David signs with AIX Racing to compete in the 2026 FIA Formula 3 Championship, becoming the first Sri Lankan to compete in the series.
2025年：Cyclone Ditwah causes severe devastation across Sri Lanka, with heavy rainfall triggering flooding and landslides that leave at least 639 people dead and 203 missing.
2025年12月11日：The Sri Lankan kithul tapping industry is officially inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
2026年2月5日：Samudika Jayarathna is appointed as the 42nd Auditor General of Sri Lanka, becoming the first woman to hold the post.

2026年3月4日：A United States Navy submarine sinks the Iranian Navy frigate IRIS Dena, approximately 40 nautical miles (74 km; 46 mi) off the southern coast of Sri Lanka, outside the territorial waters but within the exclusive economic zone, in an event related to the 2026 Iran war. The Sri Lanka Navy rescues 32 survivors from the crew of 180 and recover 87 bodies, with about 60 sailors still unaccounted for. The submarine which was involved in the engagement is later identified as USS Charlotte.
2031年5月21日：An annular solar eclipse is projected to pass over Jaffna.
2048年2月4日：Centenary of Sri Lankan independence from British rule.
2070年4月11日：A total solar eclipse is projected to pass over Galle.
2074年1月27日：An annular solar eclipse is projected to pass over Kandy and Colombo.
前4395年：Construction of the city of Susa in southwestern Iran.
前3200年：The Elamite civilisation, one of the four oldest civilisations (along with Mesopotamia, the Indus Valley, and Egypt), begins in the far west and southwest of modern-day Iran.
前2000年：Earliest date for the arrival of Aryans into Iran from Central Asia. The migrations into Iran may have been completed as late as 1000 BC.

前1500年：Start of the Avestan period, which according to some scholars continued until the sixth century BC. The prophet Zoroaster lived at some point during this era, with any time between 1500 BC and 1000 BC being the most favoured date for his life by modern scholars.
前1250年：Untash-Napirisha, king of Elam, builds the Chogha Zanbil ziggurat complex in present-day Khuzestan province.
前1210年：Elamite Empire reaches the height of its power.
前770年：The Persians start driving the Elamites of Anshan towards Susa.
前727年：Deioces founds the Median government.
前705年：Birth of Achaemenes (died c. 675 BC), the eponymous ancestor of the Achaemenid dynasty.
前678年：Phraortes founds the Median Empire.
前655年－前638年：The Assyrian conquest of Elam occurs. The Neo-Assyrian Empire under Assurbanipal is victorious at the Battle of Susa in 647 BC, resulting in the looting and sack of Susa.
前633年：The Scythians invade Media.
前625年：Cyaxares the Great becomes the king of the Medes after Phraortes dies fighting the Assyrians.
前624年：The Medes under Cyaxares repel the Scythians.
前612年：Together with the Neo-Babylonian Empire, Cyaxares the Great sacks the Assyrian capital Nineveh and destroys the Neo-Assyrian Empire.
前600年：Cyrus I becomes king of Persia.
前585年：Cyaxares dies and is succeeded by his son Astyages.
前580年：Cyrus I dies and is succeeded by his son Cambyses I.
前559年：Cambyses I dies and is succeeded by Cyrus the Great as king of Persia.
前550年：The Achaemenid Empire is founded by Cyrus the Great after he overthrows and conquers the Median Empire.
前547年：Cyrus conquers the Lydian Empire in western Asia Minor.
前545年－前540年：Cyrus conquers Bactria, Arachosia, Sogdia, Sakastan, Chorasmia, and Margiana during his eastern campaign.
前539年：Cyrus conquers the Neo-Babylonian Empire, frees thousands of slaves in Babylon and issues a declaration of human rights. This would later be inscribed into the Cyrus Cylinder.
前535年：Cyrus commences the Achaemenid conquest of the Indus Valley.
links: Achaemenid conquest of the Indus Valley

items.text: 前530年：Cyrus dies, and is succeeded by his son Cambyses II.
前525年：Cambyses II conquers Egypt after the Battle of Pelusium. Cyprus is also conquered by Cambyses.

前522年：Cambyses dies and is succeeded by either his brother Bardiya or an impostor, Gaumata, pretending to be Bardiya. This individual dies months after becoming the King of Kings, and is succeeded by Darius the Great. Civil war breaks out as a result of the mysterious circumstances surrounding Darius' ascension, with Persis, Elam, Media, Assyria, Babylonia, Egypt, Parthia, Armenia, Margiana, Sattagydia, Sagartia, Hyrcania, and Scythia all revolting. Darius suppresses all the uprisings by 520 and restores order to the Achaemenid Empire.
前518年：Darius completes the conquest of the Indus Valley.
前513年：Darius expands the Achaemenid Empire into Europe, conquering European Scythia, Thrace, Paeonia, and the coastal Greek cities.
前512年：Macedon submits to Persia.
前490年：Battle of Marathon, Persian Empire is defeated by Greek states.
前486年：Darius the Great dies; Xerxes I the Great succeeds him as King of Kings.
前484年：The Babylonian Revolt, led by two pretenders to the Babylonian throne, is crushed by Xerxes.
前480年：The Achaemenid Empire under Xerxes invades mainland Greece, reaching its greatest extent.
前480年－前479年：Persians capture and destroy Athens. The Acropolis, the Old Temple of Athena and the Older Parthenon are destroyed.
前465年：Assassination of Xerxes I. Artaxerxes I becomes the King of Kings.
前404年：Egypt breaks away from Persian rule.
前343年：Egypt is reconquered after the defeat of the Thirtieth Dynasty by Artaxerxes III.
前334年：Alexander III of Macedon crosses the Hellespont into Asia.
前334年：Alexander III of Macedon defeats the armies of the Achaemenid Empire in the Battle of the Granicus river
前333年：Alexander III of Macedon defeats the armies of the Achaemenid Empire in the Battle of Issus
前330年：Alexander III of Macedon defeats the armies of the Achaemenid Empire in the Battle of the Persian Gate
前330年：Darius III, the last Achaemenid emperor is killed, bringing an end to the Achaemenid Empire.
前330年：Persepolis, the capital of the Persian Achaemenid Empire is destroyed by Alexander III of Macedon.
前323年：Alexander III dies in Babylon, triggering a division of his empire among his generals in a treaty known as the Partition of Triparadisus.
前312年：Seleucus I Nicator, establishes the Seleucid Empire in the Persian territories of the erstwhile Macedonian Empire.
前247年：Arsaces I establishes the Parthian Empire (also known as the Arsacid Empire) in present-day north-eastern Iran.
前238年－前129年：Seleucid-Parthian Wars – the Arsacids expel the Seleucids from Iran and Mesopotamia, and those lands pass into their hands.
前94年：The Parthian Empire reaches its peak, stretching from the northern reaches of the Euphrates, in what is now central-eastern Turkey, to present-day Afghanistan and western Pakistan.
前54年：Beginning of the Roman–Parthian Wars, lasting till 217 CE.
208年：Vologases V dies and is succeeded by his son Vologases VI.
211年：Ardashir I establishes the Sasanian Empire in Istakhr in present-day Fars province.
224年：Ardashir I defeats the last Parthian Shahanshah Artabanus IV, ending the Parthian Empire.
260年：Persians defeated the Romans at the Battle of Edessa and take emperor Valerian prisoner for the remainder of his life.
360年：Sasanian Empire captures the town of Singara, in the Siege of Singara (360)
363年：Battle of Samarra (363) between the Roman Empire and the Sasanian Empire, in which Roman emperor Julian is wounded, and subsequently dies of his wounds.
371年：Roman Empire and Kingdom of Armenia defeat the Sasanian Empire and Caucasian Albania in the Battle of Bagavan
421年：Roman–Sasanian War of 421–422 after which Persian Empire agreed to tolerate Christianity and Roman Empire agreed to tolerate Zoroastrianism
570年－578年：Aksumite–Persian wars, Yemen is annexed by the Sasanian Empire.
590年：Khosrow II becomes ruler of the Sasanian Empire. During his rule till 628, Egypt, Jordan, Palestine and Lebanon are annexed into the Sasanian Empire

620年：Sasanian Empire reaches its greatest height, encompassing all of present-day Iran and Iraq and stretching from the eastern Mediterranean (including Anatolia and Egypt) to Pakistan, and from parts of southern Arabia to the Caucasus and Central Asia.
626年：Sasanian Empire lays siege to Constantinople, however is unable to capture it.
628年2月25日：Khosrow II is deposed and killed by his son Kavad II.
628年9月6日：Ardashir III becomes ruler of the Sasanian Empire.
632年6月16日：Yazdegerd III becomes ruler of the Sasanian Empire.
633年5月：Battle of Ullais in which the Rashidun Caliphate defeats the Sasanian Empire resulting in the massacre of 70,000 Persians by Arabs.
634年10月：Sasanian Empire led by Bahman Jaduya defeats the Rashidun Caliphate in the Battle of the Bridge.
636年：Arab invasion brings end of Sassanid dynasty and start of Islamic rule.
636年：Rashidun Caliphate defeats the Sasanian Empire in the Battle of al-Qadisiyyah, takes control of present-day Iraq.
637年：Destruction of the Ctesiphon library by Arabs of the Rashidun Caliphate.
642年：Rashidun Caliphate defeats the Sasanian Empire in the Battle of Nahavand, resulting in the near collapse of the Sasanian Empire.
644年11月3日：The second Rashidun caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab (reigned"}]]}'>r. 634–644) is assassinated by the Persian slave Abu Lu'lu'a Firuz.

644年11月6日：Uthman ibn Affan becomes the third Rashidun Caliph. During his reign, almost the whole of the former Sassanid empire's territories rebel from time to time, with major rebellions in Armenia, Azerbaijan, Fars, Sistan (in 649), Khorasan (651), and Makran (650).
651年：Rashidun Caliphate defeats the Sasanian Empire and the Göktürk Empire in the Battle of Oxus River.
651年：Yazdegerd III, the last Sassanid emperor, is killed near Merv putting an end to both his dynasty and to organized Persian resistance to Arab conquest.
716年－717年：Farrukhan the Great, ruler of Tabaristan in present-day Mazandaran province defeats the Muslim invasion under Yazid ibn al-Muhallab.
761年：Tabaristan falls to Muslim invasion and becomes a province of the Abbasid Caliphate.

767年：Ustadh Sis, Persian Zoroastrian revolutionary leader launches a rebellion, occupies Herat and Sistan before marching towards Merv. He initially defeats an Abbasid army under the command of al-Ajtham of Merv, but is himself defeated in a bloody battle against an army led by Muhammad ibn Abdallah.
816年－835年：Babak Khorramdin a Persian Zoroastrian revolutionary leader of the Khorram-Dīnân movement defeats successive Arab generals of the Abbasid Caliphate.
821年：Tahir ibn Husayn, an Iranian general under the Abbasid Caliphate, declared the establishment of the independent Tahirid dynasty.
867年：Ya'qub-i Laith Saffari founded the Saffarid dynasty.
867年：One of the earliest works in Early New Persian is composed by Muhammad ibn Wasif (died 909), a poet and secretary of the Saffarids.
934年：Sistan is conquered by the Samanid Empire.

930年：Zoroastrian commander Mardavij establishes the Ziyarid dynasty and briefly conquers much of northern Persia before being betrayed and killed in 935 CE. The Ziyarid dynasty continued to rule over much of Tabaristan until its demise in 1090 CE.
934年：The Buyid dynasty was founded.
1010年：The poet Ferdowsi finished writing the epic poem Shahnameh, a touchstone of the modern Persian language.
1131年：Death of the Persian poet Sanai.
1136年：The Eldiguzid dynasty (also known as the Atabegs of Azerbaijan) is founded by Eldiguz.
1157年：Death of the Seljuk sultan Ahmad Sanjar.
1182年或3年：Death of Rashid al-Din Vatvat, a secretary, poet, philologist in the Khwarazmian Empire.

1189年：Third Crusade: Teutonic Knights destroyed several cities of the Middle East. As a result of the conflict, the safety of both Christian and Muslim unarmed pilgrims is guaranteed throughout the Levant.
1195年：Death of the Persian poet Khaqani.

1219年：The Mongol conquest of Khwarezmia begins after two diplomatic missions to Khwarezm sent by Genghis Khan are massacred. In 1220 and 1221, Bukhara, Samarkand, Herat, Tus and Nishapur were razed, and the whole populations were slaughtered.
1220年：Pursued by Mongol forces, Shah Muhammad II of Khwarezm dies on an island off the Caspian coast.
1501年：Ismail I established himself in Tabriz and declared himself the king (shah) of Iran.
1514年8月23日：Battle of Chaldiran: The Ottoman Empire inflicted a severe defeat on a numerically inferior Persian force, opening the northwestern Iranian Plateau to their occupation.
1514年9月7日：The Ottoman sultan entered Tabriz.
1514年：A mutiny in the Ottoman army forced the sultan to withdraw.
1524年5月23日：Ismail died. He was succeeded by his son Tahmasp I.

1590年5月21日：The Treaty of Istanbul (1590) was signed between Safavid Empire and the Ottoman Empire ending the Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590), under which Safavid Empire ceded the Caucasus and western Iranian territories, for several years.
1603年－1612年：In the Ottoman–Safavid War (1603–1612), Shah Abbas the Great inflicts crushing defeats on the Ottoman Empire, restoring Safavid territory that had been lost.
1609年11月：Battle of Dimdim: The Persian army laid siege to a Kurdish fortress on the banks of Lake Urmia.
1610年：Battle of Dimdim: The fortress was taken, and its occupants were massacred.
1629年1月19日：Abbas I of Persia died. His grandson Safi of Persia succeeded him.

1639年：The Treaty of Zuhab was signed between Persia and the Ottoman Empire, decisively partitioning the Caucasus between the two (with the greater part remaining Iranian,) and establishing what remains the border between Iran, Turkey, and Iraq.
1642年：Safi died. He was succeeded by Abbas II of Persia.
1666年：Abbas died. He was succeeded by Suleiman I of Persia.
1709年4月21日：Mirwais Khan Hotak, the leader of the Ghilzai clan and mayor of Kandahar, killed the Persian-appointed governor George XI of Kartli and declared himself King of Persia.
1722年7月：Russo-Persian War (1722-1723): A Russian military expedition sailed to prevent the territories in disintegrating neighboring Safavid Iran fall into Ottoman hands.

1723年9月12日：Treaty of Saint Petersburg (1723): The envoy of the shah signed a peace treaty ceding the cities of Derbent and Baku and the provinces of Shirvan, Guilan, Mazandaran and Astrabad to the Russian Empire.
1746年9月4日：The Treaty of Kerden was signed between the Ottoman Empire and Iran, reaffirming the border drawn in the Treaty of Zuhab and allowing Iranian pilgrims to visit Mecca.

1795年9月11日：Battle of Krtsanisi: The Persian army demolished the armed forces of Kartl-Kakheti, captured Tbilisi, and reconquered eastern Georgia, which comprised the territories of the Kartli-Kakheti.
1796年4月：Persian Expedition of 1796: The tsarina of Russia launched a military expedition to punish Persia for its incursion into the Russian protectorate of Kartl-Kakheti.
1804年：Russo-Persian War (1804-1813): Russian forces attacked the Persian settlement Ganja.

1813年10月24日：Russo-Persian War (1804–1813): According to the Treaty of Gulistan, the Persian Empire ceded all its North Caucasian and swaths of its Transcaucasian territories to Russia, comprising modern-day Dagestan, eastern Georgia, and most of the contemporary Republic of Azerbaijan.
1826年7月16日：Russo-Persian War (1826-1828): The Persian army invaded the recently Russian-annexed territories in order to reclaim the lost regions.

1828年2月21日：Russo-Persian War (1826–1828) Facing the possibility of a Russian conquest of Tehran and with Tabriz already occupied, Persia signed the Treaty of Turkmenchay; decisive and final cession of the last Caucasian territories of Iran comprising modern-day Armenia, the remainder of the Azerbaijan Republic that was still in Iranian hands, and Igdir (modern-day Turkey).
1881年9月21日：Persia officially recognized Russia's annexation of Turkmenistan in the Treaty of Akhal.
1905年12月：The Persian Constitutional Revolution begins.
1906年：The first Persian Constitution was adopted during the Persian Constitutional Revolution.
1911年12月：The Persian Constitutional Revolution ends; Russian troops enter Tabriz and force Shah to shut down Majles.
1925年：Reza Shah the Great overthrows the Qajar dynasty, becoming the first shah of the Pahlavi dynasty.
1925年3月31日：Solar Hijri calendar legally adopted in Iran.
1941年8月25日：Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran: Three Soviet armies began invasion of Iran from the north, while British army invades Khuzestan and Central Iran.
1945年11月：The Soviet Union established the Azerbaijan People's Government in Iranian Azerbaijan.
1946年1月22日：The Soviet-backed Kurdish Republic of Mahabad declared its independence from Iran.
1946年3月2日：Iran crisis: British troops withdrew from Iran. The Soviet Union violated its prior agreement and remained.
1946年5月9日：Iran crisis: The Soviet Union withdrew from Iran.
1946年12月11日：Iran regained control over the territory of the Azerbaijan People's Government.
1946年12月15日：Iran conquered Mahabad.

1953年8月：Mohammad Mosaddegh is overthrown in a coup engineered by the British and American intelligence services after he nationalizes Iranian oil. Fazlollah Zahedi is proclaimed as prime minister and the Shah returns.
1979年2月11日：Iranian revolution: The Iranian Monarchy collapsed in a popular revolution.
1979年4月1日：A referendum passed which made Iran an Islamic republic.
1979年11月4日：Iran hostage crisis

1980年9月22日：Iraq launched a full-scale invasion of Iran. The Iran–Iraq War would last until August 1988. The tactics used by both sides were similar to those used during World War I, including large-scale trench warfare with barbed wire stretched across trenches, manned machine-gun posts, bayonet charges, human wave attacks across a no-man's land, and extensive use of chemical weapons such as mustard gas by the Iraqi government against Iranian troops, civilians, and Iraqi Kurds.
1981年10月9日：Later Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei assumes office as the President of Iran under Supreme Leader Khomenei.
1988年8月20日：The Iran–Iraq War ends in a stalemate. The Iran–Iraq War was the deadliest conventional war ever fought between regular armies of developing countries.
1988年：Massacres of Iranian political prisoners, thousands of cases of forced disappearances, executions, torture and inhuman and degrading treatment.
1989年6月3日：1st Supreme Leader of Iran and founder of the Islamic Republic, Ruhollah Khomeini, dies.
1989年6月4日：Ali Khamenei replaces Ruhollah Khomeini, becoming the second Supreme Leader of Iran.

1989年7月28日：A constitutional reform was allegedly approved by 97.6% of voters in a referendum, it was the first and so far only time the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Iran has been amended. It made several significant changes to the system of government of the Islamic Republic such as eliminating the need for the Supreme Leader (rahbar) of the country to be a marja or chosen by popular acclaim.
links: Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Iran

items.text: 1989年8月16日：Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani becomes President of Iran, the first president to assume office under the post-reform constitution.
1994年2月22日：Homa Darabi an Iranian pediatrician and women's rights activist immolates herself in protest against compulsory hijab.
1997年8月3日：Mohammad Khatami replaces Rafsanjani as president.
2001年6月8日：Iranian presidential election, 2001: President Mohammad Khatami was reelected with vast majority.
2003年12月：40,000 people are killed in an earthquake in southern Iran.
2005年6月24日：Iranian presidential election, 2005: Ahmadinejad defeated the more liberal Rafsanjani.
2009年6月12日：Iranian presidential election, 2009: Ahmadinejad re-elected for a second time after defeated Mousavi.
2009年6月13日：2009–10 Iranian election protests: Protests in Iran over election results.
2013年8月3日：Hassan Rouhani replaces Ahmadinejad as president.
2014年：My Stealthy Freedom, an online movement in which women in Iran post photos of themselves without hijabs, as a protest against the compulsory hijab laws in the country.

2015年7月14日：Signing of Iran nuclear deal between Iran and the P5+1 (the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council— China, France, Russia, United Kingdom, United States—plus Germany).
2018年5月8日：United States withdraws from the Iran nuclear deal

2017年－2019年：Iranian woman protest against compulsory hijab in multiple cities including Tehran, Kangavar, Isfahan and Shiraz. Many are physically assaulted with injuries including broken limbs and imprisoned.

2019年9月9日：Self immolation of women's rights activist Sahar Khodayari over six-month prison sentence for attempting to enter a public stadium to watch a football game, against the national ban against women at such events. Leads to widespread protests, and on 10 October 2019, more than 3,500 women attend the Azadi Stadium for a World Cup qualifier against Cambodia.
2020年1月3日：Quds Force commander Qasem Soleimani and commander of the Iran-backed Kata'ib Hezbollah militia, Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis, are assassinated in a U.S. drone strike in Baghdad.
2021年8月3日：Ebrahim Raisi replaces Rouhani as president.

2022年9月16日：22-year-old Iranian woman Mahsa Amini, also known as Jina Amini, died in a hospital in Tehran, Iran, under suspicious circumstances, after her arrest by the Islamic Republic's Guidance Patrol. Eyewitnesses, including women who were detained with Amini, reported that she was severely beaten and that she died as a result of police brutality. Her death sparked widespread antigovernmental protests in Iran.

2022年－2023年：Civil unrest and protests against the Islamic Republic of Iran associated with the death in police custody of Mahsa Amini (Persian: مهسا امینی) began on 16 September 2022 and lasted until 2023.
2024年4月1日：Israel bombed the Iranian embassy in Damascus, causing a brief escalation to direct conflict between two countries which lasted for 18 days.
2024年5月19日：Varzaqan helicopter crash and death of Iranian president, Ebrahim Raisi.
2024年7月28日：Masoud Pezeshkian appointed as the president of Iran.
2024年7月31日：Assassination of Ismail Haniyeh, Hamas political leader in Tehran, by an apparent Israel attack, increased tension between the two countries.

2025年6月13日：At approximately 4AM local time, Israel launched missiles into Iran, targeting their nuclear plants in an effort to prevent them from developing nuclear weapons. Iran's top military officials, Mohammad Hossein Bagheri and Hossein Salami, were killed in the conflict.

2026年2月28日：At about 8:30AM UTC, Israel and the US launched missiles toward Iran, striking military facilities, nuclear hubs, and government buildings. This was a coordinated attack on Iran, dubbed as Operation Roaring Lion, for Israel, and Operation Epic Fury, for the United States. Many other locations were struck from the Iranian retaliation, such as Dubai, Israel, and several other places. Trump had confirmed on Truth Social at around 9:30 PM UTC that Ali Khamenei is dead, calling him "evil."
前64年：Syria became a Roman (later Byzantine) province.
前40年：Syria is briefly captured by the Parthian forces under Pacorus I
198年：Emperor Septimius Severus divided Syria into two provinces called Coele Syria and Syria Phoenice.
526年：The 526 Antioch earthquake and conflagration destroyed most of the city.
614年：Syria fell to the Sasanian forces under Shahrbaraz
636年：Byzantine rule over Syria came to an end.
661年：The reign of the Umayyad Caliphate began.
750年：The reign of the Umayyad Caliphate ended.
977年：Fatimid Caliph Abu Mansoor Nizar al-Aziz Billah conquered Ramla.
994年：The Hamdanid dynasty came to power over Syria.
1033年：Al-Ma'arri writes "The Epistle of Forgiveness".
1097年：First Crusade: The forces of the First Crusade captured Antioch.
1260年3月1日：Hulagu Khan, grandson of Genghis, conquered Damascus.
1260年9月：Baibars, Mamluk Sultan, wages war with the Mongols to recapture Damascus and Aleppo.
1485年：The Ottomans invade Anatolia and Syria, starting the first Ottoman–Mamluk War (1485–1491).
1491年：The Ottoman–Mamluk War (1485–1491) ends in a stalemate. A peace treaty is signed, returning Mamluk control to the pre-war status quo.
1516年：The Ottoman Empire established its rule over Syria.
1918年：The Ottoman Empire's rule over Syria came to an end.
1918年10月1日：The Allies of World War I, joined by Arab nationalists, entered Damascus.
1920年4月：San Remo conference: The conference partitioned the Ottoman Empire, establishing a French mandate in Syria and Lebanon.
1925年7月：Great Syrian Revolt: Revolts started against French rule.
1936年9月：The Franco-Syrian Treaty of Independence was signed.
1939年：The monks of Alexandretta and Antioch were ceded to Turkey by the French.
1946年1月1日：Syria was recognized as an independent republic.
1946年4月17日：French troops evacuated Syria.
1947年：The first Baʿth Party congress was held in Damascus.
1948年：1948 Arab–Israeli War: Syria was involved in the war.
1958年2月1日：The United Arab Republic (UAR) was formed by the union of Syria and Egypt.
1961年9月28日：Following a military coup Syria seceded from the UAR, reestablishing itself as the Syrian Arab Republic.
1963年3月8日：A coup brought in the Ba'ath Party into power beginning the establishment of Ba'athist Syria.
1967年6月5日：Six-Day War: A war with Israel began.
1967年：Six-Day War: The Golan Heights were occupied by Israel.
1970年11月13日：Minister of Defense Hafez al-Assad effected a bloodless military coup and assumed the role of President.
1973年10月6日：Yom Kippur War: Syria and Egypt fought against Israel.
1974年5月：Syria and Israel signed a disengagement agreement.
1976年：Syrian occupation of Lebanon: The Syrian occupation of Lebanon began.
1982年2月：A Muslim Brotherhood uprising in Hama was suppressed by the military.
1990年：Syria participated in a United States-led multinational coalition against Saddam Hussein.
2000年6月10日：Al-Assad died.
2000年7月10日：Al-Assad's son Bashar al-Assad was made President.
2003年10月5日：Ain es Saheb airstrike: Israel bombed a site near Damascus.
2005年：Syrian occupation of Lebanon: Syria withdrew from Lebanon.
2007年9月6日：Operation Orchard: Israel bombed a target in the area of Deir ez-Zor.
2008年10月：Syria established diplomatic relations with Lebanon.
2011年1月26日：Syrian Revolution: Anti-government protests began in Syria.
2015年9月30日：Russia carries out its first air strikes in Syria.
2017年4月7日：Donald Trump orders a missile attack on an airbase from which Ba'athist Syrian ar force planes allegedly staged a chemical weapons attack on Khan Shaykhun.
2024年12月8日：The Assad regime collapsed after the rebels took Damascus ending 61 years of Ba'athist rule, while Bashar al-Assad fled to Russia.
2006年：08 political protests
10世紀：v
10世紀：t
10世紀：e
前1400年：The height of the Canaanite town of Ugarit.
前1200年：Phoenicians invent the alphabet and the Tyrian Purple which was a major component in their trade.
前1200年：A crisis led to the Bronze Age collapse. Cities all around the eastern Mediterranean were sacked within a span of a few decades by assorted raiders.
前842年：Shalmaneser III devastates the territory of Damascus; Palestine and the Phoenician cities send tribute.
前813年：Carthage is founded by Phoenicians.
前774年：The reign of king Pygmalion of Tyre ends.
前739年：Hiram II becomes king of Tyre.
前730年：Mattan II succeeds Hiram II as king.
前724年：The Assyrians under king Shalmaneser V start a four-year siege of Tyre that ends in 720 BC.
前710年：Judah, Tyre and Sidon revolt against Assyria.
前701年：The Assyrian siege of Tyre by king Sennacherib.
前663年：The Assyrian siege of Tyre by king Ashurbanipal.
前587年：The region is annexed to the Babylonian empire, while Jerusalem fell into their hands.
前586年：The Babylonians under king Nebuchadnezzar II sieged Tyre for thirteen years without success. Later a compromise peace was made in which Tyre had to pay tribute to the Babylonians. (to 573 BC)
前539年：Cyrus the Great conquered Phoenicia.
前350年：A rebellion in Sidon led by Tennes was crushed by Artaxerxes III, and its destruction was dramatically described by Diodorus Siculus. (to 345 BC)

前332年：Alexander the Great took Tyre following the city's siege. After Alexander's death Phoenicia witnessed a succession of Hellenistic rulers: Laomedon (323 BC), Ptolemy I (320 BC), Antigonus II (315 BC), Demetrius (301 BC), and Seleucus (296 BC).
前315年：Alexander's former general Antigonus begins his own siege of Tyre, taking the city a year later.
前286年：Phoenicia (except for Aradus) fell to the Ptolemies of Egypt.
前197年：Phoenicia along with Syria reverted to the Seleucids, and the region became increasingly Hellenized, although Tyre actually became autonomous in 126 BC, followed by Sidon in 111 BC.

前140年：Beirut was taken and destroyed by Diodotus Tryphon in his contest with Antiochus VII Sidetes for the throne of the Seleucid monarchy. It was later named Laodicea in Phoenicia (Greek: Λαοδικεια ή του Φοινίκη).
前82年：Syria, including Phoenicia, were seized by king Tigranes the Great who was later defeated by Lucullus. (to 69 BC)
前65年：Pompey finally incorporated Phoenicia as part of the Roman province of Syria.
前64年：Beirut was conquered by Agrippa and the city was renamed in honour of the emperor's daughter, Julia; its full name became Colonia Julia Augusta Felix Berytus.

前27年：the Pax Romana period, inhabitants of the principal Phoenician cities of Byblos, Sidon, and Tyre were granted Roman citizenship, while economic and intellectual activities flourished. (to AD 180)

20年：Beirut's school of law was founded, it later became widely known in the surrounding region. Two of Rome's most famous jurists, Papinian and Ulpian (both natives of Phoenicia), were taught at the law school under the Severan emperors.
50年：Saint Paul of Tarsus begins his third mission and preaches in Tyre.
451年：The Maronites, a Christian community named after Saint Maron sought refuge in the mountains of Lebanon.
551年：Beirut is destroyed by an earthquake and tsunami. About 30,000 were killed in the city alone and, along the Phoenician coast, total casualties were close to 250,000.
630年：The Marada, a group of autonomous Maronite communities, settled in Mount Lebanon and the surrounding highlands following the conquest of Syria by the Arab caliphate.
632年：Calling for a jihad against non-Muslims, Muhammad's successor, Caliph Abu Bakr, brought Islam to the area surrounding Lebanon. (to 634)
661年：After the Battle of Yarmuk, Caliph Umar appointed the Arab Muawiyah I, founder of the Umayyad dynasty, as governor of Syria, an area that included present-day Lebanon.
667年：Muawiyah negotiated an agreement with Constantine IV, the Byzantine emperor, whereby he agreed to pay Constantine an annual tribute in return for the cessation of Marada incursions.
670年：Callinicus of Heliopolis, a Byzantine chemist from Heliopolis, invents the Greek fire in Constantinople.
759年：An abortive rebellion of Lebanese mountaineers against the Abbasid rule after the harsh treatment of people living in the Lebanese-Syrian region.

878年：The Jordan valley is occupied by the Tulunids, extending in the north to the outposts in the Anti-Lebanon mountains on the Byzantine border, enabling them to defend Egypt against Abbasid attack. Tulunid Emirate in 893
960年：Prince 'Allaqa of Tyre proclaimed his independence from the Abbasids and coined money in his own name.
970年：The Fatimides settled in Egypt and extended their authority to the coastal region of Bilad al-Sham and Damascus.

986年：Under the Fatimid Caliph Al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah, a new religion was born and spread by a man called Ad-Darazi. This was the beginning of the Druze religion and its expansion in several Lebanese regions.
1110年：Beirut and Sidon are captured.
1124年：Tyre resisted the raids but finally capitulated after a long siege.
1179年：The Battle of Marj Ayyun took place on 10 June, where an Ayyubid army commanded by Saladin defeated a Crusader army led by King Baldwin IV of Jerusalem.

1182年：The Battle of Belvoir Castle in which a Crusader force led by King Baldwin IV of Jerusalem sparred inconclusively with an Ayyubid army from Egypt commanded by Saladin. The theatre of operations included Eilat, the Transjordan, Galilee and Beirut (which witnessed a siege by Saladin that ended in August of the same year).
1187年：Saladin conquers virtually all of the Kingdom of Jerusalem with the exception of Tyre, which held out under Conrad of Montferrat.
1192年：Richard the Lionheart signed a treaty with Saladin, restoring the Kingdom of Jerusalem to a coastal strip between Jaffa and Beirut.
1260年：The county of Tripoli becomes a vassal state of the Mongol Empire.
1289年：The county of Tripoli falls into the hands of the Mamluks after the attack of Egyptian Sultan Qalawun in March.
1291年：The Shia Muslims and Druze, in Lebanon, rebelled against the Mamluks who were busy fighting the European Crusaders and Mongols.
1308年：The rebellion was crushed by the Mamluks.
1516年：The Ottoman Sultan Selim I grants Emir Fakhr ad-Din I a semi-autonomous reign in Lebanon.
1570年：The Maanid period reaches its peak with the reign of Fakhr ad-Din II. (to 1635)
1613年：Fakhr ad-Din II is exiled to Tuscany after his inability to defeat the army of Ahmad al Hafiz, the governor of Damascus.
1618年：Fakhr ad-Din II returns to Lebanon with the beginning of Muhammad Pasha's reign as the new governor of Damascus.
1622年：The Battle of Anjar took place on 31 October, near Majdal Anjar between the army of Fakhr ad-Din II and an Ottoman army led by the governor of Damascus Mustafa Pasha.
1635年：By the orders of Murad IV, Kutshuk, the governor of Damascus, defeats Fakhr ad-Din who was later executed in Constantinople.
1736年：The Lebanese Council of 1736 takes place in which the Maronite Church reforms itself significantly and elaborates rules and canons for the Maronite Church.

1799年：Bashir II declines to assist the siege of Acre by Napoleon and Jezzar Pasha. Unable to conquer Acre, Napoleon returned to Egypt, and the death of Jezzar Pasha in 1804 removed Bashir's principal opponent in the area.

1831年：Bashir II breaks away from the Ottoman Empire, allies with Muhammad Ali of Egypt and assists Muhammad Ali's son, Ibrahim Pasha, in another siege of Acre. This siege lasted seven months, the city falling on 27 May 1832. The Egyptian army, with assistance from Bashir's troops, also attacked and conquered Damascus on 14 June 1832.

1840年：After Muhammad Ali's rejection of the requests of the London treaty signed on 15 June 1840, Ottoman and British troops landed on the Lebanese coast on 10 September 1840. Faced with this combined force, Muhammad Ali retreated, and on 14 October 1840, Bashir II surrendered to the British and went into exile.
1841年：Conflicts between the Druze and the Maronite Christians exploded. A Maronite revolt against the Feudal class erupted, and lasted until 1858.

1860年：A full-scale war erupted between Maronites and Druze. Napoleon III of France sent 7,000 troops to Beirut and helped impose a partition: The Druze control of the territory was recognised as the fact on the ground, and the Maronites were forced into an enclave, arrangements ratified by the concert of Europe in 1861.

1890年：The "silk crisis" took place. Cheaper and better quality Chinese silk and silk products flooded Lebanese silk's main market: Europe. The crisis was especially hard considering many had taken on large debt to expand their lands and plant mulberry trees -which leaves were used to feed the worm.
1914年：After the abolishment of Lebanon's semiautonomous status, Jamal Pasha militarily occupies Lebanon.
1915年：Jamal Pasha initiates a blockade of the entire eastern Mediterranean coast. Lebanon witnessed thousands of deaths from widespread famine and plagues. (Great Famine of Mount Lebanon)
1916年：Turkish authorities publicly executed 21 Syrians and Lebanese in Damascus and Beirut, respectively, for alleged anti-Turkish activities.
1918年：British general Edmund Allenby and Faysal I, son of Sharif Hussein of Mecca, moved into Palestine with British and Arab forces, thus opening the way for the occupation of Lebanon.
links: Hussein bin Ali, Sharif of Mecca

items.text: 1920年：France takes control over Lebanese territory after the San Remo conference.
1935年：France establishes a tobacco monopoly, followed by the 1935 Lebanon tobacco protests.

1943年11月22日：On 22 November, Lebanon gains its independence after national and international pressure following the imprisonment of president Bechara El Khoury and other parliament members by the French.
1948年：The 1948 Arab–Israeli War; Palestinian refugees begin arriving in Lebanon.
1958年：A civil war erupts but short lived after the intervention of 5,000 US Marines ordered by President Eisenhower upon the request of the Lebanese president Camille Chamoun.

1975年：Gunmen from the Phalanges, a Lebanese Christian group, ambush a bus in Beirut, killing 27 of its mainly Palestinian Muslim passengers, initiating the Lebanese Civil War, mainly between Christians (with Israeli support) and Muslims.

1982年：Israel launches a full-scale invasion of Lebanon. The south of Lebanon, all the way to Beirut, is occupied by Israel. Pro-Israeli president-elect Bachir Gemayel is assassinated. With Israeli support, the Phalangist militia kills thousands of Palestinians in the Sabra and Shatila massacre. Bachir's elder brother Amine Gemayel is elected president. Hezbollah is founded in Lebanon in opposition to the Israeli occupation of Southern Lebanon.
1988年：Outgoing President Amine Gemayel appoints an unelected military government under Christian Commander-in-Chief Michel Aoun.
1990年：Michel Aoun flees the country as Syrian troops enter Lebanon. End of the Lebanese civil war.
1992年：Wealthy businessman Rafic Hariri, a Muslim moderate, is elected prime minister.
2000年5月：Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon, putting an end to 18 years of Israeli occupation.

2005年2月：Following the assassination of Rafic Hariri, who opposed Syrian presence in Lebanon, the Cedar Revolution took place: following massive, peaceful demonstrations, the Syrian troops completely withdrew from Lebanon on 27 April 2005.
2006年：The July War takes place between Hezbollah and Israel. The conflict ends with the acceptance of the United Nations Security Council Resolution 1701 by both Israel and Lebanon.

2007年：2007 Lebanon conflict: fighting between Fatah al-Islam, an Islamist militant organization, and the Lebanese Armed Forces (LAF) on May 20, 2007, in Nahr al-Bared, an UNRWA Palestinian refugee camp near Tripoli.

2008年5月：2008 Lebanon conflict: Hezbollah-led opposition fighters seized control of several West Beirut neighborhoods from Future Movement militiamen loyal to the government, in street battles that left 11 dead and 30 wounded. The opposition-seized areas were then handed over to the Lebanese Army.
2011年：2011 Lebanese protests - part of the Arab Spring.

2011年6月：Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon - Between 2011 and 2017, fighting from the Syrian Civil War spilled over into Lebanon as opponents and supporters of the Syrian Arab Republic traveled to Lebanon to fight and attack each other on Lebanese soil. The Syrian conflict stoked a resurgence of sectarian violence in Lebanon.
links: Syrian civil war spillover in Lebanon

items.text: 2019年10月：2019–2020 Lebanese protests - part of the 2018–2020 Arab protests.

2020年8月：On August 4, 2020, a massive explosion occurred at the Port of Beirut, Lebanon, resulting in at least 218 deaths, over 7,000 injuries. The explosion was one of the most powerful non-nuclear blasts recorded and the cause is still unknown.2020 Beirut explosion
2020年－2029年：History of Israel
2020年－2029年：Timeline of Israeli history
2020年－2029年：List of years in Israel
1881年3月13日：Tsar Alexander II of Russia is assassinated, triggering multiple waves of Jewish pogroms after some blamed "agents of foreign influence", a term often directed at Jewish communities.
1881年－1903年：The First Aliyah describes the initial major wave of Jewish immigration to Palestine motivated by persecution and economic hardship.
1882年5月15日：The Russian emperor Alexander III issued the May Laws, severely restricting the rights of Jews in the Pale of Settlement, and intensifying Jewish emmigration.

1894年12月：The Dreyfus Affair was a political scandal in France that involved the wrongful conviction of Jewish army officer, Alfred Dreyfus. It is one of the most notable examples of antisemitism and miscarriage of justice.
1896年2月：Theodor Herzl published Der Judenstaat, arguing for the establishment of an independent Jewish state.

1897年8月29日：The First Zionist Congress constituted 218 delegates of Zionist organizations, most from Eastern Europe, convened in Basel. It was instrumental in the formation of the Zionist platform, founding of the World Zionist Organization, and helped unify the Zionist movement.
1901年：The Jewish National Fund is established to buy land and encourage Jewish settlement in Palestine.

1915年－1916年：British diplomats and the Sharif of Mecca exchange the McMahon-Hussein Correspondence, in which Britain promises an independent Arab state, which would include Palestine, in exchange for supporting the British against the Ottoman Empire in the First World War.
1916年1月3日：Britain, France, Russia, and Italy sign the secret Sykes-Picot Agreement which would partition the Ottoman Empire in the event of an Allied victory.
1917年11月2日：The Balfour Declaration issued by the British Government called for a national home for the Jewish People in Palestine, which was seen as a contradiction by some.
1917年11月23日：The Bolsheviks make the terms of the Sykes-Picot Agreement public, exposing contradicting promises made in the McMahon-Hussein Correspondence and the Balfour Declaration.

1919年1月3日：Chaim Weizmann and Emir Faisal, son of the Sharif of Mecca, sign the Faisal-Weizmann agreement, promising Jewish support and development in Palestine. Faisal's approval was contingent on the fulfillment of British promises to him.
1920年4月25日：The League of Nations assigns Britain the creation of Mandatory Palestine.
1920年6月：Jewish paramilitary organization Haganah is formed with the purpose of defending Jewish settlements against Arab attacks.
1920年：1920 Jerusalem riots were attacks on Jewish lives and property by Arabs, leaving 216 Jewish casualties and 25 Arab casualties.

1920年7月1日：The Palin Commission is created to investigate the 1920 Jerusalem riots. They report that Arab rioters attacked Jewish lives and property, and that the cause was attributed to the disappointment that stemmed from unfulfilled promises to them by the British.

1921年：The 1921 Cairo Conference convened by Britain aimed to organize the Middle East boundaries and develop a policy of governance. Arab and Jewish delegations were invited to advise or provide input. The conference established the division of Mandatory Palestine into Transjordan, and Palestine with Emir Abdullah ruling semi-autonomously in the former. His brother, Emir Faisal would be crowned King of Iraq.

1921年10月：The Haycraft Commission is created to investigate the 1921 Jaffa riots. The report blamed Arabs for the violence but notes growing Arab resentment of British policy, seemingly favoring Jewish communities and ambitions at the expense of the Arab population.

1922年6月3日：Winston Churchill drafts the Churchill White Paper. In it contains Britain's will to maintain their commitment to the Balfour Declaration, calls for restrictions on Jewish immigration, clarification that Palestine would not become a Jewish State. This would be the governoring policy in the region until 1939.
1923年9月29日：British Mandate for Palestine comes into effect.
1929年：1929 Palestine riots were a series of violent demonstrations and riots involving access over the Western Wall in Jerusalem. The riots lead to 472 Jewish casualties and 348 Arab casualties.

1930年3月：The Shaw Commission is created to investigate the 1929 Palestine riots. The report concludes that riots were caused by Arab fears over Jewish immigration and land acquisition. It recommends restrictions on Jewish land purchases and immigration, an inquiry to support the rapidly growing rural Palestinian population, and clairty regarding British policy.
1930年10月：The Passfield White Paper is drafted to implement recommendations made by the Shaw Commission and Hope Simpson Enquiry. The tone of the paper was considered anti-zionist by many.

1931年2月13日：The MacDonald letter written by British prime minister Ramsay MacDonald to Chaim Weizmann to clarify the new Passfield White Paper. It is considered to be an informal withdrawal of the Passfield White Paper.
1931年4月10日：Jewish paramilitary organization Irgun is founded. Irgun policy was based on Revisionist Zionism

1936年－1939年：The 1936-1939 Palestinian Revolt was a movement calling for independence from British colonial rule and the end to British support for Zionism. 5000+ Arabs, 300+ Jews, and 262 Britons were killed, with at least 15,000 Arabs wounded.
1939年－1945年：World War II: Germany invades Poland and The Holocaust occurred in German-occupied Europe killing 6 million Jews.

1946年7月22日：Jewish terrorists bombed the King David Hotel. The terrorist attack was carried out by the Zionist paramilitary group Irgun. 91 people of various nationalities, including Britons, Arabs and Jews, were killed and 45 people were injured by the militant right-wing group.

1947年11月25日：United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine that proposed a creation of one Arab state and one Jewish state passes with the Jewish leaders accepted and Arab states rejected the move. A major civil war between the Arab populations and Jewish populations began shortly after.
links: United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine

items.text: 1948年5月14日：On the last day of the British Mandate, David Ben-Gurion, executive head of the Zionist Organization and chairman of the Jewish Agency for Palestine, issued the Israeli Declaration of Independence which declared the establishment of a Jewish state in the Land of Israel to be known as the State of Israel, which covered part of the territory of what had been Mandatory Palestine.
1948年5月15日：1948 Arab–Israeli War: Hours after the expiration of the British Mandate of Palestine, Iraq, Egypt, Jordan and Syria invaded Israel.
1949年1月25日：1949 Israeli legislative election: Elections were held to a constituent assembly. Ben-Gurion's center-left Mapai won a plurality of seats.

1949年2月24日：1948 Arab–Israeli War: The first of the 1949 Armistice Agreements ending the war was signed between Israel and Egypt. An armistice line was agreed along the prewar border with the exception that Egypt remained in control of the Gaza Strip.

1949年3月8日：The first government of Israel, in which Mapai, the Jewish United Religious Front, the liberal Progressive Party, the Sephardim and Oriental Communities and the Arab Democratic List of Nazareth ruled in coalition with Ben-Gurion as prime minister, was established.
1949年5月11日：The General Assembly of the United Nations adopted United Nations General Assembly Resolution 273, according to which Israel was admitted to membership.
1949年12月13日：Ben-Gurion proclaimed Jerusalem the capital of Israel.
1950年7月5日：The Israeli legislature the Knesset passed the Law of Return, which granted all Jews the right to migrate to and settle in Israel and obtain citizenship.

1956年7月26日：Suez Crisis: In a broadcast speech, Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser gave a codeword order for the occupation and nationalization of the Suez Canal and the closure of the Straits of Tiran to Israeli shipping.
1956年10月29日：Suez Crisis: The Israeli air force began bombing Egyptian forces in the Sinai Peninsula.

1960年5月11日：Eight agents of the Israeli internal security service Shin Bet and its foreign intelligence service Mossad abducted Adolf Eichmann, the Nazi officer primarily responsible for the actual implementation of the Holocaust, near his home in San Fernando, Buenos Aires.
1966年：The martial law imposed on Israeli Arabs from the founding of the State of Israel was lifted completely.
1967年6月5日：Six-Day War: The Israeli air force destroyed the Egyptian air force on the ground over a period of three hours.

1967年6月11日：Six-Day War: Israel signed a ceasefire with its enemies Egypt, Syria, Jordan, Lebanon and Iraq. It remained in control of the formerly Egyptian Gaza Strip and Sinai Peninsula, the Syrian Golan Heights and the Jordanian West Bank and East Jerusalem.
1967年6月30日：Mayor Teddy Kollek of Jerusalem announced that the city had been fully reunified.

1973年2月21日：A Boeing 727-200 serving as Libyan Arab Airlines Flight 114 from Tripoli to Cairo was shot down over the Sinai Peninsula by Israeli fighter aircraft, killing over one hundred passengers and crew.
1973年7月21日：Lillehammer affair: A team of fifteen Mossad agents assassinated a Moroccan waiter in Lillehammer in a case of mistaken identity.
1973年10月6日：Yom Kippur War: Egyptian and Syrian forces simultaneously attacked Israeli positions in the Sinai Peninsula and the Golan Heights, respectively, on the Jewish holiday of Yom Kippur.
1973年10月14日：Operation Nickel Grass: The United States began an airlift of tanks, artillery, ammunition and supplies to Israel.
1973年10月25日：Yom Kippur War: Israel, Egypt and Syria agreed to a ceasefire. Israel remained in control of new territory north of the Golan Heights and west of the Suez Canal in the south.

1976年7月4日：Operation Entebbe: Sayeret Matkal freed some hundred hostages held at Entebbe International Airport by hijackers belonging to the Palestinian nationalist Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine – External Operations and the far-left Revolutionary Cells.
links: Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine – External Operations

items.text: 1977年5月10日：1977 Israeli Air Force Sikorsky CH-53 Sea Stallion crash: An Israeli Air Force Sikorsky CH-53 Sea Stallion crashed in the Jordan Valley, killing fifty-four soldiers.
links: 1977 Israeli Air Force Sikorsky CH-53 Sea Stallion crash

items.text: 1978年9月17日：Israel and Egypt signed the Camp David Accords at the White House. The framework agreement provided for the establishment of an autonomous authority in the West Bank and Gaza Strip and for withdrawal of Israeli forces from the Sinai Peninsula in exchange for the establishment of full diplomatic relations with Egypt.
1979年3月26日：Egypt and Israel signed the Egypt–Israel peace treaty under the framework of the Camp David Accords at the White House.
1980年2月24日：The old Israeli shekel replaced the Israeli pound as the currency of Israel.
1980年7月30日：The Knesset passed the Jerusalem Law, asserting that Jerusalem was and would remain the undivided capital of Israel.
1981年6月7日：Operation Opera: Israel carried out a surprise air strike on an Iraqi nuclear reactor eleven miles southeast of Baghdad.
1982年4月23日：The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) forcibly evacuated Yamit per the terms of the Egypt–Israel peace treaty.

1982年6月3日：Shlomo Argov, the Israeli ambassador to the United Kingdom, was shot in the head in London in an attempted assassination organized by Iraq's Iraqi Intelligence Service and carried out by the Palestinian nationalist Abu Nidal Organization.

1982年6月6日：1982 Lebanon War: The IDF invaded southern Lebanon in response to repeated attacks by the Palestinian nationalist Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), whose militants were sheltered there, on Israeli civilians.
1984年4月12日：Bus 300 affair: Four Palestinian nationalists hijacked a bus from Tel Aviv to Ashkelon and took its forty passengers hostage.
1984年11月21日：Operation Moses: The first of some eight thousand Ethiopian Jews were covertly evacuated to Israel from refugee camps in Sudan.
1985年1月5日：Operation Moses: Prime minister Shimon Peres confirmed the existence of the airlift. Sudan immediately halted flights.
1987年8月30日：The Cabinet voted to cancel development of the IAI Lavi.
1987年12月9日：First Intifada: Protests began in the Jabalia Camp in response to the death of four Palestinian civilians in a car crash with an IDF truck.
1989年9月19日：Mount Carmel Forest Fire: A forest fire began on Mount Carmel which would burn over two square miles over the next three days.
1991年1月22日：Gulf War: An Iraqi Scud missile landed in Ramat Gan, killing three and injuring nearly a hundred.
1991年5月24日：Operation Solomon: An airlift began which would transport some fourteen thousand Ethiopian Jews from Ethiopia to Israel over a thirty-six-hour period.
1991年10月30日：Madrid Conference of 1991: A conference opened in Madrid with the goal of reviving the Israeli–Palestinian peace process.
1992年12月17日：Israel deported some four hundred Palestinians to Lebanon.

1993年9月13日：Israel and the PLO signed the Oslo I Accord in Washington, D.C. The accords provided for the withdrawal of some IDF forces from the West Bank and Gaza Strip and for the establishment of a self-governing authority for the Palestinians, the Palestinian National Authority.

1994年10月26日：Israel and Jordan signed the Israel–Jordan peace treaty in the Arabah. The treaty clarified the borders of the two countries and their water rights; each pledged that neither would allow a third country to use its territory to stage an attack on the other.
1995年11月4日：Assassination of Yitzhak Rabin: The radical nationalist Yigal Amir, an opponent of the Oslo Accords, shot and killed prime minister Yitzhak Rabin after a rally in Tel Aviv.
1997年2月4日：1997 Israeli helicopter disaster: Two transport helicopters en route to southern Lebanon collided in midair above She'ar Yashuv, killing all on board.
1997年7月14日：Maccabiah bridge collapse: A pedestrian bridge collapsed over the Yarkon River in Tel Aviv, killing four.
2000年5月24日：Israel withdrew the last of its forces from southern Lebanon.
2000年10月1日：October 2000 events: The first of a series of riots began in which thirteen Arabs and one Jew would be killed over nine days.

2000年10月7日：2000 Hezbollah cross-border raid: The Lebanese Shia Islamist militant group and political party Hezbollah abducted three Israeli soldiers from the Israeli administered side of the Blue Line, the internationally recognized border.

2001年10月17日：Assassination of Rehavam Ze'evi: Tourism minister Rehavam Ze'evi was shot at a Jerusalem hotel by Hamdi Quran of the Palestinian nationalist Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine. He died of his injuries that night in hospital.
links: Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine

items.text: 2002年6月23日：Construction of the Israeli West Bank barrier began.

2004年1月29日：Some four hundred prisoners, the remains of sixty Lebanese militants and civilians, and maps showing the locations of Israeli mines in southern Lebanon, were transferred to Hezbollah in exchange for the bodies of the three soldiers abducted in 2000, as well as the abducted Israeli reservist Elhanan Tannenbaum.
2005年9月12日：Israeli disengagement from Gaza: The last Israeli settlers and security personnel were withdrawn from the Gaza Strip.
2006年1月4日：Prime minister Ariel Sharon suffered a severe hemorrhagic stroke and fell into a coma. The designated acting prime minister Ehud Olmert became acting prime minister.
2006年7月12日：2006 Hezbollah cross-border raid: Hezbollah forces crossed into Israel and ambushed two IDF vehicles, killing three soldiers and capturing two others.
2006年7月12日：2006 Lebanon War: Israeli forces began shelling Lebanese territory in response to the Hezbollah attack of earlier that morning.
2007年9月6日：Operation Orchard: Israel carried out a surprise air strike on a suspected nuclear reactor in Syria's Deir ez-Zor Governorate.

2008年12月27日：Gaza War: Israel began conducting a series of airstrikes on assets of the Palestinian Sunni Islamist organization Hamas in the Gaza Strip in response to ongoing rocket fire on the western Negev.
2009年1月18日：Gaza War (2008–09): The war ended with a unilateral Israeli ceasefire.

2010年5月31日：Gaza flotilla raid: The navy boarded a flotilla organized by the Free Gaza Movement and the Turkish Foundation for Human Rights and Freedoms and Humanitarian Relief, which was attempting to break an Israeli and Egyptian blockade of the Gaza Strip, in international waters. During the takeover, a violent confrontation erupted on board the MV Mavi Marmara in which nine activists were killed.
2010年12月2日：Mount Carmel Forest Fire: A forest fire began on Mount Carmel which would kill forty and burn nearly twenty square miles over the next three days.
2011年7月14日：2011 Israeli social justice protests: Filmmaker Daphni Leef set up a tent in Habima Square and invited others to join a protest over the absence of affordable housing.
2011年9月10日：2011 attack on the Israeli Embassy in Egypt: A crowd of thousands of Egyptian protestors breached the Israeli embassy in Cairo.
links: 2011 attack on the Israeli Embassy in Egypt

items.text: 2011年10月18日：Gilad Shalit prisoner exchange: Hamas released the Israeli soldier Gilad Shalit to Egypt in exchange for one thousand Palestinian other Arab prisoners held in Israel, including some three hundred serving life sentences for planning and perpetrating terror attacks.

2012年11月14日：Operation Pillar of Defense: The IDF began an eight-day anti-Hamas operation in the Gaza Strip, a response to ongoing rocket fire on the western Negev, with an airstrike on the senior officer Ahmed Jabari.
2014年7月8日：2014 Israel–Gaza conflict: The IDF launched a series of airstrikes against Hamas targets in the Gaza Strip.
2017年12月6日：United States recognition of Jerusalem as the capital of Israel: U.S. president Donald Trump formally announces the United States recognition of Jerusalem as the capital of Israel.
links: United States recognition of Jerusalem as the capital of Israel

items.text: 2019年3月25日：United States recognition of Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights: U.S. president Donald Trump signed a presidential proclamation to officially recognize Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights.
links: United States recognition of Israel's sovereignty over the Golan Heights

items.text: 2020年12月10日：Israel–Morocco normalization agreement: Following the Abraham Accords, Israel and Morocco signed a security cooperation agreement and began normalizing relations.
2021年4月30日：2021 Meron stampede: The deadliest civil disaster in Israel's history.
2021年5月：2021 Israel–Palestine crisis

2021年6月16日：Naftali Bennett of the Yamina party was sworn in as Prime Minister, forming a coalition government with Yair Lapid of the Yesh Atid party, marking the end of Benjamin Netanyahu's 12-year tenure as prime minister.
2021年7月14日：Israel opened its embassy in the United Arab Emirates in accordance with the Abraham Accords

2022年5月11日：Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh was shot and killed while covering an Israeli military raid in Jenin. Her death led to international condemnation and calls for an investigation into the circumstances of the shooting.
2022年6月30日：The Israeli Knesset voted to dissolve itself, triggering the fifth election in less than four years.
2022年11月1日：Israel held its fifth election in less than four years, resulting in a victory for Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party, which led to the formation of a controversial right-wing government.

2023年1月7日：2023 Israeli judicial reform protests: Large-scale protests erupted across Israel in response to proposed judicial reforms by the Netanyahu government, which critics argued would undermine judicial independence.
2023年5月9日：Operation Shield and Arrow: The IDF launched a series of airstrikes against Palestinian Islamic Jihad targets in Gaza following rocket fire towards southern Israel.

2023年10月7日：October 7 attacks and Gaza war: Hamas and several other Palestinian militant groups launched coordinated armed incursions from the Gaza Strip into southern Israel, killing 1,143 and taking 250 hostages, marking the deadliest attack in Israeli history and the first invasion of Israeli territory since the 1948 Arab–Israeli War.
2023年10月8日：Israel–Hezbollah conflict: Hezbollah begins attacking northern Israel and the occupied Golan Heights.
2023年10月27日：Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip: The IDF launched a full-scale invasion of the Gaza Strip with the goal of eliminating Hamas and releasing the hostages.
links: Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)

items.text: 30年：Pharnabazid dynasty is restored to the Iberian throne.

117年－138年：Kingdom of Iberia reaches its peak with the reign of King Pharasmanes II of Iberia, who manages to install his brother Mithridates on the Armenian throne, who is later deposed and replaced by his nephew Rhadamistus. The possibility of uniting the two kingdoms is finally shattered by Parthian invasion and Rhadamistus is overthrown.
189年：Arsacid dynasty of Iberia succeeds the Pharnabazids.
270年：Anti-Roman uprising in Colchis.
284年：Chosroid dynasty, a branch of the House of Mihran, begins reigning over the Kingdom of Iberia.
482年－502年：Vakhtang I of Iberia fights against growing Persian domination and renewed attempts of forcible conversion of Iberia, Armenia and Albania to Zoroastrianism.
580年：Death of Bacurius, the last Chosroid ruler of Iberia and subsequent abolition of Iberian monarchy by Persians.
588年：After the abolition of the monarchy by Sassanid Empire, Principate of Iberia is established with Guaram I of Iberia as its first ruler.
526年－532年：Iberian War
541年－562年：Lazic War
627年：Third Perso-Turkic War - Tbilisi, capital of the Principate of Iberia, whose ruler Stephen I of Iberia is an ally of the Khosrau II, is sacked by the combined forces of Turks and Byzantines.
654年：First entry of Arabs into Georgian lands. Principate of Iberia, unable to resist the invaders on its own, surrenders and accepts the terms of vassalage.
735年－737年：Marwan ibn Muhammad's invasion of Georgia
links: Marwan ibn Muhammad's invasion of Georgia

items.text: 1000年：Bagrat III of Georgia establishes the Kingdom of Georgia.
1040年：Seljuk Turks invade Georgia.
1071年：Byzantine-Georgian armies are defeated by Seljuk Turks at the Battle of Manzikert.
1089年：At the age 16 King David IV of Georgia inherits the throne and organizes the army to combat the Seljuk invaders.
1121年：At the Battle of Didgori Seljuks are defeated by the Georgians. Tbilisi and other Georgian lands go back to Georgia.
1204年：Queen Tamar of Georgia conquers Black Sea coast of Byzantine Empire and Empire of Trebizond is created. She puts there as emperor her own relative Prince Alexios Komnenos.
1400年：Timur invades Georgia, destroying most of the towns in western Georgia. Around 60,000 survivors were taken back to the Timurid Empire as slaves.
1463年：Self-declared King of Imereti Bagrat VI defeats George VIII forces in the Battle of Chikhori and ensures his power.
1483年：Self-declared Atabeg of Samtskhe Qvarqvare II Jaqeli assaults royal forces and defeats them in the Battle of Aradeti, therefore ensuring his power. Kingdom of Georgia finally collapses.
1490年：Governors of Kartli finally recognizes dissolution of Kingdom of Georgia.
1783年7月24日：The Treaty of Georgievsk is signed between the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti and the Russian Empire, making Kartli-Kakheti a protectorate of Russia.
1795年：Agha Mohammed Khan invades Georgia, capturing and sacking Tbilisi. Eastern Georgia briefly re-occupied by the Iranians.
1798年：Civil war breaks out within Kartli following the death of Erekle II over the succession to the throne of Kartli, eventually taken by George XII.
1799年：Russians enter Tbilisi.
1801年1月8日：Tsar Paul I of Russia signs a decree on incorporating Kartli-Kakheti into Russia, confirmed by Alexander I on 12 September the same year.
1810年：Russian Army invades and annexes Kingdom of Imereti.
1811年7月18日：Autocephaly of Georgian Orthodox Church was quashed on order of the Tsar.
1813年10月24日：Treaty of Gulistan signed between Qajar Iran and the Russian Empire, ending the Russo-Iranian War of 1804–1813. Eastern Georgia officially ceded by the Iranians to Russia.
1829年9月9日：David Gurieli was proclaimed deposed by the Russian authorities and Principality of Guria was directly annexed by Russian Empire.
1858年：Principality of Svaneti was abolished by the Russian authorities and was converted into a district of Russian Empire.
1864年：Principality of Abkhazia was abolished and incorporated in the Russian Empire, whereas Prince Mikhail Shervashidze was forced to reject his rights and resettle in Voronezh.
1867年：Niko Dadiani was deposed and Principality of Mingrelia was abolished and incorporated in the Russian Empire.
1878年7月13日：Treaty of Berlin was signed in the aftermath of the Russo-Turkish War. The Ottomans were forced to cede Adjara to the expanding Russian Empire.
1918年4月22日：Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic established.
1918年5月28日：Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic disestablished.
1918年5月26日：Democratic Republic of Georgia established.
1921年2月25日：Democratic Republic of Georgia annexed by the Bolshevik forces of the Soviet Union, following an invasion which begin 14 days earlier on the 11th.

1978年4月14日：A wave of demonstrations were held in Tbilisi to protest adopting a new constitution of the Soviet Georgia, no longer declaring Georgian to be the sole state language. Protests resulted in retaining the previous status of the Georgian language.
1989年4月9日：Soviet forces disperse demonstrations in Tbilisi, leaving 21 civilians killed.
1991年4月9日：Georgia declares independence from the Soviet Union, finalized on 25 December the same year.
1991年5月：Zviad Gamsakhurdia elected as the first President of Georgia.
1991年－1992年：Zviad Gamsakhurdia overthrowed by the military junta.
1991年－1993年：Georgian Civil War takes place.
1991年－1992年：South Ossetia War.
1992年－1993年：War in Abkhazia.
1995年11月：Eduard Shevardnadze elected as the President of Georgia.
2003年11月：The Rose Revolution resulted in overthrow of incumbent President Eduard Shevardnadze.
2004年1月：Mikheil Saakashvili elected as the new President of Georgia.
2004年5月：The Adjara Revolution restored semi-independent region under control of the central government of Georgia.
2008年8月：Russo-Georgian War.
2012年10月：Georgian Dream defeats the United National Movement party of incumbent President Mikheil Saakashvili in the parliamentary election.
約12000年：Some Ughtasar Petroglyphs carved onto dark brownish-black volcanic stones left behind by an extinct volcano
約4300年：Areni-1 cave late Chalcolithic/Early Bronze Age ritual site and settlement, was inhabited by humans
約前4000年：Godedzor archeological site was built
約前3000年：Shengavit site inhabited during a series of settlement phases from approximately 3000 BC to 2500 BC
前2492年：A legendary battle recounted by Movses Khorenatsi, said to have taken place in the valley of Hoşap River, Vaspurakan.
