1997年12月11日：The Supreme Court of Canada renders a decision onDelgamuukw v British Columbia, determining that aboriginal title had not been distinguished in BC. This ends the decades-long refusal of the BC government to participate in land claims to settle with First Nations, claiming that aboriginal title had been extinguished.

1999年4月1日：Nunavut is partitioned from the Northwest Territories to become Canada's third territory. This follows plebiscites in 1982 and 1992, and establishment of the Nunavut Land Claims Agreement in 1993.
2001年10月7日：Canada joins the War in Afghanistan.
2003年12月7日：The Canadian Alliance and PC Party merged into the Conservative Party of Canada.
2005年7月20日：The Civil Marriage Act legalizes same-sex marriage throughout Canada.

2008年6月1日：As part of the Indian Residential Schools Settlement Agreement, the Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC) is established to document the history and lasting impacts of the Canadian Indian residential school system on Indigenous persons and their families.
links: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada

items.text: 2008年6月11日：In the House of Commons, Prime Minister Harper formally apologizes to the survivors of the Residential School System on behalf of the Government of Canada.

2010年6月3日：The Haida Gwaii Reconciliation Act establishes in Canadian law the name of Haida Gwaii over the archipelago formerly known as the Queen Charlotte Islands. Further agreements would re-establish the sovereignty of over 200 islands to the Council of the Haida Nation.
2012年：Students in Quebec protest and stop proposed increases in university tuition.
2012年5月4日：The Royal Canadian Mint strikes the last Canadian penny. The coin is removed from circulation a few months later, though existing pennies remain legal tender.
2014年3月12日：Canada withdraws from the War in Afghanistan at the end of the first phase.

2018年10月17日：The Cannabis Act becomes law, making recreational cannabis use legal throughout the country. Canada is the second country (after Uruguay in 2013) to legalize recreational cannabis use nationwide.

2020年：Widespread popular protests occur across Canada after the RCMP forcibly remove peaceful protesters blocking construction of the Coastal GasLink pipeline on Wetʼsuwetʼen territory in British Columbia. The protests block several rail lines, forcing the shutdown of much of the Canadian rail network.
2020年1月25日：First presumptive case of COVID-19 is identified; a man who travelled in China. The COVID-19 pandemic spreads widely in Canada.

2022年：Right-wing protesters protesting vaccine mandates converge in Ottawa, overwhelming local police forces and disrupting residents in an occupation of downtown. After several weeks, the Canada convoy protest group is cleared after the Government of Canada invokes the Emergencies Act. Several police forces participate in a joint effort that forcibly removes the group. Similar groups block Canada-US border crossings in Windsor, Ontario and Coutts, Alberta for days before also being cleared forcibly by police. Criminal charges laid against several of the Coutts protesters.
links: 2022 alleged plot to kill Coutts RCMP officers

items.text: 2022年：After the Russian invasion of Ukraine, Canada promises $1 billion in aid to Ukraine. Canada assists in training Ukrainian soldiers in third locations, and accepts thousands of Ukrainians fleeing the fighting.
2022年：Pope Francis visits Canada to apologize for Catholic Church members' role in the Canadian Indian residential school system. Services were held in Alberta, Quebec City and Iqaluit.
links: Visit by Pope Francis to Canada

items.text: 2022年9月8日：Elizabeth II, the longest-reigning Canadian monarch in history, dies aged 96, after a reign of 70 years. Charles III becomes King of Canada.
2026年10月19日：A referendum on Alberta remaining in Canada or proceeding toward a referendum on independence is held, resulting in a majority (75%) of the province voting to remain in Canada

links: Canada in the world wars and interwar period

items.text: 1982年：present
1520年5月20日：Massacre in the Great Temple: Spanish soldiers killed a group of Aztec nobles in the Templo Mayor in Tenochtitlan during the celebration of Toxcatl.
1520年6月29日：Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire: Moctezuma II, the tlatoani of Tenochtitlan and ruler of the Aztec Triple Alliance, was killed.
links: Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire

items.text: 1520年6月30日：La Noche Triste: The Spaniard Hernán Cortés lost several hundred men in a fighting escape from Tenochtitlan.
1520年7月7日：Battle of Otumba: Combined Spanish and Tlaxcala forces seriously defeated a vastly superior Aztec force at Otumba de Gómez Farías.
1521年8月13日：Fall of Tenochtitlan: Tenochtitlan was taken by Spanish forces. The tlatoani Cuauhtémoc was taken prisoner.

1713年4月11日：War of the Spanish Succession: The Treaty of Utrecht was signed, under which Great Britain, Savoy, Portugal, and the United Provinces recognized Philip V of Spain of the House of Bourbon as king of Spain, ending the war. In exchange, Philip renounced the right to pass the throne to his heirs.
1724年1月15日：Philip abdicated in favor of his son Louis I of Spain.
1724年8月31日：Louis died of smallpox.
1767年6月：The Society of Jesus was expelled from New Spain.
1776年：The autonomous Commandancy General of the Provincias Internas was established under Teodoro de Croix in the northern provinces of New Spain.
1810年9月16日：Grito de Dolores: The Catholic priest Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla encouraged his congregation to revolt against the Spanish crown in a speech made at Dolores.
1810年9月28日：Mexican War of Independence: After Hidalgo orders Juan Antonio Riaño the surrender of Guanajuato, the insurgent troops led by José Mariano Abasolo and Ignacio Camargo take the city.
1810年10月30日：Battle of Monte de las Cruces: Insurgent forces under Hidalgo and Ignacio Allende defeated Spanish troops at Ocoyoacac.
links: Battle of Monte de las Cruces

items.text: 1811年2月10日：Miguel Hidalgo and Ignacio Allende arrive in Zacatecas.
1811年2月28日：From Guadalajara, José de la Cruz offers Miguel Hidalgo pardon, according to the amnesty decreed by the Cortes.
1811年3月1日：Near Saltillo, Ignacio Allende and Miguel Hidalgo reject the pardon. In San Antonio Béjar, José Manuel Zambrano recovers the city and Texas for the royalists.
1811年3月10日：Miguel Hidalgo, Ignacio Aldama, José Mariano Abasolo, and Ignacio Allende arrive in Saltillo.

1811年3月21日：The insurgent caudillos Miguel Hidalgo, Ignacio Allende, José Mariano Jiménez, José Mariano Abasolo and Ignacio Aldama are captured by Ignacio Elizondo at the Wells of Baján and taken prisoner to Monclova and Chihuahua. The son of Ignacio Allende dies at the site of the capture.
1811年6月26日：In Chihuahua, Ignacio Allende, Ignacio Aldama and José Mariano Jiménez are executed by a firing squad and decapitated. José Mariano Abasolo is sentenced to life imprisonment.
1811年7月11日：From Zitácuaro, Ignacio López Rayón proposes to José María Morelos the formation of a governmental board.
1811年7月30日：Miguel Hidalgo is executed by a firing squad and beheaded in Chihuahua.
1813年9月14日：The Congress of Chilpancingo is inaugurated. Morelos delivers the inaugural speech and Juan Nepomuceno Rosáins reads the Sentimientos de la Nación.

1815年11月27日：The Inquisition declares Morelos a heretic and sentences him to life imprisonment in Africa if he is not sentenced to the death penalty. The ecclesiastical degradation of Morelos is carried out in the chapel of the Holy Office.
1815年12月22日：José María Morelos is executed by a firing squad in San Cristóbal de Ecatepec.
1816年1月30日：Pope Pius VII publishes the encyclical Esti Longissimo Terrarum, where he exhorts obedience and peace from the rebels in Spanish America, favoring Ferdinand VII.

1821年2月21日：Mexican War of Independence: The Spanish colonel Agustín de Iturbide and the insurgent leader Vicente Guerrero together issued the Plan of Iguala at a meeting in Iguala, under which Mexico was to become an independent, Catholic constitutional monarchy.
1821年2月24日：Mexican War of Independence: The armies under Iturbide and Guerrero were consolidated into Iturbide's control in the Army of the Three Guarantees.
1821年8月24日：Mexican War of Independence: Iturbide and Spanish viceroy Juan O'Donojú signed the Treaty of Córdoba, recognizing the independence of Mexico in personal union with Spain.

1836年2月10日：General Santa Anna, commanding the battalions of Matamoros, Jiménez, San Luis, the regiment of Dolores and eight pieces of artillery, occupies San Antonio Béjar The rebels retreat to the fort of El Álamo.
1836年3月6日：After 12 days of siege, the Mexican army assaults the El Álamo. The rebel defenders ultimately surrender. Rebels forge the phrase "Remember the Alamo".
1836年3月26日：General Urrea abides by Santa Anna's order of executing the prisoners of Goliad under the charge of treason.

1836年4月7日：Santa Anna arrives in San Felipe Austin and finds the city abandoned and burned by the Texans. He finds out that Samuel Houston, the rebel leader, is located 10 leagues on the left bank of the Brazos River.

1836年4月21日：Santa Anna's troops, stationed in a hill near the San Jacinto River receive the reinforcement of Perfecto of Cos. The enemy takes refuge in the forest and Santa Anna decides to offer rest to his troops. To his misfortune, Houston's men ambush him. The confrontation lasts for hours until the Mexican ranks disperse.
1836年4月22日：Santa Anna, who had fled in the fray of the previous day, is captured by Texan forces.
1838年10月26日：The remains of Agustín de Iturbide are transferred to the Metropolitan Cathedral of Mexico City in a sumptuous procession.
1838年10月27日：In the Metropolitan Cathedral of Mexico City, the funeral honors and the burial of the remains of Agustín de Iturbide take place.

1846年4月25日：The Thornton Affair is the first clash of the Mexican–American War as 80 cavalrymen under the command of U.S. Captain Seth B. Thornton are attacked by 1600 men under the leadership of Mexican General Anastasio Torrejón in the Nueces Strip between the Nueces River and the Rio Grande.
1846年5月13日：The U.S. Congress declares war against Mexico.
1846年5月14日：The United States begins the Blockade of Veracruz.

1847年：The Battle of Buena Vista takes place. The Mexican army is superior in number, but it found poorly armed and exhausted by the march and severity of the weather; For its part, the US military is smaller, but is better organized and has more artillery. The result is indecisive.
1847年2月23日：During the night, Santa Anna orders the withdrawal of his troops from the battlefield for his focus on the hacienda of Agua Nueva.

1847年2月27日：The Mexican army under Santa Anna undertakes a forced march to San Luis Potosí, arriving on 12 March. In Mexico City, the Rebellion of the Polkos breaks out against the sale of ecclesiastical property, the opposition to the government of Gómez Farías, and the intention to take Santa Anna to the Presidency.
1847年8月20日：Regular Mexican troops and Saint Patrick's Battalion under Manuel Rincón hold a fortified monastery against Winfield Scott.

1847年：General Scott assaults Chapultepec Castle. Los Niños Héroes (six cadets between 12 and 18 years old who died in defense of the military academy) pass into legend. Some captured San Patricios members executed during the battle.
1847年9月15日：After several days of fierce fighting, Mexico City falls.
1847年9月27日：The Mexican government moves to Toluca. President Peña calls on the governors and deputies to meet in Querétaro.
links: Manuel de la Peña y Peña

items.text: 1847年10月13日：In the city of Querétaro, the executive power is established under General Peña y Peña.
links: Manuel de la Peña y Peña

items.text: 1848年2月2日：The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo, ending the Mexican–American War is signed in Mexico City. The U.S. agrees to pay US$15 million to Mexico and to pay off the claims of American citizens against Mexico. It gave the United States the Rio Grande as a boundary for Texas, and gave the U.S. ownership of Alta California and a large area comprising roughly half of New Mexico, most of Arizona, Nevada, and Utah, and parts of Wyoming and Colorado.
1848年7月4日：The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo goes into effect.

1854年3月1日：The Plan de Ayutla is proclaimed, setting off a 19-month revolt against Antonio López de Santa Anna known as the Revolution of Ayutla, leading to La Reforma (The Reform) and the Constitution of 1857.
links: Federal Constitution of the United Mexican States of 1857

items.text: 1855年：The Reform laws begin, separating the Catholic Church and the government of Mexico. Principal leaders were Juan Álvarez, Ignacio Comonfort, Benito Juárez, and Sebastián Lerdo de Tejada.
1855年10月4日：Juan Álvarez takes office as Interim President of Mexico in Cuernavaca.
links: List of heads of state of Mexico

items.text: 1857年2月5日：The Federal Constitution of the United Mexican States of 1857 goes into effect.
links: Federal Constitution of the United Mexican States of 1857

items.text: 1857年12月17日：The Reform War begins when the Plan of Tacubaya is proclaimed and conservative General Félix María Zuloaga ousts president Ignacio Comonfort.
1858年1月15日：Benito Juarez becomes president and he moves to Veracruz.
1861年1月1日：Juarez recaptures Mexico City and goes on to defeat the Conservatives. He is elected president in his own right in March.
1861年10月31日：France, Great Britain, and Spain agree to the Convention of London, a joint effort to extract loan repayments from Mexico, which President Juarez had frozen three months earlier.
1861年12月8日：France, Spain, and Great Britain disembark in Veracruz. Spain and Britain later withdraw.

1862年5月5日：The Mexican Army under General Ignacio Zaragoza defeats the invading French army led by General Charles de Lorencez in the Battle of Puebla. French forces took the city a year later, after the Siege of Puebla (1863).

1863年7月10日：The Second Mexican Empire is declared, with the support of French Emperor Napoleon III, as well as the Austrian and Belgian crowns. The Empire came to an end on 19 June 1867, with the execution of Emperor Maximilian I.

1864年6月10日：Fernando Maximiliano José María de Habsburgo-Lorena, Archduke of Austria, was offered the Mexican crown in October, 1863, which he accepted on 10 April. He and his wife, Charlotte of Belgium arrived in Veracruz on 29 May 1864, and they soon established their official residence at Chapultepec Castle in Mexico City.

1867年6月19日：Napoleon III withdrew his army from Mexico in 1866, and Juarez's liberal forces captured Mexico City on 15 May 1867. Maximilian was captured the next day, and following a trial, he was sentenced to death. Maximilian, General Miguel Miramón, and General Tomás Mejía Camacho were executed by firing squad in Cerro de las Campanas, Querétaro City at 6:40am on the morning of 19 June 1867.
1910年11月20日：Mexican Revolution: Francisco I. Madero calls for armed rebellion against the government of President Porfirio Díaz.
1917年2月5日：Mexican Revolution: The current constitution of Mexico was approved by a constituent assembly in Querétaro.
1920年1月3日：An earthquake of magnitude 7.8 hits Puebla and Veracruz, leaving 648–4,000 dead.
1938年3月18日：Mexican oil expropriation: President Lázaro Cárdenas expropriates the oil industry.
1960年9月21日：President Adolfo López Mateos nationalized the electrical system.
1968年10月2日：Tlatelolco massacre: The government fired on a crowd of student protesters in the Plaza de las Tres Culturas in Mexico City, killing between thirty and three hundred.
1973年8月28日：An earthquake of magnitude 7.5 hits Puebla and Veracruz, leaving 539–1,000 dead.
1982年9月1日：President José López Portillo nationalizes the banking industry.
1985年9月19日：1985 Mexico City earthquake: An earthquake centered off the Pacific coast of Michoacán caused ten thousand deaths and between three and four billion US$ in damage in Mexico City.

1988年7月6日：1988 Mexican general election: Carlos Salinas de Gortari of the Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) was elected president in a rigged election, with an official 51% of the vote. The PRI maintained its majority in the Chamber of Deputies.
1989年5月5日：Constituent parties of the National Democratic Front (FDN) established the Party of the Democratic Revolution (PRD) under the leadership of Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas.
1994年3月23日：Luis Donaldo Colosio is assassinated during his campaign to become the Mexican president in a rally in Tijuana.
2003年7月6日：2003 Mexican legislative election: The PRI won a plurality of seats in the Chamber of Deputies.
2006年7月2日：2006 Mexican general election: Felipe Calderón of the National Action Party (PAN) won the presidency with 36% of the vote. The PAN won a plurality of seats in the Chamber of Deputies.
2006年7月30日：Andrés Manuel López Obrador of the PRD led hundreds of thousands in a protest against the election results at Zócalo in Mexico City.
2009年7月5日：2009 Mexican legislative election: The PRI won a plurality of seats in the Chamber of Deputies.
2012年7月1日：2012 Mexican general election: Enrique Pena Nieto of the PRI won the presidency with 39% of the vote. The PRI won a plurality of seats in the Chamber of Deputies.

2017年9月19日：2017 Puebla earthquake: struck at 13:14 CDT on 19 September 2017 with a magnitude of Mw 7.1 and strong shaking for about 20 seconds. Its epicenter was about 55 km (34 mi) south of the city of Puebla. The earthquake caused damage in the Mexican states of Puebla and Morelos and in the Greater Mexico City area. 370 people were killed by the earthquake and related building collapses, including 228 in Mexico City, and more than 6,000 were injured. Twelve days earlier, the even larger 2017 Chiapas earthquake struck 650 km (400 mi) away, off the coast of the state of Chiapas.

2018年7月1日：Andrés Manuel López Obrador of Together we will make history (a coalition of MORENA and the Labor Party) is elected 58th president with 53% of the vote. Together we will make history also won majorities in both the Senate and the Chamber of Deputies and 5 governorships.
1492年10月27日：Christopher Columbus arrives in Cuba and claims the island for Spain.
1508年：Sebastián de Ocampo circumnavigates Cuba, confirming that it is an island.
1510年：Spanish set out from Hispaniola. The conquest of Cuba begins.
1511年：The first governor of Cuba, the Spanish conquistador Diego Velázquez de Cuéllar leads a group of settlers in Baracoa.
1512年：Indigenous Cuban resistance leader Hatuey is burned at the stake.
1513年：The first African slaves in Cuba
1519年：Havana founded as San Cristóbal de la Habana (north coast)
1523年：Emperor Charles V authorizes 4,000 gold pesos for the construction of cotton mills.
1526年：The beginning of the slave trade and the sale of African slaves in Cuba.
1532年：Jobabó Slave Revolt, the first slave rebellion is crushed.
1537年：A French fleet briefly occupies Havana.
1542年：The Spanish crown abandons the encomienda colonial land settlement system.
1553年：The Governor of Cuba relocates to Havana.
1555年：French campaign against the Sudan usam
1578年：French corsairs plunder Baracoa.
1586年：The English privateer Francis Drake lands at Cape San Antonio but does not attack.
1597年：Construction of the Morro Castle fortress is completed above the eastern entrance to Havana harbor.
1603年：Authorities decree that the sale of tobacco to foreigners is punishable by death.
1607年：Havana is named capital of Cuba.
1607年：Captaincy General of Cuba is created by Philip III of Spain.67
1628年：A Dutch fleet led by Piet Heyn plunders the Spanish fleet in Havana harbor.
1649年：An epidemic of yellow fever kills a third of the island's European population.
1662年：An English fleet captained by Christopher Myngs captures Santiago de Cuba to open up trade with Jamaica.
1670年：The English withdraw after Spain recognises England's ownership of Jamaica.
1670年：Francisco Rodríguez de Ledesma [es] becomes Governor of Cuba. He serves for ten years.
1728年：The University of Havana is founded.
1734年：Juan Francisco de Güemes [es] begins a 12-year tenure as Governor of Cuba.

1741年：British Admiral Edward Vernon briefly captures Guantánamo Bay, renaming it Cumberland Bay, during the War of Jenkins' Ear. His troops withdraw after being decimated by fevers and raids from Spanish troops.
1747年：Francisco Cajigal de la Vega begins a 13-year tenure as Governor of Cuba.
1748年：Construction of Havana Cathedral is completed.
1748年10月12日：Battle of Havana. Skirmishes between British and Spanish fleets end indecisively on a strategic level.
1762年3月5日：A massive British expedition leaves Portsmouth to capture Havana.
1762年7月30日：British troops capture Havana during the Seven Years' War.
1762年：Freemasonry in Cuba begins with the British military lodge operating out of the 48th Regiment of Foot, headquartered in the Basilica of San Francisco de Asís, Havana
links: Basilica of San Francisco de Asís, Havana

items.text: 1763年：British troops suffer atrocious losses to disease. They cede Cuba to Spain in the Treaty of Paris.
1793年：Some 30,000 French refugees from a slave rebellion in Saint-Domingue, which becomes the Haitian Revolution, arrive in Cuba.
1799年：Salvador de Muro y Salazar becomes Governor of Cuba 1799–1812.
1809年：The Rebellion of 1810 [ES] begins, one of the earliest separatist plots in Cuba.
1812年3月16日：The Aponte Rebellion is launched by José Antonio Aponte
1812年：Juan Ruíz de Apodaca becomes governor of Cuba 1812–17.
1819年4月22日：Settlers from Bordeaux and Louisiana found the first European settlement at Cienfuegos.
1823年：The Suns and Rays of Bolívar begins the Revolution of the Suns and Rays.
links: Revolution of the Suns and Rays

items.text: 1843年：Leopoldo O'Donnell, Duke of Tetuan becomes governor of Cuba 1843–48.
1844年：Known as the Year of the Lash, when an uprising of black slaves was brutally suppressed.
1851年：The filibustering Lopez Expedition was defeated by Spanish authorities.
1853年1月28日：José Martí is born in Havana.
1862年2月4日：The Bacardi company is founded in Santiago de Cuba by Facundo Bacardí Massó.
1868年：The first war of Cuban independence, also known as the Ten Years' War, begins. It lasts until 1878.
1868年10月10日：Cry of Yara. Revolutionaries under the leadership of Carlos Manuel de Céspedes proclaim Cuban independence.

1869年4月10日：An assembly of rebels against Spanish rule adopts the Guáimaro Constitution, which remains nominally in effect until the end of the Ten Years' War. The Republic of Cuba in Arms begins, officially installing Carlos Manuel de Céspedes as the first President of the Republic in Arms.
1870年：The Massacre of San Juan de Wilson occurs.
links: Massacre of San Juan de Wilson

items.text: 1873年10月27日：Salvador Cisneros Betancourt is installed as President of the Republic in Arms, following the ouster of Carlos Manuel de Céspedes.
1875年7月：Juan Bautista Spotorno becomes President of the Republic in Arms.
1876年3月29日：Tomás Estrada Palma becomes President of the Republic in Arms.
1877年：Tomás Estrada Palma is captured and imprisoned by the Spanish, forcing the appointment of Francisco Javier de Céspedes as President of the Republic in Arms.
1877年12月13日：Vicente García González becomes President of the Republic in Arms
1878年2月10日：The Pact of Zanjón, promising the end of slavery in Cuba, ends the Ten Years' War.
1878年3月15日：At the "Protest of Baraguá," a group of Cubans reject the Pact of Zanjón, particularly the fact that it did not abolish slavery in Cuba.

1878年3月16日：Signing of the Baraguá Constitution, installing Manuel de Jesús Calvar as President of the provisional government of the Republic in Arms, and Calixto García as the Commanding General of the Army.
1878年5月21日：The provisional government of the Republic in Arms officially dissolves.
1879年8月：A second uprising, The Little War, engineered by Antonio Maceo and Calixto García, begins.
1880年：The Little War ends.
1886年10月7日：Slavery is abolished in Cuba.
1889年3月3日：Conrado Walter Massaguer is born in Cárdenas, Cuba
1892年1月5日：José Julián Martí y Pérez forms the Cuban Revolutionary party.
1895年2月24日："Grito de Baire." The Cuban War of Independence begins, under the leadership of José Martí and General Máximo Gómez.
1895年3月24日：The Montecristi Manifesto is issued by José Martí
1895年3月29日：Antonio Maceo returns from exile
1895年4月10日：José Martí and Máximo Gómez Baez return to Cuba
1895年5月19日：José Martí is killed by Spanish troops at the Battle of Dos Ríos.
1895年8月：First Eastern Campaign begins, led by Generalissimo Máximo Gómez and Antonio Maceo
1895年9月：Spanish Captain-General Arsenio Martínez Campos is defeated at Peralejo and leaves Cuba in January 1896.
1895年9月：Cuban Junta forms in New York City
1895年9月16日：Jimaguayú Constitution is signed, re-establishing the Cuban Republic in Arms, establishing a Government Council, and re-installing Salvador Cisneros Betancourt as President.
1896年2月16日：Spanish general Valeriano Weyler y Nicolau institutes the policy of Reconcentration (reconcentración) to control Cuban insurgents.
1896年2月28日：The U.S. Senate recognizes Cuban belligerency status
1896年：During the First Eastern Campaign, Cuban rebels led by Antonio Maceo and Máximo Gómez execute a successful invasion along the length of the island.
1896年8月9日：The United Kingdom foils Spanish attempt to organize European support for Spanish policies in Cuba
1896年12月7日：Antonio Maceo is killed by Spanish forces.
1897年：Calixto Garcia takes a series of strategic fort complexes in the East, leaving the Spanish confined to coastal cities there.
1897年：Miguel Angiolillo assassinates Spanish Prime Minister Antonio Cánovas del Castillo at Santa Agueda, Spain. Práxides Mateo Sagasta becomes prime minister of Spain.
1897年10月：La Yaya Assembly convenes, drafting the La Yaya Constitution.
1897年10月30日：La Yaya Assembly elects Bartolomé Masó as President of the Republic in Arms, and Domingo Méndez Capote as his Vice President.
1897年10月31日：Captain General Ramón Blanco y Erenas replaces General Valeriano Weyler as governor-general of Cuba.
links: Ramón Blanco, 1st Marquess of Peña Plata

items.text: 1898年1月1日：Spain grants limited autonomy to Cuba
1898年2月12日：General Máximo Gómez issues a call to various Cuban autonomist groups for formation of a united effort against Spain.
1898年2月15日：The battleship USS Maine explodes and sinks while anchored in Havana harbor.
1898年3月13日：General Máximo Gómez repels the Spanish attack at Majagua, Cuba.
1898年3月20日：Máximo Gómez rejects an offer of Spanish Captain General Ramón Blanco of an alliance of the Cuban Liberation Army and the Spanish forces against a United States invasion.
links: Ramón Blanco, 1st Marquess of Peña Plata

items.text: 1898年4月2日：Cuban revolutionaries under Colonel J.P. Quijano defeat Spanish forces at Chambas
1898年4月10日：Spanish Governor General Blanco in Cuba suspends hostilities

1898年4月15日：The commanders of Spanish forces, under Captain General Ramón Blanco call a council of war in Havana. Only Western commanders arrive - Eastern commanders are currently engaged in combat with the Mambises.
1898年4月21日：De-Facto state of war between the United States and Spain.
1898年4月21日：Spain mines Guantanamo Bay
1898年4月25日：Spanish–American War officially begins with formal declarations of war
1898年4月30日：Blanco resumes hostilities with Cuban Liberation Army
1898年6月23日：The Rough Riders land in Cuba, led by Leonard Wood and Theodore Roosevelt.
1898年7月16日：Cuban forces led by General Calixto García defeat the Spanish in Santiago de Cuba.
1898年7月17日：Spanish General Toral surrenders to U.S. General William Shafter. Cuban commanders are excluded from the surrender negotiations at the express insistence of American authorities.

1898年8月12日：The Peace Protocol is signed in Washington between U.S. Secretary of State William R. Day and French Ambassador Jules Cambon, representing Spain. Cuban representatives are again absent and denied any observer status due to the U.S. government’s refusal to recognize the Republic in Arms or the legitimacy of the Cuban Liberation Army.
1898年10月20日：Provisional Constitution created in Santiago de Cuba by U.S. military governor General Leonard Wood
1898年10月24日：The Assembly of Representatives of Santa Cruz del Sur is convened in Santa Cruz del Sur seeking to re-insert Cuban sovereignty of the island. This Assembly disbands shortly after.
1898年11月10日：The Assembly of Representatives of the Cuban Revolution appoints Rafael María Portuondo Tamayo as President of the Executive Council.
1898年12月10日：The Treaty of Paris between Spain and the U.S. ends the Spanish–American War. Spain relinquishes sovereignty over Cuba.
1899年1月1日：The Spanish colonial government withdraws and the last captain General Alfonso Jimenez Castellano hands over power to the North American Military Governor, General John Ruller Brooke.
1899年4月4日：José Lacret Morlot succeeded Portuondo Tamayo as President of the Executive Council.
1901年3月5日：The U.S. Platt Amendment stipulates the conditions for the withdrawal of U.S. troops.
1901年6月12日：The Constitutional Convention adopts the 1901 Constitution in its final form, including the provisions of the Platt Amendment.
1902年5月20日：The Cuban Republic is established under the 1901 Constitution. Tomás Estrada Palma takes office as president.
1904年8月28日：Abril Lamarque is born in Banes, Cuba
1906年9月29日：Under attack from defeated political rivals, President Tomás Estrada Palma seeks U.S. intervention and U.S. troops reoccupy Cuba under Provisional Governor William Howard Taft.
1906年10月13日：Charles Magoon becomes Provisional Governor of Cuba
1908年5月10日：Revista Bohemia publishes its first issue, but shuts down operations only a few issues later.
1908年7月31日：Miguel Ángel Quevedo is born in Havana.
1909年1月28日：U.S. occupation ends. José Miguel Gómez of the Liberal Party becomes president.
1910年5月7日：Revista Bohemia re-establishes operations.
1912年：The Gómez government suppresses the Negro Rebellion, a revolt on the part of Afro-Cubans.
1913年5月20日：The presidency of Mario García Menocal begins.
1914年2月20日：Cuban Scouting Movement begins in the lobby of Revista Bohemia.

1917年4月7日：Cuba enters World War I on the side of the Allies. Upon Menocal's reelection, José Miguel Gómez and other Liberals launch a revolt known as the Chambelona War. The U.S. intervenes on behalf of Menocal's government.
1920年11月1日：The Dance of the Millions suddenly collapses, causing the follow-on collapse of the Cuban sugar market, and the crash of the Cuban economy.
1921年5月20日：Alfredo Zayas becomes president.
1923年3月18日：Protest of the Thirteen
1925年：Abril Lamarque begins distributing Monguito, which was the first comic strip in the world created and written entirely in the Spanish language
1925年3月23日：By the Hay-Quesada Treaty, the U.S. recognizes Cuban sovereignty over the Isle of Pines.
1925年5月20日：Gerardo Machado becomes president.
1926年8月13日：Fidel Castro is born in the province of Holguín.
1928年1月10日：Julio Antonio Mella, a founder of the Communist Party in Cuba, is murdered in Mexico.
1928年6月14日：Ernesto Guevara de la Serna, known as Che Guevara, is born in Rosario, Argentina.
1930年12月：The Bacardi Building finishes construction, and opens as the headquarters for the Bacardi company.

1931年8月10日：Old Mambi warriors Carlos Mendieta and Mario García Menocal land forces at Rio Verde in an attempt to overthrow Gerardo Machado. They are defeated by 14 August in military operations that include the first use of military aviation in Cuba.
1933年7月27日：The Cuban General Strike of 1933 begins

1933年8月12日：Gerardo Machado is forced to leave Cuba in the face of violent opposition on the part of ABC and Antonio Guiteras Holmes, a general strike, and pressure from senior officers of Cuban Armed Forces and U.S. Ambassador Sumner Welles. A provisional government is established, with Carlos Manuel de Céspedes y Quesada as president.
links: Carlos Manuel de Céspedes y Quesada

items.text: 1933年9月4日：A group of military officers that includes Fulgencio Batista launches the Sergeants' Revolt and topples the provisional government.
1933年9月5日：The five-day, five-man coalition government called the Pentarchy of 1933 lasted through 9 Sept..
1933年9月10日：Ramón Grau (one of the pentarchy) becomes president and continues the One Hundred Days Government.
1933年10月2日：Enlisted men and sergeants loyal to Batista, joined by radical elements, force Army Officers from the Hotel Nacional in heavy fighting.
links: Battle of the Hotel Nacional of Cuba

items.text: 1933年11月9日：Blas Hernández, his followers, and some ABC members make a stand in old Atarés Castle. They are defeated by Batista loyalists. Hernández surrenders and is murdered.
1934年1月15日：The One Hundred Days Government ends; Carlos Hevia serves briefly as president.
1934年1月18日：Manuel Márquez Sterling is president for a few hours, followed by Carlos Mendieta.
1934年6月16日：ABC holds a demonstration at the Havana festival and its march is attacked by radical forces, including those of Antonio Guiteras.
1935年5月8日：Leading radical Antonio Guiteras is betrayed and dies fighting Batista forces.
1938年9月：The Communist party is legalized again.
1940年10月10日：The 1940 Constitution, signed by the members of the Constitutional Assembly on 1 July, takes effect. It is suspended in 1952.
1941年：Cuba declares war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.
1942年9月5日：Heinz Lüning is captured and arrested by Captain Mariano Faget, Director of the Enemy Activities Investigation Service (SIAE).
1942年11月10日：Heinz Lüning is executed by the Cuban government. He is the only German spy executed in all of Latin America during World War II.
1943年：The Soviet Union opens an embassy in Havana. Its first ambassador is Andrei Gromyko.
1951年8月5日：Eduardo Chibás, leader of the Ortodoxo party and mentor of Fidel Castro, commits suicide during a live radio broadcast.
1952年3月10日：Former president Batista, supported by the army, seizes power once more. Ex-president Prío exiled to Miami, US.
1953年7月26日：Some 160 revolutionaries under the command of Fidel Castro launch an attack on the Moncada barracks in Santiago de Cuba and Cespedes barracks in Bayamo
1953年10月16日：On trial for his role in the attack on the Moncada barracks, Fidel Castro defends himself with a speech later published as "History Will Absolve Me".
1954年9月：Che Guevara arrives in Mexico City.
1954年11月：Batista is elected constitutional president unopposed.
1955年5月：Batista issues an amnesty that frees Fidel and other members of his movement from prison.
1955年6月：Brothers Fidel and Raúl Castro are introduced to Che Guevara in Mexico City.
1956年4月29日：Autentico Assault on Goicuria Barracks in Matanzas fails.
1956年11月：The yacht Granma sets out from Mexico to Cuba with 82 men on board, including Fidel Castro, Raúl Castro, Che Guevara and Camilo Cienfuegos.
1956年12月2日：The Granma lands in Oriente Province.
1957年1月17日：Castro's guerrillas score their first success by sacking an army outpost on the south coast, and start gaining followers in both Cuba and abroad.
1957年3月13日：University students mount an attack on the Presidential Palace in Havana. Batista forewarned. Attackers mostly killed, others flee and are betrayed.
1957年5月28日：Castro's 26 July movement, reinforced by militia led by Frank Pais, overwhelm an army post in El Uvero.
1957年7月19日：Calixto Sánchez Whyte leads a landing from the boat Corinthia at Cabonico in north Oriente of Auténtico and are defeated.
1957年7月30日：Local police kill Frank País, a leader of the 26 July movement, in the streets of Santiago de Cuba.
1957年9月5日：Forces loyal to Batista crush a naval revolt at Cayo Loco Naval Base in Cienfuegos.
1958年2月：Raúl Castro takes leadership of about 500 pre-existing Escopeteros guerrillas and opens a front in the Sierra de Cristal on Oriente's north coast.
1958年3月13日：U.S. suspends shipments of arms to Batista's forces.
1958年3月17日：Castro calls for a general revolt.
1958年4月9日：A general strike, organized by the 26 July movement, is partially observed.

1958年5月：Batista sends an army of 10,000 into the Sierra Maestra to destroy Castro's 300 armed guerrillas and their supporters. By August, the rebels had defeated the army's advance and captured a huge amount of weaponry.
1958年：Thirty key positions at Guisa are taken. In the following month most cities in Oriente fall to rebel hands.
1958年12月：Guevara, William Alexander Morgan, and forces of the Directorio Revolucionario 13 de Marzo, an organization of university students, attack Santa Clara.
1958年12月28日：Rebel forces take Santa Clara.
1958年12月31日：Camilo Cienfuegos leads revolutionary guerrillas to victory in Yaguajay; Huber Matos enters Santiago.

1959年1月1日：President Batista resigns and flees the country. Fidel Castro's column enters Santiago de Cuba. The revolutionaries starts military tribunals of captured military, with some receiving the death penalty. Various urban rebels, mainly associated with Directorio, seize Havana Cuban revolutionaries call a General Strike to ensure governmental control
1959年1月2日：Guevara and Camilo Cienfuegos arrive in Havana.
1959年1月5日：Manuel Urrutia named President of Cuba
1959年1月8日：Fidel Castro arrives at Havana, speaks to crowds at Camp Columbia.
1959年2月16日：Fidel Castro becomes Premier of Cuba.
1959年3月：Fabio Grobart is present at a series of meetings with Castro brothers, Guevara and Valdes at Cojimar
1959年4月20日：Fidel Castro speaks at Princeton University, New Jersey.

1959年5月17日：The Cuban government enacts the Agrarian Reform Law, seizing large (mostly corporate and foreign) holdings of agricultural land and redistributing it to smaller land owners. The new holdings are limited to 1,000 acres (4.0 km2).
1959年7月17日：Osvaldo Dorticós Torrado becomes President of Cuba, replacing Manuel Urrutia, who is forced to resign by Fidel Castro. Dorticós serves until 2 December 1976
1959年10月28日：Plane carrying Camilo Cienfuegos disappears during a night flight from Camagüey to Havana. He is presumed dead.
1959年12月11日：Trial of revolutionary Huber Matos begins. Matos is found guilty of "treason and sedition".
1960年3月4日：The French freighter La Coubre explodes while unloading in Havana harbor, and Fidel Castro calls it sabotage by the U.S. on 5 March.
1960年3月17日：U.S. President Dwight Eisenhower orders CIA director Allen Dulles to train Cuban exiles for a covert invasion of Cuba.

1960年4月6日：U.S. Secretary of State Lester Mallory outlines objectives of embargo in a memo: "...inconspicuous as possible, makes the greatest inroads in denying money and supplies to Cuba, to decrease monetary and real wages, to bring about hunger, desperation and overthrow of government."
1960年7月5日：All U.S. businesses and commercial property in Cuba are nationalized at the direction of the Cuban government.
1960年10月19日：U.S. imposes embargo prohibiting all exports to Cuba except foodstuffs and medical supplies.
1960年10月31日：Cuban nationalization of all U.S. property in Cuba is completed.

1960年12月26日：Operation Peter Pan (Operación Pedro Pan) begins, an operation transporting to the U.S. 14,000 children of parents opposed to the new government. The scheme continues until U.S. airports are closed to Cuban flights during 1962.
1961年：U.S. trade embargo on Cuba.
1961年1月1日：Cuban government initiates national literacy scheme.
1961年3月：Former rebel comandante Humberto Sorí Marin and Catholic leaders shot.
1961年4月15日：Bay of Pigs invasion.
1961年4月18日：Nikita Khrushchev writes to John F. Kennedy to end U.S. aggression against Cuba.
1962年1月31日：Cuba expelled from the Organization of American States.
1962年8月17日：Central Intelligence Agency Director John McCone suggests that the Soviet Union is constructing offensive missile installations in Cuba.

1962年8月29日：At a news conference, U.S. President John F. Kennedy tells reporters: "I'm not for invading Cuba at this time... an action like that... could lead to very serious consequences for many people."
1962年8月31日：President Kennedy is informed that the 29 August U-2 mission confirms the presence of surface-to-air missile batteries in Cuba.
1962年11月21日：U.S. ends Cuban blockade, satisfied that all bases are removed and Soviet jets will leave the island by 20 December.
1963年10月：2nd Agrarian reform.
1963年11月：Compulsory military service introduced.
1964年：OAS enforce embargo against Cuba.
1965年9月28日：Fidel announces Cubans can emigrate, which launches the Camarioca boatlift and airlift.
1965年10月3日：The Integrated Revolutionary Organizations (ORI) become the governing Communist Party of Cuba.
1965年10月18日：Conrado Walter Massaguer dies in Havana
1967年10月9日：Che Guevara executed in La Higuera, Bolivia.
1968年3月：All private bars and restaurants are finally closed down.
1972年：Cuba becomes a member of the Council for Mutual Economic Assistance (COMECON).
1974年：Maternity leave bill introduced by the Cuban government.
1975年：The Soviet Union engages in a massive airlift of Cuban forces into Angola.
1975年：The Family Code bill establishes the official goal of equal participation in the home.
1975年7月：OAS lifts the trade embargo and other sanctions.
1976年3月：South African forces backing the UNITA rebel force withdraw from Angola. It is regarded as a victory for Cuban forces.
1976年2月15日：A referendum endorses the 1976 Constitution, which institutionalizes the principles of the Cuban Revolution. It takes effect of 24 February.

1976年10月6日：Two time bombs destroy Cubana Flight 455 departing from Barbados, via Trinidad, to Cuba. Evidence implicated several CIA-linked anti-Castro Cuban exiles and members of the Venezuelan secret police DISIP.
1976年12月2日：Fidel Castro becomes President of Cuba.
1977年1月1日：Political and administrative division divides Cuba into fourteen provinces, 168 municipalities and the special municipality of Isla de la Juventud.
1977年5月：Fifty Cuban military personnel sent to Ethiopia.
1979年10月21日：Huber Matos is released from prison after serving out his full term.
1980年：The Mariel Boatlift. Cuban authorities allow up to 125,000 people to depart Cuba by boat from Mariel harbor for the U.S. The Cuban and U.S. governments agree to halt the exodus in October.
1980年6月7日：U.S. President Jimmy Carter orders the U.S. Justice Department to expel any Cubans who committed "serious crimes" in Cuba.
1983年10月25日：United States invades the island of Grenada and clash with Cuban troops.
1984年：Cuba reduces its troop strength in Ethiopia to approximately 3,000 from 12,000.
1987年：Law #62 on the Penal Code introduced recognising discrimination based on any reason and the violation of the right of equality as a crime.
1989年7月12日：Prominent general in the Cuban armed forces Arnaldo Ochoa is executed after allegations of involvement in drug smuggling.
1989年9月17日：The last Cuban troops leave Ethiopia.
1990年3月23日：The U.S. launches TV Marti.
1991年5月：Cuba removed all troops from Angola.

1991年12月26日：Special Period: The Soviet Union (Cuba's closest economic partner) formally dissolved, leading to a full loss of economic and military aid, causing a prolonged economic crisis through the 1990s.
1992年7月：The National Assembly of Cuba passes the Constitutional Reform Law allowing for direct elections to the assembly by the Cuban people every five years.
1993年11月6日：The Cuban government opens state enterprises to private investment.
1994年8月5日：Maleconazo: Protests break out in Havana due to economic hardships amidst the Special Period.
1996年2月：Cuban authorities arrest or detain at least 150 dissidents, marking the most widespread crackdown on opposition groups since the early 1960s.
1996年2月24日：Cuban fighter jets shoot down two US-registered civilian aircraft over international waters, killing four men.
1996年3月12日：In the U.S., the Helms-Burton Act extends the U.S. embargo against Cuba to foreign companies.
1998年1月21日：Pope John Paul II becomes the first Pope to visit the island.
1999年：Christian anti-abortion activist Oscar Elías Biscet is detained by Cuban police for organizing meetings in Havana and Matanzas.
1999年11月5日：Six-year/old Elián González is found clinging to an inner tube in the Straits of Florida.
2000年12月14日：Russian President Vladimir Putin visits Cuba and signs accords aimed at boosting bilateral ties.
2001年6月23日：Fidel Castro almost faints following a televised speech.
2002年1月：Russia's last military base in Cuba, at Lourdes, closes.
2002年5月6日：U.S. Under Secretary of State John R. Bolton accuses Cuba of trying to develop biological weapons, adding the country to Washington's list of "axis of evil" countries.
2002年5月12日：Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter visits Cuba. He praises the Varela project and criticizes the U.S. embargo.
2003年4月：The Cuban government arrests 78 writers and dissidents, blaming U.S. provocation and interference from James Cason, the chief of the United States Interests Section in Havana.
links: United States Interests Section in Havana

items.text: 2005年5月20日：Around 200 dissidents hold a public meeting, which its organizers call the first such gathering since the 1959 revolution.
2005年7月7日：Hurricane Dennis causes widespread destruction in Cuba and leaves 16 people dead.
2006年7月31日：Raúl Castro assumes the duties of president of the State Council while Fidel Castro recovers from an emergency operation.
2008年2月19日：Fidel Castro resigns as President of the Council of State.
links: List of heads of state of Cuba

items.text: 2008年2月24日：Raúl is elected president of the State Council by the National Assembly.
2011年4月19日：Raúl Castro succeeds Fidel Castro as First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba, making him the most powerful person in Cuba.
links: First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba

items.text: 2014年12月17日：Cuban Thaw: U.S. President Barack Obama and Raúl Castro re-establish diplomatic ties between the two countries.
2016年3月20日：U.S. President Barack Obama begins a three-day visit to Cuba.
2016年11月25日：The death of Fidel Castro is announced. "The commander in chief of the Cuban revolution died at 22:29 hours this evening [03:29 GMT 25 November]."
2017年6月16日：U.S. President Donald Trump cancels the previous administration's diplomatic agreements with Cuba, ending the Cuban Thaw.
2020年3月11日：Cuba confirms its first case of COVID-19.
2021年4月19日：Miguel Díaz-Canel succeeds Raul Castro as First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba, becoming the first non-Castro leader of the country since the Cuban Revolution.
links: First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba

items.text: 2021年：The largest protest against the Cuban communist government since 1959 breaks out due to shortages amidst the severe crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic, before being suppressed by the government.
2022年9月25日：Cuba holds a referendum on amending the Family Code of the Constitution, legalizing same-sex marriage and adoption. The referendum is passed with 66.85% of votes in favor.
1492年：Christopher Columbus came to the first Spanish community near Cap-Haïtien.
1501年：The first Africans were brought to Hispaniola as people in the U.S.
1503年：Queen Anacaona, leader of the last Taino kingdom in the Hispaniola, is executed by Spanish governor.
1511年：The Dioceses of Santo Domingo and Concepción de la Vega was founded
1518年：Ferdinand II of Aragon officially established Spain's African slave trade.
1528年：Don Sebastián Ramirez de Fuente became the first Catholic bishop of the island.
1625年：French, Dutch and English filibusters, pirates and privateers occupied Tortuga Island and were repeatedly expelled by the Spaniards.
1670年：The city of Cap-Francais was founded on the north coast by French settlers.
1670年：Louis XIV of France authorized the African slave trade in Saint-Dominque.
1685年：Louis XIV enacted the Code Noir, regulating slavery in Saint-Domingue and the rest of the French colonial empire.
1697年：Spain signed the Treaty of Ryswick, under whose terms she ceded the western third of Hispaniola to France.
1749年：The city of Port-au-Prince was founded by Charles Burnier, Marquis of Larnage and named the capital of Saint-Domingue.
1751年：Slave rebellions in northern Saint-Domingue, led by François Mackandal, began.
1758年：Mackandal was captured and publicly executed in Cap-Français.
1778年：Volunteer Haitian slaves, led by French admiral Count d'Estaing, left for Savannah, Georgia to participate in the unsuccessful Siege of Savannah during the American Revolutionary War.
1791年2月25日：Vincent Ogé and Jean-Baptiste Chavannes, proponents of equal rights for free blacks and mulattos and leaders of an armed rebellion, were publicly executed in Cap-Français.
1791年8月7日：The Conseil des Représentants de la Commune was founded by affranchis to demand equal rights. Pinchinat was named president of the council.
1791年8月14日：Haitian Revolution: Dutty Boukman and Cécile Fatiman held a Vodou ceremony in Bois-Caïman, where hundreds of slaves vowed to die for liberty.
1791年8月21日：Major slave revolt begins, led by Dutty Boukman and his lieutenants: Jean François, Georges Biassou, and Jeannot.
1791年8月25日：Rebel attack on Cap Francais is repulsed by the cannons and militia of the white colonists.
1791年9月24日：The Concordat de Damiens was signed, granting political rights to the affranchis.
1791年11月：The First Civil Commission, comprising Roume, Mirbeck, and Saint-Léger, arrived in Cap-Français to restore order.
1791年11月7日：Dutty Boukman killed in a counter attack by colonial forces.
1792年4月4日：France's Legislative Assembly voted to give full citizenship and equal rights to all free people of color.
1792年9月18日：The Second Civil Commission, comprising Léger-Félicité Sonthonax, Étienne Polverel and Ailhaud, arrived in Cap-Français to execute the law of 4 April.
1793年4月12日：A force led by the Second Civil Commission and affranchis defeated white colonists in a fight to enforce the law of 4 April.
1793年4月12日：Toussaint Louverture offered his services as a military commander to the Spanish.
1793年6月20日：French colonial forces, under the authority of the Second Civil Commission, put down a revolt led by François-Thomas Galbaud du Fort.
1793年6月20日：Henri Christophe was promoted to the captaincy of the French colonial forces, but soon removed when accused of adultery.
1793年6月20日：British troops landed in Saint-Domingue.
1793年6月：Toussaint, fighting for Spain, captured the city of Dondon.
1793年8月13日：Toussaint defeated the French general Desfourneaux at Ennery.

1793年8月29日：Sonthonax, without prior approval from the French government, declared the abolition of slavery by decree in northern Saint-Domingue. Polverel soon after does the same for the southern part of Saint-Domingue.
1793年12月6日：Toussaint captured Gonaïves for Spain.
1794年2月4日：The French National Convention declared the abolition of slavery in all French colonies, so making the abolition of slavery legal and applying to all of France and its colonies.
1794年5月：Toussaint left the Spanish and joined the French forces.
1794年6月1日：The British captured Port-au-Prince from Colonel Montbrun of France.
1794年10月21日：Toussaint captured the cities of Saint-Michel and Saint-Raphaël for the French.
1795年10月13日：Toussaint captured the city of Dondon a second time, this time for France.
1795年10月14日：The Treaty of Bâle was ratified, ending Spain's involvement in the conflict and surrendering the eastern part of Hispaniola to France.
1796年3月30日：Toussaint rescued French commander Laveaux from mulatto rebel Villatte; Laveaux appointed Toussaint the Lieutenant-Governor of Saint-Domingue.
links: Étienne Maynaud de Bizefranc de Laveaux

items.text: 1796年5月11日：The Third Civil Commission, comprising Sonthonax, Roume, Giraud, Leblanc, and Julien Raymond, arrived in Saint-Domingue to establish diplomatic relations between France and the colony.
1797年5月1日：Sonthonax appointed Toussaint the commander-in-chief of the French colonial forces.
1798年4月20日：General Hédouville arrived in Cap-Français on the orders of the French government in order to oppose the ambition of Toussaint Louverture.
1798年8月31日：British general Maitland agreed to evacuate Môle Saint-Nicolas in a treaty signed with Toussaint.

1799年1月12日：The generals of the colony – Toussaint, André Rigaud, Bauvais, and Laplume – met in Port-au-Prince and named Toussaint the lead commander. Rigaud surrendered control of the southern cities of Léogâne, Grand-Goâve, Petit-Goâve, and Miragoâne.
1801年1月27日：Toussaint invaded the eastern part of Hispaniola and captured Santo Domingo, declaring freedom for all slaves and appointing a ten-member Central Assembly to issue a constitution.
1801年7月8日：The Constitution of 1801 was promulgated, under which Toussaint Louverture
1802年1月29日：A French expeditionary force, sent by Napoleon Bonaparte and led by his brother-in-law Charles Leclerc, arrived in Samana Bay.
1802年2月1日：French vessels arrived at Cap-Français.
1802年2月4日：Henri Christophe burned Cap-Français to resist the French troops.
1802年2月23日：Battle of Ravine-à-Couleuvres: French forces defeated Toussaint.
1802年：Battle of Crête-à-Pierrot: The battle ended with a French victory over Jean-Jacques Dessalines.
1802年5月6日：Toussaint arrived in Cap-Français to recognize Leclerc's authority in return for an amnesty for him and his remaining generals.
1802年6月7日：Toussaint was arrested by General Leclerc and shipped to France, where he was imprisoned.
1802年10月13日：Dessalines, now Commander-in-Chief of the revolutionary forces, met with Alexandre Pétion in Haut-du-Cap to plan further military action.
1802年11月1日：Commander of the French forces General Leclerc died of yellow fever. He was succeeded by Donatien-Marie-Joseph de Vimeur, vicomte de Rochambeau.
links: Donatien-Marie-Joseph de Vimeur, vicomte de Rochambeau

items.text: 1803年4月7日：Toussaint died in the French prison of Fort de Joux.
1803年5月18日：The flag of Haiti was created during a meeting between Dessalines and Pétion in l'Arcahaie and sewn by Catherine Flon.
1803年11月18日：Battle of Vertières: During the last major battle of the revolution, Haitian forces under Dessalines and Pétion defeated the French.
1803年11月19日：French general Rochambeau signs a document of surrender and agrees to evacuate French troops from Saint-Domingue; Rochambeau is later given as a prisoner to the British
1803年11月29日：Dessalines' army arrives in Cap-Français; Christophe and Clerveaux issue a preliminary declaration of independence
1803年12月4日：French forces surrender Môle Saint-Nicolas to Dessalines' army, officially ending French presence on the island
1804年1月1日：Dessalines, in Gonaïves, declares Haiti an independent nation and becomes Governor-General

1804年2月：On the order of Dessalines, the 1804 Haiti Massacre of the French subjects in Haiti; As retaliation for the Re-conquest and Leclerc massacres of lower caste. the massacre is finally stopped 22 April.
1804年9月22日：Dessalines proclaims himself Emperor of Haiti
1804年10月6日：Dessalines becomes Emperor Jacques I in a coronation ceremony at Cap-Français
1805年5月20日：Dessalines formulates the first constitution of Haiti as an independent country, the Imperial Constitution of 1805
1806年10月17日：Dessalines is assassinated at Pont-Rouge by disaffected leaders of his administration

1806年12月27日：During a meeting at a cathedral in Port-au-Prince, the Constituent Assembly creates a new constitution and appoints Henri Christophe to a four-year term as President of the Republic of Haiti
1807年1月1日：The Battle of Sibert ends with the division of Haiti into the southern Republic of Haiti under Alexandre Pétion and the northern State of Haiti under Christophe

1807年2月17日：Henri Christophe names himself President of the State of Haiti; a state council (7 generals and 2 civilians) appointed by Christophe meets in Cap-Haïtien and votes the Constitutional Act of Haiti
1807年3月9日：Pétion is elected President of the Republic of Haiti by the Constituent Assembly under the Constitution of 1806

1809年：Napoleon sends a delegation to negotiate France's recognition of Haitian independence; Pétion meets with a French delegate, Dauxion-Lavaysse, and agrees to an indemnity payable to dispossessed French planters
1811年3月9日：Pétion is elected to a second four-year term as President of the Republic of Haiti
1811年3月26日：Christophe proclaims himself King Henri I of the northern Haitian state, now known as the Kingdom of Haiti
1811年5月28日：The Kingdom of Haiti promulgates the Royal Constitution of Henri I
1811年6月2日：Christophe is crowned as King Henri I in Cap-Haïtien
1812年2月24日：The Kingdom of Haiti establishes a civil code, the Henri Code
1814年11月：Christophe refuses to negotiate with French delegate Franco de Medina concerning France's recognition of Haitian independence
1816年6月2日：Pétion promulgates the Republican Constitution
1816年10月8日：Louis XVIII of France sends another delegation to negotiate France's recognition of Haitian independence; Pétion cuts off negotiation, Christophe declines to meet the delegates
1818年3月29日：Pétion, President of the Republic of Haiti, dies of fever
1818年3月30日：Jean-Pierre Boyer, Chief of the Presidential Guard, is appointed President-for-Life of the Republic of Haiti
1820年10月8日：Christophe, King of the northern Haitian state, commits suicide
1820年10月26日：Boyer promulgates the Republican Constitution in Christophe's northern state; northern and southern Haiti are unified
1822年2月9日：Boyer arrives in Santo Domingo and declares control over the entire island of Hispaniola
1825年4月17日：King Charles X of France signs an ordinance which conditionally recognizes the independence of Haiti and imposes a 150 million franc indemnity on the Haitian government
1825年7月3日：A squadron of French ships arrives in Haiti to deliver the news of Charles X's ordinance of 17 April to President Boyer
1831年9月22日：The city of Pétion-Ville, a suburb of Port-au-Prince named for Alexandre Pétion, is founded by Boyer
1838年：Haiti's remaining debt to France, 120 million francs, is reduced to 60 million francs
1842年5月7日：An earthquake strikes northern Haiti, destroying the city of Cap-Haïtien
1843年3月13日：President Boyer is overthrown and flees to Paris in exile
1843年9月18日：The Constituent Assembly begins formulating the Constitution of 1843; it will take more than three months to finish
1843年12月31日：The Constitution of 1843 is released and Charles Riviere-Hérard is appointed President of Haiti
1844年2月28日：The Dominican Republic declares its independence from Haiti
1844年4月4日：The Piquets, peasants of southern Haiti led by Jean-Jacques Acaau, revolt against the government
1844年5月3日：The Piquets force Riviere-Hérard into exile; Philippe Guerrier is appointed President of Haiti
1845年4月15日：President Guerrier dies in office; the State Council appoints Jean-Louis Pierrot President of Haiti
1846年3月1日：President Pierrot is overthrown; Jean-Baptiste Riché becomes President of Haiti
1847年：Haitian historian Thomas Madiou publishes the first volume of his seminal work Histoire d'Haïti ("History of Haiti")
1847年2月27日：President Riché dies in office
1847年3月1日：Faustin Élie Soulouque is elected President of Haiti
1852年4月18日：President Faustin Soulouque is crowned Emperor Faustin I of Haiti
1858年12月：Forces led by Fabre Geffrard defeat Emperor Faustin's Imperial Army
1859年1月13日：Fabre Geffrard is elected President of Haiti
1860年3月28日：Haiti and the Vatican sign an agreement which divides Haiti into five dioceses
1862年：The United States recognizes Haiti
1862年12月15日：Rhum Barbancourt is first produced
1865年：Céligny Ardouin's eleven-volume work on the history of Haiti, Essais sur l'Histoire d'Haïti, is published
1867年：President Geffrard is forced to flee the country
1867年：Sylvain Salnave is elected President of Haiti
1867年：The Constitution of 1867 is voted
1869年：The National Assembly elects Nissage Saget to a four-year term as President of Haiti after the overthrow of Salnave
1870年：Haitian writer Demesvar Delorme publishes the essay "Les Théoriciens au Pouvoir", which maintains that political power should be in the hands of the intellectual elite
1874年：Saget relinquishes the Presidency; the Constituent Assembly elects Michel Domingue as President
1874年：President Domingue promulgates the Constitution of 1874
1875年：President Domingue signs a treaty of peace and friendship with the Dominican Republic
1876年：President Domingue is overthrown; the Constituent Assembly elects Pierre Théoma Boisrond-Canal to a four-year term as President
1879年：The Constituent Assembly elects Lysius Salomon as president; President Salomon would institute many reforms and pay off Haiti's remaining debt to France for independence
1880年：The National Bank of Haiti (or Haitian Central Bank) is founded by President Salomon
1882年：Port-au-Prince and Haiti are dedicated to Our Lady of Perpetual Help during a mass in Bel Air
1883年：Haitian poet Oswald Durand composes his most famous work, "Choucoune"
1884年：Haitian writer Louis-Joseph Janvier publishes the article "L'Egalité des Races", which proclaims the equality of the races
1885年：Haitian writer Anténor Firmin publishes the book De l'Égalité des Races Humaines, which proclaims the equality of the races
1888年：President Salomon is overthrown; the Constituent Assembly installs a provisional government
1888年：The Constituent Assembly elects François Denys Légitime to the presidency
1889年：President Légitime is overthrown; the Constituent Assembly installs a provisional government
1889年：The Constituent Assembly elects Florvil Hyppolite to a seven-year term as president

1893年：Haitian writer Hannibal Price publishes De la Réhabilitation de la Race Noire par la République d'Haïti ("On the Rehabilitation of the Black Race by the Republic of Haiti") in response to Spenser St. John's Hayti or the Black Republic
1896年：President Hyppolite dies of a heart attack; Tirésias Simon Sam is elected to a seven-year term as president
1902年：President Simon Sam resigns; Pierre Nord Alexis becomes president
1904年1月1日：Haiti celebrates 100 years of independence
1904年：The Haitian Football Federation is created
1908年：Pierre Nord Alexis withdraws from the presidency; the Constituent Assembly appoints François C. Antoine Simon president
1911年：President Antoine Simon cedes the presidency to Cincinnatus Leconte
1912年8月5日：The Haitian American Sugar Company is founded
1912年8月8日：President Leconte and 300 soldiers are killed in an explosion at the National Palace; the Constituent Assembly appoints Tancrède Auguste president
1913年：President Auguste dies during a visit to northern Haiti
1913年：Senator Michel Oreste is elected president by the Constituent Assembly
1914年：President Oreste is overthrown and succeeded by Oreste Zamor
1914年：President Zamor is overthrown and lost by Joseph Davilmar Théodore

1915年：President Théodore resigns and is succeeded by Vilbrun Guillaume Sam. Sam executed 167 political prisoners (including the previous president, Zamor) who were being held in the Port-au-Prince jail. President Sam sought refuge in the French Embassy. He was found by mulatto leaders, dragged out to the street, murdered and cut into small pieces. The parts were paraded throughout the capital.
1915年7月28日：Three thousand United States Marines, led by Admiral William B. Caperton, enter Port-au-Prince; beginning of the 19-year United States occupation of Haiti
1915年8月12日：Senator Philippe Sudré Dartiguenave is elected by the Constituent Assembly to a seven-year term as president
1919年4月12日：The Haitian government undertakes a monetary reform with the National Bank of Haiti
1919年10月31日：Charlemagne Péralte, leader of the resistance against U.S. occupation, is assassinated
1920年：Haitian writer Leon Laleau publishes his first compilation of poems, A Voix Basse
1921年1月24日：President Dartiguenave addresses United States President Warren G. Harding concerning the needs of the Haitian people
1921年4月12日：United States President Harding responds to President Dartiguenave
1922年4月10日：Louis Bornó is elected to a four-year term as president by the State Council
1922年5月15日：President Dartiguenave's term ends; Louis Bornó is sworn into office
1922年12月28日：The Central School of Agriculture (Ecole Centrale d'Agriculture) is founded in Damien
1926年：President Bornó is re-elected by the State Council and makes a diplomatic trip to the United States
1926年：Haitian writer Leon Laleau publishes his second compilation of poems, La Flèche au Cœur
1928年：Haitian writer Jean Price-Mars publishes his acclaimed novel Ainsi Parla l'Oncle ("So spoke the Uncle")
1928年：Leon Laleau publishes two more compilations of poems, Le Rayon des Jupes and Abréviations
1929年1月21日：Haiti and the Dominican Republic sign an agreement settling the border between the two countries
1930年2月28日：The Forbes Commission, sent by U.S. president Herbert Hoover to investigate Haiti's political situation, arrives in the country
1930年4月21日：Louis Eugène Roy is designated temporary president by state decree
1930年11月18日：Senator Sténio Vincent is elected to a six-year term as president
1930年12月10日：Fietta, the first Apostolic Nuncio (diplomatic representative of the Roman Catholic Church) to Haiti, arrives in Port-au-Prince
1931年：Jacques Roumain publishes his acclaimed novel Gouverneurs de la Rosée ("Masters of the Dew")
1931年8月5日：The U.S. agrees to hand over control of the Offices of Public Works, Health, Agriculture and Education to the Haitian government
1931年12月15日：The ceremony commemorating the fiftieth anniversary of the dedication of Port-au-Prince to the Virgin Mary, led by Archbishop Joseph Legouaze, began.
1931年12月17日：The anniversary ceremony ended.
1933年8月7日：The governments of Haiti and the United States sign an agreement on the withdrawal of U.S. troops from the country and the end of the U.S. occupation
1933年10月18日：President Vincent of Haiti and President Rafael Leónidas Trujillo of the Dominican Republic meet for diplomatic talks in Ouanaminthe in northeastern Haiti, near the Dominican border
1934年7月5日：President of the United States Franklin D. Roosevelt visits Cap-Haïtien
1934年8月14日：Last American forces withdraw from Haiti, ending the U.S. occupation
1934年8月21日：The flag of Haiti is raised at Casernes Dessalines, where it was lowered nineteen years earlier at the start of the U.S. occupation
1935年5月16日：A new constitution is released, reinforcing the authority of the executive branch of government and renewing President Sténio Vincent's mandate for five more years
1937年：Between 20,000 and 40,000 Haitians living in the Dominican Republic are massacred by the Dominican armed forces on the orders of President Rafael Trujillo.
1938年5月18日：The 135th anniversary of the flag of Haiti is celebrated with athletic festivities at the Champs-de-Mars in Port-au-Prince
1940年：Haiti's national library, the Bibliothèque Nationale d'Haïti is organized
1941年4月14日：Élie Lescot is elected to a five-year term as president
1941年5月15日：President Vincent's term ends; Élie Lescot takes office
1944年5月7日：The Cathedral of Cap-Haïtien is consecrated after 100 years of restoration work
1944年5月14日：The Centre d'Art is founded; it exhibits important Haitian art works
1946年：A military coup forces President Lescot to resign; the newly created Executive Military Committee appoints Dumarsais Estimé president and the 8.1 Ms Dominican Republic earthquake.
1948年2月16日：The government-owned tobacco company Régie du Tabac et des Allumettes is founded
links: Régie du Tabac et des Allumettes

items.text: 1949年12月8日：The bicentennial of Port-au-Prince's founding is celebrated; a World's Fair, the Exposition internationale du bicentenaire de Port-au-Prince, is held
links: Exposition internationale du bicentenaire de Port-au-Prince

items.text: 1950年5月10日：Dumarsais Estimé relinquishes the presidency and is replaced by a provisional government
1950年10月8日：Presidential and legislative elections are held; Colonel Paul Magloire becomes the first president of Haiti to be elected directly by the people, the Delegates, and the Senators
1950年12月6日：Paul Magloire is sworn in as president
1951年：President Magloire of Haiti and President Trujillo of the Dominican Republic meet for diplomatic talks

1951年：The Haitian Institute of Statistics (Institut Haïtien de Statistique) and the Haitian Institute of Farming and Industrial Credit (Institut Haïtien de Crédit Agricole et Industriel) are established by the government
links: Institut Haïtien de Crédit Agricole et Industriel

items.text: 1953年5月31日：Father Rémy Augustin, the first native Haitian bishop, is consecrated at the Cathedral of Port-au-Prince
1954年1月1日：A celebration commemorating the 150th anniversary of Haiti's independence from France, during which monuments to the "heroes of independence" are inaugurated in Port-au-Prince, began.
1954年1月4日：The celebration ended.
1954年10月8日：Hurricane Hazel kills an estimated 1,000 Haitians and decimates the coffee and cocoa crops, affecting the economy for years to come.
1955年1月26日：President Magloire and his wife began a trip to the United States, Canada, and Jamaica.
1955年2月17日：Magloire's trip ended.
1955年3月3日：Vice-president of the United States Richard Nixon and his wife began a visit to Haiti.
1955年3月5日：Nixon's trip ended.
1956年：President Magloire relinquishes the presidency; President of the Supreme Court Joseph Nemours Pierre-Louis becomes provisional president of Haiti
1957年：Franck Sylvain is elected President of Haiti, but is succeeded by a thirteen-member Executive Council of Government
1957年：Daniel Fignolé is elected President of Haiti, but is replaced by a Military Council of Government
1957年10月22日：Dr. François "Papa Doc" Duvalier is elected President of Haiti
1958年：Duvalier began to attack his opponents violently, driving many of them into exile.
1964年：Duvalier's reign of terror ended.

1964年：The National Assembly votes to accept the Duvalieriste Constitution, establishing Duvalier as President for Life of Haiti ("Président à vie d'Haïti") and changes the flag along with coat of arms from blue and red to black and red, with the black had symbolized the ties to Africa
1968年10月28日：François Wolf Ligondé, the first Haitian archbishop, is consecrated at the Cathedral of Port-au-Prince
1970年：Thousands of Haitians began to flee poverty and repression in Haiti by boat, often arriving in south Florida.
1971年2月：The National Assembly approves an amendment to the constitution, allowing President For Life Duvalier to name his son, Jean-Claude Duvalier, as his successor
1971年4月21日：President for Life François Duvalier dies in Port-au-Prince
1971年4月22日：Jean-Claude "Baby Doc" Duvalier succeeds his father as president for Life
1974年：The Haiti national football team participates in the FIFA World Cup for the first time
1977年8月15日：The U.S. ambassador to the United Nations commission arrives in Haiti; the commission meets with the Haitian government to discuss civil rights in Haiti
1980年5月27日：President for Life Jean-Claude Duvalier marries Michèle Bennett
1983年3月：Pope John Paul II arrives in Haiti, becoming the first Pope to visit the country
1983年8月27日：The constitution is amended, creating the post of State Minister and allowing the President to name his successor
1985年6月6日：President for Life Duvalier amends the constitution to allow the creation of the post of Prime Minister of Haiti
1985年7月：A referendum is approved by 99.48% of voters, allowing political parties to participate in the government and recognizing the Presidency for Life of Jean-Claude Duvalier
1985年7月：A constitutional amendment on the Presidency for Life is passed
1985年11月28日：Three schoolboys (Jean-Robert Cius, Daniel Israël, and Mackenson Michel) are killed during an anti-government demonstration in Gonaïves
1986年1月31日：Rumors spread through Port-au-Prince that President Duvalier has fled the country
1986年2月3日：President Duvalier and members of his cabinet visit commercial and residential areas of Port-au-Prince as a show of power

1986年2月7日：President Jean-Claude Duvalier flees Haiti for Talloires, France; the National Council of Government (Conseil National de Gouvernement, CNG) is established, led by General Henri Namphy; the Legislative Chamber and Duvalier's armed forces, Volontaire Sécurité Nationale, are dissolved
1986年2月25日：The original blue and red flag of Haiti is raised at the National Palace, replacing the black and red flag of the Duvalier regime
1986年3月：Former President of Haiti Daniel Fignolé returns to Haiti; a second version of the CNG is formed, consisting of Henri Namphy, Williams Régala, and Jacques François
1986年3月20日：More than two thousand students and public transportation drivers of Carrefour demonstrate against the CNG
1986年4月26日：Eight people are killed in an attack by armed groups on Fort-Dimanche
1986年10月19日：Forty-one people are elected to a constituent assembly to draft a new constitution, the CNG appoints twenty more constituents for a total of sixty-one
1987年3月10日：The constituent assembly presents the new constitution, written in both French and Haitian Creole, to President of the CNG Henri Namphy
1987年3月29日：The new constitution is ratified by referendum; the results of 215 voting places show an approximately 99.81% approval rate
1987年5月13日：The CNG publishes a decree electing the members of the Provisional Electoral Council (Conseil Electoral Provisoire, CEP)
1987年5月22日：The CEP proclaims itself independent from the CNG
1987年6月5日：The CEP delivers the text of the electoral law to the Minister of Justice
1987年7月：Large landowners (grandons) massacre hundreds of peasants demanding land in Jean-Rabel
1987年7月17日：During a ceremony at the Military Academy, the Armed Forces of Haiti swear allegiance to the new 1987 constitution
1987年11月29日：At the Haitian presidential election, 1987 a massacre of voters takes place; the elections are suspended and General Namphy dissolves the CEP
1987年12月10日：General Namphy sets 17 January 1988 as the new election date; the CNG elects a new Provisional Electoral Council (Conseil Electoral Provisoire, CEP)

1988年1月：Christian Democrat Leslie Manigat is elected in military-run elections boycotted by the Haitian people and most candidates. In June he is overthrown in a military coup by Gen. Henri Namphy. In September, shortly after the St Jean Bosco massacre, Namphy is overthrown by Gen. Prosper Avril.
1990年1月：President/General Prosper Avril declares a state of siege in January.
1990年3月：Rising protests convince Avril to resign. A Provisional Government led by Supreme Court Justice Ertha Pascal-Trouillot is formed.

1990年12月16日：Democratic elections take place. Father Jean-Bertrand Aristide, well known throughout the country for his support of the poor, is elected president with 67.5% of the counted popular vote. The "U.S. favorite" Marc Bazin finishes a distant second with 14.2% .
1991年1月：A coup by former Tonton Macoutes head Roger Lafontant is foiled after tens of thousands pour into the streets of the capital, surrounding the National Palace.
1991年2月7日：Aristide is sworn in as president.
1991年9月30日：A military coup deposes Aristide, who goes into exile first in Venezuela, then in the United States.
1991年：Thousands of Haitians begin to flee violence and repression in Haiti by boat. Although most are repatriated to Haiti by the U.S. government, many enter the United States as refugees.
1994年9月：The de facto military government resigns at the request of the United States in September, which then sends in troops to occupy Haiti. This occupation is sanctioned by the United Nations.
1994年10月15日：The U.S. returns Aristide as president.
1995年：The U.S. nominally hands over military authority to the United Nations but maintains effective control of the occupation. Aristide dissolves the Haitian army.
1995年12月：Former prime minister René Préval is elected president.
1996年2月7日：Aristide leaves office and is succeeded by René Préval.
2000年5月：Legislative, municipal and local elections are held. The OAS disputes how the sovereign electoral council calculates the run-offs for eight Senate seats.
2000年11月：Aristide is reelected for a second five-year term with 92% of the vote in elections boycotted by the opposition. The last UN peacekeeping forces withdraw from Haiti.

2001年：Aristide succeeds Préval for a second five-year term. For the next two years, and with Washington's support, Aristide's opponents use the OAS challenge to the 2000 elections to increase economic and political instability. Former Haitian soldiers carry out guerrilla attacks, primarily along the Dominican border and in the capital.
2004年：Haiti's 200th anniversary of independence.
2004年2月4日：A revolt breaks out in the city of Gonaïves, with a local militia hostile to Aristide capturing the city and driving out the police force.

2004年2月22日：Rebels capture Haiti's second-largest city, Cap-Haïtien, after just a few hours of fighting, claiming their biggest prize in a two-week uprising that has driven government forces from most of the country's north.

2004年2月29日：Aristide resigns from office and flees Haiti aboard a U.S. military aircraft to South Africa. Boniface Alexandre is inaugurated as interim president. Aristide later claims that he was forced from office and kidnapped by the U.S. government.
2004年3月：UN Resolution 1529 authorizes a three-month multinational interim peacekeeping force. It consists of troops from France, Canada, Chile and the U.S.
2004年9月：Hurricane Jeanne kills over 1,900 people.
2006年2月：René Préval is elected president, defeating U.S.-backed and other candidates in an election overseen by U.N. peacekeepers
2008年4月：Riots break out in Les Cayes and Port-au-Prince over high food prices, forcing the ouster of Prime Minister Jacques Edouard Alexis.
2008年8月：Tropical Storm Fay, Hurricane Gustav, Tropical Storm Hanna and Hurricane Ike strike within a month, leaving nearly 800 people dead and wiping out a quarter of the economy. (to September)
2008年11月：The Pétion-Ville school collapse and the Grace Divine School collapse.
2009年5月：Former U.S. President Bill Clinton is appointed U.N. special envoy to Haiti. He is tasked with reinvigorating the country's moribund economy after the 2008 storms.
2010年1月12日：A major earthquake, 7.0 on the moment magnitude scale, kills over 230,000 and causes massive damage to buildings and infrastructure in Port-au-Prince.
2010年：A UN Peacekeeping Mission caused a cholera outbreak that killed thousands of people and continues to sicken people across the country.
2016年10月4日：Hurricane Matthew makes landfall on the peninsula of the nation as a category 4, killing over 700 (although estimates place the toll at ~1,600) and causing massive damage in its wake
2021年8月14日：2021 Haiti earthquake causes widespread damage as of 15 August 2021, 304 people are reported dead and another 1.800 injured.
前10500年：El Abra culture inhabits the Altiplano Cundiboyacense.
前9000年：Communities of hunter-gatherers are established in the regions of Tequendama, El Abra, Nemocón, Tibitó, Vistahermosa, Galindo, Aguazuque, Gachetá and Sueva.

前3000年：Inhabitants change to a semi-sedentary life. The first crops of cassava on the Caribbean coast and maize in the Altiplano Cundiboyacense are grown. Archaeological sites in Puerto Hormiga show human activity.
前2700年：Inhabitants develop agriculture in the Amazon.
前1600年：The Morro del Tulcán pyramid is built.
前1590年：The Ilama culture develops near the Calima River in the Valle del Cauca.
前1300年：The Chimitá petroglyphs in modern-day Santander Department are created.
前1270年：The Zipacón pottery is created.
前700年：Cave paintings are created near the Inírida River in modern-day Vichada Department.
前700年：The Quimbaya's formative stage occurs.
前700年：El Infiernito menhirs is built.
前300年：Malagana period
前300年：The Guayabero Cave paintings in modern-day Guaviare are created.
前300年：First type of Colombian cheese was made by an ancient civilization.
前200年：San Agustín culture
前100年：Tairona culture
100年：Early Zenú culture

300年：the Chibcha civilization expands from the northern Andes including part of what is now Panama, the high plains of the Eastern Sierra of Colombia the areas of modern departments of Santander (North and South), Boyacá and Cundinamarca, becoming the most populous zone between the Mayan and Inca Empires.
600年：Classic Quimbaya civilization. Poporo Quimbaya
600年：Tierradentro culture
700年：Late Zenú culture
1000年：Classic Muisca period. Muisca raft
1470年：Saguamanchica becomes zipa of Bacatá (to 1490).
1470年：Michuá becomes zaque of Hunza (to 1490).
1490年：Battle of Chocontá
1490年：Nemequene becomes zipa of Bacatá (to 1514).
1490年：Quemuenchatocha becomes zaque of Hunza (to 1537).
