1492年：Inca Empire invades southwest Colombia.
1498年：Spanish explorer Juan de la Cosa lands on what is today called Cabo de la Vela (Cape of Sails) in the Guajira Peninsula.
1500年：Rodrigo de Bastidas lands on the Colombian Caribbean coast.
1502年5月2日：Alonso de Ojeda arrives at Bahía Honda and founded the village of Santa Cruz, first city in Colombia
1508年：Diego de Enciso and Vasco Núñez de Balboa founded the village of Santa María la Antigua del Darién, initially called The Antigua
links: Santa María la Antigua del Darién

items.text: 1509年：Ojeda founded the village of San Sebastián de Urabá
1509年：Indigenous princess India Catalina is abducted by Spanish conqueror Diego de Nicuesa from a Calamari indigenous settlement
1510年：Spanish conquerors discover San Andres y Providencia islands
1513年9月25日：Núñez de Balboa discovers the Pacific Ocean
1514年4月12日：The Pedrarias Dávila expedition began
1514年：Tisquesusa becomes zipa of Bacatá (till 1537)
1518年12月2日：Vasco Núñez de Balboa is executed by orders of Pedrarias Dávila
1525年7月29日：Rodrigo de Bastidas founded the village of Santa Marta
1530年5月3日：Foundation of Santa Cruz de Mompox by Alonso de Heredia
1533年1月20日：Pedro de Heredia founded the village of Cartagena de Indias
1536年4月6日：The strenuous Spanish conquest expedition starts from Santa Marta
1536年7月25日：Sebastián de Belalcázar founded the village of Santiago de Cali
1537年：Foundation of St. Juan de Pasto by Lorenzo de Aldana
1537年3月：Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada with his troops reach the Muisca Confederation
1537年4月20日：zipa Tisquesusa is beaten in the Spanish conquest of the Muisca at Funza
1537年：Sagipa becomes the last zipa of Bacatá
1537年7月25日：Francisco César discovers the territory of Antioquia
1537年8月20日：zaque Quemuenchatocha is beaten in Hunza.
1537年：Aquiminzaque becomes the last zaque of Hunza.
1537年9月：The Sun Temple in Sogamoso (name in Muysccubun: Sugamuxi) was burned by Spanish soldiers
1538年8月6日：Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada founded the city of Santa fe de Bogotá *some historians argue that the date of foundation was on 27 April 1539
1538年8月20日：The Panche are beaten by an alliance of zipa Sagipa and Spanish conquistadors in the Battle of Tocarema
1539年：Cacica Gaitana starts the Paezan revolt against the Spanish conquest
1539年：Neiva is founded by Juan de Cabrera.
1539年：Honda, Tolima is founded by Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada.
1539年8月6日：Gonzalo Suárez Rendón founded the city of Tunja
1540年7月27日：King Carlos V appointed Santa Fe de Bogotá the title of city
1541年8月24日：Jerónimo Luis Tejelo discovers the Aburrá Valley
1542年：Francisco de Orellana sails the length of the Amazon River
1545年：Foundation of Riohacha by Nikolaus Federmann

1882年4月1日：Francisco Javier Zaldúa served as President of the Rionegro Convention, a constituent assembly that created the United States of Colombia (now Colombia). As President of this legislative body, Zaldúa became the de facto President of the United States of Colombia for 6 days, when President Tomás Cipriano de Mosquera ceded executive power to the convention, and until the said convention elected a Council of Ministers to serve collectively as the Colombian head of state.

items.text: 1882年12月22日：José Eusebio Otalora is President of the United States of Colombia, in his capacity as the Second Presidential Designate following the death of President Francisco Javier Zaldúa, and the non-acceptance of the office by the First Designate Rafael Núñez.
links: President of the United States of Colombia

items.text: 1884年8月11日：Rafael Nuñez is President of the United States of Colombia for second time
1884年8月28日：ETB (company) is created, being the first telecommunications company in Colombia

1886年：President Rafael Nuñez creates the Colombian Constitution of 1886, which has been one of the longest lasting constitutions in the western hemisphere, and with the Reforms of 1910, 1936, 1958, 1968, 1973 and 1986 was the constitution of Colombia until 1991. The country adopts its present name: "Republic of Colombia"

1886年4月1日：on 30 March 1886, president Núñez presented his resignation to Congress due to his poor health condition caused by dysentery. José María Campo Serrano is sworn in as Acting President, becoming the first President of Colombian Republic
1887年1月7日：Eliseo Payán is the 2nd president of Colombia
1887年6月4日：Rafael Nuñez is the 3rd President of Colombia
1888年：Carlos Holguín Mallarino is the 4th President of Colombia
1889年10月14日：Foundation of Villa Holguin (Later Armenia, Colombia ) by Jesus Maria Ocampo

1892年8月7日：Miguel Antonio Caro is the 4th president of Colombia
1892年9月29日：Rafael Nuñez is the 5th President of Colombia
1894年9月18日：Miguel Antonio Caro is the 6th president of Colombia
1896年5月26日：Poet José Asunción Silva commits suicide
1898年：Manuel Antonio Sanclemente is the 7th president of Colombia
1899年10月17日：The Thousand Days' War (1899–1902)(1130 days) (Spanish: Guerra de los Mil Días)

1900年5月26日：President Manuel Antonio Sanclemente extended the deadline for completion of the Panama Canal from 31 October 1904 to 31 October 1910. The executive decree was granted without consent of the Colombian Congress.
1900年5月26日：Battle of Palonegro
1900年6月19日：Date of death of Salvador Camacho, called the "founder of sociology" in Colombia.
1900年7月31日：José Manuel Marroquín is president of Colombia
1900年8月：Naturalist Soto Grimshaw dies of cholera during an expedition to the Caribbean region of Colombia

1901年：Colombian Geographer Francisco Javier Vergara y Velasco publishes the first complete cartographic charts of the country, the Atlas completo de geografía colombiana (1906–1910), through which he won the Charles Manoir price of the Paris Geographical Society.
1901年：Manuelita became the first Colombian sugar mill to move from mule to steam powered mills
1901年2月23日：Battle of Aguadulce

1902年10月24日：The Thousand Days' War was a civil war fought in Colombia from 17 October 1899 to 21 November 1902, at first between the Liberal Party and the government led by the National Party, and later – after the Conservative Party had ousted the National Party – between the liberals and the conservative government. The peace treaty was signed on the plantation Neerlandia on 24 October 1902.

1903年：Panama remained as a province of Colombia until this year, when – with backing from the United States in exchange for allowing the US to build the Panama Canal – it became independent (Separation of Panama from Colombia)
1903年1月22日：The United States and the Republic of Colombia sign the Hay–Herrán Treaty
1903年10月26日：The United States Navy patrol gunboat USS Nashville blocks Colombian attempts to suppress the Panamanian separatist movement

1904年6月16日：Date of death of Manuel Uribe Ángel, known for his great contributions to the advances of the practice of medicine in Colombia and the Antioquia Department. He also served as President of the then Sovereign State of Antioquia
1904年8月7日：Rafael Reyes is president of Colombia
1904年10月11日：Creation of Postobón soft drinks company
1910年：Colombian astronomer Julio Garavito Armero discovers the crater on the Moon's far side which is named after him (Garavito crater).
1910年8月7日：Carlos Eugenio Restrepo is president of Colombia
1914年8月7日：José Vicente Concha is president of Colombia
1915年5月9日：Indigenous nasa leader Quintín Lame is arrested for attempting the creation of an indigenous independent republic
1918年：Marco Fidel Suárez is president of Colombia
1926年：Miguel Abadía Méndez is president of Colombia
1927年：The Federación Nacional de Cafeteros de Colombia is created
links: Federación Nacional de Cafeteros de Colombia

items.text: 1928年12月6日：The Banana massacre, in Spanish, Matanza de las bananeras or Masacre de las bananeras: A massacre of workers for the United Fruit Company that occurred in the town of Ciénaga near Santa Marta
1930年：Enrique Olaya Herrera is president of Colombia
1932年9月1日：The Colombia–Peru War
1934年：Alfonso López Pumarejo is president of Colombia
1934年：First census in Colombia. Population:8.700.000
1935年6月24日：Argentine singer Carlos Gardel dies in a plane crash in Medellín
1938年：Eduardo Santos Montejo is president of Colombia
1942年：Alfonso López Pumarejo is president of Colombia for a second time
1945年4月29日：Date of death of impressionist painter Andrés de Santa Maria
1945年：Alberto Lleras Camargo is president of Colombia
1946年：Mariano Ospina Pérez is president of Colombia
1948年4月9日：Murder of politician Jorge Eliécer Gaitán. Bogotazo riots. Starts the bipartisan violence ("La Violencia")
1950年：Laureano Gómez Castro is president of Colombia
1953年6月13日：Gustavo Rojas Pinilla seized power by means of a coup d'état
1954年8月3日：President Rojas Pinilla government gives women the right to vote
1954年：Rojas Pinilla introduced the Television in Colombia

1955年：Rojas Pinilla ordered a military offensive against rearmed peasants triggering a confrontation known as the "Guerra de Villarrica" (War of Villarrica) which took place in the central town of Villarrica in Tolima Department.
1956年6月24日：the Liberal Party headed by Alberto Lleras Camargo and the Conservative Party headed by Laureano Gómez signed an accord on 24 June 1956 to begin the National Front (Colombia).
1958年：Dr. Jorge Reynolds Pompo is credited with having helped in the design of the first successful internal pacemaker
1960年：Creation of the first Natural protected area in Colombia, the Cueva de los Guacharos National park
links: List of national parks of Colombia

items.text: 1961年10月28日：Hurricane Hattie moves over San Andrés island with winds of 80 mph (130 km/h), causing 1 death, 15 injuries, and $300,000 in damage (1961 USD, $2.1 million 2008 USD).
1962年：Guillermo León Valencia is president of Colombia
1962年7月25日：Luz Marina Zuluaga wins Miss Universe beauty contest
1964年：The refractive surgery keratomileusis was developed by Ignacio Barraquer in Bogotá.
1964年5月：Marquetalia Republic is overrun by the Colombian army (during what was termed "Operation Marquetalia")
1965年1月7日：The National Liberation Army (Colombia) (ELN) guerrilla is created
1966年：Carlos Lleras Restrepo is president of Colombia
1970年：Misael Pastrana Borrero is president of Colombia
1972年：Discovery of Ciudad Perdida archaeological place
1974年：Alfonso López Michelsen is president of Colombia

1974年：The Black Tuna Gang, a Miami-based Colombian marijuana-trafficking group was responsible for bringing in over 500 tons of marijuana over a 16-month period in the mid-1970s ("the marijuana bonanza").
1976年12月：Starts the development of Cerrejón Coal mine. It is the largest mining operation in Colombia and among the largest open-pit coal mines in the world
1978年：Julio César Turbay Ayala is president of Colombia
1980年2月27日：Dominican embassy siege
1980年6月：Serial killer Pedro López a.k.a. Monster of the Andes confessed to over 300 murders
1981年：Homosexuality in Colombia is declared legal by the national government
1982年：Belisario Betancur is elected president of Colombia
1982年：Paramilitary group "Muerte a Secuestradores" (MAS) is formed
1982年：Antioquian entrepreneur Felix Correa and his bank FURATENA get convicted for financial fraud causing a collapse in the national financial system
1982年9月1日：Mother Teresa visits Colombia
1982年10月22日：Gabriel García Márquez wins the Nobel Prize in Literature
1982年：Colombia resigns as host for the 1986 FIFA World Cup due to scarcity of public resources
1983年：Pablo Escobar attends Colombian congress sessions as backup of congressman Jairo Ortega
1983年：President Betancur announces Colombia has signed in the Non-Aligned Movement
1983年：Businessman Roberto Soto steals 13.5 million dollars from the national budget with the help of a teleprinter machine
1983年：General Prosecutor Carlos Jimenez declares that MAS group have underground relations of support with the National Army
1983年：Guerrilla leader Manuel Marulanda announces to the press that the FARC guerrilla has grown to 28 main divisions, causing international concern
1983年：1983 Guerrilla leader Jaime Bateman Cayon a.k.a. "El Flaco" dies in a plane crash near the Gulf of Urabá while traveling from Santa Marta to Panama
1983年：Jumbo 747 airplane of Avianca airlines, in flight from Bogotá, crashes in Mejorana del campo, near Barajas airport in Madrid, Spain. 189 passengers die, including Art critic Marta Traba
1983年3月31日：Popayán is partially destroyed by an earthquake during the traditional celebrations of Holy Week
1984年：Minister of Justice Rodrigo Lara Bonilla is shot to death by teenager hitmen hired by the Medellín Cartel. One of the hitmen, Byron de Jesus Velasquez, is captured

1984年：President Betancur achieves a ceasefire with 80% of guerrilla forces in the country. In the case of FARC, this would be linked to the creation of the political movement Patriotic Union (Colombia) UP during the next year.
1984年：Dissident guerrilla 19th of April Movement (M-19) attacks Florencia, Caquetá. Over 100 civilians dead

1984年3月10日：Tranquilandia, a large cocaine processing laboratory located in the jungles of Caquetá, constructed for the Medellín Cartel is destroyed by units of the Colombian National Police, assisted by the DEA
1985年：The Gorgona Island prison is dissolved and the island is declared National park
1985年1月10日：Elkin Lucena performed the first successful In vitro fertilization, that allowed the birth of the first Latin American test tube baby (Carolina Mendez).
1985年5月23日：Guerrilla leader Antonio Navarro is victim of a bomb that nearly killed him, and loses one leg
1985年7月：Colombian cyclist Luis Herrera wins the Vuelta a España, first South American to win a Grand Tour
links: The Vuelta a España, first South American to win a Grand Tour

items.text: 1985年9月16日：Ceroxylon quindiuense is declared as the National tree by the national government

1985年11月6日：M19 guerrilla attacks the supreme court in the Palace of Justice siege. The president of the Supreme Court of Colombia and many magistrates, employees and bystanders get killed. Over 100 fatal victims and undetermined number of missing persons. The army is accused of forced disappearance of civilians

1985年11月13日：In the worst natural disaster in the history of Colombia, Armero city in Tolima department is destroyed due to a flood created by the eruption of Nevado del Ruiz volcano (Armero tragedy). Over 20.000 dead. Countless homes destroyed.
1985年12月14日：Cardiologist Alberto Villegas performed the first heart transplant in Latin America to Antonio Yepes.
1986年：Virgilio Barco is elected president of Colombia
1986年：El Espectador newspaper director, Guillermo Cano is shot to death by hitmen
1986年：Guerrilla leader Javier Delgado kills 150 fellow guerrilleros of the Ricardo Franco Group, in the Tacueyó massacre, because he suspected them to be infiltrated
1986年7月3日：Pope John Paul II visits Bogotá and the remains of Armero tragedy
1986年8月9日：Miguel "Happy" Lora wins the world boxing championship in the bantamweight division

1986年12月4日：Campo Elías Delgado kills 29 persons (including his mother) and leaves 12 injured, in the Pozzetto restaurant massacre, presumably due to mental illness. The events are depicted in the 2006 movie Satanás.
1987年：Guerrilla groups attack a military convoy in Caqueta breaking the 1984 truce. 42 soldiers dead and 27 injured
1987年：Colombian Navy ship ARC Caldas sails in waters of Atlantic Ocean in dispute with Venezuela creating a serious diplomatic incident
1987年2月4日：Drug dealer Carlos Lehder is captured in a farm near Medellín at 6:20 a.m. The same day at 5:20 p.m he is extradited and sent in a DEA turbocommander airplane to USA
1987年10月11日：UP leaders Jaime Pardo Leal and Hector Abad are killed in La Mesa, Cundinamarca. Eventually this movement would be lose more than 3000 of their members due to violence
1988年：Paramilitary groups commit massacres in Saiza, Mejor Esquina and Segovia, Antioquia
1988年：General Prosecutor Carlos Mauro Hoyos is killed by hitmen
1988年：The first election of city majors for popular vote
1988年：Politicians Álvaro Gómez Hurtado and Andrés Pastrana are kidnapped by narcotrafficking related groups
1988年：collapse of Stock market due to incarceration of financial managers Juan Ricardo Escobar and Guillermo Uribe Holguin
1988年：Massacre of Trujillo, 107 victims. On 19 December 2006 Henry Loaiza-Ceballos was accused by Colombian authorities of being responsible for the massacre
1988年：First Iberoamerican Theater Festival in Bogotá. 100.000 people attend to the closing act in Plaza de Bolívar
1988年3月21日：Colombian Painter Dario Morales dies in Paris
1988年6月：Serial killer Daniel Barbosa a.k.a. the Beast of the Andes confessed 72 murders
1988年8月18日：Luis Carlos Galán, Politician and candidate to presidency is killed by hitmen in Soacha during a public speech
1989年：Drug dealer Gonzalo Rodríguez Gacha is killed in a military operation
1989年：First reports of the presence of Coffee borer beetle in Colombian coffee crops

1989年11月27日：Avianca Flight 203 airplane HK1803 explodes in the air with 107 people on board, few minutes after leaving El Dorado International Airport as a result of a bomb planted by the Medellín Cartel. No survivors

1989年12月6日：7:30 a.m. The Security Administration Department building (Departamento Administrativo de Seguridad DAS) and an important part of the commercial area of Paloquemao district in Bogotá are destroyed by a bomb, in what is considered the worst terrorist attack in Colombian history
1990年：M19 Guerrilla leader Carlos Pizarro Leongómez is killed by hitmen when he was a presidential candidate
1990年：César Gaviria is elected President of Colombia
1990年：El Tiempo newspaper director Francisco Santos is kidnapped
1990年：20 Emberá indigenous people are killed in the Caloto, Cauca massacre due to land ownership disagreements with local landlords
1990年3月22日：UP leader politician Bernardo Jaramillo Ossa is killed by hitmen
1991年：Rafael Pardo is the first civilian to be designated as minister of defense

1991年：Minister of economy Rudolph Hommes announced the new aperture politic for international trade inspirited in the Russian perestroika and the creation of the National bank for international trade Bancomex
1991年：Starts the first concessions for mobile telephony
1991年1月：Journalist Diana Turbay is killed while kept kidnapped in a farm near Sabaneta
1991年1月：Drug dealers Fabio, Juan David and Jorge Luis Ochoa Vázquez (The Ochoa brothers) and Pablo Escobar surrender themselves to the authorities
1991年2月17日：Opening of the national assembly for reform to the 1886 national constitution (Constituent Assembly of Colombia)
1992年：The Office of the Attorney General of Colombia is created, with Gustavo de Greiff designated as the first Attorney General
links: Office of the Attorney General of Colombia

items.text: 1992年：Noemí Sanín is the new minister of foreign affairs. She is the first woman to be designed as a minister in Colombia
1992年：The collapse of the national electricity generation system causes massive power blackouts all over the country with an average of 18 hours/day without electricity from March 1992 to April 1993
1992年：Fernando Botero presents a collection of 31 sculptures in an outdoors exhibition in the Champs-Élysées in Paris
1992年7月20日：Pablo Escobar escapes from the Cathedral Prison
1992年11月15日：Villatina Massacre
1993年：Massive celebration of the winning of Colombian soccer team in a play against Argentine team in Buenos Aires with final score 5–0. Riots all over the country.
1993年：The national government achieves commercial treaties with Venezuela, Mexico and Ecuador
1993年1月14日：Galeras volcano eruption killed nine people, including six scientists who had descended into the volcano's crater to sample gases.
1993年11月：Bomb explodes on 15th Avenue of Bogotá, near the intersection with 93rd Street (in front of Centro 93 mall). 10 people die, over 100 injured
1993年12月2日：Pablo Escobar dies in combats with the police
1994年：Ernesto Samper is elected president of Colombia

1994年：8000 Process scandal of Cali Cartel narcotrafficking money investment in the Samper electoral campaign starts with the public broadcasting of tapes from telephonic conversations among Minister Alberto Giraldo and drug dealers Gilberto and Miguel Rodríguez Orejuela
1994年：Former president César Gaviria is designated as OEA general secretary
1994年：A team of 10 people steals 24.075.000.000 pesos from the Republic Bank in Valledupar in the biggest bank robbery in the Colombian history
1994年：Paez river flood in Cauca department kills hundreds of people and destroys villages in a length of 40 km
1994年2月11日：CONVIVIR (Spanish for to coexist) program of cooperative neighbourhood watch groups is created by a decree of Colombia's Ministry of Defense
1994年5月20日：Manuel Elkin Patarroyo received the Prince of Asturias Awards by his technical and scientific research in the development of synthetic malaria vaccine
1994年7月2日：Due to the poor performance of the national soccer team in the USA soccer World Cup, an angry soccer aficionado shot to death soccer player Andrés Escobar
1995年：76-year-old conservative politician Álvaro Gómez Hurtado is murdered by hitmen
1995年1月：Plane crash in Marialabaja, Bolívar Department. 52 dead, only survivor 9-year-old girl Erika Delgado
1995年2月：Luciano Pavarotti gives a concert in Bogotá
1995年6月9日：Drug dealers Miguel and Gilberto Rodriguez Orejuela (The Rodriguez Brothers) are captured in a police operation
1995年11月30日：Start operations of rapid transit rail system Metro de Medellín
1995年12月20日：Plane crash near Cali airport. American Airlines plane with 163 occupants. 4 survivors
1996年：Antioquia governor Álvaro Uribe orders the capture of the German citizens Werner and Michela Mauss, suspected of being FARC collaborators
1996年：March of protest of 90.000 cocaleros (coca leaf illegal farmers) from Guaviare Department and Putumayo Department ended with 12 cocaleros dead. Army soldiers accused of brutality
1996年：Guerrilla attack to the military base "Las Delicias" in Putumayo. 29 soldiers dead, 20 injured, 60 kidnapped
1996年6月26日：La Gabarra Massacre

1996年7月24日：Hurricane Cesar moves westward across the southern Caribbean and crosses over extreme northern Colombia and the San Andres archipelago. Cesar kills 11 people in Colombia due to flooding and mudslides.
links: Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina

items.text: 1996年11月：Aterciopelados band ranks number 1 in the MTV network, becoming the most successful Colombian rock band

1997年："Miti-Miti" corruption scandal, involving Minister of communications Saulo Arboleda and minister of mining and energy Rodrigo Villamizar accused of obtaining illegal profit of 100 fm radio concessions
1997年4月：Salvatore Mancuso and Carlos Castaño conformed what they called the "Autodefensas Unidas de Colombia" (AUC) United Self-Defense Forces of Colombia
1997年4月15日：Drug dealer Phanor Arizabaleta-Arzayus, member of the Cali Cartel is captured at a road checkpoint
1997年7月15日：Mapiripán Massacre
1997年9月：Carlos Castaño in a press interview admits responsibility for the Mapiripán Massacre. AUC is listed by the US Department of State as a Foreign Terrorist Organization.

1997年10月：Bird (sculpture by Fernando Botero) was destroyed by a terrorist attack in downtown Medellín. About 17 people died. Several body parts remained unidentified. The remains of the sculpture are displayed in San Antonio Square as a memorial for the victims
1998年：Andrés Pastrana is elected as president of Colombia

1998年：Gloria Zea, director of the national Modern Art Museum organizes one of the largest art exhibits in Colombia "Arte y Violencia en Colombia" as a commemoration of 50th anniversary of the start of the bipartisan violence La Violencia
1998年：Fernando Botero donates 100 of his works and 60 pieces of his private art collection (19th and 20th centuries) to the Antioquia Museum
1998年6月20日：Plan Colombia (Treaty signed with USA for support in the war on drugs) is officially unveiled by President Pastrana

1998年11月7日：President Pastrana granted to the FARC guerrilla a 42,000 km2 (16,200 sq mi) safe haven meant to serve as a confidence building measure, centered around the San Vicente del Caguán settlement
1999年：Betty la fea soap opera a.k.a. Ugly Betty reach the highest levels of rating and the script is sold to different producers in several countries
1999年1月19日：The 1999 Armenia earthquake devastates Armenia, Colombia. Over 2000 dead, 3000 missing persons and a quarter million people homeless
1999年4月14日：ELN guerrilla kidnap Fokker airplane with 41 occupants in Bolívar department

1999年4月22日：Serial killer Luis Garavito is found guilty of the murder of 138 boys. (The total number of victims according with Garavito confessions off-record is estimated up to 300 boys and an undetermined number of adults)
1999年5月30日：Mass kidnapping of 70 people in La Maria church in Cali
1999年8月13日：Comedian Jaime Garzón is murdered by hitmen

1999年11月13日：Strong waves from Hurricane Lenny affect the Guajira Peninsula of Colombia, flooding 1,200 homes and businesses along the northern coastline. In addition, winds and rains from the hurricane causes severe crop damage in the country. The hurricane kills two in Colombia. (to 16 November)
1999年11月29日：Date of death of Colombian essayist and historian Germán Arciniegas
2000年：First Olympic gold medal in Colombian history, earned by María Isabel Urrutia in weightlifting
2000年3月30日：A car bomb parked in front of the mayor's office in Cachipay (Cundinamarca Department) detonated, causing injuries to nineteen and deaths to four
2000年4月11日：ELN bombs damage 4 meetinghouses of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (LDS Church); bridge attack kills 1, injures 20.
links: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

items.text: 2000年5月15日：A woman was killed by a time bomb fastened to her neck by FARC guerrilla; 1 bomb disposal specialist died trying to deactivate the bomb and other 3 were wounded. The 2007 movie PVC-1 is based in this incident
2000年6月：The sport of Precolumbian origin; Turmequé or tejo is declared as the National sport by the Colombian congress
2000年8月30日：USA president Bill Clinton and his daughter Chelsea visit Cartagena de Indias

2000年9月4日：A 70 kilograms of R1 explosive bomb exploded in Barrancabermeja's commercial district, injuring four policemen, two security guards and two civilians. The intended target was apparently the National Customs and Tax Directorate (DIAN).
2000年10月：Macayepo massacre in Montes de María

2000年10月15日：A bomb went off in Cali outside a rehabilitation center in the Obrero neighborhood. Two children were killed and thirty other injured. An explosive device went off in a Christian church in Cali, killing two and injuring fifteen.

2000年11月14日：A guerrilla group gave a homeless man a package that, unbeknownst to him, was filled with explosives. The package exploded as he walked through the banking sector of Cali, killing him and wounding four others. The package reportedly contained 500 grams of ammonium nitrate fuel oil.
2000年12月4日：Politician Fernando Araújo Perdomo is kidnapped by the Farc guerrilla
2000年12月18日：Opening of the mass transportation system Transmilenio in Bogotá
2001年：The stock markets of Cali, Medellín and Bogotá are fused into a single entity: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia
2001年：Singer Shakira Mebarak wins a Grammy Award for her MTV unplugged
2001年4月24日：the House of Representatives Committee on International Relations published the findings of its investigation into IRA activities in Colombia
links: United States House Committee on Foreign Affairs

items.text: 2001年5月4日：A car bomb kills four and injures 32 in a luxury hotel in Cali. No group claims the attack.
2001年5月17日：A car bomb kills 20 and injures at least 50 in a park in Medellín.
2001年7月11日：Soccer tournament Copa America 2001 was held in Colombia (to 29 July)
2001年8月11日：Arrest of the Irish Colombia Three charged with training FARC rebels in bomb-making
2001年8月23日：In a series of attacks near Medellín, 10 bombs kill one and injure 39 others. At least 15 members of terrorist group ELN die when the explosives they were carrying detonate.
2001年9月29日：Politician Consuelo Araújo is murdered while being kidnapped by FARC guerrilla
2002年1月25日：A bomb kills a child and four police officers and injures 28 people in Bogotá. Rebel group FARC is blamed
2002年1月30日：A car bomb kills five and injures 40 in the city of Florencia in the department of Caquetá
2002年2月21日：President Pastrana ended the peace talks and ordered the armed forces to start retaking the FARC-EP controlled zone of San Vicente del Caguan
2002年2月24日：Oxygen Green Party Politician Ingrid Betancourt is kiddnapped by FARC guerrilla
2002年3月：President Uribe decided to appoint Marta Lucía Ramírez as Minister of Defense becoming the second woman in Latin America to ever hold this title, after Michelle Bachelet
2002年4月7日：Two bombs explode in the restaurant district of Villavicencio, killing twelve and injuring 70. FARC is the prime suspect for the attack.
2002年4月11日：Two police officers and a girl are killed by a bomb concealed in the corpse of a peasant (Pedro Nel Camacho) apparently executed by the FARC guerrilla with such purpose
2002年4月12日：12 politicians in Valle del Cauca are kidnapped using a hoax antibomb operative, starting the Valle del Cauca Deputies hostage crisis
links: Valle del Cauca Deputies hostage crisis

items.text: 2002年4月12日：A rocket explodes near the studios of RCN TV in Bogotá.
2002年4月14日：During an assassination attempt of then-presidential candidate Álvaro Uribe Vélez a bomb kills two and injures 20 in Barranquilla. Rebel group FARC is blamed.
2002年5月2日：Bojaya massacre in Chocó Department. A bomb destroys the local church. 117 dead, 114 injured.
2002年5月26日：Cali bishop Isaias Duarte is murdered by hitmen
2002年8月7日：Álvaro Uribe is elected president of Colombia

2002年8月7日：Four rounds of mortars are fired against the Presidential Palace in Bogotá during the inauguration ceremony of President Álvaro Uribe Vélez. 13 people, mostly homeless, die and 50 are wounded. FARC is blamed.
2002年11月24日：Guerrilla leader alias Simon Trinidad is extradited to USA
2002年12月13日：A bomb destroys 30th floor of the Intercontinental Hotel in downtown Bogotá. 37 people injured.
2003年1月16日：A car bomb kills four and injures 27 at a shopping mall in Medellín. The attack is believed to be a retaliation of FARC for the arrest of 53 of its members in the preceding days
2003年2月7日：2003 El Nogal Club bombing. Car bomb kills 36 and injures more than 200 at the El Nogal social club in Bogotá; FARC rebels are blamed
2003年2月14日：A bomb kills 18 and wounds 37 in Neiva, destroying 70 homes. Amongst the dead are the chief prosecutor in Neiva and the chief of police. FARC is blamed for the attack.
2003年3月5日：A car bomb kills six and injures 68 in a covered parking lot in Cúcuta. Rebel group ELN is blamed for the attack.

2003年5月：A group of Colombian Army soldiers, part of a Counter-terrorism unit, while cleaning up after an ambush by guerillas makes the surprising discovery of several tubs buried in the jungle which hold US$16.75 million in cash. They decide to keep the money for themselves, leading to their capture and trial. These events are depicted in the 2006 movie A Ton of Luck
2003年5月8日：A bomb kills three in an attack against a water treatment plant in Cali.
2003年8月24日：Six die and 28 are wounded when a bomb explodes in a riverboat in the town of Puerto Rico. Rebel group FARC is blamed.
2003年9月11日：A bomb strapped to a horse kills eight and injures 15 in the village of Chita, Boyacá. The attack is blamed on FARC, as the same technique had been used in the past.
2003年9月29日：A motorcycle packed with explosives kills ten and injures 54 in downtown Florencia, Caquetá. Rebel group FARC is blamed.
2003年10月8日：A car bomb kills six and injures eleven in downtown Bogotá.
2003年11月15日：A grenade attack from a motorcycle kills two and injures seventy in the Bogotá Beer Company, a popular pub in Bogotá. Two FARC members were captured.
2003年12月：Biologist Raul Cuero wins NASA Technology Award for his research in removal of radionuclides such as uranium, using Martian simulated soil
2004年3月15日：Date of death of popular salsa dancer Amparo Arrebato
2004年5月1日：Ecuadorian government placed further stringent visa restrictions on Colombians seeking to enter Ecuador

2004年5月22日：A bomb exploded in a crowded tavern/discothèque at 11:00 pm Saturday night killing six (some reports indicate seven) and wounding eighty-two. The bomb was packed in a small suitcase and left in the bathroom by suspected Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels. It is believed the bombing was part of a FARC campaign marking the organizations 40th anniversary.
2004年8月4日：A bomb exploded at a bridge in Medellín moments before a parade of antique cars was scheduled to cross it, as the closing event at the annual Festival of the Flowers. 35 people injured.

2004年10月29日：A bomb exploded near a bus stop along Bogotá's Transmilenio bus system route. A taxi passing by was caught in the blast resulting in the death of the driver and a passenger. 30 surrounded houses destroyed
2004年11月22日：USA president George W. Bush visits Cartagena de Indias
2004年11月28日：A bomb exploded beside the mayor's office in the Rafael Uribe district of Bogotá
2004年11月30日：Three people were killed and eight wounded when a fragment grenade was left at a supermarket checkout counter

2004年12月13日：Rodrigo Granda affair. FARC guerrilla leader Rodrigo Granda, was captured by individual Venezuelan officials in Caracas, Venezuela, and transferred to Cúcuta, Colombia (a departmental capital on the two nations' common border), where he was arrested by the Colombian authorities on 14 December, generating a diplomatic crisis with Venezuelan government.
2004年12月30日：Radio Televisión Nacional de Colombia (RTVC) replaced the liquidated Instituto Nacional de Radio y Televisión (Inravisión) as the government-run radio and television broadcasting service
2005年1月：Colombian justice adopts the adversarial system
2005年2月1日：FARC attacks the Iscuande marine base in Narino Department with homemade rockets, killing 15 soldiers and injuring 25.
2005年2月3日：A bridge was blown up in Putumayo Department, killing eight soldiers and a civilian.
2005年4月6日：An ambush in Arauca state, near Venezuela, kills 17 soldiers.
2005年6月24日：FARC attacks military positions in the location of Puerto Asís in the Putumayo department, killing 25 and wounding 20 in a single operation.
2005年10月27日：The islands of San Andrés and Providencia are evacuated due to Hurricane Beta (2005). Hours later, a hurricane watch was issued.

2005年12月27日：FARC launches a massive attack in the remote village of San Marino in the Chocó Department, killing at least six police officers along with the temporary abduction of some thirty, before they were released by the guerrillas on 20 December due to military pressure.
2005年12月28日：FARC rebels ambush troops near Vista Hermosa, Meta, killing 28.
2006年5月28日：Álvaro Uribe is re-elected for a second presidential term
2006年7月31日：16 soldiers die in an ambush in Tibú and a car bomb kills one and injures 22 in Bogotá. Both attacks are blamed on FARC.
2006年8月4日：A car bomb kills five outside a police station in Cali. FARC suspected responsible.
2006年10月19日：A car bomb explodes in a military college in northern Bogotá.

2006年11月9日：The Supreme Court ordered the detention of three congressmen implicated in the signature of an illegal agreement with the United Self-Defense Forces of Colombia at Santa Fe de Ralito starting the Colombian parapolitics scandal

2006年12月：First Narco submarines of Colombian origin seized by the U.S. Coast Guard, authorities dubbed it Bigfoot because they had heard rumors that such things existed, but nobody had actually seen one.
2006年12月10日：Paramilitary leader Salvatore Mancuso surrenders to the Colombian authorities

2007年1月5日：kidnapped politician Fernando Araújo Perdomo escaped from his captors after a Colombian National Army military operation in the Montes de María mountains. Araújo spent several days in hiding without food or water until eventually finding help.
2007年3月1日：Ten injured in a car bomb blast in Neiva, capital of Huila; rebel group FARC is believed responsible. The action is suspected to be an assassination attempt on Neiva's mayor.
2007年3月3日：A bomb kills four police officers and one civilian in the city of Neiva, as they attempt to deactivate it
2007年3月16日：A bomb kills 16 and injures 16 in Buenaventura. Authorities blame FARC.
2007年4月7日：The first Colombian satellite, Libertad I is launched in orbit from Baikonur cosmodrome
2007年4月28日：Kidnapped police officer Jhon Frank Pinchao escapes from the FARC guerrilla spending near a month lost in the jungle

2007年5月：Virginia Vallejo, media personality and former lover of Pablo Escobar, published her memoir Amando a Pablo, odiando a Escobar (Loving Pablo, Hating Escobar), where she accused several Colombian presidents of involvement with drug traffickers
2007年6月28日：Murder of the politicians kidnapped in the Valle del Cauca Deputies hostage crisis causes national outrage
links: Valle del Cauca Deputies hostage crisis

items.text: 2007年9月7日：Colombian coffee achieves Protected designation of origin status granted by the European Union

2007年12月13日：International Court of Justice of The Hague concluded the long-time dispute with the Republic of Nicaragua over the San Andrés y Providencia Islands in favor of Colombian sovereignty over the San Andres Archipelago, ratifying the Esguerra-Bárcenas treaty. signed between 1928 and 1930
links: Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina

items.text: 2008年1月10日：Former vice presidential candidate Clara Rojas and former congresswoman Consuelo González are freed after nearly six years in captivity
2008年3月1日：The Colombian military attacks a FARC camp inside Ecuador's territory. Several guerrilla casualties including guerrilla leader Raul Reyes starting the 2008 Andean diplomatic crisis
2008年3月3日：Iván Ríos, a member of the FARC Central High Command was killed by his security chief "Rojas".
2008年3月26日：Guerrilla commander Manuel Marulanda Vélez dies
2008年5月18日：Guerrilla leader Elda Neyis Mosquera alias "Karina" surrenders herself to the military forces

2008年7月2日：Under a Colombian military operation called Operation Jaque, the FARC was tricked by the Colombian Government into releasing 15 hostages to Colombian Intelligence agents, including Ingrid Betancourt, U.S. military contractors, and Colombian soldiers and police officers
2008年8月15日：Ituango, Antioquia. Seven people were killed and more than 50 wounded when a bomb detonated in a small town
2008年8月21日：Colombia has chosen the European DVB-T standard for Digital terrestrial television

2008年10月30日：Accusations of Colombian army soldiers involved with criminal bands with the purpose of luring unsuspecting unemployed or homeless people into isolated areas where they were murdered and the scenes were staged as combats against guerrilla in order to enhance their achievements and get performance-related payments, were investigated. The events, known as the 'false positives' scandal, led to the resignation of Commander-in-chief, general Mario Montoya. As of 2012, 3,350 such cases had been investigated in all parts of the country and verdicts had been reached in 170 cases.

2008年11月12日：Riots broke out in the municipalities of Pasto, Tumaco, Popayán and later spread all over the country after the collapse of several pyramid schemes. Thousands of victims had invested their money in pyramids that promised them extraordinary interest rates. The lack of regulation laws allowed those pyramids to grow excessively during several years. Finally, after the riots the Colombian government was forced to declare the country in economical emergency in order to seize and stop those schemes. Several of the pyramid's managers were arrested and are being prosecuted for the crime of "illegal massive money reception".
2008年11月22日：Colombia and Canada signed a new $1.14 billion dollar bilateral trade agreement (the Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement) at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting.

2009年1月8日：Colombian drug lord and head of the Caqueta cartel Leonidas Vargas is murdered inside a hospital. his brother(Héctor Fabio Vargas) and his girlfriend (Colombian actress Liliana Andrea Lozano) were tortured and murdered in Pradera, Colombia.
2009年1月8日：Recognition of same-sex unions in Colombia is achieved by rule of the Constitutional Court
links: Recognition of same-sex unions in Colombia

items.text: 2009年1月11日：Reports of mass murders of Awá (kwaiker) indigenous people by FARC guerrilla

2009年2月：Colombia has extended its existing tobacco control regulations by a smoking ban requiring all indoor work places and public places be immediately smoke-free, prohibiting tobacco advertising, promotions and sponsorship
2009年2月：the fossils of 28 individual Titanoboa cerrejonensis, the largest snake ever discovered, were announced to have been found in the coal mines of Cerrejón in La Guajira, Colombia.

2009年3月：The Álvarez incest case was uncovered when 59-year-old Arcedio Álvarez was arrested in Mariquita, Colombia, accused of sexually abusing his now 30-year-old daughter Alba Nidia Álvarez since the age of 9. The daughter also gave birth to 11 children, three of whom died.
2009年3月：the Colombian government enacted a mandate to introduce E85 flexible-fuel vehicles
2009年3月15日：Luis Carlos Sarmiento Angulo gets ranked in the Forbes list of world billionaires.

2009年4月：The Colombian armed forces launched Strategic Leap, an offensive in borders areas where the FARC's forces has still a strong military presence, especially in Arauca, near the Venezuelan border.
2009年4月：Colombian drug lord Daniel Rendón Herrera alias Don "Mario" is captured while hiding in a jungle.
2009年5月13日：Vallenato composer and troubadour Rafael Escalona dies due to heart failure.
2009年5月14日：During his visit to Colombia, the Czech Republic Prime Minister Mirek Topolánek negotiated a possible sale of Aero L-159 Alca combat aircraft with Colombian President Álvaro Uribe.
2009年6月：Clara Guerrero wins Women's World Championship World Ranking Masters

2009年：The Colombian government claimed that AT4 anti-tank rockets manufactured by Saab Bofors Dynamics of Sweden, which were later purchased by Venezuela were being used by the FARC. In response, President Chavez ordered most staff members of the embassy in Colombia to return to Venezuela, including the ambassador. Only the "lowest functionaries" were left to staff the embassy.
2009年7月18日：Ricardo Londoño, Colombia's first Formula One driver is murdered in the north Colombian Córdoba Department.

2009年8月8日：Cuban artist Tania Bruguera sets a controversial performance in the National University of Colombia (Bogotá branch), included consumption of cocaine provided by the artist to the attendants.
2009年8月30日：President Álvaro Uribe had contracted the AH1N1 flu virus, becoming the second head of state to do so (the first being Óscar Arias).

2009年9月11日：A group of eradicators of Coca crops near the village of La Gabarra, Municipality of Tibú, Norte de Santander is attacked by guerrilla forces with a donkey with bombs attached to it. 2 people deceased
前7000年－前4000年：Semi-nomadic horticulturist communities are established, such as the Guitarrero, Pikimachay, Chilca, Telamarchay and Jayhuamachay.
前4000年－前2000年：Sedentary lifestyles emerged, accompanied by agriculture and livestock farming, with it the people of Tablada de Lurin, Cerro Paloma, Huaca Prieta and Kotosh.
前4000年－前2000年：First societies develop in the region of Norte Chico; amongst them the Caral, the oldest civilization in the Americas.
前2000年：Ceramics are found in Peru.
links: Ceramics of Indigenous peoples of the Americas

items.text: 前1800年：The Caral people disappear, but the Cupisnique culture starts to develop.
前1500年：Chavin culture emerges in the Andes, and the Pucara people appear in the South.
前700年：The farming and fishing town of Paracas emerges on the Southern coast.
前400年－前200年：The cultures of the Salinar, Gallinazo, Cajamarca and Vicus people are founded.
前150年：The Chavin culture collapsed, parallel to the first emergence of militarized cultures, such as Moche in the North, Nazca in the South and Tihuanaco in the Highlands.
1260年：Sinchi Roca was succeeded by his son Lloque Yupanqui.
1290年：Lloque Yupanqui was succeeded by his son Mayta Cápac.
1320年：Mayta Cápac was succeeded by his son Cápac Yupanqui.
1350年：Cápac Yupanqui was succeeded by his son Inca Roca.
1380年：Inca Roca died. His heir Quispe Yupanqui was killed in a coup, and the throne went to Yáhuar Huácac, another son.
1410年：Yáhuar Huácac was succeeded by his son Viracocha.
1438年：Viracocha was succeeded by his son Pachacuti, who would expand Cuzco into the Inca Empire.
1471年：Pachacuti died. His son Tupac Inca Yupanqui succeeded him.
1493年：Tupac Inca Yupanqui died and was succeeded by Huayna Capac.
1527年：Huayna Capac died and was succeeded by his heir Ninan Cuyochi.
1532年：Francisco Pizarro, a conquistador, arrives with a troop of Spaniards at the Northern coast of Peru.
1532年4月：Atahualpa's army, led by Quizquiz and Chalcuchimac, captures Huáscar at the Battle of Quipaipan. Atahualpa proclaims himself Inca, thus ending the Civil War.
1532年：The Spanish founded the port of San Francisco de la Buenaesperanza, now Paita, considered the oldest port in Peru.
1532年：Atalhualpa's army, led by Quizquiz, captures Cuzco.
1532年：Pizarro founds the city of San Miguel, now Piura, considered the first city the Spanish founded in Peru.
1532年：Pizarro arrives at Cajamarca, with the intention of meeting Atahualpa.
1532年：At the Battle of Cajamarca, the Spanish army took the Inca emperor Atahualpa prisoner, marking the end of his empire.
1535年：Spaniards founded the city of Lima.
1542年：The Viceroyalty of Peru was established.
1572年：End of the Neo-Inca State in Vilcabamba.
1586年：Birth of Isabel Flores de Oliva, later Saint Rose of Lima.
1579年：Birth of Saint Martin de Porres.
1656年：Pedro Bohórquez announced to the Calchaqui Indians that he was the last living descendant of the Inca emperors.
1659年：Bohórquez led the Calchaqui in an uprising against the Spanish crown.
1667年：Bohórquez was executed and displayed in Lima.
1717年：The New Kingdom of Granada became an independent viceroyalty under the Spanish crown.
1742年：Juan Santos Atahualpa led a failed uprising against the Spanish colonial government.
1776年：The Governorate of the Río de la Plata was spun off as an independent viceroyalty.
links: Governorate of the Río de la Plata

items.text: 1780年：Battle of Sangarará: Indigenous rebels led by Túpac Amaru II soundly defeated a numerically inferior Spanish force while they attended church.
1781年：Túpac Amaru II was drawn and quartered in Cuzco.
1810年：Viceroy José Fernando de Abascal y Sousa sent troops to Córdoba, Potosí, La Paz and Charcas and reincorporated them into the Viceroyalty of Peru.
links: José Fernando de Abascal y Sousa

items.text: 1815年：By royal order, Joaquín de la Pezuela was named viceroy of Peru to replace Abascal.
links: José Fernando de Abascal y Sousa

items.text: 1816年：San Martin's Argentina had declared its independence.
1820年：An Argentine army led by José de San Martín landed at Paracas.
1821年：Pezuela was deposed. José de la Serna was proclaimed viceroy.
1821年：De la Serna moved the capital to Cuzco.
1821年7月28日：Peruvian War of Independence: San Martín declared the independence of Peru.
1824年12月9日：Battle of Ayacucho: The Spanish army was defeated, marking the end of Spanish rule in South America.
1837年5月9日：The Peru-Bolivian Confederacy was established.
1839年8月25日：The Peru-Bolivian Confederacy was officially dissolved.
1866年5月2日：A Spanish fleet under the command of Admiral Casto Méndez Núñez besieged the port city of Callao.
1879年4月5日：War of the Pacific: Chile declared war on Peru and Bolivia.
1883年10月20日：War of the Pacific: Under the Treaty of Ancón, the war ended with the cession of Peru's Tarapacá Province to Chile.
1948年10月29日：A military coup de armando the 2nd
1956年：Odría allowed free elections.
1968年10月3日：General Juan Velasco Alvarado seized power in a military coup.
1975年8月29日：A number of prominent military commanders overthrew the Alvarado government and installed General Francisco Morales Bermúdez in the presidency.
1979年7月12日：A new constitution came into force.
1985年4月14日：Alan García won election to the Presidency.
1990年4月8日：Alberto Fujimori defeated Mario Vargas Llosa in a presidential election.
1992年4月5日：Fujimori declares a self-coup and dissolves the Congress.
links: Congress of the Republic of Peru

items.text: 1992年9月12日：The Maoist leader Abimael Guzmán was arrested in Lima.
1995年1月26日：Cenepa War: The war broke out. Yared is smart
1995年4月9日：1995 Peruvian general election: Fujimori was re-elected president of Perú.

1996年12月17日：The terrorist group Túpac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) took hostage hundreds of high-level diplomats, government and military officials and business executives who were attending a party at the official residence of Japan's ambassador to Peru.
1997年4月22日：The Peruvian army mounted a dramatic raid on the residence. Fourteen members of the MRTA were killed, crippling the organization, and the hostages were freed.
2000年6月24日：Alberto Fujimori wins reelection for a third term, later resigning at the threat of impeachment.
2001年4月8日：2001 Peruvian general election: Possible Peru won a plurality of APRA.
2001年：Peruvian general election, 2001: Alejandro Toledo won the presidency.
2001年：The Mesa Redonda fire broke out in Lima, resulting in 277 casualties and leaving more than 500 missing, caused by the explosion of a fireworks device.
2003年5月26日：Toledo declared a state of emergency in response to a series of paralyzing strikes.
2003年7月14日：Birth of Jose Diego Salazar in Trujillo, Peru.
2006年4月9日：2006 Peruvian general election: Union for Peru won a plurality of seats in the Congress. Their presidential candidate, Ollanta Humala, went into a runoff against García.
links: Congress of the Republic of Peru

items.text: 2006年6月4日：Alan García won the presidency.
2007年8月15日：2007 Peru earthquake: A 7.9 earthquake hit Pisco Province.
2010年：Peru celebrates Peruvian novelist Mario Varga Llosa's achievement in receiving the Nobel Prize in Literature.
2011年7月28日：Ollanta Humala is inaugurated, winning the presidency over Keiko Fujimori.
2016年7月28日：Pedro Pablo Kuczynski is inaugurated as President of Peru, prevailing over former President Alberto Fujimori's daughter, Keiko Fujimori.
2017年12月24日：Kuczynski pardons former President Alberto Fujimori, who was sentenced for 25 years with manslaughter, corruption, bribery, and violation of human rights.

2018年3月21日：Amidst a political crisis, Pedro Pablo Kuczynski resigns the presidency in the threat of impeachment for corruption and bribery. First Vice President Martín Vizcarra assumes the presidency.
2019年7月26日：The opening ceremony for the 2019 Pan American Games is held.
2020年1月26日：Amidst a constitutional crisis, Vizcarra's snap parliamentary election is held, resulting in Popular Action placing first.
2020年3月6日：COVID-19 pandemic in Peru.
2020年11月9日：Second impeachment of Martín Vizcarra. Manuel Merino (and later Francisco Sagasti) becomes president.
2021年7月28日：Pedro Castillo is sworn in after being elected president in the second round, defeating Keiko Fujimori.
2022年12月7日：Castillo is impeached and removed as president after the 2022 Peruvian self-coup attempt. Dina Boluarte becomes president; she is the first woman to hold the role.
2025年10月10日：Boluarte is impeached and removed as president. José Jerí becomes president.
2026年2月17日：Jerí is censured and removed as president. José María Balcázar becomes president.

2026年7月28日：Keiko Fujimori is sworn in after being elected president in the second round, defeating Roberto Sánchez. Popular Force also won a plurality of seats in the re-established bicameral Congress.
2027年7月23日：The opening ceremony for the 2027 Pan American Games is held.
約前16500年：Settlement of Monte Verde, the "earliest known human settlement in the Americas".
約前5050年：Chinchorro culture practices funerary mummification, the first known example of this practice in the world.
約1000年－1150年：Tiwanaku Empire collapses ushering migratory and societal changes that reach as far south as Araucanía.
1300年－1399年：Possible date for a Cunco-Huilliche migration to Chiloé Island. Chonos were possibly displaced further such to places like Guaitecas Archipelago.
1420年9月1日：a 9.4 MS-strong earthquake shakes Chile's Atacama Region causing tsunamis in Chile as well as Hawaii and Japan.
1471年－1493年：At some point in this time interval the battle of the Maule between Incas and Mapuches may have occurred.
1502年：The Inca Emperor Túpac Yupanqui reached Itata River
1513年9月25日：Vasco Núñez de Balboa becomes the first European to sight the Pacific Ocean from the New World; he calls it Mar del Sur.

1520年：Explorer Ferdinand Magellan's expedition finds the passage now known as the Strait of Magellan. In the process, they become the first Europeans to describe Chilean Patagonia and its inhabitants.
1532年：Francisco Pizarro arrives in Peru from Panamá. He begins the Conquest of the Inca Empire and captures Emperor Atahualpa during the Battle of Cajamarca.
1532年：A possible date for the battle of the Maule between Incas and Mapuches.
1535年：Spanish Conquistador Diego de Almagro begins his expedition to the lands south of Peru through the eastern side of the Andes Mountains.
1536年：Almagro's expedition crosses the Andes into the Copiapó River valley and explores the central region of Chile as far south as the Aconcagua River valley.

1536年：Almagro sends an expedition under :es:Gómez de Alvarado southwards toward the Bio-Bio region. The expedition ends at the Battle of Reynogüelén, near the Itata River, being considered the first battle between Spaniards and Mapuches.
1541年2月12日：Pedro de Valdivia founds Santiago de Nueva Extremadura, now known as Santiago.
1541年4月25日：es:Lucas Martínez Vegaso founds Villa San Marcos de Arica, now known as Arica.

1541年9月11日：An uprising led by toqui Michimalonco attacks fledgling Santiago in an attempt to drive out the Spanish. Key actions undertaken by Inés de Suárez, the first Spanish woman to set foot in Chile, are attributed with avoiding the complete destruction of the outnumbered settlement.
1544年9月4日：es:Juan Bohón founds Villanueva de la Serena, now known as La Serena.
1545年：Foundation of the port of Arica. The port becomes a key staging point between the mines of Potosí in Upper Peru (now Bolivia) and Lima.
1546年：Mapuche child Lautaro is captured by the Spanish and made a yanacona. Eventually, Lautaro becomes personal page of Pedro de Valdivia.
1550年10月5日：Pedro de Valdivia founds Concepción del Nuevo Extremo, now known as Concepción.
1552年2月9日：Founding of Valdivia.
1552年：Lautaro, after six years' imprisonment by the Spanish, escapes. He then teaches his people European warfare, including riding horses.
1553年12月25日：Battle of Tucapel: Mapuches led by Lautaro defeat the Spanish at the ruins of Tucapel capturing Pedro de Valdivia who is then executed. A general Mapuche uprising develops under Lautaro.

1557年4月30日：Battle of Mataquito: A Spanish force led by Francisco de Villagra defeats the forces of Lautaro, killing him amidst the battle. Caupolicán assumes the role of Mapuche toqui (wartime chief).
1558年：Caupolicán is captured and executed by impalement.
1558年3月27日：Governor García Hurtado de Mendoza founds San Mateo de Osorno, now known as Osorno.
links: García Hurtado de Mendoza, 5th Marquis of Cañete

items.text: 1564年4月：Concepción is unsuccessfully besieged by native Mapuches.
1565年8月27日：The King of Spain decrees the creation of Real Audiencia in Concepción.
1567年2月12日：Chiloé Archipelago is claimed by Spain. Martín Ruiz de Gamboa founds Castro on the main island; the southernmost European settlement at that time.
1567年8月5日：Real Audiencia in Concepción starts its functions. The Audiencia is abolished in 1575.
1570年2月8日：Concepción is struck by an earthquake.
1574年11月22日：Spanish captain Juan Fernández discovers the Juan Fernández Islands.
1575年12月16日：Earthquake in Valdivia causes extensive damage in Valdivia and surrounding cities of Villarrica, Osorno, and Castro. As in the 1960 Valdivia earthquake, the Riñihue Lake dams.
1576年4月：The dam of San Pedro River burst flooding many settlements downstream including Valdivia.
1578年12月：Francis Drake attacks the coast of Chile during his circumnavigation of the earth; La Serena and Valparaíso are plundered.
1580年6月26日：Martín Ruiz de Gamboa founds Chillán.
1584年2月5日：Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa founds the settlement Nombre de Jesús on the eastern end of the Strait of Magellan.
1584年3月25日：Gamboa founds the settlement Rey Don Felipe in the Strait of Magellan. By 1587 both settlements lay in ruins, leading English pirate Thomas Cavendish to dub Rey Don Felipe as Port Famine.
1598年12月23日：Battle of Curalaba: Governor Martín García Óñez de Loyola killed in a Mapuche ambush.
1599年：The Real Situado, an annual payment of silver from Potosí to Chile, is established.
1600年2月16日：Huaynaputina begins its catastrophic eruption.
1600年4月19日：In the Battle of Castro a Spanish force defeat and expel Huilliche rebels and Dutch corsairs from Castro.
1602年：General uprising of the Mapuches under Pelantaro. All cities south of the Bío-Bío River are demolished, in what is now called Destruction of the Seven Cities.
1604年：A fort established in 1602 at the ruins of Valdivia is abandoned.
1608年：Jesuits establishes themselves in Chiloé Archipelago.
1612年：Beginning of the Defensive War phase (promoted by Luis de Valdivia) in the Arauco War.
1613年：Jesuits from Chiloé reach Guayaneco Archipelago for the first time.
1639年：The alcabala is reestablished after it had been suspended since the Disaster of Curalaba in 1598.
1640年：Llaima begins an eruption.
1641年1月6日：The first Parliament of Quillín is held.
1641年：The first large shipment of Fitzroya wood leaves Chiloé Archipelago.
1643年5月20日：A Dutch expedition led by plunders Carelmapu and Castro soon after. Governor of Chiloé Andrés Herrera dies in battle and is replaced by Fernando de Alvarado.
1643年8月28日：The Dutch, now led by Elias Herckmans, establish a base at the ruins of Valdivia.
1643年10月28日：The Dutch retreat from Valdivia to Constantino Island and then to Dutch Brazil.
1644年4月30日：Captain Juan de Acevedo departs to investigate about the Dutch presence in Valdivia, entering the site of the ruins and finding they have left.
1645年：Repopulation of Valdivia and construction of the Valdivian Fort System. Valdivia comes under direct rule of the Viceroyalty of Peru.
1647年5月13日：Santiago is struck by a devastating earthquake.
1651年1月24日：The Parliament of Boroa is held.
1651年3月21日：Spanish ship San José with provisions aimed for Valdivia wrecks of the coast south of Valdivia. Its surviving crew is killed by local Cuncos.
1654年1月11日：A Spanish army led by Juan de Salazar is defeated by local Mapuche-Huilliches as it tries to cross Bueno River in Southern Chile.
1655年2月14日：Mapuches launch a general insurrection creating turmoil as far north as Maule River, far beyond the ordinary frontier.
1656年1月20日：New governor Pedro Porter Casanate defeat a Mapuche army at the battle of Conuco.
1660年：Military leader Alejo is murdered by his two wives.
1664年：The Viceroalty of Peru estimates 30,000 to 42,000 Spaniards to have died in Chile of which half would have died by the direct consequences of the Arauco War.
1667年：Governor Francisco de Meneses is destituted after accusations of immorality against him.
1670年12月31日：The expedition of John Narborough leaves Corral Bay having surveyed the coast and lost four hostages to the Spanish.
1671年1月：The Parliament of Malloco is held.
1672年：Jesuits established in Chiloé founds the Mission of Nahuel Huapi across the Andes.
1674年11月30日：Bartolomé Gallardo's expedition reaches the mouth of San Tadeo River after crossing the isthmus of Ofqui.
1675年11月28日：The Antonio de Vea expedition departs from Chiloé to explore the fjords and channels of Patagonia.
1676年1月26日：The Antonio de Vea expedition returns to the shipyard of Chiloé.
1676年2月17日：Sixteen expeditionaries are seen for the last time while attempting to reach Evangelistas Islets.
1680年12月13日：Bartholomew Sharp destroys and pillages La Serena.
1681年：By royal decree, the Atacama desert is declared to be the border between the Captain-Generalship of Chile and the Viceroyalty of Peru.
1684年：Valdivia's original site, downtown of modern Valdivia is repopulated.
1687年10月20日：Peru is struck by a major earthquake and stem rust plague. These events marks the beginning of an era of Chilean wheat exports to Peru.
1709年：Alexander Selkirk, the inspiration for Defoe's Robinson Crusoe, is rescued from the Robinson Crusoe Island in the Juan Fernández Archipelago.
1712年2月10日：A Huilliche rebellion occurs in the Chiloé Archipelago.
1717年：The Jesuit mission at Nahuel Huapi Lake is destroyed.
1722年4月5日：Rapa Nui (Easter Island) is discovered by Dutch navigator Jacob Roggeveen.
1723年：After 30 years of peace, the War of Arauco resumes with a Mapuche uprising.
1726年：A Mapuche-Spanish peace treaty is signed at a parliament in Negrete.
1737年12月24日：A violent earthquake and subsequent tsunami strike Valdivia and Chiloé.
1740年：Valdivia is reincorporated as part of the Captaincy General of Chile.
1741年：HMS Wager is wrecked off the coast of Western Patagonia.
1742年：Martín Olleta rescue the survivors of HMS Wager and hands them over to Spanish authorities.
1749年：A fort and prison is established on Robinson Crusoe Island of Juan Fernández Archipelago.
1751年5月25日：A violent earthquake and subsequent tsunami completely destroy the city of Concepción. The earthquake causes severe destruction to cities as far away as Talca.
1759年1月27日：Cuncos and Huilliches defeat a Spanish expedition aiming to build a fort on Bueno River.
1766年12月25日：The Arauco War resumes with a large Mapuche uprising.
1767年2月：An agreement between Mapuche and Spanish authorities in Chile bring an end to the Mapuche uprising of 1766–1767.
1767年8月26日：Jesuits all over Chile are arrested as the Spanish Empire suppresses the Society of Jesus.
links: Suppression of the Society of Jesus

items.text: 1768年8月20日：Ancud is founded. Chiloé becomes part of the Viceroyalty of Peru.
1769年：Pehuenches attack Spanish settlements in Isla del Laja.
1771年：The Franciscan order assumes the religious functions of the Jesuits in Chiloé.
1771年10月：Jesuit properties in Chile begin to be auctioned.
1776年：The territories of Cuyo, previously governed as part of Chile, become part of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata. (See History of Argentina.)
links: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata

items.text: 1778年：Direct commerce between Chile and Spain is allowed.
1788年5月：Ambrosio O'Higgins, father of future Chilean independence leader Bernardo O'Higgins, is named governor of Chile.
1788年：Caicumeo, a road across forests and swamps that connects Castro with Ancud is opened.
1784年：La Moneda Palace begins construction in Santiago.
1789年：Start of the French Revolution, which affected Europe and the Americas with its ideas.
1792年：A Huilliche rebellion occurs in the surroundings of Río Bueno.

1793年：The parliaments of Negrete and Las Canoas between Spanish and native Mapuche and Huilliche are celebrated. The native chiefs accept the Spanish king as their de jure sovereign, but their own independence is also confirmed.
1796年1月13日：Governor Ambrosio O'Higgins officially begins the repopulation of Osorno atop the city ruins discovered in 1792. The city had previously been destroyed by the indigenous mapuche in 1602.
1805年：Rafael de Sobremonte, the Viceroy of the Río de la Plata, sends the first smallpox vaccines to Santiago and Lima. Friar es:Pedro Manuel Chaparro administers the vaccine throughout Santiago.
links: Rafael de Sobremonte, 3rd Marquis of Sobremonte
Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata

items.text: 1807年12月：The South American branch, under Manuel Julián Grajales, of the Real expedición filantrópica de la Vacuna (Royal Philanthropic Vaccine Expedition) reaches Santiago. Grajales proceeds to organize the Junta Central de Vacuna (Central Vaccine Board) to reinforce the smallpox immunization efforts of 1805.
1808年：Francisco Antonio García Carrasco is the unpopular Governor of Chile. The Spanish king Ferdinand VII is imprisoned by Napoleon during his invasion of Spain.
1810年：Imitating the juntista movement of the rest of Latin America, the criollos (people of Spanish ancestry, but not born in Spain) of Santiago de Chile proclaim a governing Junta.
1811年4月1日：Tomás de Figueroa leads a failed a mutiny to restore colonial order in Santiago.
1811年9月4日：José Miguel Carrera leads a successful coup d'état in Chile.
1811年10月7日：Near Vallenar the silver deposit of Agua Amarga is discovered.
1811年12月2日：The congress of Chile is dissolved and José Miguel Carrera initiates a dictatorship.

1812年：Hostilities begin between the moderados, led by Bernardo O'Higgins, and the exaltados, led by Carrera. Carrera institutes the first Chilean national symbols (flag, coat of arms, and national anthem), and Fray Camilo Henríquez begins to publish the Aurora de Chile, the first Chilean newspaper. The Chilean Constitution of 1812 comes into effect. Founding of the Logia Lautaro.

1813年：The Spanish send military expeditions (under Antonio Pareja and Gabino Gaínza) from the Viceroyalty of Peru. In the ensuing battles O'Higgins rises to be seen as a figure of great stature, overshadowing the continually less popular Carrera, who ultimately resigns. Francisco de la Lastra becomes Supreme Director.

1814年：The "Disaster of Rancagua". Mariano Osorio, in command of a third Spanish expedition, defeats O'Higgins (October 1 – 2). Osorio reconquers Santiago for Spain. Exodus of Chilean patriots to Mendoza, Argentina, where they receive the support of José de San Martín. Those patriots who remain in Chile are captured by the Spaniards are deported to the Juan Fernández Islands. Osorio is confirmed Governor of Chile by the Viceroy Fernando de Abascal of Peru. The talaveras, under the command of San Bruno, install a regime of terror extending to those merely suspected of sympathy for the Chilean cause.

1815年：Guerrilla resistance against the Spanish begins, led by Manuel Rodríguez Erdoiza, and other spies such as Justo Estay. Increasing enmity between Osorio and Abascal leads Abascal to replace Osorio with Casimiro Marcó del Pont.

1817年：Battle of Chacabuco. José de San Martín and O'Higgins defeat Rafael Maroto, reconquering Santiago. Captain San Bruno, hated chief of the talaveras, is captured and — less than 24 hours later — executed by firing squad. O'Higgins becomes dictator.

1818年：O'Higgins signs the Chilean Declaration of Independence (February 12). Shortly afterwards, in the Battle of Maipú, O'Higgins defeats a new military expedition led by Mariano Osorio, and Chile definitively obtains independence from Spain (April 5). The rivalry between O'Higgins and Manuel Rodríguez ends with the ambush and assassination of the latter in Tiltil. The brothers Juan José and Luis Carrera are shot in Argentina.

1820年：Valdivia is captured by Lord Cochrane who commands the Chilean navy. The Freedom Expedition of Perú is organised by the government of Chile, and manages to free some parts of Peru from Spanish rule.
1821年：José Miguel Carrera arrested as a montonero (mounted rebel/bandit) in Argentina, and executed in Mendoza.
1822年：The Chilean Constitution of 1822 comes into effect.
1823年：Ramón Freire leads a military expedition from Concepción to Santiago and forces O'Higgins to resign. He goes into exile in Peru, where he dies in 1842. Freire assumes power.

1825年：Taking advantage of the un-surveyed border, and ignoring the royal decree of 1681 and the principal uti possidetis, Simón Bolívar grants the port of Cobija to Bolivia. This gives Bolivia an outlet to the sea between Chile and Peru, which it will retain until the War of the Pacific.

1826年：Freire incorporates Chiloé, the last area under Spanish control, into Chile. He later resigns, initiating an interregnum known as The Anarchy. First attempt in Chile of federal (as against centralized) government, led by the first president of Chile Manuel Blanco Encalada, and the federalist José Miguel Infante.
1828年：Francisco Antonio Pinto assumes power after the resignation of Encalada and his predecessors. Chilean Constitution of 1828.
1829年：Chilean Civil War of 1829. After several battles, Joaquín Prieto defeats Ramón Freire in the Battle of Lircay.
約1830年：Charles Saint Lambert introduces reverberatory furnaces to Chile initiating a revolution in copper mining in Chile.
1830年：Diego Portales begins to remodel Chilean institutions, converting the country into an authoritarian republic.

1831年：José Joaquín Prieto becomes president of Chile. He will serve two consecutive five-year terms. With him, the so-called decenios (decade-long reigns) begin, which continue until 1871. This 30-year Conservative Party hegemony is sometimes referred to as the Authoritarian Republic.

1832年：Discovery of mineral deposits in Chañarcillo, and the beginning of the rise of silver in what was then el Norte Chico and now constitutes the Atacama and Coquimbo regions of Chile. The mining fortunes constitute an important source of power in the following decades.
1833年：Chilean Constitution of 1833. "Portalian" — that is, inspired by Diego Portales — definitively fixed Chilean institutions.
1834年：Charles Darwin lands at Valparaíso, during the second voyage of HMS Beagle. He also visits Santiago.
1835年：Southern Chile is affected by the worst earthquake for several decades on 20 February, an event witnessed by Charles Darwin. Darwin visits Valdivia, Concepción and Mendoza.
1836年：Diego Portales declares the war on the Peruvian-Bolivian Confederation.
1837年：Diego Portales is assassinated by mutinous soldiers in Quillota. A Chilean military expedition debarks in Perú, beginning the War of the Confederation.
1837年11月17日：An earthquake strikes Valdivia and Chiloé. The earthquake caused a tsunami that struck Hawaii, what is now French Polynesia and Japan.
1839年：Battle of Yungay and defeat of the Confederation.
1840年：The Vatican acknowledges the Independence of Chile
1841年：Manuel Bulnes, victorious marshal of the Battle of Yungay, elected president of Chile.
1843年9月17日：The University of Chile is founded.
1843年9月21日：The crew of Ancud takes formal possession of the Strait of Magellan on behalf of Chile.
1844年：Spain recognizes the Independence of Chile
1848年：Founding of Punta Arenas in the Strait of Magellan

1851年：José María de la Cruz revolts in the southern provinces of Chile. Bulnes crushes the revolutionary attempt and signs the treaty of Purapel with the revolutionaries. Manuel Montt becomes the third of the decenal presidents.
1851年11月17日：Mutiny of Cambiazo: Mutineers led by José Miguel Cambiazo ravages the nascent settlement of Punta Arenas.
1853年2月12日：The city of Puerto Montt is founded.

1856年：The Dispute of Sacristán ("Cuestión del Sacristán"). An apparently trivial question of ecclesiastical discipline divides the Conservative Party into secular and ultra-Catholic factions, which lays the ground for their political defeat in the elections of 1861.
1857年：The Civil Code of Chile comes into effect; it will become a model for Latin American legal codes down to the present day.

1859年：Chilean Revolution of 1859. Pedro León Gallo, radical revolutionary of Copiapó, and others are defeated by the government forces. However, as a consequence, Antonio Varas renounces to his candidature.
1861年：José Joaquín Pérez of the Liberal Party elected president. His party will retain power until the Chilean Revolution of 1891.
1863年：A French adventurer proclaims himself Orélie Antoine I, King of Araucanía. After a short time he is arrested by the Chileans and deported in the pacification of Araucanía.
1866年：Chile, Ecuador, Peru, and Bolivia at war with Spain. The port of Valparaíso is bombed by the Spanish. A treaty of limits (borders) of 1866 is signed with Bolivia.

1871年：A constitutional reform prohibits re-election, resulting in the end of the decenios. Governments of five years duration persist until 1925, except for the premature death of Pedro Montt in 1910.
1874年：Another treaty of limits is signed with Bolivia due to political tensions.

1879年：The War of the Pacific begins with Chilean troops occupying the then-Bolivian port city of Antofagasta. Bolivia's ally Peru attempts to mediate, but Chile refuses to negotiate and Peru enters the war on the side of Bolivia. Chile captures the provinces of Antofagasta from Bolivia and Tarapacá from Peru.
1880年：The United States attempts to mediate in the Lackawanna Conference, but both sides refuse to negotiate.
1881年：Chilean troops occupy Lima, the capital of Perú. Boundary treaty of 1881 between Chile and Argentina.
links: Boundary treaty of 1881 between Chile and Argentina

items.text: 1883年：The Treaty of Ancón is signed with Perú to end the war, but hostilities with Bolivia continue. Law of Civil Matrimony adopted. This secularization was fiercely resisted by the Roman Catholic Church. The "Pacification of Araucanía" ends, and according to some historians this concludes the long-running War of Arauco.

1884年：The War of the Pacific ends with the signing of a truce with Bolivia. Chile's territorial gains allow the mining of saltpeter in the conquered regions, leading to great national prosperity for Chile. Treaty called "Pacto de Tregua".
1888年6月21日：The Pontifical Catholic University of Chile is established.
1888年9月9日：Policarpo Toro ahead of a naval expedition takes possession of Easter Island.
1888年11月：The pirate Pedro Ñancúpel is executed in Castro.
1890年：The Malleco Viaduct is opened and railway traffic expands further south during the following decades.
1891年：1891 Chilean Civil War. The constitutional president José Manuel Balmaceda is overthrown by troops favorable to the National Congress. The beginning of "Parliamentarism".
1895年：Easter Island is rented to Compañía Explotadora de Isla de Pascua.
1903年3月20日：The first auction of sheep farming lands in the Magallanes Territory takes place.

1905年10月22日：The Meat riot in Santiago begins. The workers revolt against the central government due to an increase in the cost of living, including the price of meat. The government responds sending in the army. Two days of riots follow, during which hundreds of civilians are killed in street fighting.

1907年：Massacre of the Escuela Santa María de Iquique; soldiers fire on saltpeter workers and their unarmed associates. It will be years before the workers, terrorized by the brutal repression, resume the struggle for their rights.
links: Massacre of the Escuela Santa María de Iquique

items.text: 1910年：Centenary of Chilean independence. Celebrations are darkened by the death of President Pedro Montt, the only president between 1831 and 1925 did not serve for a full five-year term.
1912年10月21日：15 Mapuche-Huilliche are killed by Chilean police in the Forrahue massacre near Osorno.
1914年8月15日：The Panama Canal opens; with Atlantic–Pacific shipping redirected to the new canal, the formerly crucial port of Valparaíso enters an economic decline.
1914年11月1日：First World War: A German naval squadron decisively defeats a British squadron at the Battle of Coronel, off the coast of Chile.
1920年：Arturo Alessandri Palma is elected president, indicating a rise to power by the Chilean middle classes.
1924年：Chile's first income tax is levied.

1925年：After intense political agitation the Chilean Constitution of 1925 is adopted, only slightly less authoritarian than that of 1833. The Impuesto Global Complementario, a graduated income tax, is introduced.

1927年：In a bloodless coup, Carlos Ibáñez del Campo takes the presidency by force during great political instability. He subsequently governs as a dictator until 1931. The corps of Carabineros — paramilitary police — is founded.
1928年12月1日：A magnitude 7.7 Mw earthquake strikes Talca.
1929年：The crash of 1929 begins to affect the Chilean economy. The World Economic Survey of the League of Nations estimated that Chile was the worst affected nation by the Great Depression.
1930年3月21日：Fuerza Aérea de Chile (Chilean Air Force) founded.
1931年：The deep economic crisis obliges Ibáñez del Campo to step down. A series of civilian governments and military juntas follows, some of which last no more than a few days.
1932年：The period of political anarchy ends with the return to power of Arturo Alessandri Palma.
1934年：Women obtain the legal right to vote in municipal elections.
1938年：Massacre of Seguro Obrero: the Carabineros execute members of the fascist National Socialist Movement of Chile (Nacistas), after the fascists attempted to oust the government in a coup d'état.
1939年：The Radical Party gains power, which they will retain until 1952.
1940年：President Pedro Aguirre Cerda registers the first Chilean claims in Antarctica.
1945年：Chilean poet Gabriela Mistral receives the Nobel Prize for Literature.
1945年6月19日：The Smoke Tragedy leaves 355 workers dead in the underground copper mine of El Teniente.

1946年：Gabriel González Videla becomes president, backed by a broad alliance of parties, including the Radicals and Communists. Once in power, he accedes to pressure from the United States and promulgates the Law of Permanent Defense of the Democracy, also known as the Ley Maldita ("accursed law"). The law outlawed his former allies the Communists, some of whom were placed in concentration camps in Pisagua. Poet Pablo Neruda is hounded into exile.
links: Law of Permanent Defense of the Democracy

items.text: 1949年：Women obtain the legal right to vote in both presidential and parliamentary elections.
1949年8月6日：First publication of Condorito comic in :es:Okey magazine.
1952年：Carlos Ibáñez del Campo returns to the presidency, this time via the ballot box, ending the era of the Radical Party.
1958年：Argentine forces destroy a Chilean lighthouse during the Snipe incident.
1960年2月：First instance of the yearly Viña del Mar International Song Festival is organized.
links: Viña del Mar International Song Festival

items.text: 1960年5月22日：The magnitude 9.5 Mw Great Chilean earthquake, the most intense earthquake ever recorded, hits offshore near Valdivia. The earthquake generated a tsunami which spread across the Pacific Ocean, affecting Chile, Hawaii, Japan, the Philippines, and New Zealand, among many.
links: List of tsunamis affecting New Zealand

items.text: 1962年：Chile hosts the FIFA World Cup football competition. The Chile national football team comes in 3rd; its highest ever placement in the competition.

1964年：Christian Democrat Eduardo Frei Montalva becomes president, proclaiming the so-called "Revolution in Liberty". His election campaign was largely (and secretly) funded by the CIA, an intelligence agency of the United States.

1970年9月4日：Salvador Allende is elected president; the first democratic election of a Marxist politician. The election campaign was highly polarised and subject to covert interference by foreign intelligence agencies (the CIA and KGB). Allende's socialist and Marxist orientation greatly displeased the government of the United States which directed resources to "prevent Allende from coming to power or to unseat him".

1970年10月25日：Commander-in-Chief of the Chilean Army René Schneider is assassinated in Santiago in an alleged kidnapping attempt. The group responsible received material support prior to and after the crime from the CIA.
1971年：Poet Pablo Neruda receives Nobel Prize for Literature.
1971年7月11日：The nationalization of all large copper mines in Chile is completed.
1972年：Chile truckers' strike against the Popular Unity government headed by the President Salvador Allende.
1973年6月：The international social sciences conference Primer Congreso del Hombre Andino is held in the cities of Arica, Iquique and Antofagasta.
