1973年6月29日：An attempted coup d'état led by junior officers known as El Tanquetazo is suppressed.

1973年9月11日：The armed forces, carabineros, and others stage a violent coup by overthrowing Allende, who dies in the course of the coup. Some historians believe that the coup was supported or encouraged by the CIA. In the aftermath, Augusto Pinochet establishes himself as the head of a military junta. The subsequent repression of leftists and other opponents of the military regime results in approximately 130,000 arrests and at least 2,000 dead or "disappeared" over the next 17 years.
1977年：Beagle conflict: The binding Beagle Channel Arbitration awards the Picton, Nueva and Lennox islands to Chile.
1978年：Beagle conflict: Argentina refuses to abide by the judgement and invades Chile in Operation Soberania. Argentine forces withdraw before any combat occurs.

1980年：The military government promulgates the Chilean Constitution of 1980, which is adopted by plebiscite. Economic policy begins to be significantly influenced by the ideas of the Chicago School and of Neoliberalism. The United States oblige President of the Philippines Ferdinand Marcos to cancel a scheduled visit by President Pinochet to the Philippines.
1982年：Chile provides non-combat support for British armed forces during the Falkland War.
1984年：Beagle conflict: Treaty of Peace and Friendship of 1984 between Chile and Argentina is signed.
links: Treaty of Peace and Friendship of 1984 between Chile and Argentina

items.text: 1988年：Pinochet loses a plebiscite mandated by the constitution, which triggers elections the following year.
1990年：Patricio Aylwin takes office as president after democratic elections. The Chilean transition to democracy begins.
1991年3月14日：Escondida in Chile's Atacama Desert –which was to become the worlds most productive copper mine– is officially inaugurated.
1991年6月18日：More than 90 people die in Antofagasta and Taltal as result of mudflows generated by unusual rainfall in the Atacama Desert.
1991年6月21日：The volcano Mount Hudson in Patagonia erupts, in one of the world's largest volcanic eruptions of the twentieth century.
1994年：Eduardo Frei Ruiz-Tagle is elected president.

1995年8月：A limatic event consisting of intense winds, cold, snowfall and rain that and known as the White Earthquake occurred through southern Chile. 7,176 people were left isolated as result of the heavy snowfall and three died.

1998年：During a visit to London for medical reasons, Augusto Pinochet is arrested in accord with the orders of Spanish judge Baltasar Garzón, beginning an international struggle between his supporters and detractors. He returns to Chile the following year, and the charges against him are later thrown out on the basis of his mental state. Chile suffers greatly from a world economic crisis, resulting in years of inflation and unemployment.
links: Indictment and arrest of Augusto Pinochet

items.text: 2000年：In the second round of voting, in a tight contest with right wing candidate Joaquín Lavín, Ricardo Lagos Escobar is elected president.
2001年：Chile Promotes the death penalty for ordinary crimes.
2001年11月30日：Eduardo Miño commits suicide by self-immolation in protest to government neglect of Pizarreño's asbestos victims.
2004年：The Supreme Court of Chile declares that Augusto Pinochet is mentally competent to stand trial.
2005年：The Pinochet trial continues. The presidential election of December 11 puts Michelle Bachelet and Sebastián Piñera into a second round.
2006年12月10日：Augusto Pinochet dies.
2007年4月5日：Chile Helps Fund a Christian school in Austin, TX
2010年2月27日：2010 Chile earthquake.
2010年3月11日：Sebastián Piñera assumed office as President of Chile.
2010年：Copiapó mining accident.
2011年：2011 student protests, and later massive protest claiming for better education and economic equality.
2014年：Michelle Bachelet assumed office as President of Chile as the first woman to be reelected.
2017年7月16日：Snowfall in the capital Santiago.
2019年10月18日：The 2019–2020 Chilean protests escalated dramatically.

約前10000年：The earliest traces of humans are dated from the Paleolithic period, and there are further signs in the Mesolithic and Neolithic. However, large areas of the interior were apparently depopulated during an extensive dry period between 4000 and 2000 BC.
前500年：Irrigation permitted development of sedentary agriculture of staple crops in western and northwestern Andean region
1年：Several corn-based civilizations developed in the western and northwestern Andean region (Ansilta, Condorhuasi, Cienaga, Aguada, Santa Maria, Huarpes, Diaguitas, Sanavirones, among others)
600年：Development of metallurgical technologies, permitting elaborate bronzeworks
700年：Cueva de las Manos was last inhabited, with the final cave dwellers possibly being ancestors of the Tehuelche tribes.
850年：Emergence of fortified urban settlements
1480年：The Inca Empire, under the rule of emperor Pachacutec, launched an offensive and conquered present-day northwestern Argentina, integrating it into a region called Qullasuyu

1516年：Spanish navigator Juan Díaz de Solís first European explorer to visit Río de la Plata, on territory which is now Argentina; Díaz de Solís killed and supposedly cannibalised by native Charrúa, Querandí or Guaraní
1526年：Sebastian Cabot sailed up Paraná River and built short-lived fort near modern Rosario
1536年：Santa María del Buen Ayre founded by Pedro de Mendoza on site of modern Buenos Aires
1541年：Santa María del Buen Ayre settlement abandoned after indigenous attacks
1553年：Santiago del Estero founded by Francisco de Aguirre (some claim 1550)
1561年：Mendoza founded
1562年：San Juan founded
1573年：Córdoba and Santa Fe founded
1580年：Permanent colony re-established by Spain on the site of Buenos Aires as part of the Viceroyalty of Peru; initial settlement was primarily overland from Peru
1582年：Salta founded
1591年：La Rioja founded
1593年：San Salvador de Jujuy founded
1609年：First Jesuit missions to the Guaraní founded in the Upper Paraná area. San Ignacio in Misiones
1613年：National University of Córdoba founded by Jesuits
1657年：Diaguita rebellion led by Spanish rebel, Pedro Bohórquez
1661年：San Ignacio school in Córdoba founded by Jesuits
1680年：The Portuguese established a trading post across the Rio de la Plata from Buenos Aires
1685年：City of Tucumán moved to present location
1767年：Jesuits expelled from Spanish territories

1776年：Establishment of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata (Spanish: Virreinato del Río de la Plata) comprising today's Argentina, Uruguay, and Paraguay, as well as much of present-day Bolivia, declared with Buenos Aires as its capital
links: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata

items.text: 1794年：Establishment of the Commerce Consulate of Buenos Aires

1806年：British invasions of the River Plate unsuccessfully attempt to establish control over Spain's southern colonies as part of the Napoleonic Wars. Spanish troops offer no defence but British repelled by local civilians and militias (to 1807)
links: British invasions of the River Plate

items.text: 1810年5月：Secret meetings in 1810 organised a petition for an open meeting – Cabildo Abierto
1810年5月：The petition was refused by viceroy Baltasar Hidalgo de Cisneros, but popular protest forced his hand on 22 May.
1810年5月22日：The Cabildo opened its session with 251 of the city's most prominent citizens, and discussed the future government of the provinces.

1810年5月23日：The assembly voted for the removal of the viceroy and the creation of the Primera Junta of locals to govern Buenos Aires, proclaiming loyalty to Ferdinand VII. This was properly agreed and the Junta sworn in on 25 May.
1810年：Unsuccessful military campaigns in Paraguay and Alto Perú failed to gather support for joint action by the entire viceroyalty against Spanish forces (to 1811).
1810年5月：News of Napoleon's invasion of Spain caused a power vacuum in Buenos Aires leading to a series of events known as the May Revolution.
1810年12月：Junta Grande, with delegates from other provinces of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, replaced Primera Junta.
links: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata

items.text: 1811年9月：First Triumvirate of Feliciano Chiclana, Juan José Paso and Manuel de Sarratea replaced Junta Grande.
1812年8月23日：The Jujuy Exodus was led by Manuel Belgrano, with several thousand soldiers and civilians retreating from Jujuy and Salta, to avoid military defeat and defections.
1812年10月8日：Second Triumvirate of Nicolás Rodriguez Peña, Antonio Álvarez Jonte and Juan José Paso replaced First Triumvirate.
1813年1月31日：The Assembly of the Year XIII called in February to plan further military campaigns and organise defence of Buenos Aires
1813年2月3日：The Battle of San Lorenzo, the first battle of José de San Martín in the Argentine War of Independence.
1814年1月31日：Second Triumvirate replaced by position of Supreme Director, first occupied by Gervasio Antonio de Posadas
1814年：Battle of Buceo saw United Provinces' fleet defeat Spanish navy securing coast.
1815年：Defeats in battles in late 1815 led to final loss of modern Bolivia
1816年3月：An assembly of provincial delegates met as the Congress of Tucumán to discuss future military and political developments
1816年7月9日：The Congress declared the independence of Argentina

1820年：The Battle of Cepeda took place between Unitarians who supported a strong centralised state, and Federals, largely provincial caudillo warlords who wanted decentralised authority. The Federals won and the February 1820 Treaty of Pilar declared Argentina as a federal country, although Unitarian ideals continued
1825年：The United Kingdom recognises Argentine independence.

1825年：Deputies from the eastern bank of the Río de la Plata declare independence from Brazil, leading to the Cisplatine War. The 1827 Battle of Ituzaingó saw tactical success for Argentina. The war ended in 1828 with a treaty giving independence to Uruguay
1828年：Luis Vernet establishes settlement on the Falkland Islands
1829年12月6日：Juan Manuel de Rosas became governor of Buenos Aires Province
1830年：Yaghan aboriginal Jemmy Button (Orundellico) taken from Tierra del Fuego to England by Robert FitzRoy on HMS Beagle
1831年1月4日：Pacto Federal signed between provinces to protect federal nature of country
1831年：The Voyage of the Beagle with Charles Darwin and Robert FitzRoy visited the Río de la Plata, Patagonia and Tierra del Fuego (to 1834)
1831年：Argentine Governor of the Falkland Islands Luis Vernet is expelled by USS Lexington following his seizure of United States interests. New governor murdered in 1832 mutiny
1833年：Juan Manuel de Rosas begins the First Conquest of the Desert
1833年1月2日：British forces re-occupy the Falkland Islands
links: Reassertion of British sovereignty over the Falkland Islands (1833)

items.text: 1839年：Rosas made Supreme Chief of the Argentine Confederation
1852年：Rosas overthrown by Justo José de Urquiza following Battle of Caseros
1853年5月1日：Constitution of Argentina agreed by assembly in Santa Fe, creating modern system of government
1854年：Urquiza became first President of Argentina in modern sense but opposed by Buenos Aires, still opposed to federal project
1859年：Defeat of Unitarian forces led by Bartolomé Mitre by Urquiza and federals at Battle of Cepeda; Buenos Aires re-enters confederation
1861年3月20日：Mendoza earthquake kills 6,000 to 12,000 citizens of Mendoza.
1864年11月13日：Start of Paraguayan War between Paraguay and the Triple Alliance of Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay, leading to utter defeat of Paraguay by 1870
1878年：Commencement of the Conquest of the Desert against indigenous inhabitants of the south led by Julio Argentino Roca; final surrender by 1884
1880年：Roca became president, finally defeated federals and moved capital to Buenos Aires from Rosario
1884年9月：Gold is discovered near Cape Virgenes sparking the Tierra del Fuego gold rush
1890年6月26日：Founding of the Radical Civic Union (UCR) or Radical Party
1890年：The Panic of 1890 brought the Baring Brothers bank in London close to collapse after disastrous investments in Argentina
1895年：Mandatory military service (Conscription) established
1902年：The Drago Doctrine is announced by the Argentine Minister of Foreign Affairs Luis María Drago.
1912年2月：Sáenz Peña Law introduces universal, secret and compulsory male suffrage, end of the Generation of '80
1916年10月12日：Start of presidency of Hipólito Yrigoyen, UCR democratic reformist
1918年：Students strikes and demonstrations enforce the university reform of shared powers between teachers, graduates and students
1927年10月10日：Fabrica Militar de Aviones aircraft factory founded in Cordoba
1930年：Military coup deposed Yrigoyen, starting the 'Infamous Decade'
1931年：General Agustín Pedro Justo declared winner of Presidency following 'patriotic fraud' in election
1943年：'National Revolution' led by nationalist military officers including Colonel Juan Perón; ensured continued non-intervention in World War II
1944年1月15日：San Juan earthquake destroys provincial capital, kills 10,000.
1945年：Argentina enters World War II on the side of the Allies and admitted as founding member of United Nations
1945年：Perón arrested then freed after major popular protest by those known as the Descamisados
1946年5月15日：Indigenous people march in Malón de la Paz to Buenos Aires to demand land rights
1946年6月4日：Perón elected president; re-elected to presidency in 1951
1947年：Women's suffrage is approved
1950年5月31日：The National Atomic Energy Commission (Comisión Nacional de Energía Atómica, CNEA) is founded
1950年6月27日：First flight of the FMA IAe 33 Pulqui II, the first jet fighter to be entirely developed and built in Latin America.
1952年7月26日：Death of Eva Perón
1955年9月：Perón ousted in 'Liberating Revolution' military coup
1956年12月4日：INTA (National Agricultural Technology Institute), is created
1957年12月27日：INTI (National Institute of Industrial Technology), is created
1958年：ARA Independencia, the first aircraft carrier of the Argentine Navy, enters service
1962年3月29日：Military coup ended presidency of civilian Arturo Frondizi
1966年：General Juan Carlos Onganía assumed power and represses political parties
1967年10月9日：Death of Ernesto 'Che' Guevara
1969年5月：In the Cordobazo protests, thousands of citizens routed the army and police and took control of Córdoba for two days
1969年8月20日：A counterinsurgency aircraft, the FMA IA 58 Pucará, flies for the first time
1969年：Aircraft carrier ARA Veinticinco de Mayo replaces ARA Independencia
1970年：General Alejandro Agustín Lanusse emerged as president after Onganía toppled
1970年：Civil conflict and terrorist attacks, principally by left-wing Montoneros and Ejército Revolucionario del Pueblo opposed by paramilitary Argentine Anticommunist Alliance (to 1976)
1973年6月20日：The Ezeiza massacre takes place upon Perón's return from exile, when members of the Triple A open fire on the crowd awaiting him.
1973年：Democratic elections brought Peronist Héctor José Cámpora to power; Perón elected president in fresh elections later that year
1974年：Atucha Nuclear Power Plant, the first nuclear power plant in Latin America, began operation
1974年：Death of Juan Perón, leaving widow Isabel Perón as president
1976年3月24日：A military coup deposed Isabel Perón

1976年3月24日：The Proceso de Reorganización Nacional military government led by Jorge Videla repressed political and armed opposition through use of torture, forced disappearance and extrajudicial killing up of to 30,000 people (to 1983)
1976年9月1日：The high tech company INVAP is created.
1978年6月：Argentina hosted and won the 1978 FIFA World Cup
1978年：Argentina refused the binding Beagle Channel arbitration and started the Operation Soberanía in order to invade Chile
1982年4月：Leader General Leopoldo Galtieri sent troops to the Falkland Islands triggering Falklands War; British task force retook islands by mid-June
1983年12月10日：Military government collapsed; election of Radical Raúl Alfonsín as president
1984年1月20日：Embalse Nuclear Power Station began operations
1984年10月6日：The trainer aircraft FMA IA-63 Pampa flight for the first time.
1984年11月29日：The Treaty of Peace and Friendship of 1984 between Chile and Argentina ends border dispute over Picton, Nueva and Lennox islands
links: Treaty of Peace and Friendship of 1984 between Chile and Argentina

items.text: 1985年：La Historia Oficial film won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film
links: Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film

items.text: 1986年：Argentina wins 1986 FIFA World Cup, captained by Diego Maradona
1987年4月：First uprising by Carapintadas, commanded by Colonel Aldo Rico, two arrested. Alfonsín declares La casa está en orden (The house is in order)
1988年1月：Second Carapintada revolt, again under Rico's command in January, 300 arrested
1988年：Third and last Carapintada uprising, led by Mohamed Alí Seineldín, two arrested
1989年：Dissident military group attacks La Tablada regiment, but are finally seized
1989年：Hyper-inflation and political turmoil brings Peronist Carlos Menem to power in election
1990年：Neo-liberal economic policies and privatisations brought general strikes, hunger strikes and political party realignments
1991年：Argentine peso pegged to United States dollar
1991年：Argentina is the only Latin American country to participate in the first Gulf War under mandate of the United Nations
1991年：Mercosur customs union founded by the Treaty of Asunción
1991年：Argentina, Brazil and Chile signed the Mendoza Declaration prohibiting Chemical Weapons
links: Argentina and weapons of mass destruction

items.text: 1992年：Israeli Embassy attack in Buenos Aires killed 29 in terrorist attack
links: Israeli Embassy attack in Buenos Aires

items.text: 1993年：Argentina joins UNFICYP mission at Cyprus. As of 2006, ground troops and helicopters are serving there and since 1999 have other Latin American countries troops embedded.
1994年：Following the Pact of Olivos, the constitution reform is agreed, allowing Presidents to serve second consecutive term
links: 1994 amendment of the Constitution of Argentina

items.text: 1994年：Bombing of AMIA Jewish Community Centre in Buenos Aires, killing 85
1994年：The murder of Omar Carrasco, a 20-year-old conscript, leads President Menem to abolishing conscription
1995年：Menem won second term
1995年：Argentina acceded to the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty
1995年：FMA privatized into Lockheed Martin Aircraft Argentina
1996年：Radical Fernando de la Rúa elected first Mayor of Buenos Aires
1997年：Radicals, left-wing FrePaSo and others joined forces as Alianza electoral alliance to oppose Menem and Peronists
1997年：The A-4AR Fightinghawk enter service in the Argentine Air Force
1998年：U.S. President Bill Clinton designated Argentina as a major non-NATO ally
1999年：De la Rúa won Presidency as head of the Alianza, but was confronted by growing economic crisis
1999年：In one of the worst accidents in the history of Argentinian aviation, LAPA Flight 3142 crash at Aeroparque Jorge Newbery airport resulted in 65 fatalities.
2000年：High tech company INVAP is chosen by Australia to design and construct the OPAL nuclear reactor
2000年：Vice-President Carlos Álvarez resigned in protest political bribes scandal, precipitating crisis in ruling alliance
2001年：In March, the remaining FrePaSo ministers resigned from government in protest at economic and labour reforms
2001年11月：The government responded to a run on banks by limiting access to bank deposits in the corralito

2001年12月：Events that have become known as the Argentinazo took place: Middle classes, exasperated with constraints of corralito, took to streets in protest in the Cacerolazo Trade unions and piqueteros began protests, and shops and businesses were ransacked Violent protests and mass demonstrations in the Plaza de Mayo; 26 die in protests nationwide Finance minister Domingo Cavallo and President de la Rúa resigned in quick succession on 19 and 20 December Provincial governor Adolfo Rodríguez Saá appointed president by Argentine Congress on 22 December Rodríguez Saá declared a short-lived debt moratorium. After a few days, Argentina officially defaulted on $93 billion of its debt to the International Monetary Fund and creditors Rodríguez Saá resigned after a week following lack of support from colleagues Eduardo Duhalde, losing candidate in the 1999 presidential elections, appointed president with broad cross-party support
2002年：Duhalde imposes further financial measures, including converting dollar accounts to pesos, scrapping 1:1 parity with the dollar, and social measures to bring economy under control
2003年：Former President Carlos Menem wins first round of presidential election but pulls out facing certain defeat, handing victory to fellow Peronist Néstor Kirchner
2004年4月：More than 100,000 people demonstrated in Buenos Aires in support of Juan Carlos Blumberg, father of murdered student Axel Blumberg, demanding harsher criminal laws.
2004年：Kirchner pursued Argentine debt restructuring
2004年：Natural gas supply shortage produced tension with Chile
2004年9月1日：Secretariat of the Antarctic Treaty established in Buenos Aires
2004年12月30日：A fire in the República Cromagnon nightclub in Buenos Aires kills 194 people and injures over 1,000.
2005年2月：Relations between Catholic Church and government broke down between military chaplain and minister over abortion
2005年：Supreme Court overruled 'Laws of Pardon' that were used to pardon military figures of the Dirty War
2005年：First disputes of the Cellulose plant conflict between Argentina and Uruguay
links: Cellulose plant conflict between Argentina and Uruguay

items.text: 2005年10月：Mid-term elections saw a massive split in the Justicialist Party between Kirchner's centre-left Front for Victory faction and the rump of his former patron Duhalde and other provincial leaders; Front for Victory wins by large margin
2005年：Massive demonstrations against U.S. President George W. Bush at the 4th Summit of the Americas in Mar del Plata
2005年12月：Kirchner announced cancellation of IMF debt with single, final payment
2006年3月：Buenos Aires mayor Aníbal Ibarra removed from office following accusations of negligence regarding the República Cromagnon nightclub fire of 2004

2007年10月9日：Catholic priest Christian von Wernich is found guilty of involvement in seven murders and 42 cases of kidnapping and torture related to the state-sponsored Dirty War. Von Wernich is sentenced to life imprisonment.
2007年12月10日：Cristina Kirchner assumes as new president of Argentina.
2010年7月22日：Same-sex marriage has been legal in Argentina
2020年12月：The abortion law was liberalized when the Voluntary Interruption of Pregnancy Bill was passed by the National Congress.
1000年：Marajoara culture flourishes as an Amazonian center.

1492年－1502年：Voyages of Christopher Columbus: navigator Christopher Columbus, sailing in the employ of Castile and Aragon, departed from Palos de la Frontera in search of a westward route to the East Indies.

1494年6月7日：Treaty of Tordesillas: Spain and Portugal divide the New World between themselves. Even though the treaty was negotiated without consulting the Pope, a few sources call the resulting line the "Papal Line of Demarcation".
1500年：Spanish navigator Vicente Yáñez Pinzón lands in the coast of Brazil but is prevented from claiming it by the Treaty of Tordesillas.
1500年4月22日：Portuguese navigator Pedro Álvares Cabral officially discovers Brazil and claims the land for the Kingdom of Portugal. He has 13 vessels with him.
1500年7月18日：Amerigo Vespucci Letter from Seville describes experiences on Alonso de Ojeda's May 1499 voyage. The letter is notable for its description of the Brazilian coast and its inhabitants.
1502年1月1日：Portuguese explorers, led either by Gaspar de Lemos or Gonçalo Coelho, sail into Guanabara Bay, Brazil, which they name Rio de Janeiro.
1502年：Beginning of the exploitation of brazilwood.
1502年：The Trindade and Martin Vaz Islands are discovered in 1502 by Portuguese navigators led by Estêvão da Gama, and, along with Brazil, became part of the Portuguese Empire.

1503年8月10日：The Fernando de Noronha island is discovered by a Portuguese expedition, organized and financed by a private commercial consortium headed by the Lisbon merchant Fernão de Loronha. The expedition is under the overall command of captain Gonçalo Coelho and carries the Italian adventurer Amerigo Vespucci aboard, who writes an account of it.
1516年：The first sugar cane mills appear in Pernambuco.

1527年：Cristóvão Jacques imprisons three French galleons in Recôncavo, Bahia. But having acted with barbarity towards the prisoners, this gesture eventually caused him major problems with Dom João III.
1530年－1533年：Martim Afonso de Sousa's expedition patrols the Brazilian coast, banishes the French, and creates the first colonial town: São Vicente.
1531年：Bertrand d'Ornesan tries to establish a French trading post at Pernambuco.
1532年1月22日：São Vicente is established as the first permanent Portuguese settlement in Brazil.
1534年：The Captaincies of Brazil are established by King Dom João III. Colonial Brazil is divided into fifteen captaincies
1534年－1536年：Iguape War in the region of São Vicente.
1537年3月12日：The Portuguese establish Recife in Pernambuco, in the Northeast of Brazil.
1539年－1542年：The first African slaves arrive in Pernambuco.
1549年3月29日：The city of Salvador, Brazil's first capital, is founded by Tomé de Sousa.
1551年：Portugal founds a sugar colony at Bahia.
1554年1月25日：Missionaries Joseph of Anchieta and Manuel da Nóbrega establish São Paulo, then named São Paulo dos Campos de Piratininga, in southeast Brazil.
links: São Paulo dos Campos de Piratininga

items.text: 1557年：German adventurer Hans Staden publishes a widely translated account of his detention by the Tupi people of Brazil, Warhaftige Historia und beschreibung eyner Landtschafft der Wilden Nacketen, Grimmigen Menschfresser-Leuthen in der Newenwelt America gelegen ("True Story and Description of a Country of Wild, Naked, Grim, Man-eating People in the New World, America").
1560年3月17日：Fort Coligny on Villegagnon Island in Rio de Janeiro is attacked and destroyed during the Portuguese campaign against France Antarctique.
1565年3月1日：Estácio de Sá founds Rio de Janeiro as São Sebastião do Rio de Janeiro.

1580年3月25日：Iberian Union: King Philip II of Spain becomes King of Portugal under the name Philip I, following the death without heirs of King Henry of Portugal, in a personal union of the crowns, thus maintaining Portuguese independence (in Europe and throughout the Portuguese Empire, including Brazil). The Philippine Dynasty rule lasts until 1640.
1588年－1591年：English privateer Thomas Cavendish loots Santos and São Vicente before losing most of the crew in a battle against the Portuguese at the village of Vitória.
1595年：Anglo–Spanish War: an English military expedition led by James Lancaster captures Recife.

1608年：Thornton expedition: a Tuscan expedition under Captain Robert Thornton, sent by Ferdinando I of Tuscany to explore northern Brazil and the Amazon River and prepare for the establishment of a settlement in northern coastal South America, which would serve as a base to export Brazilian wood to Renaissance Italy. which would be colonised by France in 1630. The expedition was the only attempt by an Italian state to colonise the Americas.

1612年9月8日：São Luís is founded by the French, who intend to make it the center of the Equinoctial France. They build a fort named Saint-Louis de Maragnan after King Louis XIII and his Saintly ancestor Louis IX.

1616年：6-year-old António Vieira arrives from Portugal, with his parents, in Salvador in Colonial Brazil where he will become a diplomat, noted author, leading figure of the Church, and protector of local indigenous peoples.
1616年：Physician Aleixo de Abreu is granted a pension of 16,000 reis for services to the crown in Angola and Brazil by Philip III of Spain, who also appoints him physician of his chamber.
1616年：A slave ship carries smallpox from the Kingdom of Kongo to Salvador.

1616年1月12日：The city of Belém, Brazil, is founded on the Amazon River delta by the Portuguese captain Francisco Caldeira Castelo Branco, who had previously taken the city of São Luís in Maranhão from the French.
1624年：The Dutch West India Company invades the Portuguese colony of Bahia in Brazil.
1625年4月30日：The Portuguese recapture Salvador from the Dutch, with the help of a combined Spanish and Portuguese force, consisting of 52 ships and 12,500 men.
1630年：The Dutch West India Company invades the Portuguese colony of Pernambuco and founds Dutch Brazil.
1631年9月12日：Eighty Years' War: a Spanish fleet under the command of admiral Antonio de Oquendo defeats a Dutch fleet off the coast of Brazil in the Battle of Albrolhos.
1641年：The first Rio Carnival happens to celebrate Dom João IV's coronation as king of Portugal.
1641年3月11日：Guaraní forces living in the Jesuit missions defeat bandeirantes loyal to the Portuguese Empire at the Battle of Mbororé in present-day Panambí, Argentina.
1642年：Isaac Aboab da Fonseca is appointed rabbi in Pernambuco, thus becoming the first rabbi of the Americas.
1644年5月6日：Johan Mauritius resigns as Governor of Dutch Brazil.
1648年4月19日：First Battle of Guararapes: the Portuguese army defeats the Dutch army in northeast Brazil.
1649年2月19日：Second Battle of Guararapes: decisive Portuguese victory against the Dutch in northeast Brazil.
1654年：After several years of open warfare, the Dutch withdraw from Brazil; the Portuguese paid off a war debt in payments of salt.
1661年：Treaty of The Hague: the Dutch Republic recognizes Portuguese imperial sovereignty over New Holland (Dutch Brazil).
1684年：Beckman Revolt in Maranhão.
1693年：Gold is found near modern-day cities of Sabará, Caeté and Ouro Preto, beginning of the Brazilian Gold Rush.
1694年2月6日：The runaway slave colony of Quilombo dos Palmares is destroyed.
1694年3月8日：The Casa da Moeda do Brasil is established by the Portuguese in Salvador.
1695年11月20日：Quilombo dos Palmares ruler Zumbi is captured and beheaded.
1707年－1709年：War of the Emboabas in modern-day Minas Gerais.
1710年－1711年：The Mascate War pits merchants of Recife against the planters of nearby Olinda.
1711年：São Paulo officially becomes a city.
1720年6月28日：The Vila Rica Revolt, also known as the Filipe dos Santos Revolt, was held against the Portuguese Crown.
1720年9月12日：The Captaincy of Minas Gerais is established, after being separated from the Captaincy of São Paulo and Minas de Ouro.
1722年：Expedition led by the second Anhanguera discovers gold in present-day Goiás.
1727年：Lt. Col. Francisco de Mello Palheta smuggles coffee seeds to Brazil in a bouquet, starting a coffee empire.

1750年1月13日：The Treaty of Madrid between Spain and Portugal authorizes a larger Brazil than had the Treaty of Tordesillas of 1494, which originally established the boundaries of the Portuguese and Spanish territories in South America.
1756年2月：The Guaraní War takes place between the Guaraní tribes of seven Jesuit missions and joint Spanish-Portuguese forces.
1759年：Jesuits are expelled from Brazil by the Marquis of Pombal. Indians left without protection.
links: Sebastião José de Carvalho e Melo, 1st Marquis of Pombal

items.text: 1763年：The capital of Colonial Brazil is transferred from Salvador to Rio de Janeiro, which is located closer to the mining region and provides a harbor to ship the gold to Europe.
1772年：The Kingdom of Portugal divides its colony of the State of Great-Pará and Maranhão into the State of Great-Pará (capital, Belém) and the State of Maranhão (capital, São Luis).
1775年：The Kingdom of Portugal reunites its South American colonies of the State of Brazil, the State of Great-Pará, and the State of Maranhão into the Colony of Brazil. Rio de Janeiro is the capital.
1788年－1789年：Inconfidência Mineira, conspiracy against the colonial authorities in Brazil.
1792年4月21日：Tiradentes, prime figure in the Inconfidência Mineira plot, is executed in Rio de Janeiro.
1798年：Revolt of the Alfaiates in Bahia.
1807年11月29日：The Portuguese Queen Maria I and the Court embark at Lisbon bound for Brazil. Rio de Janeiro becomes the capital of the Portuguese Empire.
1808年1月22日：The Braganza Royal Family arrives in Brazil, fleeing from the French army.
links: Transfer of the Portuguese Court to Brazil

items.text: 1808年6月13日：The Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden is founded by King John VI of Portugal.
1808年10月12日：Banco do Brasil is founded by then prince regent John (later King John VI of Portugal) to finance the kingdom's public debt.
1809年：Napoleonic Wars: Brazilian and Portuguese forces conquer French Guiana.
1812年：The first official group of Chinese immigrants to Brazil for Tea planters in Rio de Janeiro during the period of the Portuguese Royal family in Brazil.

1815年：The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves is established under Queen Maria I. Brazil is elevated from the status of Portuguese colony to a constituent kingdom of the united kingdom.
links: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves

items.text: 1817年3月：The French Artistic Mission in Brazil comes to Rio de Janeiro.
1817年5月13日：Prince Pedro is married by proxy to Maria Leopoldina of Austria.
1817年：The Pernambuco Revolt breaks out.
1819年11月4日：The first 1,400 non-Portuguese immigrants arrive from Switzerland.
1821年：Portugal enters a severe political crisis that obliges John VI and the royal family to return to Portugal.
1822年1月9日：Prince regent Pedro of Braganza refuses to comply with the Portuguese cortes order to return to Portugal (Dia do Fico).
1822年9月7日：Prince Pedro proclaims the Brazilian independence on 7 September.
1822年12月1日：Prince Pedro is crowned as emperor Pedro I of Brazil.
1822年－1825年：Brazilian War of Independence.
1824年：Confederation of the Equator rebellion in the Northeast.
1824年：The Constitution of 1824 is adopted.
1824年5月26日：The United States become the first country to recognize the independence of Brazil.
1825年1月13日：Frei Caneca and other leaders of the Confederation of the Equator rebellion are executed in Recife.
1825年8月25日：Uruguay is declared independent of the Empire of Brazil by the Thirty-Three Orientals, a militant revolutionary group led by Juan Antonio Lavalleja.
1826年12月11日：Empress Maria Leopoldina dies after suffering a miscarriage.
1828年4月26日：Treaty of Commerce and Navigation signed between Brazil and Denmark, establishing diplomatic relations between the two countries.
1828年：Irish and German Mercenary Soldiers' revolt rebellion breaks out.
links: Irish and German Mercenary Soldiers' revolt

items.text: 1828年8月2日：Dom Pedro I is married by proxy to Amélie of Leuchtenberg.
1828年8月27日：Treaty of Montevideo: Brazil and Argentina recognize the independence of Uruguay.
1831年4月7日：Dom Pedro I abdicates in favor of his 5-year-old son Dom Pedro II, who will reign for almost 59 years. The regency period begins.
links: Abdication of Pedro I of Brazil

items.text: 1831年11月7日：Slave trading is forbidden in Brazil, the law is largely ignored.

1834年8月12日：The Additional Act provides for the establishment of the Provincial Legislative Assemblies, extinction of the State Council, replacement of the Triumviral Regency, and introduction of a direct and secret ballot.
1834年9月24日：Former Brazilian emperor Pedro I dies in Lisbon.
1835年1月：Malê revolt in Salvador.
1835年9月20日：Ragamuffin War begins in Rio Grande do Sul with the capture of Porto Alegre.
1836年9月11日：The Riograndense Republic is proclaimed in southern Brazil following the battle of Seival.
1838年－1841年：Balaiada revolt in Maranhão.
1840年7月23日：Pedro II is prematurely declared "of age" and begins to reassert central control in Brazil.
1840年：Last remaining rebel group of the Cabanagem revolt, under the leadership of Gonçalo Jorge de Magalhães, surrenders.
1841年7月18日：Coronation ceremony of emperor Pedro II of Brazil in Rio de Janeiro.
1842年：Liberal rebellions of 1842.
1843年1月20日：Honório Hermeto Carneiro Leão, Marquis of Paraná, becomes de facto first prime minister of the Empire of Brazil.
links: Honório Hermeto Carneiro Leão, Marquis of Paraná

items.text: 1843年9月4日：The Emperor Dom Pedro II of Brazil marries Dona Teresa Cristina of the Two Sicilies in a state ceremony in Rio de Janeiro Cathedral.
links: Teresa Cristina of the Two Sicilies
Old Cathedral of Rio de Janeiro

items.text: 1845年3月1日：Ragamuffin War: peace negotiations led by Lima e Silva and Antônio Vicente da Fontoura conclude with the signing of the Ponche Verde Treaty between the two sides, in Dom Pedrito.
links: Luís Alves de Lima e Silva, Duke of Caxias

items.text: 1845年8月9日：The Aberdeen Act is passed by the Parliament of the United Kingdom empowering the British Royal Navy to search Brazilian ships as part of the abolition of the slave trade from Africa.
1847年6月11日：Afonso dies at age two, leaving his father Pedro II without a male heir.
1848年－1849年：Praieira revolt in Pernambuco.
1850年9月4日：Eusébio de Queirós Law abolishes the international slave trade in the country.
1851年－1852年：The Platine War ends and the Empire of Brazil has the hegemony over South America.

1852年2月3日：Platine War: Battle of Caseros, Argentina: the Argentine provinces of Entre Rios and Corrientes allied with Brazil and members of Colorado Party of Uruguay, defeat the Argentine Confederation under Juan Manuel de Rosas.
1854年4月30日：The first railway in Brazil is inaugurated by Pedro II in Rio de Janeiro, built by industrialist Irineu Evangelista de Sousa.
links: Irineu Evangelista de Sousa, Viscount of Mauá

items.text: 1859年5月5日：Border Treaty between Brazil and Venezuela: the two countries agree their borders should be traced at the water divide between the Amazon and the Orinoco basins.
1862年6月26日：Brazil adopts the Metric system.
1864年10月7日：American Civil War: Bahia incident: USS Wachusett illegally captures the CSS Florida Confederate raider while in port in Bahia, Brazil, in violation of Brazilian neutrality.
1864年－1865年：Uruguayan War: forces of the Empire of Brazil invade Uruguay in support of Venancio Flores' Colorado Party.
1865年5月1日：The Triple Alliance of Argentina, Brazil, and Uruguay against Paraguay is formally signed; the Paraguayan War begins.
1865年6月11日：Paraguayan War: Battle of Riachuelo: the Imperial Brazilian Navy squadron defeats the Paraguayan Navy on the Riachuelo stream.

1867年3月27日：The Treaty of Ayacucho is signed between the Empire of Brazil and Bolivia, Brazil assigns the land of Acre to Bolivia in exchange for 102,400 sq kilometers of territory further annexed to the Amazonas.

1868年1月5日：Paraguayan War: Brazilian Army commander Luís Alves de Lima e Silva enters Asunción, Paraguay's capital. Some days later he declares the war is over. Nevertheless, Francisco Solano López, Paraguay's president, prepares guerrillas to fight in the countryside.
1868年12月6日：Paraguayan War: Battle of Ytororó: Field-Marshal Luís Alves de Lima e Silva leads 13,000 Brazilian troops against a Paraguayan fortified position of 5,000 troops.
1870年3月1日：End of the Paraguayan War. Francisco Solano López is defeated and killed in the Battle of Cerro Corá.
1871年3月7日：José Paranhos, Viscount of Rio Branco, becomes Prime Minister of the Empire of Brazil, serving for 4 years.
links: José Paranhos, Viscount of Rio Branco

items.text: 1871年9月28日：Law of Free Birth, or Rio Branco Law, is passed by the Brazilian Parliament, intending to provide freedom to all newborn children of slaves, and slaves of the state or crown.
1872年1月9日：In the aftermath of the Paraguayan War, the new government of Paraguay makes peace with Brazil, granting reparations and territorial concessions.
1872年：Brazil conducts its first official census, the population is 9,930,478.
1873年－1874年：Revolt of the Muckers in Rio Grande do Sul.
1876年4月28日：Francisco, a slave, becomes the last person to be executed in Brazil, after murdering his masters, being hanged in Pilar, Alagoas.
1877年－1878年：Grande Seca (Great Drought) in Northeastern Brazil.
1882年：Brazilian Anthropological Exhibition of 1882.
1883年9月30日：Mossoró, in the province of Rio Grande do Norte, is the first city in Brazil to abolish slavery.
1885年9月28日：Sexagenarian Law, or Saraiva-Cotegipe Law, which frees slaves over the age of 60, is passed.
1888年5月13日：The Lei Áurea abolishes the last remnants of slavery.

1889年11月15日：Field Marshal Deodoro da Fonseca organizes a military coup which deposes Emperor Pedro II of Brazil and abolishes the Brazilian monarchy. Deodoro da Fonseca proclaims Brazil a Republic and forms a Provisional Government.
1889年11月17日：The Brazilian Imperial Family is forced into exile in France.
1889年11月19日：The modern-day flag of Brazil is adopted by the Provisional Government of the Republic.
1889年11月20日：Argentina is the first country to recognize the abolition of the monarchy in Brazil.
1891年11月：First revolt of the Armada.
1891年11月15日：The constitution of the First Brazilian Republic is promulgated.
1891年11月23日：President Deodoro da Fonseca resigns as a consequence of the first revolt of the Armada, vice president Floriano Peixoto succeeds to the presidency.
1891年12月5日：Deposed emperor Dom Pedro II dies in Paris, France aged 66.

1893年：American James Harden-Hickey claimed the Trindade island and declares himself as James I, Prince of Trinidad. According to James Harden-Hickey's plans, Trinidad, after being recognized as an independent country, would become a military dictatorship and have him as dictator. He designed postage stamps, a national flag, and a coat of arms; established a chivalric order, the "Cross of Trinidad"; bought a schooner to transport colonists; appointed M. le Comte de la Boissiere as Secretary of State; opened a consular office at 217 West 36th Street in New York; and even issued government bonds to finance construction of infrastructure on the island. Despite his plans, his idea was ridiculed or ignored by the world.
1893年－1894年：Second revolt of the Armada.
1894年1月：Rio de Janeiro Affair: a series of incidents during the Brazilian Naval Revolt.
1894年6月27日：Federalist Revolution: Battle of Passo Fundo in the state of Rio Grande do Sul
1894年9月15日：Inauguration of Prudente de Morais as president.
1895年：The Federalist Revolution comes to an end.

1895年7月：The British again tried to take possession of the strategic Trindade island in the Atlantic. The British planned to use the island as a cable station. However, Brazilian diplomatic efforts, along with Portuguese support, reinstated Trindade Island to Brazilian sovereignty.
1895年11月5日：Japan establishes diplomatic relations with Brazil.
1895年11月17日：Flamengo, a well known professional football club in Brazil, is officially founded.

1897年1月24日：In order to clearly demonstrate sovereignty over the Trindade island, now part of the State of Espírito Santo and the municipality of Vitória, a landmark is built. Nowadays, Brazilian presence is marked by a permanent Brazilian Navy base on the main island.
1897年10月5日：Canudos War: after a long siege, Brazilian government troops take Canudos in Northeastern Brazil, crushing Antônio Conselheiro and his followers.
1897年10月12日：The City of Belo Horizonte, Brazil is created. The construction of the second Brazilian planned city is completed successfully.
1898年3月1日：In the presidential election, Manuel Ferraz de Campos Sales of the Republican Party of São Paulo, is successful, with 90.9% of the vote.
1899年7月14日：The First Republic of Acre is declared.
1900年4月25日：The Republic of Acre is reincorporated into Bolivia, with Brazilian help.
1901年10月19日：Aviator Alberto Santos-Dumont wins the Deutsch de la Meurthe prize with a flight that rounds the Eiffel Tower.

1902年3月1日：Presidential election: Rodrigues Alves of the Republican Party of São Paulo receives 91.7% of the vote. Francisco Silviano de Almeida Brandão is elected vice president, but dies suddenly before the start of his term of office.
1902年10月26日：The first season of competitive football in Brazil concludes with a victory for São Paulo Athletic Club.
1902年12月3日：José Paranhos, Baron of Rio Branco, is appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs. His ten-year tenure would be the longest in the country's history.
links: José Paranhos, Baron of Rio Branco

items.text: 1903年11月11日：The Treaty of Petrópolis ends tension between Brazil and Bolivia over the then-Bolivian territory of Acre (today the Acre state).
1904年10月14日：The National Congress of Brazil approves a large naval acquisition programme.
1904年：Vaccine Revolt in Rio de Janeiro.
1904年：The Evangelical Lutheran Church of Brazil is founded in Rio Grande do Sul.
1904年：Ford begin selling cars in Brazil.
1905年12月30日：Law no. 1452 is passed by the National Congress of Brazil, authorizing expenditure of £4,214,550 for new warship construction (£1,685,820 in 1906).

1906年1月21日：The Brazilian battleship Aquidabã sinks, after its powder magazines explode, near the Jacuacanga strait, in Angra dos Reis bay. A total of 212 people are killed, including three admirals and most of the ship's officers; 98 survive.
1906年3月1日：In the presidential election, Afonso Pena of the Minas Gerais Republican Party receives 97.9% of the vote.
1906年5月5日：The Treaty of Limits between Brazil and the Netherlands is signed in Rio de Janeiro, establishing the international boundary between Brazil and the Dutch colony of Suriname.
1906年10月23日：An aeroplane of Alberto Santos-Dumont takes off at Bagatelle in France and flies 60 meters (200 feet). This is the first officially recorded powered flight in Europe.
1906年11月9日：The Brazilian Flag Anthem ("Hino à Bandeira Nacional"), with lyrics by Olavo Bilac and music by Francisco Braga, is performed for the first time.
1907年：Construction of the Madeira-Mamoré Railroad begins, linking the cities of Porto Velho and Guajará-Mirim.

1907年4月24日：The Vásquez Cobo–Martins treaty between Brazil and Colombia is signed, establishing the border from the Rio Negro northwestward along the Amazon River-Orinoco watershed divide, "then generally southward along various river courses and straight-line segments to the mouth of the Apaporis River".
1908年6月16日：The Kasato Maru arrives at the Port of Santos with the first official group of Japanese immigrants to Brazil.

1908年9月10日：The first Minas Geraes-class Dreadnought battleship for Brazil, Minas Geraes, is launched at Armstrong Whitworth's yard on the River Tyne in England, catalysing the "South American dreadnought race".
1908年10月30日：Pedro de Alcântara, Prince of Grão-Pará, renounces his claim on the Brazilian throne in order to marry Countess Elisabeth Dobržensky de Dobrženicz.
links: Pedro de Alcântara, Prince of Grão-Pará

items.text: 1909年9月8日：The Velarde-Río Branco treaty [es] between Brazil and Peru is signed, establishing borders south of the Yavarí.

1910年3月1日：In the presidential election, Hermes da Fonseca receives 57.1% of the vote. Fonseca is supported by several of the most influential Republican parties, whilst his main opponent, Ruy Barbosa, is supported by the Civilist Campaign.

1910年11月22日：Revolt of the Lash: the mostly black crews of four Brazilian warships, led by João Cândido, mutiny shortly after a sailor receives 250 lashes. The crews depose their white officers and threaten to bombard Rio de Janeiro.
1911年1月10日：The cargo ship 'SS São Luiz runs aground off the coast of Rio Grande do Norte.
1912年10月：Beginning of the Contestado War, a dispute between settlers and landowners.
1912年12月29日：The federal government sends in 200 federal troops to deal with ongoing trouble in the State of Santa Catarina.

1913年12月12日：Roosevelt–Rondon Scientific Expedition: following a speaking tour in Brazil and Argentina, former US President Theodore Roosevelt meets up with Cândido Rondon to embark on a joint exploration of the "River of Doubt".
1914年3月1日：In the presidential election, incumbent Vice President Venceslau Brás, of the Minas Gerais Republican Party, receives 91.6% of the vote.
1914年6月8日：The Brazilian Football Confederation is founded, with Álvaro Zamith as its first president. The Brazilian Olympic Committee is founded on the same day.

1914年9月14日：The British Royal Navy auxiliary cruiser HMS Carmania fought the German SMS Cap Trafalgar off Trindade in the Battle of Trindade. Carmania sank Cap Trafalgar, but sustained severe damage herself.
1915年1月29日：Heitor Villa-Lobos gives the first in a series of chamber concerts; one of the new works he introduces during this year is his Cello Concerto no 1.

1916年3月5日：The liner Príncipe de Asturias runs aground in fog on the shoals out of Ponta do Boi, in the island of Sao Sebastião, while trying to approach the port of Santos. At least 445 people out of the 588 aboard are killed.

1916年5月3日：Brazilian merchant ship Rio Branco is sunk by a German submarine. Because the ship is in restricted waters and registered under the British flag, and most of its crew is Norwegian, it is not considered an illegal attack by the Brazilian government, despite public protests.
1916年8月：Brazilian Naval Aviation is established, in preparation for the country's participation in the First World War.
1916年：The capture of rebel leader Deodato Manuel Ramos ("Adeodato") marks the effective end of the Contestado War.
1917年4月5日：The steamship Paraná, loaded with coffee and travelling in accordance with the demands made on neutral countries, is torpedoed by a German submarine; three Brazilians are killed.
1917年4月11日：Brazil breaks off diplomatic relations with Germany.
1917年5月7日：Foreign Minister Lauro Müller is obliged to resign because of his German origins.
1917年：Several Brazilian vessels are torpedoed by the Germans.
1917年10月26日：World War I: Brazil declares war on the Central Powers.
1917年11月1日：A mob damages German property in Petrópolis, including the restaurant Brahma (completely destroyed), the Gesellschaft Germania, the German school, the company Arp, and the German Journal.
1918年1月30日：Ministerial Notice No. 501 is issued, establishing the Naval Division for War Operations (Divisão Naval em Operações de Guerra – DNOG).
1918年3月1日：Brazilian general election, 1918: former President Rodrigues Alves receives 99.1% of the vote.
1918年8月18日：The Brazilian Medical Mission, led by Dr. Nabuco Gouveia and directed by General Aché, is established with 86 doctors.
1918年9月24日：The Brazilian Medical Mission lands at Marseille, France, and supports the local population during a flu outbreak, ensuring the continuity of logistical support to the troops at the front.
1918年11月15日：President-elect Rodrigues Alves, suffering from influenza, is unable to take office on the scheduled date, and is replaced by Vice President Delfim Moreira.
1919年4月13日：In the presidential election brought about by the death of Rodrigues Alves, Epitácio Pessoa of the Paraíba Republican Party receives 71.0% of the vote.
1919年4月24日：Ford Brasil, a subsidiary of the Ford Motor Company, is founded.
1919年：The 1919 South American Championship football tournament is held in Rio de Janeiro. It is won by the home country.
1919年7月28日：Epitácio Pessoa takes office as president, replacing acting President Delfim Moreira, who continues as vice president.
1920年4月20日：Opening ceremony of the 1920 Summer Olympics in Antwerp, at which Brazil competes for the first time. Sport shooter Guilherme Paraense is the first Brazilian to win a gold medal.
1921年10月：The government implements a new policy in defense of coffee, for the third time in the history of the Republic.
1922年：Modern Art Week is held in São Paulo, marking the beginning of Brazilian Modernism.
1922年3月1日：In the Brazilian presidential election, Artur Bernardes of the Mineiro Republican Party receives 56.0% of the vote.

1922年7月5日：The 18 of the Copacabana Fort revolt occurs in Rio de Janeiro, then Federal District of Brazil. It is the first revolt of the tenentista movement, in the context of the Brazilian Old Republic.
1923年5月3日：Brazil sign the Pan-American Treaty.
1923年：The Brazilian Society of Chemistry is founded.
1923年：Brazil's first radio broadcasting station, the Radio Society of Rio de Janeiro, is founded; it is still working under the name Rádio MEC.
1924年：Military revolt in São Paulo.
1925年4月12日：The Coluna Prestes movement is launched at a meeting in Foz do Iguaçu.
1925年5月29日：British explorer Percy Fawcett sent a last telegram to his wife, before he disappears in the Amazon.
1926年3月1日：In the presidential election, Washington Luís of the Republican Party of São Paulo, who received 98.0% of the vote.
1927年6月11日：The Brazilian submarine Humaytá is launched at the Odero-Terni-Orlando shipyard at La Spezia, Italy.
1928年8月10日：The ETA – Empresa de Transporte Aéreo airline is founded; it remains in operation for only a year.
1928年：The Liberator Party (Brazil) is founded for the first time, by members of the Rio Grande do Sul Federalist Party, notably Joaquim Francisco de Assis Brasil.

1929年8月：Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul, and Paraíba join the political opposition from several states, including the Democratic Party of São Paulo, to oppose the presidential candidacy of Washington Luís's nominated successor, Júlio Prestes, and form the Liberal Alliance.
1929年9月20日：The Liberal Alliance nominates its candidates for the presidential elections: Getúlio Vargas as president and João Pessoa Cavalcanti de Albuquerque as vice president.
1929年10月29日：The US stock market crash causes a fall in coffee quotations to 60%.

1930年3月1日：A general election is held; in the presidential elections, the result is a victory for Júlio Prestes of the Republican Party of São Paulo, who receives 57.7% of the vote. Vital Soares is elected vice president, but never takes office.

1930年7月26日：The assassination of João Pessoa Cavalcânti de Albuquerque, governor of Paraíba, by João Duarte Dantas, stirs up a wave of bad feeling toward the federal government and the outgoing president Washington Luís, who is accused of bearing the "moral responsibility".
1930年8月13日：1930 Curuçá River event: the area of Curuçá River near latitude 5° S and longitude 71.5° W experiences a meteoric air burst (also known as the Brazilian Tunguska event).
1930年9月：The state capital of Paraíba, formerly Parahyba, is renamed João Pessoa, in memory of its assassinated governor.
1930年10月3日：Revolution of 1930.
1930年10月24日：Incumbent President Washington Luís is deposed. A military junta, led by General Augusto Tasso Fragoso, temporarily takes control of the country.
1930年11月1日：Beginning of the Vargas Era: the ruling junta hands power and the presidential palace to Getúlio Vargas.
1930年：The National Institute of Metrology Standardization and Industrial Quality (INMETRO) is founded.
links: National Institute of Metrology Standardization and Industrial Quality

items.text: 1931年9月16日：Frente Negra Brasileira, Brazil's first black political party, is created.
1931年10月12日：The statue of Christ the Redeemer, overlooking Rio de Janeiro, is consecrated.
1932年2月24日：The Justiça Eleitoral do Brasil is created by Decreto nº 21.076.
1932年2月24日：Women win the right to vote.
1932年4月：Peter Fleming joins the expedition to find missing Englishman Colonel Percy Fawcett; the following year he publishes an account of the expedition, entitled Brazilian Adventure.
1932年5月23日：Four protesting students (Martins, Miragaia, Dráusio and Camargo) are killed by government troops, sparking off the "Paulista War".
1932年6月：São Paulo rebels take control of the state.
1932年7月9日：Constitutionalist Revolution: the population of the state of São Paulo revolt against the 1930 coup d'état.
1932年10月2日：The São Paulo rebels are defeated by government forces.
1932年10月：Brazilian Integralism, a Fascist movement, is founded by Plínio Salgado.
1933年10月10日：The Anti-war Treaty of Non-aggression and Conciliation, an inter-American treaty, is signed in Rio de Janeiro by representatives of Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Paraguay and Uruguay.

1934年7月16日：The Vargas government introduces what will be the shortest-lived Constitution of Brazil, lasting only 3 years (until 1937). It is the first time a Brazilian constitution has been written from scratch by directly elected deputies in multi-party elections, and incorporates a number of improvements to Brazilian political, social and economical life.
1934年7月17日：In the presidential election, carried out by the Constituent Assembly, acting President Getúlio Vargas receives 175 of the 248 votes.
1934年：The University of São Paulo is established.
1934年：The Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics is founded under the title of the National Institute of Statistics.
links: Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics

items.text: 1935年11月：A Communist insurrection, the "Red Revolt of 35", or the Intentona Comunista, fails to unseat President Vargas. Olga Benário Prestes and her husband Luís Carlos Prestes are among the conspirators arrested.

1936年10月16日：President Vargas signed the decree, which gives the name of the aviator Alberto Santos Dumont Airport, located in Ponta do Calabouço, in the city of Rio de Janeiro, named Santos Dumont Airport, Brazil's first civilian airport.
1937年5月7日：One of the leaders of the communist revolution, Luis Carlos Prestes, is sentenced to 16 years and eight months in prison.
1937年6月10日：National Democratic Union, ahead of support for the candidacy of Armando Sales de Oliveira for president in the 1938 elections is created.
1937年6月14日：President Getúlio Vargas signed the decree establishing the Itatiaia National Park, the first national park in Brazil.
1937年8月13日：The National Union of Students is founded in Rio de Janeiro.
1937年11月10日：The fourth Brazilian Constitution is granted by President Vargas, starting the Estado Novo.
1937年12月21日：President Vargas signs the ordinance which extinguishes all political parties in the country.
1938年5月：The Brazilian integralist movement attempt a coup d'état, supported by the Axis powers. The failure of the "Pajama Putsch" leads to the dissolution of the AIB.
1938年7月28日：Folk hero Lampião and his band are ambushed in one of his hideouts, the Angicos farm, in the state of Sergipe.
1939年11月30日：Serra dos Órgãos National Park is created.
1939年12月5日：The Imperial Mausoleum is officially inaugurated at the Cathedral of Petrópolis.
1942年1月28日：Brazil breaks diplomatic relations with the Axis countries.
1942年：Several Brazilian vessels are torpedoed by the Germans.
1942年8月22日：President Getúlio Vargas signs the declaration of war against Germany and Italy.
1942年11月1日：The Cruzeiro "antigo" is adopted as the official currency.
1943年6月11日：The Order of Military Merit is established by President Getúlio Vargas.

1943年7月13日：On the recommendation of the National Petroleum Council, Brazil bans the use of private motorcycles throughout the nation in order to conserve fuel. Use of gasoline-powered automobiles had been prohibited the year before.

1943年7月31日：The Brazilian passenger ship and freighter Bagé, largest commercial ship in Brazil's fleet, is torpedoed and sunk off the coast of the Sergipe state. The Bagé, carrying 129 passengers and 102 crew, was en route from Belém to Rio de Janeiro when it was struck by a German U-boat. Seventy-eight people (41 passengers and 37 crew) are lost.
1944年1月1日：The former Royal Military Academy expends into the city of Resende.
1944年7月2日：Second World War: the first five thousand Brazilian Expeditionary Force soldiers, the 6th RCT, leave Brazil for Europe aboard the USNS General Mann.
1944年9月：Brazilian air-land forces go into action in Italy.
1944年10月13日：Brazilian pilots begin operations, as individual elements of flights attached to 350th FG squadrons.
1944年－1945年：Second World War, Battle of Monte Castello: the battle marks the Brazilian Expeditionary Force's entry into the land war in Europe.
1945年2月：A fourth transport of troops of the Brazilian Expeditionary Force reaches Italy, in preparation for the Spring 1945 offensive.
1945年5月12日：Brazilian troops arrive in Turin on the same day that the cessation of hostilities is announced.

1945年5月：Bishop Carlos Duarte Costa, an outspoken critic of the regime of President Getúlio Vargas and of the Vatican's alleged relationship with fascist regimes, gives newspaper interviews accusing Brazil's Papal nuncio of Nazi-Fascist spying, and accusing Rome of having aided and abetted Hitler. Shortly afterwards he establishes the Brazilian Catholic Apostolic Church.
1945年10月29日：President Vargas resigns. José Linhares becomes acting president, beginning the period known as the Fourth Brazilian Republic at the end of his term.

1945年12月2日：A general election is held, the first since the establishment of Getúlio Vargas' Estado Novo. The presidential election is won by Eurico Gaspar Dutra of the Social Democratic Party (PSD), which also wins a majority of seats in both the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate.
1946年9月18日：A new constitution is introduced, and the position of Vice President of Brazil is recreated; Nereu Ramos is selected as the first incumbent.

1947年1月19日：Parliamentary elections are held, for 19 vacant seats in the Chamber of Deputies, one additional Senator for each state (except Santa Catarina, which elected two), and for all state Governors and legislatures. The Brazilian Communist Party wins nearly 10% of the vote in the state elections, becoming the third party in the state of São Paulo (ahead of the UDN) and the single largest party in the federal capital, Rio de Janeiro.
1947年8月6日：The Brazilian Socialist Party is founded.
1947年10月2日：The São Paulo Museum of Art opens to the public.
1949年：The Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisas Físicas is founded by Cesar Lattes, José Leite Lopes, and Jayme Tiomno.
1950年6月16日：The Maracanã Stadium opens in Rio de Janeiro.
1950年：Brazil hosts the 1950 FIFA World Cup. The local national team is beaten 1–2 by Uruguay in the final game.
1950年9月18日：First television broadcasting in Brazil by TV Tupi.

1950年10月3日：The Brazilian general election is won by the Social Democratic Party, who remain the largest party in both the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, although they lose their majority in the former. The presidential election is won by former President Getúlio Vargas of the Brazilian Labour Party.
1951年：The Brazilian Medical Association is founded.
1951年：The Escola Superior de Propaganda e Marketing is founded in São Paulo.
links: Escola Superior de Propaganda e Marketing

items.text: 1952年3月4日：Anchieta rail disaster: a crowded steam-powered passenger train derails while crossing a bridge over the Pavuna River near Anchieta station, sending two old wooden carriages broadside onto the adjacent line. A modern high-speed electric freight train, travelling in the opposite direction, ploughs into the wooden carriages, telescoping them upwards. The severity of the accident was compounded by the fact that the suburban train is overloaded, with passengers clinging to the sides, underneath and between the carriages. A witness says they saw "passengers flying in all directions when the crash occurred". 119 people are killed and the resulting outcry prompts major new investment in Brazilian railways.

1952年4月28日：Pan Am Flight 202 crashes in the Amazon Basin approximately 220 nautical miles (410 km) southwest of Carolina, Brazil. All 50 people on board are killed in the worst-ever accident involving the Boeing 377.

1952年8月12日：1952 Transportes Aéreos Nacional Douglas C-47 mid-air explosion: a Douglas C-47A registered PP-ANH is destroyed after an in-flight fire causes it to crash near Palmeiras de Goiás. All 24 people on board are killed.
links: 1952 Transportes Aéreos Nacional Douglas C-47 mid-air explosion

items.text: 1952年：Bob's, Brazil's first fast food chain, opens in Rio de Janeiro.
1954年8月24日：Brazilian President Getúlio Vargas commits suicide after being accused of involvement in a conspiracy to murder his chief political opponent, Carlos Lacerda.
1954年10月3日：Brazilian legislative election, 1954
1955年10月3日：The presidential election results in victory for Juscelino Kubitschek, who receives 35.7% of the vote.
1955年11月3日：Café Filho is forced to give up the presidency of Brazil on health grounds. Kubitschek does not take office until the following year.
1955年：The Museum of Modern Art, Rio de Janeiro, is completed, a Modernist concrete museum building, designed by Affonso Eduardo Reidy, with gardens designed by Burle Marx.
links: Museum of Modern Art, Rio de Janeiro

items.text: 1956年1月31日：Juscelino Kubitschek is inaugurated as the 21st President of Brazil.
1957年10月：The Africanized bee is accidentally released in Brazil.
1957年10月16日：Antônio Vilas Boas, a Brazilian farmer, claims to have been abducted by extraterrestrials; the first famous alien abduction case.
1958年6月29日：Brazil beats Sweden 5–2 in the final game to win the football World Cup in Sweden.

1960年4月21日：The country's capital (Federal District) is relocated from the city of Rio de Janeiro to the new city, Brasília, in the highlands. The actual city of Rio de Janeiro becomes the State of Guanabara.
1960年10月3日：Jânio Quadros is elected President of Brazil for a five-year term.
1961年8月25日：João Goulart replaces Jânio Quadros as President of Brazil
1961年12月17日：A circus tent fire in Niterói, Brazil, kills 323.
1962年6月17日：Brazil beats Czechoslovakia 3–1 to win the 1962 FIFA World Cup.
1962年：The first official group of Korean immigrants to Brazil. There has been a large flow of documented Korean migrants to Brazil.
1964年3月31日：The military overthrows Brazilian President João Goulart in a coup, starting 21 years of dictatorship in Brazil.
1964年4月1日：Deployed military rule in Brazil ended the then government of President João Goulart.
1964年4月11日：Brazilian presidential election, 1964: the Brazilian Congress elects Field Marshal Humberto de Alencar Castelo Branco as President of Brazil.
1965年4月26日：Rede Globo, the 3rd largest TV broadcaster of the world, is founded, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
1965年10月27日：Brazilian President Humberto de Alencar Castelo Branco removes power from parliament, legal courts and opposition parties.
1966年3月5日：A massive theft of nuclear materials is revealed in Brazil.
1967年1月24日：New constitution is promulgated.
1967年3月1日：Brazilian police arrest Franz Stangl, ex-commander of Treblinka and Sobibór extermination camps.
1967年3月15日：The Republic of the United States of Brazil is renamed the Federative Republic of Brazil.
links: Republic of the United States of Brazil

items.text: 1968年3月28日：Brazilian high school student Edson Luís de Lima Souto is shot by the police in a protest for cheaper meals at a restaurant for low-income students. The aftermath of his death is one of the first major events against the military dictatorship.

1968年12月13日：Faced with growing discontent and the proliferation of actions by groups considered subversive, Brazilian President Artur da Costa e Silva enacts the Institutional Act Number Five "AI-5". AI-5 grants broad powers to the government, allowing the suspension of constitutional guarantees, the closure of the National Congress, and censorship of the press, beginning the most repressive period of the 21-year Brazilian Military Dictatorship.

1969年：Brazilian Military Junta of 1969 rules the country following sudden illness and resignation of President da Costa e Silva. The junta consists of Army General Aurélio de Lyra Tavares, Navy Admiral Augusto Hamann Rademaker Grunewald and Air Force Brigadier Márcio de Souza e Mello.
1969年11月19日：Playing for Santos against Vasco in Rio de Janeiro, Brazilian footballer Pelé scored his 1,000th goal.
1970年3月11日：Japanese consul-general in São Paulo Nobuo Okuchi is kidnapped by the leftist guerrilla group Vanguarda Popular Revolucionária.
1970年3月15日：Japanese consul-general in São Paulo Nobuo Okuchi is ransomed by the Brazilian government, he is released in exchange for five political prisoners.
1970年6月11日：West German ambassador Ehrenfried von Holleben is kidnapped by the Vanguarda Popular Revolucionária and by the Ação Libertadora Nacional.
1970年6月21日：Brazil defeats Italy 4–1 to win the 1970 FIFA World Cup in Mexico.
1970年12月1日：Giovanni Enrico Bucher, the Swiss ambassador to Brazil, is kidnapped by the Ação Libertadora Nacional in Rio de Janeiro; kidnappers demand the release of 70 political prisoners.
1971年1月14日：Seventy Brazilian political prisoners are released in Santiago, Chile; Giovanni Enrico Bucher is released 16 January.
1971年1月16日：Giovanni Enrico Bucher is released by the Ação Libertadora Nacional.

1971年11月20日：A bridge still in construction, called "Elevado Engenheiro Freyssinet", falls over the Paulo de Frontin Avenue, in Rio de Janeiro; 48 people are killed and several injured. Reconstructed, the bridge is a part of the Linha Vermelha elevate.
1974年2月1日：Fire breaks out in the Joelma Building in São Paulo, Brazil; 177 die and 293 are injured; 11 die later of their injuries.
1974年3月4日：The Rio–Niterói Bridge opens.
1975年3月15日：Guanabara State merges into the state of Rio de Janeiro. The state's capital moves from the city of Niterói to the city of Rio de Janeiro.
1977年：President Geisel closed Congress briefly to control presidential succession as conflict erupted between Geisel, the duristas, Congress, the Church, and the media.
links: History of Roman Catholicism in Brazil

items.text: 1977年－1978年：Operação Prato.
1979年2月7日：Nazi criminal Josef Mengele suffers a stroke and drowns while swimming in Bertioga, Brazil. His remains are found in 1985.

1980年6月1日：Mauro Milhomem, a pilot, attempted to crash his Sertanejo-721 into the Hotel Presidente owned by his mother-in-law, after he had an argument with his wife the previous day after he discovered that she cheated him. The plane failed to hit the target and hit into several objects and ultimately crashed into an accounting office in front to a forum. Six people were killed and four were wounded.
1980年7月9日：Pope John Paul II visits Brazil; 7 people are crushed to death in a crowd meeting him.
1981年9月20日：The Brazilian river boat Sobral Santos capsizes in the Amazon River, Óbidos, Brazil, killing at least 300.
1983年12月19日：The Jules Rimet Trophy is stolen from the Brazilian Soccer Confederation building in Rio de Janeiro.

1984年4月16日：More than one million people, led by Tancredo Neves, occupy the streets of São Paulo to demand direct presidential elections during the Brazilian military government of João Figueiredo. It is the largest protest during the Diretas Já civil unrest, as well as the largest public demonstration in the history of Brazil. The elections are granted in 1989.
1984年5月：The Itaipu Dam is inaugurated on the border of Brazil and Paraguay after 9 years of construction, making it the largest hydroelectric dam in the world at the time.
links: List of largest hydroelectric power stations

items.text: 1985年1月15日：Tancredo Neves is elected President of Brazil by the Congress, ending the 21-year military rule.

1985年3月15日：Vice President José Sarney, upon becoming vice president, assumes the duties of President of Brazil, as the new President Tancredo Neves had become severely ill, the day before. Sarney will become Brazil's first civilian President in 21 years, upon Neves' death on 21 April.
1985年4月21日：Brazilian President Tancredo Neves dies, he is succeeded by Vice President José Sarney. The vice president post is left vacant until 1990.

1985年6月6日：The remains of Josef Mengele, the physician notorious for Nazi human experimentation on inmates of Auschwitz concentration camp, buried in 1979 under the name of Wolfgang Gerhard, are exhumed in Embu das Artes, Brazil.

1987年9月13日：Goiânia accident: a radioactive object is stolen from an abandoned hospital in Goiânia, Brazil, contaminating many people in the following weeks and causing some to die from radiation poisoning.
1988年6月25日：PSDB is founded by members of the Brazilian Democratic Movement Party linked to the European social democratic movement as an attempt to clarify their ideals.
1988年10月5日：Brazil adopts a new constitution.
1988年12月22日：Brazilian union and environmental activist Chico Mendes is assassinated.
1988年12月31日：The Bateau Mouche cruise ship capsized and sank in the South Atlantic off Rio de Janeiro with the loss of at least 51 of the 149 people on board.

1989年11月12日：Brazil holds its first free presidential election since 1960. This marks the first time that all Ibero-American nations, excepting Cuba, have elected constitutional governments simultaneously.
1989年11月15日：Brazil holds the first round of its first free election in 29 years; Fernando Collor de Mello and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advance to the second round, to be held the following month.
1989年12月17日：Brazil holds the second round of its first free election in 29 years; Fernando Collor de Mello is elected to serve as president from 1990.

1990年3月15日：Fernando Collor de Mello takes office as President of Brazil, Brazil's first democratically elected president since Jânio Quadros in 1961. The next day, he announces a currency freeze and freezes large bank accounts for 18 months.
1991年3月26日：Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay sign the Treaty of Asunción, establishing the South Common Market (Mercosur is its acronym in Spanish).
1991年9月30日：A tornado destroys parts of Itu, a city in southeastern Brazil, killing 16 and leaving 176 injured.
1992年6月8日：The first World Oceans Day is celebrated, coinciding with the Earth Summit held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

1992年8月24日：A special commission in Brazil concludes that there is sufficient evidence to begin impeachment proceedings against President of Brazil Fernando Collor de Mello, finding he had accepted millions of dollars' worth of illegal payments from business interests.

1992年9月29日：The Chamber of Deputies of Brazil votes to impeach President of Brazil Fernando Collor de Mello, the country's first democratically elected leader in 29 years. Vice President Itamar Franco becomes acting president.
1992年10月2日：A riot breaks out in the Carandiru Penitentiary in São Paulo, Brazil, resulting in the Carandiru massacre.
1992年12月29日：Brazil's President Fernando Collor de Mello is found guilty on charges that he stole more than $32 million from the government, preventing him from holding any elected office for 8 years.
1993年4月21日：A constitutional referendum is held to determine the form of government of the country.
1993年7月23日：Candelária massacre: Brazilian police officers kill eight street kids in Rio de Janeiro.
1993年8月29日：Vigário Geral massacre.
1993年12月16日：Brazil's Supreme Court rules that former President Fernando Collor de Mello may not hold elected office again until 2000 due to political corruption.
1994年5月1日：Brazilian Three time Formula One World Champion, Ayrton Senna is killed in a crash during the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix.
1994年7月1日：Brazil introduces its new currency, the Real.
1994年7月17日：Brazil wins the 1994 FIFA World Cup, defeating Italy by 3–2 in penalties (full-time 0–0).
1995年1月1日：Fernando Henrique Cardoso becomes President of Brazil.
1996年1月20日：Varginha UFO incident in Minas Gerais.

1996年3月2日：A Learjet 25 (registration PT-LSD) carrying the Brazilian satirical rock band Mamonas Assassinas attempts a go-around at São Paulo–Guarulhos International Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, but crashes in the Serra da Cantareira mountain range, killing all eight people on board including all five members of the band.
1996年4月17日：Eldorado dos Carajás massacre.
1999年6月6日：In São José dos Campos, 345 prisoners escape from Putim prison through the front gate.
2001年9月10日：Antônio da Costa Santos, mayor of Campinas, is assassinated.
2001年9月11日：Three Brazilians are killed in the September 11 attacks in the United States.
2002年6月30日：Brazil wins its 5th FIFA World Cup title by defeating Germany 2–0 in the 2002 FIFA World Cup final.
2002年10月27日：Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva wins the 2002 Brazilian general election with 52.7 million votes (61.3% of the total).
2003年1月1日：Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is inaugurated as president of Brazil.
2003年1月30日：The Fome Zero program is introduced by president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
2003年8月19日：A car-bomb attack on United Nations headquarters in Iraq kills the agency's top envoy Sérgio Vieira de Mello and 21 other employees.
2004年3月28日：The first ever reported South Atlantic hurricane makes landfall in southern Brazil in the state of Santa Catarina – the hurricane is dubbed Hurricane Catarina.
2004年6月1日：The United Nations Stabilization Mission in Haiti (MINUSTAH) is established, its military component is led by Brazil.
links: United Nations Stabilisation Mission in Haiti

items.text: 2005年6月6日：Mensalão scandal threatens to bring down the government of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
2005年8月6日：Banco Central burglary at Fortaleza
2005年10月23日：2005 Brazilian firearms and ammunition referendum

2006年3月30日：Marcos Pontes becomes the first Brazilian and the first native Portuguese-speaking person to go into space, where he stays on the International Space Station for a week. During his trip, Pontes carries out eight experiments selected by the Brazilian Space Agency. He lands in Kazakhstan on 8 April 2006, with the crew of Expedition 12.
2006年5月：May 2006 São Paulo violence.
2006年7月：July 2006 São Paulo violence
2006年8月7日：Lei Maria da Penha is sanctioned by president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
2006年9月29日：Gol Transportes Aéreos Flight 1907 leads to the 2006–2007 Brazilian aviation crisis.
2006年10月29日：Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is re-elected as president.
2007年3月18日：Cesare Battisti, convicted in absentia of two murders in Italy in the 1970s and who later became a crime writer in France, is arrested in Brazil.
2007年5月：Pope Benedict XVI visits Brazil to reaffirm Catholicism in the country.
2007年5月11日：Pope Benedict XVI canonizes Brazil's first native-born saint, Frei Galvão, an 18th-century Franciscan friar.
2007年6月26日：Bolivia reclaims two oil refineries from Brazilian state-owned energy company Petrobras.
2007年6月27日：Complexo do Alemão massacre.

2007年7月7日：The New 7 Wonders of the World are announced. These are The Great Wall of China, Petra in Jordan, the Christ the Redeemer statue in Brazil, Machu Picchu in Peru, Mexico's Chichen Itza Mayan site, the Colosseum in Rome and the Taj Mahal in India.
2007年：The Fifteenth Pan American Games take place in Rio de Janeiro.
2007年7月17日：TAM Linhas Aéreas Flight 3054 carrying 186 people crashes in Congonhas International Airport, São Paulo, Brazil. The death toll is estimated to be at least 200 people.
2007年11月4日：At least six people are killed as a Learjet 35 crashes into a residential district in São Paulo, Brazil.
2007年11月25日：At least eight football fans die when part of the Fonte Nova stadium in Salvador, Bahia, collapses.
2007年12月2日：Brazil starts free-to-air digital television transmissions in São Paulo, but broadcasting companies must transmit signals in both analogue and digital formats until June 2016.

2007年12月20日：The Portrait of Suzanne Bloch (1904), by the Spanish artist Pablo Picasso, and O Lavrador de Café by Brazilian modernist painter Candido Portinari, are stolen from the São Paulo Museum of Art.

2007年12月17日：The leaders of Brazil, Bolivia, and Chile agree to build a highway by 2009 that will link the Atlantic (in Santos, São Paulo, Brazil) and the Pacific (in Iquique, Chile) coasts of South America.

2008年1月9日：The police recovered the Portrait of Suzanne Bloch (1904), by the Spanish artist Pablo Picasso, and O Lavrador de Café by Brazilian modernist painter Cândido Portinari, which had been stolen in December 2007.
2008年11月24日：The 2008 Santa Catarina floods in Santa Catarina, Brazil, kill 126 and force the evacuation of over 78,000 people.
2009年6月1日：Air France Flight 447, en route from Rio de Janeiro, to Paris, crashes into the Atlantic Ocean, killing all 228 on board.
2009年10月2日：The International Olympic Committee awards the 2016 Summer Olympics to Rio de Janeiro.
2009年10月16日：Brasil de Pelotas bus crash: two players and a coach die.
2010年1月：January 2010 Rio de Janeiro floods and mudslides
links: January 2010 Rio de Janeiro floods and mudslides

items.text: 2010年2月17日：Sinking of the Concordia.
2010年4月：April 2010 Rio de Janeiro floods and mudslides
links: April 2010 Rio de Janeiro floods and mudslides

items.text: 2010年6月：2010 Northeastern Brazil floods.
2010年：2010 Rio de Janeiro security crisis
2011年1月1日：Inauguration of Dilma Rousseff as the 36th President of Brazil.
