1989年：Time Inc. and Warner Communications announce plans for a merger, forming Time Warner.
1989年：The tanker Exxon Valdez oil spill in Alaska's Prince William Sound, dumping 10.8 million US gallons of oil into pristine wildlife habitat.
1989年：Awareness of stalking is raised with the murder of actress Rebecca Schaeffer by an obsessed fan.
1989年：Hurricane Hugo strikes the Caribbean and U.S. Southeast Coast, causing $7 billion in damage.
1989年：The 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake kills 63 in the greater San Francisco Bay Area. The quake occurs in the midst of Game 3 of the 1989 World Series, caught live on television broadcasts by ABC.
1989年：President Bush declares a "War on Drugs."
1989年：The animated television sitcom The Simpsons debuts on Fox.

1989年：President Bush and Soviet Premier Gorbachev release statements indicating that the Cold War between their nations may be coming to an end. Symbolic elsewhere around the world was the fall of the Berlin Wall in Germany.

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (1990–2009)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (1990–2009)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (1990–2009)

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1991年：The Gulf War is waged in the Middle East, by a U.N.-authorized coalition force from thirty-four nations, led by the U.S. and United Kingdom, against Iraq.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1991年：The World Wide Web first debuts as an Internet service.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1991年：The Cold War ends as the USSR is dissolved. The United States becomes the only superpower in the world.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：Los Angeles riots result in over 60 deaths and $1 billion in damage, spurred by the acquittal of four Los Angeles Police Department officers accused in the videotaped beating of black motorist Rodney King.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：Hurricane Andrew, a Category 5 hurricane, kills 65 people and causes $26 billion in damage to Florida and other areas of the U.S. Gulf Coast, and will be the costliest natural disaster until Hurricane Katrina in 2005.
links: Gulf Coast of the United States

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：Hurricane Iniki is the strongest hurricane ever to hit Hawaii.

items.section: Presidency of George H. W. Bush
items.text: 1992年：1992 United States presidential election: Bill Clinton elected president; Al Gore elected vice president.
1993年1月20日：Clinton becomes the 42nd president; Gore becomes the 45th vice president.
1993年：A truck bomb explodes in the parking garage under the World Trade Center in New York City, killing six people and injuring over a thousand.
1993年：Branch Davidians standoff and fire near Waco, Texas, resulting in the deaths of 81 people including their leader, David Koresh.
1993年：The "Storm of the Century" strikes the Eastern Seaboard, with blizzard conditions and severe weather, killing 300 people and causing $6 billion in damage.
1993年：Massive flooding along the Mississippi and Missouri Rivers kill 50 people and devastate the Midwest with $15–$20 billion in damage.
1993年：President Clinton signs 'Don't ask, don't tell' into law which prohibits gay or bisexual people from serving openly in the military.
1994年：North American Free Trade Agreement goes in effect.
1994年：1994 Northridge earthquake kills 72 and injures 9,000 in the Los Angeles area and causes $20 billion in damage.
1994年：Former Arkansas state employee Paula Jones accuses President Clinton of sexual harassment.
1994年：The United States hosts the FIFA World Cup, which is won by Brazil.

1995年：Retired professional football player O. J. Simpson is acquitted of two charges of first-degree murder in the 1994 slayings of his ex-wife, Nicole Brown Simpson, and Ronald Goldman. The nine-month trial receives worldwide publicity.
1995年：A heat wave kills 739 in Chicago, bringing to attention the plight of the urban poor and the elderly in extreme weather conditions.
1995年－1996年：A budget crisis forces the federal government to shut down for several weeks.
1996年：TWA Flight 800 explodes off Long Island killing all 230 aboard.
1996年：Khobar Towers bombing leaves 19 U.S. servicemen dead in Saudi Arabia.
1996年：Centennial Olympic Park bombing at Summer Olympics in Atlanta kills 1 and injures 111.
1996年：1996 United States presidential election: Bill Clinton is re-elected president, Al Gore is re-elected vice president.
1997年1月20日：President Clinton and Vice President Gore begin their second terms.
1997年：Sparked by a global economic crisis scare, the Dow Jones Industrial Average follows world markets and plummets 554.26, or 7.18%, to 7,161.15.
1998年：In the 1998 United States elections, the Republicans hold both the House and the Senate.

1998年－1999年：Clinton–Lewinsky scandal: President Clinton is accused of having a sexual relationship with 22-year-old White House intern Monica Lewinsky. This leads to the impeachment of Clinton later in the year by the U.S. House of Representatives. Clinton is acquitted of all impeachment charges of perjury and obstruction of justice in a 21-day Senate trial.
1999年：The Dow Jones Industrial Average closes above the 10,000 mark for the first time, at 10,006.78.
1999年：Teenage students Eric Harris and Dylan Klebold murder 12 other students and one teacher at Columbine High School, sparking an international debate on gun control and bullying.
1999年：A violent tornado outbreak in Oklahoma kills 50 people, becoming the first one to produce $1 billion in damage.
1999年：The first officer deliberately crashes EgyptAir Flight 990 south of Nantucket, Massachusetts, killing 217.

1999年：Along with the rest of the world, the U.S. prepares for the possible effects of the Y2K bug in computers, which was feared to cause computers to become inoperable and wreak havoc. The problem isn't as large as theorized, preparations are successful, and disaster is averted.
2000年：The Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, the USS Cole (DDG-67) is bombed in Yemeni waters, killing seventeen U.S. Navy sailors.

2000年：2000 United States presidential election: Initial result inconclusive and the result in Florida is disputed. George W. Bush is certified president after a Supreme Court ruling. Al Gore wins the nationwide popular vote but loses the electoral college. Dick Cheney is certified vice president.
2001年1月20日：Bush becomes the 43rd president; Cheney becomes the 46th vice president.
2001年：Democrats gain narrow control of Senate after Jim Jeffords defects from the Republican Party.
2001年：No Child Left Behind Act education reform bill passed.
2001年：Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act of 2001 institutes large tax cuts.
links: Economic Growth and Tax Relief Reconciliation Act of 2001

items.text: 2001年：Congress passes an emergency bailout package for the airline industry as a result of the attacks
2001年：Anthrax attacks kill 5 and infect a further 17 through the U.S. Mail system.
2001年：The United States launches the invasion of Afghanistan marking the start of Operation Enduring Freedom.
2001年：Patriot Act, increasing law enforcement agencies' ability to conduct searches in cases of suspected terrorism. Agencies were enforced.
2001年：American Airlines Flight 587 crashes in Queens, New York, killing 265.
2002年：The Department of Homeland Security is created in the wake of the September 11 attacks.
links: United States Department of Homeland Security

items.text: 2002年：The United States withdraws from Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty.
2002年：10 people are killed and 3 are injured in the Beltway sniper attacks around the Washington D.C. area.
2003年：Republicans retake narrow control of the Senate following 2002 elections.
2003年：Space Shuttle Columbia disintegrates upon re-entry to the Earth's atmosphere, killing all seven astronauts and resulting in a 29-month suspension of the Space Shuttle program.

2003年：A series of incidents occur that institute a crackdown on building, fire, and safety code violations across the United States, including the E2 nightclub stampede which killed 21, The Station nightclub fire which killed 100, and a porch collapse which killed 13.
2003年：U.S. forces continue fighting an insurgency in Iraq while helping the Iraqis build a new army of their own and develop a democratic form of government
2003年：In Iraq, deposed Iraqi president Saddam Hussein is captured by U.S. special forces.
2004年：The social networking website Facebook is launched.

2004年：The 2004 Atlantic hurricane season produces four deadly and damaging hurricanes which impact Florida, Charley, Frances, Ivan, and Jeanne, which kill a combined 100 people in the U.S. and produce over $50 billion in damage
2004年：Massachusetts becomes the first state to legalize same-sex marriage in compliance with a ruling from the state's Supreme Court ruling in Goodridge v. Department of Public Health
links: Same-sex marriage in the United States
Goodridge v. Department of Public Health

items.text: 2004年：Former President Ronald Reagan dies from complications resulting from Alzheimer's disease. He lies in state at the U.S. Capitol building before being interred.
links: Death and state funeral of Ronald Reagan

items.text: 2004年：2004 United States presidential election: George W. Bush is re-elected president, Dick Cheney is re-elected vice president.
2005年1月20日：President Bush and Vice President Cheney begin their second terms.
2006年：The Democratic Party retakes control of both houses of Congress, and gains a majority of state governorships (28-22).
2007年：Democrat Nancy Pelosi becomes the first female speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
links: Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives

items.text: 2007年：George W. Bush orders a troop surge which substantially increases the number of U.S. troops in Iraq and ultimately leads to reductions in casualties and major victories for coalition and Iraqi forces, against the insurgency.

2007年：A South Korean student shoots and kills 32 other students and professors in the Virginia Tech shooting before killing himself. It stands as the worst mass shooting in U.S. history until 2016 and spurs a series of debates on gun control and journalism ethics.
2007年：The first iPhone is released for sale in the U.S.

2007年：The I-35W Mississippi River bridge in Minneapolis, Minnesota collapses, killing 13 people. The bridge collapse brings to national attention the need to rehabilitate the aging U.S. infrastructure system.
2007年：The Great Recession officially begins in December.
links: Great Recession in the United States

items.text: 2008年：The Super Tuesday tornado outbreak kills over 60 people and produces $1 billion in damage across Arkansas, Kentucky, Tennessee, and Alabama.

2008年：Steven Kazmierczak kills five, injures 21, and then kills himself in the Northern Illinois University shooting. After this incident, calls are made for more focus on mental health services and interest grows substantially in the group Students for Concealed Carry on Campus.
links: Students for Concealed Carry on Campus

items.text: 2008年：Hurricane Ike kills 100 people along the Texas coast, produces $31 billion in damage, and contributes to rising oil prices.
2008年：U.S. oil prices hit a record $147 per barrel in the wake of—among other factors—international tensions and the falling U.S. dollar vs. the Euro.

2008年：The 2008 financial crisis begins as the stock market crashes. In response, U.S. President George W. Bush signs the revised Emergency Economic Stabilization Act into law to create a 700 billion dollar Treasury fund to purchase failing bank assets.
links: United States Emergency Economic Stabilization fund

items.text: 2008年：2008 United States presidential election: Barack Obama is elected president, and Joe Biden elected vice president.
2009年1月20日：Obama becomes the 44th president, Biden becomes the 47th vice president. Obama is the first African-American to hold the office.

2009年：The first of a series of Tea Party protests are conducted across the United States, focusing on smaller government, fiscal responsibility, individual freedoms and conservative views of the Constitution.
2009年：President Obama obtains Congressional approval for the $787 billion stimulus package, the largest since President Dwight D. Eisenhower.
links: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009

items.text: 2009年：Pop icon Michael Jackson dies, creating the largest public mourning for an entertainer since the death of Elvis Presley.
2009年：Nidal Hasan kills 12 servicemen and injures 31 in the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.

pages.title: Timeline of the history of the United States (2010–present)
pages.displayTitle: Timeline of the history of the United States (2010–present)
pages.sourcePage: Timeline of the history of the United States (2010–present)

items.text: 2010年：The Deepwater Horizon oil rig in the Gulf of Mexico explodes, spilling millions of gallons of oil into the sea. The spill becomes the worst oil spill in American history.
2010年：In the 2010 Midterm elections, the Republicans retake the House of Representatives as the Democrats lose 63 seats.
links: United States House of Representatives elections, 2010

items.text: 2011年：Representative Gabrielle Giffords is severely wounded in an assassination attempt when a gunman went on a shooting spree, killing federal judge John Roll and five other people, and wounding at least 13 others, at an event Giffords was hosting in suburban Tucson, Arizona.
2011年：The ATF gunwalking scandal emerged, wherein thousands of guns were allowed to "walk" through interdiction to Mexico, supposedly to aid in the capture of criminals.
2011年：A series of tornadoes cause heavy damage in the South, Alabama being the hardest hit. 324 people are killed in the deadliest American natural disaster since Hurricane Katrina.
2011年：Osama bin Laden, leader of al-Qaeda and mastermind of the September 11 attacks, is killed in Abbottabad, Pakistan, by U.S. Navy SEALs.
2011年：Flooding devastates the Mississippi River valley causing $2 to $4 billion in damage.
2011年：A tornado devastates Joplin, Missouri, killing 158 and injuring over 1,000, making it the deadliest single U.S. tornado since the advent of modern weather forecasting

2011年：Casey Marie Anthony is acquitted of all charges related to the death of her daughter, Caylee; she was convicted of four counts of providing false information to a law enforcement officer. She was released a week later because of credit for time served.

2011年：STS-135: The Space Shuttle Atlantis touches down at the Shuttle Landing Facility at Kennedy Space Center, ending the 30-year shuttle program, which began with the launch of Space Shuttle Columbia on April 12, 1981.
2012年：A gunman kills 12 and injures 70 at a movie theater in Aurora, Colorado.
2012年：Hurricane Sandy strikes the Eastern Seaboard.
2012年：2012 United States presidential election: Barack Obama reelected president, Joe Biden reelected vice president.
2013年1月20日：President Obama and Vice President Biden begin their second terms.

2013年：Christopher Dorner murders three people in Southern California, starting the largest manhunt in Los Angeles history. His spree ends in Big Bear Lake, California where he barricades himself in a cabin, kills a second officer, before committing suicide.
2013年：Edward Snowden leaks highly classified documents from the National Security Agency.

2013年：Terrorists attack the Boston Marathon by detonating two bombs at the finishing line of the race, killing three and injuring 283 runners and spectators. Suspects Tamerlan and Dzhokhar Tsarnaev then led Boston police on a high-speed chase, killing one officer at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Tamerlan was killed in a shootout with police and Dzhokhar was detained the day after.
2013年：A tornado devastates suburbs near Oklahoma City, killing 24.
2013年：The most destructive wildfire in Colorado history burns nearly 16,000 acres and kills two people.

2013年：The Supreme Court strikes down the Defense of Marriage Act, which banned the federal recognition of same-sex marriages and refused to recognize the legal standing of proponents of Proposition 8, which resulted in the re-legalization of same-sex marriage in California.
links: Supreme Court of the United States

items.text: 2013年：Black Lives Matter emerges as a political movement, protesting against widespread racial profiling, police brutality, and racial inequality in the United States criminal justice system.
links: Police brutality in the United States
Race in the United States criminal justice system

items.text: 2014年：A grand jury decides not to charge Officer Darren Wilson in the shooting death of Michael Brown inciting protests and riots against racism and police brutality in the St. Louis area Causing riot.
2014年：The Republicans win the Senate in the Midterm elections.
2015年：Dzhokhar Tsarnaev is convicted and sentenced to death for committing the Boston Marathon bombing.
2015年：Dylann Roof kills 9 people during a Bible study at the Emanuel African Methodist Episcopal Church in Charleston, South Carolina.
2015年：Rizwan Farook and Tashfeen Malik carried out an attack at the Inland Regional Center in San Bernardino, California, killing 14 and seriously injuring 22 others.
2016年：Omar Mateen kills 49 people and injures 53 members of the LGBT community at the Pulse nightclub.
2016年：2016 United States presidential election: Donald Trump elected president, Mike Pence elected vice president.
2016年：36 people are killed in the Oakland Warehouse Fire.
2017年：Fort Lauderdale airport shooting.
2017年1月20日：Trump becomes the 45th president, Pence becomes the 48th vice president. Trump is the first person without prior military or government service to hold the office.
2017年：Trump fires FBI director James Comey, precipitating the Mueller investigation.
2017年：Relations between the U.S. and the U.N. and North Korea strain after the country tested missiles in various places.
2017年4月：The United States drops missiles and bombs on Syria.

2017年：A white supremacist rally in Charlottesville, Virginia leads to three deaths and to the discussion about racism in modern American society. The term alt-right receives renewed popular consciousness.

2017年：Hurricane Harvey makes landfall in the United States, flooding broad swaths of Texas and Louisiana and causing tens of billions of dollars of damage, making it one of the costliest natural disasters in U.S. history.
2017年：Hurricane Irma makes landfall in Florida and causes tens of billions of dollars of damage. Irma also wrecks the Caribbean Islands.
2017年：Hurricane Maria made landfall on Puerto Rico as a Category 5 hurricane, killing hundreds and knocking out the island's power.
2017年10月1日：A gunman opens fire at a Las Vegas Strip concert, killing 60 people and injuring 867. This was the deadliest mass shooting in modern U.S. history.

2017年11月5日：A gunman kills 26 people and wounds 22 others at a church in Sutherland Springs, Texas, before killing himself. This was the deadliest mass shooting in Texas history and the deadliest shooting in an American place of worship in modern history.
2017年：Film producer Harvey Weinstein is accused of sexual harassment in a New York Times expose, marking the beginning of the Me Too movement.
2018年2月14日：A gunman kills 17 people and injures 17 at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida.
2018年：Donald Trump meets with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in Singapore.
2018年：The entire West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals is impeached.
links: Impeachment of the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia, 2018

items.text: 2018年：In the 2018 United States elections, the Democrats retake the House while the Republicans keep the Senate.
2018年10月27日：A gunman opens fire on the Tree of Life congregation in the Pittsburgh synagogue shooting killing 11 and wounding 6.
2018年：Creator of SpongeBob SquarePants Stephen Hillenburg and Creative leader of Marvel Comics Stan Lee both die in November.
2018年11月30日：Former U.S. President George H. W. Bush dies from complications resulting from Parkinson's disease. He lies in the state at the U.S. Capitol building before being interred.
links: Death and state funeral of George H. W. Bush

items.text: 2019年：All the works published in 1923 except for sound recordings (2022 scheduled events) enter the public domain in the United States.
2019年1月1日：Washington bans all persons under 21 years of age from purchasing a semi-automatic rifle.
2019年1月25日：The second-longest government shutdown in American history, which lasted from December 22, 2018 to January 25, 2019 (35 days), officially ends.
2019年1月30日：Large portions of the United States are hit with a polar vortex. The city of Chicago once again hit a record low: 27 degrees below zero. It occurred for fifty-two straight hours.
2019年2月1日：President Donald Trump confirms that the U.S. will leave the Intermediate-range Nuclear Forces Treaty.
2019年：Mexican drug boss/lord Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán is found guilty on all ten counts at a drug-trafficking trial in New York.
2019年2月22日：Singer R. Kelly charged with ten counts of aggravated criminal sexual abuse for incidents dating back as far as the year 1998.
2019年2月27日：2019 North Korea – United States Hanoi Summit held in Vietnam. It is the second summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.
links: 2019 North Korea – United States Hanoi Summit

items.text: 2019年3月26日：Vice President Mike Pence orders NASA to fly Americans to the Moon within the next five years, using either government or private carriers.
2019年：The Supreme Court case Bucklew V. Precythe rules 5 to 4 that inmates on death row are not guaranteed "painless executions" under the Constitution.

2019年4月4日：The 1973 War Powers Act Resolution is invoked for the first time when the House of Representatives votes 247–175 to end U.S. military assistance in Saudi Arabia in its intervention in the Yemeni Civil War.
2019年4月：The first image of a black hole is taken.
2019年4月：James Earl Carter Jr. becomes the longest ever living U.S. president at 94 years old, following the death of George H. W. Bush in December 2018.
2019年4月27日：A gunman kills one and injures three in a California synagogue. The suspect is white supremacist John Timothy Earnest, who was 19 years old at the time.
2019年5月31日：A city employee for Virginia Beach enters a municipal building with a gun and kills 12 people.
2019年6月8日：President Trump reaches an agreement with Mexico to avoid tariffs.
2019年6月9日：A construction crane falls on an apartment complex in Dallas, killing 1 person and injuring 6.
2019年6月14日：One person dies and two more are injured after a gunman entered a Costco in Southern California.
2019年7月26日：The Supreme Court rules in a 5–4 vote to give President Trump $2.5 billion to fund the Mexico–United States border wall.
2019年8月3日：23 people are killed and another 23 are injured in a mass shooting at a Walmart in El Paso, Texas.
2019年8月4日：A gunman opens fire on a bar in Dayton, Ohio. He kills nine people and injures another 27.

2019年8月10日：Financier and convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein is found dead in his prison cell under mysterious circumstances. It was declared a suicide by hanging, although the ruling is widely disputed.

2019年8月12日：An anonymous whistleblower filed a complaint against Donald Trump and Rudy Giuliani, claiming that the two sought foreign intervention in the 2020 presidential election. This complaint would lead to an investigation into the Trump-Ukraine scandal.
2019年9月24日：Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi announces the House of Representatives would begin an impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump.
2019年12月18日：The U.S. House of Representatives impeaches President Trump for high crimes and misdemeanors.
2020年1月3日：President Donald Trump approves the targeted killing of Iranian general Qasem Soleimani and Iraqi paramilitary leader Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis in Baghdad, Iraq.
2020年1月16日：The first impeachment trial of President Donald Trump begins in the U.S. Senate.
links: First impeachment trial of Donald Trump

items.text: 2020年1月21日：The first patient in the United States is diagnosed with coronavirus.
links: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States

items.text: 2020年1月26日：Kobe Bryant, along with his daughter, Gianna, and 7 others, perish in a helicopter crash.
2020年2月5日：The majority of the United States Senate votes to acquit President Trump of charges related to the Trump-Ukraine scandal.
2020年2月24日：Former film producer Harvey Weinstein is found guilty of rape.
2020年2月26日：6 people are killed in a mass shooting in Milwaukee, Wisconsin before the perpetrator killed himself.
2020年2月29日：The Trump administration and the Taliban sign a conditional peace agreement in Doha, Qatar as part of a process to end the War in Afghanistan.
2020年3月3日：Super Tuesday 2020 takes place.
2020年3月5日：The U.S. Senate approves an $8.3 billion federal emergency aid package in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.
links: Coronavirus Preparedness and Response Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2020

items.text: 2020年3月11日：The World Health Organization officially declares COVID-19 a global pandemic.
2020年3月13日：President Trump declares a national emergency in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, freeing up $50 billion in disaster relief funds.
links: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States

items.text: 2020年3月16日：The Dow Jones falls by −2,997.10, the single largest point drop in history and the second largest percentage drop ever at −12.93%, a larger crash than the Wall Street Crash of 1929. Most schools are also closed by this date.
links: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education

items.text: 2020年3月18日：President Trump signs the Families First Coronavirus Response Act into law and announces he will invoke the Defense Production Act to improve U.S. medical resources as well as directing the Housing and Urban Development Department (HUD) to suspend evictions and foreclosures of federal housing until the end of April.
links: United States Department of Housing and Urban Development

items.text: 2020年3月24日：The U.S. box office records zero revenue for the first time ever.

2020年3月26日：The Trump administration indicts Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro's government of drug trafficking and narcoterrorism and offers a $15 million reward for information leading to Maduro's arrest.
2020年3月27日：President Trump signs the CARES Act in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.
2020年4月8日：Senator Bernie Sanders suspends his presidential campaign, leaving Joe Biden as the presumptive Democratic nominee.
2020年4月11日：The U.S. becomes the country with the highest number of reported COVID-19 deaths: over 20,000, overtaking Italy.
2020年4月14日：President Trump announces that he will suspend U.S. funding of the World Health Organization (WHO) pending an investigation into its early response to the outbreak.

2020年4月15日：Michigan governor Gretchen Whitmer faces two federal lawsuits accusing her of violating constitutional rights during the state's containment efforts. Thousands of people attend a protest in Lansing as anti-lockdown sentiment spreads.
links: COVID-19 anti-lockdown protests in the United States

items.text: 2020年4月16日：It is revealed that nearly 22 million Americans have filed for unemployment within a single month due to COVID-19 lockdowns, the worst unemployment crisis since the Great Depression.
2020年4月21日：Oil prices reach a record low, falling into negative values, due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic and the Russia–Saudi Arabia oil price war.
2020年4月27日：The US Pentagon releases three UFO videos.
2020年4月30日：Armed protesters enter the Michigan State Capitol building to demand an end to lockdown measures.
2020年5月15日：The Trump administration formally announces Operation Warp Speed, a public–private partnership for accelerating the development of a COVID-19 vaccine.

2020年5月25日：George Floyd, an African-American man living in Minneapolis, dies by asphyxiation after police officer Derek Chauvin knelt on Floyd's neck and back for over nine minutes. This occurred during an arrest in which Floyd was suspected of using a counterfeit twenty-dollar bill. Chauvin was arrested for murder and multiple demonstrations against police brutality occurred globally.
2020年8月28日：Actor Chadwick Boseman dies from colon cancer.

2020年5月27日：The official nationwide COVID-19 death toll surpasses 100,000—more Americans than were killed in the Vietnam and Korean wars combined, and approaching that of the First World War, when more than 116,000 Americans died in combat.
2020年9月18日：Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg dies.
links: Death and state funeral of Ruth Bader Ginsburg

items.text: 2020年10月2日：President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump are diagnosed with COVID-19. The former is taken to Walter Reed hospital.
links: Walter Reed National Military Medical Center

items.text: 2020年10月8日：The FBI announces that thirteen men have been arrested for plotting to kidnap Gretchen Whitmer.
2020年10月10日：Lee Keltner, a navy veteran and custom western hat maker, was shot following a "patriot rally" in Denver.
2020年10月31日：Most protest-related deaths this year involved shootings, with many incidents stemming from confrontations at protests that escalated fatally when at least one participant was armed.
2020年11月3日：2020 United States presidential election
2020年11月7日：Four days after election day, Joe Biden is elected president; Kamala Harris is elected vice president.
2020年12月14日：The first doses of the Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine are given out in the United States.
2021年1月6日：Trump-supporting rioters storm the United States Capitol, forcing Congress to evacuate and interrupting the Electoral College vote count that certified Joe Biden's victory.
links: 2021 storming of the United States Capitol
2021 United States Electoral College vote count

items.text: 2021年1月13日：Trump becomes the only president to be impeached for a second time. Ten Republicans join all Senate Democrats in voting to impeach Trump.

2021年1月20日：President Biden signs his first executive orders reversing several Trump administration actions, including rejoining the Paris Agreement and the World Health Organization, repealing the 2017 travel bans, ending funding for the United States–Mexico border wall, and revoking the permit for the Keystone XL pipeline.
links: List of executive actions by Joe Biden

items.text: 2021年1月20日：Biden becomes the 46th president and Harris becomes the 49th vice president. Harris is the first woman to hold her office.
2021年2月13日：Donald Trump is acquitted by the Senate in his second impeachment trial. Seven Republicans joined Democrats in voting to convict Trump.
links: Second impeachment trial of Donald Trump

items.text: 13年2月－17年：A major winter storm kills 58 people in the United States (and 12 in Mexico) and causes over 9,724,000 power outages across 13 states in the Midwest and Southwest, with Southwest Power Pool declaring an "energy emergency".
15年2月：House Speaker Nancy Pelosi announces that Congress will establish a 9/11-styled commission to investigate the January 6 riot at the United States Capitol.
links: Speaker of the United States House of Representatives

items.text: 2021年3月7日：Floods in Hawaii leave one missing, destroy six homes, force evacuations, and leave 1,300 without electricity.
2021年3月11日：American Rescue Plan Act of 2021 is passed.
2021年3月16日：A spa shooting in Atlanta leaves 8 dead; 6 of the victims were of Asian descent.
2021年3月22日：Ten people are killed in a mass shooting at a King Soopers location in Boulder, Colorado. This is the second mass shooting with at least 8 dead in a week.
2021年3月31日：Four people are killed and two others, including the suspect, are injured in a shooting at an office building in Orange, California.

2021年4月2日：The Capitol Building in Washington, D.C. is placed under lockdown after a suspect rams a car into a barricade on Constitution Avenue and exits the vehicle holding a knife. Two police officers are injured in the attack and taken to a hospital, where one dies from his injuries. The suspect is killed by Capitol Police.
2021年4月－2022年1月：Arizona's Maricopa County conducts an audit of the 2020 presidential election ballots, claiming election fraud.
2021年4月7日：Six people are killed by gunshots at a house in Rock Hill, South Carolina. The shooter, former NFL cornerback Phillip Adams, later committed suicide.
2021年4月15日：Nine people are killed, including the shooter, and seven injured, in a mass shooting at a FedEx facility in Indianapolis.
2021年5月9日：Seven people are shot dead at a birthday party in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
2021年5月26日：A mass shooting occurs at a Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority rail yard in San Jose, California, leaving ten people dead, including the gunman, who committed suicide.
2021年6月17日：Juneteenth National Independence Day Act is passed, making Juneteenth a federal holiday.
2021年6月24日：A condominium in Miami collapses, killing ninety-eight people and injuring eleven others.
2021年8月10日：New York Governor Andrew Cuomo announces he will resign effective August 24 after an inquiry found he sexually harassed multiple women.
2021年8月30日：The United States withdraws its remaining troops from Afghanistan, ending its 20-year involvement in the War in Afghanistan.
2021年10月13日：Star Trek actor William Shatner becomes the oldest person to go into space, at age 90, on board the Blue Origin NS-18, launched from Texas.
2021年11月5日：A crowd crush during a Travis Scott concert at the Astroworld Festival in Houston kills ten people and injures more than 300.
2021年11月15日：The Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act is signed into law.

2021年11月17日：The U.S. House of Representatives votes 223–207 to censure Rep. Paul Gosar (R–AZ) after he posted a photo-shopped anime clip of him killing Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D–NY) and threatening President Biden, making him the first lawmaker to be censured since Charlie Rangel in 2010.
2021年11月30日：Four students are killed and seven other people are injured in a mass shooting at Oxford High School in Oxford Township, Michigan.
2021年12月10日：A late season tornado outbreak occurs in the Southern and Midwestern United States, causing major damage and killing at least 94 people.

2021年12月29日：British socialite Ghislaine Maxwell is convicted in a federal court on five of six charges relating to her recruiting and trafficking young girls to be sexually abused by the late financier Jeffrey Epstein.
2022年5月24日：A school shooting in Uvalde, Texas kills 19 students and two teachers.
2022年6月24日：Roe v. Wade is overturned by the Supreme Court.
links: Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization

items.text: 2022年11月：In the 2022 United States elections, the Republicans retake the House while the Democrats keep the Senate.
2023年1月：Kevin McCarthy is elected Speaker of the House of Representatives on the fifteenth ballot.
links: January 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election

items.text: 2023年：March, April 2023 – Former president Donald Trump is indicted and arraigned. He pleads not guilty on 34 counts of falsifying business records.
links: Prosecution of Donald Trump in New York

items.text: 2023年：August, 2023 - Wildfires in Hawaii kill over 100 and caused $5.5 billion in damages.
2023年10月3日：McCarthy becomes the first Speaker of the United States House of Representatives to be removed from office.
links: Speaker of the United States House of Representatives

items.text: 2023年10月25日：Mike Johnson elected Speaker.
2023年10月：present – Over 115 attacks occur on U.S. military bases in Iraq and Syria.
links: Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq and Syria (2023–present)

items.text: 2024年3月26日：The Francis Scott Key Bridge in Baltimore, Maryland collapses, killing 6 construction workers.

7年7月：11, 2024 – Hurricane Beryl makes landfall in Texas, causing at least $6 billion (2024 USD) in damage to the state, before continuing across the central United States, where it produced a large and significant tornado outbreak consisting of 68 tornadoes. At least 48 deaths occurred in the United States as a result of Beryl.
links: Effects of Hurricane Beryl in Texas

items.text: 2024年7月13日：While campaigning for the 2024 U.S. presidential election, former President of the United States Donald Trump is injured in an assassination attempt at a rally he held near Butler, Pennsylvania.
links: 2024 shooting at a Donald Trump rally

items.text: 13年7月：16, 2024 – An intense sequence of severe weather outbreaks affected much of the Midwestern and Northeastern United States, producing two significant derechoes that each had wind gusts exceeding 100 mph (160 km/h), as well as multiple tornado outbreaks that produced a combined 90 tornadoes.
2024年7月21日：Incumbent President Joe Biden withdraws from the 2024 United States presidential election, endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris to replace him as the Democratic nominee.
links: Withdrawal of Joe Biden from the 2024 United States presidential election

items.text: 2024年9月：Hurricane Helene causes devastation in the Southeastern United States, killing over 230.
2024年10月：Hurricane Milton strikes Florida, killing at least 24.

2024年11月：The 2024 United States elections result in a Government trifecta for the Republicans. In the presidential race, Donald Trump and JD Vance defeated Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. In Congress, the Republicans gain control of the United States Senate and retain control of the United States House of Representatives.

2024年12月4日：Brian Thompson, CEO of UnitedHealthCare, was shot and killed outside the New York Hilton Midtown in New York City. Alleged killer Luigi Mangione was arrested five days later in Altoona, Pennsylvania and was charged with the murder of Thompson.
2024年12月29日：Jimmy Carter, president of the United States from 1977 to 1981, dies at the age of 100 in Plains, Georgia. He was the only centenarian president.
links: Death and state funeral of Jimmy Carter

items.text: 2025年1月1日：A truck attack kills 15 people in New Orleans, Louisiana. A separate incident occurred on the same day in Paradise, Nevada after a Cybertruck exploded at the entrance of Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, killing the perpetrator.
2025年1月：Wildfires in Southern California killed at least 24 people, forced nearly 180,000 to evacuate, and destroyed or damaged more than 10,000 structures in the Los Angeles area.

2025年1月18日：Social media company TikTok, which has 170 million users in the United States, goes offline in the United States before a law banning the platform would take effect. TikTok services were restored the next day.
links: Restrictions on TikTok in the United States

items.text: 2025年1月20日：Donald Trump is inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States, and JD Vance becomes the 50th Vice President of the United States. Trump signs a number of executive orders which withdrew from the Paris Climate Accords, established the Department of Government Efficiency, pardoned January 6th defendants, delayed the TikTok ban, and attempted to end birthright citizenship, among other things.
links: List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump
United States and the Paris Agreement
Pardon of January 6 United States Capitol attack defendants
Restrictions on TikTok in the United States
Protecting the Meaning and Value of American Citizenship
Birthright citizenship in the United States

items.text: 2025年1月：The Trump Administration begins mass immigration enforcement raids and deportations against undocumented immigrants. U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement raids have caused fear in immigrant populations. Detentions of pro-Palestinian academic activists have also occurred.
links: Deportation in the second presidency of Donald Trump
Undocumented immigrant population of the United States
Visa and deportation controversies in the second Trump administration

items.text: 2025年1月29日：American Eagle Flight 5342 collides with a U.S. Army Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk over the Potomac River in Washington, D.C. near Reagan National Airport, killing all people on both aircraft, including U.S. Figure Skating athletes. It was the deadliest U.S. air disaster in nearly a quarter century.
2025年1月31日：Med Jets Flight 056 crashed in Northeast Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, killing 7 people including everyone on board and one person on the ground. The flight injured at least 22 people.

2025年2月1日：The United States enters a trade war with Canada and Mexico after Donald Trump signed tariffs on the two nations as well as China. Mexico and Canada claims this action violates the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement.
links: 2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico

items.text: 2025年2月：Thousands of federal workers in the U.S. government's bureaucracy are fired by the Trump administration and its Department of Government Efficiency, led by Elon Musk. Agencies, such as the National Nuclear Security Administration, the United States Department of Transportation, USAID, and the National Park Service, among others, are affected.
2025年2月22日：A mass shooting and hostage situation occurs at the UPMC Memorial Hospital in Shiloh, Pennsylvania. Two people, the shooter and a police officer, were killed and five were injured.

2025年2月28日：Donald Trump and JD Vance get into an argument with Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the White House over U.S. support for Ukraine. This occurs after the U.S. sided with Russia in a United Nations resolution that condemned Russian aggression against Ukraine.

2025年3月11日：Information regarding military operations in Yemen were leaked after Jeffrey Goldberg, an editor from The Atlantic, was accidentally added into a Signal group chat with senior government officials.
links: United States government group chat leak

items.text: 2025年3月15日：Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran national residing in Maryland, is unlawfully deported by the Trump administration via an "administrative error." Garcia was imprisoned without trial at the Terrorism Confinement Center maximum security prison in El Salvador. Despite court orders to "facilitate and effectuate" his return, the Trump administration and Salvadoran president Nayib Bukele initially refused to do so. Garcia was returned to the United States in June to face criminal charges.
2025年3月15日：Over 53 people are killed after the U.S. military launched large-scale air and naval attacks against Houthis in Yemen.
links: March 2025 United States attacks in Yemen

items.text: 2025年3月31日：Senator Cory Booker of New Jersey delivered a 25 hour long speech in the U.S. Senate to protest the policies of Donald Trump and Elon Musk. It surpassed Strom Thurmond's filibuster of the Civil Rights Act of 1957 to become the longest speech in Senate history.
links: Strom Thurmond filibuster of the Civil Rights Act of 1957

items.text: 2025年4月1日：Susan M. Crawford defeated Brad Schimel in the 2025 Wisconsin Supreme Court election, which became the most expensive judicial race in U.S. history.
2025年4月2日：Donald Trump announced a 10% universal import duty on all goods brought into the U.S. and even higher rates for certain trading partners as a part of his protectionist tariff policies.
links: Tariffs in the second Trump administration

items.text: 2025年4月17日：A shooting at Florida State University kills 2 and injures 6.
2025年5月8日：Following the 2025 papal conclave, Pope Leo XIV (born Robert Francis Prevost) of Chicago, Illinois, became the first pope born in the United States.
2025年5月15日：27 people are killed in a tornado outbreak that impacted the Midwestern and Southeastern United States.
2025年5月21日：2 Israeli embassy staff members are shot and killed outside the Lillian & Albert Small Capital Jewish Museum in Washington, D.C.
links: Embassy of Israel in Washington, D.C.
2025 killing of Israeli Embassy workers in Washington, D.C.
Lillian & Albert Small Capital Jewish Museum

items.text: 2025年6月：Demonstrations against Donald Trump's immigration policies erupt in Los Angeles, California, along with other demonstrations (including the No Kings protests) across the country. To quell the demonstrations in Los Angeles, Trump deployed U.S. Marines to the city and federalized the California National Guard, against California governor Gavin Newsom's wishes.
links: 2025 United States protests against mass deportation

items.text: 2025年6月14日：Minnesota legislator Melissa Hortman and her spouse are assassinated in what law-enforcement believe is an anti-abortion motivated attack. Another legislator, John Hoffman and his spouse, were also targeted, but survived.
2025年6月21日：The U.S. enters the Twelve-Day War following strikes on three Iranian nuclear sites.
links: 2025 United States strikes on Iranian nuclear sites

items.text: 2025年6月29日：Two firefighters are killed in an ambush while responding to a brush fire in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho.
2025年7月3日：The United States Congress narrowly passes the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. President Trump signs it into law the next day.
4年7月：7, 2025 – Floods in the Texas Hill Country of Central Texas kill over 100.
2025年7月7日：The U.S. Department of Justice releases a memo claiming that the Epstein files do not exist, creating division among the Trump's political base.

2025年7月28日：3 people are killed and 7 injured in mass shooting at the Grand Sierra Resort in Reno, Nevada. Later in the day, a separate mass shooting in the Midtown Manhattan neighborhood of New York City kills 4 and injures 1.

2025年8月11日：President Trump invokes the District of Columbia Home Rule Act using dubious claims about crime in Washington, D.C. to take over the District of Columbia Metropolitan Police Department and deploy the District of Columbia National Guard and federal law enforcement to the District.
links: District of Columbia Home Rule Act
District of Columbia Metropolitan Police Department
Declaring a Crime Emergency in the District of Columbia

items.text: 2025年8月20日：The Texas State House passes a new congressional map which gives Republicans an advantage in the 2026 United States House of Representatives elections. This action initiated a wave of redistricting by both parties in several states to give themselves an advantage in the 2026 midterms through gerrymandering.
links: 2026 United States House of Representatives elections

items.text: 2025年8月27日：A shooting at the Church of the Annunciation in Minneapolis, Minnesota leaves three dead and twenty-three injured.

2025年9月1日：The U.S. Navy begins military strikes on alleged drug traffickers in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea, killing at least 87 in what has been described as extrajudicial killings that violate international law.
links: 2025 United States military strikes on alleged drug traffickers

items.text: 2025年9月10日：Conservative political commentator Charlie Kirk is assassinated at a Turning Point USA event at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah.

2025年10月1日：The U.S. Federal Government enters a shutdown after Congress failed to pass appropriations legislation. On November 5th, it became the longest shutdown in U.S. history. Eight senate Democrats joined Republicans in passing an agreement to end the shutdown on November 9th, and the House voted to end the shutdown on November 12th.
2025年10月10日：An explosion at a munitions factory in Humphreys County, Tennessee kills 16.

2025年11月4日：The November 2025 United States elections result in what has been described as "blue wave" for the Democrats, with them winning gubernatorial races in Virginia and New Jersey. In New York City, Democrat Zohran Mamdani wins the city's mayoral race and the Democrats win several downballot races in Georgia and Pennsylvania. The Democrats also pass Proposition 50 in California, which will allow them to redistrict the state's congressional districts.
2025年11月4日：UPS Airlines Flight 2976 crashes near Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport in Louisville, Kentucky, killing at least 12.
2025年11月12日：The last Penny is minted by the Philadelphia Mint after more than two centuries of circulation.
links: Penny debate in the United States

items.text: 2025年11月19日：The Epstein Files Transparency Act is signed into law by President Trump, which requires that all files relating to Jeffrey Epstein be released.
2025年11月26日：Two members of the West Virginia National Guard, who were deployed to Washington, D.C., were shot near Farragut West Station.
links: Declaring a Crime Emergency in the District of Columbia

items.text: 2025年12月19日：Portions of the Epstein Files are released by the U.S. Department of Justice as a result of the deadline set by the Epstein Files Transparency Act. The release has been highly criticized for heavy redactions and multiple unreleased documents.
2026年1月3日：The U.S. Armed Forces launches strikes on Venezuela and captures Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro.

2026年1月：Federal law enforcement conduct Operation Metro Surge with the purpose of apprehending undocumented immigrants in the Twin Cities area of Minnesota. The operations result in the killings of U.S. citizens Renée Good and Alex Pretti, anti-ICE demonstrations, and the disruption of everyday life in Minnesota.
2026年1月：At least 88 people are killed as a major winter storm encompases North America, including the Northeastern and Southern United States.
2026年1月19日：A sewage spill releases over 240 million gallons of untreated wastewater into the Potomac River in one of the largest sewage spills in U.S. history.
2026年1月22日：The United States officially withdraws from the World Health Organization.
2026年2月5日：New START, a nuclear arms reduction treaty between the United States and Russia, officially expires.
2026年2月14日：A partial government shutdown, impacting the Department of Homeland Security, begins. The shutdown sees major disruptions at U.S. airports.

2026年2月20日：The Supreme Court's ruling in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump vacates many of the tariffs implemented by Donald Trump under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, which are quickly replaced with new tariffs under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974.
links: Tariffs in the second Trump administration
Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974

items.text: 2026年2月28日：The U.S. and Israel launch strikes on Iran, killing Iranian supreme leader Ali Khamenei, and starting a war against Iran.
2026年4月1日：Artemis II is launched by NASA, becoming the first crewed mission past low Earth orbit since the Apollo program.
2026年4月25日：A shooting occurs at the 2026 White House Correspondent's Dinner. One officer was shot in the bullet-resistant vest while President Trump was left unharmed.
2026年5月2日：American low-cost carrier Spirit Airlines ceases operations after entering Chapter 11 bankrupcy.
2026年5月21日：50,000 people are placed in an evacuation order after a chemical leak occurs in Orange County, California.
2026年6月11日：The 2026 FIFA World Cup, hosted by the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, opens.
2026年6月12日：Elon Musk becomes the first US-dollar trillionaire in U.S. and world history.
